records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources organised a two-day symposium in Salalah on water resources sustainability and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources organised a two-day symposium in Salalah on water resources sustainability and climate change, in partnership with Dhofar Municipality, Nama Dhofar Services, UNESCO and other national institutions. The event focused on strengthening water-resource management, climate adaptation, modern technologies, and policies and partnerships to enhance water sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Pakistan agreed to strengthen cooperation on food security and agricultural trade, with a target of increasing Pakistan’...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Pakistan agreed to strengthen cooperation on food security and agricultural trade, with a target of increasing Pakistan’s agricultural and food exports to Saudi Arabia to $3 billion. Priority areas include rice, red meat, fruits and fruit concentrates, green fodder, and water-efficient agricultural technologies. The two sides also agreed to facilitate private-sector partnerships, expand trade and investment in livestock, agri-food processing and rice value chains, and advance water-efficient irrigation initiatives, supporting Saudi Arabia’s food security priorities and Pakistan’s agricultural export growth.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Oman will host the International United Nations Symposium on Water Resources Sustainability in Salalah under the theme “Water and Climate...
records.description: Oman will host the International United Nations Symposium on Water Resources Sustainability in Salalah under the theme “Water and Climate Change,” bringing together experts to discuss sustainable water management and climate resilience. Key topics include drought, floods and salinity risks, desalination and treated-water reuse, improving agricultural water-use efficiency, protecting groundwater, rehabilitating traditional aflaj irrigation systems, and applying AI, remote sensing and hydrological modelling. The symposium aims to share expertise and promote innovative approaches to strengthening water security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Oman’s Industrial Strategy 2040 is allocating RO 935 million to polymer and packaging projects as part of efforts to strengthen local man...
records.description: Oman’s Industrial Strategy 2040 is allocating RO 935 million to polymer and packaging projects as part of efforts to strengthen local manufacturing, reduce import dependence, and develop circular economy opportunities. The SOHAR Port and Freezone is advancing a polyethylene foam packaging plant with United Packaging Industries, while smart manufacturing and workforce programmes aim to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and create higher-quality employment. The strategy also targets stronger non-oil exports and greater private-sector and foreign investment in manufacturing.
records.institution: SOHAR Port and Freezone

records.title: Saudi Arabia will host the Innovation Driven Water Sustainability Conference (IDWS 2026) in Jeddah, bringing together global water-sector...
records.description: Saudi Arabia will host the Innovation Driven Water Sustainability Conference (IDWS 2026) in Jeddah, bringing together global water-sector leaders, investors, researchers, and innovators to advance sustainable water solutions. The conference will focus on desalination, water reuse, circular systems, AI and digital technologies, agricultural water use, infrastructure, and water quality, with a new focus on water conservation and efficiency. It will also connect innovation with financing and implementation through the Global Prize for Innovation in Water, technical workshops, a water hackathon, and an innovation showcase, supporting Saudi Arabia’s efforts to improve water security, efficiency, and resource sustainability.
records.institution: Saudi Water Authority

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Mithnab Red Sukkari date variety is leading sales at the local dates season market in Al-Mithnab, capturing the largest market sha...
records.description: The Al-Mithnab Red Sukkari date variety is leading sales at the local dates season market in Al-Mithnab, capturing the largest market share among more than 65 varieties and driving agricultural trade. The season is organised in cooperation with the National Center for Palms and Dates, the Qassim Chamber of Commerce, and local entities. Large shipments are being distributed across Saudi Arabia at moderate prices, alongside popular varieties including Sukkari, Barhi, Sagai, and Medjool.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Public Authority for Small and Micro Enterprise Development is supporting the development of Yemen’s dairy value chain as part of eff...
records.description: The Public Authority for Small and Micro Enterprise Development is supporting the development of Yemen’s dairy value chain as part of efforts to strengthen local production, create jobs, increase household incomes, reduce dairy imports, and improve food security. Interventions include supporting livestock-owning families, expanding milk production, training local associations in modern dairy processing, providing equipment, and linking producers with processing and marketing opportunities. In Hodeidah, these efforts have significantly increased milk production and enabled thousands of families to sell milk directly to factories, while further initiatives target food-processing training, women and students, research, and the establishment of milk and dairy production centres.
records.institution: Public Authority for Small and Micro Enterprise Development

records.title: The General Authority for Zakat launched an economic empowerment project to support 75 families in beekeeping, honey production, and mark...
records.description: The General Authority for Zakat launched an economic empowerment project to support 75 families in beekeeping, honey production, and marketing in Wasab Al-Safil District, providing 1,875 beehives along with production, processing, packaging, training, and marketing support. Implemented in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries and local agricultural organisations, the project aims to create sustainable income opportunities for poor and vulnerable families, increase honey production, improve product quality, and strengthen access to markets. The initiative also includes forming productive beekeeper groups and providing extension services to improve the sustainability and efficiency of the projects.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries

records.title: Emirati agricultural company Al Dahra Holding, through Al Dahra Agriculture Trading, has begun implementing a five-year agreement to supp...
records.description: Emirati agricultural company Al Dahra Holding, through Al Dahra Agriculture Trading, has begun implementing a five-year agreement to supply Egypt with wheat under an arrangement valued at up to $500 million and supported by the Abu Dhabi Exports Office. The agreement aims to strengthen Egypt’s wheat supply-chain buffer and improve resilience against unexpected disruptions in global grain markets. The initiative builds on Al Dahra’s longstanding presence in Egypt and its broader cooperation to strengthen agricultural supply chains and food security.
records.institution: Al Dahra Holding

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development signed and supported several financing agreements and development projects in Jordan aimed at strength...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development signed and supported several financing agreements and development projects in Jordan aimed at strengthening economic resilience, infrastructure, industrial competitiveness, and human capital. Key initiatives include approximately AED 1.1 billion (USD 300 million) in budget support, a USD 70 million project to connect industrial cities to the natural gas network, and a USD 40 million programme to develop and equip five government technical schools offering specialisations including agriculture, engineering, construction, tourism, and other fields. The projects are aligned with Jordan’s Economic Modernisation Vision and seek to strengthen fiscal stability, reduce industrial production costs, improve energy infrastructure, develop workforce skills, support employment, and promote sustainable economic growth.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD)

records.title: UAE company begins wheat supplies to Egypt in $500m deal
records.description: Emirati agricultural company Al Dahra Holding, through Al Dahra Agriculture Trading, has begun implementing a five-year agreement to supply Egypt with wheat under an arrangement valued at up to $500 million and supported by the Abu Dhabi Exports Office. The agreement aims to strengthen Egypt’s wheat supply-chain buffer and improve resilience against unexpected disruptions in global grain markets. The initiative builds on Al Dahra’s longstanding presence in Egypt and its broader cooperation to strengthen agricultural supply chains and food security.
records.institution: Al Dahra Holding

records.title: Estidamah, in cooperation with the Qassim Region branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, conducted two specialised...
records.description: Estidamah, in cooperation with the Qassim Region branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, conducted two specialised workshops to promote modern and sustainable agricultural practices. The first workshop focused on the production, harvesting, and baling of seasonal fodder, with emphasis on improving fodder quality and production efficiency, while the second addressed greenhouse management, crop growth, productivity, and the efficient use of resources in protected agriculture systems. The activities aim to strengthen farmers’ technical knowledge, transfer agricultural expertise, and encourage the adoption of improved practices to enhance production efficiency and resource management.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: Salalah Free Zone signed an agreement with DuroMENA LLC to develop a US$105 million integrated fertilizer and chemical production complex...
records.description: Salalah Free Zone signed an agreement with DuroMENA LLC to develop a US$105 million integrated fertilizer and chemical production complex in Dhofar, with annual production capacity of up to 100,000 tonnes each of sulfate of potash (SOP) and granular calcium carbonate, alongside specialized chemical products. The project will support high-value crop production by supplying chloride-free fertilizer, while strengthening Oman’s non-oil industrial base, creating employment, expanding exports, and supporting regional fertilizer supply chains across the GCC, India, Southeast Asia, and East Africa. The investment also aligns with Oman Vision 2040 by promoting economic diversification, developing value-added manufacturing, and leveraging Salalah’s strategic port and logistics infrastructure.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

records.title: Estidamah has developed two new wheat varieties that showed higher yields and improved irrigation water-use efficiency in initial field t...
records.description: Estidamah has developed two new wheat varieties that showed higher yields and improved irrigation water-use efficiency in initial field trials. The varieties produced up to 9.8 and 8.6 tons per hectare, while reducing irrigation water use by 15% and 24.2%, respectively, compared with a widely cultivated commercial variety. The research aims to improve wheat production efficiency, reduce crop losses, and strengthen Saudi Arabia’s food security, with further trials underway to confirm performance under different conditions.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: ADAFSA will participate in the Abu Dhabi International Hunting and Equestrian Exhibition to showcase its efforts to protect animal health...
records.description: ADAFSA will participate in the Abu Dhabi International Hunting and Equestrian Exhibition to showcase its efforts to protect animal health, strengthen biosecurity, and ensure sustainable livestock resources. The authority will highlight veterinary, research, regulatory, vaccination, animal identification, feed testing, and livestock breeding services, while raising awareness of zoonotic diseases and the One Health approach. The initiative also promotes veterinary careers among young people and supports food security and livestock sustainability.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Saudi Arabia has updated its executive regulations for the sustainable management of the marine and coastal environment, introducing stri...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has updated its executive regulations for the sustainable management of the marine and coastal environment, introducing stricter controls, prohibitions, and penalties for environmental violations. Fines for failing to contain marine or coastal leaks can reach SAR 5 million, with violators also required to repair damage and pay compensation. The regulations prohibit harmful fishing practices, dumping of untreated wastewater and hazardous materials, damage to sensitive habitats, and other activities that threaten marine ecosystems, while requiring environmental permits for several marine and coastal activities. The measures aim to strengthen environmental compliance and protect marine biodiversity and coastal resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Al-Mithnab Dates Season opened with the arrival of the first quantities of Al-Mithnab Al-Hamra dates at the governorate’s central mar...
records.description: The Al-Mithnab Dates Season opened with the arrival of the first quantities of Al-Mithnab Al-Hamra dates at the governorate’s central market, attracting strong interest from traders, consumers, and visitors. The season is supported by the National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD) and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, highlighting the importance of the local date variety to Al-Mithnab’s agricultural identity and economy. Farmers reported high-quality, fully ripened produce and strong demand from the start of the auction.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD)

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) launched the first phase of the Women Farmer Field Schools (FFS) programme under...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) launched the first phase of the Women Farmer Field Schools (FFS) programme under the “Empowering Women Farmers” initiative to strengthen women’s role in sustainable agriculture, food security, and agricultural entrepreneurship. The programme will provide practical, field-based training on sustainable palm management, pest control, irrigation and fertilisation, greenhouse and open-field production, beekeeping, honey production, record-keeping, and farm profitability. Implemented jointly with Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) and FAO, the initiative also aims to expand market opportunities for women farmers and promote knowledge transfer within families and communities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: Credit Oman reported approved credit ceilings of approximately OMR226.6 million and insured sales of OMR191.4 million during the first ha...
records.description: Credit Oman reported approved credit ceilings of approximately OMR226.6 million and insured sales of OMR191.4 million during the first half of the year, with manufacturing accounting for the largest share of both. The agriculture, forestry and fishing sector ranked third, receiving around OMR3.1 million in approved credit ceilings and generating OMR6.2 million in insured sales. The institution continues to provide credit insurance and protection against non-payment and buyer default, supporting Omani exporters and businesses in maintaining operations, entering new markets, and expanding sales.
records.institution: Credit Oman

records.title: The Capital Secretariat of Sana’a, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, launched the first ph...
records.description: The Capital Secretariat of Sana’a, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, launched the first phase of a green belt project by planting 10,000 Sidr trees on the outskirts of Sana’a. The initiative aims to expand green spaces, improve environmental and aesthetic conditions, contribute to a better urban climate, and promote community participation in tree planting.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, together with the local authority in Al-Hodeidah Governorate, launched a proj...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, together with the local authority in Al-Hodeidah Governorate, launched a project to distribute 22 locally manufactured seed sieves and 20 mechanical seeders to multipurpose agricultural cooperative associations across the governorate. The initiative, implemented through Sohool Al-Yemen Company for Agricultural and Fisheries Development and Investment in cooperation with local manufacturers and the General Corporation for Grain Development and Production, aims to improve seed quality, increase farming efficiency, reduce seed losses and production costs, and strengthen agricultural services for farmers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia has achieved self-sufficiency in fresh potato production, with domestic output reaching approximately 623,770 tonnes from 17...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has achieved self-sufficiency in fresh potato production, with domestic output reaching approximately 623,770 tonnes from 17,064 hectares, supporting the expansion of potato processing and frozen potato exports to neighbouring markets. The sector benefits from two annual growing seasons, government support, advanced irrigation technologies, and the Saudi Potato Development Programme established through cooperation with the Netherlands. To conserve water resources, MEWA regulates fresh potato trade through seasonal import and export restrictions, permits, farm registration requirements, and restrictions on exports from areas with vulnerable groundwater reserves.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Badayea Dates Market in Qassim Region is experiencing strong commercial activity, supported by high consumer demand, diverse date...
records.description: The Al-Badayea Dates Market in Qassim Region is experiencing strong commercial activity, supported by high consumer demand, diverse date supplies, and active participation from local farmers, marketers, and young entrepreneurs. Operating under the seasonal market framework overseen by the National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD), the market aims to improve marketing efficiency, enhance services, and expand market opportunities for premium local dates, particularly the Sukkari variety. The market also creates seasonal employment and supports youth-led businesses involved in marketing, packaging, and value-added date products, contributing to the local economy while preserving Qassim’s agricultural heritage.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: be’ah is developing carbon-credit opportunities from greenhouse-gas reductions across its waste-management operations, with landfill gas...
records.description: be’ah is developing carbon-credit opportunities from greenhouse-gas reductions across its waste-management operations, with landfill gas recovery as a key focus. Its Carbon Management Framework covers emissions measurement, reduction projects, carbon-credit registration and verification, and the eventual sale and financial integration of credits. Two landfill gas recovery projects at Al Multaqa and Barka have been registered under the Verra Verified Carbon Standard, while efforts are underway to use recovered methane for electricity generation. The initiative aims to reduce landfill emissions, support renewable energy generation, promote resource recovery, and create potential climate-finance revenues.
records.institution: Oman Environmental Services Holding Company (be’ah)

records.title: Oman plans to develop a wheat grain storage facility in Ibra, North Al Sharqiyah Governorate, to expand national grain-handling capacity...
records.description: Oman plans to develop a wheat grain storage facility in Ibra, North Al Sharqiyah Governorate, to expand national grain-handling capacity and improve the storage and distribution of wheat. The project forms part of broader efforts to strengthen food supply systems, reduce risks associated with dependence on imported food, and improve grain logistics and infrastructure. The investment also complements Oman’s wider development of milling, port, agricultural, and transport infrastructure, while potentially supporting the country’s role in regional grain trade and distribution.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Qassim Region has recorded date production of around 584,128 tons, supported by approximately 10.87 million palm trees across more than 1...
records.description: Qassim Region has recorded date production of around 584,128 tons, supported by approximately 10.87 million palm trees across more than 13,400 agricultural holdings, highlighting the region’s leading role in Saudi Arabia’s date production and marketing. The National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD), in cooperation with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, is supporting seasonal date markets across the region to regulate sales and purchases, strengthen farmers’ and producers’ market access, expand marketing opportunities, and stimulate economic activity in the palm and date sector.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD) / Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture – Qassim Branch

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the Ministry of Culture completed the second phase of a greening initiative in His...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the Ministry of Culture completed the second phase of a greening initiative in Historic Jeddah, with volunteers planting around 3,000 seedlings to expand green spaces, improve the urban landscape, and promote environmental sustainability at cultural and heritage sites. The initiative supports the targets of the Saudi Green Initiative while encouraging community participation and raising awareness of vegetation conservation and sustainable environmental practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is advancing clean energy infrastructure while integrating environmental protection, res...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is advancing clean energy infrastructure while integrating environmental protection, resource efficiency, waste management and biodiversity conservation across its projects. Key initiatives include the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, which is planned to exceed 8,000 MW by 2030, and the Hatta pumped-storage hydroelectric power plant, supporting Dubai’s clean energy and energy-storage goals. DEWA also conducts environmental assessments and monitoring, promotes circular economy practices, and supports biodiversity through mangrove planting and beach-cleaning campaigns. These efforts contribute to reducing emissions, conserving natural resources, strengthening climate resilience, and supporting Dubai’s transition toward a low-carbon and sustainable economy.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) concluded the “Livestock and Processing Industries” track of the third edition of...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) concluded the “Livestock and Processing Industries” track of the third edition of the Mustadeem programme, in collaboration with the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Livestock. The four-day programme, held at the Mleiha Dairy Farm and Factory and a wheat farm in Sharjah, provided students from Grades 6 to 8 with hands-on training in livestock production, veterinary care, biosecurity, food quality, dairy processing, and supply chains.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held an interactive farmer workshop in Dibba, Fujairah, to discuss farmers’ production, marketing,...
records.description: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held an interactive farmer workshop in Dibba, Fujairah, to discuss farmers’ production, marketing, irrigation, and agricultural service needs ahead of the new growing season. The workshop introduced NAC initiatives aimed at improving resource-use efficiency, strengthening agricultural value chains, and supporting sustainable local production, including the Integrated Agricultural Centres project, the Al Hamraniyah Centre in Ras Al Khaimah, and the UAE Good Agricultural Practices (UAE G.A.P.) programme. The UAE G.A.P. framework supports improved product quality, food safety, traceability, production efficiency, market access, and stronger links between farmers and supply chains. The initiative also supports the UAE’s Plant the Emirates programme and broader national food-security objectives by encouraging modern technologies, sustainable agricultural practices, and greater farmer participation in agricultural development.
records.institution: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC)

records.title: The Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park (SRTI Park) is strengthening Sharjah’s innovation ecosystem by connecting researcher...
records.description: The Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park (SRTI Park) is strengthening Sharjah’s innovation ecosystem by connecting researchers, startups, industry, investors, and government entities to develop, test, and commercialise practical solutions in food security, agriculture, water management, clean energy, and the circular economy. Its initiatives include precision agriculture, AI-enabled farming, smart water management and reuse, renewable energy, hydrogen, energy storage, emissions reduction, and resource recovery technologies. The ecosystem aims to accelerate technology transfer and move innovations from research and pilot stages into scalable commercial applications, while Sharjah Next – Sustainability will provide a platform for collaboration, investment, pilot projects, and deployment of sustainable technologies.
records.institution: Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park (SRTI Park)

records.title: Kuwait Customs seized 2,236 items of subsidized and rationed food supplies from six containers at Shuwaikh Port that were being prepared...
records.description: Kuwait Customs seized 2,236 items of subsidized and rationed food supplies from six containers at Shuwaikh Port that were being prepared for export to Sri Lanka. The shipment included subsidized milk, flour, oil, ghee, lentils, pasta, rice, sugar, and tomato paste. The seizure is part of efforts to protect Kuwait’s food security, safeguard strategic stocks of essential commodities, ensure subsidized products reach their intended beneficiaries, and prevent their illegal export.
records.institution: General Administration of Customs (Kuwait)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Unaizah International Dates Season highlights Qassim’s leading role in date production, with around 2,850 farms and more than 1.5 mil...
records.description: The Unaizah International Dates Season highlights Qassim’s leading role in date production, with around 2,850 farms and more than 1.5 million palm trees producing approximately 90,000 tonnes of dates annually. Featuring more than 20 varieties, including the highly sought-after Sukkari, the season serves as a major platform connecting producers, traders, and consumers. Ongoing development aims to strengthen the event as an important economic, agricultural, and cultural platform, reinforce Qassim’s position as a leading global date-producing hub, and support the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: Qassim Region

records.title: Saudi Arabia produced around 623,770 tonnes of potatoes from 17,064 hectares, supporting a high level of domestic self-sufficiency and a...
records.description: Saudi Arabia produced around 623,770 tonnes of potatoes from 17,064 hectares, supporting a high level of domestic self-sufficiency and a growing processing and export sector. Potato production is concentrated in several central and northern regions and increasingly uses water-efficient irrigation technologies, including drip irrigation. MEWA regulates potato imports and exports through seasonal restrictions, permits, farm registration, and water-resource assessments, with export limitations applied in areas where groundwater conservation is a concern. The sector continues to balance domestic food supply, processing and export opportunities with the need to protect scarce water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The agricultural sector in Madinah Region recorded the highest growth among economic sectors at 44%, supported by major development proje...
records.description: The agricultural sector in Madinah Region recorded the highest growth among economic sectors at 44%, supported by major development projects and an increase in agricultural commercial registrations. The region is a major date-producing and processing hub, with around 344,000 tonnes of dates produced annually from more than 8 million palm trees, alongside significant exports to international markets. Its date-processing and packaging industry includes 39 factories, contributing to value addition, investment, employment, food processing, and the expansion of Saudi agricultural exports.
records.institution: Madinah Chamber of Commerce and Industry

records.title: The Jazan branch of Estidamah, in collaboration with Thamarah Association for Agricultural Marketing and Food Processing, organized a spe...
records.description: The Jazan branch of Estidamah, in collaboration with Thamarah Association for Agricultural Marketing and Food Processing, organized a specialized workshop on banana farming to promote modern cultivation practices, improve crop quality and productivity, and enhance efficient resource use. The training covered land preparation, planting distances, irrigation management, crop production practices, and post-harvest handling to reduce losses and increase market value. The initiative supports farmers and promotes more sustainable and efficient agricultural production in Jazan.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: A training course for leaders of Agricultural Cooperative Union branches in seven governorates concluded in Sana’a, focusing on strengthe...
records.description: A training course for leaders of Agricultural Cooperative Union branches in seven governorates concluded in Sana’a, focusing on strengthening cooperative work, field-based agricultural development, value-chain approaches, and the implementation of agricultural policies. The training aims to improve the capacity of cooperative associations to support production, promote self-sufficiency, reduce dependence on imports, and strengthen local economic development. The initiative also highlighted ongoing efforts related to plowing and seed projects and expanding domestic crop production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition conducted inspection campaigns in Al-Jahra Governorate and recorded 40 food safety violations...
records.description: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition conducted inspection campaigns in Al-Jahra Governorate and recorded 40 food safety violations, including the display and sale of food products unfit for human consumption, leading to legal action and the closure of five food establishments. The inspections targeted warehouses, factories, and other food establishments to ensure compliance with approved food safety regulations and health requirements, reinforcing efforts to protect consumer health and improve food safety standards.
records.institution: Public Authority for Food and Nutrition

records.title: The fourth edition of the Shaqra Al-Asyah Dates Festival opened in Ain Ibn Fahid, bringing together farmers, producers, shoppers, and vis...
records.description: The fourth edition of the Shaqra Al-Asyah Dates Festival opened in Ain Ibn Fahid, bringing together farmers, producers, shoppers, and visitors to promote locally produced dates and support agricultural and economic activity. The weeklong festival provides farmers with opportunities to market their products, showcase the quality and diversity of local dates, and increase commercial activity during the harvest season.
records.institution: Al-Asyah Governorate

records.title: The Saudi Water Authority will host the 21st IDRA World Congress on Desalination and Water Reuse (IDRA 2026) in Riyadh, bringing together...
records.description: The Saudi Water Authority will host the 21st IDRA World Congress on Desalination and Water Reuse (IDRA 2026) in Riyadh, bringing together water-sector leaders and experts from around 100 countries to address global water security. The congress will focus on water reuse, desalination, water efficiency, climate adaptation, energy efficiency, digital transformation, financing, and regulatory frameworks, while promoting international cooperation and innovation to address water scarcity and growing demand. The event also includes the Water Regulation Forum, technical sessions, scientific presentations, workshops, and a dedicated exhibition.
records.institution: Saudi Water Authority (SWA)

records.title: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held a farmer workshop in Dibba, Fujairah, to discuss farmers’ production, marketing, and agricultu...
records.description: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held a farmer workshop in Dibba, Fujairah, to discuss farmers’ production, marketing, and agricultural service needs and introduce initiatives aimed at strengthening local agricultural production and sustainability. The workshop highlighted the Integrated Agricultural Centres project, which provides farmers with technical support, production inputs, packaging, marketing, and distribution services, as well as the UAE Good Agricultural Practices (UAE G.A.P.) programme, which promotes quality, food safety, traceability, resource efficiency, and access to new markets. The initiative supports the UAE’s food security objectives and the “Plant the Emirates” programme by encouraging modern technologies, sustainable farming practices, and stronger agricultural value chains.
records.institution: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC)

records.title: The Culinary Arts Commission has documented 35 products from Madinah among 180 Saudi products featured in the “Ark of Taste” global initi...
records.description: The Culinary Arts Commission has documented 35 products from Madinah among 180 Saudi products featured in the “Ark of Taste” global initiative, which seeks to protect heritage food products, support local producers, and preserve agricultural biodiversity and culinary traditions. The listed products include traditional wheat, dates, mint, honey, chickpeas, bread, cabbage, and jujube, reflecting Madinah’s rich agricultural and culinary heritage. The initiative aims to enhance the cultural and economic value of traditional foods, raise awareness of their preservation, support local producers, and ensure that traditional knowledge and production practices are passed on to future generations.
records.institution: Culinary Arts Commission

records.title: The Ministry has approved updated executive regulations for monitoring and enforcing water-efficiency and conservation standards, empower...
records.description: The Ministry has approved updated executive regulations for monitoring and enforcing water-efficiency and conservation standards, empowering the National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center to investigate violations across the urban, agricultural, and industrial sectors. The rules introduce escalating fines for using inefficient sanitary fixtures, tampering with water-saving components, wasting drinking water due to defective or poorly maintained tanks, and using drinking water for purposes where alternative sources such as treated wastewater or licensed wells are available. Penalties range from SR500 to SR200,000, strengthening enforcement of water conservation and supporting the sustainable management of Saudi Arabia’s scarce water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The UAE is expanding its network of Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreements (CEPAs) to diversify export markets, reduce trade barri...
records.description: The UAE is expanding its network of Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreements (CEPAs) to diversify export markets, reduce trade barriers, strengthen private-sector competitiveness, and expand investment and trade links across Asia, Africa, and Europe. Since the programme was launched in 2021, the UAE has signed 38 CEPAs, with an increasing number entering into force and improving market access for UAE businesses. The agreements are supporting opportunities in sectors including agriculture, logistics, renewable energy, manufacturing, and investment, while strengthening the UAE’s role as a global trade and logistics hub connecting Asian, African, and European markets.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning are supporting the development of t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning are supporting the development of the Al Najd Agricultural City in Dhofar, a large-scale self-sustaining agricultural development designed to strengthen food security, agricultural innovation, and economic diversification in line with Oman Vision 2040. The masterplan integrates large agricultural areas with urban facilities and incorporates technologies such as agrivoltaics, aquaponics, greenhouse production, advanced irrigation, and water-reuse and management systems. The project will focus on water-efficient and locally suitable crops, agro-processing and export opportunities, and sustainable energy and water use, with the long-term goal of creating Oman’s first zero-waste agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia increased the disposal rate of ozone-depleting substances to 69% during the first half of 2026, with more than 8,000 metric...
records.description: Saudi Arabia increased the disposal rate of ozone-depleting substances to 69% during the first half of 2026, with more than 8,000 metric tons of ozone-depleting substances and HFCs cleared as part of the gradual phase-out programme. The initiative strengthens regulatory oversight of the import and circulation of controlled substances through environmental clearance procedures, supported by electronic integration with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority. Since 2023, more than 3,200 clearance permits have been issued under the Montreal Protocol framework.
records.institution: National Center for Environmental Compliance

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) imposed a nationwide seasonal ban on the fishing, possession, transpor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) imposed a nationwide seasonal ban on the fishing, possession, transportation, sale, purchase, storage and trade of kingfish (kanad) along Oman’s coasts from 15 August to 15 October 2026. The measure, issued under the Marine Fisheries Law and Ministerial Decision No. 70/2026, aims to protect kingfish stocks during a critical stage of their life cycle and support the long-term sustainability of Oman’s fisheries and marine biodiversity. Fishermen and businesses holding existing stocks are required to register them with the relevant authorities, while violations are subject to legal penalties.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is monitoring the potential environmental and food-safety impacts of a grounde...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is monitoring the potential environmental and food-safety impacts of a grounded vessel incident off Al Qibliya Island in the Al Hallaniyat Islands, Dhofar. As a precautionary measure, the Food Safety and Quality Centre is conducting inspections, investigations, and sampling of fishery products circulating in markets to verify their safety and compliance with health standards. The ministry has also instructed fishermen and seafarers to report oil slicks, unusual odours, or visible changes in seawater and marine life and to avoid fishing in affected areas.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia’s consumer inflation remained relatively low in July, with prices increasing by 1.8% year-on-year, despite a sharp rise in r...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s consumer inflation remained relatively low in July, with prices increasing by 1.8% year-on-year, despite a sharp rise in regulated gas prices and higher rents. However, wholesale prices increased by 5%, driven largely by supply-chain constraints affecting transportation and logistics, higher agricultural produce prices, and a significant increase in basic chemical prices. While consumer prices have so far remained largely insulated, continued supply-chain pressures could gradually feed into retail prices, although a major increase in inflation is not expected.
records.institution: Saudi General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT)

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification signed SAR40 million in contracts with Morooj National...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification signed SAR40 million in contracts with Morooj National Foundation for sustainable forest management projects, marking the first national initiative of its kind to strengthen forest sustainability and preserve their environmental, economic, and social value while increasing the contribution of the non-profit sector to national environmental goals. The initiative uses GIS and remote sensing to assess forest conditions, including topography, degradation, and climate factors, and covers six areas: improving forest health, preventing and restoring fire-affected forests, rehabilitating degraded forests, engaging stakeholders and encouraging investment, strengthening forest monitoring, and assessing risks and developing mitigation measures.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.description: The NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC), a consortium involving ACWA Power, Air Products, and NEOM, has completed construction of the $8.5 billion green hydrogen project at Oxagon and entered the commissioning stage. The facility is expected to become the world’s largest green hydrogen plant, producing up to 600 tonnes of carbon-free hydrogen daily and converting it into green ammonia for international export. Powered by large-scale solar and wind generation, the project is designed to support Saudi Arabia’s energy diversification, renewable energy development, and transition toward lower-carbon industrial production.
records.institution: NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC) / ACWA Power / NEOM

records.description: A consortium comprising EDF power solutions, Al Khadra Partners, and OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) has reached financial close for the 120 MW Jaalan Bani Bu Ali Wind Independent Power Project in Oman. The project will establish a major onshore wind farm with 16 turbines, providing renewable electricity for more than 13,500 households and reducing carbon emissions. It is expected to support local employment, skills development, and Omani businesses while strengthening energy security and diversifying the national energy mix. The project aligns with Oman Vision 2040 and the country’s renewable energy and Net Zero 2050 objectives.
records.institution: OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) / Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP)

records.description: The Food Security Exhibition opened in Salalah with the participation of around 100 institutions, companies, and projects working across agriculture, livestock, fisheries, food industries, modern agricultural technologies, logistics, financing, and investment. The five-day exhibition showcases food security-related products, projects, and innovations while providing a platform to strengthen cooperation, promote investment opportunities, and connect public and private sector stakeholders across Oman’s food and agriculture sectors.

records.title: Saudi Arabia’s Port of Jeddah is experiencing congestion as shipping companies reroute cargo away from traditional Gulf routes amid the o...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s Port of Jeddah is experiencing congestion as shipping companies reroute cargo away from traditional Gulf routes amid the ongoing United States–Iran conflict. Increased volumes through Jeddah have contributed to vessel waiting times of five to ten days, while several carriers have suspended or reduced direct services and introduced additional surcharges. Shipping companies are also redirecting cargo through alternative gateways, including King Abdullah Port, while land-bridge and multimodal routes are being adjusted. These disruptions are affecting exporters and logistics providers, increasing freight costs and complicating procurement, inventory management, delivery schedules, and regional supply-chain planning.
records.institution: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani)

records.title: The Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) intensified national food safety monitoring, increasing inspections of imported food shipments and l...
records.description: The Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) intensified national food safety monitoring, increasing inspections of imported food shipments and local food establishments while using laboratory testing, sampling, and digital services to verify compliance with food safety standards and regulations. During the second quarter, the Food Safety Department inspected 29,147 imported food shipments, conducted 5,748 inspection visits to local food establishments, collected thousands of food samples, and carried out 136,280 laboratory tests. The department also expanded digital food safety services through the Watheq system, supporting stronger oversight, compliance, and food safety practices across Qatar’s food supply chain.
records.institution: The Ministry of Public Health (MoPH)

records.title: Saudi Arabia, through the Weqaa Center and King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief), provided logistical support to the...
records.description: Saudi Arabia, through the Weqaa Center and King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief), provided logistical support to the FAO Commission for Controlling the Desert Locust in the Central Region to strengthen regional efforts to control desert locusts and protect agricultural resources and food security. The support included 40 modern devices and equipment, 8,250 safety items, and 100 tonnes of pest-control materials, enhancing emergency response capacity and the safety of control teams across member countries. The initiative strengthens regional preparedness and promotes coordinated, preventive action against cross-border agricultural pests.
records.institution: National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center)

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is supporting the “Rural Dhofar 2026” exhibition, which brings together rural women entrepreneurs and productive families to promote and market Omani agricultural, fishery, food, honey, dates, and natural products. The exhibition aims to expand direct marketing opportunities, increase household incomes, support small and medium-sized enterprises, and strengthen the role of rural women in food security and sustainable economic development. It also includes specialised workshops on sustainable production, product quality and value addition, financing opportunities, and women’s contribution to food security, supporting the development of rural communities and the diversification and sustainability of Oman’s economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources will implement a seasonal ban on catching, possessing, transporting, selling,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources will implement a seasonal ban on catching, possessing, transporting, selling, trading, storing, freezing, and exporting kingfish along Oman’s coasts to protect fish stocks and ensure the long-term sustainability of the fishery. The measure forms part of a broader fisheries management approach that includes regulating fishing seasons, protecting stocks during breeding periods, strengthening compliance, and raising fishermen’s awareness. Kingfish is an economically and nutritionally important resource in Oman, with production concentrated mainly in Al Wusta and South A’Sharqiyah Governorates, making sustainable management essential for maintaining fishermen’s livelihoods, fish supplies, and the wider fisheries economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Buraidah International Dates Carnival highlights Qassim Region’s leading role in Saudi Arabia’s palm and dates sector, with around 11...
records.description: The Buraidah International Dates Carnival highlights Qassim Region’s leading role in Saudi Arabia’s palm and dates sector, with around 11 million palm trees producing more than 580,000 tonnes of dates annually, equivalent to approximately half of the Kingdom’s total production. The sector benefits from government support, suitable agricultural conditions, and farmers’ adoption of modern cultivation and palm-care practices. The carnival markets a large share of Sukkari date production and serves as a major platform connecting producers, traders, and consumers, contributing to food security and the local agricultural economy. The sector’s future development is expected to focus on modern agricultural technologies, mechanisation, and water-efficient irrigation systems to improve productivity while conserving water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is supporting the development of Jazan as Saudi Arabia’s leading hub for tropical frui...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is supporting the development of Jazan as Saudi Arabia’s leading hub for tropical fruit production, with the region producing significant quantities of mangoes, papayas, bananas, guavas, and custard apples. Jazan accounts for nearly 60% of national mango production, supported by its favourable agricultural conditions, modern farming practices, and government and farmer efforts to improve productivity and product quality. The region is also developing the “Tropical Fruits and Greenhouses” project, with investments exceeding SAR 600 million, aimed at expanding production capacity, introducing modern agricultural technologies, increasing value addition, and creating investment opportunities while contributing to food security and rural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture supports the development of the dates sector through seasonal events such as the Al-Khabra and Riyadh Al-Khabra Dates Festival, which stimulates date trading, strengthens logistics and supply chains, and creates seasonal employment opportunities. The festival also promotes local agricultural products, tourism, and economic activity in Qassim Region, while supporting the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 through agricultural development, income diversification, increased local content, and improved competitiveness and sustainability of the dates sector.

records.description: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), in cooperation with the Office of the Governor of Dhofar and the Ministry of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries and Water Resources, is organising the Food Security Forum and Exhibition 2026 in Salalah to strengthen food security, attract investment, and promote sustainable growth in Oman’s agricultural and food sectors. records.description: The Social Development Bank (SDB) supported the participation of 15 cottage-industry families in the Farmers’ Market Festival in Rafha Governorate, helping them access direct sales opportunities and expand the marketing of their products. The festival, organised by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Northern Borders Region branch, showcases locally produced dates, fruits, vegetables, honey, and other rural and food products, alongside awareness activities promoting sustainable agricultural practices and local production. The initiative supports farmers and productive families, strengthens market access and livelihoods, and contributes to agricultural development, food security, and Saudi Vision 2030 objectives related to microenterprises and the cottage industry.

records.title: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held an interactive workshop with farmers in Ras Al Khaimah to strengthen engagement, identify farm...
records.description: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held an interactive workshop with farmers in Ras Al Khaimah to strengthen engagement, identify farmers’ needs, and promote initiatives supporting climate-smart farming and sustainable resource management. The session highlighted the Integrated Agricultural Centres Project, which provides agricultural extension, production inputs, packaging, marketing, and distribution support to improve value chains and the competitiveness of UAE-grown products. Farmers were also introduced to the UAE Good Agricultural Practices (UAEG.A.P.) programme, implemented with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), which supports food safety, traceability, responsible use of water and agricultural inputs, and access to retail and export markets.

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture – Northern Borders Region Branch launched the Farmers’ Market Festival to support local farmers and productive families by promoting the direct marketing and sale of locally produced agricultural and rural products. The festival showcases dates, vegetables, fruits, honey, and other food products, while also providing awareness activities on sustainable agricultural practices and encouraging consumption of national products. records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) hosted a workshop in Riyadh on smart irrigation and water-use efficiency, bringing together specialists to explore innovative approaches to addressing water scarcity and improving agricultural productivity. Discussions focused on crop water requirements, advanced greenhouse technologies, and the use of data and artificial intelligence to develop smart irrigation systems. The workshop highlighted the importance of research, innovation, and collaboration in conserving water resources and advancing sustainable agriculture in Saudi Arabia, supporting preparations for the Year of Water 2027.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD) and the Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT) are strengthening cooperation under the...
records.description: The Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD) and the Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT) are strengthening cooperation under the Abu Dhabi Waste Management Strategy through coordinated land, coastal, and marine clean-up operations combined with systematic waste data collection and analysis. The initiative involves partners including Tadweer Group, the Abu Dhabi Marine Sports Club, and diving associations, with waste being classified, weighed, and documented through the Sahim – Citizen Science programme. The resulting data helps identify waste patterns, improve monitoring, target awareness campaigns, optimise resource allocation, and support evidence-based waste management policies. The programme also promotes community participation and responsible waste practices, contributing to Abu Dhabi’s environmental protection, sustainability, and more efficient waste management.
records.institution: Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD)

The project contributes to the deployment of renewable energy, energy storage, emissions reduction, and the Liquid Fuel Displacement Program, while advancing Saudi Vision 2030 and the national target of increasing renewable energy and storage to around 50% of the electricity generation mix by 2030.

records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) concluded the Marine Environment Track of its “Mustadeem” programme, an initiative designed to build youth awareness and skills in marine conservation, biodiversity protection, sustainable fisheries, food security, and water-quality management. Conducted in partnership with the Sharjah Marine Science Research Centre and the University of Khorfakkan, the programme combined classroom learning, laboratory exercises, aquaculture visits, beach clean-ups, marine litter and microplastic analysis, and practical water-quality monitoring.

records.description: Qatar is expected to experience strong growth in solar power as the country accelerates investments in renewable energy to diversify its energy mix, strengthen energy security, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Ongoing and planned large-scale solar projects are increasing electricity generation capacity while supporting national sustainability and climate objectives. The adoption of protected agriculture enables year-round production, improves crop quality, conserves water through modern irrigation systems, and reduces exposure to pests and adverse weather conditions. records.title: Oman submits third National Determined Contribution report to UNFCCC
records.description: The Environment Authority of Oman submitted the country's third Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC) report to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), outlining climate mitigation and adaptation targets through 2035. The report commits to reducing greenhouse gas emissions, expanding renewable energy, improving energy efficiency, promoting green hydrogen and circular economy initiatives, and strengthening resilience to climate risks such as drought, rising temperatures, floods, sea-level rise, and tropical cyclones. It also prioritizes adaptation measures for key sectors including agriculture, water resources, fisheries, public health, tourism, and infrastructure, supporting Oman Vision 2040 and the national net-zero emissions target by 2050.
records.institution: The Environment Authority of Oman
