records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced the opening of the squid fishing season in Yemen’s Red Sea territor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced the opening of the squid fishing season in Yemen’s Red Sea territorial waters under regulated conditions based on scientific assessments and technical recommendations. The measures include restrictions on fishing in estuaries and shallow areas, field monitoring of juvenile squid, enforcement against illegal fishing, and the implementation of an emergency squid stock management plan in coordination with relevant authorities. The initiative aims to conserve squid stocks, ensure the sustainable management of marine fisheries, protect aquatic resources, and support continued fish production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture highlighted tree planting as a natural measure to reduce summer temperatures, noting t...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture highlighted tree planting as a natural measure to reduce summer temperatures, noting that trees lower heat through shading, reduced heat absorption, and transpiration, while each tree can absorb an average of 150 kilograms of carbon dioxide annually. The ministry stated that expanding green spaces improves air quality, reduces noise, supports rainwater management, and provides habitats for wildlife and pollinators. It recommended planting native tree species adapted to local climatic conditions and advised irrigation during early morning or evening using drip irrigation systems, together with organic mulch to conserve soil moisture and regulate soil temperature.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Governorate conducted a field training workshop for farmers on the safe use of agricultural pesticides.
records.description: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Governorate conducted a field training workshop for farmers on the safe use of agricultural pesticides. The programme provided guidance on pesticide handling, personal protective equipment, integrated pest management, crop rotation, pest identification, correct application rates, pre-harvest safety intervals, first aid for pesticide poisoning, and the proper disposal of pesticide containers. Officials also warned against the use of banned or smuggled pesticides and highlighted unsafe practices observed among farmers, while distributing awareness materials at the end of the workshop.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Governorate

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Trinasolar signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Al-Raebi for Trading and Solar Energy Systems Company to explore a potential 1...
records.description: Trinasolar signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Al-Raebi for Trading and Solar Energy Systems Company to explore a potential 1.5 GW solar project pipeline in Yemen during 2026–2029. The agreement provides a framework for evaluating large-scale solar energy opportunities, technical requirements, and future cooperation models, including the potential use of advanced photovoltaic technologies for utility-scale and commercial projects. The partnership focuses on renewable energy development and expanding access to clean energy solutions in Yemen and the wider Middle East.
records.institution: Al-Raebi for Trading and Solar Energy Systems Company

records.title: Researchers at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) developed a new genome engineering method that enables the prec...
records.description: Researchers at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) developed a new genome engineering method that enables the precise insertion of large genetic sequences into specific locations within plant genomes without creating DNA breaks. The method was successfully demonstrated in tobacco and rice and expands the capabilities of plant biotechnology for developing crops with complex genetic traits, including improved tolerance to heat, drought, and disease, as well as supporting plant-based biomanufacturing.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) signed seven contracts worth SAR1 billion to expand logistics centres at Jeddah Islamic Port and the A...
records.description: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) signed seven contracts worth SAR1 billion to expand logistics centres at Jeddah Islamic Port and the Al Khumra logistics zone. The projects will develop nearly 384,000 square metres of logistics infrastructure for storage, consolidation, and re-export, supported by digital technologies and enhanced transport connectivity. The expansion includes new container yards in partnership with Maersk and is expected to improve supply chain efficiency, increase trade capacity, create more than 5,000 jobs, and strengthen Saudi Arabia’s position as a regional and global logistics hub under Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy.
records.institution: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani)

records.title: The Bonyan Development Foundation, in cooperation with the local authority in Ibb Governorate, the Ministries of Agriculture, Fisheries a...
records.description: The Bonyan Development Foundation, in cooperation with the local authority in Ibb Governorate, the Ministries of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and Social Affairs and Labor, concluded a 10-day training course for members of agricultural associations. The programme strengthened the technical and administrative capacities of association representatives through training on development mechanisms, agricultural policies, institutional management, productive groups, and resource optimization. It was implemented by the Bonyan Training and Qualification Academy with support from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit and involved participants from several districts in Ibb Governorate.
records.institution: The Bonyan Development Foundation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced the implementation of 493 food security projects under Oman’s 10th F...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced the implementation of 493 food security projects under Oman’s 10th Five-Year Plan (2021–2025), with investments aimed at strengthening domestic agricultural and fisheries production, reducing reliance on food imports, and enhancing long-term food security. The projects span the agriculture, fisheries, and related sectors, with the majority focused on agricultural development, supporting economic diversification, increasing local production capacity, and improving the resilience of the national agrifood system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is exploring the expanded use of drone technology to strengthen agricultural p...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is exploring the expanded use of drone technology to strengthen agricultural productivity, environmental monitoring, and biosecurity in Oman. The initiative focuses on integrating unmanned aerial systems into crop monitoring, pest and disease surveillance, precision agriculture, and the protection of agricultural resources, while also enhancing food security through the adoption of advanced technologies. The discussions emphasize collaboration among government institutions, technology providers, and research partners to develop innovative drone applications that improve decision-making, increase production efficiency, and support the sustainable development of the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The National Center for Palms and Dates highlighted Al-Kharj Governorate's role as one of Saudi Arabia's leading date-producing regions,...
records.description: The National Center for Palms and Dates highlighted Al-Kharj Governorate's role as one of Saudi Arabia's leading date-producing regions, supported by extensive palm cultivation, diverse date varieties, and an integrated production, processing, and marketing system that strengthens food security and agricultural development. The governorate produces approximately 90,400 tons of dates annually, generating significant economic value and seasonal employment. Annual promotional events, including the Al-Kharj Dates and Saudi Coffee Festival, further support marketing, boost local economic activity, and create additional job opportunities.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in coordination with the General Authority for Water Resources and Water Faci...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in coordination with the General Authority for Water Resources and Water Facilities and local authorities, assessed water infrastructure needs in Bayt Hadyan, Bani Al-Harith district, to support agriculture and improve groundwater recharge. The planned interventions include developing dams and water barriers to maximize rainwater harvesting, strengthen irrigation for vineyards, and expand cultivated farmland through community-led initiatives supported by technical assistance and hydrological studies. The initiative aims to enhance sustainable water resource management, reduce pressure on groundwater resources, and strengthen agricultural self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Khayrat AlUla seasonal initiative at AlManshiyah Farmers Market promotes the marketing of locally produced summer fruits by providing...
records.description: The Khayrat AlUla seasonal initiative at AlManshiyah Farmers Market promotes the marketing of locally produced summer fruits by providing farmers with direct access to consumers, increasing market opportunities and farm incomes while supporting sustainable agriculture. The initiative also encourages value addition through the production of processed foods such as juices, jams, dried fruits, and sweets, creating opportunities for cottage industries and small businesses. By strengthening production, processing, and marketing linkages, the programme enhances agricultural value chains, supports entrepreneurship, and contributes to local economic development and the sustainable growth of AlUla’s agricultural sector.
records.institution: Royal Commission for AlUla

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through its Tabuk branch, launched mobile honey sorting and packaging units to provid...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through its Tabuk branch, launched mobile honey sorting and packaging units to provide on-site services for beekeepers across villages and natural pasture areas. The units offer honey analysis, sorting, packaging, and technical guidance using modern technologies to improve product quality and marketing. The initiative aims to strengthen the regional apiculture sector, increase the commercial value of locally produced honey, enhance service efficiency, and support sustainable agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The General Tihama Development Authority reported significant progress in agricultural and livestock development through programs aimed a...
records.description: The General Tihama Development Authority reported significant progress in agricultural and livestock development through programs aimed at increasing production, strengthening food security, and supporting self-sufficiency. Key achievements included expanding agricultural and livestock exports, rehabilitating irrigation infrastructure and floodwater harvesting systems, implementing large-scale livestock vaccination campaigns, establishing agricultural field schools, supporting beekeeping, promoting digital transformation, deploying solar energy systems, strengthening pesticide control, and improving agricultural facilities. The authority also emphasized continued investment in irrigation, farmer support, environmental protection, and institutional modernization to enhance agricultural productivity and resilience across the Tihama Plain.
records.institution: The General Tihama Development Authority

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through its Qassim branch, planted 183,000 trees during the first half of 2026 as par...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through its Qassim branch, planted 183,000 trees during the first half of 2026 as part of efforts to expand vegetation cover, conserve natural resources, and advance environmental sustainability. The afforestation initiative was supported by strong community participation involving volunteers, public and private sector partners, and regional nurseries. It also included environmental awareness campaigns targeting schools and technical colleges to promote sustainability and support the environmental objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in North Al Sharqiyah, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in North Al Sharqiyah, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, organized a stakeholder forum to promote the use of water desalination units as part of efforts to strengthen sustainable food and water security. The event brought together private sector representatives, farmers, investors, and technicians to discuss desalination solutions and foster collaboration. A partnership agreement was signed with Nada Al Rabee Company to provide technical support and install water desalination units for farms affected by soil and water salinity, helping improve agricultural resilience and water resource management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is supporting the expansion of modern agricultural projects that enhance food...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is supporting the expansion of modern agricultural projects that enhance food security, improve resource-use efficiency, and promote high-value crop production in Oman. A papaya cultivation project in North Al Batinah demonstrates the successful adoption of climate-suitable crop varieties, drip irrigation, modern fertilization practices, and technical extension services to increase productivity and optimize water use. The project also plans to expand cultivation and invest in agro-processing to produce value-added products such as juices and dried fruits, contributing to agricultural diversification, increased farmer incomes, and the competitiveness of Omani agricultural products.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) implemented a project to strengthen the wheat production chain in eastern A...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) implemented a project to strengthen the wheat production chain in eastern Aleppo, Syria, by rehabilitating key agricultural infrastructure and providing equipment to improve food security and farmer livelihoods. The project included the delivery of a mobile seed-cleaning station, rehabilitation of a seed multiplication warehouse to increase certified seed production and reduce post-harvest losses, renovation of agricultural extension centers, provision of agricultural tractors and machinery, and restoration of irrigation pumping stations powered by solar energy. These interventions aim to improve access to quality seeds, mechanized farming services, irrigation, and technical support, thereby enhancing agricultural productivity, strengthening the resilience of farming communities, and supporting sustainable food production in conflict-affected areas.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), in partnership with the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), the Ministr...
records.description: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), in partnership with the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), the Ministry of Water Resources, and with financial support from Global Affairs Canada (GAC), launched the MURUNA project to strengthen climate resilience and improve food and water security in Iraq. The project promotes inclusive water governance, improved community-based water management, and climate-smart agriculture through better water planning, rehabilitation of water infrastructure, support for water user associations, and the introduction of innovative agricultural technologies and practices. Targeting communities affected by water scarcity, drought, desertification, rising temperatures, and declining river flows, the initiative aims to enhance agricultural productivity, strengthen the resilience of vulnerable farmers, improve sustainable resource management, and support long-term food security, with particular emphasis on community participation and women's inclusion.
records.institution: The International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), the Ministry of Water Resources

records.title: The Sana'a Chamber of Commerce and Industry, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, Sana'a Univ...
records.description: The Sana'a Chamber of Commerce and Industry, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, Sana'a University, and the Central Veterinary Laboratory, reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening the poultry sector by complying with government health and veterinary regulations. Following scientific assessments addressing concerns over Newcastle disease, stakeholders pledged to implement regular vaccination and immunization programs, strengthen quality control of poultry production inputs such as feed and chicks, and cooperate fully with veterinary inspection teams to ensure supply chain safety and compliance with national standards. The initiative aims to restore market confidence, reduce losses for poultry farmers, safeguard domestic poultry production, and support national food security by maintaining a reliable and affordable source of animal protein.
records.institution: The Sana'a Chamber of Commerce and Industry

records.title: The Razat Sultaniya Farm of the Royal Court Affairs in Oman has successfully established local pineapple production after extensive resea...
records.description: The Razat Sultaniya Farm of the Royal Court Affairs in Oman has successfully established local pineapple production after extensive research to assess the crop's suitability under local conditions. The initiative advanced from small-scale cultivation to commercial production under shaded areas and greenhouses in Dhofar, where favorable climatic conditions support growth. The farm evaluated multiple pineapple varieties before selecting the globally preferred MD-2 variety for its high yield, fruit quality, and market value. The project also demonstrated the crop's relatively low water requirements and adopted tissue culture technology to produce disease-free planting material, supporting the potential expansion of pineapple cultivation and agricultural diversification in Oman.
records.institution: The Razat Sultaniya Farm of the Royal Court Affairs

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change outlined Qatar’s comprehensive strategy to combat desertification and drought through the...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change outlined Qatar’s comprehensive strategy to combat desertification and drought through the National Strategy to Combat Desertification 2025–2030, aligned with Qatar National Vision 2030. The strategy focuses on sustainable land management, ecosystem restoration, afforestation, rehabilitation of degraded land, protection of biodiversity, expansion of nature reserves, and the use of advanced technologies such as geographic information systems, remote sensing, drones, and artificial intelligence for environmental monitoring. Complemented by legislative reforms, research, community engagement, and international cooperation, including the Middle East Green Initiative, the ministry is implementing programs to increase vegetation cover, improve water efficiency, restore natural habitats, and strengthen climate resilience while supporting sustainable agriculture and long-term environmental sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is conducting inspection and awareness campaigns in livestock markets across the Makka...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is conducting inspection and awareness campaigns in livestock markets across the Makkah Region to strengthen compliance with animal health and veterinary regulations, protect consumers, preserve livestock, and support national food security. As part of a nationwide program, the initiative combines field inspections with awareness activities targeting livestock owners, vendors, and market workers to promote proper livestock transport, handling, display, and veterinary practices while reducing regulatory violations and improving market operations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: According to agricultural trial data released by Razat Royal Farm, operating under the Royal Court Affairs, Oman has successfully cultiva...
records.description: According to agricultural trial data released by Razat Royal Farm, operating under the Royal Court Affairs, Oman has successfully cultivated local pineapple crops in the Dhofar Governorate following nearly fifteen years of agronomic research and field trials. Supervised by the farm’s agricultural engineering specialists, the cultivation methodology transitioned from initial container trials to shaded field planting and controlled greenhouse production, revealing that the crop adapts optimally to Dhofar's mild temperatures and high humidity during the annual Khareef (monsoon) season from July through December. The research evaluated the Queen, Mauritius, and MD-2 pineapple cultivars, identifying the MD-2 variety as the most commercially viable due to its high sweetness profile, low irrigation requirements relative to other tropical species, and large fruit weight ranging from two to over four kilograms. To facilitate future commercial scaling and crop diversification under the Sultanate's agricultural development goals, the farm integrated advanced tissue-culture techniques to systematically mass-produce uniform, disease-free seedlings.
records.institution: The Royal Court Affairs

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dhahirah Governorate, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and W...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dhahirah Governorate, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, is advancing agricultural, livestock, and food security investments to position the governorate as a key production hub in Oman. The region is developing a portfolio of projects covering crop production, greenhouses, livestock farming, food processing, storage, logistics, and agricultural services, supported by government services, private sector partnerships, and modern technologies. These initiatives aim to increase local production, strengthen value chains, enhance self-sufficiency, attract investment, and contribute to Oman Vision 2040 food security objectives.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dhahirah Governorate

records.title: According to data released by the Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources, Al Dhahirah Governorate has compiled an integra...
records.description: According to data released by the Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources, Al Dhahirah Governorate has compiled an integrated portfolio of 67 active food security investment projects across three wilayats, spanning approximately 9,607 acres with an aggregate capital value of OMR 84 million. Operating under the strategic framework of Oman Vision 2040 and coordinated with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the subnational development plan includes a newly finalized poultry production agreement with A'Namaa valued at OMR 28.85 million. The localized investments are structurally distributed to optimize regional comparative advantages, with Ibri leading in diverse greenhouse, fodder, and livestock processing facilities, Dhank functioning as a primary vegetable and table egg production basket, and Yanqul executing horticultural and fish market management projects. To transition from basic harvesting to integrated value chains, the governorate has collaborated with Madayn (Ibri Industrial City) and the Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning to introduce dozens of new high-tech agronomic, tissue culture, and organic fertilizer opportunities via the Tatweer platform, aiming to lock in localized value addition and expand regional agrifood export capacity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Buraimi Governorate has launched its first integrated agricultural investment project in the Al Zaroub area of Mahdah, representing a...
records.description: The Buraimi Governorate has launched its first integrated agricultural investment project in the Al Zaroub area of Mahdah, representing a strategic infrastructure development designed to enhance national food security and mobilize private capital into the agrifood sector. Valued at an initial investment exceeding OMR 171,000 (approximately $444,770), the 30-acre facility specializes in the commercial cultivation, processing, and marketing of high-value horticultural commodities, specifically figs, lemons, and mangoes. Current land allocation includes dedicated acreage for lemon trees, fig orchards, and mango groves, with structural land preparation actively underway to expand production capacity by establishing a new seven-acre fig orchard. This localized initiative functions as a subnational model for sustainable resource management and commercial crop diversification to maximize the economic productivity of agricultural lands.
records.institution: The Buraimi Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced plans to construct 33 new dams across Oman under the Eleventh Five-Y...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced plans to construct 33 new dams across Oman under the Eleventh Five-Year Development Plan to enhance water security, reduce flood risks, and improve climate resilience. The projects include flood protection dams, groundwater recharge facilities, surface storage dams, and community-based water projects aimed at strengthening water resource management, supporting agriculture, and protecting communities and infrastructure. The initiative builds on Oman’s existing dam network and incorporates advanced hydrological models, climate data, early warning systems, and monitoring technologies to improve preparedness for extreme weather events and ensure sustainable water use.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has officially launched the 2026–2027 Khairat AlUla agricultural season to strengthen the competitiv...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has officially launched the 2026–2027 Khairat AlUla agricultural season to strengthen the competitiveness and production efficiency of the region’s agricultural sector across more than 20,500 hectares of cultivated land. To modernize the local agrifood value chain and boost export readiness, the commission has surveyed over 4.2 million palm trees and integrated more than 1.5 million palms into a smart QR code traceability system. These data-driven interventions support the institution's strategic goals to increase gross agricultural output and maximize export revenues, backed by advisory, technical, and veterinary extension services deployed to over 7,100 farmers. Furthermore, the commission is executing circular economy initiatives to recycle agricultural waste into organic compost, alongside deploying designs for modern, water-efficient irrigation networks across 4,000 hectares to achieve targeted reductions in water consumption.
records.institution: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Farmers' Market Festival in Turaif Governorate has commenced operations, under the organizational oversight of the regional branch of...
records.description: The Farmers' Market Festival in Turaif Governorate has commenced operations, under the organizational oversight of the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture alongside the Social Development Bank, to create vital localized sales channels for smallholders and cottage-industry producers. The institutional initiative features dedicated market stalls designed to showcase regional dates, fresh fruits, vegetables, honey, and traditional handicrafts, effectively converting local agronomic production into high-value micro-economic outputs. Furthermore, the event integrates community-level awareness modules focusing on standardized food security frameworks and sustainable agricultural practices, operating as a strategic subnational mechanism to incentivize the consumption of domestic products and advance the socio-economic empowerment of rural communities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Dubai World Trade Centre is scheduled to host Growtech Middle East 2026 (GrowtechME) from October 26 to 28, 2026, in Halls 7 and 8, s...
records.description: The Dubai World Trade Centre is scheduled to host Growtech Middle East 2026 (GrowtechME) from October 26 to 28, 2026, in Halls 7 and 8, serving as a primary regional venue for agricultural innovation, technology, and sustainable farming. Rebranded from its previous iteration as Agra Middle East (AgraME) to reflect an intensifying institutional focus on food security, the exhibition leverages a 17-year sector legacy across the agriculture, aquaculture, and animal health verticals. Designed as a commercial B2B matchmaking and knowledge-sharing hub to connect public and private stakeholders across the agrifood value chain, the upcoming event is projected to feature more than 150 international exhibitors and attract over 9,000 professional attendees.
records.institution: The Dubai World Trade Centre

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The National Center of Meteorology (NCM) reported a high probability that moderate El Niño conditions will persist through the coming mon...
records.description: The National Center of Meteorology (NCM) reported a high probability that moderate El Niño conditions will persist through the coming months, with temperatures and rainfall across the UAE expected to range from near normal to above seasonal averages, particularly toward the latter part of the forecast period. Based on monitoring of sea surface temperatures in the tropical Pacific, the outlook indicates that El Niño is likely to influence the UAE’s climate, with potential implications for weather conditions that are relevant to water resources, agriculture, and climate monitoring.
records.institution: The National Center of Meteorology (NCM)

records.title: The Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, in coordination with the regional Agriculture Office and the Agri...
records.description: The Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, in coordination with the regional Agriculture Office and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, has concluded two specialized animal health training courses for 36 trainees in the Al-Makhadir and Dhi As-Sufal districts of Ibb Governorate. Executed in partnership with the Bonyan Development Foundation and the Bonyan Academy for Training and Qualification, the 19-day curriculum provided intensive theoretical and field-based training in diagnosing and treating viral, bacterial, and parasitic livestock diseases. This community-level veterinary intervention, supported by local authorities and the Dhi As-Sufal Agricultural Cooperative Society, aims to establish a rural veterinary nucleus to minimize livestock losses, improve animal health management, and advance national food security and self-sufficiency goals. At the culmination of the program, graduates were equipped with integrated veterinary kits to provide sustainable veterinary extension services directly to smallholder breeders across local villages.
records.institution: The Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Alternative Energy Projects Company (AEP), a Kuwait-based renewable energy developer, has announced plans to raise capital to expand...
records.description: The Alternative Energy Projects Company (AEP), a Kuwait-based renewable energy developer, has announced plans to raise capital to expand its solar energy operations across Kuwait and the wider MENA region, appointing Kamco Invest and Burgan Bank to lead the transaction. Under the agreement, Kamco Invest will establish a special purpose vehicle for clients to participate in the capital increase, acquiring an equity stake and board representation to support the execution of the firm's growth strategy. The proceeds will be utilized to accelerate the development, financing, and operation of a high-quality pipeline of solar and hybrid off-grid projects under long-term contracts spanning 15 to 25 years. This capital injection will enhance AEP's regional footprint, which already includes secured projects in Kuwait and Oman, while positioning it to pursue additional utility-scale, commercial, and industrial opportunities across Saudi Arabia, Jordan, and the broader region in alignment with national sustainability objectives.
records.institution: The Alternative Energy Projects Company (AEP)

records.title: As part of a strategic initiative reported by the Saudi Press Agency (SPA), the Jazan Region has launched a major tropical fruits and gre...
records.description: As part of a strategic initiative reported by the Saudi Press Agency (SPA), the Jazan Region has launched a major tropical fruits and greenhouses project with capital investments exceeding SAR 600 million to establish the province as a modern agricultural hub. Spanning 1 million square meters, the project allocates half of its footprint to high-tech greenhouse infrastructure and the remaining half to commercial tropical fruit cultivation. The infrastructure integrates smart farming systems—including closed-loop irrigation networks for water recycling and automated greenhouse climate controls—engineered to reduce water consumption by up to 75%. Facilitated through a strategic Saudi-Dutch bilateral partnership for technology transfer, this agrifood investment aims to localize advanced agronomic expertise, expand local content, enhance national food security, and open new channels for high-value manufacturing and exports in line with long-term economic sustainability goals.
records.institution: Jazan Region

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Organized by the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the Khairat Najran festival has commenced operati...
records.description: Organized by the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the Khairat Najran festival has commenced operations, featuring extensive participation from localized organic farms to showcase domestic agricultural yields and promote standardized organic farming practices. The institutional exhibition provides dedicated commercial booths for local agrarian producers, allowing consumers to interface with chemical-free agricultural commodities cultivated using advanced agronomic technologies without synthetic fertilizers or pesticides. Participating farmers highlighted the regional festival as a vital B2B and B2C marketing platform that drives rewarding economic returns, stimulates the subnational agrarian economy, and capitalizes on growing consumer demand for high-quality, verified organic produce, thereby incentivizing smallholders to expand production capacity and optimize structural efficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Local authorities alongside the Jabal Al-Sharq Agricultural Association have launched a specialized breeding center for native Fayoumi ch...
records.description: Local authorities alongside the Jabal Al-Sharq Agricultural Association have launched a specialized breeding center for native Fayoumi chickens in Dhamar Governorate to bolster domestic poultry production, advance food self-sufficiency, and drive rural economic empowerment. Implemented with institutional support from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the Higher Agricultural and Fisheries Committee, and the Bonyan Development Foundation, the project establishes an integrated production framework where core breeding and hatching occur at the center, while second-generation chicks are distributed to rural households via productive livestock loan programs. To ensure long-term operational viability and mitigate overhead costs for smallholders, the initiative incorporates circular economy principles by providing localized technical training, veterinary vaccination protocols, and cost-effective, locally sourced feed alternatives.
records.institution: The Jabal Al-Sharq Agricultural Association

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has announced the completion of 11 development projects valued at ove...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has announced the completion of 11 development projects valued at over SAR 70 million, designed to modernize Saudi Arabia's beekeeping and honey production sector. The initiative includes four honey production infrastructure assets worth nearly SAR 17 million and seven regional stations for queen bee breeding and bee package production worth more than SAR 53.3 million. These specialized breeding installations have reached advanced completion rates across multiple areas, including Tabuk, Hail, Madinah, Jazan, and Aseer (Namas). Alongside physical infrastructure, the program has deployed mobile diagnostic veterinary clinics, three specialized mobile laboratories, and field clinics at strategic quarantine sites to mitigate bee diseases and pests. This comprehensive agrifood intervention aims to enhance subnational biodiversity, optimize domestic bee colony strains, and scale production capacities to advance national food security and rural self-sufficiency goals.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: Expo City Dubai, in partnership with the UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism, launched the first Expo Green Licences for six sustainabili...
records.description: Expo City Dubai, in partnership with the UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism, launched the first Expo Green Licences for six sustainability-focused businesses as part of the UAE’s first Green Innovation District. The initiative provides financial and business incentives to organizations with verified environmental, social, and governance (ESG) credentials to promote sustainable innovation, circular economy solutions, climate technologies, and clean energy. The programme aims to support green business growth, strengthen the UAE’s sustainability ecosystem, and contribute to the country's economic diversification and net-zero ambitions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: A multi-ministerial workshop held in Sana’a, bringing together the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, the Ministry of Economy and Ind...
records.description: A multi-ministerial workshop held in Sana’a, bringing together the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, the Ministry of Economy and Industry, and the General Land Transport Authority in cooperation with the Agricultural Cooperative Union and the Bonyan Foundation, outlined a unified strategy to develop the domestic pomegranate value chain ahead of the seasonal harvest. To reduce post-harvest losses and protect agrarian incomes, the collaborative framework prioritizes shifting from arbitrary basket-based pricing to standardized, kilogram-based market transactions. Key operational directives focus on expanding localized cold-storage networks, optimizing packaging systems, and establishing a joint logistics operations room with the land transport sector to guarantee stable truck fleets and fixed transport rates. By coordinating subnational marketing extensions, launching product promotional festivals, and mitigating seasonal oversupply, the joint initiative aims to break export monopolies, expand access to international agrifood corridors, and conserve regional water resources by shifting acreage away from water-intensive cash crops.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, the Ministry of Economy and Industry

records.title: A specialized study published by the Geographical Society reveals that nearly 50 percent of Kuwait’s land has the biophysical potential t...
records.description: A specialized study published by the Geographical Society reveals that nearly 50 percent of Kuwait’s land has the biophysical potential to support agricultural expansion if supported by reliable and sustainable water resources, framing innovative water management as a core pillar to reduce import dependence and achieve long-term food self-sufficiency. Faced with climate-induced pressures such as rising evaporation rates and unpredictable rainfall, the research outlines a strategic shift toward capturing seasonal runoff through rainwater harvesting systems, maximizing the utilization of treated wastewater for irrigation, and transitioning to drought-tolerant crops like barley, sorghum, and quinoa. By adopting high-tech water recycling models similar to international best practices, the study concludes that integrated resource planning can successfully transform severe desert water scarcity into a resilient national asset capable of withstand supply chain and environmental shocks.
records.institution: The Geographical Society

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia has inaugurated its first seasonal initiative at Al-Hazem Rural Farm in the Al-Mandaq Governorate of the Al-Baha Region. Featuring 22 specialized exhibition pavilions, the public-private event brings together seasonal fruit cultivators, local beekeepers, cottage industry entrepreneurs, and traditional artisans. The agricultural governance framework is structured to empower subnational smallholders and honey producers by optimizing regional market access, enhancing direct-to-consumer commercial pipelines, and stimulating rural tourism and micro-economic growth. By highlighting Al-Baha's distinct agrifood and apiculture offerings, the state-led initiative advances the socio-economic diversification and rural development mandates outlined in Saudi Vision 2030.

records.description: The Saudi government has officially granted ACWA Power Company (ACWA) an exclusive mandate to export green hydrogen and its synthesized derivatives—including green ammonia, green methanol, and low-carbon green fuels—produced within the Kingdom to international markets. Under this sovereign authorization, the utility enterprise will develop integrated infrastructure projects to generate, transmit, and export renewable-generated electricity directly to European and Arab trade markets to support regional energy security. This exclusive export framework leverages the company's extensive asset pipeline to advance Saudi Arabia's strategic Vision 2030 energy transition targets, establishing a large-scale logistics and operational foundation to connect the Kingdom's abundant renewable resources with expanding global demand for clean energy molecules.

records.description: According to a report by the state-run Syrian News Agency, a strategic trade agreement has been established to launch a direct overland transit corridor for fruit and vegetable exports routing from Syria through Iraq into the United Arab Emirates. Bypassing regional intermediaries to optimize delivery timelines and increase financial returns for local farmers, the framework includes a memorandum of understanding with the UAE-based Mair Group to construct four specialized agricultural processing and sorting centers across Syria's coastal, central, southern, and eastern regions. The initiative also features the development of an integrated digital platform and digital financing services to streamline agrifood value chains, aligning with a broader logistics corridor designed to connect Syrian ports with Iraq’s port of Umm Qasr and the UAE’s Khalifa Port.
records.institution: Mair Group

records.title: The Tadweer Group has awarded a strategic contract to the Spanish environmental services corporation Urbaser to construct and operate Abu...
records.description: The Tadweer Group has awarded a strategic contract to the Spanish environmental services corporation Urbaser to construct and operate Abu Dhabi’s first greenfield Material Recovery Facility. Operating through a joint venture structured with a 60% stake held by Urbaser and 40% by Tadweer Group, the state-of-the-art 400,000-tonne facility is designed to process 200,000 tonnes of municipal solid waste and 200,000 tonnes of commercial and industrial waste annually. The infrastructure asset will integrate automated sorting, optical technologies, and artificial intelligence to optimize material separation accuracy, feeding recovered materials directly into Abu Dhabi's upcoming Waste-to-Energy (WtE) pipeline. This landmark circular economy project marks the international operator's expansion into the UAE waste treatment sector and serves as a primary operational lever to achieve the emirate's sovereign mandate of diverting 80% of municipal waste away from landfills.
records.institution: The Tadweer Group

records.description: The Agricultural Cooperation and Food Security Committee of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) has convened an extraordinary ministerial meeting to accelerate the integration of a unified Gulf food security system and enhance the subregional capacity to absorb international economic shocks. Chaired under the current presidency of the Kingdom of Bahrain, the high-level virtual summit brought together ministers and senior officials to advance the technical blueprint for a joint GCC strategic storage network encompassing staple foods, essential medicines, and critical commodity reserves. To insulate member states from high import dependency, the institutional framework prioritizes the immediate diversification of foreign agricultural supply lines, the harmonization of cross-border customs logistics to safeguard the continuous movement of agrifood goods, and the expansion of domestic production using advanced agritech applications. This coordinated public planning initiative serves as an essential national security pillar designed to solidify regional emergency preparedness and maintain supply chain resilience across all member states.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and private sector partners, concluded a project to strengthen sustainable beekeeping and enhance the capacity of small and medium-sized enterprises in the sector. records.description: According to data released by Mwani Qatar, Qatari ports experienced a significant increase in trade volume and operational efficiency, marked by a 13% month-on-month rise in container handling to over 78,000 TEUs and a 21% jump in vessel arrivals to 121 ships. The maritime infrastructure also successfully absorbed a 40% surge in bulk cargo, exceeding 67,000 tonnes, driven by increased imports of essential food commodities to support national food security objectives and industrial raw materials for local construction activity. This expansion in shipping traffic was accommodated without a proportional rise in congestion or cargo delays, underscoring enhanced capacity for temperature-controlled refrigerated containers and reinforcing the nation's broader economic diversification and international trade connectivity goals.

records.description: The Middle East Green Initiative (MGI) and the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) have signed a strategic memorandum of understanding (MoU) in Riyadh to strengthen regional cooperation on land rehabilitation and vegetation cover development. Under the executive framework, the partnership establishes a mechanism for intensive information sharing, technical capacity building, and knowledge transfer across member states to systematically combat land degradation and accelerate desertification control projects. The agreement aligns with the G20 Global Land Initiative and supports the environmental sustainability mandates of Saudi Vision 2030 by mobilizing technical and financial resources to restore degraded ecosystems, protect vital natural resources, and scale up subnational and regional conservation programs.

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in the Qassim Region has driven a significant expansion in agricultural diversification by providing targeted agricultural guidance, technical lectures, and field extension tours to optimize local farming efficiency. This institutional support has enabled the region to establish a robust fig cultivation sector alongside its traditional palm, peach, grape, and melon crops, directly contributing to the national food security system in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. Utilizing favorable local environmental conditions, the region now features nearly 30 specialized farms cultivating over 100,000 fig trees across roughly 30 distinct local and international varieties. By enhancing downstream agricultural practices and proving the economic viability of high-yield fruit crops, this public-private framework successfully transforms regional natural resources into sustainable, value-added domestic agrifood assets.

records.description: The General Women’s Union (GWU), the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), and the Ministry of Education of the United Arab Emirates have collaborated to execute the "Future Women Farmers" training program. Launched as a core component of the "We Grow for Sustainability" initiative and aligned with the United Nations’ declaration of the International Year of the Woman Farmer, the four-month educational curriculum engaged 190 female students from schools across the nation. The program provided an integrated scientific and practical pathway covering sustainable agronomy, soil fertility preservation, and biodiversity protection. By combining hands-on agricultural applications with advanced agritech solutions—such as vertical farming, hydroponics, and smart irrigation systems—the inter-institutional framework is engineered to optimize water efficiency, support the "Plant the Emirates" national program, and cultivate a new generation of technical female talent capable of advancing the mandates of the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy 2051.

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dakhiliyah Governorate has scaled its food security investment portfolio...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dakhiliyah Governorate has scaled its food security investment portfolio, securing contracts worth approximately OMR 158 million through May 2026 and exceeding its annual target with a 113% completion rate. Spurred by state-led investment platforms like "Tatweer" and the "Propose Your Project" window, the regional development strategy has unlocked over 185.7 million square meters of newly zoned agricultural, livestock, and aquaculture lands across the Wilayats of Nizwa, Adam, Izki, Al Hamra, and Al Jabal Al Akhdar. Key capital deployments include an OMR 4 million tissue culture biotechnology facility in Nizwa for date palm and seedling optimization, an OMR 3 million downstream processing plant via the Nizwa Food Industries Factory, and the OMR 1.7 million Al Bashair Veterinary Hospital in Adam, functioning as a landmark public-private partnership. By systematically integrating primary production with specialized food processing, modernized fish market infrastructure, and advanced micro-climate farming for high-value crops like saffron and olives, the institutional framework aims to build an integrated agrifood value chain that accelerates import substitution and supports the economic diversification mandates of Oman Vision 2040.

records.title: The OQ Group, in strategic public-private partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Agricultura...
records.description: The OQ Group, in strategic public-private partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund, has concluded the primary phase of the "OQ Green Initiative," yielding significant agricultural, economic, and environmental results across Oman. Managed operationally through specialized state bodies like the Department of Agricultural Research in the North Al Batinah Governorate, the unified framework successfully cultivated and distributed more than 274,000 high-productivity economic seedlings—including mango, Omani lemon, fig, grape, and pomegranate varieties—to commercial operations, smallholders, and public institutions. The long-term macroeconomic forecast models an output exceeding 10,000 tonnes of domestic fruit yields with an estimated market valuation of OMR 4.3 million, directly advancing national import substitution, reinforcing the expansion of plant genetic banks, and introducing a carbon sequestration asset capable of absorbing 8,000 tonnes of $CO_2$ annually. Furthermore, the program maximized in-country value (ICV) by directing over OMR 346,000 across 60 operational contracts to local small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), successfully aligning private corporate capital with the sustainable land-management, decarbonization, and economic diversification mandates of Oman Vision 2040 and the Net Zero 2050 target.

To drive these structural reforms, the UAE has locked in concrete success metrics, targeting a 50% reduction in licensing times for new agritech ventures, a 30% reduction in irrigation water consumption per tonne of crop, and a 15% reduction in overall food waste.

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia has reported an annual domestic peach harvest exceeding 31,000 tons, driving a seasonal supply surge across national retail markets during the peak summer period. Cultivated primarily across the specialized agricultural zones of Tabuk, Al-Jouf, Aseer, and Al-Baha, the locally grown peach varieties support both fresh consumer markets and expanding downstream industrial value chains, including specialized regional food processing, cosmetic, and medical product manufacturing. To sustain this production volume, the ministry deploys an integrated development framework providing local smallholders with advanced agricultural technologies, technical field extensions, and targeted financing facilities. By anchoring supply and distribution channels through state-supported seasonal exhibitions, this public intervention optimizes logistics, improves market accessibility for national products, and reduces reliance on agrifood imports in direct alignment with the economic diversification and food security targets of Saudi Vision 2030.

records.description: The Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology of Oman, in strategic coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has launched a state-backed maritime subsidy program designating Asyad Shipping to receive 50% government coverage for fuel and insurance costs on the India-Oman trade route for up to six months. Engineered to insulate the sultanate's national food supply chain from international market volatility, this targeted logistics initiative requires the national carrier to pass financial savings directly to qualifying commercial import clients transporting essential food cargoes on its regular container liner services. By subsidizing these primary overhead costs, the government aims to suppress imported inflation, stabilize domestic consumer food prices, and capitalize on Asyad's extensive regional maritime fleet to fortify cross-border trade connectivity with India.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia has successfully concluded the inaugural Saudi Water Week in Jeddah, b...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia has successfully concluded the inaugural Saudi Water Week in Jeddah, bringing together over 2,500 delegates, 180 international experts, and 20 ministerial delegations from more than 80 countries across 97 specialized technical and policy sessions. Serving as a unified multilateral platform, the event integrated high-level consultative meetings for the Seventh Arab Water Forum and advanced preparations for the 11th World Water Forum, establishing an operational roadmap designated as the “Road to Riyadh 2027.” The state-backed framework successfully facilitated trans-boundary political and technical dialogues focused on mitigating global water waste, optimizing structural resource efficiency, scaling innovative financing mechanisms, and enforcing integrated water resources management (IWRM) strategies. By bridging the gap between scientific innovation and public policy, the framework is engineered to build cross-border knowledge partnerships, elevate youth engagement in resource stewardship, and strengthen macro-level global and regional water security architecture ahead of the upcoming 2027 global summit.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Qassim Region has established itself as a premier agricultural hub for grape cultivation in Saudi Arabia, leveraging its favorable so...
records.description: The Qassim Region has established itself as a premier agricultural hub for grape cultivation in Saudi Arabia, leveraging its favorable soil and environmental conditions to yield an annual harvest of approximately 30,875 tons. Managed across roughly 60 specialized farms spanning over 1,021 hectares and containing more than 1.28 million fruit-bearing grapevines, the regional sector relies on modern agricultural practices and careful manual harvesting to maintain high fruit quality for the domestic market. Driven by the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, current efforts focus on expanding cultivation footprints and stimulating investment in downstream grape-related food processing and cottage industries. This strategic framework is engineered to maximize value-added production, enhance local market competitiveness, and diversify regional agricultural outputs in direct alignment with the sustainable development and economic diversification mandates of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Public Authority for Agricultural Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR) of Kuwait has temporarily suspended its subsidized fodder distr...
records.description: The Public Authority for Agricultural Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR) of Kuwait has temporarily suspended its subsidized fodder distribution services during the first week of July to execute a major technical overhaul of the automated system governing feed disbursement operations. Implemented as an operational component of Kuwait's broader national digital transformation strategy, the temporary suspension halts feed allocations at central supply depots to allow engineering teams to complete critical database and software updates. By modernizing its digital infrastructure, the authority aims to optimize transaction processing speeds, enhance data tracking accuracy for registered livestock holdings, and eliminate future procedural bottlenecks for local breeders and pastoral owners.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Agricultural Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman has deployed technical field support, pest management guidance, and lo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman has deployed technical field support, pest management guidance, and logistical marketing assistance to accelerate youth-led and high-density commercial investment projects focused on the cultivation of high-yield tropical crops. Highlighted by a specialized private-sector venture in the Al Dakhiliyah Governorate, the commercial development leverages four acres of land optimized with 9,000 trees of the Taiwanese hybrid papaya variety “Red Lady,” an early-fruiting cultivar engineered for rapid maturity and transport durability. Utilizing advanced agrotech infrastructure—including modern automated drip irrigation integrated with fertigation (injecting fertilizers directly into irrigation lines) and integrated pest management (IPM) protocols—the project yields a consistent baseline of two to three tonnes of fresh produce weekly. Distributed directly to regional hubs and central markets like Samail, this state-supported production framework is designed to drive domestic crop diversification, catalyze high-value downstream agrifood processing industries, expand arid green covers to mitigate desertification, and fortify national food security architecture through intensive land-use efficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF) of Saudi A...
records.description: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF) of Saudi Arabia, has announced the structural integration of its wholly owned Ukrainian primary production asset, the Continental Farmers Group (CFG), into Olam Agri, in which SALIC holds an 80.01% controlling stake following a recent SAR 7 billion transaction. This corporate integration consolidates SALIC's international asset portfolio by matching CFG's large-scale upstream agricultural production and cultivation footprints in Ukraine with Olam Agri's extensive midstream sourcing, trading, value-added processing, and global logistics networks across more than 30 nations. Engineered to compress value-chain inefficiencies and expand primary crop sourcing optionality, the strategic realignment leverages multinational operational scale to optimize cross-border supply chains, mitigate macroeconomic market shocks, and fortify long-term food system resilience.
records.institution: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC)

records.title: The Saudi Irrigation Organization, in institutional partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the specialized Esti...
records.description: The Saudi Irrigation Organization, in institutional partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the specialized Estidamah Center, has accelerated the deployment of data-driven smart farming frameworks across the Kingdom, highlighted by the operational integration of artificial intelligence (AI) at the Haswah Mango Farm in Rijal Alma, Asir. By syncing real-time data from soil moisture sensors, wind-speed monitors, and water-salinity telemetry, the AI-powered precision architecture optimized irrigation and fertilization schedules to scale the farm's mango flowering rate from 60% to over 98%. This local agrotech application mirrors macro-level achievements validated by the national "Improving Irrigation Efficiency and Water Productivity Among Farmers" initiative, which has elevated irrigation efficiency from 50% to over 92% at regional demonstration farms while securing a 19% reduction in water consumption for tropical fruit cultivation. Backed by academic validation from Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University, these state-directed modernizations—encompassing hydroponics, high-tech glasshouses, biofertilizers, and nanotechnology—are engineered to compress agricultural water demand, maximize crop yields in arid environments, and solidify national food security baselines.
records.institution: The Saudi Irrigation Organization

records.title: The Saudi Reef Academy, in strategic operational cooperation with the Eastern Region branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agr...
records.description: The Saudi Reef Academy, in strategic operational cooperation with the Eastern Region branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, has scaled a specialized capacity-building initiative to advance sustainable rural development. Executed through a multi-sectoral community partnership alongside beekeepers' associations from the Eastern and Baha regions, the state-backed development framework focuses on optimizing localized natural resources by training apicultural producers in advanced apiary management and best practices for high-value mangrove honey production. By deploying targeted field extension services, practical training programs, and enhanced commercial branding strategies, the initiative aims to refine agricultural value chains, elevate the market identity of domestic products, and generate sustainable grassroots economic opportunities. This structural framework capitalizes on the specific geographic and comparative advantages of the Kingdom's rural zones, directly supporting the human capital and environmental sustainability mandates of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Saudi Reef Academy

records.title: The Haswa Mango Farm, situated within the Rijal Almaa Governorate of the Tihama Aseer region, has established a high-efficiency cultivati...
records.description: The Haswa Mango Farm, situated within the Rijal Almaa Governorate of the Tihama Aseer region, has established a high-efficiency cultivation model for tropical fruits by integrating an advanced, artificial intelligence-driven agricultural management framework. Utilizing an interconnected digital infrastructure consisting of automated soil moisture sensors, real-time wind-monitoring arrays, and automated water-quality analysis systems, the enterprise applies precision data analytics to optimize resource consumption and drive localized agricultural decision-making. This agrotech infrastructure enabled the compact farm to generate a high-quality yield of approximately four metric tons of mangoes, validating scientific benchmarks regarding the capacity of digital water monitoring to mitigate resource waste and maximize crop productivity in arid zones. Fully aligned with the environmental sustainability and food security mandates of Saudi Vision 2030, this operational framework demonstrates how deploying smart irrigation technologies and digital water-management systems can successfully scale high-density primary production while preserving finite regional water assets.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief), in operational partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief), in operational partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), has signed a joint executive program to implement a rural women's economic empowerment project in the Syrian Arab Republic under the "Bathraa" initiative. Engineered to directly support 520 individuals and indirectly benefit more than 284,000 others, the international development framework focuses on stabilizing livelihoods and expanding local household incomes by rehabilitating and equipping specialized, multipurpose production hubs. These localized centers will integrate automated food-processing units, agricultural waste composting systems, dedicated marketing kiosks, and decentralized renewable energy solutions to establish a sustainable, self-sufficient manufacturing and training environment. Furthermore, the state-backed humanitarian program incorporates comprehensive technical, entrepreneurial, and leadership capacity-building curriculums alongside the direct distribution of specialized machinery and tools to catalyze income-generating grassroots enterprises and reinforce rural economic resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia, in institutional coordination with water ministers and high-level del...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia, in institutional coordination with water ministers and high-level delegations from 11 Arab nations, has spearheaded a strategic agreement to formulate a unified regional roadmap targeting long-term water security during the Seventh Arab Water Forum. Convened in Jeddah under the broader framework of the inaugural Saudi Water Week, the inter-governmental ministerial session addressed critical trans-boundary water deficits, accelerating climate-driven desiccation, and escalating municipal demands fueled by rapid urbanization and population growth across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. Moving away from fragmented, isolated domestic interventions, the agreed-upon state roadmap establishes a cohesive framework for joint investments in non-conventional water resources—including advanced seawater desalination and wastewater reclamation—alongside nature-based infrastructure solutions, institutional twinning programs, and cross-border clean technology transfers. By integrating water asset management with regional food and energy security matrices, the state-backed multilateral initiative is engineered to deploy innovative financing mechanisms and enforce inclusive governance models to secure equitable resource distribution and strengthen regional climate resilience.

records.title: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center, operating under the institutional patronage of the Ministry of Environment, Water...
records.description: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center, operating under the institutional patronage of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia, has officially launched the "My Water (Maee)" Award during the inaugural Saudi Water Week in Jeddah. Designed as a key strategic initiative to incentivize national sustainability goals, the award framework establishes a competitive national environment to stimulate scientific innovation, promote cross-sector efficiency benchmarks, and recognize outstanding engineering and conservation practices across public, private, and civil sectors. By embedding the launch within a high-level international utility summit, the state-backed center aims to accelerate the adoption of high-impact water-use technologies, cultivate a culture of resource stewardship, and preserve critical water reserves for future generations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman has expanded operations at the Mango Gene Bank within the Sohar Agricu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman has expanded operations at the Mango Gene Bank within the Sohar Agricultural Research Station, establishing one of the largest field genetic repositories for the crop in the region. Designed as a living database and a strategic buffer against climate-induced agricultural pressures, the research center houses 252 local and international mango varieties distributed across 708 trees—including 62 distinct Omani cultivars collected across various governorates and specimens from 23 leading fruit-producing nations. By deploying advanced phenotypic profiling, genetic fingerprinting, and artificial intelligence models, state researchers isolate high-yield genetic traits to breed new, resilient cultivars optimized for drought tolerance, extreme heat, and salinity resistance. This public-sector biotechnology initiative is engineered to optimize domestic nursery pipelines, supply commercial farmers with premium propagation materials, and eliminate international seedling dependency, directly strengthening Oman's long-term food security and agricultural export competitiveness

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia, in institutional coordination with the World Water Council and the Gl...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia, in institutional coordination with the World Water Council and the Global Water Organization, has launched the inaugural Saudi Water Week in Jeddah to advance international water diplomacy and structural sector modernization. The high-level summit hosts the 7th Arab Water Forum and the consultative proceedings for the 11th World Water Forum, bringing together global policymakers, research institutions, and utility operators to align infrastructure strategies with Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Water Strategy. Institutional reforms over the past decade have successfully compressed non-renewable groundwater extraction from 21 billion cubic meters in 2016 to approximately 11 billion cubic meters, while simultaneously scaling daily desalination utility capacity to 16 million cubic meters and expanding strategic storage reserves by over 125%. Backed by standardized regulatory frameworks that have mobilized more than SAR 60 billion in private-sector investments across the national supply chain, the state-backed initiative leverages an accompanying technology exhibition focused on digitalization, water reuse, and high-efficiency desalination to secure regional water resources, optimize production energy footprints, and establish the Kingdom as a primary architect of global water sustainability.

records.title: The General Authority for Red Sea Fisheries, in institutional coordination with the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives F...
records.description: The General Authority for Red Sea Fisheries, in institutional coordination with the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, has completed the handover of the first phase of a specialized infrastructure modernization project across fish landing centers in Hodeida governorate. Financed through a state-backed allocation of 93 million Yemeni rials, the initial phase establishes eight fully equipped, prefabricated administrative service centers out of a planned 14-center network designed to streamline local maritime governance. Formally launched by the Hodeida local authority leadership, the regulatory infrastructure framework is engineered to optimize fish catch data collection, issue fishing vessel licenses, and standardize transit permits for marketing vehicles, directly safeguarding product quality from coastal landing points to retail markets. By upgrading these crucial logistical nodes, the public sector initiative reinforces regional food security, safeguards marine resources, and supports localized economic development for thousands of smallholder artisanal fishing families along the Red Sea coast.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman, in institutional coordination with Oman Flour Mills, has launched the sixth consecutive annual national wheat purchase campaign to collect and process the 2026 domestic grain harvest from smallholders across several governorates. Engineered as a state-backed agrifood localization framework, the procurement initiative establishes an organized, reliable wholesale marketing channel that provides local farmers with fair, stabilized pricing, encouraging the expansion of cultivated acreage and the deployment of modern farming technologies. By integrating the harvested crop directly into domestic processing facilities to manufacture Oman-made food products, the public-private partnership effectively closes the agricultural value chain, optimizes local value addition (ICV), and minimizes international grain import reliance in alignment with national food security strategy objectives.

records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), via its Jazan Branch and in institutional cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Reef National Foundation, has organized a specialized two-day technical workshop dedicated to establishing a "Community Seed Bank in Jazan Region."
