records.title: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP) has issued a tender for techno-economic consultancy services to develop a large-s...
records.description: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP) has issued a tender for techno-economic consultancy services to develop a large-scale Independent Power Project (IPP) fueled by green hydrogen. This pioneering initiative explores the feasibility of a generation facility with a capacity of 800 to 1,000 megawatts capable of operating on up to 100% hydrogen, marking a shift from Oman's traditional focus on hydrogen exports toward domestic power application. By evaluating hydrogen as a long-duration energy storage medium and a clean fuel for dispatchable power, Nama PWP aims to balance the intermittency of increasing solar and wind capacity while reducing reliance on natural gas in alignment with Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP)

records.title: Baladna and Al Dahra Holding have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) during the Make it in the Emirates 2026 forum to establish a...
records.description: Baladna and Al Dahra Holding have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) during the Make it in the Emirates 2026 forum to establish a strategic partnership focused on global farming and animal feed supply. Under this agreement, Al Dahra will serve as a strategic supplier of grains and feed commodities, supporting Baladna’s international dairy expansion and ensuring high-quality feed security for its operations in several markets, including Syria. The collaboration aims to develop integrated farming platforms and scalable agricultural systems to enhance productivity and long-term food security.
records.institution: Baladna

records.title: Fruit cultivation in the Najran Region has become a primary driver of agricultural diversity and food security, leveraging the area's fer...
records.description: Fruit cultivation in the Najran Region has become a primary driver of agricultural diversity and food security, leveraging the area's fertile soil and moderate climate to establish red guava as a high-value investment crop. According to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the region now hosts approximately 7,000 productive red guava trees, marking a qualitative transformation in local output supported by technical guidance for farmers. This expansion aligns with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 by promoting self-sufficiency and creating new employment opportunities within the agricultural and processing sectors. By focusing on high-quality nutritional crops with strong economic viability, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture aims to solidify Najran's position as a strategic agricultural hub.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Halal Products Development Company (HPDC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and the multi-protein producer MBRF have...
records.description: The Halal Products Development Company (HPDC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and the multi-protein producer MBRF have completed the financial closing of the SAR 8 billion (US$2.07 billion) Sadia Halal transaction. This strategic deal integrates production plants, logistics hubs, and distribution networks across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Oman to create a large-scale regional halal food platform. Under the agreement, HPDC has increased its stake to 20%, with the potential to reach 40%, as the company prepares for an initial public offering on the Tadawul stock exchange. The partnership aims to strengthen regional food supply chains and enhance Saudi Arabia's role in the global halal market through expanded industrial capabilities.
records.institution: The Halal Products Development Company (HPDC)

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has completed the rehabilitation of the central fish, vegetable, and fruit...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has completed the rehabilitation of the central fish, vegetable, and fruit market in Al-Mukalla, Hadhramaut, as part of a sustainable agriculture and fisheries empowerment project. The renovation included upgrading 22 fish outlets and 17 vegetable and fruit stalls, along with modernizing water, sewage, and electrical systems to provide advanced infrastructure for local producers. By developing value chains and improving market access, the initiative aims to enhance local resilience, support the livelihoods of fishermen and farmers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality products to consumers.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture led a high-level delegation to the 5th Istanbul International Water Forum to advocate...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture led a high-level delegation to the 5th Istanbul International Water Forum to advocate for a global shift in treating water as a strategic economic link between climate, food, health, and ecosystems. During the forum, officials emphasized the necessity of international cooperation, governance, and innovation to build global water resilience and address growing scarcity challenges. In partnership with the World Water Council, the delegation also reviewed preparatory progress for the upcoming World Water Forum, which the Kingdom is scheduled to host in Riyadh in 2027.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has reached a 50% completion milestone for the Rayyis Fish Auction an...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has reached a 50% completion milestone for the Rayyis Fish Auction and Boat Maintenance Center on the Red Sea coast. This strategic project is designed to boost the local economy by improving the marketing lifespan of seafood and providing an advanced auction hall and ice production facilities for approximately 150 boats monthly. Additionally, the initiative includes a technical maintenance center capable of servicing up to 25 boats per month using modern diagnostic technologies to reduce downtime for local fishermen. By focusing on professional packaging and the localization of technical skills, the program aims to enhance the competitiveness of Rayyis fish in both local and international markets.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Expo City Dubai Foundation has awarded funding to seven global projects under its Global Innovators Programme, specifically targeting...
records.description: The Expo City Dubai Foundation has awarded funding to seven global projects under its Global Innovators Programme, specifically targeting extreme heat challenges in the Global South. Selected from over 1,000 applications, these initiatives from Egypt, Morocco, Peru, India, and Nigeria will each receive up to $100,000 to implement sustainable solutions in sectors such as agriculture, construction, and waste management. Notable projects include Ecodome Maroc (Morocco), which uses traditional building methods for heat-resistant bricks, and Visenleer (Egypt), which produces cooling textiles from ocean waste. By providing technical support and access to global networks, the foundation aims to scale these climate-resilient innovations, which have already reached over six million people worldwide since the program's inception.
records.institution: The Expo City Dubai Foundation

records.title: The Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC) has signed a strategic Collaboration Framework Agreement with Masdar to accelerate the...
records.description: The Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC) has signed a strategic Collaboration Framework Agreement with Masdar to accelerate the deployment of utility-scale renewable energy projects across the UAE. This roadmap aims to diversify the national energy mix and secure 60% of Abu Dhabi’s total energy demand from renewable and clean sources by 2035, specifically targeting over 30GW of solar PV capacity and 8GW of battery energy storage. By streamlining project development from early stages to financial close, the partnership seeks to enhance supply security, support local industrial growth, and foster Emirati talent in line with the UAE Net Zero by 2050 Strategic Initiative.
records.institution: The Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC)

records.title: The Russia-UAE Business Council (RUBC) and the UAE Food Cluster signed a strategic cooperation agreement during the "Make it in the Emira...
records.description: The Russia-UAE Business Council (RUBC) and the UAE Food Cluster signed a strategic cooperation agreement during the "Make it in the Emirates" forum to enhance bilateral trade and industrial localization within the food sector. The partnership focuses on four priority areas: joint project development, mutual market access, the establishment of resilient logistics corridors, and the creation of agro-industrial localization programs. This agreement aligns with the UAE's National Programme to Strengthen Supply Chain Resilience and leverages the complementary nature of the two economies to secure supplies of food and industrial goods while exploring joint opportunities in third-country markets.
records.institution: The UAE Food Cluster

records.title: The Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Establishment (EKTIFA), operating under the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Lives...
records.description: The Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Establishment (EKTIFA), operating under the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Livestock, signed a memorandum of understanding with Al Dahra during the "Make it in the Emirates" 2026 forum to enhance the sustainability and efficiency of local food production. The agreement focuses on building robust agricultural value chains, developing specialized animal feed solutions, and establishing flexible supply arrangements to support major projects like Mleiha Farm. By leveraging the global expertise of Al Dahra, EKTIFA aims to integrate leading agricultural institutions to drive higher-quality output and ensure the responsible stewardship of natural resources in line with national food security goals.

records.title: The Silal Group launched an advanced AI-powered sustainability platform named "Zero," developed by Olive Gaea, during the "Make it in the...
records.description: The Silal Group launched an advanced AI-powered sustainability platform named "Zero," developed by Olive Gaea, during the "Make it in the Emirates" 2026 forum. This platform utilizes machine learning and real-time intelligence to automate carbon tracking, ESG data collection, and sustainability reporting across all of the group's subsidiaries. By aligning with the UAE's Net Zero 2050 Strategy, the Silal Group aims to enhance investor transparency, bolster internal governance, and support the national food security agenda through data-driven environmental stewardship.
records.institution: The Silal Group

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman organized the Veterinary Medicine Forum 2026 in Muscat to strengthen t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman organized the Veterinary Medicine Forum 2026 in Muscat to strengthen the role of veterinarians in safeguarding public health and food safety. The forum brought together specialists and representatives from the World Organization for Animal Health (WOAH) to discuss international health standards, disease prevention, and the enhancement of technical competencies within the livestock sector. By fostering partnerships between the public and private sectors, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources aims to support sustainable agricultural development and modernize veterinary services to mitigate global health risks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has launched an awareness campaign designed to reposition the value of water...
records.description: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has launched an awareness campaign designed to reposition the value of water as a fundamental driver of urban, industrial, and agricultural progress. By linking conservation directly to economic expansion and food security, the National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) aims to shift community perception from simple daily usage to a broader strategic development scope. The initiative underscores that improving water-use efficiency is essential for supporting the national economy, ensuring sustainable development, and enhancing overall quality of life.
records.institution: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE)

records.title: The aquaculture sector in the Qassim Region is undergoing a transformative expansion, serving as a key pillar of Saudi Vision 2030 to enh...
records.description: The aquaculture sector in the Qassim Region is undergoing a transformative expansion, serving as a key pillar of Saudi Vision 2030 to enhance national food security. Despite the region's arid climate, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has successfully integrated high-tech solutions like Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Aquaponics to maximize water efficiency. Primarily focusing on Tilapia and Catfish, these projects provide a sustainable source of local protein while diversifying rural incomes. According to the Qassim branch of MEWA, the sector is now shifting toward strengthening private sector partnerships and developing robust supply chains to meet both domestic demand and future export targets, positioning the Kingdom as a rising leader in desert-based aquaculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has achieved substantial progress on critical infrastructure and development p...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has achieved substantial progress on critical infrastructure and development projects across the Musandam Governorate to enhance food security and economic growth. Significant milestones include the near-completion of fish markets in Khasab, Ghamdha, and Al-Jari, along with a strategic OMR 39.8 million expansion of the Dibba fishing port. The initiative also encompasses environmental and resource management efforts, such as marine habitat rehabilitation, national pest management programs, and the construction of dams and protection walls. By integrating advanced aquaculture technologies, promoting oyster and finfish farming, and expanding private sector participation in the fisheries sector, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is fostering a sustainable blue economy that creates jobs and bolsters the resilience of local artisanal fishing communities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation, through the Oman Animal and Plant Genetic Resources Center (Mawrid), is spearh...
records.description: The Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation, through the Oman Animal and Plant Genetic Resources Center (Mawrid), is spearheading an advanced national framework to collect, preserve, and study the Sultanate’s diverse biological resources. This initiative includes the documentation of thousands of terrestrial, marine, and microbial samples, ranging from purebred Arabian horse semen and endangered wild animal DNA to strategic crops like wheat and medicinal plants. To enhance research efficiency, the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation has introduced a mobile research laboratory and a digital data platform, both of which serve as the foundation for a future national gene bank. By collaborating with local universities and international partners, the ministry aims to leverage Oman’s unique biodiversity—including globally significant species like the Arabian leopard and frankincense tree—to drive innovation in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and the bioeconomy while ensuring long-term environmental sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, in collaboration with several government entities including the Ministry of Education...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, in collaboration with several government entities including the Ministry of Education, is set to launch Saudi Environment Week 2026 under the theme “Green Impact.” This nationwide initiative features programs across all 13 administrative regions, aiming to engage over nine million students and the general public in environmental conservation and the celebration of biodiversity. Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, the week includes a national environmental exhibition showcasing technological innovations and successful protection strategies, alongside an interactive platform designed to foster partnerships between the public, private, and non-profit sectors. By raising community awareness and encouraging active participation in field activities, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture seeks to generate a lasting sustainable impact and secure natural resources for future generations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Center for Research and Development for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) represented the national delegation at the Shang...
records.description: The National Center for Research and Development for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) represented the national delegation at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) in China to discuss the integration of modern technologies in addressing regional agricultural challenges. The center focused on enhancing natural resource efficiency, adopting innovative technological solutions, and developing sustainable practices to improve production efficiency and food security. By engaging with international scientific entities, the National Center for Research and Development for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) emphasized the value of global knowledge exchange and the adoption of successful international models in advanced agriculture. This participation highlights a strategic effort to foster international cooperation and utilize cutting-edge technology to support long-term agricultural development and sustainability.
records.institution: The National Center for Research and Development for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially closed the coastal shrimp fishing season in the Red Sea within...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially closed the coastal shrimp fishing season in the Red Sea within territorial waters, effective as of end of April , 2026. This regulatory decision, based on recommendations from the Marine Science and Aquatic Life Research Authority and the Tihama Coast Association, aims to preserve fishery resources and allow for the natural reproduction of aquatic life. As part of the closure, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has mandated an inventory of all stored shrimp stocks and directed the Coast Guard and the General Authority for Fisheries to intensify maritime monitoring. Violators of this decision will face legal penalties under the Law Regulating the Fishing, Exploitation, and Protection of Aquatic Life, ensuring the long-term sustainability of the marine ecosystem.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Green Muscat Sustainability Solutions, an Omani-British joint venture, has officially launched its PET waste recycling facility at Al Rus...
records.description: Green Muscat Sustainability Solutions, an Omani-British joint venture, has officially launched its PET waste recycling facility at Al Rusayl Industrial City, marking a significant milestone in Oman’s transition toward a circular economy. The facility currently processes approximately 15 tonnes of post-consumer beverage bottles daily, transforming them into high-quality secondary raw materials. By the end of 2027, the company aims to scale its capacity to 10,000 metric tonnes annually. Through a robust supply chain involving 43 local collectors and strategic partnerships with hotels—achieving a landfill diversion rate of over 80%—Green Muscat is ensuring that plastic waste is retained as a strategic economic asset. Furthermore, the venture is expanding its impact by preparing to convert secondary waste components, such as caps and labels, into specialized products for the Omani agricultural sector.
records.institution: Green Muscat Sustainability Solutions

records.title: Qatar and Greece have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to enhance cooperation in the agricultural sector, aiming to strengthen...
records.description: Qatar and Greece have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to enhance cooperation in the agricultural sector, aiming to strengthen collaboration in food security, sustainable farming, agricultural development, and technology exchange. The agreement was concluded between Qatar’s Ministry of Municipality and the Greek Ministry of Rural Development and Food, reflecting a shared commitment to boosting agricultural productivity and innovation and deepening bilateral cooperation between the two countries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) branch in the Makkah Region has officially launched the Saudi Mango Festival in...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) branch in the Makkah Region has officially launched the Saudi Mango Festival in Jeddah. This event serves as a strategic marketing platform to bolster the visibility of national agricultural products and support local farmers. By addressing the "marketing bottleneck"—a primary challenge for the sector—the festival integrates efforts to improve agricultural inputs and select commercially competitive varieties. Beyond its economic role, the festival promotes the Kingdom's success in cultivating tropical fruits and enhances local tourism by providing direct-to-consumer outlets and showcasing innovative agricultural practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Eighth International Date Palm Conference 2026 has opened at Emirates Palace in Abu Dhabi, serving as a premier global platform for a...
records.description: The Eighth International Date Palm Conference 2026 has opened at Emirates Palace in Abu Dhabi, serving as a premier global platform for advancing date palm cultivation and agricultural innovation. Organised by the Khalifa International Award for Date Palm and Agricultural Innovation in cooperation with UAE University, the event convenes international ministers, scientists, and experts to address critical themes including biotechnology, genetic engineering, and the circular economy. Key highlights of the conference include the launch of the UAE’s first AI-powered digital platform for documenting local date varieties and research into AI-driven early detection of the red palm weevil. By showcasing smart monitoring systems and innovative uses for palm waste, the conference reinforces the UAE's leadership in sustainable agriculture and its commitment to integrating cutting-edge technology into the heritage-rich date palm sector.
records.institution: The Eighth International Date Palm Conference 2026

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has officially expanded the approved use of recycled plastics in food-contact app...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has officially expanded the approved use of recycled plastics in food-contact applications, moving beyond rPET to include recycled polypropylene (rPP) and recycled polyethylene (rHDPE and rLDPE). This regulatory shift is a cornerstone of the UAE’s Green Agenda 2030 and Net Zero 2050 targets, designed to transform plastic waste into high-value circular raw materials. By allowing these polymers in packaging formats like yogurt pots, tubs, and flexible films for fresh produce, the UAE is fostering a domestic "closed-loop" system. This move not only supports the “UAE Operated” manufacturing initiative but also provides food and beverage companies with a legal framework to reduce their reliance on imported virgin polymers while meeting the 2026 bans on single-use plastics.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The National Programme to Strengthen Supply Chain Resilience has been approved as a strategic initiative to safeguard essential supplies...
records.description: The National Programme to Strengthen Supply Chain Resilience has been approved as a strategic initiative to safeguard essential supplies of food, medicine, and industrial products against global challenges. Aimed at bolstering economic security and supporting sustainable growth, the National Programme to Strengthen Supply Chain Resilience establishes a comprehensive framework to diversify import sources and promote local manufacturing and agriculture in partnership with the private sector. By ensuring the continued availability of staple goods and enhancing the nation's readiness for regional and global developments, the National Programme to Strengthen Supply Chain Resilience seeks to address severe risks currently facing global trade routes and critical commodity access.
records.institution: The National Programme to Strengthen Supply Chain Resilience

records.title: Majra – National CSR Fund, in partnership with the National Agricultural Centre, has launched a dedicated agricultural category within th...
records.description: Majra – National CSR Fund, in partnership with the National Agricultural Centre, has launched a dedicated agricultural category within the “Sustainable Impact Challenge.” Introduced at the UAE Agricultural Exhibition and Conference 2026, this national initiative is designed to accelerate sustainable production models and empower local farmers by scaling applied agricultural projects. The challenge focuses on enhancing production efficiency, optimizing resource use, and improving the market competitiveness of UAE-grown products. By fostering cross-sector partnerships between the government, private sector, and academic institutions, the National Agricultural Centre and Majra aim to future-proof the nation’s food supply chains and recognize high-impact innovations during the upcoming Impact Summit in October.
records.institution: The National Agricultural Centre

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has secured four major investment contracts worth over OMR 51 million to signi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has secured four major investment contracts worth over OMR 51 million to significantly expand the national aquaculture sector. These projects, distributed across South Al Sharqiyah, Al Wusta, and Muscat, aim to bolster food security and industrial capacity through high-volume shrimp and finfish production. In South Al Sharqiyah, the Local Fish Company and the Arab Company for Aquatic Development will invest a combined OMR 41.3 million to produce 11,000 tonnes of shrimp annually. Further expansion includes a OMR 6 million shrimp farm by the Arabian Sea Aquaculture Company in Al Wusta and a OMR 3.8 million European seabass facility managed by Marjan Global Fish Company in Muscat. Collectively, these agreements represent a strategic move by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to utilize local expertise and coastal resources to achieve an annual production target exceeding 15,000 tonnes of high-value aquatic products.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Economic Development, Russia has become a key contributor to Oman’s food security through the supply of wheat and barley,...
records.description: The Ministry of Economic Development, Russia has become a key contributor to Oman’s food security through the supply of wheat and barley, while Oman exports chemical products, petroleum derivatives, and luxury perfumes to the Russian market. Joint investment projects are currently expanding across logistics, finance, information technology, and agriculture, supported by an integrated system of grants and tax incentives. Furthermore, the Ministry of Economic Development highlighted a deepening partnership in energy, including green hydrogen and renewables, as well as a growing tourism sector bolstered by a visa-waiver system and direct flights between Muscat and Sochi. To sustain this momentum, Russia has introduced business reforms, such as a "golden visa" system and specialized economic zones, to attract long-term investment from the Omani private sector into its competitive and growing economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economic Development

records.title: A groundbreaking study led by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), in collaboration with international partners, h...
records.description: A groundbreaking study led by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), in collaboration with international partners, has identified that mangrove forest ecosystems are a vital resource for discovering enzymes capable of breaking down plastic waste, specifically polyethylene terephthalate (PET). By analyzing the microbial diversity in mangrove soils under varying conditions like salinity and pollution, researchers from the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) discovered that introducing agricultural residues can boost the presence of plastic-degrading enzymes. Utilizing a combination of metagenomics, 3D structural analysis, and artificial intelligence, the team uncovered a new group of enzymes that remain functional in high-salinity industrial environments where conventional enzymes typically fail. This research highlights the microscopic potential of Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea mangroves, positioning these dynamic ecosystems as natural laboratories for developing sustainable solutions to global plastic accumulation while emphasizing the need for further testing to realize their practical industrial potential.
records.institution: The King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) has entered into a strategic agreement with the Environment Fund (EF) to provide credit facilities for beneficiari...
records.description: Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) has entered into a strategic agreement with the Environment Fund (EF) to provide credit facilities for beneficiaries of the incentives and grants program, aimed at accelerating environmental transformation across the Kingdom. This partnership enables small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) as well as large corporations to access financing solutions—including term loans, project finance, and trade finance—for projects focused on waste management, environmental compliance, and wildlife conservation. By facilitating greater access to capital for green initiatives, the Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) and the Environment Fund (EF) aim to foster a more attractive investment environment for the private sector while supporting the national goals of combating desertification and promoting vegetation development. This collaboration reinforces a broader commitment to economic diversification and sustainable development, ensuring that businesses can adopt environmentally responsible practices in alignment with national strategic visions.
records.institution: Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB)

records.title: MOCCAE, ICBA Launch ‘National Agricultural Initiative for Adoption of Climate-Smart Crops in UAE’
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), in partnership with the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), has launched a national initiative to adopt climate-smart crops such as millet and sorghum to enhance water sustainability and food sovereignty. Designed to support the National Food Security Strategy 2051, the program focuses on crops that consume up to 50 percent less water and thrive in extreme heat, alongside water-efficient fodder like Blue Panicum for the livestock sector. The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) is implementing the initiative in two phases, beginning with 45 field trials and the training of farmers and extension officers, followed by commercial expansion through private sector partnerships. By integrating scientific research into practical field solutions and introducing prototype products like "Resilience," the initiative aims to build a resilient, innovation-based agricultural ecosystem that transforms environmental challenges into sustainable economic opportunities for the UAE.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA)

records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to strengthen national biosecurity and food safety through enhanced institutional integration. This agreement focuses on unifying diagnostic systems and laboratory testing capabilities for water, food, animal feed, and livestock, leveraging advanced infrastructure such as the Central Testing Laboratory. By standardizing procedures and fostering data exchange, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) aims to accelerate response times to plant and animal health challenges while protecting vital supply chains. The partnership also emphasizes the development of qualified national talent and the implementation of inter-laboratory testing programs, creating a proactive and efficient regulatory framework that ensures the highest standards of quality assurance and environmental sustainability across the UAE’s ports of entry.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC)

records.title: The National Agricultural Centre (NAC) and NRTC Group (a subsidiary of Ghitha Holding) have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understandin...
records.description: The National Agricultural Centre (NAC) and NRTC Group (a subsidiary of Ghitha Holding) have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding to integrate UAE-grown produce into mainstream retail and distribution networks. Signed at the Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition 2026, the agreement focuses on creating dedicated retail spaces for local produce, streamlining logistics, and implementing training programs for quality grading and packaging. By leveraging the advanced infrastructure of the NRTC Group and its "Mazraati" initiative—supported by recent acquisitions like Ripe Organic and Mahsool—the partnership aims to improve farmer returns and enhance supply chain traceability. This collaboration, overseen by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, represents a critical step in future-proofing the national food system by empowering Emirati farmers and ensuring a consistent supply of sustainable local products to the market.
records.institution: The National Agricultural Centre (NAC)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has finalized its comprehensive operational plan for the 1447 AH Hajj season, designed...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has finalized its comprehensive operational plan for the 1447 AH Hajj season, designed to enhance the pilgrim experience through optimized service quality and infrastructure readiness. The plan focuses on the full preparation of slaughterhouses and public benefit markets, the implementation of advanced performance indicators (KPIs) to track operational efficiency, and the automation of livestock sales tracking. Key environmental initiatives include the establishment of new engineered landfill cells and the licensing of specialized operators for waste transport, alongside the activation of volunteer programs to support workforce capacity and shelter point management. Furthermore, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has strengthened regulatory enforcement and charitable partnerships to manage surplus meat distribution, ensuring an integrated and sustainable framework that aligns with national goals for safety, efficiency, and environmental protection during the pilgrimage.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) hosted the Agricultural Sustainability and Food Security Forum as part of the Emirates Agricul...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) hosted the Agricultural Sustainability and Food Security Forum as part of the Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition 2026, serving as a high-level platform to align academic research with national food security priorities. Featuring specialized sessions on the circular bioeconomy, the impact of climate change on livestock, and the role of genomic technologies in agricultural output, the forum emphasized the university's role in developing homegrown innovations through its College of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine. Supported by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, the event focused on empowering youth and integrating climate science with food safety policies to build a more resilient production system. By fostering partnerships between researchers and government entities, the United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) reaffirmed its commitment to the nation’s vision of a sustainable, knowledge-based agricultural future rooted in the late Sheikh Zayed’s legacy of viewing agriculture as a cornerstone of growth and dignity.
records.institution: The United Arab Emirates University (UAEU)

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman concluded a highly successful participation in the International Seafood Exhibition 2026 in Barcelona, securing com...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman concluded a highly successful participation in the International Seafood Exhibition 2026 in Barcelona, securing commercial deals exceeding OMR 30 million. Led by the Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (Madayn), the Omani pavilion served as a strategic gateway to markets in Africa, Europe, and Asia. This participation, aligned with Oman Vision 2040, highlights the nation's push to become a global hub for marine industries. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reported that Oman’s fish production surpassed 900,000 tonnes in 2025, with exports now reaching 84 countries. Beyond trade, the event was used by Madayn and the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones to pitch high-value investment opportunities in aquaculture, fish processing, and specialized logistics, supported by preliminary feasibility studies and competitive industrial incentives.
records.institution: The Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (Madayn)

records.title: Oman has recorded a massive 288 percent surge in aluminum scrap recycling volumes by the end of 2025, a milestone driven by the sultanate...
records.description: Oman has recorded a massive 288 percent surge in aluminum scrap recycling volumes by the end of 2025, a milestone driven by the sultanate’s Oman Vision 2040 and new aluminum-specific regulations introduced in March 2025. Highlighted at the third Aluminium Recycling Forum, this growth reflects a successful partnership between the Environment Authority and Sohar Aluminium to streamline scrap management and retain high-value materials within the local economy. By capturing scrap domestically rather than exporting it, Oman is significantly reducing the carbon footprint of its industrial sector—given that recycling aluminum requires 95 percent less energy than primary production—while positioning itself as a regional hub for the circular economy.
records.institution: The Environment Authority and Sohar Aluminium

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has officially launched the ‘Young Farmer Seal’ at the Emirates Agriculture Confe...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has officially launched the ‘Young Farmer Seal’ at the Emirates Agriculture Conference 2026. This initiative is designed to transition young Emirati farmers from traditional production to competitive "agri-entrepreneurship." By providing a certified stamp of quality, the program builds consumer trust and grants young producers direct access to major retail outlets and cooperative societies. Developed by the Emirates Youth Council for Agriculture, the initiative is open to Emiratis under 35 who own or manage farms, livestock, or beekeeping projects. To qualify, projects must undergo a technical evaluation to ensure they meet the UAE’s high standards for sustainability and innovation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment organized a strategic gathering where the National Agriculture Centre signed five major Me...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment organized a strategic gathering where the National Agriculture Centre signed five major Memoranda of Understanding to accelerate the digital and sustainable transformation of the UAE’s food sector. These agreements establish a robust framework for institutional cooperation in areas such as artificial intelligence, vertical farming, and livestock production, specifically involving partnerships with the Department of Agriculture and Livestock Sharjah, Elite Agro Holding, ADNOC, NRTC, and Al Baraka Dates Factory. By focusing on the deployment of smart technologies, the reuse of treated water, and the integration of local farm outputs into global marketing networks, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment is working to enhance resource efficiency and strengthen national food security value chains. This collaborative effort aims to transition the agricultural sector into a future-ready industry that prioritizes sustainable production, national capacity building, and the competitiveness of local products in alignment with the country’s long-term economic vision.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.title: The Zayed for Good Foundation and Silal Group have formalized a strategic partnership through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed...
records.description: The Zayed for Good Foundation and Silal Group have formalized a strategic partnership through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed at the UAE Agricultural Conference 2026. This collaboration represents a shift from traditional humanitarian aid toward a sustainable development model that prioritizes food security and community resilience. By leveraging Silal’s Innovation Oasis, the partnership aims to cultivate national talent, advance agricultural technology, and export Emirati expertise to international markets. The agreement focuses on practical learning for students and capacity-building for farmers, ensuring the adoption of modern, technology-driven practices that enhance productivity and resource efficiency.
records.institution: The Zayed for Good Foundation and Silal Group

records.title: Badia Farms has committed a multi-million dollar investment to develop a 50,000sqm "Agricultural Oasis" in Hamala.
records.description: Badia Farms has committed a multi-million dollar investment to develop a 50,000sqm "Agricultural Oasis" in Hamala. The project is the result of a strategic partnership with Edamah (the real estate arm of Mumtalakat), with the land secured through the Government Land Investment Platform. This high-tech facility will utilize advanced hydroponic systems and controlled-environment greenhouses to enable year-round production of fruits and vegetables, effectively overcoming Bahrain's challenges with water scarcity and seasonal climate shifts. Designed as a model of sustainability, the farm will integrate solar energy, water recycling, and biodegradable waste management. Leaders from Mumtalakat and the Bahrain Economic Development Board have hailed the initiative as a transformative step that will drive foreign direct investment, create local jobs, and redefine sustainable agriculture in the Kingdom.
records.institution: Badia Farms

records.title: The Jazan branch of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in collaboration with the Minis...
records.description: The Jazan branch of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, conducted a specialized workshop in Qilwah Governorate to empower local farmers. The initiative combined scientific presentations with hands-on field training, specifically focusing on the diagnosis and control of mango diseases, soil analysis, and advanced grafting techniques. By addressing real-world field challenges through open discussions, Estidamah aims to bridge the gap between applied research and daily farming practices, ensuring the localization of agricultural technologies and the sustainable improvement of crop quality throughout the Al-Baha Region.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: Silal has officially opened applications for its Farm Innovation Fund at the Emirates Agriculture Conference 2026, a strategic initiative...
records.description: Silal has officially opened applications for its Farm Innovation Fund at the Emirates Agriculture Conference 2026, a strategic initiative launched by Silal’s Innovation Oasis. The fund is designed to empower Emirati farmers by providing the financial and technical resources necessary to develop, test, and scale cutting-edge agricultural solutions. Annually, five selected farmers will each receive up to AED 200,000 in support, alongside specialized mentorship, with the long-term goal of supporting 25 projects over the next five years. By focusing on field-based innovation tailored to local environmental needs, Silal aims to enhance crop productivity, optimize water and energy efficiency, and transform grassroots ideas into commercially viable, sustainable ventures that strengthen the UAE's national food security.
records.institution: Silal

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen the commencement of the wheat harvest across the South A’Sharqiya...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen the commencement of the wheat harvest across the South A’Sharqiyah Governorate in Oman, specifically in the wilayats of Al Kamil wa Al Wafi, Sur, and Ja’alan Bani Bu Hassan. With 41 feddans under cultivation, production is projected to exceed 50 tonnes for the 2025–2026 season, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources through the provision of modern harvesting machinery and technical guidance on seed quality. Simultaneously, the Grain Trading Company in Iraq has readied 78 silos with a 340,000-tonne capacity to handle the upcoming harvest, implementing rigorous moisture and pest inspections to ensure grain quality. While Iraqi officials prepare for a 10-day delay due to recent rains, internal discussions persist regarding procurement quotas, as regional authorities advocate for a larger purchase share of a harvest that could surpass 2 million tonnes.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Wa...
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has launched a high-value investment portfolio targeting nearly $250 million (OMR 96 million) across 11 food security projects. This initiative, unveiled through the Invest Oman platform in April 2026, aims to bolster national self-sufficiency and resource sustainability under Oman Vision 2040. In the Al Najd Agricultural Zone, the portfolio features five diverse crops including potato (OMR 5.5 million), onion (OMR 4.8 million), and garlic (OMR 2.3 million) cultivation and processing. The fisheries sector offers strategic opportunities ranging from whiteleg shrimp farming (OMR 25 million) to a major OMR 32 million giant tiger prawn project in Ras Madrakah. Additionally, a OMR 3.8 million sustainable fish feed alternative project in Samail Industrial City is being promoted to strengthen the integration of domestic food value chains.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has reached over 75% completion on a model livestock farm complex in Jubail, a key ini...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has reached over 75% completion on a model livestock farm complex in Jubail, a key initiative under the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef). Designed to align with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, the facility features advanced infrastructure including specialized livestock barns, a veterinary clinic, sterilization units, and quarantine pens. By integrating modern technologies such as artificial insemination and breed improvement, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture aims to boost domestic meat production, enhance food self-sufficiency, and reduce dependence on imports. Beyond its technical capacity, the project supports the local economy by creating sustainable jobs, raising breeder incomes, and serving as a hub for research and development in sheep and goat farming.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) showcased its role in advancing global clean energy under the theme "Our Power, Our Planet." By...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) showcased its role in advancing global clean energy under the theme "Our Power, Our Planet." By financing high-impact renewable projects, the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) is helping developing nations, particularly small island states, transition away from conventional fuels toward sustainable energy systems. Major investments highlighted include the AED 551 million Sheikh Zayed Solar Power Complex in Jordan, which powers 50,000 homes, and a AED 25.7 million solar plant in the Comoros. Additionally, the fund has tapped into wind resources through a AED 103 million farm in the Seychelles and coastal stations in Mauritania that provide both clean power and technical training for local communities. These efforts, often coordinated with the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), reflect the UAE’s strategic commitment to climate action and international development.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD)

records.title: To mark Earth Day, the UAE has reinforced its global leadership in climate action and biodiversity through the UAE Cabinet's approval of...
records.description: To mark Earth Day, the UAE has reinforced its global leadership in climate action and biodiversity through the UAE Cabinet's approval of the seventh national biodiversity report and the expansion of protected areas to 55 reserves. Key institutions such as the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi, the Mohamed bin Zayed Species Conservation Fund, and Mubadala are spearheading critical marine initiatives, including the restoration of mangrove ecosystems and the protection of endangered species like the dugong. In the energy sector, Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company - Masdar and Global South Utilities are expanding renewable capacity across three continents, while the Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority continues to advance scientific research into local biodiversity. Furthermore, the Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative and Suqia UAE underscore a commitment to global water security as the nation prepares to co-host the upcoming United Nations Water Conference.
records.institution: The UAE Cabinet

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources have launched...
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources have launched a high-value investment portfolio via the Invest Oman platform to bolster national food security. The initiative features ten primary projects across the Al Najd Agricultural Zone and various coastal regions, including large-scale cultivation of onions, garlic, and potatoes, as well as sophisticated aquaculture ventures for abalone, tuna, and shrimp. With investment values ranging from OMR 1.6 million to OMR 32 million, these opportunities aim to leverage the strategic location and infrastructure of the Invest Oman ecosystem to enhance self-sufficiency and resource sustainability. By integrating production, manufacturing, and logistics, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources seek to attract global investors to support the economic diversification goals of Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

records.title: In the highlands of Asir, avocado cultivation is being established as a viable agricultural alternative to reduce reliance on imported fr...
records.description: In the highlands of Asir, avocado cultivation is being established as a viable agricultural alternative to reduce reliance on imported fruit and strengthen domestic supply chains. Local trials conducted in regions like Al-Namas have demonstrated a success rate exceeding 80%, with the moderate mountain climate proving suitable for maintaining the specific temperature and irrigation levels required for the crop. While initial reports indicate that the texture and taste of the harvest are comparable to international varieties, future growth depends on scaling production volumes and formalizing distribution channels. By leveraging these favorable environmental conditions, the regional agricultural sector aims to integrate locally grown avocados into the national market, marking a significant shift toward diversified mountain farming.
records.institution: The Saudi Government

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) emphasized its commitment to global energy transitions under the theme "Our Power, Our Planet," highlighting a portfolio of high-impact renewable projects in developing nations. Through strategic partnerships with organizations like the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) has financed diverse initiatives, including the AED 551 million Sheikh Zayed Solar Power Complex in Jordan, which powers over 50,000 homes, and a AED 25.7 million solar plant in the Union of Comoros. The fund’s reach extends to wind energy, having supported a 6-megawatt farm in the Seychelles to replace diesel reliance and multiple coastal wind stations in Mauritania that include local technical training programs. records.title: Nama Water Services has successfully transitioned treated water from a secondary utility into a strategic asset through its "Manhal Nama"...
records.description: Nama Water Services has successfully transitioned treated water from a secondary utility into a strategic asset through its "Manhal Nama" initiative. By shifting from traditional resource management to a value-based model, the company is maximizing the utility of every cubic meter of water to support Oman Vision 2040. Leveraging advanced treatment technologies that meet international standards, the initiative provides a "technical backbone" for agriculture and industry, resulting in a 36% increase in beneficiaries by late 2025. With key infrastructure projects like the 12-kilometer Nizwa-Manah pipeline and the Al Shakhakhit distribution scheme (serving 60+ farms), Nama is effectively de-risking the agricultural sector while preserving the Sultanate's precious freshwater reserves.
records.institution: Nama Water Services

records.title: The MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE, FISHERIES AND WATER RESOURCES (MAFWR) has launched a high-velocity investment roadmap for the first half of...
records.description: The MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE, FISHERIES AND WATER RESOURCES (MAFWR) has launched a high-velocity investment roadmap for the first half of 2026, targeting 400 projects with a total valuation of RO 400 million. As of April 2026, the ministry has already activated 55% of these opportunities via the Tatweer platform, signaling a rapid transition toward a private-sector-led food security model. By focusing on industrial-scale poultry expansion and localized livestock breeding, Oman is moving closer to total self-sufficiency in key proteins, effectively decoupling the national food supply from global market volatility.
records.institution: The MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE, FISHERIES AND WATER RESOURCES (MAFWR)

records.title: The signing of 18 new agricultural usufruct contracts marks a significant expansion of the "technical backbone" supporting Oman’s food se...
records.description: The signing of 18 new agricultural usufruct contracts marks a significant expansion of the "technical backbone" supporting Oman’s food security and rural economy. With a total investment exceeding OMR 1.9 million, these projects span 300 acres across six governorates, illustrating a geographically balanced strategy to diversify the Sultanate's agricultural output. By transitioning government lands into high-value production hubs for everything from grape and sapodilla cultivation to industrial water purification, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning are fostering a robust environment for entrepreneurs. This momentum, building on the 585 contracts signed last year, reinforces the sector’s role as a primary driver of national economic sustainability and resource optimization.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is spearheading a major showcase of "Agri-Tech 4.0" at the Emirates Agricult...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is spearheading a major showcase of "Agri-Tech 4.0" at the Emirates Agriculture Conference 2026, positioning Abu Dhabi as a regional laboratory for climate-resilient food systems. From the unveiling of the first dedicated Emirati sheep breed to the strategic introduction of cassava and mushrooms as alternative crops, ADAFSA is hard-wiring innovation into every link of the value chain. By integrating Artificial Intelligence and sensor-based analytics with hands-on livestock management workshops and a AED 910,000 prize fund for breeding excellence, the authority is bridging the gap between high-level policy and field-level productivity. This comprehensive approach, supported by the Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award, ensures that the transition to a sustainable food system is both technologically advanced and economically rewarding for the UAE’s farming community.
records.institution: he Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE, FISHERIES AND WATER RESOURCES has successfully steered a massive expansion of the national food security inf...
records.description: The MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE, FISHERIES AND WATER RESOURCES has successfully steered a massive expansion of the national food security infrastructure, overseeing 493 projects worth OMR 1.9 billion during the previous five-year cycle. Entering the current 11th Five-Year Plan, the institution is targeting an additional 400 investment projects valued at OMR 400 million, with over 50% of these opportunities already accessible via the "Tatweer" digital platform. This strategic investment has resulted in remarkable self-sufficiency milestones, notably 146% in fisheries, 99% in dates, 95% in table eggs, and 77% in vegetable crops, with Omani products now reaching markets as far as Europe and Japan. To further close import gaps, the ministry is prioritizing a transition in the livestock sector—aiming to raise white meat sufficiency to 74% and red meat to over 45%—through high-capacity partnerships and the industrial scaling of local production chains to ensure long-term national economic resilience.
records.institution: The MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE, FISHERIES AND WATER RESOURCES (MAFWR)

records.description: The 15th Mango Festival in Al-Qunfudhah, launched under the patronage of the Governor of Makkah, marks a significant milestone in the governorate’s five-decade journey of agricultural excellence. As one of the Kingdom’s premier production hubs, Al-Qunfudhah has transformed mango cultivation into a high-value investment sector, supported by the MINISTRY OF ENVIRONMENT, WATER AND AGRICULTURE. This year’s festival serves as a critical "technical backbone" for the regional economy, blending commercial marketing for local farmers with community engagement through specialized exhibitions and cottage industry support. By formalizing the link between heritage farming and modern investment, the event reinforces Al-Qunfudhah’s role as a strategic contributor to Saudi Arabia’s domestic food security and agricultural identity.
records.institution: THE MINISTRY OF ENVIRONMENT, WATER AND AGRICULTURE

records.description: Nama Water Services has transformed treated water from a secondary utility into a central pillar of the Sultanate’s water economy through its "Manhal Nama" initiative. Moving beyond simple disposal, the company is now employing advanced treatment technologies to deliver high-quality water that meets both national and international standards for agriculture, industry, and green space irrigation. By expanding infrastructure—including a new 12-kilometer pipeline in Al Dakhiliyah and specialized networks in Barka—Nama is providing a "technical backbone" that allows the private sector to scale sustainably while significantly lowering operational costs.

records.title: The integration of Saudi Arabia Railways (SAR), Mawani, and Bahri to transport Diammonium Phosphate (DAP) from Ras Al-Khair to Yanbu Port...
records.description: The integration of Saudi Arabia Railways (SAR), Mawani, and Bahri to transport Diammonium Phosphate (DAP) from Ras Al-Khair to Yanbu Port marks a sophisticated leap in the Kingdom’s "logistics backbone." By moving 45,000 tons of this critical agricultural fertilizer through a multimodal system—utilizing rail for long-haul transport and sea for global export—Saudi Arabia is securing its position as a primary guarantor of global food supply chains. This operation demonstrates the high-capacity synergy between the mining and transport sectors, moving away from fragmented road haulage toward an integrated, high-efficiency model that supports the Saudi Vision 2030 goal of becoming a premier global logistics hub.
records.institution: Saudi Arabia Railways (SAR), Mawani

records.title: The Al Hamriyah Municipality, in a landmark collaboration with local residents, has officially inaugurated a 20,000-square-meter (2-hecta...
records.description: The Al Hamriyah Municipality, in a landmark collaboration with local residents, has officially inaugurated a 20,000-square-meter (2-hectare) integrated model community farm. Launched in April 2026, this initiative directly manifests the directives of His Highness Sheikh Dr. Sultan bin Mohammed Al Qasimi, Ruler of Sharjah, to embed agricultural sustainability into the fabric of daily life. By combining diverse crop production with a "circular economy" waste-to-fertilizer system, the farm serves as a technical and social blueprint for Sharjah’s vision of a self-reliant, environmentally conscious community.
records.institution: The Al Hamriyah Municipality

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a high-precision aerial spraying campaign across the S...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a high-precision aerial spraying campaign across the South Al Batinah Governorate to combat the "spring generation" of the Palm Dubas Bug (Al Mataq). Utilizing helicopters to cover 1,800 acres, the three-day operation targets the wilayats of A’Rustaq, Al Awabi, Nakhal, and Wadi Al Maawil. This intervention serves as a critical "technical backbone" for the palm sector, as the current biological cycle of the pest coincides with the sensitive fruit-setting and growth phases. By neutralizing the bug and its harmful honeydew secretions—which otherwise trigger fungal infections and stunt photosynthesis—the campaign protects the marketable quality and long-term sustainability of Oman’s most vital agricultural resource.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The GULF UNITED FISH PRODUCTS FACTORY has been inaugurated as the first fully automated, integrated facility of its kind in the Sultanate...
records.description: The GULF UNITED FISH PRODUCTS FACTORY has been inaugurated as the first fully automated, integrated facility of its kind in the Sultanate of Oman, representing a significant advancement in the national food security system. With initial investments totaling OMR 6.2 million and a focus on high-yield industrial outputs, the plant specializes in producing fishmeal, fish oil, and soluble fish paste for the aquaculture and animal feed sectors. By converting marine resources into essential secondary products under strict quality and sustainability standards, the facility reduces import reliance and enhances self-sufficiency. This project, supported by the MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE, FISHERIES AND WATER RESOURCES through regulatory facilitation and sustainable resource management, is set to lead a major expansion phase involving future investments of OMR 75 million in shrimp farming, seafood processing, and integrated agricultural initiatives.
records.institution: The GULF UNITED FISH PRODUCTS FACTORY

records.title: The Al-Baha Region is strategically positioning itself as a hub for high-value horticulture by expanding banana cultivation across its go...
records.description: The Al-Baha Region is strategically positioning itself as a hub for high-value horticulture by expanding banana cultivation across its governorates. Leveraging a unique micro-climate characterized by warm temperatures, fertile soil, and sufficient water resources, the region is transforming banana farming from a traditional practice into a competitive investment sector. This expansion serves as a "technical backbone" for Al-Baha’s agricultural economy, supported by the introduction of modern irrigation and fertilization techniques and rigorous extension programs. By focusing on production efficiency and crop quality, the region ensures a steady, high-grade supply to local markets, directly contributing to the economic resilience of Saudi Arabia’s southwestern agricultural belt.

This strategic partnership focuses on moving beyond raw harvesting toward sophisticated seafood processing and value-chain engineering. This initiative directly supports Saudi Vision 2030 by reducing import reliance, enhancing supply chain transparency, and leveraging private sector innovation to establish the Kingdom as a premier regional hub for sustainable food manufacturing.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) is spearheading a strategic expansion of mango cultivation in the Wilayat of Barka, South Al Batinah, to solidify Oman's food security and fruit self-sufficiency. This project, which integrates over 40,000 trees across 4,000 acres, utilizes a usufruct land model in partnership with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning. By combining high-quality seedlings from national research centers with elite imported varieties, the initiative establishes a "technical backbone" for high-yield horticulture. Managed by Omani investors and experts, the project is anchored in modern water management, specifically fountain irrigation, to maximize productivity in the Sultanate's arid environment, with the first commercial harvest slated for 2027.

These structures do more than just prevent flood damage; they serve as active groundwater recharge systems that have successfully revived the traditional aflaj networks by raising the water table. By integrating advanced hydrological monitoring and controlled release protocols—including a "three-day settlement" rule to ensure high-quality, sediment-free recharge—the Ministry of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) is creating a resilient ecosystem that captures rainwater otherwise lost to the sea.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has authorized a strategic OMR 50 million ($130 million) financial package to safeguard the Sultanate’s food supply chain against regional instability. This emergency fund is specifically designed to buffer crop and livestock farmers against a 30% surge in the cost of seeds and equipment recorded over the last six weeks. By integrating this aid with the recently established food depots in Sohar, Oman is creating a resilient logistical corridor near the UAE border, effectively bypassing maritime conflict zones. This package serves as a critical "technical backbone" to the nation’s $13 billion 2020–2040 food security roadmap, ensuring that local production targets for meat and essential crops remain viable despite shifting global economic pressures.

records.description: The Dakhliyah Governorate has officially opened a tender for the construction and operation of a specialized fruit farm as part of the massive Jabal Shams Grand Canyon View project in Al Hamra. Situated at an altitude of 3,000 meters, the project combines modern agricultural production with adventure tourism—featuring a 97-meter glass walkway, ziplines, and a 500-seat theatre—to create a sustainable economic model. Covering approximately 9,000 acres, these initiatives are strategically diversified across field crops like wheat, high-value fruits such as date palms and grapes, and advanced greenhouse cultivation for garlic and onions. The livestock sector is simultaneously being modernized through large-scale red meat and dairy production facilities utilizing calf fattening and efficient breeding methods. Beyond the completed works, the Ministry has already initiated new maintenance phases for additional systems in governorates like A’Dakhiliyah and Muscat, ensuring that these heritage water networks continue to provide the consistent irrigation necessary for national food security and the sustainability of rural agricultural lands.

records.description: The Sultanate of Oman has become the 32nd country to join Japan’s Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM), signing a strategic cooperation memorandum as of April 2026. This partnership establishes a formal "technical backbone" for bilateral decarbonization, allowing Oman to adopt advanced Japanese low-carbon technologies and infrastructure while generating carbon credits. These credits, derived from greenhouse gas removals or reductions, will be shared between both nations to meet their respective Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement. By leveraging Article 6.2 guidance to avoid double counting, the agreement transforms carbon reduction into a practical engine for sustainable development, combining technological diffusion with rigorous capacity-building support for Omani institutions.
records.institution: Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)

records.title: The Qassim Region is undergoing a high-tech agricultural evolution, successfully scaling mulberry and berry cultivation from experimental...
records.description: The Qassim Region is undergoing a high-tech agricultural evolution, successfully scaling mulberry and berry cultivation from experimental greenhouses into a robust economic sector that rivals international imports. Under the strategic framework of Saudi Vision 2030, the region has leveraged its distinct soil conditions to become a national hub for black, white, red, and blue berry varieties. Modern farms, particularly in Unaizah, are now recording annual yields of approximately 40 tons, supported by a "technical backbone" of closed-loop greenhouses, solar energy, and precision climate-control systems. By utilizing advanced drip irrigation to navigate water scarcity and extreme heat, these projects have created a scalable model for technology-driven farming that reduces import reliance and strengthens the Kingdom’s food security and global competitiveness.

records.description: The Sharjah Waste to Energy Facility has reached a massive operational milestone, processing 1,000,000 tonnes of waste since its 2022 inauguration. This facility, a joint venture between BEEAH and Tadweer Group, serves as the "technical backbone" of Sharjah’s circular economy, enabling a record 93% landfill diversion rate. By converting residual, hard-to-recycle waste into 30MW of low-carbon electricity, the plant currently powers 28,000 homes while offsetting 450,000 tonnes of $CO_2$ annually. As the project advances into Phase 2, these figures are set to double, raising output to 60MW and processing capacity to 600,000 tonnes per year, further solidifying the UAE’s path toward its Net Zero 2050 ambitions.

records.description: Saudi Arabia has emerged as a global frontrunner in the energy transition, recording a staggering 87% year-on-year increase in renewable capacity to reach 12,332 MW in 2025. According to the IRENA ‘Renewable Capacity Statistics 2026’ report, this "technical backbone" of the Kingdom's Vision 2030 was almost exclusively driven by solar photovoltaic (PV) additions, which alone accounted for 97% of the growth. With the share of renewables in the national power mix nearly doubling from 6.9% to 12.6% in a single year, the Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC) is now accelerating into 2026 with plans to award an additional 14 GW of capacity across solar and wind projects, including the massive Round 7 tenders.

records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has officially activated the appointment booking service through the “Mahsoli” platform to facilitate the reception of local wheat for the current agricultural season. Operating in coordination with the National Grains Supply Company (SABIL), the initiative streamlines the supply process at various regional branches for eligible farmers in Riyadh, the Eastern Province, and Qassim. To enhance operational efficiency, the General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has modernized its electronic services, allowing farmers to verify data and manage logistics digitally, while the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture provides the necessary licensing to ensure that the reception of domestic grain aligns with national food security and sustainability standards.

records.description: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has launched a strategic digital awareness campaign, positioning water as a "fundamental pillar" for the Kingdom’s development and long-term quality of life. This initiative is a core component of MAEE’s broader mandate to unify water conservation efforts across the urban, agricultural, and industrial sectors. By providing practical, knowledge-based guidance, the campaign aims to shift societal behaviors toward conscious consumption and sustainability. These efforts are directly aligned with Saudi Vision 2030 and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), emphasizing that the "technical backbone" of water sustainability relies as much on individual behavioral correction as it does on large-scale infrastructure and industrial efficiency.

records.description: The United Arab Emirates has bolstered its "technical backbone" for the energy transition, achieving a 15.4% year-on-year increase in renewable capacity to reach 7,907 MW in 2025. According to the IRENA ‘Renewable Capacity Statistics 2026’ report, this growth was anchored by the addition of over 1,000 MW of solar PV, which now represents the vast majority of the nation's clean energy portfolio. A strategic milestone in 2025 was the UAE's entry into long-duration energy storage with the commissioning of 250 MW of pumped hydro capacity, a critical move to ensure grid stability as intermittent solar penetration rises. These advancements directly support the UAE Energy Strategy 2050, which aims to triple the contribution of renewable energy over the next decade.
