records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reached a 47% completion rate on the Wadi Adai Dam project, a strategic cornerstone of Muscat’s flood protection system. During an inspection visit by the Wali of Mutrah, officials detailed the dam’s "technical backbone," which includes a significant storage capacity of 23 million cubic metres. This infrastructure is specifically engineered to mitigate flood risks for residential and commercial districts, protecting essential road networks and utility services from extreme weather events. Once fully operational, the Wadi Adai Dam will integrate into the broader Muscat governorate safety network, enhancing public safety and supporting long-term sustainable water resource management in the Sultanate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reported a significant acceleration in the "technical backbone" of Oman's...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reported a significant acceleration in the "technical backbone" of Oman's wheat sector for the 2025/2026 harvest season. Under the Wheat Cultivation Expansion Project (2023–2027), the Sultanate is moving to reduce its 350,000-tonne annual requirement gap by incentivizing local production through a government purchase price of RO 500 per tonne. This strategic push is most evident in the Najd region of Dhofar, where cultivated land now exceeds 6,400 acres, and in Al Mudhaibi. While the sector saw a 9.1% growth in its GDP contribution by late 2025, the government maintains a dual model: boosting domestic yields via high-yield varieties and smart technologies while leveraging the silo capacities of Oman Flour Mills and Salalah Mills to manage a total import and re-export volume of roughly 900,000 tonnes.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: AlUla Governorate is undergoing a strategic agricultural transformation with the expansion of saffron cultivation trials, a high-value in...
records.description: AlUla Governorate is undergoing a strategic agricultural transformation with the expansion of saffron cultivation trials, a high-value initiative designed to leverage the region’s unique micro-climate and volcanic soil. Under the Kingdom’s saffron localization project, led by the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), AlUla has successfully produced premium-grade "Saudi Saffron" that meets rigorous ISO 3632 international standards. This "technical backbone" for luxury spice production is built on an integrated support system—managed by Estidamah—which provides local farmers with specialized training in soil preparation, specialized bulb (corm) management, and delicate harvesting techniques. By transitioning from traditional crops to this "red gold," AlUla is enhancing its agricultural sustainability and establishing a new, high-margin economic pillar in line with national diversification goals.
records.institution: AlUla Governorate

records.title: The Saudi Irrigation Organization has reported a massive influx of over 4.6 million cubic meters of floodwater into the Al-Baha region’s...
records.description: The Saudi Irrigation Organization has reported a massive influx of over 4.6 million cubic meters of floodwater into the Al-Baha region’s dam network following heavy rainfall between March 19 and April 6, 2026. This "technical backbone" of water infrastructure, comprising 50 dams across the Sarat and Tihama sectors, saw several facilities—including the Dharak, Al-Mazlimat, and Jarab dams—reach 100% capacity. Managed through controlled gate discharges and emergency protocols, the surge has significantly bolstered the region’s water security. Out of the 50 dams, 35 are strategically utilized for groundwater recharge, while 6 are dedicated to drinking water, providing a vital resource for Al-Baha’s agricultural sector, which remains heavily dependent on seasonal runoff for long-term sustainability.
records.institution: The Saudi Irrigation Organization

records.title: UNS Vertical Farms, a subsidiary of the UAE-based Speedex Group, has launched a state-of-the-art 10,000-square-metre high-tech tomato fac...
records.description: UNS Vertical Farms, a subsidiary of the UAE-based Speedex Group, has launched a state-of-the-art 10,000-square-metre high-tech tomato facility in Al Ain, marking a significant milestone in the UAE's pursuit of food self-sufficiency. This "technical backbone" of modern desert farming leverages Controlled-Environment Agriculture (CEA), combining hydroponics with AI, IoT, and data-driven systems to produce 150,000 kilograms of premium, non-GMO tomatoes annually. By operating independently of the region's arid climate and extreme heat, the facility reduces water consumption by up to 90% compared to traditional methods. With a direct-to-consumer (D2C) model ensuring delivery within 24 to 48 hours of harvest, UNS Vertical Farms is actively advancing the UAE National Food Security Strategy 2051 and Net Zero 2050 goals through high-precision, pesticide-free local production.
records.institution: UNS Vertical Farms

records.title: ACWA Power has informed the Saudi bourse, Tadawul, that two of its major solar independent power producer (IPP) plants in Saudi Arabia—th...
records.description: ACWA Power has informed the Saudi bourse, Tadawul, that two of its major solar independent power producer (IPP) plants in Saudi Arabia—the 1,425MW Al Kahfah and the 2,000MW Ar Rass 2—are currently facing temporary dispatch limitations. These restrictions were issued by the grid operator due to technical concerns regarding reactive power fluctuations and their potential impact on grid stability. While ACWA Power and the project firms dispute these allegations and have issued "deemed energy" invoices to protect their contractual rights, the financial impact has already reached approximately SAR 95 million for Al Kahfah and SAR 73 million for Ar Rass 2 as of late March. To resolve the impasse, the ACWA Power project companies are conducting independent third-party technical assessments and coordinating with authorities to restore full operational capacity to these critical renewable energy assets.
records.institution: ACWA Power

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in North Al Sharqiyah has reported a significant expansion in the l...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in North Al Sharqiyah has reported a significant expansion in the livestock and poultry sectors, with seven new investment projects valued at approximately OMR 33 million. These initiatives, ranging from horse breeding to Dutch rabbit meat and ostrich farming, are supported by the "Tatweer" and "Suggest Your Project" platforms to modernize the regional "technical backbone." With a livestock population of 435,000 head, the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources oversaw the administration of over 818,000 vaccine doses and provided veterinary services through a network of 50 public and private clinics, marking a 24% growth in prevention programs. Furthermore, the governorate has achieved a remarkable 218% self-sufficiency rate in table eggs and produces over 3.6 million birds annually. By managing 1,622 farm complexes and approving 46 pastoral sites, the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is effectively balancing industrial growth with sustainable rangeland management to enhance the Sultanate’s overall food security.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially launched the 2026 Food Safety Week in the Wilayat of Sohar, aiming to strengthen the national "technical backbone" of food oversight under the theme "Food safety is the responsibility of all." Managed by the Food Safety and Quality Centre, the six-day event serves as a strategic platform for government departments and private sector establishments to exchange expertise through a specialized food safety forum and the "Food safety system in numbers" lecture series. Key initiatives include the launch of a dedicated food safety magazine, a public marathon, and an exhibition featuring innovative programs from leading production companies. By integrating specialized workshops, field visits to production facilities, and educational outreach for schools and universities, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is working to harmonize regulatory standards and raise public awareness to ensure a resilient and high-efficiency food power system across the Sultanate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.description: The Saudi Reef program has identified the Jazan Region as a primary hub for the green economy, leveraging its vast natural assets to transform the traditional jasmine and aromatic plant sectors into high-efficiency processing industries. By developing specialized "jasmine cities," Saudi Reef is building a "technical backbone" for small farmers to move beyond cottage industry sales into industrial-scale production. This strategic modernization of Jazan's botanical heritage aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals for sustainability and regional economic diversification, positioning the area as a leading center for the high-value natural products market.

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy and the Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company (Masdar) are spearheading a massive strategic expansion of the UAE’s clean energy footprint, domestic and international, through integrated technology and infrastructure projects. records.description: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry has issued a ministerial decision to provide financial support for additional import costs, a strategic measure designed to safeguard the uninterrupted supply of essential goods and stabilize local market prices. Under this framework, the government will cover extra expenses incurred by importing companies when exceptional circumstances—such as disruptions to sea, land, or air transport—force a reliance on alternative, more expensive shipping routes. This support is strictly focused on a "technical backbone" of basic commodities, including rice, flour, lentils, vegetable oils, sugar, frozen chicken, infant formula, and various canned products. By authorizing the extension of these subsidies as needed within approved budget limits, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry aims to protect national food security and mitigate the impact of global logistical volatility on Kuwaiti consumers.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a period of significant strategic expansion, leading to a 146% se...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a period of significant strategic expansion, leading to a 146% self-sufficiency rate in fish and substantial gains across the dairy and poultry sectors. Managing a diverse landscape that includes 312,000 acres of cultivated land and 3.2 million acres of natural grazing land supporting 4 million head of livestock, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has achieved self-sufficiency rates of 99% for dates, 96% for fresh milk, and 95% for table eggs. This progress is anchored by a robust "technical backbone" consisting of 26 research centers, 35 food safety laboratories, and extensive water infrastructure including desalination plants, recharge dams, and treatment facilities producing millions of cubic meters of water. These coordinated efforts by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources have not only driven a 5.2% production growth rate but also significantly improved the nation's global environmental and fisheries management rankings.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reported a significant strengthening of Oman’s strategic water reserves fo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reported a significant strengthening of Oman’s strategic water reserves following the Masarrat low-pressure system, which brought intense rainfall to several wilayats. Data shows that Ibra recorded the highest precipitation at 356mm, followed by Wadi Al Maawil (289mm) and Yanqul (276mm). This surge has directly impacted the nation's "technical backbone" of water infrastructure; of the Sultanate's 209 dams, 181 are now completely filled. With a total national storage capacity of 458.7 million m³, current reserves have reached 160 million m³, with Muscat Governorate holding the largest share at nearly 80 million m³. These figures, tracked by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, underscore the critical role of the dam network in flood protection, sustainable water management, and essential groundwater recharge across the Sultanate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, through its Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Dhofar, has officially launched the wheat harvest for the current agricultural season in Al Najd province. To support this "technical backbone" of domestic production, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources provides farmers with subsidized seeds and free harvesting machinery, while streamlining collection logistics in coordination with the Oman Flour Mills Company. This integrated support system ensures that high-quality Omani wheat efficiently reaches the market, strengthening the economic resilience of the agricultural community in the Dhofar Governorate.

records.description: The Food and Water Security Committee of the Shura Council convened its fifth meeting of the 2025–2026 sitting to discuss the strategic development of "Future Agricultural Cities" in Oman. This initiative, aligned with Oman Vision 2040, aims to bridge the gap between laboratory research and commercial application by establishing business incubators for agricultural startups and strengthening the "technical backbone" of the Sultanate's arid-land farming through enhanced water and energy efficiency.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman, in partnership with Nafath Energy Company and the Development Bank, has launched the "Solar Energy — Sustainable Harvest" initiative. This program provides farmers and investors with interest-free or low-interest (3%) financing of up to RO 15,000 to integrate solar power into their operations, targeting a 30% reduction in electricity costs. Applications are processed through the Tharawat platform, with priority given to high-production farms utilizing greenhouses and modern irrigation. By enabling the transition to clean energy, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources aims to lower operating expenses, enhance the sustainability of natural resources, and align the agricultural sector with the Sultanate’s long-term vision for innovative, green development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Golden Pass LNG project, a landmark joint venture between QatarEnergy (70%) and ExxonMobil (30%), has achieved a historic milestone b...
records.description: The Golden Pass LNG project, a landmark joint venture between QatarEnergy (70%) and ExxonMobil (30%), has achieved a historic milestone by producing its first LNG from the first of its three liquefaction trains. Located in Sabine Pass, Texas, this $10 billion investment represents a core pillar of QatarEnergy’s decade-long international strategy and its 2018 commitment to invest $20 billion in the US energy sector. With a total planned capacity of 18 million tonnes per annum (mtpa), the start of operations at Golden Pass LNG is timed to address urgent global energy security needs, providing international markets with expanded access to cleaner energy while solidifying the strategic partnership between the Qatari state energy firm and the US oil major.
records.institution: QatarEnergy, ExxonMobil

records.title: The Ministry of Municipality has established a resilient food security framework for Qatar, anchored by three strategic pillars: local pr...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality has established a resilient food security framework for Qatar, anchored by three strategic pillars: local production, strategic stockpiling, and international investment. The Ministry of Municipality has achieved 100% seasonal self-sufficiency in vegetables and approximately 99% in poultry and dairy products, significantly reducing reliance on imports. To mitigate global supply chain risks, the Ministry of Municipality, in coordination with the Ministry of Commerce, maintains reinforced stockpiles of essential grains like rice and wheat, supported by early warning systems and international activities through the Hassad Company. This comprehensive approach is further bolstered by the Ministry of Municipality’s digital transformation, which offers over 250 electronic services via the Aoun app to ensure market stability and the continuous availability of production inputs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched the "Solar Energy – Sustainable Harvest" initiative to integrate...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched the "Solar Energy – Sustainable Harvest" initiative to integrate renewable energy into Oman's farming sector. In collaboration with Nafath Renewable Energy and the Development Bank, the program offers financing of up to RO 15,000 to transition farms—particularly those using greenhouses and modern irrigation—to solar power. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has structured the financing to include zero interest for full-time farmers and a 3% rate for part-time farmers, aimed at reducing operational costs and carbon emissions. Priority is given to projects supporting national food security, provided the land is officially registered, possesses an agricultural electricity meter, and offers at least 100sqm of shade-free space for panel installation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia has achieved a monumental environmental milestone by successfully rehabilitating one million hectares of degraded land under...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has achieved a monumental environmental milestone by successfully rehabilitating one million hectares of degraded land under the Saudi Green Initiative, a feat the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) hails as a global blueprint for water-scarce regions. Spearheaded by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, this achievement utilizes science-based solutions—including cloud seeding, sandstorm early warning systems, and expanded protected areas—to strengthen biodiversity and ecosystem resilience. Aligned with Vision 2030, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has demonstrated that coordinated action between the government and private sector can turn environmental challenges into economic opportunities. As the international community prepares for COP17 in Mongolia in August 2026, this million-hectare restoration serves as a critical example of the scale and pace required to bolster global food security and drought resilience.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in partnership with the Ministry of Environment, Wate...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in partnership with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Al-Baha branch, has launched a significant afforestation campaign in Wadi Dharak National Park. This initiative is a localized extension of the Saudi Green Initiative, focusing on the ecological restoration of the Al-Baha region through the planting of native species specifically adapted to the desert climate. By fostering community participation, the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification aims to expand the region’s green footprint, improve the quality of life for residents, and secure long-term environmental sustainability in alignment with the Kingdom's broader development goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has marked the International Day of Zero Waste (March 30) by reaffirming its...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has marked the International Day of Zero Waste (March 30) by reaffirming its extensive commitment to the UAE’s sustainability agenda. Through a comprehensive "Circular Economy" approach, ADAFSA is integrating Agriculture 4.0 technologies—including robotics, AI-driven oversight, and big-data analytics—to minimize resource depletion across the food value chain. In 2025 alone, the Authority conducted over 116,000 inspection visits and administered 6.1 million vaccinations to stabilize livestock supply chains and reduce mortality. By repurposing food loss into broiler nutrition, redistributing surplus through food banks, and launching the Ghars Educational Platform, ADAFSA is fostering a high-tech, knowledgeable agricultural community dedicated to the UAE's 2030 Sustainable Development Goals.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition in Kuwait has confirmed that national food supplies remain "sufficient" and that its speciali...
records.description: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition in Kuwait has confirmed that national food supplies remain "sufficient" and that its specialized teams are operating around the clock to manage the flow of incoming shipments. Under the guidance of the Public Authority for Food and Nutrition, laboratories and inspection outlets are working at full capacity to examine products and ensure strict compliance with health safety standards. According to the Public Authority for Food and Nutrition, inspection tours of central markets and food factories have been intensified to protect public health and maintain a stable food environment for all citizens and residents.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has issued an urgent advisory for farmers, livestock breeders, beekeepers, and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has issued an urgent advisory for farmers, livestock breeders, beekeepers, and fishermen to take comprehensive precautions to protect themselves and their property ahead of a forecasted weather depression. Following alerts from the National Multi Hazard Early Warning Center under the Civil Aviation Authority (CAA), officials warned of a low-pressure system expected to bring scattered thunderstorms, active winds, and potential flash floods across several governorates. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources specifically urged the public to stay away from dams and drainage channels and advised against maritime activities during the storm to mitigate risks associated with heavy wadi flow and reduced visibility.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued a comprehensive suite of emergency guidelines for farmers and liv...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued a comprehensive suite of emergency guidelines for farmers and livestock breeders to mitigate the impact of recent weather events. To protect plant wealth, ADAFSA recommends delaying harvests until crops are fully dry and applying copper and calcium-based treatments to fruit trees and tuber crops to prevent fungal infections. For livestock management, the ADAFSA protocols mandate the disinfection of barn floors with lime or agricultural sulphur, the isolation of animals exposed to rain, and a strategic 10–20% increase in high-nutrient feed supplemented with Vitamin C and amino acids to bolster immunity. Furthermore, ADAFSA urged operators of shared irrigation systems to inspect water tanks and transmission lines, emphasizing that technical support remains available through its regional agricultural extension centers and veterinary clinics to ensure the long-term sustainability of the sector.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Credit Oman achieved a 3.67% growth in performance, with total exports and insured local sales reaching OMR 390.2 million compared to OMR...
records.description: Credit Oman achieved a 3.67% growth in performance, with total exports and insured local sales reaching OMR 390.2 million compared to OMR 376.4 million in the previous year. Operating entirely on its own resources, Credit Oman reported a profit of OMR 258,200 while playing a pivotal role in supporting national development and promoting non-oil exports, which accounted for OMR 210 million of its insured sales across sectors such as agriculture, fisheries, and petrochemicals. The institution saw a 15.7% increase in the number of document holders, reflecting a growing awareness of its credit insurance services as a vital tool for mitigating non-payment risks and stabilizing cash flows for companies of all sizes. By allocating investments into highly liquid instruments, Credit Oman grew its total assets beyond OMR 20 million, reinforcing its strategic approach to providing comprehensive insurance solutions that enable local businesses to contract confidently with international partners and expand into global markets.
records.institution: Credit Oman

records.title: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) has dramatically accelerated its "Logistics Corridors Initiative" to bypass the Strait of Hormuz block...
records.description: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) has dramatically accelerated its "Logistics Corridors Initiative" to bypass the Strait of Hormuz blockade. By launching a new shipping link with Bahrain and adding five high-capacity maritime services in partnership with global leaders like Maersk and MSC, Saudi Arabia has added over 63,000 TEUs of operational capacity to the region. The strategic pivot focuses on rerouting Gulf-bound cargo toward Red Sea gateways—including Jeddah Islamic Port and King Abdullah Port—and utilizing overland transport to deliver essential goods to Eastern markets. This shift, coupled with new integrated vessel support services in the Arabian Gulf, is designed to stabilize food supply chains and ensure the predictable movement of commodities despite ongoing geopolitical volatility.
records.institution: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani)

records.title: Saudi Arabia’s waste plastic recycling market is undergoing a high-tech evolution, projected to grow from US$411.4 million in 2025 to US$...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s waste plastic recycling market is undergoing a high-tech evolution, projected to grow from US$411.4 million in 2025 to US$748.0 million by 2034. Driven by Vision 2030 and a robust 6.87% CAGR, the Kingdom is deploying AI-driven sorting and advanced chemical recycling to manage its 7 million tonnes of annual plastic waste. With the Saudi Investment Recycling Company (SIRC) leading a nationwide infrastructure overhaul, the goal is to divert 81% of waste from landfills by 2035, transforming the nation into a regional hub for the circular economy.
records.institution: The Saudi Investment Recycling Company (SIRC)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in partnership with the private sector, is spearheading a transition toward i...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in partnership with the private sector, is spearheading a transition toward investment-driven farming in the Al-Uwaynat area of Sohar to reduce imports and enhance national self-sufficiency. This initiative encompasses nine integrated projects covering approximately 100 acres with a total investment of OMR 2.3 million, positioning North Al Batinah as a primary food basket for the Sultanate. By utilizing a strategic mix of open-field cultivation and modern greenhouse technologies, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources ensures year-round production of sustainable fruit crops like mango and lemon, alongside seasonal melons and protected vegetables. These model farming projects, facilitated through the "Tatweer" platform, align with the goals of Oman Vision 2040 by adopting advanced irrigation and smart farming techniques to secure water resources while creating employment and stabilizing the local food supply.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources recorded a total of 24.47 million cubic metres of water impounded by dams acro...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources recorded a total of 24.47 million cubic metres of water impounded by dams across the Sultanate of Oman following significant weather conditions. The highest rainfall was observed in Barka at 133 mm, with major retention occurring in the Wadi Dayqah Dam in Muscat and several dams in Al Batinah South, including Al Taw and Al Maawil. Several reservoirs, such as the Al Sudairiyin and Al Aqida dams, reached maximum capacity as the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources monitored mid-range to heavy rainfall across governorates including Musandam, Al Dhahirah, and Al Sharqiyah North. This influx of surface water across the national dam network remains a critical component for recharging aquifers and securing long-term water resources for the agricultural and domestic sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia’s celebration of World Water Day 2026 marks a significant transition from national resource management to global leadership.
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s celebration of World Water Day 2026 marks a significant transition from national resource management to global leadership. With this year’s theme, "Water and Gender: Where Water Flows, Equality Grows," the Kingdom is highlighting the intersection of water security and social equity. Under the guidance of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA), Saudi Arabia is leveraging its status as the world’s largest producer of desalinated water to export technical expertise and humanitarian aid to water-stressed regions globally.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The UAE has marked World Water Day 2026 by solidifying its role as a global leader in water diplomacy and innovation, highlighted by the...
records.description: The UAE has marked World Water Day 2026 by solidifying its role as a global leader in water diplomacy and innovation, highlighted by the upcoming 2026 United Nations Water Conference in December, which it will co-host with Senegal. Addressing a global crisis where 2.2 billion people lack clean drinking water, the UAE is deploying a multi-billion-dollar strategy that includes a $150 million pledge for scarcity solutions and the $60 million "Clean Rivers" program spanning Brazil, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Through high-impact humanitarian engineering like Operation Chivalrous Knight 3, the UAE has established critical infrastructure including a 2-million-gallon-per-day pipeline in Gaza and desalination units for Cyprus, demonstrating a unique ability to export both financial capital and advanced water technology to the world's most water-stressed regions.
records.institution: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative and Suqia UAE

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has marked World Water Day 2026 by accelerating its transition to "Agricultu...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has marked World Water Day 2026 by accelerating its transition to "Agriculture 4.0," a technology-driven strategy to combat groundwater depletion and rising salinity. In a strategic partnership with the Abu Dhabi Department of Energy, the Authority has implemented a pilot AI-driven smart metering project in Al Wathba, while simultaneously expanding a massive recycled water network that currently serves over 1,600 farms. By integrating smart sensors, data analytics, and digital training via the Ghars Educational Platform, ADAFSA aims to eliminate water waste and move the Emirate toward a non-conventional water cycle, ensuring that irrigation is precisely calibrated to soil conditions while preserving non-renewable national reserves.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched the Namaa Endowment Fund with an initial SAR 100 million ($26.6 million)...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched the Namaa Endowment Fund with an initial SAR 100 million ($26.6 million) contribution from the General Authority for Awqaf. Developed in partnership with the Capital Market Authority and SNB Capital, the fund introduces a modern institutional endowment model designed to finance environmental sustainability and circular economy initiatives through a licensed digital platform. By supporting non-profit institutions like Reef, Morooj, and Saqaya, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture aims to reduce food waste, protect biodiversity, and accelerate the Kingdom's goal of diverting 90% of waste from landfills by 2040, ultimately boosting the non-profit sector's contribution to the national GDP under Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in South Al Batinah has partnered with the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fish...
records.description: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in South Al Batinah has partnered with the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to launch 23 new investment sites in the Al Muladdah area, covering over 180 acres. Offered through the "Tatweer" platform under a 25-year usufruct system, these opportunities include 16 agricultural projects focused on lemon and mango cultivation, plant nurseries, and crop sorting, alongside 7 integrated livestock ventures combining goat and sheep breeding with fodder production and aquaculture. By providing a five-year grace period and specific investment incentives, the Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning aims to optimize government land use and attract high-value investments that align with the Sultanate's economic diversification and food security targets.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The International Dates Council, headquartered in Saudi Arabia, has officially initiated the transfer of high-quality date palm seedlings...
records.description: The International Dates Council, headquartered in Saudi Arabia, has officially initiated the transfer of high-quality date palm seedlings to the Chinese Academy of Tropical Agricultural Sciences (CATAS). This technical exchange activates a 2025 strategic agreement aimed at integrating Saudi expertise in date cultivation with China’s advanced research in tropical agriculture. Beyond the scientific exchange, the initiative serves a diplomatic function, coordinated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to formally invite China to join the council as an associate member. By establishing these global agricultural hubs, the International Dates Council seeks to modernize production techniques and enhance the global sustainability of the palm industry through the shared development of resilient crop varieties and smart farming technologies.
records.institution: The International Dates Council

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has launched a comprehensive food safety and inspection campaign across the...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has launched a comprehensive food safety and inspection campaign across the Emirate in preparation for Eid Al Fitr 2026. This proactive strategy involves intensifying routine and unannounced inspections at retail outlets, traditional kitchens, and produce markets across Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra to ensure the highest standards of hygiene and raw material quality. By utilizing advanced smart inspection tools and deploying additional veterinary staff to approved abattoirs, ADAFSA aims to streamline the inspection process and prevent unregulated slaughtering practices. The authority emphasizes a partnership with the public, encouraging consumers to report violations via the government contact center to maintain the integrity of the food supply chain during this high-demand season.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has partnered with the Azimut Group to develop a first-of-its-kind...
records.description: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has partnered with the Azimut Group to develop a first-of-its-kind food security equity index, scheduled for launch in the second quarter of 2026. This collaboration focuses on creating a transparent, rules-based benchmark for listed companies across the Arab world that specialize in agricultural production, supply-chain infrastructure, and food processing. By providing structured exposure to these critical sectors, the Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) aims to attract institutional capital into regional agriculture, with plans already underway to launch a dedicated Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) later this year.
records.institution: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.title: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, in collaboration with the Ministry of Local Administration and Rural Developme...
records.description: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, in collaboration with the Ministry of Local Administration and Rural Development, has launched a humanitarian initiative to distribute 1,500 food baskets to impoverished families in the Al-Thawra District of Sana’a. Attended by high-ranking officials, including the Acting Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the launch follows national directives to strengthen social solidarity and alleviate the suffering caused by the ongoing blockade and economic hardship. This charitable effort is part of a broader strategy by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology to fulfill its social responsibilities, providing essential nutrition to those in need while encouraging local businessmen and philanthropists to expand support for charitable kitchens and seasonal aid programs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources convened a strategic coordination meeting at the Silal Central Market with a b...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources convened a strategic coordination meeting at the Silal Central Market with a broad coalition of merchants and investors to ensure the abundance and price stability of essential food commodities. This high-level gathering, which included representatives from the Consumer Protection Authority, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, and the Asyad Group, prioritized the maintenance of smooth supply chains to meet the increased demand during festive periods. By conducting field tours to inspect daily operational movements and listening directly to merchant feedback, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and its partners reinforced their commitment to market stability and the continuous flow of goods for all residents.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The “Today’s Seed… Tomorrow’s Palm” initiative has officially launched in the Al-Sukhnah District of Hodeidah, marking a grassroots expan...
records.description: The “Today’s Seed… Tomorrow’s Palm” initiative has officially launched in the Al-Sukhnah District of Hodeidah, marking a grassroots expansion of Yemen’s date production capabilities. Operating under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the project encourages residents to repurpose date seeds from daily consumption for planting. By mobilizing the Al-Sukhnah Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society and local families, the initiative seeks to leverage the district’s ideal climate to build a resilient, self-sufficient agricultural economy. Officials emphasize that this community-led effort, launched at the start of Ramadan, aims to transform simple household waste into a long-term national resource, eventually increasing the density of palm groves and reducing reliance on imported fruit.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism has clarified that the recent price hikes for onions and tomatoes are a temporary and limited byprodu...
records.description: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism has clarified that the recent price hikes for onions and tomatoes are a temporary and limited byproduct of the ongoing regional crisis and heightened demand during Ramadan. To counter this, the Ministry of Economy and Tourism has already injected abundant supplies of these commodities into the market and intensified nationwide field inspections to ensure price stability. With a robust strategic reserve capable of covering essential needs for up to six months, the Ministry of Economy and Tourism reassures consumers that supply chains remain fully operational through the country’s entry points. Furthermore, the Ministry of Economy and Tourism has taken strict enforcement actions—conducting over 7,100 inspection tours and identifying hundreds of violations—while emphasizing that prices for nine essential food categories remain under a strict "no-increase" policy without prior government approval.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: The General Authority for the Development of Tihama has launched a specialized training workshop in the Bajil District of Hodeidah to qua...
records.description: The General Authority for the Development of Tihama has launched a specialized training workshop in the Bajil District of Hodeidah to qualify 28 "Livestock Champions." Operating under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the initiative is designed to bridge the gap between official agricultural authorities and local breeders. The program focuses on modernizing herd management, improving nutritional techniques, and aggressively raising awareness against the slaughter of female livestock—a practice that threatens long-term food security and the sustainability of national herds in the Tihama Plain.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Meranti Green Steel has secured a strategic agreement with a long-term investor to accelerate its green iron project in Oman, marking a c...
records.description: Meranti Green Steel has secured a strategic agreement with a long-term investor to accelerate its green iron project in Oman, marking a critical milestone toward a Final Investment Decision (FID) targeted for mid-2026. This investment strengthens the project's financial foundation, positioning it as a bankable, low-carbon industrial hub designed to serve international markets—particularly Europe—under tightening carbon regulations like the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). By leveraging Oman’s strategic geography, port access, and renewable energy potential, the project aligns with the Sultanate’s broader ambition to build a competitive green hydrogen economy and an export-oriented ecosystem for low-emissions materials.
records.institution: Meranti Green Steel

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a strategic surge in livestock imports to the Sultanate, facilita...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a strategic surge in livestock imports to the Sultanate, facilitating the arrival of 285,890 head of cattle, sheep, and goats to meet rising seasonal demand for red meat. This represents a significant year-on-year increase in import volumes, a trend the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has supported by approving 239 import permits and streamlining administrative and quarantine procedures. By coordinating closely with private sector importers and monitoring market data, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources ensures a steady supply of both live animals and chilled or frozen meats, maintaining food stability and price consistency across all governorates during periods of high consumption.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Elsewedy Electric for Power Transmission & Distribution has announced the successful completion and handover of the El Saad Solar Plant i...
records.description: Elsewedy Electric for Power Transmission & Distribution has announced the successful completion and handover of the El Saad Solar Plant in Saudi Arabia, a utility-scale facility with a peak capacity of 348.6 MW. Developed in partnership with Jinko Power and Al Ghazala Energy Company Limited, the project marks a significant milestone as the company's first major photovoltaic asset in the Gulf region. Elsewedy Electric for Power Transmission & Distribution demonstrated exceptional engineering efficiency by compressing the original 24-month construction timeline to just 16.5 months, delivering not only the solar array but also a 33/132 kV high-voltage substation and interconnection infrastructure. Now entering its operations and maintenance phase, the plant is fully integrated into the high-voltage grid, supporting the Kingdom’s clean energy transition under the oversight of the Saudi Power Procurement Company.
records.institution: Elsewedy Electric for Power Transmission & Distribution

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially extended a comprehensive four-year ban on the catching, possess...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially extended a comprehensive four-year ban on the catching, possession, and trading of sea cucumbers within the marine waters of the Republic of Yemen to safeguard depleting fish stocks and preserve marine biodiversity. Under this directive, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources prohibits all related activities, including the purchase, transport, storage, and export of the species, with oversight provided by the General Authority for Fisheries in the Red Sea to ensure legal compliance. Furthermore, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has mandated the General Authority for Marine Sciences and Aquatic Life Research to conduct specialized scientific studies to assess the environmental status of sea cucumber populations, aiming to establish long-term sustainable management policies that protect the marine environment for future generations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a transformative period for the Sultanate's aquaculture sector, w...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a transformative period for the Sultanate's aquaculture sector, which achieved a 67.7 percent growth in production to reach 9,240 tonnes with a market value exceeding OMR20.3 million. By prioritizing species such as whiteleg shrimp, European seabream, and Omani abalone, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is advancing a sustainable blue economy aligned with Oman Vision 2040 to diversify national income. This strategic expansion is supported by a robust framework that includes 80 percent project financing for entrepreneurs, the promotion of "integrated aquaculture" to optimize water use, and the construction of massive new production facilities, such as the OMR23.5 million shrimp project in North Al Batinah. To ensure global competitiveness, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources enforces strict adherence to international Best Aquaculture Practices (BAP), facilitating the export of premium Omani seafood to major markets in the European Union, China, and across the GCC.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Silal and the National Agricultural Center have entered into a strategic partnership to establish an integrated support framework for UAE...
records.description: Silal and the National Agricultural Center have entered into a strategic partnership to establish an integrated support framework for UAE farmers, beginning with an initiative in Ras Al Khaimah’s Al Hamraniyah region. This collaboration focuses on empowering local producers through a comprehensive system that includes technical assistance, the provision of high-quality agricultural inputs, and oversight of post-harvest handling. To streamline the path from farm to market, Silal and the National Agricultural Center will establish a dedicated crop collection center designed to enhance the efficiency of agricultural supply chains and boost the competitiveness of Emirati products. By integrating production, marketing, and distribution stages, this initiative strengthens the resilience of the agricultural sector and advances the country's national food security objectives.
records.institution: Silal and the National Agricultural Center

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has announced that national poultry meat production has reached a re...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has announced that national poultry meat production has reached a record 1,310,000 tons. This surge in domestic output is a central pillar of the "From the Bounty of Our Land" campaign, which promotes local consumption during Ramadan to bolster food security. While domestic capacity expands under Saudi Vision 2030, the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has simultaneously tightened biosecurity measures, imposing a total import ban on poultry products from 40 countries and partial restrictions on 16 others. These controls, driven by the global spread of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), aim to protect the Kingdom's thriving poultry sector and ensure the safety of the national food supply.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has officially launched its 2026 Livestock Auction series, a strategic initiative designed to bolster national food security and support local breeders. Held on the final weekend of every month at the Al Wathba platform, these auctions provide a transparent, intermediary-free marketplace for high-quality sheep and goats. By facilitating direct sales, ADAFSA aims to increase financial returns for local producers while ensuring that consumers have access to healthy, locally-sourced livestock that meet rigorous biosecurity and Sharia standards, particularly during high-demand periods like Ramadan and the upcoming Eids.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched a landmark national initiative at the start of Ramadan 2026 unde...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched a landmark national initiative at the start of Ramadan 2026 under the slogan "Today's Pit is Tomorrow's Palm Tree." This project aims to transform the millions of date pits remaining from iftar tables into a vast production base for palm trees across Yemen. By engaging the community in a "low-cost, high-impact" model, the ministry seeks to expand the agricultural footprint of palm trees to all governorates, ultimately reducing the nation's reliance on date imports and strengthening local food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has announced six new agricultural investment opportunities in the Bur...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has announced six new agricultural investment opportunities in the Buraimi Governorate, totaling 114.5 acres, accessible through the Tatweer platform. These projects are designed to integrate modern agricultural technologies with private sector expertise to boost local productivity and food sustainability. The opportunities range from high-tech tissue culture laboratories and seedling production to specialized cultivation of staples like onions and potatoes, as well as high-value crops like figs. By leveraging strategic locations in Mahdah (specifically the Al Zaroub, Al Wadiyeen, and Safwan areas), the ministry aims to diversify the Sultanate’s agricultural output and strengthen the national food security framework in line with Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), through its Food Safety and Quality Center, has formalized a strategi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), through its Food Safety and Quality Center, has formalized a strategic partnership with Nama Water Services Company to bolster the Sultanate’s drinking water monitoring systems. This memorandum of cooperation focuses on unifying institutional efforts to track water quality, identify emerging pollutants, and accelerate scientific research within the sector. By combining the regulatory oversight of the Food Safety and Quality Center with the operational expertise of Nama Water, the agreement aims to develop innovative technical solutions and raise community awareness, ensuring that Oman’s water infrastructure aligns with the highest international safety standards and the sustainable development goals of Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The South Al Batinah Governorate achieved a significant milestone in 2025, producing 12.4 thousand kilograms of local honey with a market...
records.description: The South Al Batinah Governorate achieved a significant milestone in 2025, producing 12.4 thousand kilograms of local honey with a market value exceeding RO 186.5 thousand. According to the Directorate of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the harvest was dominated by Samar honey (7,136.5 kg) and Sidr honey (5,097.5 kg), alongside other floral varieties. To sustain this momentum, the Directorate is implementing a comprehensive support strategy that includes technical field consultations, quality supervision, and specialized marketing exhibitions. These efforts are designed to modernize the honey value chain, enhance the global competitiveness of Omani honey, and diversify the local economy in alignment with national strategic goals for the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The South Al Batinah Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has announced that Saudi Arabia’s poultry meat production has exceeded 1.31 mil...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has announced that Saudi Arabia’s poultry meat production has exceeded 1.31 million tons, a milestone that significantly bolsters national food security and self-sufficiency. This production surge is timed to meet the heightened seasonal demand during the holy month of Ramadan, providing a reliable source of high-quality protein to the local market. By employing advanced breeding technologies and rigorous nutrition standards, the ministry ensures that national products maintain superior quality and safety levels compared to imports. This growth aligns with the strategic objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, fostering sustainable agricultural development and enhancing consumer confidence in the domestic poultry sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) has signed a strategic agreement with the Estijabah Foundation for Hum...
records.description: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) has signed a strategic agreement with the Estijabah Foundation for Humanitarian Aid and Relief to launch the "Strengthening the Agricultural Value Chain for Smallholders" project. This initiative targets approximately 2,300 Yemeni families—benefiting more than 16,000 individuals—in the agriculturally vital governorates of Abyan, Marib, and Hadhramaut. By improving access to high-quality inputs and modernizing irrigation technologies, the project seeks to transition rural farmers from low-yield subsistence to high-value production. A key pillar of the program involves enhancing the sustainability of pastoral livelihoods, ensuring that families relying on livestock can achieve better economic returns while fostering long-term social stability and food security for vulnerable groups.
records.institution: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has officially launched the Saudi strawberry season, marking a strategic expans...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has officially launched the Saudi strawberry season, marking a strategic expansion in the Kingdom's high-value crop production. Through partnerships with major retailers, the ministry is deploying innovative packaging and display techniques to enhance the market presence and perceived quality of domestic strawberries. By providing high-quality tissue culture seedlings to farmers in regions such as Qassim, Taif, and Al-Jouf, the institution is successfully reducing import dependency and leveraging diverse regional climates to extend the production window. This initiative not only secures fresh produce for local markets but also feeds into a growing agro-industrial ecosystem, supporting the manufacture of jams, juices, and frozen goods to maximize the economic value of the national agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: Al Rawdah, a subsidiary of the Emirates Rawabi Food Group, has established a benchmark for fully integrated poultry production in the UAE...
records.description: Al Rawdah, a subsidiary of the Emirates Rawabi Food Group, has established a benchmark for fully integrated poultry production in the UAE, managing every stage from breeder genetics to renewable energy generation. By operating 78 high-capacity broiler houses and an in-house hatchery producing 16 million eggs annually, the company has minimized external dependencies while optimizing bird performance in extreme climates using specialized Cobb 500 and Ross 308 breeds. A significant portion of the facility's operations—currently 30%—is powered by solar energy, with strategic plans to exceed 50% in the near future. Aligned with the UAE Food Security Strategy 2051, Al Rawdah prioritizes a "fresh-first" model, delivering 90% of its output within hours of processing, while integrating circular waste management and in-house feed production to ensure long-term sustainability and biosecurity.
records.institution: Emirates Rawabi Food Group

records.title: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has concluded a significant international tender for 794,000 metric tons of wheat, exceeding i...
records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has concluded a significant international tender for 794,000 metric tons of wheat, exceeding its initial procurement target to bolster national reserves. This purchase, finalized in early March 2026, is scheduled for delivery between May and July via 13 separate shipments arriving at strategic ports including Jeddah, Yanbu, Jazan, and Duba. The acquisition follows a major tender in January and aligns with the institution's strategic shift toward international imports to preserve domestic freshwater resources. By securing these substantial volumes for the national milling industry, the authority continues to ensure the stability of the grain supply chain and reinforce the Kingdom's long-term food security framework.
records.institution: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA)

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has distributed urea fertilizer and essential agricultural supplies to 500...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has distributed urea fertilizer and essential agricultural supplies to 500 farmers in the Aleppo Governorate as part of the Sab' Sanabel Project. This initiative aims to support a total of 750 farming families in the production of wheat and vegetables by covering the costs of energy, seeds, and tools, while simultaneously providing training on best agricultural practices. Beyond direct aid, the project creates job opportunities for approximately 500 daily-wage workers, fostering economic resilience within the local community. By empowering Syrian agricultural families and enhancing their productivity, the program serves as a critical pillar in KSrelief’s broader humanitarian strategy to achieve livelihood stability and food security in the region.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The General Corporation for the Propagation of Improved Seeds, in partnership with the Al-Hujaylah District Multi-Purpose Agricultural Co...
records.description: The General Corporation for the Propagation of Improved Seeds, in partnership with the Al-Hujaylah District Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association, has officially inaugurated the maize harvest for the 1447 AH agricultural season in Al-Hodeidah. This initiative, coordinated with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, focuses on translating the state’s strategic vision into tangible grain and fodder production to cover local needs. By utilizing modern agricultural technologies and selected seed varieties, the project aims to ensure economic feasibility for farmers while moving toward national self-sufficiency in staple crops. Initial yields in the Tihama regions have shown promising results, providing a foundation for the Agricultural Cooperative Union to expand maize cultivation across broader areas in future seasons.
records.institution: The General Corporation for the Propagation of Improved Seeds

records.title: Al Hodeidah Projects and Agricultural & Fisheries Initiatives Financing Unit spearheaded a transformative development program, investing...
records.description: Al Hodeidah Projects and Agricultural & Fisheries Initiatives Financing Unit spearheaded a transformative development program, investing hundreds of millions of riyals into infrastructure and sustainability. Key achievements included the rehabilitation of irrigation facilities in Wadi Zabid and the drilling of solar-powered artesian wells in Al-Dhahi to secure water resources for seed multiplication. The institution also prioritized environmental resilience through the "Green Belt" project and the cultivation of 20,000 Sidr seedlings to bolster local honey production. Furthermore, the unit strengthened the region's technical capacity by rehabilitating the Tihama Agricultural Research Center and initiating construction on a Central Laboratory for Fish and Marine Life to ensure export quality.
records.institution: Al Hodeidah Projects and Agricultural & Fisheries Initiatives Financing Unit

records.title: The General Corporation for Improved Seed Multiplication, in partnership with the Bajil District Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative A...
records.description: The General Corporation for Improved Seed Multiplication, in partnership with the Bajil District Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association, has officially launched the maize harvest for the 1447 AH agricultural season in Al Hodeidah. This initiative, coordinated by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and supported by the Bonyan Development Foundation, aims to reduce the national import bill by enhancing the quality and scale of domestic grain and fodder production. By integrating improved seed varieties and modern agricultural techniques, the project focuses on increasing cultivation efficiency in the Tihama areas while ensuring economic feasibility and rewarding returns for local farmers.
records.institution: The General Corporation for Improved Seed Multiplication

records.title: Agriculture ministry signs Country Programme Framework agreement 2026–2030 with FAO
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has formally entered into a five-year Country Programme Framework (CPF) agreement with the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), covering the period from 2026 to 2030. This strategic partnership is the result of an extensive consultative process involving government bodies, the private sector, and civil society to align international expertise with Oman's national development priorities. The framework is designed to bolster food security by enhancing the sustainability and resilience of the agricultural and fisheries sectors, optimizing value chain efficiencies, and improving the management of natural resources. Furthermore, the agreement emphasizes a commitment to climate action and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), ensuring that the Sultanate’s primary production sectors remain competitive and environmentally viable through the end of the decade.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced the completion of a massive RO 6.4 million ($16.6 million) maintenan...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced the completion of a massive RO 6.4 million ($16.6 million) maintenance program covering 59 dams across the Sultanate. The project, spanning 2024–2025, focused on enhancing the structural integrity and monitoring capabilities of Oman's national water infrastructure. Key upgrades included the removal of millions of cubic meters of silt, the installation of 32 advanced monitoring cameras, and the replacement of 18 water discharge gates. These measures are critical for Oman’s water security, as the nation increasingly relies on groundwater recharge dams to replenish aquifers and combat seawater intrusion along its coastal plains.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has successfully operationalized a new cloud seeding station in the Wilayat of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has successfully operationalized a new cloud seeding station in the Wilayat of Khasab, Musandam, as part of a national strategy to bolster water security and climate resilience. This facility, which utilizes an ionization-based system to stimulate rainfall and recharge groundwater reserves, marks the 14th station in a specialized network spanning the Hajar mountains and the Dhofar highlands. With an operational reach of up to 70 kilometers, the station is designed to enhance precipitation prospects across the region’s unique geographical landscape. By expanding this weather enhancement infrastructure, the institution aims to achieve long-term water sustainability targets and mitigate the impacts of regional water scarcity through advanced meteorological technology.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially reaffirmed the strategic status of Saudi Coffee as a vital national...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially reaffirmed the strategic status of Saudi Coffee as a vital national crop and a cornerstone of the Kingdom's cultural identity, particularly during the month of Ramadan. As part of Saudi Vision 2030, the government is aggressively scaling domestic production to transition coffee from a traditional heritage drink into a high-value global commodity. With over 1.3 million productive trees now established in the southwestern highlands, Saudi Arabia is rapidly closing the gap on its ambitious goal to reach 7,000 tons of annual production by the end of 2026.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has launched an international tender to procure 655,000 metric tons of wheat to secure t...
records.description: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has launched an international tender to procure 655,000 metric tons of wheat to secure the Kingdom’s domestic flour milling requirements and bolster national strategic reserves. This massive procurement is distributed across eleven shipments destined for major maritime hubs, including Jeddah Islamic Port, King Abdulaziz Port in Dammam, Yanbu Commercial Port, and Jazan Port. By coordinating these large-scale arrivals through a centralized digital bidding process, the institution aims to ensure a continuous and stable supply of high-quality grain during peak consumption periods, reinforcing the logistical efficiency of the national food security framework.
records.institution: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA)

records.title: The Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA) launched a major call for projects to select twenty Productive Alliances.
records.description: The Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA) launched a major call for projects to select twenty Productive Alliances. Financed by the World Bank under the 2025–2030 Food Systems Transformation Support Program, this initiative aims to bridge the gap between small-scale producers and commercial buyers. By formalizing business plans and commercial partnerships, the program seeks to shield vulnerable farmers from market volatility while ensuring a steady, high-quality supply for market operators. Selected alliances will receive a two-year package of technical and financial government support to ensure their transition into competitive, structured value chains.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs & Agriculture

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Dhofar announced the successful second harvest of its pilot gin...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Dhofar announced the successful second harvest of its pilot ginger cultivation project. Funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund, the initiative has scaled from its 2024 debut to a 2026 yield of 2.5 tons—more than doubling the previous year's output. Under the leadership of Engineer Radwan bin Abdullah Al Ibrahim, the project has expanded to include 60 farmers across the Wilayats of Rakhyut and Dhalkut. By providing technical advisory, modern irrigation systems, and soil improvement techniques, the program aims to replicate the success of Dhofar’s earlier turmeric localization, shifting the region toward high-value spice production to reduce national import reliance and create sustainable income for local families.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman announced the successful commissioning of its newest artificial rainma...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman announced the successful commissioning of its newest artificial rainmaking station in the Musandam Governorate (Wilayat of Khasab). This facility marks the 14th station in Oman’s national cloud-seeding network, which now blankets the Hajar Mountains and the Dhofar highlands. Utilizing advanced ion technology, the Khasab station emits ions to catalyze cloud condensation, with an operational reach of up to 70 kilometers to the northwest and south. This expansion is a key pillar of Oman’s strategy to bolster groundwater recharge and ensure water security amidst the increasing pressures of climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources
