records.title: The Qatar Free Zones Authority (QFZ) and Qatar Foundation (QF) entered into a strategic partnership agreement to establish a collaborativ...
records.description: The Qatar Free Zones Authority (QFZ) and Qatar Foundation (QF) entered into a strategic partnership agreement to establish a collaborative framework focused on climate change action and sustainable development. This initiative aims to strengthen national preparedness and resilience through climate education, applied research, and community engagement projects, utilizing flagship sustainability platforms such as the Earthna Center for a Sustainable Future and the Sustainability Academy at Green Island. By integrating expertise in innovation and human capacity building, the partnership seeks to foster sustainable behaviors and advance the environmental pillar of the Qatar National Vision 2030 through coordinated annual work plans and measurable impact reporting.
records.institution: The Qatar Free Zones Authority (QFZ)

records.title: The Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in New Delhi issued a formal request to Indian authorities to suspend the import of fruits and vegetabl...
records.description: The Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in New Delhi issued a formal request to Indian authorities to suspend the import of fruits and vegetables from Kerala and West Bengal. This precautionary measure follows the detection of two confirmed cases of Nipah virus (NiV) in healthcare workers in West Bengal in January 2026. While Kerala has not reported active cases in recent months, its history of near-annual outbreaks since 2018 has led to its inclusion in the suspension. The directive mandates that produce from other Indian states undergo rigorous phytosanitary inspections, specifically looking for signs of bat activity (bite marks or droppings) to prevent the zoonotic transmission of the virus through contaminated food.
records.institution: The Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia

records.title: The Bajil Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Al-Hodeidah Governorate officially commenced its soybean procurement season.
records.description: The Bajil Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Al-Hodeidah Governorate officially commenced its soybean procurement season. This initiative, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, marks a turning point for the Tihama region as it shifts toward localizing strategic crops to reduce the national import bill. District officials highlighted the success of intercropping soybean with corn, a technique that has significantly improved land-use efficiency and soil health. By activating cooperative warehouses for standardized drying, cleaning, and storage, the project aims to establish a reliable local value chain for plant-based protein, moving Yemen closer to food sovereignty.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: ne’ma (the National Food Loss and Waste Initiative) announced the expansion of its ‘Valuing Our Roots’ campaign, marking its largest nati...
records.description: ne’ma (the National Food Loss and Waste Initiative) announced the expansion of its ‘Valuing Our Roots’ campaign, marking its largest nationwide rollout to date. Operating across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Al Ain, Sharjah, and Ras Al Khaimah, the initiative aims to rescue over 300,000 tonnes of food—a 50% increase in surplus recovery compared to 2025. Centered on the ne’ma Family Iftar Boxes, the program redistributes fresh produce and non-perishables from major suppliers like Silal, Agthia, and Majid Al Futtaim to more than 10,000 low-income families.
records.institution: ne’ma

records.title: The Eastern Sector Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana’a Governorate launched a major initiative to distribute 10,000...
records.description: The Eastern Sector Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana’a Governorate launched a major initiative to distribute 10,000 almond and fruit tree saplings from its Al-Yafi’iyah nursery. Part of a broader plan to plant 50,000 trees this year, the project targets cooperatives across several sub-districts to bolster local crop diversity and move toward national self-sufficiency in fruits like apples, peaches, and grapes. Beyond reforestation, the Eastern Sector Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society is expanding into garlic cultivation in the Khawlan districts and has provided nearly eight tons of improved cereal and legume seeds through interest-free loans.
records.institution: The Eastern Sector Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society

records.title: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in South Al Batinah launched over 15 new investment opportunities through the Tatwe...
records.description: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in South Al Batinah launched over 15 new investment opportunities through the Tatweer platform to strengthen the national food security system. These initiatives involve the allocation of over 150 acres of land for diverse projects including citrus and lemon cultivation, agricultural nurseries, and fish farming, specifically designed to leverage the governorate's unique environmental advantages. Aimed at achieving the sustainable development goals of Oman Vision 2040, the program promotes decentralization by attracting quality private sector projects and empowering small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to drive local economic growth and production efficiency.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources officially broke ground on a massive white-legged shrimp aquaculture project i...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources officially broke ground on a massive white-legged shrimp aquaculture project in the Wilayat of Shinas, North Al Batinah. With a substantial investment of RO 23.5 million (approx. $61 million), this 15-hectare facility is engineered to produce 7,500 tonnes of shrimp annually. This project is a cornerstone of Oman Vision 2040, aimed at transforming the Sultanate into a regional aquaculture powerhouse while reducing economic reliance on oil and gas. By integrating high-tech hatcheries and automated water management, the facility will serve as a technical hub for localizing modern biosecurity standards and boosting the national food security index.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources launched a major investment drive in the Buraimi Governorate, unveiling 20 diverse...
records.description: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources launched a major investment drive in the Buraimi Governorate, unveiling 20 diverse opportunities via the Tatwir platform. Spanning approximately 798.3 feddans, these projects are designed to localize food production and integrate advanced "Agri-Tech" into Oman's desert landscapes. By focusing on high-demand staples like onions and garlic alongside livestock fattening and veterinary services, the ministry aims to transform Buraimi into a high-efficiency agricultural hub that aligns with the Sultanate’s broader economic diversification and food security goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) launched a national awareness campaign titled "Our Land's Bounty" (Khair Ardhin...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) launched a national awareness campaign titled "Our Land's Bounty" (Khair Ardhina) to coincide with the approach of Ramadan. This strategic initiative aims to pivot consumer behavior toward domestic agricultural products and their processed derivatives, directly supporting Saudi farmers and enhancing the Kingdom's self-sufficiency. By promoting high-quality local content such as dates, red meat, and olive oil, the campaign reinforces the goals of Saudi Vision 2030 to build a resilient, sustainable agricultural sector that reduces the carbon footprint associated with food imports and ensures food security during periods of peak seasonal demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Abu Dhabi-based Global South Utilities (GSU) inaugurated a 5 MWp grid-connected solar PV plant in Berbera and launched the Green Berbera...
records.description: Abu Dhabi-based Global South Utilities (GSU) inaugurated a 5 MWp grid-connected solar PV plant in Berbera and launched the Green Berbera Vision, a strategic roadmap to transition the city’s utility system from diesel dependence to renewable-powered generation. Through its 45% ownership in the Berbera Electric Company (BEC), Global South Utilities (GSU) is positioning the strategic port city as a regional hub for clean energy in the Horn of Africa, utilizing solar PV as the primary daytime source supported by battery energy storage systems (BESS). The project, which includes 11.2 km of transmission lines and generates 10,000 MWh annually, aligns with Somaliland’s National Electrification and Energy Sector Strategy to provide reliable power to 28,000 households while avoiding nearly 6,890 metric tonnes of carbon emissions. By 2027, the Berbera Electric Company (BEC) plans to double its renewable capacity, establishing a model for East African port cities to strengthen economic resilience through cost-stable, sustainable energy.
records.institution: Global South Utilities (GSU)

records.title: Gheras Agricultural Company is advancing an integrated agricultural model in Sharjah designed to revolutionize sustainable food security...
records.description: Gheras Agricultural Company is advancing an integrated agricultural model in Sharjah designed to revolutionize sustainable food security in arid environments. Strategically located in Al Dhaid to leverage the region's farming heritage and proximity to academic institutions, the 32-hectare project combines innovative Emirati-developed techniques with smart technologies. A centerpiece of the facility is a unique positive-air-pressure cooling system that utilizes solar energy to reduce water and power consumption by 70%, allowing for the direct use of well water without desalination. With a diverse production profile including organic blueberries, citrus, and a honey factory capable of producing 120 tonnes annually, Gheras Agricultural Company is bridging the gap between historical seed preservation and modern, research-based farming.
records.institution: Gheras Agricultural Company

records.title: The Bonyan Development Foundation, in partnership with the Sharab Al-Salam Association, concluded a specialized four-week animal health t...
records.description: The Bonyan Development Foundation, in partnership with the Sharab Al-Salam Association, concluded a specialized four-week animal health training program in Taiz Governorate. This initiative, supported by the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects Financing Unit, successfully trained 27 female specialists to serve as the "first line of defense" for Yemen’s livestock resources. By equipping rural women with advanced veterinary and epidemiological skills, the program addresses the critical intersection of animal health, community resilience, and national food security.
records.institution: The Bonyan Development Foundation

records.title: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG (OFM) has signed a share purchase agreement to increase its stake in the Arabian Food Production Company SA...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG (OFM) has signed a share purchase agreement to increase its stake in the Arabian Food Production Company SAOC to 66.67%, securing majority control through its subsidiary, Atyab Investments LLC. By acquiring an additional stake from Gulf Japan Poultry Farm, the company aims to strengthen vertical integration across the food value chain, from milling to specialized bakery mixes and poultry feeds. This strategic move, supported by Oman Food Capital and the Oman Investment Authority, aligns with national food security objectives by enhancing local production resilience and streamlining operations. Through its diverse portfolio, including Oman-Australia Limited for grain sourcing and Atyab International Services for quality assurance, Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG (OFM) continues to expand its manufacturing ecosystem to ensure reliable access to essential commodities and improve market competitiveness.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG (OFM)

records.title: Thde Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources officially inaugurated the Al Bashayer Veterinary Hospital in the Wilayat of...
records.description: Thde Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources officially inaugurated the Al Bashayer Veterinary Hospital in the Wilayat of Adam, Al Dakhiliyah Governorate. This OMR 2 million facility represents a strategic milestone in Oman’s animal health infrastructure, particularly as a model for public-private partnership (PPP). Operated by Al-Khairat Veterinary Medical Services Company, the hospital is specifically designed to support the Sultanate’s livestock sector, which comprises approximately four million heads. With a specialized focus on camels—which hold immense social and economic value—the hospital integrates advanced surgical and reproductive technologies to enhance the productivity and health of national herds.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially launched the Namaa Endowment Fund, a pioneering institutional model desi...
records.description: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially launched the Namaa Endowment Fund, a pioneering institutional model designed to secure the long-term sustainability of the non-profit sector within the Kingdom’s environmental framework. In collaboration with the General Authority for Awqaf, the Capital Market Authority, and SNB Capital, the fund seeks to enhance the non-profit sector's contribution to the national GDP in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. With an initial SAR 100 million contribution from the General Authority for Awqaf, the fund will utilize modern investment tools to finance charitable initiatives and support organizations like the Reef National Foundation, the Vegetation Cover Development Foundation, and the Sekaya Charitable Foundation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) announced the second Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition (EmiratesACE) in Al Ain, a strategic move to bolster sustainable food security. The event integrates the entire food value chain, focusing on empowering local farmers and livestock owners while fostering partnerships with national food companies. By prioritizing agricultural innovation among youth and women, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) aims to transform local agriculture into a technology-driven driver of national growth. The platform will feature a specialized knowledge conference, an international pavilion for policy dialogue, and a farmers' market, all designed to advance the UAE's position as a global hub for smart agricultural technologies and resilient food systems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) significantly expanded its footprint in the Sultanate's food manufacturing sector by signing a share purch...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) significantly expanded its footprint in the Sultanate's food manufacturing sector by signing a share purchase agreement to acquire a controlling interest in the Arabian Food Production Company. Through its subsidiary, Atyab Investments, the group will increase its stake from 33.33% to 66.67% by acquiring the shareholding previously held by Gulf Japan Poultry Farm. This acquisition is a strategic move toward vertical integration within the newly formed Oman Food Capital—the powerhouse created by the merger of Nitaj and Fisheries Development Oman. By securing a majority stake, Oman Flour Mills aims to deepen operational coordination, enhance domestic production capacity, and further stabilize the national food value chain in line with Oman's long-term security objectives.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM)

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in the Al Buraimi Governorate announced 20 new investment opportunities for ag...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in the Al Buraimi Governorate announced 20 new investment opportunities for agricultural and livestock projects via the "Tatweer" platform. This initiative, covering a total area of 798.3 acres, is a strategic move to localise food investments and achieve long-term food sustainability within the governorate's wilayats. The projects focus on high-demand commodities such as onions, potatoes, and garlic using modern agricultural technologies, as well as the expansion of date palm cultivation and sheep and goat fattening. By offering specialized projects like fodder processing and a dedicated veterinary clinic, the Directorate aims to build a comprehensive and resilient agricultural ecosystem that supports both large-scale investors and small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs).
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources

records.title: The Al-Ahsa Agricultural Development Association, with the strategic support of the National Center for Palms and Dates, signed a landmar...
records.description: The Al-Ahsa Agricultural Development Association, with the strategic support of the National Center for Palms and Dates, signed a landmark agricultural cooperation memorandum with LOTTE International to expand the global footprint of Saudi date products. This partnership focuses on strengthening innovation in value-added production, facilitating knowledge transfer, and developing high-quality processed date products tailored for international retail markets. By leveraging a global distribution network of over 13,000 stores, the initiative seeks to enhance the competitiveness of national products and increase the agricultural sector’s contribution to the Kingdom’s GDP, directly supporting the industrial and food security objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. This collaboration represents a significant step in the national strategy to modernize the date and palm sector, transforming it into a technology-driven industry capable of securing long-term strategic investment partnerships and sustainable global market access.
records.institution: The Al-Ahsa Agricultural Development Association

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, with funding from the Governorate’s Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, with funding from the Governorate’s Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit. The initiative, implemented by the General Corporation for Improved Seed Multiplication, focuses on restoring cotton’s historic role as a vital cash crop to support the national economy and achieve industrial self-sufficiency. By providing high-yield improved seeds and technical guidance, the General Corporation for Improved Seed Multiplication aims to enhance productivity and quality, directly feeding the raw material needs of the Spinning and Textile Corporation. This collaborative effort between regional authorities and the Projects Financing Unit is designed to integrate the agricultural and industrial sectors, create local jobs, and improve the income levels of farming households through sustainable and profitable production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Two specialized training courses concluded in the Ibb Governorate focused on Community Agricultural Extension and Participatory Rapid App...
records.description: Two specialized training courses concluded in the Ibb Governorate focused on Community Agricultural Extension and Participatory Rapid Appraisal (PRA) methodology. Funded by the Agricultural Financing, Projects, and Initiatives Unit, the program successfully qualified 68 researchers and extension workers from eight local cooperative associations. The curriculum was designed to shift agricultural development toward a "bottom-up" approach, enabling cadres to diagnose field problems and develop solutions in direct coordination with local communities. By mastering participatory planning and field data analysis, these trainees are now equipped to align official research with the actual needs of farmers, thereby supporting the governorate's strategic goal of achieving productive self-sufficiency.
records.institution: Ibb Governorate

records.title: The International Agricultural Exhibition (AgriteQ 2026) was launched in Doha at Katara Cultural Village, bringing together over 520 exhi...
records.description: The International Agricultural Exhibition (AgriteQ 2026) was launched in Doha at Katara Cultural Village, bringing together over 520 exhibitors from 41 countries to promote sustainable agriculture and food security. The event highlights Qatar’s commitment to its National Food Security Strategy (2024–2030), focusing on increasing self-sufficiency, expanding local production, and strengthening resilient food systems. It serves as a platform for decision-makers, investors, and farmers to exchange knowledge, showcase advanced agricultural technologies, and build partnerships. Qatar has achieved high self-sufficiency levels in key products such as dairy and poultry and continues to enhance its agricultural competitiveness. The exhibition also features workshops, innovative farming solutions, and a new Sustainable Agricultural Production Award to encourage sustainability and innovation in the sector.
records.institution: Qatar Government

records.title: Officials from the Ministry of Agriculture and the Hodeidah Governorate officially launched the cotton marketing season at the Hodeidah g...
records.description: Officials from the Ministry of Agriculture and the Hodeidah Governorate officially launched the cotton marketing season at the Hodeidah ginning factory. The first batches crop were received from agricultural cooperatives in the Tihama plain, a region historically vital for long-staple cotton production. In coordination with the General Corporation for Textile and Spinning Industry, the initiative aims to revitalize the national textile value chain by providing farmers with a reliable cash crop and prompt payment systems. By focusing on quality control and improved harvesting techniques, the Ministry seeks to reduce dependence on imported fibers and strengthen the "community economy" through self-sufficiency in industrial raw materials.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), will launch a comprehensive Fisheries Resources Survey Project in the Arabian Sea and the Sea of Oman. This scientific expedition is a central pillar of Oman Vision 2040, designed to transition the Sultanate toward evidence-based marine management. Utilizing a specialized research vessel, technical teams will conduct integrated field surveys to estimate fish biomass, map the distribution of target species, and analyze critical oceanographic data such as salinity, dissolved oxygen, and chlorophyll levels. By establishing an integrated national database, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources aims to protect marine biodiversity while identifying sustainable new investment horizons in the fisheries sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources has issued updated ministerial decisions to regulate the import of live birds...
records.description: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources has issued updated ministerial decisions to regulate the import of live birds and their derivatives, aligning with international veterinary and biosecurity standards. Under these new measures, the Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources lifted import bans on consignments originating from Odisha in India, Buenos Aires in Argentina, and several counties in Ireland, following successful epidemiological assessments. Conversely, the Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources imposed new temporary restrictions on imports from Catalonia in Spain, specific regions in the United Kingdom, the Philippines, and Poland to prevent the introduction of transboundary animal diseases. These protocols, which follow the guidelines of the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH), exclude products that have undergone thermal processing, ensuring that Oman's food supply remains secure while maintaining strict animal health safeguards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Oman Investment Authority (OIA)—through its subsidiary Oman Food Capital—finalized a $150 million (OMR 57.7 million) strategic partne...
records.description: The Oman Investment Authority (OIA)—through its subsidiary Oman Food Capital—finalized a $150 million (OMR 57.7 million) strategic partnership with the Brazilian food giant JBS to establish a world-class red meat and poultry production hub. This venture, which marks the largest investment in the Middle East for the world's leading protein producer, focuses on completing an integrated poultry facility in Ibri and revitalizing a beef and mutton processing plant in Thumrait. With a target capacity of 300,000 tons annually, the project aims to transition Oman from a net importer to a regional exporter of "halal" meat within three years, supporting the national food security strategy led by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. This initiative aligns with broader efforts under Oman Vision 2040, including the development of a $4.2 billion agricultural city in Saham and the expansion of strategic grain reserves through the Salalah Mills Company, which recently secured 110,000 tonnes of wheat from Russia to ensure supply stability.
records.institution: The Oman Investment Authority (OIA)

records.title: The Agriculture Sector in Hajja Governorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, launched a...
records.description: The Agriculture Sector in Hajja Governorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, launched a strategic initiative providing interest-free loans to establish veterinary clinics for agricultural associations. Supervised by the General Directorate of Animal Health and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the project aims to decentralize veterinary services by placing a dedicated clinic within every cooperative association across the governorate's districts. This "foundational core" of veterinary infrastructure is designed to provide immediate medical support to livestock owners and farmers, directly enhancing the resilience of the livestock sector. By leveraging the expertise of provincial agricultural staff, the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners are working to ensure that these clinics become sustainable hubs for animal health and productive development in rural communities.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector in Hajja Governorate

records.title: The Al-Wahda Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association recently launched the "The Best of Our Hands" festival in the Al-Wahda Dis...
records.description: The Al-Wahda Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association recently launched the "The Best of Our Hands" festival in the Al-Wahda District to showcase the economic potential of productive families. Organized in coordination with the Agricultural and Fisheries Project and Initiative Financing Unit, the Bonyan Development Foundation, and the General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Projects, the event focuses on completing the local "value chain" by linking agricultural inputs directly to processing, packaging, and consumer markets. By fostering a "community economy," these participating institutions aim to transform society from a model of passive consumption to one of active, sovereign production, effectively reducing the national import bill. The Capital Secretariat and the Ministry of Social Affairs have emphasized that such cooperative frameworks are essential for achieving financial independence and building a resilient national economy rooted in self-reliance and the localization of high-value-added products.
records.institution: The Al-Wahda Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in the South Al Batinah Governorate, in collaboration with the Directorate General...
records.description: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in the South Al Batinah Governorate, in collaboration with the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has signed 11 investment agreements valued at over OMR 750,000 ($1.9 million). These projects, covering 120 acres, aim to modernize the regional food security system by enhancing agricultural production and land utilization. A key feature of this initiative is the inclusion of four small and medium enterprises (SMEs) holding Riyada cards, which underscores a strategic push to empower local entrepreneurs and integrate them into national food supply chains. These agreements align with Oman Vision 2040, focusing on economic diversification, job creation, and sustainable development to reduce reliance on food imports.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with a Yemeni civil-soci...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with a Yemeni civil-society organization to implement the "Seed" initiative in the Socotra Governorate. This project is designed to bolster food security and rural sustainability by providing 150 vulnerable families with essential agricultural inputs and livestock, alongside the installation of domestic biogas production units. Furthermore, the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) will facilitate specialized training for 75 individuals in dairy production and 20 in veterinary care, while equipping a mobile veterinary unit to be operated by the relevant government authority. These efforts are part of a broader humanitarian framework by KSrelief to modernize the agricultural sector in Yemen, directly benefiting 1,050 individuals through integrated livestock support and renewable energy solutions.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) officially launched the Solar (Photovoltaic) Energy Self-Supply Policy, a landmark regulatory framework that allows consumers to generate and store their own renewable electricity. This policy is a core enabler of the Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Efficiency Strategy 2030, which targets a 22% reduction in electricity consumption and a 32% reduction in water use. In a strategic first phase, the policy specifically targets the agricultural sector, as well as owners of ranches and rest houses, providing these high-demand users with a "Zero-Capex" pathway to energy independence through smart solar and battery storage solutions.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture representative in Al-Bayda, in coordination with the local authority of the Mukayras District, launched a sig...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture representative in Al-Bayda, in coordination with the local authority of the Mukayras District, launched a significant seed distribution program to bolster regional food security. The initiative facilitated the distribution of 20 tons of improved potato seeds through the Mukayras Agricultural Cooperative Multipurpose Society, directly targeting 120 farmers across the district's sub-districts. This effort, supported by the Public Company for Potato Seed Production, is part of a broader agricultural advancement strategy in the governorate that has previously included the distribution of seeds for legumes, corn, wheat, and various vegetables. By providing high-quality inputs and technical facilities, the Al-Bayda Agriculture Office aims to expand the cultivation of fertile lands, reduce dependence on imports, and move the region toward sustainable self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.description: The Jazan Honey Exhibition 2026, a cornerstone of the 11th annual Jazan Festival, has set new records for the region’s agricultural and tourism sectors. Held at the cultural center in Al-Edabi Governorate, the event serves as a vital showcase for the biodiversity of Saudi Arabia’s southwest. records.description: The Bahraini Farmers’ Market, a flagship initiative organized by the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in partnership with the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD), serves as a vital platform for strengthening national food security and supporting local producers. Held at the Budaiya Botanical Garden, the market provides a direct link between producers and consumers, featuring over 100 varieties of fresh local vegetables and fruits. By eliminating middlemen, the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture and NIAD help increase farmer incomes while ensuring high-quality, affordable produce for the public. Beyond its commercial impact, the market functions as a developmental hub for sustainable agriculture and entrepreneurship, highlighting the contributions of Bahraini youth and women and aligning with the Kingdom's broader vision for a resilient and competitive agricultural ecosystem.

records.description: The AlUla Honey Season returned for its second annual edition in February 2026, transforming the Al-Manshiyah Farmers’ Market into a hub for agricultural innovation and heritage. Launched by the Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU), the event is a key component of the Khayrat AlUla Seasons, an integrated initiative designed to celebrate the oasis city’s biodiversity and transform its agricultural outputs into sustainable economic value. By empowering local beekeeping families and highlighting the exceptional quality of AlUla’s honey, the RCU is positioning the governorate as a premier destination for "agro-tourism." This strategy directly supports Saudi Vision 2030 by diversifying the local economy and preserving the region's ancient agricultural heritage.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) highlighted Najran as a premier model for Saudi Arabia’s agricultural transform...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) highlighted Najran as a premier model for Saudi Arabia’s agricultural transformation. By fusing traditional expertise with high-tech innovation, the region has successfully mitigated its arid climatic challenges to become a critical pillar of the Kingdom’s domestic food supply. This transformation is underpinned by a massive expansion of greenhouse farming and precision irrigation, ensuring year-round production of high-value crops like tomatoes, citrus fruits, and the region’s renowned "Arabian coffee.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) inaugurated the Al-Hashiya Festival at the Al-Qahwiyan Reserve in the Al-Qaid Center, Hail Region. This festival serves as a strategic platform to showcase the region's agricultural identity, featuring over 32 specialized pavilions. The event highlights Hail's core agricultural outputs, including dates, citrus fruits, and honey, alongside emerging food processing industries. By integrating the Al-Qahwiyan Reserve into the local economic landscape, MEWA aims to stimulate agricultural tourism, support small-scale producers, and promote the sustainable use of natural resources in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially launched "Saqr", an innovative AI-powered smart assistant integrated...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially launched "Saqr", an innovative AI-powered smart assistant integrated into the "Hafidh" digital platform. Named after the falcon (a symbol of sharp vision and precision), Saqr is designed to revolutionize field monitoring and regulatory enforcement. By providing inspectors with real-time, accurate access to the Water Law and its implementing regulations, the tool standardizes legal interpretations across the Kingdom, minimizes procedural errors, and ensures that water resource protection is both data-driven and legally robust.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: Dubai Municipality unveiled the "Blue and Green Spaces Roadmap 2030" at the World Governments Summit, a $1.1 billion (AED 4 billion) stra...
records.description: Dubai Municipality unveiled the "Blue and Green Spaces Roadmap 2030" at the World Governments Summit, a $1.1 billion (AED 4 billion) strategic initiative to transform the emirate into a global leader in urban sustainability. Launched in the presence of the UAE’s top leadership, the roadmap aims to integrate nature directly into the city's infrastructure corridors to enhance the quality of life for residents and visitors. Key targets include planting 1.5 million trees by 2031, developing 120 new parks covering 3 million square meters, and creating 200 integrated sports and recreational spaces. The "blue" aspect of the plan focuses on coastlines, with 15 major projects designed to revitalize waterfronts, introduce three new beach destinations annually, and expand public beach capacity by 150%. By extending beachfront cycling and jogging tracks by 285% and increasing beach amenities by 400%, Dubai Municipality is aligning with the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan to ensure the city remains a resilient, human-centric, and vibrant desert metropolis.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) launched the Solar (Photovoltaic) Energy Self-Supply Policy, a landmark regulatory framework designed to decentralize power generation and accelerate the Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Efficiency Strategy 2030. This policy empowers consumers—specifically starting with the agricultural sector and owners of ranches and rest houses—to install their own solar panels, solar water heaters, and battery storage systems to meet their daily energy needs. By shifting from a purely grid-dependent model to a flexible "self-supply" system, the DoE aims to reduce peak demand on the national grid, lower carbon emissions, and provide significant cost savings for high-consumption rural and agricultural facilities.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) established a strategic partners...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) established a strategic partnership during the World Governments Summit in Dubai to revolutionize rural development and food security. Under this new institutional framework, both organizations will align their financing mechanisms to support sovereign projects within IFAD's global portfolio, focusing on strengthening agricultural value chains and building climate resilience for small-scale farmers. The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development will coordinate its evaluation and approval processes with IFAD to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring that co-financed investments deliver high-impact results in rural economies. By integrating their roles in sustainable development finance, the ADFD and IFAD aim to empower vulnerable communities to adapt to climatic and economic changes while fostering long-term economic growth and food sovereignty.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD)

records.title: The National Agriculture Center (NAC) and the Sharjah Entrepreneurship Center (Sheraa) have launched Agriboost 2026, a six-week sprint-ba...
records.description: The National Agriculture Center (NAC) and the Sharjah Entrepreneurship Center (Sheraa) have launched Agriboost 2026, a six-week sprint-based incubation program designed to accelerate early-stage agri-tech startups in the UAE. This initiative aligns with the national "Plant the Emirates" program and the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment’s sustainability goals. Five seed-stage startups will be selected to undergo an intensive curriculum focused on solution validation, customer discovery, and go-to-market execution. Each participating startup receives support valued at AED 15,000, alongside access to Sheraa’s co-working spaces, discounted business licensing, and a global network of mentors and investors.
records.institution: The National Agriculture Center (NAC)

records.title: The Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit of the local authority in Taiz concluded a four-day training workshop designed t...
records.description: The Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit of the local authority in Taiz concluded a four-day training workshop designed to modernize the governorate's agricultural sector. The program focused on building technical and institutional capacities for 39 directors of agriculture branches and extension units across several model districts, including Khadir, Maqbanah, Mawiyah, Al-Ta'iziyah, and Al-Silu. By equipping extension personnel with modern expertise, the General Administration for Extension Programs and Activities aims to unify extension efforts and promote the adoption of low-cost, high-productivity farming methods. This strategic investment in human capital is a key pillar of the Taiz Economic and Social Development Plan (2024–2026), which seeks to achieve food self-sufficiency, reduce the national import bill, and transition the region toward a resilient, sustainable agricultural economy.
records.institution: The General Administration for Extension

records.title: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund financed 13 key projects in 2025 with a total investment of OMR2.4 million, targeting the...
records.description: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund financed 13 key projects in 2025 with a total investment of OMR2.4 million, targeting the agricultural, fisheries, and water resources sectors. According to Executive Director Hanan Said Al Sulaimi, this initiative is part of a broader five-year strategy that has seen the Fund invest over OMR10.6 million across 64 developmental projects. By focusing on aquaculture, value chain improvement, and sustainable innovation, the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund serves as a strategic driver for Oman Vision 2040, specifically supporting economic diversification, environmental protection, and food security. In close integration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, these investments aim to enhance local production and modernize the national food security ecosystem.
records.institution: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development

records.title: The European School of Management and Technology (ESMT) Berlin, through its DEEP - Institute for Deep Tech Innovation, has partnered with...
records.description: The European School of Management and Technology (ESMT) Berlin, through its DEEP - Institute for Deep Tech Innovation, has partnered with the Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) and the Qatar Research, Development, and Innovation Council (QRDI) to launch DEEP Qatar, a new university-affiliated innovation hub in Doha. This initiative aims to bridge the German and Qatari ecosystems by focusing on deep technology transfer and entrepreneurship through three main pillars: the Creative Destruction Lab (CDL-Doha), the DEEP Academy, and DEEP Pioneers. Supported by over $1 billion in venture capital funding from the Qatar Investment Authority (QIA), the hub will offer specialized tracks in artificial intelligence, health, agriculture, and food technology, providing mentorship and training to scientists and researchers. By aligning with the Qatar Research, Development, and Innovation Council (QRDI) national strategy, the partnership seeks to accelerate the commercialization of scientific research and position Qatar as a global leader in high-impact technology sectors.
records.institution: The Qatar Investment Authority (QIA)

records.description: Indian construction conglomerate Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has contracted Nextpower Arabia, a joint venture between Nextpower and Abunayyan Holding, to supply 2.25 gigawatts of advanced solar tracking systems for the Bisha Solar project in Saudi Arabia's Asir Province. Developed by a consortium led by ACWA Power and procured by the Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC), this initiative is the largest of Wave 6 under the National Renewable Energy Program overseen by the Ministry of Energy. The project marks the first major order for the newly operational Nextpower Arabia, which aims to enhance efficiency and reduce shipping costs by localizing manufacturing and supply chain capabilities.
records.institution: The Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC)

records.title: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) and the National Agricultural Development Company (NADEC) have established a l...
records.description: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) and the National Agricultural Development Company (NADEC) have established a long-term strategic partnership to bridge the gap between advanced scientific research and large-scale agricultural operations. By signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), both institutions aim to transform theoretical scientific outputs into field-ready applications that address Saudi Arabia’s unique environmental challenges, such as water scarcity and rising temperatures. This collaboration grants KAUST researchers access to NADEC's operational data and field sites, allowing for the real-world testing and scaling of innovations through the KAUST Center of Excellence for Sustainable Food Security.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: The Ministry of Energy of Saudi Arabia and the Turkish Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources finalized a landmark agreement to invest...
records.description: The Ministry of Energy of Saudi Arabia and the Turkish Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources finalized a landmark agreement to invest $2 billion in two massive solar farms. This project, signed during Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's official visit to Riyadh, marks the first phase of a broader 5,000 MW renewable energy framework designed to deepen economic ties and support Turkey's ambitious energy transition. The two solar plants—one located in the central province of Karaman and the other in the eastern province of Sivas—will have a combined capacity of 2,000 MW. Together, they are expected to supply clean electricity to approximately 2.1 million Turkish households.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic initiative to modernize rainfed crop product...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic initiative to modernize rainfed crop production across the Makkah, Al-Baha, Aseer, and Jazan regions. By distributing 729 modern devices, including 200 tillage machines and 529 specialized attachments, the program aims to enhance production efficiency and reduce operational costs for local farmers. According to Saudi Reef, this technical support is paired with comprehensive training and guidance to ensure the safe and sustainable use of the equipment, ultimately minimizing waste and labor effort while adhering to rigorous quality and safety standards.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: The Codex Alimentarius Commission (Codex) has officially approved a proposal by the United Arab Emirates to develop the first internation...
records.description: The Codex Alimentarius Commission (Codex) has officially approved a proposal by the United Arab Emirates to develop the first international standard for pasteurized camel milk. Announced during the Commission’s 48th session in Rome, this milestone aims to harmonize global quality criteria, safeguard consumers against fraudulent practices—such as the adulteration of camel milk with bovine powder—and facilitate fair international trade. With the global camel milk market projected to reach $1.934 billion by 2033, and the United Arab Emirates already producing over 7,000 tonnes annually for export to the EU, China, and the US, this standard is expected to significantly boost market confidence. The National Codex Committee emphasized that this initiative not only supports local production chains but also reinforces the nation's leadership in shaping the global food safety ecosystem and sustainable development goals.
records.institution: The Codex Alimentarius Commission (Codex)

records.title: The NRTC Group has officially launched Mazraati, a "farm-to-fork" digital platform designed to integrate and modernize the UAE’s agri-foo...
records.description: The NRTC Group has officially launched Mazraati, a "farm-to-fork" digital platform designed to integrate and modernize the UAE’s agri-food supply chain. Unveiled at Gulfood Green 2026 and digitally supported by Etheral IT Solutions LLC, the platform connects growers, logistics providers, and buyers through a unified system utilizing AI-supported quality grading, real-time logistics tracking, and QR-based traceability. By digitizing every stage of the journey—from harvest and temperature-controlled transport to pack house intake—the NRTC Group aims to eliminate fragmented workflows, reduce food waste, and provide farmers with data-driven insights into market demand. This structural shift is intended to expand the local sourcing network to over 260 farmers by 2027, with plans to increase deliveries of locally grown produce, such as lettuce and tomatoes, from 20,000 tons to over 100,000 tons within three years.
records.institution: The NRTC Group

records.title: The Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority (EPAA) concluded the 25th edition of the Sharjah International Forum for Arabian Bi...
records.description: The Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority (EPAA) concluded the 25th edition of the Sharjah International Forum for Arabian Biodiversity (SICFAB), held at Sharjah Safari to address critical environmental and conservation challenges in the Arabian Peninsula. Bringing together 180 experts, the forum focused on the rehabilitation of seabirds, diagnostic techniques for wildlife mortality, and the management of invasive species. Sessions led by international specialists highlighted that human activities, such as fishing, significantly impact avian health, while workshops on IUCN Red List assessments and EICAT methodologies provided scientific frameworks for prioritizing protected areas. Furthermore, the Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority (EPAA) emphasized the severe economic and ecological threats posed by invasive species like the red palm weevil and invasive ants, calling for unified regional databases and enhanced cooperation to protect the region's natural heritage and support sustainable development goals.
records.institution: The Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority (EPAA)

records.title: The Tabuk Agricultural Development Company has finalized a strategic 10-year investment contract with Ruwad Alsinaa Waltatweer Company to...
records.description: The Tabuk Agricultural Development Company has finalized a strategic 10-year investment contract with Ruwad Alsinaa Waltatweer Company to lease its grape orchards, a move designed to stabilize cash flow and reverse a decade of financial losses. Valued at SAR 23.3 million (approximately US$6.2 million), the agreement shifts all operating costs to the investor in exchange for fixed rental income. This transition is critical for the company, as its grape segment has accumulated losses exceeding SAR 57 million over the last ten years. By converting these underperforming agricultural assets into a predictable revenue stream, the Tabuk Agricultural Development Company aims to improve the book value of its orchards and enhance its overall financial performance indicators on the Tadawul stock exchange.
records.institution: The Tabuk Agricultural Development Company

records.title: The UAE has finalized a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), marking a strate...
records.description: The UAE has finalized a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), marking a strategic expansion of its trade network into Central and Eastern Africa. Signed in Abu Dhabi by President Sheikh Mohamed and President Felix Tshisekedi, the deal aims to eliminate trade barriers and reduce tariffs to stimulate investment in critical sectors like mining, agriculture, and clean energy. Given the DRC's status as a top global producer of cobalt—a vital component for the electric vehicle and energy transition industries—the partnership is a cornerstone of the UAE's strategy to secure essential minerals while boosting its non-oil foreign trade toward a target of $1.1 trillion by 2031.
records.institution: The UAE Government

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture recently conducted a specialized training course in Sana’a to enhance the technical proficiency of plant prod...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture recently conducted a specialized training course in Sana’a to enhance the technical proficiency of plant production and planning personnel. The program focused on qualifying ten participants in the precise mechanism for completing forms related to agricultural crop policies, ensuring accurate data collection and analysis. records.description: The Ministry of Municipality has announced the launch of the thirteenth edition of the International Agricultural Exhibition in Qatar, known as AgriteQ 2026, which serves as a premier regional and international platform for agriculture, food production, and sustainability. Spanning an area of more than 40,000 square meters at the Katara Cultural Village, the exhibition brings together government sectors, private entities, and international experts to showcase an advanced agricultural system built on innovation. The event coincides with the third phase of the National Food Security Strategy 2024–2030 and supports the goals of the Qatar National Vision 2030 by employing the latest agricultural technologies to enhance self-sufficiency. In addition to technical displays, the Ministry of Municipality has curated an integrated program featuring specialized markets for honey, dates, and flowers, alongside interactive workshops and live demonstrations designed to highlight the strategic importance of national food production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.description: A consortium comprising Etihad Water and Electricity (EtihadWE), Taqa Water Solutions, and Saur International has secured a landmark contract to develop Ras Al Khaimah’s largest wastewater treatment plant. Marking the emirate's first-ever Public-Private Partnership (PPP), the project will be delivered via a Build–Own–Operate–Transfer (BOOT) model in collaboration with the Ras Al Khaimah Public Services Department. The plant will feature a capacity of 60,000 cubic meters per day, serving a population of 300,000 and enabling the reuse of 100% of recycled water for irrigation and cooling. This strategic infrastructure expansion aligns with the UAE Net Zero 2050 Strategy and reinforces Ras Al Khaimah's vision for sustainable urban growth, environmental stewardship, and long-term economic resilience.
records.institution: Etihad Water and Electricity (EtihadWE)

records.description: The National Agriculture Centre has launched the Sustainable Product initiative to increase the share of locally sourced agricultural and animal products in the UAE’s restaurant and hotel sector to 25%. This strategic shift by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment focuses on strengthening market demand and providing Emirati farmers with the economic confidence to expand investments, effectively bridging the marketing gap. By connecting national farm output with the luxury hospitality sector, the National Agriculture Centre aims to reduce reliance on food imports and foster a climate-smart agricultural ecosystem that utilizes advanced technology and innovation to ensure long-term food security.
records.institution: The National Agriculture Centre

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its fisheries sector leadership, has initiated a new regulatory framework at the Al-Rahedah border crossing to tighten oversight on the entry of fishery inputs and products. During a coordination meeting with the Red Sea Fisheries Authority and the Customs Authority, officials established procedures for permanent fisheries representation at the crossing to ensure all imports comply with national laws and health standards. The collaboration focuses on defining a specific list of authorized inputs and identifying products subject to customs duties to protect local production and prevent the entry of substandard materials. By synchronizing efforts between the Red Sea Fisheries Authority and the Customs Authority, the government aims to preserve marine resources and strengthen the national economy through more disciplined trade movement.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Experimental Farm Project in Al-Lith Governorate is a 10-hectare applied research hub designed to spearhead the modernization of the...
records.description: The Experimental Farm Project in Al-Lith Governorate is a 10-hectare applied research hub designed to spearhead the modernization of the Kingdom’s agricultural sector. Built to address the specific challenges of water scarcity, the project utilizes smart irrigation systems and intelligent control platforms to maximize resource efficiency across both open fields and advanced greenhouses. By serving as a high-tech testing ground for localized agricultural knowledge, the farm not only strengthens regional food supply chains but also functions as a strategic investment model. This initiative aligns with national sustainable development goals by demonstrating how modern technology can transform challenging environments into productive, attractive opportunities for agricultural investment.
records.institution: The Experimental Farm Project in Al-Lith Governorate

records.title: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has officially moved into the enforcement phase of new licensing regulations...
records.description: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has officially moved into the enforcement phase of new licensing regulations designed to standardize and professionalize water conservation services across Saudi Arabia. Targeting the urban, agricultural, and industrial sectors, this regulatory framework establishes clear responsibilities for service providers and practitioners while introducing rigorous oversight mechanisms to protect beneficiaries. By formalizing activities such as water auditing, leak detection, and specialized renovation management, MAEE is creating a structured market for water-saving solutions. This move is a strategic step toward achieving the sustainability goals of Saudi Vision 2030, ensuring that water resource management adheres to high-quality technical standards and verified saving protocols.
records.institution: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE)

records.title: On the sidelines of Gulfood 2026, the UAE Food Cluster, in collaboration with DMCC, convened a high-level summit to solidify the UAE–Indi...
records.description: On the sidelines of Gulfood 2026, the UAE Food Cluster, in collaboration with DMCC, convened a high-level summit to solidify the UAE–India strategic partnership, with India serving as the event's Country Partner. Led by officials from the Indian Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) and the Consulate General of India, the dialogue focused on integrating India's massive agricultural production with the UAE's world-class logistics and re-export infrastructure. A centerpiece of the engagement was the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the UAE Food Cluster and DMCC, aimed at leveraging specialized commodity exchanges and harmonizing regulatory standards. This collaboration seeks to position both nations as a unified global food hub, building on a bilateral trade relationship that surpassed US$ 100 billion in 2025.
records.institution: The UAE Food Cluster and DMCC

records.title: The Ibb Governorate has launched a series of community-led water harvesting initiatives to address water scarcity and boost agricultural...
records.description: The Ibb Governorate has launched a series of community-led water harvesting initiatives to address water scarcity and boost agricultural productivity in the Yarim and al-Radmah districts. These projects, inaugurated by the local administration, center on the construction of 300 water cisterns and the rehabilitation of several existing dams. Additionally, a new water barrier project was launched in al-Radmah to maximize the capture of seasonal rainfall. By leveraging community participation, the Ibb Governorate aims to create a more resilient and sustainable water infrastructure, ensuring a reliable resource for local farmers and supporting long-term food security in the region.
records.institution: The Ibb Governorate

records.description: In a significant move to localize heavy industry within the national green hydrogen ecosystem, Meranti Green Steel has secured full binding offtake agreements for the entire output of its planned hydrogen-ready Hot Briquetted Iron facility at the Duqm Special Economic Zone. These long-term contracts with global industrial traders and steel producers—including Thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, INTERFER, and Glencore—bolster the project’s commercial bankability as it moves toward a final investment decision. The facility is designed to leverage a blend of natural gas and green hydrogen to produce low-carbon iron feedstock tailored for international markets, utilizing a strategic partnership with the Amnah consortium for its future hydrogen requirements. Supported by KfW IPEX-Bank and Jebsen & Jessen Industrial Solutions, the initiative capitalizes on competitive energy costs and a supportive regulatory environment to position the Duqm Special Economic Zone as a hub for cost-competitive, sustainable industrial production.

records.description: The National Water Company (NWC) has successfully planted over 2.1 million trees in the Madinah Region, marking a significant milestone in its contribution to the Saudi Green Initiative. By utilizing tertiary-treated wastewater from its treatment plants, the company is transforming a byproduct into a vital resource to expand vegetation cover and combat desertification. In 2025, the project accelerated with the planting of 472,000 additional trees, and the National Water Company (NWC) confirmed that approximately 200,000 trees have already reached maturity, allowing them to thrive independently. This effort, conducted in partnership with the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, aims to improve air quality, reduce emissions, and support local biodiversity while optimizing the Kingdom's water resources for sustainable urban and rural development.
records.institution: The National Water Company (NWC)

records.title: The high-level preparatory meeting for the United Nations Water Conference 2026 concluded in Dakar, serving as a critical milestone for t...
records.description: The high-level preparatory meeting for the United Nations Water Conference 2026 concluded in Dakar, serving as a critical milestone for the global summit to be hosted by the United Arab Emirates in Abu Dhabi later this year. In collaboration with the Republic of Senegal, the session focused on accelerating progress toward Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6), particularly through six newly endorsed interactive dialogues: Water for people, prosperity, planet Earth, cooperation, multilateral processes, and investment. A key highlight of the deliberations was the intrinsic link between water and food security, noting that agriculture accounts for 70% of global freshwater usage. Led by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the UAE delegation emphasized the need for "tangible impact" and targeted investments to reshape the international framework for water management, ensuring that the upcoming conference translates global solidarity into practical, sustainable initiatives for communities worldwide.
records.institution: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs

records.title: The Ministerial Council of the Middle East Green Initiative (MGI) convened its second session in Jeddah to finalize the transition into i...
records.description: The Ministerial Council of the Middle East Green Initiative (MGI) convened its second session in Jeddah to finalize the transition into its implementation phase, marked by the formal establishment of its permanent Secretariat in Riyadh. Chaired by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the meeting welcomed Ghana, Sierra Leone, Sri Lanka, and Syria as new members, bringing the total tree-planting commitments to over 22 billion. This regional effort is mirrored by the Saudi Green Initiative (SGI), which has already seen 151 million trees planted and natural reserves expanded to cover 18% of the Kingdom's land. With a long-term goal to rehabilitate 40 million hectares and achieve 30% reserve coverage by 2030, the council emphasized that unified regional action is essential for land restoration and securing environmental sustainability for future generations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed a USD 10 million grant agreement with the UNHCR and the Republic of Sudan to rehabilitate...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed a USD 10 million grant agreement with the UNHCR and the Republic of Sudan to rehabilitate and expand critical water supply systems. This strategic initiative focuses on improving the Nile water system in Khartoum by integrating solar-powered operations and enhancing technical capacity to ensure long-term sustainability. The project is designed to address acute water scarcity and provide equitable access to clean water for both displaced populations and their host communities. By strengthening local infrastructure, the Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) aims to mitigate the risk of waterborne diseases, bolster community health, and reduce the daily hardships faced by vulnerable families affected by conflict.
records.institution: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has announced that the development of the Raysut fishing port in Salalah is 81...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has announced that the development of the Raysut fishing port in Salalah is 81% complete, with full operations expected by the first quarter of 2026. This OMR 3 million investment is designed to modernize the infrastructure for local fishermen, featuring a new 610-meter breakwater and a 60-meter fixed wharf. To ensure long-term viability, the project includes a 250-meter rock groyne to prevent siltation and the deepening of 100,000 cubic meters of sand within the basin. These upgrades, overseen by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, are part of a broader strategic matrix aimed at enhancing maritime productivity across Dhofar, with future ports planned for Mirbat, Sadah, Rakhyut, and Al Shuwaymiyah.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.description: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ) has signed landmark usufruct agreements with Mawarid Turbine to establish Oman's first wind turbine manufacturing and assembly plant in the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD). With an initial investment of RO 70 million ($182 million) for its first phase, the plant is designed to localise the renewable energy value chain and build a national industrial base for the energy transition. The facility will have an annual production capacity of 800 to 1,000 MW, focusing initially on the manufacturing of turbine blades and specialized components. Strategically located near the Port of Duqm to facilitate global exports, the project aligns with Oman Vision 2040 and SEZAD’s 2030 strategy to become a premier regional hub for green industries.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ)

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman, represented by the OPEX supervisory team, is showcasing a unified national front at Gulfood 2026 to attract high-v...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman, represented by the OPEX supervisory team, is showcasing a unified national front at Gulfood 2026 to attract high-value investments into its food and beverage sector. Through a collaborative pavilion featuring the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, and Madayn, Oman is highlighting strategic opportunities in its free zones and industrial cities, including the newly announced Al Suwaiq Industrial City. A central focus of the participation is the "Second Billion" initiative, which aims to more than double the sector's economic contribution and increase self-sufficiency rates. By leveraging its strategic location and integrated logistics infrastructure, the Sultanate aims to substitute food imports with domestic manufacturing, localize advanced food technologies, and expand the global reach of the "Omani Product" brand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: At Gulfood 2026, Al Ghurair Foods announced a major strategic pivot toward value-added ingredients, highlighted by the launch of its new...
records.description: At Gulfood 2026, Al Ghurair Foods announced a major strategic pivot toward value-added ingredients, highlighted by the launch of its new brand, PURL, and a US$20 million investment in a new meat coating systems plant. This facility, capable of processing 60,000 tons annually, will deliver halal-certified solutions for the snacks and protein sectors with significantly reduced lead times. Complementing this is a US$130 million non-GMO corn milling facility in KEZAD, which forms the backbone of a strategy to reduce import reliance by producing infant-grade maltodextrin, native starches, and specialty flours. By integrating these advanced manufacturing capabilities with its existing 1.5 million-ton flour production capacity, Al Ghurair Foods aims to strengthen local supply chains and expand its reach into high-growth markets across Southeast Asia and North Africa.
records.institution: Al Ghurair Foods

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has completed a three-year research program evaluati...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has completed a three-year research program evaluating seasonal forage alternatives to replace perennial crops, which are being phased out by the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture to preserve groundwater. Working across key regions like Al-Jouf and Tabuk, Estidamah identified seven high-performing plant varieties that consume significantly less water than traditional perennials—which use up to 32,000 cubic meters per hectare. These seasonal winter forages achieve productivity rates of 8–15 tons per hectare while reducing water consumption by 50% and enhancing soil fertility. This transition is a critical component of Saudi Vision 2030, ensuring a sustainable local feed supply while protecting the Kingdom's non-renewable water resources.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic initiative to modernize Saudi Arabia's beeke...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic initiative to modernize Saudi Arabia's beekeeping sector by providing 1,800 equipment packages to beekeepers across the Kingdom. This project, which aligns with Saudi Vision 2030, focuses on transitioning from traditional methods to sustainable, technology-driven practices that optimize resource use and improve honey quality. By integrating modern hive management tools, the Saudi Reef program aims to reduce colony stress and minimize losses, while complementing the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s efforts to establish queen bee breeding stations. These combined actions are designed to enhance the genetic traits of local bee populations and strengthen the market competitiveness of Saudi honey through improved safety and production efficiency.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: Dubai Municipality has launched the third edition of the Hatta Farming Festival at Hatta Leem Lake, a cornerstone of the "Dubai Farms" pr...
records.description: Dubai Municipality has launched the third edition of the Hatta Farming Festival at Hatta Leem Lake, a cornerstone of the "Dubai Farms" program aimed at elevating Hatta as a premier destination for agri-tourism and eco-tourism. Under the supervision of the Supreme Committee to Oversee the Development of Hatta, the festival brings together Emirati farmers, local agricultural companies, and, for the first time, specialized programs to empower People of Determination. To bolster sustainable local production, Dubai Municipality has committed AED 3.7 million in support packages, which include the distribution of over 24,000 bags of fertilizer and 5,100 bags of seeds. Running until 1st February 2026, the event features livestock beauty contests, workshops, and market platforms designed to strengthen Dubai’s food security while empowering the next generation of farmers through modern technology and expert advisory services.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.title: The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) has officially endorsed a scientific twinning programme between the Abu Dhabi Agriculture...
records.description: The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) has officially endorsed a scientific twinning programme between the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) and the State Central Veterinary Laboratory (SCVL) of Mongolia. This three-year partnership (2025–2028) positions Abu Dhabi as a global reference hub, tasked with qualifying Mongolia’s laboratory as a regional reference center for camel diseases in Central Asia. The initiative focuses on a comprehensive "One Health" approach, providing Mongolia with advanced technical training in viral isolation, biobank management, and diagnostic reagent production. By aligning with international ISO standards, the programme strengthens global biosecurity and enhances the early detection of zoonotic threats, such as MERS-CoV and Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), across both Dromedary and Bactrian camel populations.
records.institution: The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Oman is advancing a comprehensive zero-carbon strategy rooted in Oman Vision 2040, achieving a global ranking of 55th on the Environmenta...
records.description: Oman is advancing a comprehensive zero-carbon strategy rooted in Oman Vision 2040, achieving a global ranking of 55th on the Environmental Performance Index. Led by the Environment Authority, the Sultanate has implemented 589 environmental projects over the last five years, including the "Blue Carbon" initiative, which aims to plant 100 million mangrove trees to sequester 14 million tonnes of carbon dioxide. Beyond reforestation, the Ministry of Economy highlights a robust legislative framework that has achieved a 99.2% response rate to pollution reports and an 82% compliance rate with environmental penalties. These efforts are complemented by the "Rozna" system for sustainable building certification and innovative waste management programs that convert green waste into fertilizer and recycle construction debris, ensuring a balanced approach to biodiversity protection and carbon neutrality
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy
