records.title: The Ministerial Council of the Middle East Green Initiative is convening its second session in Jeddah to transition from its foundational...
records.description: The Ministerial Council of the Middle East Green Initiative is convening its second session in Jeddah to transition from its foundational stage to a decisive implementation phase. Bringing together representatives from 31 member states across Asia and Africa, the council is focused on activating flagship projects aimed at planting 50 billion trees and rehabilitating 200 million hectares of degraded land. These efforts, supported by a General Secretariat based in Riyadh, seek to reduce global carbon dioxide emissions by 10% while significantly improving air quality and biodiversity protection. The session reinforces a collective regional commitment to climate mitigation and land restoration, backed by long-term operational support and a dedicated governance framework under the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has achieved a major milestone in global food safety by officially joining the Joint FAO/WHO Exp...
records.description: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has achieved a major milestone in global food safety by officially joining the Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives (JECFA). The appointment of an SFDA expert to the committee’s Roster of Experts highlights the Kingdom's growing scientific influence and professional capacity in risk assessment. This committee is responsible for setting critical international health guidelines, such as Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI) and Tolerable Daily Intake (TDI), which serve as the scientific backbone for the Codex Alimentarius Commission. By participating in the JECFA, the SFDA will play a proactive role in shaping global food policies, aligning national safety frameworks with international best practices, and advancing the strategic objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 to protect public health through science-based regulation.
records.institution: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.title: At Gulfood 2026, the Mahsool national agri-food initiative signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with NRTC (Nassar Al Rifai...
records.description: At Gulfood 2026, the Mahsool national agri-food initiative signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with NRTC (Nassar Al Rifai Trading Company) to scale domestic food production and solidify the UAE's food security. Endorsed by His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the partnership combines Mahsool’s technology-driven farming platform with NRTC’s commercial distribution network and ESG Agro’s operational expertise. The collaboration currently manages 100 high-tech, climate-controlled greenhouses with a roadmap to reach 400 farms within five years. By 2026, the initiative is projected to produce 20,000 tonnes of high-quality, pesticide-free crops—including cherry tomatoes, capsicum, and eggplant—supported by a state-of-the-art packhouse capable of handling 300 tonnes per day, significantly reducing the nation's reliance on food imports.
records.institution: The Mahsool, NRTC (Nassar Al Rifai Trading Company)

records.description: Expo Centre Sharjah is launching the third edition of the Al Dhaid Agriculture Exhibition, a premier specialized event dedicated to advancing sustainable farming and food security in the UAE. Organized with the support of the Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Livestock, the exhibition unites over 40 leading companies to showcase innovations in hydroponics, vertical farming, smart irrigation, and livestock management. By bringing together policymakers, industry experts, and farmers, the event serves as a vital hub for addressing climate challenges and water efficiency while providing access to modern machinery and pest control solutions. The program further supports the UAE National Food Security Strategy 2051 through interactive workshops focused on high-yield, climate-resilient crops and efficient supply chain management.
records.institution: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Livestock

records.description: Sharjah Cooperative, in partnership with the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), has officially launched the 6th Farmers’ Forum at Rahmania Mall. Running under the slogan “Our roots are the foundation of our future,” the event serves as a strategic community platform to strengthen the national food security ecosystem and support local producers. The forum features 25 dedicated booths showcasing Emirati organic products, honey, and fresh produce, alongside a "Shop and Win" initiative to incentivize the purchase of national goods. By integrating interactive workshops for children and a dedicated section for productive families, the Sharjah Cooperative aims to foster a culture of sustainable agriculture and community resilience, aligning with the Year of the Family objectives and the long-term vision of Sharjah's leadership to build a self-sufficient, sustainable food system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources has officially launched eight new environmental industry activities, establishing a structured industrial pathway to promote investment and sustainability. Supported by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs and Housing, and the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN), this initiative allows companies to obtain specialized licenses via the Senaa’i platform. These newly regulated activities focus on the recycling and reuse of municipal, industrial, and hazardous waste, alongside the production of organic fertilizers and the conversion of waste into alternative fuels or electricity. By integrating waste classification and primary sorting into industrial value chains, the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources aims to improve resource efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and solidify the Kingdom's position as a leader in the circular economy.

records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has signed memoranda of understanding with eight non-profit environmental associations to accelerate national targets for ecological restoration and sustainability. This strategic partnership—including organizations such as the Hail Agriculture Development Association and the Yanbu Environmental Association—aims to decentralize environmental efforts by integrating volunteer and community-led initiatives into the national framework. The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) will collaborate with these non-profits on large-scale afforestation, the rehabilitation of degraded lands, and the development of nature-based tourism destinations. By facilitating expertise exchange and technical training, this initiative seeks to build local capacities and foster a culture of environmental stewardship across the Kingdom, directly supporting Saudi Arabia's long-term sustainability and climate resilience goals.

records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), through its subsidiary Moro Hub, has announced that construction on Phase I of its 100MW solar-powered Green Data Centre in Warsan is set to begin later this year. Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is collaborating with international engineering consultancies to ensure the center meets global standards for energy efficiency, cooling, and advanced cloud-hosting solutions. records.description: In the Qassim Region, hydroponic farming has evolved from an innovative alternative to a cornerstone of the provincial agricultural economy. This technological surge is primarily driven by the need to mitigate groundwater depletion—which has historically fallen by nearly 0.6 meters per year—by utilizing systems that consume up to 90% less water than traditional open-field irrigation.

records.description: The fifth edition of the Saudi International Marine Exhibition (SIMEC) has launched in Riyadh, serving as a premier global platform for the fisheries, aquaculture, and maritime service sectors. Featuring participants from more than 30 countries and over 120 local and international companies, the exhibition showcases cutting-edge innovations in seafood processing, shipbuilding, and algae production while facilitating strategic cooperation between global investors. With thousands of business leaders and visitors in attendance, the Saudi International Marine Exhibition (SIMEC) highlights critical investment opportunities and addresses global challenges related to food security and environmental sustainability. The event is set to host the signing of numerous cooperation agreements, reinforcing the Kingdom's role as a vital hub for international trade and the sustainable development of marine resources.

records.description: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) recently hosted an international Codex Alimentarius workshop in Riyadh, bringing together global leaders from the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the World Health Organization (WHO) to shape the future of global food safety. Under the theme “One Codex: Together We Learn, Together We Lead,” the event focused on the strategic roadmap for 2026–2031, with a particular emphasis on integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) to modernize food standard operations. By facilitating inter-regional coordination and developing new mechanisms for implementing safety texts, the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) underscored Saudi Arabia's growing influence in international food governance. records.institution: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.title: The Environment Authority in Musandam is implementing a comprehensive suite of conservation programs to protect the region's unique marin...
records.description: The Environment Authority in Musandam is implementing a comprehensive suite of conservation programs to protect the region's unique marine and terrestrial biodiversity, including coral reefs, dolphins, and turtles. To address challenges such as overfishing and oil pollution, the Environment Authority utilizes modern monitoring technologies and field patrols while enforcing strict environmental regulations. Key initiatives currently underway include the “Tharwa” coral reef rehabilitation project, mangrove planting in Dibba, and the conservation of wildlife within the Musandam Governorate National Natural Park Reserve. These efforts by the Environment Authority are designed to balance tourism with environmental protection, ensuring long-term sustainability through scientific research, community awareness, and active habitat restoration.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is spearheading the construction of two major fishing harbours in Hasik and Hadbeen at a total cost of RO5.8mn. Currently, the Hadbeen project has reached 50% completion while Hasik stands at 34%, with both sites involving the installation of breakwaters, floating pontoons, and modern lighting systems. These projects are part of a strategic infrastructure plan managed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to modernize marine resource utilization and support sustainable investment in the Dhofar region. By facilitating higher landing volumes and providing integrated marketing and maintenance services, these harbours are designed to enhance the fisheries sector’s contribution to the national economy and create new growth opportunities for coastal communities.

records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic project to modernize the traditional fishing sector by equipping small-scale boats with high-efficiency marine engines and satellite distress beacons. Implemented across the Makkah, Madinah, Tabuk, Aseer, Jazan, and Eastern regions, the initiative distributed 450 engines and 1,000 emergency devices to enhance maritime safety and operational efficiency. By upgrading the infrastructure of local fish supply chains and ensuring compliance with global safety standards, Saudi Reef aims to protect the lives of fishermen and reduce material losses while boosting the sector's economic viability. This project aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 by promoting the optimal use of state resources and transforming traditional fishing into a more sustainable and attractive source of income.

records.title: The Tadweer Group has partnered with the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR) to launch "Waste-to-Value," a stra...
records.description: The Tadweer Group has partnered with the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR) to launch "Waste-to-Value," a strategic initiative consisting of academic-industry workshops designed to solve critical challenges in the waste management sector. Held during the World Future Energy Summit, the inaugural workshop focused on the recovery of green waste, seeking technically and financially viable ways to transform agricultural byproducts into high-value market products. Through this collaboration, the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR) facilitates the integration of university research with national sustainability priorities, matching academic experts with real-world operational data provided by the Tadweer Group. This partnership aims to enhance waste segregation and feedstock quality, ultimately providing tangible benefits for farmers and supporting the UAE’s transition toward a circular economy and a more resilient future.
records.institution: The Tadweer Group

records.description: The Zayed International Foundation for the Environment, in partnership with the Dubai Police Academy and Curtin University Dubai, successfully hosted the 1st International Conference on Green AI to explore how advanced technology can address urgent environmental challenges. Held under the theme "Harnessing AI Applications for Environmental Sustainability," the event gathered global experts to discuss AI’s role in climate resilience, emission reduction, and the management of water and energy resources. Key focus areas included smart environmental governance, biodiversity protection, and the development of sustainable cities through innovative digital solutions like air quality monitoring and natural risk forecasting. By integrating a specialized exhibition of green technologies with high-level policy discussions, the Zayed International Foundation for the Environment aimed to align technological progress with the national vision for sustainable development and environmental security.

records.description: The Al-Taiziyah Agricultural Cooperative Association has inaugurated a new water reservoir project in al-Zawaqir to bolster local agricultural productivity through improved rainwater harvesting. Funded by the local Zakat Authority, the initiative is designed to store seasonal rainfall for irrigation, providing a sustainable water source for farmers in the district. During the launch, representatives highlighted the project as a key component of a broader economic strategy to develop the region's agricultural sector and emphasized the importance of community-led management to ensure the reservoir's long-term effectiveness. By reducing reliance on scarce groundwater, the Al-Taiziyah Agricultural Cooperative Association aims to enhance food security and support the livelihoods of rural families in the province.
records.institution: The Al-Taiziyah Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organi...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), held a national workshop focused on ecosystem monitoring and field verification for land rehabilitation. This initiative is a central component of the National Greening Program, which aims to rehabilitate 40 million hectares of degraded land and plant 10 billion trees in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. By integrating scientific assessment with on-the-ground implementation, the program seeks to enhance environmental security and maximize economic returns through a sustainable green economy. The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification emphasized that precise field verification ensures the efficiency of these interventions, while the FAO reaffirmed its commitment to providing international recognition and technical support for the Kingdom's extensive restoration efforts.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.title: Sultan Qaboos University (SQU), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has achieved a scientif...
records.description: Sultan Qaboos University (SQU), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has achieved a scientific milestone by producing spirulina algae in commercial quantities for the first time. Funded by the Agriculture and Fisheries Development Fund (AFDF), the research project focused on cultivating strains specifically adapted to Oman's climate and salt-water conditions, achieving a high protein content of up to 65%. This initiative aims to utilize non-arable coastal lands along the Arabian Sea to manufacture spirulina-enhanced animal and fish feeds, supporting the goals of Oman Vision 2040 regarding food security and a knowledge-based economy. By successfully scaling this microalgae production, the Sultan Qaboos University (SQU) is converting theoretical research into an applied industrial solution that bolsters the national aquaculture and livestock sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has issued a ministerial decision banning the import of live birds and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has issued a ministerial decision banning the import of live birds and poultry-related products from the Indian state of Kerala. This preventive measure, based on recommendations from competent veterinary authorities, addresses health concerns following recent avian influenza outbreaks in the region. The ban encompasses live birds, their products, derivatives, and waste, and will remain in effect until the health risks are resolved. However, an exception is made for poultry products that have been thermally processed or treated in compliance with the international standards of the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH).
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Yemeni Authority for Standards, Metrology, and Quality Control organized a specialized workshop as part of the National Yemeni Honey...
records.description: The Yemeni Authority for Standards, Metrology, and Quality Control organized a specialized workshop as part of the National Yemeni Honey Festival to strengthen the quality and global standing of Yemeni honey. The workshop focused on the YSMO 2449/2019 standard, which outlines the chemical composition and quality criteria for premium varieties like Sidr and Acacia honey. Technical experts highlighted the adoption of advanced detection technologies, such as NMR and C4 testing, to combat commercial fraud and ensure international compliance. By integrating these standards with support for small-scale facilities, the Yemeni Authority for Standards, Metrology, and Quality Control aims to modernize national laboratories and provide technical certifications that protect this strategic product and boost its competitiveness in global markets.
records.institution: The Yemeni Authority for Standards, Metrology, and Quality Control

records.title: Saudi Reef Projects Increased Earnings for Small Farmers by 2030
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) projects that the average monthly income for its beneficiaries will exceed SAR 20,000 by 2030, a significant increase aimed at ensuring long-term economic stability for rural communities. This forecast, shared by program spokesperson Majed Al-Buraikan, highlights the impact of expanding support to over 200,000 farmers and producers across the Kingdom. By providing access to modern irrigation, agricultural mechanization, and technical training, Saudi Reef is transitioning small-scale traditional farming into a commercially viable sector. These efforts are a core component of Saudi Vision 2030, focusing on reducing rural-to-urban migration, enhancing local food security, and empowering rural families to become substantial contributors to the national economy.

records.description: Masdar, in partnership with a consortium including OQ Alternative Energy, Komipo, and Al Khadra Partners, has reached financial close for the Ibri III Solar Independent Power Project in Oman. Developed for Nama Power and Water Procurement (Nama), this $300 million initiative is the first in the Sultanate to combine a 500MW solar photovoltaic plant with a 100-megawatt-hour battery energy storage system (BESS). Financed by First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) and Natixis CIB, the project will power approximately 33,000 homes and offset 505,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide annually. This milestone directly supports the Oman Vision 2040 target of generating 30% of electricity from renewable sources by 2030, reinforcing Masdar’s role in accelerating the regional energy transition through advanced storage technologies.

records.description: The Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority (DECCA) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Domus Group to integrate advanced drone technologies and vertical aviation solutions into Dubai’s environmental and climate action strategies. This partnership aims to leverage high-precision aerial surveys for mapping mangroves, monitoring air quality, and conducting carbon sink assessments, as well as strengthening the enforcement of environmental regulations and unauthorized fishing laws. By aligning with the UAE Net Zero 2050 pathway and the Dubai Economic Agenda (D33), DECCA intends to use these unmanned aircraft systems as key enablers for data-driven decision-making in biodiversity conservation and sustainable agriculture. This collaboration reflects a commitment to adopting cutting-edge global innovations to meet local ecological requirements and ensure long-term sustainable development.

records.description: The ownership consortium of the Al Dhafra solar project—comprising TAQA, Masdar, EDF, and Jinko Power—has successfully raised $871 million (AED 3.2 billion) through long-term green bonds. This 100% green-certified issuance, which carries a 5.794 percent coupon and matures in 2053, will refinance the debt of the 2-gigawatt plant, currently one of the world's largest single-site solar facilities. Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC) serves as the principal offtaker under a 35-year fixed-tariff agreement, providing the stable cash flows that earned the bonds a preliminary 'A' rating from S&P Global Ratings. By utilizing bi-facial panel technology to offset 2.4 million metric tonnes of $CO_2$ annually, the project reinforces Abu Dhabi's energy transition strategy and establishes a model for securing competitive, long-term capital for future renewable energy infrastructure.

Harvests. records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in the Aseer Region, in collaboration with an agricultural practices development initiative team, has launched a project to establish seven specialized agricultural fields. By integrating advanced farming methods and rigorous monitoring, the project aims to enhance regional productivity and environmental sustainability while serving as a practical model for local farmers. records.title: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has issued an international tender to purchase approximately 595,000 metric tons of hard milli...
records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has issued an international tender to purchase approximately 595,000 metric tons of hard milling wheat to replenish strategic reserves and meet rising domestic consumption. The procurement, which seeks wheat with a minimum 12.5% protein content from optional global origins, includes ten consignments scheduled for delivery in April and May across key ports in Jeddah, Yanbu, Dammam, and Jizan. As the entity responsible for sourcing grain and managing storage, GFSA oversees the Kingdom's shift toward an import-reliant food security model following the 2016 phase-out of large-scale domestic wheat cultivation to conserve water. This substantial tender reinforces Saudi Arabia's role as a major global importer and ensures a stable supply for the national flour milling and baking industries.
records.institution: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA)

records.description: The launch of Gulfood Logistics at the Dubai Exhibition Centre (DEC) marks a strategic expansion for Gulfood 2026, addressing a global logistics market projected to reach $23 trillion by 2035. As the Middle East's largest logistics hub, the UAE accounts for 30% of regional activity, and this new platform leverages Dubai’s geostrategic position to showcase innovations in cold-chain systems, smart warehousing, and real-time cargo tracking. Industry leaders such as Maersk, DP World, and MSC Shipping are participating to demonstrate resilient "farm-to-fork" supply chain solutions that ensure food safety and sustainability across continents. By integrating thought leadership on digital transformation and regulatory compliance, the event reinforces the UAE's role in global trade connectivity, highlighting how advanced infrastructure and international cooperation are essential for maintaining supply reliability and reducing food waste in an increasingly complex global landscape.
records.institution: The Government of the United Arab Emirates

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced that the adoption of Saudi Good Agricultural Practices (Saudi GAP) within the national poultry sector has reached approximately 90%, driving broiler chicken production to 1.2 million tons in 2024. As part of its "Your Local Guarantee" awareness campaign, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is promoting the use of modern technologies and innovations to ensure the highest standards of food safety, quality, and environmental protection. These advancements have not only strengthened national supply chains and market availability but have also increased the overall investment value of the industry. By prioritizing sustainable resource use and standardized production requirements, the ministry continues to enhance the Kingdom’s food security system in alignment with the strategic goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources, in collaboration with the Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones (MOD...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources, in collaboration with the Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones (MODON) and the Saudi Irrigation Organization (SIO), has launched the Mining Infrastructure Enablement Initiative to bolster the Kingdom's mining competitiveness. Announced at the Future Minerals Forum 2026, a primary focus of this initiative is the Jabal Sayid mineralized belt, which holds an estimated SAR192 billion in copper, gold, and rare earth elements. To unlock this potential sustainably, a new 75-kilometer pipeline will deliver over 20,000 cubic meters of treated water daily, reducing water costs by 60% and preserving vital groundwater resources in line with the National Water Strategy. By addressing "last-mile" infrastructure challenges and providing integrated solutions for exploitation license holders, the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources aims to de-risk investments and accelerate production, transforming Saudi Arabia into a premier global destination for a stable and cost-efficient mine-to-market ecosystem.

This partnership aligns with the broader commitment to achieve Net Zero by 2040, as BEEAH explores innovative ways to convert closed landfills into solar farms and Masdar continues to expand its global renewable energy portfolio toward a 100-gigawatt target.

records.description: Masdar has partnered with Elite Agro Holding to launch the first agricultural photovoltaic (AgriPV) project in the MENA region, located at the Al Foah Farm in Al Ain. Announced during Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, the initiative integrates solar panels with greenhouses to enable the simultaneous generation of clean energy and crop cultivation on the same land. This innovative model is designed to maximize resource efficiency by using PV panels to provide shading, which reduces heat and water stress on plants while lowering irrigation requirements. By advancing the UAE’s Net Zero 2050 and National Food Security Strategy 2051, the project serves as a scalable blueprint for sustainable farming in arid climates, providing critical data to optimize land use and energy resilience for future large-scale deployments across the emirate.

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is showcasing its leadership in autonomous technologies at UMEX 2026, highlighting four flagship projects that integrate AI, robotics, and unmanned systems into the agricultural and food sectors. These initiatives include the use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) for precise monitoring of farms and livestock, the Food Security Jahazeya Project for predictive supply chain analytics, and AI-driven visual monitoring systems for food establishments to ensure real-time safety compliance. Additionally, the Advanced Agriculture 4.0 System utilizes agricultural robotics and big-data sensors to enable remote crop management and optimize resource use. By deploying these cutting-edge solutions, ADAFSA aims to modernize traditional farming methods, strengthen national food security reserves, and reinforce Abu Dhabi’s position as a global hub for innovation in sustainable agriculture and digital transformation.

records.description: The National Agriculture Centre, in collaboration with the Sharjah Entrepreneurship Centre (Sheraa), has launched the Agriboost Programme 2026 to empower early-stage agri-tech startups addressing the UAE’s national food security and sustainability priorities. This six-week, sprint-based incubator is designed to help five selected UAE-based startups validate their solutions and move toward market execution through hands-on guidance, industry mentorship, and access to a network of investors. Supported by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, the program provides each participant with AED 15,000 in support, along with co-working spaces and software perks, culminating in a Demo Day to showcase climate-smart agricultural innovations. By fostering a direct link between entrepreneurs and real-world agricultural needs, the National Agriculture Centre and Sheraa are building a scalable framework for sustainable technology that strengthens the resilience of the national food system.

records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) identifies the UAE as a strategic international partner essential for bolstering food security through the implementation of the National Food Security Strategy 2051. This strategy prioritizes sustainable local production, supply chain efficiency, and the reduction of food loss and waste to ensure the long-term stability of food systems. By hosting international platforms such as Global Food Week and collaborating with the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment on regional dialogues regarding food safety, the nation facilitates knowledge exchange and the development of advanced regulatory frameworks. This partnership integrates technical roles with institutional support, emphasizing capacity building and multilateral action to confront global food crises and improve preparedness in regions most affected by environmental and economic shocks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.description: The Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award pavilion at the Sheikh Zayed Festival hosted a session focused on transitioning traditional farming into a technology-driven economic ecosystem. Organized by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the discussion emphasized how national initiatives stimulate innovation, institutional growth, and international knowledge exchange. Modern agricultural practices in the region now integrate artificial intelligence and smart farming systems to optimize water consumption and nutrient management, moving toward a science-based model for food security. By fostering a culture of collaboration among entrepreneurs and farmers, the Emirates Agricultural Pioneers Association and Gracia Group aim to leverage advanced infrastructure and supportive policies to enhance local production quality and long-term sustainability through data-driven decision-making.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

Running every Saturday through February 14, 2026, the market is a collaborative effort between the Ministry, the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD), and private sector partners. This season features 33 local farmers, alongside specialized nurseries, apiaries, and productive families. By providing a direct-to-consumer marketing channel, the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture aims to strengthen consumer confidence in "Made in Bahrain" produce, particularly fresh seasonal vegetables, while supporting the economic livelihoods of local agricultural entrepreneurs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

Organized through a partnership between the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the Emirates Poultry Breeders Association, and specialized private firms, the event showcased advanced cattle and poultry farming technologies, focusing on biosecurity standards, smart farm management, and resource efficiency.

This partnership is a cornerstone of the Sultanate’s dual strategy: securing national food reserves and transforming Oman into a competitive hub for global grain trading. This year’s event features the participation of 45 olive farms, 10 specialized agricultural companies, and seven countries, highlighting the region's massive agricultural assets, which include over 23 million olive trees. Organized to align with the developmental goals of the agricultural sector, the festival provides an integrated marketing platform to empower local producers and elevate Saudi olive products in local, regional, and international markets.

records.description: The Executive Unit for the Management of Financing for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives in Dhamar Governorate has established a successful model for community-led development, focusing on water security and sustainable farming. By supporting 66 community initiatives with a total investment exceeding 1.7 billion rials, the Executive Unit has facilitated the construction and maintenance of dams, barriers, and reservoirs. Notably, the local community contributed 86 percent of the total costs, while the Executive Unit provided essential supplies such as cement, fuel, and heavy machinery. This partnership has directly benefited over 8,200 farmers across 345 hectares, prioritizing the irrigation of strategic cereal and legume crops—such as wheat, barley, and lentils—while strictly prohibiting the use of these resources for qat cultivation to ensure national food security.
records.institution: The Executive Unit for the Management of Financing for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has inaugurated the 10th annual Citrus Festival in Al-Hariq Governorate, a strategic event designed to empower local farmers and strengthen national food security. Aligned with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030, the ten-day festival serves as a comprehensive platform for marketing a diverse range of local produce—including citrus fruits, dates, and honey—while developing the technical and marketing capabilities of the agricultural community. By integrating commercial exhibitions with tourism and recreational activities, the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture aims to highlight the region’s agricultural identity and environmental diversity, transforming the governorate into a premier destination for both agricultural investment and sustainable tourism.

records.description: The Saudi Halal Center, operating under the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), has launched the Halal Mark Track system, a first-of-its-kind initiative designed to integrate Halal certification with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) standards. Developed in partnership with the Halal Product Development Company (HPDC)—a Public Investment Fund (PIF) subsidiary—and THIQAH, the system ensures that products meet both Islamic Sharia requirements and international sustainability benchmarks. By embedding ESG principles like ethical sourcing and environmental stewardship into the Halal ecosystem, the Kingdom aims to boost the global competitiveness of Saudi products and solidify its position as a leading hub for the $2 trillion global Halal economy.
records.institution: The Saudi Halal Center

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE), serving as the Principal Partner of Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, is showcasing a comprehensiv...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE), serving as the Principal Partner of Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, is showcasing a comprehensive portfolio of projects aligned with its Strategic Framework 2050. The Department is demonstrating how an integrated approach—utilizing artificial intelligence, smart infrastructure, and digital platforms—can enhance the efficiency and resilience of the energy and water sectors. Key innovations on display include AD.WE, an AI-powered management platform for end-to-end system optimization, and the Integrated Water Strategy, which focuses on diversifying sources and improving network efficiency to ensure long-term water security. By embedding these advanced technologies into agricultural and utility networks, the Department of Energy reinforces its role in driving the UAE's sustainability ambitions and positioning the Emirate as a global leader in energy transformation.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE)

records.description: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has entered into a strategic partnership with Ghitha, a food sector portfolio company of Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Company, to strengthen regional food security. The Memorandum of Understanding establishes a comprehensive framework for cooperation in food production, the development of strategic commodity reserves, and the optimization of distribution networks. By leveraging Ghitha’s growing operational capabilities and AAAID’s investment expertise, the two entities aim to scale innovative agricultural products and facilitate access to international markets. This collaboration is a key component of Bahrain’s national food security objectives and AAAID’s broader mandate to foster sustainable agricultural development across the Arab world.
records.institution: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.title: In a major step toward achieving food security and national sovereignty, the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financin...
records.description: In a major step toward achieving food security and national sovereignty, the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit in Hodeida, in collaboration with the Yemen Plains Foundation and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, has introduced a fleet of 16 modern agricultural harvesters to serve local cooperative societies. This initiative, part of a broader vertical expansion program, aims to modernize the Tihama "breadbasket" by replacing traditional, high-cost manual methods with efficient mechanical technology. By accelerating the harvest of grain and fodder crops and significantly reducing post-harvest losses, the project empowers cooperative societies to organize fieldwork effectively and lowers production costs for farmers. This transition is a key pillar of the state's vision to restore agriculture's role as a primary economic driver and transform local fertile lands into a sustainable foundation for self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Yemen Plains Foundation

records.title: Saudi Arabia has achieved a significant agricultural milestone with the inauguration of the Kingdom's first white strawberry production a...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has achieved a significant agricultural milestone with the inauguration of the Kingdom's first white strawberry production at Hail Strawberry Park, positioned as only the third country globally to produce this rare variety after the United States and Japan. This development, which coincided with the launch of the park's seventh seasonal exhibition, underscores the strategic importance of the region as a primary agricultural hub and a vital contributor to national food security. By successfully cultivating these specialty berries, the facility demonstrates the growing role of the agricultural sector as a pillar of the national economy and a leader in innovative crop production within the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has reported a significant milestone in Saudi Arabia’s food security, with table egg p...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has reported a significant milestone in Saudi Arabia’s food security, with table egg production reaching 8.4 billion eggs, a 6.4% increase over the previous year. This surge has enabled the Kingdom to achieve a self-sufficiency rate of 100%, effectively meeting all domestic demand with local production. The Riyadh region remains the national leader, contributing 3.2 billion eggs, followed by Makkah and the Eastern Province. A key driver of this success is the Saudi Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) initiative, which now certifies 82% of the country's egg production. By enforcing these high standards for food safety and quality, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture continues to strengthen consumer trust and provide a surplus of high-quality protein for both the national market and regional exports.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

Visitors can explore and purchase a wide variety of premium fruits—including oranges, sweet lemons, citrons, and kumquats—while farmers benefit from a vital platform to market their produce directly to the public. records.title: The UAE government has enacted a major legislative overhaul to modernize its agricultural, veterinary, and environmental sectors, alignin...
records.description: The UAE government has enacted a major legislative overhaul to modernize its agricultural, veterinary, and environmental sectors, aligning national regulations with international standards like CITES and the International Plant Protection Convention. Managed by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, these updated federal laws significantly strengthen the country's biosecurity framework by introducing stricter quarantine protocols for animal and plant shipments and granting authorities expanded powers to seize illegal wildlife specimens. The reforms also introduce robust protections for new plant varieties to encourage agricultural innovation and impose much tougher penalties for violations, including fines of up to AED 2 million and mandatory deportation for repeat foreign offenders.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.title: The World Future Energy Summit, hosted by Masdar at the ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi, is set to become a primary staging ground for a strategic...
records.description: The World Future Energy Summit, hosted by Masdar at the ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi, is set to become a primary staging ground for a strategic green hydrogen alliance between the UAE and the UK. As the hydrogen market transitions from "hype" to "market realism," the Summit highlights the UAE's role in helping the UK reach its ambitious target of 10GW of low-carbon hydrogen production by 2030. With the UK requiring an estimated £9 billion (AED 44.6 billion) in private investment to scale its flagship hydrogen projects, the UAE—already a leader in large-scale Carbon Capture (CCUS) and renewable infrastructure—is positioned as a vital funding and technical partner. This collaboration is bolstered by the UAE's own domestic projects, such as the Ta'ziz Industrial Hub and the Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), as both nations seek to leverage green hydrogen to drive industrial decarbonization and long-term economic growth.
records.institution: Masdar

records.title: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Mahwit Governorate has launched an emergency veterinary intervention to combat a localized outbreak of lump...
records.description: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Mahwit Governorate has launched an emergency veterinary intervention to combat a localized outbreak of lumpy skin disease. Working in coordination with the Animal Health Department at the Ministry of Agriculture and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the governorate has begun distributing a specialized batch of medicines, vaccines, and medical supplies to affected districts. The campaign focuses on treating active cases in sheep and goats while simultaneously vaccinating healthy cattle to prevent the disease from spreading further. By integrating the efforts of local cooperative societies and district agricultural offices, the Agricultural Sector aims to safeguard livestock—a critical pillar of rural income—and enhance regional food security through this comprehensive containment and awareness strategy.
records.institution: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Mahwit Governorate

records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) recently carried out a significant food distribution operation in the Badakhshan Province of Afghanistan, reaching 490 families in the provincial capital. This effort provided essential nutritional support to nearly 3,000 individuals, including orphans and families who have recently returned to the country. As the primary humanitarian arm of Saudi Arabia, the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) implements these projects to alleviate suffering and address food insecurity in vulnerable communities. This specific distribution is part of a broader, ongoing commitment to provide life-saving assistance and stabilize the living conditions of those affected by displacement and economic hardship across the region.

Key highlights include the completion of the Al-Lujam Dam and ongoing progress on the Awaira Dam, alongside strategic investments in the College of Agriculture to equip modern laboratories. records.description: QatarEnergy and the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources have signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to deepen bilateral energy cooperation. The agreement primarily addresses Egypt's immediate and long-term energy needs, starting with the supply of up to 24 LNG cargoes to the Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company (EGAS) scheduled for delivery this summer. Beyond this immediate relief, the MoU establishes a framework for ongoing negotiations regarding a long-term LNG supply partnership. This strategic move aims to fuel Egypt’s industrial growth and economic expansion while reinforcing Qatar's position as a reliable energy provider to the region.

As the largest of its kind in the Middle East, this market serves 40,000 breeders and manages a sector valued at over AED 4.5 billion. The seminar detailed how precision nutrition—balancing proteins, fibers, and energy—not only boosts meat and milk yields but also strengthens animal immunity and fertility, directly contributing to the nation's food security and self-sufficiency goals.

records.title: Oman launches 11th Five-Year Development Plan (2026-2030)
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman has officially launched its Eleventh Five-Year Development Plan (2026–2030), marking a pivotal second stage in the "Oman Vision 2040" roadmap. Targeting a steady economic growth rate of 4% at constant prices, the plan prioritizes a transition to a low-carbon economy, fiscal sustainability, and deep economic diversification. To achieve these goals, the government has allocated approximately RO 15.6 billion in additional investments, focusing on high-potential "core" sectors: Manufacturing, Tourism, and the Digital Economy. This strategic framework is divided into two pathways—Economic and Developmental—designed to bridge the nation from recovery to rapid expansion while generating 300,000 direct job opportunities for citizens by 2030.
records.institution: The Omani Government

By verifying compliance with marine systems, the ministry aims to prevent overfishing, safeguard biodiversity, and enhance the long-term sustainability of the Kingdom's fish stocks. This coordinated effort is a key component of a broader strategy to modernize the fisheries sector, improve food security, and ensure the resilience of the marine ecosystem for future generations.

records.description: Bahrain’s Electricity and Water Authority (EWA) has officially launched the construction of the Al Dur Solar Power Plant, a major 100-megawatt (MW) project that marks a key milestone in the kingdom’s renewable energy journey. The facility is located in the Al Dur area of the Southern Governorate, spanning two adjacent sites that total approximately 830,000 square meters. Featuring 135,000 solar panels, the plant is expected to be completed and connected to the national grid by Q3 2026.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has launched a transformative investment cluster designed to turn the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has launched a transformative investment cluster designed to turn the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) into a premier seafood industrial hub and expand large-scale farming in Dhofar. This initiative is a core component of the "From Sea to Manufacturing" strategy under Oman Vision 2040, focusing on shifting from traditional harvesting to high-value industrial processing. In Duqm, the first phase features six specialized fish processing plants focused on canning sardines, tuna, and small pelagic species, as well as producing value-added fillets. This is complemented by a newly launched RO 7.7 million floating factory operated by Oceans Fish Company, which allows for immediate sea-to-market processing. Meanwhile, in Dhofar, 16 agricultural opportunities covering 1,813 acres target the cultivation of grains, legumes, and tropical fruits like mangoes and lemons. These projects are supported by robust incentives, including 50-year land usufruct rights and 10-year tax exemptions, aimed at attracting global capital to secure the Sultanate's food future.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.description: The Shumoukh Al Ezz Group recently signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding with the US-based company PittMoss to advance sustainable agriculture in the UAE and the broader GCC region. This partnership focuses on introducing innovative, peat-free growing media made from upcycled cellulose fibers (such as recycled paper and cardboard), which serves as an eco-friendly alternative to traditional soil components. Under the agreement, the two entities will explore technology transfer and the potential for establishing local manufacturing facilities in the UAE to strengthen regional supply chains. The technology is designed to improve water retention by up to two-thirds and reduce fertilizer dependency by 30%, directly supporting national food security and water conservation goals in arid climates.

records.description: The Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT) has directed the Ministry of Public Works to amend a significant infrastructure tender for the construction and maintenance of rainwater drainage systems across four major residential areas: Sabah Al-Ahmad, South Sabah Al-Ahmad, Al-Khairan, and Al-Wafra. Valued at approximately KD 222 million ($723 million), the project is designed to prevent urban flooding while strategically replenishing groundwater reserves. A key feature of the system is the filtration of sediments and oils, allowing the captured runoff to serve as a sustainable alternative water source for agricultural irrigation. By reducing reliance on costly desalinated water for non-potable uses, the initiative aims to enhance Kuwait's water security and alleviate the operational burden on the nation's wastewater treatment plants.

records.description: The Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI), in partnership with the UAE Presidential Court and the Gates Foundation, has launched the Institute for Agriculture and Artificial Intelligence (IAAI) to revolutionize global food security through digital innovation. As a core pillar of the Abu Dhabi AI for Agriculture Ecosystem, the institute aims to support 43 million smallholder farmers in climate-vulnerable regions like Africa and India by providing open-access, real-time digital advisory tools. By creating a high-quality, trusted agricultural data corpus, the IAAI addresses critical gaps in language and geography, developing multimodal diagnostic models for pest detection and voice-based systems tailored to local dialects and literacy levels. This initiative marks a strategic shift toward field-ready AI solutions, empowering farmers to boost productivity and resilience in a warming world while positioning Abu Dhabi as a global hub for sustainable agritech innovation.

This year alone, 800 MW was added as part of the project’s sixth phase, utilizing a mix of photovoltaic and concentrated solar power (CSP) technologies. Furthermore, DEWA launched the tender for the seventh phase, which will add 2,000 MW of solar power integrated with 1,400 MWh of energy storage, reinforcing the park's status as the world's largest single-site solar facility.

records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has achieved a historic milestone in its rainfed crop sector, reporting a growth rate exceeding 1,100% as of late 2025. This expansion highlights the program's success in revitalizing traditional farming in water-scarce regions, particularly in the southwestern provinces like Jazan, Asir, Makkah, and Al-Baha. By providing financial and technical support to over 13,300 beneficiaries, the initiative has significantly improved the standard of living for smallholder farmers while reducing reliance on non-renewable water sources. These efforts, spearheaded by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) in collaboration with the FAO, are central to achieving the food security and economic diversification goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: As part of the #HattaWinter initiative, Dubai Municipality has launched the 10th edition of the Hatta Honey Festival, running until 31st...
records.description: As part of the #HattaWinter initiative, Dubai Municipality has launched the 10th edition of the Hatta Honey Festival, running until 31st December 2025 at Hatta Hall. The free-to-enter event serves as a strategic platform for over 50 Emirati beekeepers to showcase diverse local honey varieties while promoting sustainable agri-tourism in the region. A significant highlight this year is the involvement of the Dubai Central Laboratory, which utilizes infrared technology to test honey quality in under a minute and has introduced a smart robot for automated sample reception. Additionally, the Municipality is pioneering a "laboratory fingerprint" and digital identity system for local honey—the first of its kind in the UAE—to guarantee origin and quality, reinforcing consumer trust and supporting the local rural economy.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), in collaboration with the Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority (DECCA), recently...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), in collaboration with the Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority (DECCA), recently planted 600 mangrove trees at the Jebel Ali Marine Sanctuary. This initiative, supported by over 200 volunteers, brings DEWA's total contribution to 13,950 mangroves planted since early 2023. The project aligns with the "Plant the Emirates" National Programme and the UAE's goal to plant 100 million mangroves by 2030 to enhance biodiversity and combat climate change. By restoring coastal ecosystems, the authorities aim to implement nature-based solutions that protect marine habitats and ensure long-term ecological sustainability.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

records.title: The Western Sector Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana'a Governorate has launched a major distribution initiative for the current wi...
records.description: The Western Sector Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana'a Governorate has launched a major distribution initiative for the current winter season, providing 20 tons of improved wheat seeds and 5 tons of legume seeds to farmers across the sector's districts. This effort, supported by the Executive Unit for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Funding Management, aims to boost local production and reduce reliance on imported food crops. The seeds are distributed through the society’s specialized seed bank, which has achieved significant success in previous seasons by supplying a cumulative total of 70 tons of cereal seeds and 10 tons of legumes. By leveraging the fertile areas of the Western Sector—which include districts like Al-Haymah Al-Kharijiyah—the society is working toward strategic goals of food security and national self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Western Sector Agricultural Cooperative Society

records.title: The Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR) has championed a technological transformation in Al-Wafra and Al...
records.description: The Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR) has championed a technological transformation in Al-Wafra and Al-Abdali, where Kuwaiti farmers are now utilizing climate-controlled greenhouses to produce commercial quantities of fruits previously considered unsuited for desert climates, such as citrus, bananas, and mangoes. This shift contributed to a $10\%$ year-on-year increase in agricultural output during the first nine months of 2025, reaching 220,700 tons of fresh produce valued at approximately 23.9 million dinars ($78.15 million). To sustain this momentum and achieve long-term food security, the Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy has begun implementing electronic subsidy systems to streamline financial support for energy-intensive greenhouse operations, while farmers continue to advocate for nominal utility pricing to lower production costs.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR)

records.title: The Ruler of Sharjah, inaugurated the Mleiha Dairy Factory, a 20,000-square-meter facility with a daily production capacity of 100,000 li...
records.description: The Ruler of Sharjah, inaugurated the Mleiha Dairy Factory, a 20,000-square-meter facility with a daily production capacity of 100,000 liters. During the event, the Mleiha Dairy Farm was officially recognized by Guinness World Records as the world’s largest A2A2 cattle farm, housing over 6,400 cows that produce milk with superior health benefits. The project, managed by the Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Foundation (Iktifa), prioritizes organic, natural practices and human health over commercial profit. It features a circular milking parlor capable of handling 500 cows per hour and eco-friendly packaging lines, marking a major milestone in Sharjah’s comprehensive food security strategy which includes wheat, poultry, and vegetable production using original, non-chemical seeds.
records.institution: The Mleiha Dairy Factory

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO) has launched the ‘Green Circles’ platform, a strategic initiative designed to unify global le...
records.description: The World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO) has launched the ‘Green Circles’ platform, a strategic initiative designed to unify global leaders, policymakers, and businesses in accelerating the transition toward inclusive and sustainable economic models. Through high-level dialogues—including sessions held with AmCham Dubai and Dubai Chambers—the platform bridges the gap between policy and investment, resulting in two foundational white papers: ‘Accelerating the Transition to Responsible Business’ and ‘Enabling the Sustainability Ecosystem for Responsible Business’. These documents provide actionable roadmaps for integrating sustainability into core business models, reinforcing regulatory frameworks, and stimulating green investment. By fostering cross-sector partnerships, the platform serves as a practical framework for translating global climate commitments into tangible outcomes that support the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and a low-carbon future.
records.institution: AmCham Dubai and Dubai Chambers

records.title: Throughout 2025, the UAE advanced its low-carbon economy by launching the world's first "round-the-clock" gigascale project in Abu Dhabi,...
records.description: Throughout 2025, the UAE advanced its low-carbon economy by launching the world's first "round-the-clock" gigascale project in Abu Dhabi, combining solar power with a record-breaking battery energy storage system. The Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure and the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi expanded domestic conservation through the "Abu Dhabi Coral Gardens" and a new geospatial platform designed to reduce groundwater use by shifting agriculture toward unconventional water resources. Industrial sustainability reached new milestones as BEEAH announced the region's first commercial waste-to-hydrogen plant, while the Emirates Nuclear Energy Company confirmed the Barakah Plant now provides 25% of the nation’s electricity, offsetting 22.4 million tonnes of carbon annually. Internationally, Masdar and Mubadala solidified the UAE's leadership in climate resilience by developing gigawatt-scale solar and green hydrogen projects across Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure

records.title: The Al-Jouf International Agricultural Forum has launched its third edition to bolster sustainable development and food security in align...
records.description: The Al-Jouf International Agricultural Forum has launched its third edition to bolster sustainable development and food security in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. During the event, the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture inaugurated a specialized Olive Laboratory to advance research and production quality in the region. With participation from over 40 domestic and international companies, the forum highlights major investment opportunities and modern technologies in one of the Middle East’s most vital agricultural hubs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Western District Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana’a Governorate has launched a vaccination campaign targeting over ten thousa...
records.description: The Western District Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana’a Governorate has launched a vaccination campaign targeting over ten thousand cattle to combat the emergence of lumpy skin disease. Implemented by the association's veterinary unit under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, the initiative provides both preventative vaccinations and specialized treatment for over 200 infected or suspected cases. By deploying mobile field teams across all districts, the campaign combines medical intervention with farmer education on maintaining safe environments and eradicating disease vectors. This strategic effort aligns with national directives to protect livestock assets, enhance local production, and move toward self-sufficiency in the national meat and dairy markets.
records.institution: The Western District Agricultural Cooperative Society

records.title: The Al-Khut Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association organized a specialized training workshop to enhance the capabilities of p...
records.description: The Al-Khut Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association organized a specialized training workshop to enhance the capabilities of production group facilitators in managing plant and animal value chains. Supported by the Binyan Development Foundation and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the program focused on modernizing agricultural supervision and integrating best practices from seed selection to marketing. Participants discussed strategies for cost reduction and quality improvement to drive vertical and horizontal expansion within the governorate’s agricultural sector. This initiative aims to build local community capacity and ensure the delivery of high-quality products, fostering long-term sustainable development and food security.
records.institution: The Al-Khut Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued a new resolution to regulate veterinary medical practices, mandat...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued a new resolution to regulate veterinary medical practices, mandating that all establishments and professionals obtain official licensing before operating. This regulatory framework aims to bolster the national biosecurity system and animal health by enforcing strict technical requirements and introducing administrative fines for non-compliant entities. By aligning with the "One Health" concept, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) seeks to ensure food safety and build a sustainable agricultural environment through enhanced oversight. This strategic move modernizes the legislative framework, positioning the region as a center of excellence for specialized medical regulation while increasing public confidence in veterinary care.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The signing of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) marks a significant milestone in bilateral relations, aimed at gen...
records.description: The signing of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) marks a significant milestone in bilateral relations, aimed at generating substantial opportunities across major economic sectors and enhancing investment flows. This strategic partnership, supported by the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Confederation of Indian Industry, focuses on reducing trade barriers and fostering growth in infrastructure, technology, and food security. Additional agreements in agriculture, higher education, and maritime heritage further solidify the multi-faceted cooperation between the two nations under their respective long-term development visions. These collaborative efforts ensure a sustainable framework for economic diversification, energy cooperation in green hydrogen, and strengthened regional security through shared maritime initiatives.

records.title: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has partnered with Equiti Group to accelerate digital transformati...
records.description: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has partnered with Equiti Group to accelerate digital transformation and strengthen the regional food security system through advanced financial technology. This collaboration focuses on developing an innovative digital platform powered by Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), blockchain, and AI-driven tools to enhance investment analysis and project management for agricultural portfolios. By exchanging critical data for feasibility studies and financial projections, the entities aim to build a resilient market infrastructure that facilitates more efficient capital mobilization and expands access for accredited investors. This strategic initiative aligns with national efforts to promote sustainable growth and inclusive development across the 21 member countries of the institution.
records.institution: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.description: King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST) and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) organized a workshop on groundwater sustainability to discuss advanced technologies for aquifer recharge and restoration. This initiative aims to enhance national water security and reduce reliance on non-renewable reserves by integrating research, development, and innovation into Saudi Vision 2030 goals. Experts explored innovative solutions in desalination, treatment, and efficient management practices for arid environments to foster a more resilient and sustainable economy. The event concluded with recommendations to strengthen collaboration between research and executive bodies, establish expertise-sharing platforms, and develop specialized national capacities in water management.

records.description: A workshop in Bayda focused on establishing marketing units and signing contracts for cooperative agricultural associations to expand production and improve marketing mechanisms across districts. The Ministry of Agriculture presented contract farming as a strategic step to increase local grain and legume yields and reduce reliance on imports through organized production groups. Supported by the initiative funding unit, these efforts prioritize rainwater harvesting and land reclamation to achieve national food security and self-sufficiency. This initiative empowers farmers to participate in quality-based marketing plans that strengthen the overall capacities and sustainable development of the regional agricultural sector.

records.title: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) signed a memorandum of understanding with the International Maize and Wheat Im...
records.description: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) signed a memorandum of understanding with the International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT) to enhance scientific cooperation on improving climate-resilient crops in Saudi Arabia. This partnership aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 by combining global expertise in maize and wheat development with advanced research in genomics, bioinformatics, and computational agriculture. The collaboration aims to accelerate the creation of high-yield, climate-adapted varieties capable of withstanding the harsh conditions of arid and high-temperature environments. This strategic move strengthens national food security by addressing challenges such as climate change, pests, and rising food demand through innovative, sustainable agricultural solutions.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: The Korea-Oman Joint Seminar on Sustainable Water Resources Management was co-hosted by the Embassy of Korea in Muscat, the Ministry of C...
records.description: The Korea-Oman Joint Seminar on Sustainable Water Resources Management was co-hosted by the Embassy of Korea in Muscat, the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment of Korea, and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman, along with the Korea Water Partnership (KWP) and the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA) Muscat Office. The event brought together government agencies and industry leaders from both nations to share policy insights and technical expertise on topics such as non-revenue water (NRW) reduction, desalination, wastewater treatment, and smart water network innovation. This reaffirmed the shared commitment of both countries to strengthening long-term bilateral cooperation in the water sector amidst rising climate and resource challenges.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy, in collaboration with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), launched the Smar...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy, in collaboration with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), launched the Smart Metre Project in the Al Wathba area to enhance water-use efficiency and support sustainable agriculture using artificial intelligence and digital monitoring technologies. This strategic initiative involves connecting AI-powered smart meters to the Department of Energy's digital platform, AD.WE, to ensure equitable water distribution and provide farmers with real-time data and analytics. The project, which currently covers 80 farms in Al Wathba with plans for expansion, aims to improve consumption efficiency, support data-driven decision-making, and reinforce Abu Dhabi's commitment to food and water security.

records.title: The first phase of the Economic Empowerment Project was inaugurated in Ibb Governorate, providing interest-free loans for the purchase of...
records.description: The first phase of the Economic Empowerment Project was inaugurated in Ibb Governorate, providing interest-free loans for the purchase of $37$ solar power systems for $40$ farmers in Hazm Al-Udayn District, implemented by the Central Economic Empowerment Unit in cooperation with the Hazm Al-Udayn Agricultural Cooperative Association. Funded by the Governorate's Unit for Financing Agricultural Projects and Initiatives, Bonyan Foundation, and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, this initiative aims to enhance the farmers' economic empowerment by reducing production costs, increasing productivity, and shifting reliance away from traditional energy sources. The project is seen as a crucial step towards strengthening the agricultural sector, achieving food security, and supporting the local economy's resilience through sustainable production practices.

records.description: The Al Meera Consumer Goods Company (Q.P.S.C.) inaugurated the Local Farmers Market Festival at its Ain Khaled branch, with attendance from the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Running from December 11 to 24, the festival celebrates the vital contributions of Qatari farmers to food security and local production. The initiative reflects Al Meera's national mandate and commitment to empowering local producers, aligning with the Qatar National Vision 2030 for sustainable development and economic diversification. The market brings together local farms to offer fresh vegetables, fruits, and herbs, reinforcing Al Meera's role as a strategic partner in promoting national products and creating platforms for local brands to grow.

This strategic initiative is aimed at enhancing food security, supporting farmers with improved local seeds, and preserving plant genetic resources to achieve agricultural sustainability and reduce reliance on imported seeds.

records.title: Work is advancing on a large-scale shrimp farming complex in Shinas, Oman, driven by Singapore-based Blue Aqua International and Omani in...
records.description: Work is advancing on a large-scale shrimp farming complex in Shinas, Oman, driven by Singapore-based Blue Aqua International and Omani investors, as part of Oman’s strategy for food security and economic diversification. The facility, which integrates a shrimp farm, hatchery, and broodstock center, is expected to be fully operational by February 2026 with a target annual output of 1,800 metric tonnes. The site prioritizes technology-focused farming methods, controlled operations, efficient water use, and robust biosecurity procedures to ensure stable, sustainable, and disease-free harvests for both domestic and regional supply. The project is part of a broader 22-hectare aquaculture initiative that also includes plans for a 5,000 metric tonne land-based trout farm utilizing Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) technology by 2027, and is expected to generate significant local employment.
records.institution: Omani Government

records.description: Arabian Qudra (AQ), a subsidiary of Abunayyan Holding Company, announced a landmark agreement with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), the national entity regulating the water sector, to establish the first floating solar power plant in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This move underscores Qudra Arabia's commitment to advancing renewable energy sources. The SWA also signed a research cooperation agreement with Saudi Yokogawa Company to apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies for early water leak detection and system efficiency, and sealed a deal with the Water Management Alliance to enhance water security and build capacity.
