records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), in collaboration with Silal, is organizing a Farmers’ and Livestock Breeder...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), in collaboration with Silal, is organizing a Farmers’ and Livestock Breeders’ Market as part of the Liwa International Festival – Moreeb Dune 2025, running from December 12, 2025, to January 3, 2026. The market aims to support local producers by providing 20 fully equipped stalls for farmers to sell fresh vegetables, fruits, and honey, and 20 pens for breeders to sell local sheep, enabling direct sales to consumers without intermediaries. This initiative forms part of ADAFSA’s broader efforts to strengthen food security by supporting local production, reducing reliance on imports, and promoting sustainable agricultural practices and modern technologies. The market allows festival visitors to directly engage with local producers and contribute to the sustainability of the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: An agreement for the construction of the Wadi al Uwaynah Dam in the wilayat of Dhank was signed at the headquarters of the Directorate Ge...
records.description: An agreement for the construction of the Wadi al Uwaynah Dam in the wilayat of Dhank was signed at the headquarters of the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Dhahirah. The project, with a total cost of RO120,000, is jointly funded by the village residents and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, serving as a model of community partnership. The dam will measure 100m in length and 14m in height. It is expected to significantly enhance water availability and the sustainability of local water resources, directly benefiting Uwaynah village's vital agricultural and livestock activities, which rely on date palms, fodder crops, and seasonal produce.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources,

records.title: The text reports that Saudi Arabia recorded a significant increase in food product self-sufficiency ratios in 2024 compared to 2023, acco...
records.description: The text reports that Saudi Arabia recorded a significant increase in food product self-sufficiency ratios in 2024 compared to 2023, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). Key self-sufficiency ratios in 2024 were highest for shrimp at 149%, dairy products at 131%, and dates at 121%. Notable increases from 2023 to 2024 included onions (+41.2%) and tomatoes (+9.2%). The highest annual per capita consumption was for rice (52.1 kg) among plant products and milk (70.3 liters) among animal products. The data compilation is based on information from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the General Food Security Authority, and the Agricultural Development Fund.
records.institution: The General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT)

records.title: Silal’s Innovation Oasis (iO), the state-of-the-art research and development hub in Al Ain, signed a landmark collaboration agreement wit...
records.description: Silal’s Innovation Oasis (iO), the state-of-the-art research and development hub in Al Ain, signed a landmark collaboration agreement with Square Roots, a global agritech company specializing in modular controlled-climate farming and AI-powered cultivation systems. The partnership establishes a national testbed for fast-tracking innovation in desert and indoor farming, deploying a multi-zone, cloud-connected, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered research facility at the iO site. The initiative aims to advance climate-smart agriculture by developing low-light crop genetics for lower energy consumption, identifying strategic crops suited to desert environments, and localizing advanced farmer training programs to enhance the UAE's food security and water efficiency goals.
records.institution: Silal’s Innovation Oasis (iO)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched the "Model Directorates" program, selecting Bajil Directorate in Hod...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched the "Model Directorates" program, selecting Bajil Directorate in Hodeida governorate as a key paradigm for comprehensive agricultural and productive development in the Tihama Plain. The initiative drives a vast development transformation focused on boosting local production, achieving self-sufficiency, and building an effective marketing system through partnerships between the state and the community. This transformation involves organizing over 750 productive groups, reclaiming agricultural land, distributing improved seeds for strategic crops like soybeans and maize, launching a dairy production line at the Bajil Agricultural Cooperative Society factory, and establishing infrastructure like the "Kilo 18" Central Market to support commercial and agricultural activity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Ebb, a water technology company, partnered with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), the government entity regulating the Kingdom's water sec...
records.description: Ebb, a water technology company, partnered with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), the government entity regulating the Kingdom's water sector, to decarbonize desalination and target megaton-level $CO_2$ removal within the next decade. This milestone project, initially deploying at SWA's research facility in Jubail, integrates Ebb’s innovative electrochemical system with existing desalination infrastructure to transform previously wasted desalination brine into valuable products like caustic soda and hydrochloric acid. This process not only improves freshwater recovery and plant efficiency but also creates a new industry by using the caustic soda to enhance seawater alkalinity, which kickstarts a natural process that permanently removes $CO_2$ from the atmosphere, directly supporting Vision 2030 objectives.
records.institution: The Saudi Water Authority (SWA)

records.title: A closing workshop was held in Sana'a province to review the pilot project, “Farmer-Led Natural Regeneration,” implemented in Manakhah di...
records.description: A closing workshop was held in Sana'a province to review the pilot project, “Farmer-Led Natural Regeneration,” implemented in Manakhah district. Organized by Roya Amal International in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture and local authorities, the event highlighted the project's role in promoting sustainable agriculture, restoring degraded lands, and enhancing food security and livelihoods. The project's director noted that activities had been implemented across 10 villages, focusing on rehabilitating degraded environments, boosting biodiversity, and strengthening community resilience to climate change by training farmers on natural regeneration techniques and sustainable land use
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), with support from Oman India Fertiliser Company (OMIFCO), launc...
records.description: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), with support from Oman India Fertiliser Company (OMIFCO), launched a new Smart Vegetable Farms project adopting advanced Plant Factory technology to introduce a qualitative shift in the agricultural sector. This initiative relies on a highly controlled, closed ecosystem, or Indoor Vertical Farming, which precisely manages all growing elements to produce pesticide-free leafy vegetables year-round. The project is designed to encourage farmers, youth, and entrepreneurs to embrace modern agricultural technologies, offering measurable benefits like reduced water consumption and increased land-use efficiency, thereby reinforcing national food security, enhancing self-sufficiency, and aligning with Oman's strategy to modernize the sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Municipality of Qatar and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay signed a Memorandum of Unde...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality of Qatar and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for cooperation in the fields of agriculture and food security, reflecting a commitment to strengthening bilateral relations and sustainable development. The agreement emphasizes the exchange of expertise, knowledge, and technology in various areas, including livestock and artificial insemination, feed production, the import/export of live animals, and the use of modern and smart agricultural technologies. This collaboration, which aligns with FAO agreements, seeks to implement joint training programs and expand agricultural markets, overseen by a joint working group to ensure stable and sustainable agricultural development.

Discussions highlighted the critical role of national legislation, the utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced technologies for early detection and risk prediction, and the importance of digital modelling to enhance future readiness against potential biological threats.

records.description: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) signed a SAR200 million contract with Arabian Agricultural Services Company (ARASCO) to establish a 40,000 square meter logistics center for storage and distribution at King Abdulaziz Port in Dammam. The investment will specifically increase the port’s capabilities in grain unloading and storage by constructing warehouses capable of handling up to 100,000 metric tons.
records.institution: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani)

records.title: The UAE has launched Ai.(d), a $1 billion initiative led by the Abu Dhabi Exports Office (Adex), the export financing arm of the Abu Dhab...
records.description: The UAE has launched Ai.(d), a $1 billion initiative led by the Abu Dhabi Exports Office (Adex), the export financing arm of the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD), to advance digital infrastructure and improve lives across Africa. The platform aims to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a transformative tool for sustainable and inclusive growth, integrating AI-driven solutions in key development sectors such as education, agriculture, and digital infrastructure to advance the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The initiative plans to establish Smart Resilient Future Zones (SRFZs), which will serve as AI-enabled corridors, and is underpinned by the Multilateral Innovation Fund (MIF), a blended-finance mechanism designed to reduce risks and finance AI-powered projects in coordination with African governments.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Exports Office (Adex)

records.title: The UAE launched a major initiative, the AI Ecosystem for Global Agriculture Development, in collaboration with the Gates Foundation, bui...
records.description: The UAE launched a major initiative, the AI Ecosystem for Global Agriculture Development, in collaboration with the Gates Foundation, building on their $200 million fund announced at Cop28, to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help millions of smallholder farmers adapt to climate change. The high-tech strategy is built upon four landmark projects, including the establishment of the CGIAR AI Hub in Abu Dhabi, hosted by ai71; the Institute of Agriculture and Artificial Intelligence at the Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI); AgriLLM, an open-source large language model developed by ai71; and Aim for Scale, based at NYU Abu Dhabi, which is successfully delivering AI-powered weather forecasting and digital advisory services to farmers.
records.institution: The Gates Foundation

records.description: the Mara’ee 2025 Agriculture and Animal Production Show will open this December, offering one of the region’s largest platforms for agriculture and livestock production. The event aims to strengthen national food-security efforts and support domestic farming and animal husbandry. It will feature local and international exhibitors across agricultural displays, livestock markets, a heritage village, a farmers’ market, and even a children’s play area. Through this initiative, the government underscores its commitment to advancing the agriculture sector.

records.title: The "Entrepreneurship Forum in Fifth Generation Agriculture" began in Muscat, jointly organized by the Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fis...
records.description: The "Entrepreneurship Forum in Fifth Generation Agriculture" began in Muscat, jointly organized by the Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Arab Organisation for Agricultural Development (AOAD). The five-day forum reviews fifth-generation technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), and drones, to empower entrepreneurs and build a smarter, more sustainable agricultural sector. The event, which includes an exhibition for drones and AI technologies and training programs, reflects Oman's commitment to enhancing agricultural innovation and establishing a smart and sustainable agricultural system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources signed an agreement with Future Cities Company “Tadum” for the operation of an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources signed an agreement with Future Cities Company “Tadum” for the operation of an integrated technological system for tracking fishing boats. This strategic project aims to enhance the sustainability of fisheries resources and regulate the fishing sector by establishing a comprehensive national system for real-time monitoring of all artisanal fishing boats. The system, which relies on a coastal LoRaWAN network and satellite connectivity, transmits data on geographical location, speed, direction, and emergency alerts, enabling authorities to analyze sailing patterns, manage fishing efforts, and combat illegal fishing. Crucially, it also enhances maritime safety for fishermen by reducing risks and facilitating search and rescue operations through immediate data provision to the operations room.
records.institution: he Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources' Fisheries Undersecretary stressed the Ministry's commitment to develo...
records.description: The Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources' Fisheries Undersecretary stressed the Ministry's commitment to developing the fisheries sector, overcoming the effects of the blockade, and improving the quality of national fish products to open broader opportunities for Yemeni exports in regional and international markets. During a visit to fish processing and export facilities in Hodeida, the Undersecretary emphasized the Ministry's support for national companies and strengthening partnerships with the private sector. The al-Jazeera Marine Resources Company Ltd. highlighted challenges, primarily the ongoing blockade, which has made securing operational supplies and managing increased shipping costs difficult.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Startups across the MENA region are accelerating growth, evidenced by new funding rounds and partnerships across key sectors, demonstrati...
records.description: Startups across the MENA region are accelerating growth, evidenced by new funding rounds and partnerships across key sectors, demonstrating strong investor confidence. Saudi Arabian agritech startup Nabt secured a $3.4 million seed extension (bringing total funding to $5 million), led by SHG Group, to expand its physical and digital infrastructure for fresh produce and develop services like its Online Auction and Intel platform, aligning with the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture's efforts. Additionally, Saudi cybersecurity company COGNNA closed a $9.2 million Series A round to accelerate the global expansion of its AI-driven Agentic SOC platform, while Dubai-based AI-native lunch subscription startup Funch raised $500,000 in a pre-seed round.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Dubai Municipality launched the fifth season of the Farmers' Souq at Quranic Park, an initiative supporting the local agriculture sector...
records.description: Dubai Municipality launched the fifth season of the Farmers' Souq at Quranic Park, an initiative supporting the local agriculture sector and providing a direct marketing channel for 41 Emirati farmers. The market, which runs every Saturday and Sunday until February 8, 2026, features locally grown fresh produce and new family-friendly attractions like the Plant Lab and Petting Zoo. The initiative reflects the Municipality's commitment to strengthening the local agriculture sector, promoting sustainable farming practices, and enhancing the community's support for local products.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.title: The largest animal and aquatic feed factory in Oman, a RO 36 million project located in Khazaen Economic Zone, was inaugurated by the Min...
records.description: The largest animal and aquatic feed factory in Oman, a RO 36 million project located in Khazaen Economic Zone, was inaugurated by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. Operated by Oman Bio-Products, a subsidiary of Oman Flour Mills, the facility is one of the first in the region to embody the circular economy by using advanced technology to recycle green agricultural and biological by-products, and date residues into specialized, value-added feed. The initial phase has an annual capacity of 48,000 tonnes of animal feed and 15,000 tonnes of aquatic feed, significantly enhancing self-sufficiency, reducing reliance on imports, and strengthening Oman’s food security ecosystem.
records.institution: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Hydroponics is gaining importance in Saudi Arabia's Qassim Region as a sustainable solution to boost crop productivity while reducing wat...
records.description: Hydroponics is gaining importance in Saudi Arabia's Qassim Region as a sustainable solution to boost crop productivity while reducing water consumption by up to 90% compared to traditional agriculture. This modern method, which involves growing crops in nutrient-rich water solutions and using systems like vertical farming, addresses critical challenges like food security, water scarcity, and soil degradation. Although initial costs are higher, the method provides high yields of pesticide-free, quality crops year-round. The Saudi government continues to support farmers with financing and guidance to develop these sustainable systems, aligning with Vision 2030’s goal of fostering innovative farming.
records.institution: Hydroponics

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources inaugurated the first phase of a new feed production plant in Khazaen Economic...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources inaugurated the first phase of a new feed production plant in Khazaen Economic City, owned by the Omani Bioproducts Company (a subsidiary of Oman Flour Mills), built at a cost of OMR36 million. The facility has an initial annual capacity of 48,000 tonnes of animal feed and 15,000 tonnes of aquatic feed, significantly boosting local supply and reducing import dependence. The plant aligns with Oman's bio-economy strategy by using advanced technology to convert recycled green agricultural residues and date waste into high-nutrition feed, which enhances food security and supports the sustainability of the livestock and aquaculture sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Al Wathba Honey Festival, organized by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) alongside the Sheikh Mansour bin...
records.description: The Al Wathba Honey Festival, organized by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) alongside the Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award, commenced its activities at the Sheikh Zayed Festival in Abu Dhabi. The festival brings together 42 local producers to showcase and market honey, pollen, and propolis, aiming to support local beekeepers and encourage the adoption of global best practices. For the first time, it features the Beekeepers Association in the UAE and highlights the country's role as the host for the 50th International Apicultural Congress, Apimondia, in Dubai in 2027. The event includes eight competitions with a total prize pool of AED622,000, where a specialized committee, in cooperation with the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council and ADAFSA, ensures samples meet rigorous national quality and safety standards.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Asyad Group unveiled a series of forward-looking projects during the Oman Green Hydrogen Summit 2025, organized under the auspices of the...
records.description: Asyad Group unveiled a series of forward-looking projects during the Oman Green Hydrogen Summit 2025, organized under the auspices of the Ministry of Energy and Minerals and in partnership with Hydrom. These projects are designed to enhance Oman’s national logistics infrastructure for the green hydrogen economy. Key initiatives include developing an AI-driven digital platform for enhanced transport efficiency, advancing digital simulation solutions for routing wind-turbine components, and establishing smart warehouses equipped with IoT systems. Asyad is also upgrading Oman’s ports to handle, store, and export low-carbon fuels like green ammonia and liquid hydrogen, and developing green-fuel bunkering corridors, solidifying Oman’s position as a provider of advanced clean-fuel solutions.
records.institution: Asyad Group

records.title: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced a crucial, mandatory requirement for Omani companies exporting agr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced a crucial, mandatory requirement for Omani companies exporting agricultural, livestock, and water products, including poultry, to the Saudi Arabian market. These companies must now adhere to the mechanism for obtaining the Saudi Good Agricultural Practices (Saudi GAP) certificate. To secure the certificate, firms must pass an inspection by an accredited documentation body, which verifies the application of Saudi GAP standards on the farm of origin. This new measure, offered free of charge through the ‘NAAMA’ platform, aims to ensure that imported Omani products meet the high quality and safety benchmarks required by the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Al Khayyat Investments (AKI) announced a partnership via a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with CJ Group's food division, CJ Foods, to...
records.description: Al Khayyat Investments (AKI) announced a partnership via a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with CJ Group's food division, CJ Foods, to expand the availability of Korean food products across the Middle East, particularly in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. This collaboration will leverage AKI's regional distribution network and CJ Foods' expertise to meet the increasing demand for K-Food, driven by the growing popularity of Korean culture. The companies will also explore opportunities for joint product development and the possibility of local manufacturing within the UAE, supporting the country's initiatives for food security and economic diversification.
records.institution: Al Khayyat Investments (AKI)

records.title: The Oman AgroFood, the 7th International Trade Exhibition for Agriculture, Food and Fisheries, was launched at the Oman Convention and Ex...
records.description: The Oman AgroFood, the 7th International Trade Exhibition for Agriculture, Food and Fisheries, was launched at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. The three-day event serves as a platform for knowledge exchange and the promotion of investment opportunities, supporting the Sultanate's vision for transformative and sustainable growth. The exhibition highlights government initiatives such as supporting SMEs in local medicinal and aromatic plants, introducing water- and fertilizer-efficient technologies like soilless cultivation and aquaponics, and implementing renewable energy solutions (solar power) in net house operations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.description: The SOHAR Port and Freezone is exploring the potential development of naturally occurring (white) hydrogen in the Wilayat of Suhar through collaboration with Swiss specialist HYNAT SA, according to CEO. Reserves are confirmed, and the next stage is extraction testing to assess feasibility, which could provide a direct, low-carbon fuel source for SOHAR's industries. This effort is complementary to SOHAR’s commitment to green hydrogen, where it aims to be a manufacturing hub. The port's strategy includes finalizing an investment case to install 80–100 MW of grid-connected electrolysers to supply continuous hydrogen to high-demand industries and has established a partnership with a Swiss consortium to explore a green corridor between Oman and Switzerland.
records.institution: The SOHAR Port and Freezone

records.title: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics released its 2024 Agricultural Statistics Bulletin, reporting that date production reache...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics released its 2024 Agricultural Statistics Bulletin, reporting that date production reached approximately 1.923 million tons, a 1% increase over 2023, from over 37.6 million date palm trees. Open field vegetable production saw an 8.4% increase to 2,745,000 tons, led by potatoes and watermelons. Notably, greenhouse vegetable output reached 797 tons (a 10.6% increase), with tomatoes and cucumbers as the leading crops, reflecting the continued expansion of controlled environment cultivation. Overall, agricultural exports totaled 506,000 tons, up 13% year on year, with edible fruits and nuts accounting for 72.1% of the total volume.
records.institution: The General Authority for Statistics

records.title: An acoustics-based system trained with AI is emerging as a new line of defense for Gulf date palm farms against the destructive red palm...
records.description: An acoustics-based system trained with AI is emerging as a new line of defense for Gulf date palm farms against the destructive red palm weevil (RPW), which currently causes losses exceeding $400 million in Saudi Arabia alone. This technology, repurposed by researchers at Kaust (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology), uses extremely thin fiber cables wrapped around palm trees combined with an AI machine learning method to filter background noise and detect the faint sounds of feeding insect larvae, costing only about $0.50 per tree per year for monitoring. The World Economic Forum’s Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution in Saudi Arabia is collaborating with the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water & Agriculture to implement technology-based solutions, while the UAE launched the International Consortium for Red Palm Weevil Control with partners like the Gates Foundation and ICARDA to scale these innovations.
records.institution: Kaust (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)

records.title: Tanmiah Food Company has entered into a cooperation agreement with Big Idea Ventures, a global investment firm, to jointly pursue project...
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company has entered into a cooperation agreement with Big Idea Ventures, a global investment firm, to jointly pursue projects supporting Saudi Arabia’s food security goals. The arrangement creates a framework for both companies to evaluate equity stakes in US red meat producers and study opportunities in upstream assets such as feedlots and related infrastructure to secure reliable red meat supplies. A second key focus is developing a local agricultural system to grow alternative feed ingredients, which aims to cut the country’s exposure to external feed markets and support cost-efficient poultry and dairy operations.
records.institution: Tanmiah Food Company

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, received Algeria’s Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, received Algeria’s Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries for talks on strengthening bilateral cooperation. The meeting focused on exchanging expertise in agriculture, marine fishing, and rural development. Experts from both sides outlined specific potential areas for joint investment, including desert soil management, precision agriculture, date cultivation, tropical fruits, and horticultural development. Both countries agreed on the need for continued coordination in research and technical programs to support sustainable food security and the development of vital sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Al Saeed Multi Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Bani Sa'd District, Al Mahwit Governorate, Yemen, implemented various...
records.description: The Al Saeed Multi Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Bani Sa'd District, Al Mahwit Governorate, Yemen, implemented various field activities to reclaim damaged and neglected agricultural lands. The work, supported by the Central Emergency Development Interventions Unit, included surveying and reclaiming an area estimated at 10,500 square meters and removing approximately 3,500 cubic meters of flood debris. These interventions aim to facilitate farming operations, improve water flow, and enable farmers to resume agricultural activity next season, ultimately enhancing food security and achieving self-sufficiency in the district.

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture witnessed the signing of 12 agreements between the National Center for Palms and...
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture witnessed the signing of 12 agreements between the National Center for Palms and Dates and several public- and private-sector entities. These agreements are intended to support the development of palm and date processing industries by enhancing public-private partnerships. The Minister also honored the winners of the fourth edition of the International Award of the National Center for Palms and Dates, which aims to advance modern technologies, encourage innovation, and reinforce the Kingdom’s position as the world's largest exporter of dates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Al Rostamani Group inaugurated three state-of-the-art agricultural facilities at the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (...
records.description: The Al Rostamani Group inaugurated three state-of-the-art agricultural facilities at the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) headquarters in Dubai, marking the completion of a multi-year partnership fully funded by the Group. The ceremony was attended by the UAE Minister of Climate Change and Environment. The new facilities—a Training and Knowledge Transfer Building, a Plant Tissue Culture Laboratory, and an Integrated Agri-Aquaculture System—significantly enhance the UAE’s agricultural research landscape. These facilities are designed to advance sustainable agriculture, scientific research, and capacity development, supporting national capabilities in climate-smart agriculture, water-efficient production, and the nation’s vision for environmental sustainability and food security.

Held under the patronage of the Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the event attracted over 6,000 participants and featured 16 speakers from eight countries. The workshop supported the national agricultural research and innovation ecosystem by discussing global trends in smart agriculture, remote sensing, and precision farming to enhance production efficiency and resource sustainability.

records.description: Emirates Rawabi PSC, one of the UAE’s leading integrated agribusiness groups, has formed a strategic partnership with ReFarm Global Investments LLC, a pioneer in regenerative and circular sustainability technologies. This collaboration aims to revolutionize the UAE's agricultural and food production systems by driving a new model of circular agribusiness. They will implement cost-efficient, carbon-conscious solutions to strengthen food security, enhance soil health, and drastically reduce water use, aligning with the UAE’s long-term vision for sustainable growth and urban greening, particularly in Dubai.

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Hazardous Materials Management Centre and the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to establish a comprehensive framework for cooperation in the handling of hazardous materials within the agricultural sector. The agreement supports the safe and responsible management of these materials to reinforce the highest standards of environmental sustainability and public safety in Abu Dhabi. This strategic partnership aims to enhance the business and investment environment by streamlining regulatory procedures, improving operational efficiency for farmers and producers, and supporting Abu Dhabi's position as a leading destination for agricultural and food innovation.

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that local olive production in the Kingdom has surged past 351,000 tons.
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that local olive production in the Kingdom has surged past 351,000 tons. This achievement, driven by the expansion of cultivated areas and the adoption of modern farming technologies, has increased the total number of olive trees to nearly 21.5 million, with over 18 million fruit-bearing trees. This growth aligns with the National Agriculture Strategy and Vision 2030 by supporting sustainable economic and social development and enhancing food security. The Al-Jouf Region remains the most important center, leading the Kingdom with a production of 290,000 tons.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Emirates Biotech unveiled Embio, its new line of UAE-produced PolyLactic Acid (PLA) biopolymers, positioning the company as one of the Mi...
records.description: Emirates Biotech unveiled Embio, its new line of UAE-produced PolyLactic Acid (PLA) biopolymers, positioning the company as one of the Middle East’s emerging suppliers of bioplastics. The PLA biopolymers offer a lower carbon footprint than conventional plastics, are recyclable, and industrially compostable. By stocking PLA locally, Emirates Biotech will eliminate long lead times, offering faster delivery and lower minimum order quantities for regional customers. This launch and the ongoing development of the $90 million Falcon PLA plant reinforce the UAE’s commitment to sustainable manufacturing, circular economy solutions, and its Net Zero 2050 goals.

records.title: The National Company for Agricultural Services (AgriServ) is participating in the Global Veterinary Expo at the Riyadh International Conv...
records.description: The National Company for Agricultural Services (AgriServ) is participating in the Global Veterinary Expo at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center. The company is showcasing services mandated by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA), including expedited permit issuance, quarantine appointment booking, and vaccination services for imported livestock. AgriServ is also presenting its agricultural services application and offering a live demonstration of its virtual clinic service, which allows remote or on-site veterinary consultations, reflecting its commitment to enhancing digital solutions and service accessibility.

The festival, which will feature over 70 exhibitors (including beekeepers and traders), aims to strengthen the beekeeping sector, promote local production, and align with the objectives of the National Food Security Strategy 2051. The event will host competitions for the "Best Sidr Honey" and "Best Samar Honey," with winners selected based on rigorous technical and chemical testing. The SCCI affirmed the festival's role as a vital platform for showcasing local products, fostering knowledge exchange, and supporting sustainable agricultural growth in Sharjah.

records.description: Ghitha, Bahrain’s Food Holding Company and a portfolio company of Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Company, has secured a strategic minority investment in baked goods manufacturer Amalfi Foods. This partnership marks Ghitha’s entry into the bakery industry and will enable Amalfi Foods to double its production capacity by establishing a new, highly automated facility. The expansion is expected to support the launch of over 20 new bakery products for regional distribution and create up to 100 new jobs. records.description: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals reinforced Oman’s role in the global hydrogen economy by participating in the Asian Hydrogen Summit and Exhibition in Sydney. The Under-Secretary delivered a keynote address outlining Oman’s national strategy to advance a large-scale hydrogen industry, detailing regulatory and investment reforms, streamlined permitting, and targeted incentives to attract global investors. The Omani delegation held high-level meetings with the Australian government and the Australian Trade and Investment Commission to explore cooperation and technical exchange. Oman's participation highlights its determination to build strategic partnerships, attract investment, and develop national capabilities to emerge as a leading international hub for green hydrogen.

records.title: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA) confirmed the purchase of 300,000 metric tons of 12.5% protein hard wheat in its latest...
records.description: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA) confirmed the purchase of 300,000 metric tons of 12.5% protein hard wheat in its latest international tender, with arrival scheduled between February and April 2026. The tender was open to multiple origins, though European traders suggest the bulk will likely be sourced from the Black Sea region due to competitive pricing. The GFSA secured the volumes on a cost-and-freight (C&F) basis from sellers including Cargill, Solaris, and Cofco, with pricing reflecting notable market aggression due to strong global wheat supplies. This purchase is part of the GFSA's strategic plan to maintain national wheat stocks and stabilize domestic supply, following a series of substantial recent procurements.
records.institution: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA)

records.title: The Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) between the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Chile has officially entered into forc...
records.description: The Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) between the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Chile has officially entered into force, marking a transformative step to significantly enhance bilateral trade, which is projected to exceed $500 million within five years. The pivotal agreement is set to create new investment opportunities across vital sectors, including renewable energy, tourism, infrastructure, and agriculture. This collaboration, which solidifies the UAE's role as a global supply-chain hub connecting South America with markets in Africa, Europe, and Asia, is integral to the UAE's foreign trade strategy targeting $1 trillion in total trade value by 2031.
records.institution: The United Arab Emirates Government

records.description: VIV MEA 2025, the Middle East and Africa’s leading trade show for animal protein production and agribusiness, returns to the Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre (ADNEC) from November 25–27, 2025, in partnership with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA). Highlights include the dedicated Aquatic Pavilion and the VIV Industry Leaders (VIL) Program for senior executives, with over 30 conference sessions addressing critical issues like AI-powered solutions and intelligent water management.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Tanmiah Food Company, a leading Saudi producer, signed three Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) during the Saudi Agri-Food Tech Alliance...
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company, a leading Saudi producer, signed three Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) during the Saudi Agri-Food Tech Alliance (SAFTA) Forum to fast-track its decarbonization and enhance energy efficiency. The MoUs include a partnership with Schneider Electric to perform a carbon inventory under the SBTi framework, collaboration with Strataphy to deploy the region’s first geothermal-cooled poultry operation at its Shaqrah Facility under a Cooling as a Service (CaaS) model, and an agreement with Kayes Arabia to convert diesel-powered equipment to Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) systems. These strategic partnerships reflect Tanmiah’s commitment to innovation, sustainability, and contributing to Saudi Vision 2030 objectives for a cleaner food production ecosystem.

records.description: A comprehensive veterinary campaign was launched in Al-Hali District, Al-Hodeidah Governorate, to vaccinate and treat sheep against Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR). The campaign is being implemented through cooperation between the Al-Hali Cooperative Association and relevant authorities. The initiative aims to protect livestock, curb the spread of epidemic diseases, and enhance the immunity and productivity of sheep herds. This effort is emphasized as a fundamental part of national directions to prioritize the livestock sector and agriculture, thereby supporting food security and local development efforts toward self-sufficiency.

records.title: The Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reaffirmed the continued enforcement of the ban on importing foreign ra...
records.description: The Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reaffirmed the continued enforcement of the ban on importing foreign raisins, denying a widely circulated forged document that claimed the ban had been lifted. The Ministry stressed that the ban remains in effect to protect local producers, promote local production, and prevent the drain on foreign currency, which contributes to achieving self-sufficiency. The Ministry's Marketing Sector urged importers to comply with the official circular and emphasized that official decisions are published exclusively through verified channels.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia's state grains buying agency, the General Food Security Authority (GFSA), issued its sixth and final international tender fo...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's state grains buying agency, the General Food Security Authority (GFSA), issued its sixth and final international tender for 2025 to purchase around 300,000 tonnes of hard milling wheat, with delivery scheduled between February and April 2026. This purchase, divided across five vessels for Jeddah Islamic Port and Yanbu Commercial Port, is part of the GFSA's strategic plan to maintain wheat stocks and ensure the availability and price stability of food supplies. Concurrently, the Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAID) is exploring new investment opportunities in the Kingdom's agricultural and food industries to support the national strategy of strengthening food security and meeting Saudi Vision 2030 goals for self-sufficiency in key commodities.
records.institution: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA)

records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain announced that the Bahrain Animal and Agriculture Production Show (Mara’ee 2025) will be held under the patronage of His Majesty King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa. The exhibition, taking place at the Bahrain International Endurance Village, aims to support food security and strengthen local production by showcasing advanced agricultural technologies and expanding livestock development initiatives. The Minister highlighted the show's role as a scientific, technical, investment, and family-oriented event that reflects Bahrain’s commitment to sustainable agricultural development, with expanded activities including the Bahrain Mangrove Exhibition, a farmers’ market, and a date exhibition.

records.title: Global investments in the energy transition hit a new record of $2.4 trillion in 2024, a 20% increase from the prior two years' average,...
records.description: Global investments in the energy transition hit a new record of $2.4 trillion in 2024, a 20% increase from the prior two years' average, with $807 billion specifically directed toward renewable energy technologies. Despite this milestone, the year-on-year growth rate for renewables significantly slowed to 7.3% in 2024 (down from 32% in 2023). A major finding from the report by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) and the Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) is that 90% of energy transition investments remain concentrated in advanced economies and China, leaving emerging and developing countries behind. This gap highlights the urgent need for impact-driven capital like low-cost debt and grants, as nearly half of global investment is provided as market-rate debt, risking an exacerbation of debt burdens in lower-income nations.
records.institution: The International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA)

records.title: Nama Women Advancement (NAMA) announced the launch of the three-year “Nthanda Women Mushrooms Project” in Lilongwe, Malawi, running from...
records.description: Nama Women Advancement (NAMA) announced the launch of the three-year “Nthanda Women Mushrooms Project” in Lilongwe, Malawi, running from 2025 to 2028. Implemented in partnership with Zayane Creations Trust, the initiative aims to empower 900 rural women by establishing 45 women-led agricultural enterprises focused on mushroom cultivation. The project provides comprehensive training in technical, financial, and entrepreneurial skills, directly addressing the economic and social challenges faced by rural women in Malawi. This initiative is designed to create sustainable enterprises, increase household income, and promote environmental sustainability through drought-resilient irrigation practices, aligning with NAMA's global strategy to empower women and achieve the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
records.institution: Nama Women Advancement (NAMA)

records.title: The Kuwait Authority for Partnership Projects (KAPP) has opened bidding for a new 0.5-gigawatt (GW) solar project, covering the Al Dibdib...
records.description: The Kuwait Authority for Partnership Projects (KAPP) has opened bidding for a new 0.5-gigawatt (GW) solar project, covering the Al Dibdibah Power and Al Shagaya Renewable Energy Phase III. The project is being developed under a 30-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) to supply the Ministry of Electricity. Six pre-qualified consortia, including groups led by Masdar and ACWA Power, have been invited to submit proposals for the Independent Power Project (IPP). This initiative is part of Kuwait's effort to expand clean power generation and address severe power shortages caused by population growth and rising temperatures.
records.institution: The Kuwait Authority for Partnership Projects (KAPP)

records.title: Nama Water Services officially inaugurated the Al Shikhaikhat Renewed Water Network in the Wilayat of Barka, under the auspices of the Mi...
records.description: Nama Water Services officially inaugurated the Al Shikhaikhat Renewed Water Network in the Wilayat of Barka, under the auspices of the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. The first phase of the project, valued at over RO 2 million, includes 40 kilometers of pipelines supplying reclaimed water to 40 farms to support agricultural productivity and reduce pressure on groundwater. This initiative aligns with Oman Vision 2040 by promoting environmental sustainability and the circular economy. Nama also unveiled its new reclaimed water brand, Manhal Nama, and integrated the network with a central SCADA system and smart meters, marking a major step in the company's digital transformation journey.
records.institution: Nama Water Services

records.title: The Jazan Region is renowned for its significant livestock production, particularly cattle rearing, a longstanding tradition that provide...
records.description: The Jazan Region is renowned for its significant livestock production, particularly cattle rearing, a longstanding tradition that provides essential local food sources of milk, meat, and cheese. Current statistics from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) indicate approximately 130,161 cattle, underscoring the importance of this activity for local food security. MEWA is committed to enhancing this wealth by providing crucial support through regional branches and veterinary clinics, including preventive immunizations, disease diagnosis, and financial aid. This effort, supported by the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef), aims to boost livestock productivity and marketing, linking traditional practices with sustainable development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that Saudi Arabia is committed to reducing ozone-depleting compounds (ODCs)...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that Saudi Arabia is committed to reducing ozone-depleting compounds (ODCs) by 67.5% by the end of 2025, with the ultimate goal of complete elimination (100%) by 2030. This follows a phase-out plan that began with a 10% reduction in 2015 and reached 35% in 2020. The Minister stressed that relevant authorities must strictly adhere to the precise timelines for phasing out hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs) and comply fully with the Unified Law of the GCC regarding ozone-depleting substances. Furthermore, the regulations stipulate that prior environmental approval is required for any contracts or projects involving controlled materials listed in the Montreal Protocol.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Dubai International Food Safety Conference, organized by Dubai Municipality under the theme “Technology and Innovation in Food Safety...
records.description: The Dubai International Food Safety Conference, organized by Dubai Municipality under the theme “Technology and Innovation in Food Safety,” opened with over 3,500 participants and 225 international speakers. Organized in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), the International Association for Food Protection (IAFP), and the National Environmental Health Association, the conference examines leveraging emerging technologies to enhance food safety systems, reduce food waste, and support sustainable global food practices. Dubai Municipality launched several programs, including the "Food Safety Storytellers – Creators" initiative and the "AI Food Intelligence Guide," reinforcing Dubai's mission to achieve a safe, resilient, and sustainable food environment in line with the National Food Security Strategy 2051.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.title: The First Deputy Governor of Al Hodeidah inaugurated a series of campaigns for health awareness, agricultural guidance, and rural develop...
records.description: The First Deputy Governor of Al Hodeidah inaugurated a series of campaigns for health awareness, agricultural guidance, and rural development, along with an agricultural land reclamation project in the Bab Al-Naqa area of Bajil. These initiatives were organized by the Bajil Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society to strengthen food security and rural development. The implemented activities included health awareness programs, community guidance on dairy production, and the reclamation of neglected lands to enhance income sources for productive families. The Governor praised the association’s work in integrating health awareness with local food production and emphasized the governorate leadership’s support for such productive projects.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture witnessed the signing of nine new investment contracts to support the production of co...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture witnessed the signing of nine new investment contracts to support the production of coffee, almonds, fruits, and poultry in the Al-Baha Region, reflecting the Kingdom's commitment to Saudi Vision 2030. These contracts include establishing five new coffee cities for planting over 819,000 Arabica coffee trees, an almond city, and two poultry production projects. records.title: A land reclamation and watercourse rehabilitation project was launched in Bani Saad District, al-Mahwit Governorate, Yemen.

The initiative aims to reclaim land damaged by floods and rehabilitate irrigation channels to support the maize planting season, thereby boosting agricultural productivity and improving farmers' livelihoods. This project is highlighted as a crucial step in developing agricultural infrastructure and supporting national efforts toward food security and self-sufficiency.

records.title: The Qassim Region maintains a vibrant, year-round agricultural output, particularly in leafy greens, which are valued for their nutrition...
records.description: The Qassim Region maintains a vibrant, year-round agricultural output, particularly in leafy greens, which are valued for their nutritional richness and strong market demand. Local farmers are expanding cultivated areas as these greens are economically rewarding, easy to cultivate, and allow for multiple annual harvests with low cost. Farmers utilize modern methods like drip irrigation and temperature control in greenhouses to ensure high-quality, consistent production. This sector is actively supported by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture through training and guidance, which has been crucial for boosting productivity and promoting sustainable agricultural returns.

records.description: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP), Oman's sole procurer of new capacity, signed a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with a joint venture between Sembcorp and OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) to develop the 125 MW Dhofar II Wind Power Project. With an investment of approximately RO 43 million, the project will generate about 396,754 MWh of electricity annually enough to power over 18,000 Omani households. This strategic initiative, scheduled for commercial operation in Q3 2027, marks a key milestone in Oman’s commitment to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050 and the goals of Oman Vision 2040 by significantly reducing 158,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions and conserving approximately 76 million cubic meters of natural gas annually.

records.description: Beekeepers in the Najran Region harvested nearly 20,000 kilograms of natural Sidr honey last month, contributing significantly to the region's estimated annual production of 90 tons. Najran's environment is ideal for beekeeping due to its suitable weather and flowering plants. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef), has launched a rural development incubator to support entrepreneurs in beekeeping and honey production, enhancing their skills in strategic planning, business management, and marketing.

records.description: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) inaugurated a new Training and Knowledge Transfer Building, a Plant Tissue Culture Laboratory, and an Integrated Agri-Aquaculture System at its Dubai headquarters, fully funded by Al Rostamani Group. The inauguration, attended by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, marks a major milestone in strengthening ICBA’s role as a center for sustainable agriculture and innovation. The facilities will support farmers, researchers, and policymakers by developing water-efficient models and pioneering work in enabling crops to thrive in saline and arid environments, reinforcing the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy 2051.

records.description: Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP), Oman's sole offtaker for power and water projects, signed a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with a consortium led by Sembcorp Utilities and OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) to develop the 125-megawatt (MW) Dhofar II Wind Power Project. records.description: The Directorate of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Al Batinah North, Oman, organized the Water Security Seminar to highlight the importance of water sustainability and explore alternatives to groundwater. The event focused on two main themes: "Sustainable Water Wealth," which discussed modern technologies like advanced irrigation and water recycling, and "Investment Opportunities in the Water Sector." The seminar emphasized the urgent need to reduce dependence on groundwater and promote the use of treated wastewater and desalinated water as viable alternatives, underscoring the shared responsibility of protecting water resources in line with Oman Vision 2040's environmental sustainability goals.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has kicked off the distribution of 15 tonnes of improved and l...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has kicked off the distribution of 15 tonnes of improved and local wheat seeds to farmers across the Dhahirah Governorate. This initiative, which includes high-yielding, bird-resistant varieties like Wadi Quriyat 110, aims to promote strategic crop cultivation and enhance the Sultanate's self-sufficiency in wheat production. The MAFWR provides certified seeds, technical guidance, and on-field monitoring to ensure optimal yields. This effort is part of a broader national strategy under Oman Vision 2040 to expand wheat cultivation, improve seed quality, and enhance food resilience, especially given the sector's reliance on modern irrigation systems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman launched a new initiative to support Omani beekeepers and enhance the value of honeybee products like pollen, propolis, and royal jelly. The project seeks to strengthen commercial production by providing equipment, technical guidance, and monitoring. Applicants must be Omani citizens with a valid apiary license, own more than 150 beehives, and commit to meeting specific annual production targets. The initiative is being implemented in collaboration with the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund and aims to achieve sustainable growth in the sector, especially prioritizing jobseekers dedicated to beekeeping.

records.title: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ), through its Chairman, affirmed that the transition to green hydrog...
records.description: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ), through its Chairman, affirmed that the transition to green hydrogen as a primary energy source in the Special Economic Zone at Al Duqm (SEZAD) is firmly on track, although natural gas will serve as a crucial bridge fuel initially. The Integrated Gas Company (IGC) recently allocated 18.614 million standard cubic metres per day of gas for industrial consumers in Al Duqm, underscoring its growing industrial prominence. New projects, such as the green steel project and the refinery, are required to factor in a transition to green hydrogen from the design stage, aligning SEZAD's decarbonization efforts with Oman Vision 2040 and the nation’s Net Zero 2050 goal.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ)

records.title: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia achieved a major international milestone when the Codex Alimentarius Commission (CAC) adopted the first inter...
records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia achieved a major international milestone when the Codex Alimentarius Commission (CAC) adopted the first international standard for fresh dates during its 48th session at the FAO headquarters in Rome. This achievement took place while the Kingdom was co-chairing the working group, according to the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA). The development of this unified standard reflects the Kingdom's leading position as the world's largest exporter of dates and its influential role in shaping international food standards. The initiative, a close collaboration between the SFDA and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, aims to raise the quality and safety of dates, facilitate international trade, and align with Saudi Vision 2030 objectives to solidify the Kingdom as a global hub for date production and trade.
records.institution: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.title: The hospitality property "Erth" successfully activated its Food Waste Composter (Waste Master System) in October, marking a significant m...
records.description: The hospitality property "Erth" successfully activated its Food Waste Composter (Waste Master System) in October, marking a significant milestone in its commitment to sustainability. Since its activation, the system has processed over 1,150 kilograms of food waste, converting it into nutrient-rich compost for landscaping. This achievement diverts substantial waste from landfills and underscores "Erth" leadership in responsible, sustainable Emirati hospitality, contributing directly to the UAE’s vision for a cleaner, more sustainable future.
records.institution: The hospitality property "Erth"

records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain announced the return of the Bahraini Farmers’ Market, organized in cooperation with the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD) and STC Bahrain. The market, opening at the Budaiya Botanical Garden, will feature 32 Bahraini farmers, local brands, and artisans. records.description: Fourth Milling Co., one of the privatized milling entities in Saudi Arabia, signed a civil works agreement worth approximately SAR 265 million ($70.7 million) to begin construction of a major new flour mill and feed plant in Al-Kharj. The investment, which has received approval from the General Food Security Authority (GFSA), will fund a 750-tonne-per-day (tpd) flour mill and a new 240-tpd feed mill. This significant expansion aims to enhance the company's ability to serve domestic and regional demand for flour and animal feed, playing a key role in supporting the Kingdom’s national food security and self-sufficiency objectives under Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: Fourth Milling Co.

records.title: Tanmiah Food Company, a leading Saudi poultry producer, has partnered with the geothermal technology firm Strataphy to establish the MENA...
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company, a leading Saudi poultry producer, has partnered with the geothermal technology firm Strataphy to establish the MENA region's first geothermal-cooled poultry facility at its Shaqrah site. The project utilizes Strataphy's technology, which relies on stable subsurface temperatures, offering a high-efficiency, low-carbon alternative to conventional air conditioning. The system is implemented under Strataphy's Cooling as a Service (CAS) model. This initiative, which aligns with the objectives of the Saudi AgriFood Tech Alliance, aims to significantly reduce energy dependence in the agri-food sector and position Saudi Arabia as a potential leader in scalable, low-carbon agricultural technology.

This success reaffirms AlUla’s position as a leading agricultural hub and highlights the RCU's efforts to support farmers and boost the competitiveness of local products in global markets.

records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is aggressively advancing the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, a strategic pro...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is aggressively advancing the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, a strategic project that exemplifies the UAE's push for clean energy leadership. The festival serves as a leading platform to promote excellence, innovation, and sustainable practices in livestock production across all emirates.

records.description: Oxy Oman, a subsidiary of Occidental, has launched a first-of-its-kind pilot project using carbon dioxide CO₂ for enhanced oil recovery (EOR) in its Block 9 concession, with potential for replication across its portfolio. The project, launched in 2023 at the Safah Field, aims to increase oil recovery from mature fields while supporting Oman's decarbonization and net-zero ambitions. If successful, this initiative will integrate carbon capture and storage (CCS) with existing operations to deliver carbon-neutral oil. Additionally, Oxy signed an MoU with OQ Gas Networks (OQGN) to explore an integrated carbon management platform and is exploring renewable energy integration with OQ Alternative Energy.

records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in North Al Batinah Governorate, Oman, organized a water security symposium under the auspices of the Governor of North Al Batinah. The event featured two dialogue sessions on key water security issues. The symposium also included an exhibition showcasing equipment used for water quality testing and highlighting the Directorate's efforts in monitoring water quality and implementing water projects. The primary focus was on raising public awareness about preserving water resources and ensuring their sustainability for future generations.

records.description: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) issued Ministerial Decision No. 258/2025, announcing a ban on the import of live birds and related products from several European regions due to animal health concerns. The affected regions include Gelderland (Netherlands), Žilina (Slovakia), West Flanders and Antwerp (Belgium), Nordland (Norway), and Zeeland and the southern region of Denmark. The Ministry stated that the ban will remain in force until the health reasons are resolved. Products that have been heat-treated or processed in accordance with the World Organisation for Animal Health standards are exempt.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) officially opened the Al Wathba Food Festival as part of the Fourth Sheikh M...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) officially opened the Al Wathba Food Festival as part of the Fourth Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award. The festival aims to promote sustainable food security, encourage local production, and celebrate Emirati food heritage through 14 culinary competitions offering AED 362,000 in prizes. The event provides a crucial platform for productive families to showcase their talents and contribute to the local economy. It reinforces ADAFSA's commitment to empowering local farmers and advancing the UAE Food Security Strategy 2051 by blending heritage with innovation.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The largest edition of Global Food Week concluded in Abu Dhabi with historic success, securing 58 agreements valued at Dh6.6 billion and...
records.description: The largest edition of Global Food Week concluded in Abu Dhabi with historic success, securing 58 agreements valued at Dh6.6 billion and attracting over 40,108 attendees (a 16% increase). Held under the patronage of the Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the week featured major exhibitions like the Abu Dhabi International Food Exhibition and the Abu Dhabi Date Palm Exhibition, alongside new initiatives. These included the debut AgriTech Forum and the Agricultural Investment Forum, aimed at empowering food producers, fostering sustainable development, and showcasing over 30 investment opportunities. Key discussions focused on food security, resilient food systems, innovation, technology, and best global practices, while the launch of the Alternative Proteins Initiative (PALT) by the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) highlighted innovations in plant-based and cultivated protein products.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, launched a 20-day national veterinary campaign to vaccinate and treat livestock ac...
records.description: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, launched a 20-day national veterinary campaign to vaccinate and treat livestock across 13 districts. The campaign aims to protect over 650,000 heads of livestock from widespread diseases like sheep plague and smallpox, thereby ensuring the sustainability of income sources for thousands of families and supporting the national economy. The initiative is being implemented by 39 field teams comprising 156 veterinarians, with support and guidance from the Ministry of Agriculture's General Directorate of Animal Health and Veterinary Quarantine and local authorities. The launch included a training workshop for participants to ensure maximum efficiency and comprehensive coverage of all targeted areas.
records.institution: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Jawf Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture signed agreements to allocate six agricultural plots in Hoorat A'ali, covering 40,...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture signed agreements to allocate six agricultural plots in Hoorat A'ali, covering 40,138 square meters, to Bahraini farmers through a public auction on the Government Land Investment Platform. This initiative, supported by the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD), is part of the Ministry's strategy to strengthen food security and develop the agricultural sector. The allocated plots come equipped with essential infrastructure, including treated and desalinated water and irrigation networks, to empower local farmers and expand sustainable local production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that the Governor of Riyadh Region will inaugurate and lay the foundation st...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that the Governor of Riyadh Region will inaugurate and lay the foundation stone for 181 environmental, water, and agricultural projects in the Riyadh Region, with a massive total cost exceeding SAR 38.1 billion. The projects, which include 82 initiatives costing over SAR 9.8 billion and 99 new projects worth SAR 28.3 billion, aim to enhance sustainability, improve the quality of services provided to citizens, and strengthen food and water security in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture
