records.title: Dubai Municipality has opened registration for the fifth season of the Farmers’ Market, set to run from December 6, 2025, to February 8,...
records.description: Dubai Municipality has opened registration for the fifth season of the Farmers’ Market, set to run from December 6, 2025, to February 8, 2026, at Quranic Park in Al Khawaneej. The initiative brings together 41 Emirati farmers and 16 local product and agricultural supply owners to showcase their fresh and organic goods directly to consumers. The market supports farm and business development, aims to boost local agricultural output, and encourages sustainable practices, aligning with Dubai Municipality’s efforts to strengthen local agriculture through logistical assistance, training, and advisory services.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.title: SALIC, a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and global agri-tech leader Syngenta Crop Protection AG (Syngenta), have signed...
records.description: SALIC, a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and global agri-tech leader Syngenta Crop Protection AG (Syngenta), have signed a Letter of Intent (LOI) to explore joint projects aimed at creating a resilient agri-food sector in Saudi Arabia and globally. The collaboration will focus on areas like sustainable farming, digital agriculture, soil health, and crop protection solutions. Potential projects include climate-smart farming, water conservation, and the creation of centers of excellence for capacity building and knowledge transfer. Both entities affirm that this strategic partnership is intended to enhance resource efficiency and strengthen the Kingdom’s food security.
records.institution: SALIC

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has announced a tender for consultancy services related to the Fisher...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has announced a tender for consultancy services related to the Fishery Industries City in South Al Sharqiyah Governorate. This key strategic initiative is designed to develop modern infrastructure that supports the growth of fishery industries and enhances the value-added of the fisheries sector. The project aims to strengthen supply chains, attract local and foreign investment, and implement sustainable solutions to promote a sustainable blue economy. Specialized companies are invited to submit their bids through the eTendering platform.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has enforced a new directive requiring importers of selected agricult...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has enforced a new directive requiring importers of selected agricultural products to register their consignments with the Agricultural Quarantine Department prior to the goods' arrival. Shipments arriving without this essential pre-registration will be rejected, and the Ministry explicitly stated it will not bear responsibility for them. This move comes as Oman's imports of fruits and vegetables are growing, with the import value of vegetables alone surging by 44.9% to $110.5 million in a recent period.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Agricultural Development Fund (ADF) will participate in the Biban Forum 2025 in Riyadh, organized by the Small and Medium Enterprises...
records.description: The Agricultural Development Fund (ADF) will participate in the Biban Forum 2025 in Riyadh, organized by the Small and Medium Enterprises General Authority (Monsha’at). The ADF will use its dedicated pavilion to showcase financing programs and products to investors and entrepreneurs in the agricultural sector. These programs cover a wide range of projects, including greenhouses, poultry farming, aquaculture, veterinary facilities, and agricultural/food product factories. The Fund's participation is designed to promote financing solutions that support sustainable agricultural transformation and help investors capitalize on promising opportunities within the Kingdom's agricultural sector.
records.institution: Monsha’at

records.title: A two-day symposium focused on "Using Available Water Resources in Al Buraimi and Al Dhahirah Governorates to Enhance the Sustainability...
records.description: A two-day symposium focused on "Using Available Water Resources in Al Buraimi and Al Dhahirah Governorates to Enhance the Sustainability of Projects" kicked off in Al Buraimi Governorate, Oman. The symposium is organized by the Oman Water Society in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Office of the Governor of Al Buraimi. The goal is to assess scopes for agricultural investment and related industries, study current water challenges, and explore ways to achieve the sustainability of projects related to farming, food security, and industry.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman issued a ministerial decision prohibiting the fishing, collect...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman issued a ministerial decision prohibiting the fishing, collection, possession, and trade of abalones during the 2025 fishing season. This ban covers all related activities, including its preparation, export, handling, transport, sale, and distribution. The prohibition aims to protect abalone stocks and ensure the sustainability of marine life in Omani waters. Quantities legally registered with relevant authorities from previous seasons are exempt, provided they do not exceed the set limits.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has signed a collaboration agreement with the National Company for Agricultural Services (NCAS) to a...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has signed a collaboration agreement with the National Company for Agricultural Services (NCAS) to advance specialized agriculture and veterinary services in AlUla. The partnership aims to elevate service quality and strengthen the farmer experience by establishing unified standards for laboratories, plant and animal quarantine, market operations, and streamlined licensing. This initiative, which includes joint efforts on advisory studies, training programs, and agricultural festivals, reflects the RCU’s commitment to advancing the agricultural sector as a pillar of sustainable economic development and aligns with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is spearheading a joint initiative with the Quality and Conformity Council (...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is spearheading a joint initiative with the Quality and Conformity Council (QCC) and the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) to develop a new regulatory framework for novel foods like cultivated meat and precision fermentation-based dairy. This framework aims to reduce product approval timelines by six to nine months and will simplify procedures by consolidating product registration, halal certification, and permits into a single contact point.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched a project in Taiz Governorate to distribute seeds for maize, beans,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched a project in Taiz Governorate to distribute seeds for maize, beans, and wheat to agricultural cooperatives and district branches. The project is funded by the local authority through the Unit for Financing Agricultural and Fishery Projects and Initiatives. The launch included the distribution of 30 tons of maize seeds, 2 tons of wheat, and 2 tons of beans from the governorate's seed bank. This strategic step aims to enhance local production, achieve self-sufficiency, and develop the local seed system with modern agricultural standards to reduce import costs and strengthen national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources' Animal Wealth Department in Al Dhahirah Governorate, Oman, is spearheading st...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources' Animal Wealth Department in Al Dhahirah Governorate, Oman, is spearheading strategic projects to bolster the national food security framework under Oman Vision 2040. The relevant authorities have signed seven investment contracts worth approximately OMR35 million across over five thousand acres. Key projects include the "Gulf International Poultry Farm," which produces about one million eggs daily, and new ventures like the Al Nour Al Haditha Company project for eggs and liquid egg products, all aiming to drive self-sufficiency in high-quality livestock products.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources' Animal Wealth Department

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: QatarEnergy has awarded the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contract to Samsung C&T Corporation for a landmark carbon ca...
records.description: QatarEnergy has awarded the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contract to Samsung C&T Corporation for a landmark carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) project. The new facility is set to capture up to 4.1 million tons of $\text{CO}_2$ per annum, making it one of the world’s largest CCS projects and strongly supporting Qatar’s National Climate Change Action Plan. This initiative is a critical part of QatarEnergy's strategy to capture over 11 million tons of $\text{CO}_2$ by 2035, reinforcing its position as a reliable provider of affordable lower-carbon energy.
records.institution: QatarEnergy

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced four new investment opportunities in the Jazan Region to promote self-su...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced four new investment opportunities in the Jazan Region to promote self-sufficiency and food security, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. The investments include establishing an agricultural city in Abu Arish focusing on fruit cultivation and a project for hydroponic farming greenhouses in Damad Governorate. Additionally, two large opportunities were announced in the livestock sector in Farasan Governorate for breeding, fattening, and red meat production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Second Edition of the Water Partnerships Forum will launch in Riyadh, hosted and organized by the Saudi Water Partnerships Company.
records.description: The Second Edition of the Water Partnerships Forum will launch in Riyadh, hosted and organized by the Saudi Water Partnerships Company. The event, held under the patronage of the Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture, will serve as a strategic platform to strengthen cooperation between the public and private sectors. With over 50 local and international speakers, the forum aims to combine expertise with advanced solutions to build a sustainable water future. This initiative directly supports Saudi Vision 2030 objectives related to sustainability, resource management efficiency, and the development of water infrastructure.
records.institution: The Saudi Water Partnerships Company

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) officially launched the festivals and 77 accompanying competitions of the Fo...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) officially launched the festivals and 77 accompanying competitions of the Fourth Edition of the Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Award for Agricultural Excellence. This prestigious award, held at the Sheikh Zayed Festival, celebrates excellence and innovation across the UAE's agricultural and food sectors. The events include five major specialized festivals: the Al Wathba Food Festival, the Al Wathba Agricultural Festival, the Livestock Festival, the Honey Festival, and the Flower Festival. These platforms reinforce the nation's drive toward sustainability and food security by connecting producers with consumers and fostering a culture of innovation, with dedicated competitions now including youth participants.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Oman has earmarked US$97 million for new food security initiatives, announced at the conclusion of the Food Security Lab, as part of the...
records.description: Oman has earmarked US$97 million for new food security initiatives, announced at the conclusion of the Food Security Lab, as part of the country's broader strategy under Oman Vision 2040. The funding supports the rollout of 27 investment projects and 31 enabling initiatives aimed at boosting domestic production and enhancing self-sufficiency. The largest share of this new funding, $81.4 million, is allocated to the fisheries sector, underscoring the nation's aquaculture potential. These efforts are complemented by local agricultural projects, such as large-scale garlic cultivation in Dhofar Governorate, and infrastructure investments like the Integrated Food Market and Khasab Port expansion.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID), based in Dubai, has launched operations at a new fish-processing...
records.description: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID), based in Dubai, has launched operations at a new fish-processing plant in Nouadhibou, Mauritania, described as the largest in North Africa. The plant, valued at approximately US$28 million, has an annual processing capacity of 100,000 metric tons and cold storage for up to 10,000 metric tons. The facility, which is run by AAAID's subsidiary, the Arab Mauritanian Fish Company (SAMAK), is supported by the Mauritanian government as part of its strategy to process more of the national catch domestically. The project is expected to generate hundreds of jobs, strengthen Mauritania's industrial base, and increase foreign exchange earnings through exports of fish products, fish oil, and fish powder.
records.institution: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) delivered 55 diverse modern agricultural machines to farmers in Yemen's Had...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) delivered 55 diverse modern agricultural machines to farmers in Yemen's Hadhramout Governorate. This initiative is part of a sustainable agriculture project aimed at enhancing agricultural resilience and boosting productivity through modern mechanization. The equipment provided included hand tillers, threshing tools, and farm-spraying and cutting machines. The project also included a training program to help farmers operate and maintain the equipment, along with providing fuel supplies, all to facilitate plowing and harvesting while significantly reducing costs and labor.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief)

records.title: Vegetable farming in Saudi Arabia's Taif Governorate is a key agricultural activity that significantly contributes to strengthening the K...
records.description: Vegetable farming in Saudi Arabia's Taif Governorate is a key agricultural activity that significantly contributes to strengthening the Kingdom’s food security. Due to its fertile soil and moderate, year-round climate, Taif is a leading producer of a wide variety of vegetables in the Makkah region, including tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplant, and peppers. The favorable conditions allow for multi-season cultivation and a continuous supply of high-quality produce, particularly in winter. Taif also serves as the primary distribution hub for vegetables to neighboring cities.
records.institution: Taif Governorate

records.title: Yokogawa Saudi Arabia has been awarded a contract by the Royal Commission for Riyadh City to provide the command and control systems for...
records.description: Yokogawa Saudi Arabia has been awarded a contract by the Royal Commission for Riyadh City to provide the command and control systems for the major Green Riyadh project. This massive afforestation initiative aims to plant 7.5 million trees and will use treated wastewater for irrigation. Yokogawa's systems will act as a unified platform for real-time monitoring and predictive analytics to optimize the management of water resources and urban infrastructure, supporting the project's goals of improving air quality and
records.institution: Yokogawa Saudi Arabia

records.title: The Musandam Global Investment Company (MGIC), through its new branch MP World, has launched a strategic initiative by signing a 10-year...
records.description: The Musandam Global Investment Company (MGIC), through its new branch MP World, has launched a strategic initiative by signing a 10-year agreement with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources for the development and operation of the Khasab Fishery Port. This agreement is exclusively designated to advance Oman's fisheries infrastructure and support the nation's growing blue economy. MGIC, a publicly listed company on the Muscat Stock Exchange (MSX), aims for MP World to eventually manage additional commercial, industrial, and logistics ports, reinforcing Musandam’s strategic role as a maritime gateway.
records.institution: The Musandam Global Investment Company (MGIC)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi energy company, was awarded two solar photovoltaic (PV) projects with a combined capacity of 2 gigawatts (GW) under...
records.description: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi energy company, was awarded two solar photovoltaic (PV) projects with a combined capacity of 2 gigawatts (GW) under Saudi Arabia's National Renewable Energy Program (NREP). These Independent Power Producer (IPP) projects, for the Najran and Ad Darb facilities, will be developed on a Build, Own, and Operate (BOO) basis under a 25-year power purchase agreement with the Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC). The award significantly expands Masdar's portfolio in the Kingdom, supporting Saudi Vision 2030's renewable energy targets.
records.institution: Masdar

records.title: Oman is nearing the launch of its first-ever sugar refinery at Sohar Port and Freezone, a major step toward domestic production and reduc...
records.description: Oman is nearing the launch of its first-ever sugar refinery at Sohar Port and Freezone, a major step toward domestic production and reduced reliance on imports. The advanced facility is in the final stages of commissioning by the German engineering firm BMA. Once operational, the Oman Sugar Refinery will have a daily production capacity of 3,000 tonnes of refined white sugar. The complex, which includes a massive 30,000-metric-tonne capacity DomeSilo, is designed for low energy consumption and high efficiency, marking a significant milestone in Oman's industrial diversification and aiming to strengthen its position as a regional player in the sugar industry.
records.institution: Oman Sugar Refinery

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) is affirming its commitment to supporting and enhancing afforestation...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) is affirming its commitment to supporting and enhancing afforestation across the Kingdom by empowering small farmers with training and providing them with seedlings of environmentally compatible varieties. These efforts align with the Saudi Green Initiative and Saudi Vision 2030. Since its launch until 2024, Saudi Reef successfully planted more than 15.5 million seedlings across all regions of the Kingdom. The fruit sector accounted for the largest share with 12.6 million seedlings, while the coffee and rose sectors contributed 1.8 million and 1.1 million seedlings, respectively.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: Ghitha Holding PJSC, a subsidiary of IHC, reported strong financial results for the nine months, with revenue climbing to AED 4.0 billion...
records.description: Ghitha Holding PJSC, a subsidiary of IHC, reported strong financial results for the nine months, with revenue climbing to AED 4.0 billion and operating profit rising by 41.1%. The growth was driven by strategic acquisitions, including the realignment of agricultural operations via NRTC Food Holding LLC, and its role in forming Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG). Ghitha is now set to merge with other IHC entities into a single AED 120 billion investment powerhouse, reinforcing its leadership in food and resource security.
records.institution: Ghitha Holding

records.title: Provisur Technologies and IMA Group will showcase their advanced processing and packaging solutions at Gulfood Manufacturing 2025 in Duba...
records.description: Provisur Technologies and IMA Group will showcase their advanced processing and packaging solutions at Gulfood Manufacturing 2025 in Dubai, highlighting the push for automation in food production. Provisur will feature its latest industrial food processing systems, including the Formax® forming system for shaping meat products and separation equipment designed to maximize protein recovery. Meanwhile, IMA Group will present integrated processing, filling, dosing, and packaging technologies across multiple food categories, from dairy to confectionery.
records.institution: Provisur Technologies and IMA Group

records.title: The Mayor of the capital of Yemen, launched the first phase of a project to rehabilitate and deepen four water wells for the agricultural...
records.description: The Mayor of the capital of Yemen, launched the first phase of a project to rehabilitate and deepen four water wells for the agricultural sector and operate them with solar energy. This project has a cost of 140 million Yemeni riyals. The initiative is funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit in Sana'a, and aims to enhance water resources for the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Yemeni Government

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has banned the import of bottled water and its products from the Islam...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has banned the import of bottled water and its products from the Islamic Republic of Iran. The suspension was enacted under Ministerial Decision No. 241/2025 and took effect immediately. The decision is based on Oman's Food Safety Law and its accompanying regulations. The Ministry stated that the ban will remain in place until the reasons for the order are resolved and an official decision is made to lift the suspension.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia has received ISO 42001 accreditation for its artificial intelligence (...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia has received ISO 42001 accreditation for its artificial intelligence (AI) management systems. This achievement is the culmination of the ministry's efforts to establish a comprehensive AI governance system that ensures the safe and effective use of AI technologies. The system focuses on risk assessment, transparency, accountability, and adherence to regulations. The accreditation highlights the Ministry's commitment to advancing digital transformation, promoting innovation, and supporting decision-making to enhance productivity and sustainability across the environment, water, and agriculture sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia launched “Saudi Pomegranate Week” across local retail markets to promo...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia launched “Saudi Pomegranate Week” across local retail markets to promote local varieties and enhance marketing efficiency. This initiative aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals by supporting farmers and boosting economic returns. Saudi Arabia cultivates pomegranates over approximately 2,000 hectares, with an annual production of around 37,000 tons. Cultivation is primarily concentrated in the Al-Baha, Aseer, Makkah, Madinah, and Tabuk regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Environment Authority (EA) of Oman is adopting innovative financial policies to meet the Sultanate's 2050 carbon neutrality objective...
records.description: The Environment Authority (EA) of Oman is adopting innovative financial policies to meet the Sultanate's 2050 carbon neutrality objectives by securing funding from the Green Climate Fund (GCF). This strategic effort includes developing the National Adaptation Plan (NAP) and facilitating access to green financing through partnerships with bodies like the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI). The initiative supports Oman Vision 2040 by financing projects crucial for coastal resilience, protecting water resources, and supporting sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The Environment Authority (EA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman imposed a ban on the import of live birds and their products f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman imposed a ban on the import of live birds and their products from three regions—Ardabil (Iran), Drenthe (Netherlands), and Veneto (Italy)—due to animal health concerns. This preventive measure, issued under the national Veterinary Quarantine Law, will remain in effect until the health risks are resolved. Despite rising local production, the country remains a net importer of poultry, making the ban a crucial step in protecting the safety of domestic poultry supplies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The General Corporation for the Development and Production of Grains in Yemen, under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheri...
records.description: The General Corporation for the Development and Production of Grains in Yemen, under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, launched the harvest and purchase of the bean crop in Dhamar District. This strategic initiative, implemented in partnership with the Mikhlaf Manqadha Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association, aims to achieve self-sufficiency in legumes by providing support for seed supply and guaranteed crop purchase. The locally produced crop will be designated as seeds for distribution, directly contributing to reducing the annual import bill and enhancing national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Olive presses in Saudi Arabia's Tabuk Region have started receiving the harvest from over 1.5 million olive trees, signaling the start of...
records.description: Olive presses in Saudi Arabia's Tabuk Region have started receiving the harvest from over 1.5 million olive trees, signaling the start of an anticipated abundant olive season. The Ministry of Environment, Water and None Agriculture's Tabuk branch estimates production will reach 94,000 tons of olives, yielding more than 12,250 tons of oil. Tabuk is a prominent region for olive production due to its temperate climate and fertile soil, and it also contributes significantly to the production of various fruits, reflecting the region's agricultural strength and prosperity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and None Agriculture's Tabuk branch

records.title: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) of Saudi Arabia purchased approximately 500,000 metric tonnes of wheat from Saudi investors op...
records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) of Saudi Arabia purchased approximately 500,000 metric tonnes of wheat from Saudi investors operating overseas in its second dedicated tender. This procurement is a key part of the Kingdom's strategy to enhance food security by diversifying sourcing channels and securing supply directly from Saudi-backed farming ventures abroad. The investor-sourced supply will complement traditional international tenders to meet the national consumption demand of about 4.6 million tonnes.
records.institution: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) signed five strategic Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) during Global Food W...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) signed five strategic Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) during Global Food Week to expand its partnership network and reinforce Abu Dhabi's position as an agricultural innovation hub. The agreements cover crucial areas, including delivering specialized technical training with the Ministry of Defence, developing an advanced trade framework for perishable agricultural products with ADIO and Abu Dhabi Customs, and promoting joint research in arid-environment agriculture with the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA). These collaborations strengthen the sector's sustainability and competitiveness by integrating government, military, research, and private sector efforts.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC), and the Abu Dhabi Inv...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC), and the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) launched a strategic initiative to develop a new regulatory framework for novel foods. This collaboration aims to accelerate the adoption of advanced solutions, such as alternative proteins, by establishing a streamlined, single-point registration system. The new framework will reduce the registration period by up to nine months, strengthen Abu Dhabi's position as a competitive global hub for food innovation, and support the UAE's National Food Security Strategy 2051.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The General Corporation for Grain Development and Production in Yemen, under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and...
records.description: The General Corporation for Grain Development and Production in Yemen, under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, launched a Soybean Seed Multiplication Project in the Bajil District of Al-Hodeidah. The initiative involves distributing 800 bags of seeds across 1,000 hectares to 300 farmers. This project is a practical step toward expanding the cultivation of strategic crops, strengthening food security, and advancing the national goal of self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The General Corporation for Grain Development and Production, Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Training courses on beekeeping, honey production, and marketing concluded in four districts of Yemen's Al-Bayda Governorate, training 200...
records.description: Training courses on beekeeping, honey production, and marketing concluded in four districts of Yemen's Al-Bayda Governorate, training 200 participants over six days. The program was organized by the Ministry of Agriculture's General Directorate of Animal Wealth and Technical Committee and supported by the Yemeni Red Crescent Society and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). This initiative is part of an economic empowerment program focused on developing local resources, improving the quality of Yemeni honey, and advancing the national goal of self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) has unveiled Oman's first electric locomotive, a project undertaken in partnership with the Ministry of Commerce,...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) has unveiled Oman's first electric locomotive, a project undertaken in partnership with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion and the Royal Oman Police. This sustainable initiative aims to fortify the food security sector and supports Oman's commitment to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050. records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has reaffirmed the prohibition of cryptocurrency mining on agricultural land, an activity that contradicts the purpose of farm use and negatively impacts sustainability and biosecurity. records.description: The second Unaizah International Dates Forum has been inaugurated in the Qassim Region, with broad participation from local and international experts. Organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates in cooperation with the Unaizah Chamber of Commerce and the International Dates Council, the forum focuses on sustainability, innovation, and modern technologies in the palm and date sector. The program includes scientific sessions and workshops aimed at addressing challenges and exploring opportunities from farm to global markets.
records.institution: National Center for Palms and Dates

records.title: The Tanmiah Food Company, a leading poultry and food producer, has launched two new facilities in Saudi Arabia's central region: a poultr...
records.description: The Tanmiah Food Company, a leading poultry and food producer, has launched two new facilities in Saudi Arabia's central region: a poultry processing plant in Al-Majma’ah and a feed mill in Dahna. Inaugurated under the patronage of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, these facilities are part of Tanmiah's commitment to advancing food security, enhancing operational efficiency, and creating local jobs in line with Saudi Vision 2030. The Majmaa 2 plant, which features the latest technology, has a biological wastewater treatment system that recycles water for tree plantations. The Dahna Feed Mill, with a capacity of 40 metric tons per hour, further reinforces the company’s integrated business model. These projects are complemented by the company's "One Million Trees" initiative and other sustainability efforts, reflecting a commitment to environmental responsibility and innovation.
records.institution: Tanmiah Food Company

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman has signed a technical cooperation agreement with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to implement a...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman has signed a technical cooperation agreement with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to implement a master plan for the development of the Al Najd area in Dhofar Governorate. The agreement, signed by officials from Oman's Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and JICA, aims to leverage the area's natural potential, including abundant water resources and fertile lands, to attract agricultural investment and boost domestic production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Grape and Pomegranate Cultural Festival is set to launch in Taif Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agr...
records.description: The Grape and Pomegranate Cultural Festival is set to launch in Taif Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in partnership with the private sector. For the first time, the festival will feature an auction for the finest varieties of grapes and pomegranates, alongside cultural events and programs. The festival aims to support seasonal agricultural products, open new marketing channels for farmers, and boost the governorate’s economic and tourism activity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia will host the 27th session of the Near East Forestry and Range Commission in Jeddah, a collaborative effort w...
records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia will host the 27th session of the Near East Forestry and Range Commission in Jeddah, a collaborative effort with the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification. The session will focus on integrated solutions for forests and rangelands to mitigate the effects of climate change, improve food systems, and support sustainable rural development. Key topics include land restoration, combating desertification, and the use of artificial intelligence for climate-resilient land systems.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.title: The Yemen Bounty Festival is set to kick off its second season in Sana'a, organized by the Capital Sana'a Local Council and the Ministry...
records.description: The Yemen Bounty Festival is set to kick off its second season in Sana'a, organized by the Capital Sana'a Local Council and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources. The five-day event aims to reinforce Yemen's agricultural reputation by highlighting the quality and diversity of its products and opening new prospects for marketing and investment. This year's festival will particularly focus on key crops such as pomegranates, grapes, apples, and dates. It will feature a range of activities including exhibitions, workshops, and seminars, serving as a national platform to encourage farmers to improve crop quality and promote the agricultural sector to enhance its global competitiveness.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The first Bahrain Veterinary Conference and Exhibition has been inaugurated, with broad local and international participation.
records.description: The first Bahrain Veterinary Conference and Exhibition has been inaugurated, with broad local and international participation. The two-day event emphasizes Bahrain's dedication to supporting the livestock sector, which is considered a crucial element of the nation's food security and sustainable development goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: Oman has initiated its first pilot oyster farming project on Masirah Island to diversify food resources and bolster the economy in line w...
records.description: Oman has initiated its first pilot oyster farming project on Masirah Island to diversify food resources and bolster the economy in line with Oman Vision 2040. The project, implemented by a private company, utilizes a semi-automated system imported from New Zealand to efficiently raise oysters. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, this aquaculture initiative is a crucial, sustainable solution to meet the growing national demand for seafood, which is increasing with the country's economic and social development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Development Bank of Oman received a Sustainable Project Finance Award from the European Organization for Sustainable Development (EOSD).
records.description: The Development Bank of Oman received a Sustainable Project Finance Award from the European Organization for Sustainable Development (EOSD). The award recognizes the bank's efforts in financing sustainable farming projects in Al Najd, Dhofar, an agricultural zone crucial to Oman's food security and economic diversification.
records.institution: The Development Bank of Oman

records.title: Tadweer Group has launched a new company, Tadweer Collection (Tajmee’e), to revolutionize waste collection in Abu Dhabi.
records.description: Tadweer Group has launched a new company, Tadweer Collection (Tajmee’e), to revolutionize waste collection in Abu Dhabi. This initiative is a critical step towards a cleaner and more sustainable emirate, aligning with the UAE's national environmental goals and circular economy vision. The new company will use AI-powered systems for route optimization and digitally-enabled safety monitoring tools to enhance operational efficiency, reduce emissions, and improve safety standards. This next-generation fleet is designed to provide consistent, high-quality service while delivering measurable benefits in emissions reduction and resource recovery, positioning the group as a leader in sustainable waste management.
records.institution: Tadweer Group

records.title: In the Al-Hodeidah governorate, several economic empowerment projects have been launched with a total cost exceeding 1.032 billion riyals...
records.description: In the Al-Hodeidah governorate, several economic empowerment projects have been launched with a total cost exceeding 1.032 billion riyals, aimed at transforming aid-dependent families into self-sufficient producers. These projects, funded by the General Authority for Zakat and implemented by the General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Projects, include the distribution of cows to hundreds of families to create sustainable income and enhance food security. Additionally, support is being provided to the palm sector through the distribution of solar systems to farmers to help replant hundreds of thousands of damaged palm trees, thereby reviving a crucial agricultural resource and strengthening the local economy.
records.institution: General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Projects

records.title: Oman’s first utility-scale solar and battery storage project will be developed through a partnership between Nama Power and Water Procure...
records.description: Oman’s first utility-scale solar and battery storage project will be developed through a partnership between Nama Power and Water Procurement and a consortium led by Masdar alongside Al Khadra Partners, Korea Midland Power, and OQ Alternative Energy. The Ibri III Independent Power Project will combine a 500 MW solar photovoltaic plant with a 100 MWh battery energy storage system, covering nearly 10 million square meters. With an investment of around $299 million, the project will reduce carbon dioxide emissions by about 505,000 tonnes annually, contribute up to 4 percent of renewable energy to the national electricity mix, and advance Oman’s Vision 2040 goals of energy diversification, sustainability, and enhanced energy security.
records.institution: OQ Alternative Energy OQAE

records.title: The Janaen Salalah Project, led by Omran Group’s subsidiary Janaen in partnership with Oman Agriculture Development, is a landmark agri-t...
records.description: The Janaen Salalah Project, led by Omran Group’s subsidiary Janaen in partnership with Oman Agriculture Development, is a landmark agri-tourism initiative in Dhofar Governorate that combines large-scale farming with tourism experiences. Spanning over 786,000 square metres, the project will cultivate coconuts, papayas, and cashews—introducing cashew farming commercially in Oman for the first time—while implementing advanced irrigation and sustainable agricultural systems. By integrating modern agriculture with interactive tourism activities, the project aims to strengthen food security, promote sustainable use of natural resources, create jobs, support SMEs, and establish Oman as a distinctive agri-tourism destination.
records.institution: Janaen

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched three private sector investment opportunities in the Makkah Region to boo...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched three private sector investment opportunities in the Makkah Region to boost agricultural development, vegetation cover, and food security. These include establishing an agricultural city for fruit tree cultivation and marketing services in Al-Qunfudhah, setting up a seedling nursery in Adham, and creating a wild seedling nursery in Al-Qunfudhah. The initiatives aim to attract investors through the “Furas” platform, supporting local production, job creation, and the broader goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG) and Food Tech Valley have partnered to establish a 260,000-square-foot logistics hub in Dubai aimed at boosting...
records.description: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG) and Food Tech Valley have partnered to establish a 260,000-square-foot logistics hub in Dubai aimed at boosting food distribution efficiency and sustainability. The project will cut delivery distances, reduce carbon emissions by an estimated 2,500 tonnes annually, and lower fleet-related emissions by up to 35 percent, while increasing distribution efficiency by about 33 percent. Scheduled to begin construction in late 2025 and complete in early 2027, the hub will create over 100 jobs and feature advanced technologies. Designed to support AAFG’s integrated operations in dairy, poultry, eggs, and juices, the facility aligns with the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy 2051 and Net Zero 2050 goals, while strengthening supply chains and positioning Dubai as a leader in food innovation and resilience.
records.institution: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG)

records.title: The United Arab Emirates has announced a nationwide ban on single-use plastic products, covering the import, production, and trade of ite...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates has announced a nationwide ban on single-use plastic products, covering the import, production, and trade of items such as cups, lids, cutlery, food containers, and plates. The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment confirmed the measure as part of the country’s broader transition toward a circular economy and sustainable waste management. Abu Dhabi’s Environment Agency (EAD) has already pioneered incentive-based bottle return schemes that recovered over 130 million bottles, while Dubai and Sharjah have each introduced bans and restrictions on plastic bags and other single-use items. The policy reflects the UAE’s commitment to protecting the environment, cutting plastic waste at the source, and encouraging businesses and consumers to adopt reusable alternatives, positioning the country among a growing group of nations phasing out single-use plastics.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.title: Bahrain signed an agreement with the International Dates Council to establish the International Date Observatory, which will serve as a g...
records.description: Bahrain signed an agreement with the International Dates Council to establish the International Date Observatory, which will serve as a global hub for collecting, analyzing, and publishing data on the date industry to support transparency, international trade, and Bahrain’s agricultural heritage. The observatory aims to provide a reliable reference for decision-makers and member countries, reflecting Bahrain’s efforts to strengthen its position as a regional and international center for the date sector. Hosting the observatory highlights Bahrain’s role in promoting agricultural innovation and advancing the date industry as a knowledge- and innovation-driven sector in line with global cooperation and development goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities and Agriculture

records.title: The inaugural IFAT Saudi Arabia exhibition will debut in Riyadh to serve as a hub for environmental innovation, focusing on technologies...
records.description: The inaugural IFAT Saudi Arabia exhibition will debut in Riyadh to serve as a hub for environmental innovation, focusing on technologies related to waste, water, and the environment. Organized by dmg events and licensed by Messe München, with the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) as a key partner, the event is timed to support over $192 billion in private investment opportunities in the kingdom’s waste and water sectors. The exhibition aligns closely with Saudi Vision 2030 and Net Zero 2060 goals, aiming to accelerate technology adoption to achieve targets such as meeting 90% of water demand through desalination by 2030 and a 90% landfill diversion rate by 2040. The event will feature over 450 exhibitors and a strategic summit for policymakers.
records.institution: National Center for Waste Management (MWAN)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has adopted 40 innovative technologies for water treatment and reuse, such as algae-ba...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has adopted 40 innovative technologies for water treatment and reuse, such as algae-based treatment, nanobubbles, zero liquid discharge, pyrolysis, and AI-assisted methods. The decision followed the Kingdom’s first national report on innovation trends in the water sector, which analyzed over 10,000 sources and 100 million data points using the OECD 2024 framework. The report reviewed 27,000 signals related to wastewater treatment and reuse, evaluating technical indicators and investment feasibility. Wastewater treatment and reuse is identified as a national priority under “Environmental Sustainability and Basic Needs,” with the report highlighting innovation trends, policies, and investment opportunities for policymakers, investors, and entrepreneurs. It also featured insights from ENOWA, NEOM’s energy and water company, ensuring a practical perspective aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Supported by the Agricultural Innovation Mechanism for Scale (AIM for Scale), researchers from Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial...
records.description: Supported by the Agricultural Innovation Mechanism for Scale (AIM for Scale), researchers from Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) and the University of Chicago are collaborating to help low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) adopt AI-powered weather forecasting early and build world-class national services. Backed by a UAE Presidential Court grant, the program is training staff from national meteorological and agricultural ministries to use AI models tailored to local needs, with the first cohort from Bangladesh, Chile, Ethiopia, Kenya, and Nigeria trained in the UAE. The initiative, hosted by MBZUAI and the National Centre of Meteorology, provides hands-on capacity building and high-performance laptops to ensure sustainability, while engaging ministries of agriculture to tailor forecasts to farmers’ needs. By extending access to accurate, cost-effective, and hyper-local forecasts, the program aims to improve farm planning, yields, and livelihoods.
records.institution: The Agricultural Innovation Mechanism for Scale (AIM for Scale), Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)

records.title: The Future Food Forum in Dubai, organized by the UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism and the UAE Food & Beverage Business Group, serves a...
records.description: The Future Food Forum in Dubai, organized by the UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism and the UAE Food & Beverage Business Group, serves as a key platform to align on strategies for resilient and sustainable food systems. The event is a central initiative of the UAE Food Cluster, a national strategic program designed to unify stakeholders from farming to trade to drive the nation's food security and sustainability agenda. The forum aims to connect with global food ecosystems, while launching new initiatives such as a Knowledge Hub and a Global Buyers Programme. These efforts are intended to strengthen local supply chains and reinforce the United Arab Emirates' position as a regional hub for trade and food security, in line with the We the UAE 2031 vision.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: The Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Department organised a Farmers’ Forum in collaboration with local companies and retail...
records.description: The Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Department organised a Farmers’ Forum in collaboration with local companies and retail outlets to discuss developing and marketing local agricultural products, with a focus on sustainable farming, knowledge exchange, and balancing productivity with environmental preservation. The forum, aligned with Sharjah’s vision of a competitive agricultural sector and the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy, highlighted challenges farmers face in reaching markets and explored solutions such as contract farming, modern technologies, and quality standards aligned with global best practices. Participants reviewed successful practices, discussed innovative approaches to sustainability, and emphasised efficient resource use, improved production quality, and the shift from traditional to model farms.
records.institution: The Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Department

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), in collaboration with the UAE Alliance for Climate Action (UACA), held a ses...
records.description: The UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), in collaboration with the UAE Alliance for Climate Action (UACA), held a session to support private sector stakeholders in advancing climate action. The meeting focused on familiarizing companies with national climate priorities and the new Federal Decree-Law No. (11) of 2024, which provides a framework for reducing emissions. The UAE's approach, aligned with its Net Zero by 2050 goal, emphasizes transparency and partnerships to accelerate innovation and stimulate low-carbon economic growth. The session aimed to bridge the knowledge gap by providing practical guidance on measuring and reporting carbon footprints and highlighted the role of the National Register for Carbon Credits in enabling a green economy.
records.institution: The UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: UAE: Ewec to source 60% power from carbon-free sources by 2035
records.description: Emirates Water and Electricity Company (Ewec) is leading the decarbonization of Abu Dhabi’s water and power sectors by integrating renewable and clean energy with low-carbon desalination. This strategy supports the UAE Net Zero by 2050 Strategic Initiative and the Abu Dhabi Department of Energy’s (DoE) goal for 60% of the emirate's power to be from carbon-free sources by 2035. By 2030, Ewec forecasts a 54% reduction in the carbon intensity of its electricity generation and a 94% reduction in emissions from its water production.
records.institution: Emirates Water and Electricity Company (Ewec)

records.title: A campaign was launched in the Al-Mur‘adah and Al-Wasi‘ sub-districts of Al-‘Ashah District, Amran Governorate, to control fall armyworm...
records.description: A campaign was launched in the Al-Mur‘adah and Al-Wasi‘ sub-districts of Al-‘Ashah District, Amran Governorate, to control fall armyworm pests in maize crops and raise farmers’ awareness on effective control methods. The initiative focused on educating farmers about the causes of infestations, early-stage elimination techniques, and the use of natural materials to eradicate the pest. Field teams also carried out diagnostic work to identify infestations, provided preventive guidance, and supported efforts to strengthen the agricultural sector and protect crops from widespread pests.
records.institution: Plant Protection at the Governorate’s Agriculture Sector

records.title: The Water Basin Committee in Taiz governorate held a meeting to review the status of the main water basin and discuss requests for drilli...
records.description: The Water Basin Committee in Taiz governorate held a meeting to review the status of the main water basin and discuss requests for drilling and expanding wells. The session assessed measures taken following previous approvals, postponements, and rejections of drilling requests. Officials emphasized the need to preserve water reserves, balance consumption with replenishment, and construct dams, barriers, and reservoirs to support agriculture and food self-sufficiency. The committee also called for a comprehensive report on basin conditions, clear legal frameworks for permits, and building on past technical studies. Recent activities included studies on rainwater harvesting sites and citizen well-drilling requests within the basin area.
records.institution: The Water Basin Committee in Taiz Governorate

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: In partnership with bp Oman, the company 4Elements launched the "Water for Earth, Water for Life" initiative to install wastewater treatm...
records.description: In partnership with bp Oman, the company 4Elements launched the "Water for Earth, Water for Life" initiative to install wastewater treatment plants and irrigation systems in eight schools in Oman's Ad'Dahirah and Ad'Dakhiliyah regions. The project utilizes Kubota's advanced Japanese Johkasou technology to treat wastewater and reuse it for irrigating school grounds. This effort aims to reduce the consumption of fresh water, expand green spaces, and raise environmental awareness among students, serving as a model of public-private partnership for social and environmental development. The installed systems have a production capacity of 4.2 cubic meters of treated water per day, directly supporting afforestation initiatives in the face of water scarcity.
records.institution: bp Oman

records.title: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 and the Republic of Poland 🇵🇱 have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to strengthen agricultur...
records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦 and the Republic of Poland 🇵🇱 have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to strengthen agricultural cooperation. The agreement, signed by officials from the two countries' agriculture ministries, aims to support and develop the production and manufacturing of agricultural and livestock products. The MoU focuses on the exchange of technology, support for production, and the implementation of rural development projects, all in line with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Najran branch of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) hosted a delegation from the Om...
records.description: The Najran branch of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) hosted a delegation from the Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. The visit was part of a scientific cooperation effort between Saudi Arabia and Oman to review research programs and modern technologies in citrus cultivation. The program included specialized lectures on micropropagation and biological control, as well as a tour of the center's specialized laboratories and model nurseries. The visit aimed to strengthen research partnerships and facilitate the exchange of knowledge to support sustainable agricultural development.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Abs Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association has launched a new agricultural project in Abs District, Hajjah Governorate, Ye...
records.description: The Abs Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association has launched a new agricultural project in Abs District, Hajjah Governorate, Yemen, to cultivate 20,000 acres of hard soils and sand dunes with sorghum and other grains. The project, which aims to achieve food security and self-sufficiency, is a top priority for the association. It is funded by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Agricultural Project Financing Unit. The initiative also seeks to combat desertification and builds on a successful two-year experience in reclaiming desertified land.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The date season in AlUla is attracting a growing number of farmers, shoppers, and traders, solidifying its role as a key economic platform.
records.description: The date season in AlUla is attracting a growing number of farmers, shoppers, and traders, solidifying its role as a key economic platform. The region, home to over 4.1 million palm trees that produce more than 169,000 tons of dates annually, saw sales of over 1.7 million kilograms last season, generating SAR8.8 million in revenue. This success is a result of support from the Royal Commission for AlUla, which has empowered more than 2,500 farmers and certified 250 farms to ensure their dates meet high quality standards. These efforts have established AlUla dates as a premium Saudi product, boosting the local economy and enhancing AlUla's reputation as a cultural and tourist destination.
records.institution: Royal Commission for AlUla

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Dumat Al-Jandal agricultural processing products festival is an event that brings together farmers, family businesses, and government...
records.description: The Dumat Al-Jandal agricultural processing products festival is an event that brings together farmers, family businesses, and government entities. Its main goal is to promote the diverse agricultural products of the Al-Jouf region and explore new opportunities for the sector. The festival offers specialized workshops for producers, covering topics like agricultural laboratory services, farm biosecurity, and renewable energy. It also serves as a platform for young innovators in sustainable agriculture. The event highlights various local products, including olives, honey, and dates, and features popular local dishes from the cottage industry.
records.institution: The Saudi Government

records.title: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has announced that 21 international teams from 13 countries have advanced in the "Al Miyah Challen...
records.description: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has announced that 21 international teams from 13 countries have advanced in the "Al Miyah Challenge for Agriculture." This competition, which offers a prize of AED 8 million, seeks to identify innovative solutions for reducing water consumption while maintaining or increasing crop yields in water-scarce regions. The qualifying teams proposed a range of technologies, from precision irrigation to AI-driven analytics. The initiative is a partnership with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), ASPIRE, and Silal Food and Technology. Finalists will pilot their technologies in the UAE to test their viability for real-world application.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced new regulations for the packaging and labeling of fruits and vegetables...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced new regulations for the packaging and labeling of fruits and vegetables sold in public markets, as part of its commitment to food safety and environmental protection in line with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030. The rules require that each packaged retail unit include a label with the product name, net weight, packaging date, country of origin, and supplier details. Furthermore, the regulations specify that packaging must be made of durable, recyclable, and food-grade materials that allow for air circulation. For cardboard, the packaging must be corrugated and covered externally to prevent contamination during storage and transport.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: An Omani-Indian fertiliser joint venture is planning to list on the Muscat stock exchange as part of Oman’s broader privatisation efforts.
records.description: An Omani-Indian fertiliser joint venture is planning to list on the Muscat stock exchange as part of Oman’s broader privatisation efforts. The company has requested proposals from banks for the potential listing, which remains in the early stages. State-backed OQ holds half of the venture, with the rest equally owned by two Indian cooperatives. Established in 1994, the company operates plants in Sur Industrial City producing large volumes of ammonia and urea. Oman has recently raised billions from previous listings, while IPO activity across the Middle East and North Africa has surged to its highest first-half level since 2008, with 25 companies raising a combined $4.5 billion.
records.institution: Oman India Fertiliser Company (Omifco)

records.title: The Food Security Forum and Exhibition, held under the theme “Safe Investment for Sustainable Food”, concluded after two days with over 3...
records.description: The Food Security Forum and Exhibition, held under the theme “Safe Investment for Sustainable Food”, concluded after two days with over 360 participants, 25 expert speakers, and 27 exhibiting institutions. Discussions highlighted Oman’s economic growth and investment opportunities as drivers of food security. Key recommendations focused on boosting local food manufacturing, strengthening agricultural value chains, and encouraging private investment in storage, distribution, and marketing systems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources for Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: QatarEnergy signed an agreement with Samsung C&T’s Engineering & Construction Group to build the Dukhan solar power plant, a world-scale...
records.description: QatarEnergy signed an agreement with Samsung C&T’s Engineering & Construction Group to build the Dukhan solar power plant, a world-scale project west of Doha that will reach 2,000 MW capacity by mid-2029. The plant, one of the largest globally, will double Qatar’s solar production, support the country’s renewable energy targets, and contribute to Qatar National Vision 2030. Integrated with KAHRAMAA’s grid, it will reduce carbon emissions by an estimated 4.7 million tons annually and cover up to 30% of peak electricity demand, strengthening Qatar’s sustainable energy transition.
records.institution: QatarEnergy

records.title: QatarEnergy signs Dukhan Solar Power Plant construction contract
records.description: QatarEnergy has signed an agreement with Samsung C&T for the construction of the Dukhan Solar Power Plant, one of the world’s largest, located 80 km west of Doha. The project will be developed in two phases, reaching 2,000 MW capacity by mid-2029, and will double Qatar’s solar power production. Once operational, it will contribute up to 30% of peak electricity demand and cut carbon emissions by 4.7 million tons annually. The first 1,000 MW phase is expected to begin supplying power to the KAHRAMAA grid by late 2028.
records.institution: QatarEnergy

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia’s Power Procurement Company (SPPC) has launched a Request for Qualification (RFQ) for the seventh round of the National Rene...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s Power Procurement Company (SPPC) has launched a Request for Qualification (RFQ) for the seventh round of the National Renewable Energy Programme (NREP), covering six projects with a total capacity of 5.3 GW. The round includes four solar PV projects—Tabarjal 2 (1,400 MW), Mawaq (600 MW), Tathleeth (600 MW), and South Al-Ula (500 MW)—and two wind projects, Bilghah (1,300 MW) and Shaqran (900 MW), all located in different regions of the Kingdom. To date, SPPC has tendered over 43 GW of renewable capacity and signed PPAs for more than 38 GW.
records.institution: Saudi Arabia’s Power Procurement Company (SPPC)

records.title: The National Center for Meteorology (NCM), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the National Cent...
records.description: The National Center for Meteorology (NCM), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the National Center for Non-Profit Sector, launched an initiative in Jeddah to support weather and climate enthusiasts, associations, and volunteer teams by granting free access to its resources, services, and training. The program aims to boost community participation, strengthen meteorological awareness, and provide opportunities for engagement in climate-related events, with registration available through the NCM website and the Anwaa platform.
records.institution: The National Center for Meteorology (NCM)

records.title: Hodeidah has launched the second phase of contract farming in the poultry sector, aiming to replace imports with 5,400 tons of locally pr...
records.description: Hodeidah has launched the second phase of contract farming in the poultry sector, aiming to replace imports with 5,400 tons of locally produced frozen chicken by the end of 2025. The initiative, coordinated by the Yemeni government through the Ministries of Agriculture, Fisheries, Water Resources, Economy, Industry, and Investment, brings together cooperative associations, small-scale poultry farmers, slaughterhouses, and marketing companies. It is designed to strengthen local production, improve product quality, create jobs, and support self-sufficiency in the poultry sector.
records.institution: The Ministries of Agriculture, Fisheries, Water Resources, Economy, Industry, and Investment

records.title: The “Saudi Reef” program launched a media initiative called “Sustainable Reef” to showcase its role in empowering farmers and rural famil...
records.description: The “Saudi Reef” program launched a media initiative called “Sustainable Reef” to showcase its role in empowering farmers and rural families, promoting agricultural sustainability, and strengthening food security in the Kingdom. Since inception, it has supported over 87,000 rural beneficiaries through financial aid, training, and modern technologies. The program covers eight sectors—coffee, livestock, rain-fed crops, beekeeping, aromatic plants, fisheries, fruits, and value-added development—advancing smart farming and contributing to Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program “Saudi Reef”

records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Economy and Finance of Mauritania in Nouak...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Economy and Finance of Mauritania in Nouakchott, providing a $6 million grant from Saudi Arabia under the fifth phase of the Saudi Well Drilling and Rural Development Program in Africa. The initiative aims to strengthen water security in Mauritania, combat desertification, support agriculture, and reduce waterborne diseases. Since 1982, the program has drilled and equipped over 10,000 water facilities in 21 African countries, with investments exceeding $330 million, contributing to improved living standards and sustainable water and food security.
records.institution: Saudi Fund for Development (SFD)

records.title: The ministry announced the closure of the coastal shrimp fishing season in the Red Sea from 16 September 2025 until further notice, to pr...
records.description: The ministry announced the closure of the coastal shrimp fishing season in the Red Sea from 16 September 2025 until further notice, to protect shrimp stocks. Exporters must declare stored quantities, while violators will face legal penalties. Fishermen were urged to adjust nets to 38 mm mesh, with the Fisheries Authority and Coast Guard tasked to enforce monitoring.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Despite importing 90% of its food, Bahrain has achieved an advanced global ranking of 38th on the Global Food Security Index (GFSI).
records.description: Despite importing 90% of its food, Bahrain has achieved an advanced global ranking of 38th on the Global Food Security Index (GFSI). The Bahrain Food Holding Company (Ghitha) is a key driver of this success, acting as a partner to the private sector to develop national food security initiatives. Ghitha oversees major food companies, including the Bahrain Flour Mills Company, which is planning a strategic project to increase wheat storage capacity to six months. In addition, the General Poultry Company is expanding to raise its market share from 44% to 70%, while the Delmon Poultry Company also has significant room to expand its current 18-20% market share to meet growing local demand.
records.institution: Bahrain Food Holding Company (Ghitha)

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman has officially joined the World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies, marking its commitment t...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman has officially joined the World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies, marking its commitment to international cooperation, ocean sustainability, and the protection of marine resources. The Ministry of Commerce, Industry, and Investment Promotion, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and Oman’s mission to the WTO in Geneva, led the accession efforts to ensure alignment with national legislation, economic priorities, and UN Sustainable Development Goal 14.6. The agreement, adopted at the WTO’s Twelfth Ministerial Conference, prohibits harmful fisheries subsidies that contribute to overfishing and global fish stock depletion. Oman emphasized that this step supports food security, artisanal fishing, fair maritime trade, and environmental sustainability, while reinforcing the country’s active role in the multilateral trading system since joining the WTO in 2000.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: On Arab Palm Day, ADAFSA reaffirmed its commitment to developing the palm sector and promoting sustainable agriculture in Abu Dhabi.
records.description: On Arab Palm Day, ADAFSA reaffirmed its commitment to developing the palm sector and promoting sustainable agriculture in Abu Dhabi. Through initiatives such as the Integrated Palm Pest Management and Palm & Date Best Practices Programmes, ADAFSA has treated over 6.5 million palm trees and captured major pests, while supporting farmers with training and awareness campaigns. Backed by ADAFSA, Al Foah Company also promotes Emirati dates globally via the digital platform eZad, strengthening the sector’s market reach and sustainability.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.description: The ministry launched Phase II of the Government Facilities Afforestation Project in Sana’a, targeting 100,000 seedlings (50% fruit trees, 50% ornamental/forest trees) as part of a national plan to plant nearly one million seedlings across governorates. The project also covers streets and public spaces, with community participation encouraged to build a productive and sustainable society.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: Alternative Energy Projects (AEPCo), a Kuwaiti renewable energy developer, has partnered with elementsix, a Dubai-based carbon and ESG ad...
records.description: Alternative Energy Projects (AEPCo), a Kuwaiti renewable energy developer, has partnered with elementsix, a Dubai-based carbon and ESG advisory firm, to accelerate corporate decarbonization in the Gulf and MENA region. The partnership provides companies with an integrated solution to measure their carbon footprint, develop reduction strategies, and implement clean energy projects. This initiative is designed to help businesses achieve net-zero goals, gain a competitive advantage, and align with ESG standards for investor confidence, while also contributing to job creation and economic transformation.
records.institution: Alternative Energy Projects (AEPCo)

records.title: A research team from King Khalid University has been granted a patent by the Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property for an innovative...
records.description: A research team from King Khalid University has been granted a patent by the Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property for an innovative method to purify industrially contaminated water using prickly pear peels. The technique, which leverages agricultural waste, has been proven to remove over 98% of contaminants and remains effective after multiple uses. This groundbreaking method is not only environmentally friendly and energy-efficient but also cost-effective and practical for both industrial and community applications, transforming agricultural waste into a high-value environmental solution.
records.institution: King Khalid University

records.title: The Saudi Irrigation Organization participated in the Fourth World Irrigation Forum (WIF4) and the 76th meeting of the International Comm...
records.description: The Saudi Irrigation Organization participated in the Fourth World Irrigation Forum (WIF4) and the 76th meeting of the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage in Kuala Lumpur, where it highlighted Saudi Arabia's advancements in water resource management. The organization presented initiatives focusing on agricultural wastewater treatment and the reuse of treated water to address water scarcity. The discussions also featured papers on a smart tool for irrigation scheduling in dry areas and a framework for improving water efficiency, both of which are aligned with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: Saudi Irrigation Organization
