records.title: The second Sakaka dates festival, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf, has concluded.
records.description: The second Sakaka dates festival, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf, has concluded. The five-day event featured 30 farmers and 18 families from the cottage industry, with the goal of supporting local farmers, promoting Al-Jouf dates, and exploring new marketing opportunities. The festival also included entertainment, agricultural activities for children, and a showcase of local cuisine, concluding with a ceremony that recognized winners of awards for the largest date bunches.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: A training workshop for agricultural field school facilitators has begun in Ibb governorate, organized by the Office of Agriculture, Fish...
records.description: A training workshop for agricultural field school facilitators has begun in Ibb governorate, organized by the Office of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the General Department of Agricultural Extension and Training. Funded by the Executive Unit for Financing Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives, the three-day workshop aims to provide 62 participants with skills and knowledge to boost agricultural and livestock production under an agricultural expansion project. The training focuses on the principles of sustainable field schools to raise farmers' awareness through informal education and practical learning, ultimately contributing to rural development and achieving food security and self-sufficiency.
records.institution: Office of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The fourth edition of BIOFACH Saudi Arabia, an international exhibition for organic products, will be held at the Riyadh International Co...
records.description: The fourth edition of BIOFACH Saudi Arabia, an international exhibition for organic products, will be held at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center. Sponsored by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in strategic partnership with the Saudi Society for Organic Agriculture, the event will showcase the latest innovations in organic products and promote sustainable agricultural practices. The exhibition aims to attract major investors, distributors, and suppliers, with the goal of promoting a healthy lifestyle and boosting the competitiveness of Saudi organic products in global markets. Workshops and discussion sessions led by experts will also be featured.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) is advancing its goal of producing sustainable protein for animal feed by incorporating insect farming.
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) is advancing its goal of producing sustainable protein for animal feed by incorporating insect farming. According to a recent report, the company has completed a feasibility study for a facility that would produce insect meal from black soldier fly larvae (BSFL), a high-protein source that can serve as a viable alternative to fishmeal and soy. This initiative aligns with circular economy principles by utilizing organic waste, and it's being supported by OFM's strong financial performance. The company is leveraging its profitability to also pursue other diversification projects, including a health bar production facility and a baby food project in Uzbekistan.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills (OFM)

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) participated in the International Government Communication Forum (IGCF) to showca...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) participated in the International Government Communication Forum (IGCF) to showcase the UAE's strategic vision for food security and sustainable development. The ministry highlighted its focus on empowering youth through initiatives like the 'Plant the Emirates' National Programme and the 'Mustadeem' programme, while also emphasizing the role of advanced agricultural technologies, such as vertical farming, in overcoming climate challenges. The discussion also covered the UAE's ambitious vision for marine conservation, including a proposed 'National Partnership for the Sea' initiative, and its efforts to ensure a sustainable fishing industry through the National Framework Statement for Sustainable Fisheries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has announced the 21 qualifying teams for its "Al Miyah Challenge for Agriculture," a competition...
records.description: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has announced the 21 qualifying teams for its "Al Miyah Challenge for Agriculture," a competition focused on developing innovative solutions for water-scarce regions. Selected from hundreds of international applicants, the teams represent 13 countries and have proposed a wide range of solutions, including precision irrigation, AI-driven analytics, and wastewater reuse, all aimed at reducing water consumption in agriculture. The challenge, which offers a prize purse of AED 8 million, is a partnership with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), ASPIRE, and Silal Food and Technology. The goal is to identify and test technologies for real-world application in the UAE that can be scaled for global use, thereby enhancing food security and sustainability.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: A workshop held in Hajja Governorate, organized by the local Agriculture Sector and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, emphasized the im...
records.description: A workshop held in Hajja Governorate, organized by the local Agriculture Sector and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, emphasized the importance of unifying efforts to promote agricultural expansion projects and value chains. The participants, including representatives from the Agricultural and Fisheries Project and Initiative Financing Unit, discussed the need to support farmers and agricultural associations with technical expertise and essential resources. The workshop concluded by stressing the importance of a joint work plan and a strengthened partnership between the Ministry of Agriculture, its local office, the Cooperative Union, and agricultural associations to achieve self-sufficiency and develop the agricultural sector in the governorate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC) has announced that its green hydrogen plant, the world's largest, is over 80% complete.
records.description: The NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC) has announced that its green hydrogen plant, the world's largest, is over 80% complete. This flagship project, seen as a blueprint for low-cost, large-scale production, is advancing rapidly across its production facility, solar farm, wind garden, and transmission grid. With key equipment now being installed, the project remains on track to complete 4GW of renewable power generation by mid-2026, with the first hydrogen product expected to be available in 2027. This initiative is a core component of Saudi Arabia's global energy transition efforts.
records.institution: NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC)

records.title: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), in cooperation with the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), hosted the Hack4SaferPlates...
records.description: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), in cooperation with the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), hosted the Hack4SaferPlates hackathon to support innovation in food safety and sustainable food systems. The event brought together innovators and professionals from across the region to develop technology-based solutions aimed at improving food safety standards, enhancing early warning systems, and reducing food waste. The hackathon also featured workshops and mentorship sessions from local and international experts from organizations like Berytech, the Mediterranean Agronomic Institute of Bari (CIHEAM Bari), the National Center for Research and Development of Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), Fermendom, FoodSight, and Goumbook.
records.institution: Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.title: Undersecretary of Al-Jouf Region Principality Hussein Al Sultan inaugurated the second dates festival in Sakaka yesterday, organized by t...
records.description: Undersecretary of Al-Jouf Region Principality Hussein Al Sultan inaugurated the second dates festival in Sakaka yesterday, organized by the Al-Jouf branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture. More than 30 farmers are participating in the five-day festival, showcasing some of the finest dates from Al-Jouf Region. Additionally, 18 families working in the cottage industry, representing the palm and date-related processing industries, are participating. The festival offers direct technical and advisory services to farmers and producers through three specialized laboratories affiliated with the ministry’s branch, providing agricultural testing and consultations. It aims to support farmers and producers, enhance the quality of palm trees and date products from Al-Jouf, and open new marketing channels to strengthen the region’s agricultural presence.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ad Hoc Technical Committee on Conservation and Sustainable Use of Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (ACSU-10) held its...
records.description: The Ad Hoc Technical Committee on Conservation and Sustainable Use of Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (ACSU-10) held its tenth meeting in Doha, organized by the Ministry of Municipality's Agricultural Research Department. The event focused on strengthening regional and international cooperation to conserve and sustainably use plant genetic resources as a fundamental pillar for food security. Discussions covered major challenges in the sector, best practices for adapting to climate change, and a review of the relevant international treaty. The meeting's outcomes are expected to contribute to a clear roadmap for joint action and reflect Qatar's pioneering efforts in this field through its Agricultural Research Department and Gene Bank.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has partnered with a civil society organization to implement the Saba' Sana...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has partnered with a civil society organization to implement the Saba' Sanabel project in Idlib and Aleppo in northern Syria. The initiative aims to enhance food security and sustainability by providing 750 farming families with essential agricultural tools, energy sources, seeds, and training on best practices. As part of a broader humanitarian effort by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the project also seeks to create job opportunities for approximately 500 daily wage workers in the region.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The Saudi Irrigation Organization (SIO) took part in the 4th World Irrigation Forum in Kuala Lumpur, where representatives from over 60 c...
records.description: The Saudi Irrigation Organization (SIO) took part in the 4th World Irrigation Forum in Kuala Lumpur, where representatives from over 60 countries discussed irrigation and drainage challenges, innovation, financing, and nature-based solutions for resilience. SIO President Mohammed Abuhaid highlighted Saudi Arabia’s efforts to enhance water use efficiency, expand treated water reuse, and implement over 65 projects nationwide in line with Vision 2030 and the National Water Strategy. He emphasized the Kingdom’s commitment to cooperation with ICID, adopting innovation, and learning from global best practices to advance sustainability in the irrigation sector.
records.institution: The Saudi Irrigation Organization (SIO)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) has signed a landmark agreement with Goldman Sachs International to explore innovative financing...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) has signed a landmark agreement with Goldman Sachs International to explore innovative financing models for enhancing water security. This partnership aims to attract foreign direct investment and implement joint projects to modernize water infrastructure, reduce network losses, and deploy next-generation desalination technologies powered by clean energy. The collaboration, which will also leverage the AD.WE platform for digital transformation, is a key part of Abu Dhabi's strategy to attract significant foreign investment and establish itself as a regional leader in sustainable utilities, in line with the UAE Water Security Strategy 2036.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE)

records.title: The Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy, and Remote Work Applications Office has partnered with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food S...
records.description: The Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy, and Remote Work Applications Office has partnered with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) to enhance food security using artificial intelligence. The collaboration focuses on developing innovative digital solutions, building talent, and fostering a culture of innovation through workshops, competitions, and hackathons. This partnership aligns with the UAE's goal of becoming a global leader in AI development and reinforces its commitment to using technology to achieve food security and sustainable agricultural practices. The agreement follows ADAFSA's recent achievement of the ISO 42001:2023 international certification for AI Management Systems, a global first in the agriculture and food security sector.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Global Water, Energy and Climate Change Congress (GWECCC) is being held in Bahrain, focusing on sustainability and security in the Ar...
records.description: The Global Water, Energy and Climate Change Congress (GWECCC) is being held in Bahrain, focusing on sustainability and security in the Arabian Gulf. Under the theme "Sustainable Water and Energy Transformation: Innovation for a Secure Future," the conference will bring together over 3,000 participants from 30 countries. The event aims to discuss the interconnected challenges of water, energy, and climate change and will feature a comprehensive program including ministerial sessions, leadership dialogues, a youth forum, and a hackathon for university students. An accompanying exhibition will showcase the latest technologies and innovations from specialized companies and startups.
records.institution: Global Water, Energy and Climate Change Congress (GWECCC)

records.title: The Fisheries Investment Opportunities Forum, organized by Oman’s Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, highlights the...
records.description: The Fisheries Investment Opportunities Forum, organized by Oman’s Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, highlights the growing role of aquaculture both globally and locally. The two-day event brings together government officials, investors, financial institutions, international organizations such as FAO and WAS, and academic experts to discuss global trends, challenges, and opportunities. Sessions cover Oman’s achievements, global market prospects, farming techniques for key species, governance, and investment models, with Chile presented as a successful example. The forum also showcases advanced technologies, including AI, and highlights Oman’s rich marine biodiversity, which supports farming of more than 15 species.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), through its Al Batinah North branch, is organizing a Food Security Forum in Al Suwaiq w...
records.description: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), through its Al Batinah North branch, is organizing a Food Security Forum in Al Suwaiq with the theme "Safe Investment for Sustainable Food." The event aims to boost investment and localize technology-driven projects in agriculture and fisheries, aligning with Oman Vision 2040. The two-day program will include sessions on investment opportunities and financing, with a focus on how traditional farms can evolve into innovative ventures through partnerships with government bodies, private firms, and international organizations like the FAO. An accompanying exhibition will showcase innovative solutions and foster new partnerships to shape a sustainable food future for Oman.
records.institution: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)

records.title: The Regional Workshop of the International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC) for the Near East and North Africa region began in Salalah,...
records.description: The Regional Workshop of the International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC) for the Near East and North Africa region began in Salalah, bringing together experts from 20 countries to discuss the latest developments in plant health. The four-day programme covers outcomes of recent IPPC meetings, updates on international standards, and consultations on new measures, while also addressing emerging challenges such as climate change and e-commerce. Participants will explore regional initiatives on propagation materials for key crops like date palms, citrus, and olives, alongside advances in digital tools such as electronic certification and monitoring platforms. The workshop emphasizes strengthening institutional and technical capacities in diagnostics, early warning, and pest risk management, aiming to unify regional positions on draft standards, enhance national preparedness, and promote knowledge exchange across the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) signed a cooperation agreement in Damascus with a civil society organizatio...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) signed a cooperation agreement in Damascus with a civil society organization to support the wheat production chain in eastern Aleppo’s countryside. The project focuses on rehabilitating agricultural infrastructure, improving access to high-quality wheat seeds, and providing technical support in extension and mechanization. Covering 2,750 hectares and benefiting about 16,500 people from 2,750 families, the initiative aims to empower small farmers, strengthen food security, and promote self-sufficiency. This intervention is part of Saudi Arabia’s broader humanitarian and relief efforts in Syria through KSrelief.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has approved and distributed over 21,000 date palm seedlings and 100,000 fruit...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has approved and distributed over 21,000 date palm seedlings and 100,000 fruit seedlings to eligible farmers. This initiative, in line with Oman Vision 2040, aims to establish "model fields" to achieve sustainable agricultural development, enhance production efficiency, and strengthen food security. The ministry is supporting farmers with technical guidance, workshops, and coordination with the Development Bank and the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund. The date palm seedlings are sourced from the Tissue Culture Research Center in Jamah, and the program's objective is to supply the market with high-quality local products and provide a new source of income for farmers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has distributed seeds and veterinary kits to 90 beneficiaries in Marib Gove...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has distributed seeds and veterinary kits to 90 beneficiaries in Marib Governorate, Yemen, as part of its sustainable agriculture and fisheries support project. This initiative is considered vital for empowering local farmers and enhancing food security. The project also includes a component to train veterinarians, which will improve animal health services in rural areas. The distribution is part of the ongoing humanitarian assistance provided by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through KSrelief to support the livelihoods of vulnerable communities in Yemen.
records.institution: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi International Hunting and Equestrian Exhibition (ADIHEX) is featuring strong participation from leading institutions and co...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi International Hunting and Equestrian Exhibition (ADIHEX) is featuring strong participation from leading institutions and companies in veterinary medicine and animal health. Exhibitors are showcasing the latest innovations in veterinary care, breeding technologies, and animal nutrition. Prominent participants include the Advanced Scientific Group, which operates a specialized veterinary laboratory for camel research, and the United Arab Emirates University, which offers academic programs in veterinary medicine, food science, and integrated agriculture. Companies like Zabeel Feed, Al Hikma, and the German Standards Group are also present, offering animal feeds, nutritional supplements, and a wide range of veterinary medicines and equipment.
records.institution: ADNEC Group

records.title: The Buraidah Dates Carnival is showcasing over 150 varieties of dates, including many rare types for which the Qassim Region is renowned.
records.description: The Buraidah Dates Carnival is showcasing over 150 varieties of dates, including many rare types for which the Qassim Region is renowned. The wide selection highlights the abundance and diversity of Saudi date products, with each variety offering a distinct flavor. By focusing on these unique dates, the carnival aims to enhance the Qassim Region’s reputation as a hub of agricultural quality, thereby boosting the area's economic and tourism activity.
records.institution: Qassim Region

records.title: The Aseer Region Municipality has signed an environmental and technical partnership agreement with netzero, an environmental services com...
records.description: The Aseer Region Municipality has signed an environmental and technical partnership agreement with netzero, an environmental services company from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Sedra Program. The collaboration aims to launch "smart afforestation initiatives" across the region's 33 municipalities, including a landmark project to plant and document one million smart trees. The initiative also seeks to establish miniature forests to boost biodiversity and increase green spaces, reinforcing a commitment to a sustainable future and supporting Saudi innovations in climate technologies.
records.institution: Aseer Region Municipality

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced a new Cabinet-approved protocol that will strengthen Saudi Arabia's comm...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced a new Cabinet-approved protocol that will strengthen Saudi Arabia's commitment to marine sustainability, in line with Saudi Vision 2030. The agreement, which includes members of the Regional Organization for the Conservation of the Environment of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden (PERSGA) such as Egypt, Jordan, Sudan, Djibouti, Somalia, and Yemen, is a key tool under the Jeddah Convention. It provides a specialized platform for cooperation to sustainably manage marine resources, protect habitats, combat illegal fishing, and enhance data exchange. The protocol also aims to provide training and technical support to member states to help them modernize legislation and improve biosecurity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: With the arrival of fall, Saudi Arabia's Aseer Region celebrates its pomegranate harvest, a key economic driver for local farmers and fam...
records.description: With the arrival of fall, Saudi Arabia's Aseer Region celebrates its pomegranate harvest, a key economic driver for local farmers and families. Known for its distinctive varieties, including a sweet local red, a slightly sour yellow, and the Taif pomegranate, the fruit's season generates significant income and marketing opportunities. The harvest is celebrated at annual festivals organized by the local branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture. These events showcase the quality of local produce and support farmers while attracting visitors from across the Kingdom, thus solidifying the pomegranate's status as a central local product that stimulates economic and tourism activity.
records.institution: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Oman is set to establish the first integrated green ship recycling facility in the Middle East, a move that aligns with its 2050 net-zero...
records.description: Oman is set to establish the first integrated green ship recycling facility in the Middle East, a move that aligns with its 2050 net-zero goals. The project, a partnership between the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT) and Green Wheel Recycling Middle East, will be located in North Batinah. The facility is designed to responsibly dismantle and recycle over 70 ships annually and is projected to produce 2 million tonnes of low-carbon steel each year in its initial phase. This initiative will provide eco-friendly solutions for international fleets to comply with regulations like the EU Ship Recycling Regulation and the Hong Kong Convention, while also creating jobs and contributing to the country's non-oil GDP.
records.institution: The Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)

records.title: The National Livestock Vaccination Campaign has been launched in South Al Batinah Governorate and will be implemented for eight months by...
records.description: The National Livestock Vaccination Campaign has been launched in South Al Batinah Governorate and will be implemented for eight months by the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources. The campaign aims to vaccinate goats, sheep, and cattle against priority infectious diseases, thereby reducing infection rates and enhancing biosecurity. As a fundamental part of the national strategy to combat animal epidemics, the initiative seeks to increase the number of vaccinated animals annually and ensure the sustainability of livestock production, which contributes to food security. Officials have urged livestock breeders to cooperate with veterinary teams to protect their herds and support the agricultural sector.
records.institution: Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Buraidah Dates Carnival is a major economic and tourism event in the Qassim Region, attracting traders, farmers, and visitors from ac...
records.description: The Buraidah Dates Carnival is a major economic and tourism event in the Qassim Region, attracting traders, farmers, and visitors from across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf. The carnival serves as an integrated platform for marketing, tourism, and entertainment, featuring a wide range of activities, including traditional performances, exhibitions, and sections for productive families and handicrafts. The event is organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture, under the supervision of the Qassim Region Principality. Its purpose is to support Saudi Vision 2030 objectives by promoting the local agricultural sector, empowering productive families, and highlighting local heritage.
records.institution: National Center for Palms and Dates, The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has launched an agricultural training program to help farmers in the governorate adopt modern, effic...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has launched an agricultural training program to help farmers in the governorate adopt modern, efficient farming practices. The program offers specialized courses on a variety of topics aimed at enhancing crop quality and production efficiency. Key areas of focus include field irrigation techniques, optimal pesticide use, palm seedling care, drip irrigation, and fertilization management. This initiative reflects the RCU's commitment to developing the agricultural sector in the region.
records.institution: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU)

records.title: The Al-Badayea Governorate date market is experiencing robust economic activity with the start of the Al-Badayea Date Season.
records.description: The Al-Badayea Governorate date market is experiencing robust economic activity with the start of the Al-Badayea Date Season. An average of 170 tons of dates arrive at the market daily, attracting shoppers and suppliers from across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This influx of produce offers a wide selection of date varieties that meet consumer needs in terms of quality, quantity, and value. The market is considered a major agricultural and economic event for the region due to its significant commercial value and its role in ensuring transparent buying and selling.
records.institution: Al-Badayea Governorate

records.title: The Global Water Expo, organized by dmg events, is being held in Riyadh, bringing together over 300 exhibitors from more than 25 countrie...
records.description: The Global Water Expo, organized by dmg events, is being held in Riyadh, bringing together over 300 exhibitors from more than 25 countries to showcase technologies for water, wastewater, and environmental services. The event serves as a strategic platform to connect solution providers with opportunities in Saudi Arabia, particularly following the National Water Company's announcement of 30 new water and sewerage projects valued at $533 million. The expo reflects the rapid growth of the Saudi water sector, which is projected to expand significantly, and aligns with the country's Vision 2030 water priorities. The event features a range of exhibitors, from global leaders to local companies, presenting advanced systems and smart monitoring tools to address the Kingdom's water challenges.
records.institution: National Water Company

records.title: The Khudair Cooperative Association in Taiz Governorate has inaugurated a new Agricultural Services Center to provide support for local f...
records.description: The Khudair Cooperative Association in Taiz Governorate has inaugurated a new Agricultural Services Center to provide support for local farmers. The center will supply agricultural inputs, including seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and equipment. The new center is part of the Agricultural Value Chain program and was funded by an interest-free loan of six million Yemeni Riyals from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit to the cooperative. Officials emphasized that the center is a significant step toward advancing the agricultural sector, as it will enable farmers to easily access essential services and benefit from agricultural development programs.
records.institution: Khudair Cooperative Association

records.title: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, has l...
records.description: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, has launched 12 new investment opportunities in Al Buraimi Governorate via the "Tatweer" platform. These projects, which span a total area of 287.9 acres, are designed to boost food security and encourage agricultural investment. The initiatives include diverse projects such as cultivating vegetables and other crops using modern technology, raising livestock and fish, and establishing specialized facilities like a veterinary clinic, a modern agricultural nursery, and a water bottling plant. The opportunities also cover specific ventures in the wilayats of Al Buraimi, Mahda, and Al Sunainah. This is part of a larger government effort that has seen a total of 54 investment opportunities launched in the agricultural and water sectors in the governorate this year.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) is participating in the Saudi Drone Exhibition (SADEX 2025) in Riyadh, an event showcasing...
records.description: The General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) is participating in the Saudi Drone Exhibition (SADEX 2025) in Riyadh, an event showcasing the latest drone technologies for a variety of sectors, including transportation, agriculture, and environmental management. The exhibition brings together over 100 entities from within Saudi Arabia and abroad. GACA's involvement in the event is part of its ongoing effort to establish the Kingdom as a global logistics hub and advance its infrastructure for emerging air transport technologies, in line with the country's National Aviation Strategy.
records.institution: General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA)

records.title: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa) organized a forum in Buraidah to discuss th...
records.description: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa) organized a forum in Buraidah to discuss the sustainable management of palm trees. The event, which is part of Weqaa's efforts to protect national agricultural resources, focused on key issues such as integrated pest management, post-harvest control, and the latest technologies for combating the red palm weevil. The forum also saw the signing of several agreements to advance laboratory diagnostics and strengthen collaboration with the private sector. This initiative aligns with Saudi Vision 2030, which aims to enhance food security and support the national economy through the palm and date sector.
records.institution: National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa)

records.title: The National Environmental Recycling Company (Tadweer) has secured a SAR 90 million ($24 million) loan from the Saudi Industrial Developm...
records.description: The National Environmental Recycling Company (Tadweer) has secured a SAR 90 million ($24 million) loan from the Saudi Industrial Development Fund (SIDF), which is part of a larger credit facility obtained from Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB). This financing is intended to support the company's expansion of recycling projects, including technology upgrades and capacity boosts, aligning with Saudi Arabia’s sustainability agenda and Vision 2030 goals. The Saudi National Center for Waste Management aims to divert 82% of the Kingdom's waste from landfills by 2035, creating significant opportunities for companies like Tadweer, which specializes in recycling scrap metals. This financial milestone reflects a growing regional trend where lending institutions are actively supporting green industrial development and sustainable finance.
records.institution: National Environmental Recycling Company (Tadweer)

records.title: The Buraidah Dates Carnival in Saudi Arabia is a major event organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the regional branch...
records.description: The Buraidah Dates Carnival in Saudi Arabia is a major event organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, under the supervision of the Qassim Principality. The carnival serves as a central hub for the Qassim Region's annual production of over 390,000 tons of dates. At the carnival's export yard, dates are processed and distributed both domestically and to more than 100 countries worldwide. Farmers in the region plan to plant over two million additional palm trees to further increase output, an initiative that supports the goals of Saudi Vision 2030 to boost non-oil revenues. .
records.institution: National Center for Palms and Dates

records.title: The Farmer Field Schools project has been launched in 14 districts of Al-Hodeidah Governorate under the General Authority for the Develop...
records.description: The Farmer Field Schools project has been launched in 14 districts of Al-Hodeidah Governorate under the General Authority for the Development of Tihama. The initiative, sponsored by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Project Finance Unit, aims to empower 2,500 farmers by establishing 100 field schools. These schools will focus on key crops such as sesame, date palms, cotton, and corn, as well as dairy production. The project, which emphasizes a hands-on approach and the empowerment of rural women, seeks to enhance farmers' skills in good agricultural practices, post-harvest processes, and marketing to improve their livelihoods.
records.institution: General Authority for the Development of Tihama

records.title: The Sahel Tihama Cooperative Fisheries Association has launched the first phase of a Community Savings Funds project for fishermen at the...
records.description: The Sahel Tihama Cooperative Fisheries Association has launched the first phase of a Community Savings Funds project for fishermen at the Hodeidah Fishing Port. The initiative, which is funded with 25 million riyals to benefit 70 fishermen, is a collaboration with the Red Sea Fisheries Authority, the Navy, and the Coast Guard. The project aims to provide practical solutions to the economic issues faced by fishermen and to enhance their livelihood stability. The initiative, also supported by the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, is expected to be expanded in the future to include more beneficiaries.
records.institution: Sahel Tihama Cooperative Fisheries Association

records.title: According to Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information, the country’s GDP grew by 4.7% in the first quarter of 2025, reaching...
records.description: According to Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information, the country’s GDP grew by 4.7% in the first quarter of 2025, reaching 10.53 billion Omani rials. The growth was driven by a strong performance in non-oil activities, which grew by 4.1%. The highest growth was in the agriculture and fisheries sector, which expanded by 11.1%, signaling progress in Oman's economic diversification efforts. The oil sector also contributed, primarily due to an 89% increase in natural gas value, which offset a decline in crude oil. The overall non-oil exports also saw an 8.6% increase, driven by goods like construction materials, petrochemicals, and agricultural products
records.institution: Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information

records.description: During the Damascus International Fair, several Saudi companies, including ACWA Power, signed a series of agreements with Syrian authorities to support the country's energy sector. ACWA Power's agreement with Syria's Ministry of Energy focuses on studying and proposing up to 1,000 megawatts of solar and 1,500 megawatts of wind power projects, in addition to evaluating and optimizing Syria's existing power grid. Other deals were signed by Saudi Electricity Company, Saudi Electricity Project Development Company, TAQA, ADES Holding, Arabian Drilling, and ARGAS, covering cooperation in electricity infrastructure, as well as oil and gas exploration, drilling, and processing.

records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM Food Company Topian, concluded the second edition of a greenhouse management training program in Riyadh. The five-day program provided 30 participants, including graduates and agricultural practitioners, with 40 hours of theoretical and practical training. Participants learned how to operate advanced climate control systems, smart irrigation, and crop monitoring technologies to address environmental challenges related to soil, crop health, and resource conservation.

records.description: The second phase of a UAE-funded solar power plant has been launched in the Bir Ahmed area of Aden, Yemen. The project, which is implemented in partnership with the Yemeni Ministry of Electricity and Energy, is expected to have a total capacity of 240 megawatts upon completion, making it the first of its kind in the country. The plant is designed to provide clean, sustainable power to residents, reduce reliance on imported fuel, and significantly lower carbon emissions. The initiative is seen as a strategic step toward renewable energy development in Yemen and a model for other governorates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Electricity and Energy

records.description: Alba and the Bahrain Centre for Strategic, International and Energy Studies (Derasat) have partnered to advance Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives and support Bahrain's national sustainability goals. The collaboration will focus on boosting energy efficiency and reducing carbon emissions, with a joint task force tasked with studying the ideal energy mix for Alba’s operations and creating a unified ESG framework. This agreement, which aligns with Bahrain’s 2060 net-zero commitment, reinforces the importance of strategic partnerships in driving sustainable industrial growth.

Hydrom, the state-backed entity responsible for the sector's development, mandates that all project developers demonstrate clear strategies for local supply chains, SME participation, and community engagement. The SME Development Authority (Riyada) and Hydrom are collaborating to support small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which are being presented with opportunities across the entire value chain, from manufacturing renewable energy components to infrastructure.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a new commercial sesame-farming project in Oman's Dhofar Governor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a new commercial sesame-farming project in Oman's Dhofar Governorate. The initiative, a partnership with SIFCO, Salalah Free Zone, and the Omani Agricultural Association in Dhofar, utilizes a contract-farming model that connects farmers directly to processing facilities. In its initial phase, the project covers 600 feddans with a projected yield of 300 tonnes. The goal is to build a value-added agri-food chain by converting sesame into products like tahini and various oils. Officials state that this project will strengthen national food security and support the industrial diversification goals of Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.description: The Sustainable Rural Agricultural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a solar drying tunnel project for figs, which aims to reduce post-harvest losses by up to 30%. A successful trial produced 2,500 kilograms of dried figs, generating a return of over SAR100,000. The program also provided training on the new technology to 13 farmers and employees. This initiative is part of Saudi Reef's efforts to support the fruit sector and enhance food security by improving the quality and market value of agricultural products.
records.institution: Sustainable Rural Agricultural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.description: A tree-planting campaign was launched in the Azal District of Sana'a Capital as part of activities to mark the Prophet's birthday. Dozens of fruit-bearing trees provided by the sector's nursery were planted in streets and neighborhoods. The campaign reflects a commitment to agriculture and environmental preservation and relies on cooperation between officials and the community to ensure the continued care of the planted trees.

records.description: Maaden Bauxite and Alumina Company (MBAC), a subsidiary of Maaden, has signed a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Emerge, a joint venture between the UAE’s Masdar and France’s EDF. The agreement is for a solar power project with a battery energy storage system to supply the Al Baitha Bauxite Mine with clean energy. The off-grid facility will generate approximately 17,300 MWh of electricity annually and help to prevent 13,800 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions per year. This initiative aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 and its energy transition goals.
records.institution: Maaden

records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has launched a new investment opportunity for wild thyme cultivation in Saudi Arabia's Northern Borders Region. Covering an area of 1 million square meters, the initiative aims to enhance the sustainability of natural vegetation, increase local production to achieve self-sufficiency, and contribute to the local economy. This project is part of the NCVC's strategic plans to promote environmental and economic sustainability through the optimal use of natural resources and by fostering an investment environment that supports the agricultural sector and biodiversity.

records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), in partnership with Expo 2020 Dubai and Siemens Energy, has produced over 100 tonnes of...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), in partnership with Expo 2020 Dubai and Siemens Energy, has produced over 100 tonnes of green hydrogen from its project, the first of its kind in the Middle East and North Africa. The facility uses solar energy to produce and store hydrogen, which is then used to generate clean electricity and to fuel hydrogen-powered vehicles for companies like Emirates National Oil Company (ENOC). This initiative supports a number of key strategies in the UAE and Dubai, including the UAE's Net Zero 2050 Strategy and the Dubai Green Mobility Strategy 2030, reinforcing the country's leading position in green hydrogen competitiveness as noted in a report by Alvarez & Marsal.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (Dewa)

records.title: Qatar is working to increase its food self-sufficiency, with the National Food Security Strategy 2030 aiming to reduce reliance on import...
records.description: Qatar is working to increase its food self-sufficiency, with the National Food Security Strategy 2030 aiming to reduce reliance on imports and secure essential goods. The strategy focuses on local production of perishable items and building strategic reserves for storable products. While current self-sufficiency levels are high in dairy and poultry (98%), the country has set new targets for 2030, including reaching 55% in vegetables and 70% in eggs. This is supported by partnerships between the public and private sectors, with private companies investing in agricultural technology and livestock projects, while key institutions like the Ministry of Municipality, Qatar Chamber, and the Ministry of Commerce and Industry provide guidance and oversight.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.description: Agroforestry is a sustainable agricultural practice that combines trees with crops or pastures in a single area to provide environmental, economic, and social benefits. The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is spearheading efforts to promote agroforestry in the Kingdom. The NCVC's projects, including an action plan to advance agroforestry, aim to enhance environmental sustainability, foster economic and social development, and encourage investment. The organization is also strengthening partnerships with local communities to protect vegetation cover and support national targets aligned with the Saudi Green Initiative and Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's office in Yanbu, in collaboration with the Reef National Foundation, provided suppor...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's office in Yanbu, in collaboration with the Reef National Foundation, provided support to fishermen. The initiative included delivering marine engines and other tools and equipment for boats. The program also trained beneficiaries and, in a previous phase, supplied refrigeration vehicles and fishing boats in partnership with the Yanbu Cooperative Society for Fishermen. The fishing boats have generated significant sales from numerous fishing trips. This initiative is part of the larger Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM food company Topian, launc...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM food company Topian, launched a greenhouse management training program in Riyadh. The initiative, part of Estidamah's knowledge transfer program, aims to promote sustainable agricultural practices by training participants in the management of climate-controlled greenhouses. The curriculum focuses on advanced systems for smart irrigation, crop monitoring, and energy-saving solutions, while also addressing key challenges like water scarcity and soil health. This program supports the country's National Agriculture Strategy to improve production efficiency and enhance food security.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched an agricultural advisory application called Murshiduk to provide farmers...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched an agricultural advisory application called Murshiduk to provide farmers with fast and reliable guidance. The app offers real-time support through consultations, educational content, and seasonal advice to help farmers make informed decisions, thereby reducing costs and improving productivity. The ministry encourages all farmers to use the free application, which is available on iOS and Android, and has already provided over 6.4 million technical consultations to its 282,000 registered users.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The 8th annual Sharjah Investment Forum (SIF 2025) will be held in a joint agenda with the 29th World Investment Conference (WIC), markin...
records.description: The 8th annual Sharjah Investment Forum (SIF 2025) will be held in a joint agenda with the 29th World Investment Conference (WIC), marking the first time the two events have been integrated. The forum, organized by the Sharjah FDI Office (Invest in Sharjah) in partnership with the World Association of Investment Promotion Agencies (WAIPA) and the UAE Ministry of Investment, will address global shifts in investment strategies under the theme, "Transforming Our World: Investing for a Resilient and Sustainable Future." It will serve as a global platform for economic leaders, investors, and decision-makers to discuss sustainable investment, green finance, and food security as key drivers of resilience and growth.
records.institution: Sharjah FDI Office

records.title: The Survey and Land Registration Bureau (SLRB) in Bahrain has signed an agreement with the international company "Aetosky" to begin the s...
records.description: The Survey and Land Registration Bureau (SLRB) in Bahrain has signed an agreement with the international company "Aetosky" to begin the second phase of an AI-powered system that detects changes and building violations. This system, which utilizes satellite imagery, aims to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of geospatial data and improve coordination among government agencies. Building on the success of the first phase—which resulted in a more than 60% improvement in monitoring efficiency—this new phase focuses on transferring and localizing the AI technology within the Bureau and expanding its use to other government entities to support the country's Government Programme (2023–2026).
records.institution: Survey and Land Registration Bureau (SLRB)

records.title: The pastoral nursery in Oman's A’Dhahirah Governorate, which is affiliated with the Directorate General of Agricultural Wealth and Water...
records.description: The pastoral nursery in Oman's A’Dhahirah Governorate, which is affiliated with the Directorate General of Agricultural Wealth and Water Resources, has distributed over 8,000 pastoral seedlings free of charge to more than 385 beneficiaries. This initiative aims to increase vegetation cover, improve soil quality, and support beekeepers by providing plants essential for producing high-quality local honey. The distribution of these indigenous species is part of a broader effort to engage the local community in environmental conservation and promote the green economy in Oman.
records.institution: Directorate General of Agricultural Wealth and Water Resources in A’Dhahirah Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain, in cooperation with Checklist Events, Trade and Advisories, is organiz...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain, in cooperation with Checklist Events, Trade and Advisories, is organizing the first Bahrain Veterinary Medicine Forum and Exhibition. The event will serve as a platform for veterinarians, researchers, experts, and government and private institutions from Bahrain, the GCC, and worldwide to exchange knowledge and learn about the latest innovations in the field. The forum, which will include the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH), aims to address health and environmental challenges and enhance Bahrain's role as a regional hub for veterinary and scientific investment. An accompanying exhibition will feature the latest technologies and services from veterinary companies, hospitals, and clinics, fostering partnerships and investment.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: Markets in Saudi Arabia are experiencing a significant influx of local fig crops, with this season's production exceeding 28,100 tons.
records.description: Markets in Saudi Arabia are experiencing a significant influx of local fig crops, with this season's production exceeding 28,100 tons. The ministry is supporting local farmers through an integrated system of technical, advisory, and financial services to help them adopt modern agricultural technologies. This initiative is aimed at improving food security and is aligned with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.description: The Najran Region of Saudi Arabia is gaining recognition for its high-quality fig production, with annual output exceeding 650 tons. The region's unique climate makes it well-suited for this summer crop, which offers high economic returns and is used in various processing industries. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Najran Region supports farmers by providing agricultural guidance and improved seedlings to promote the adoption of good farming practices, which has led to a consistent expansion of the cultivated area and presents promising investment opportunities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Najran Region

records.description: The tissue culture laboratory of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture's (Estidamah) has delivered 4,000 coffee seedlings and 15,000 blackberry seedlings to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Al-Baha Region. records.description: Mango cultivation projects in the wilayats of Barka and Al Musanaah in South Al Batinah Governorate, Oman, are vital initiatives aimed at bolstering food security and reducing import reliance. records.description: The date trade in the Qassim Region of Saudi Arabia is a prominent economic pillar, largely centered around the Buraidah Dates Carnival. This market serves as a central hub where traders compete to acquire premium date varieties through public auctions, ensuring transparent transactions. The region's advanced infrastructure, including sales yards and refrigerated warehouses, facilitates sales, storage, and transportation, supporting the various marketing strategies of traders.
records.institution: Qassim Region

records.title: The Qassim Region in Saudi Arabia has become a model for sustainable agriculture and urban development by launching the "Qassim Land" ini...
records.description: The Qassim Region in Saudi Arabia has become a model for sustainable agriculture and urban development by launching the "Qassim Land" initiative. This program, which promotes green cities and the circular economy to support Sustainable Development Goal 12, focuses on advancing production methods, recycling agricultural waste, and expanding exports. The initiative was presented by the Saudi Green Building Forum at a United Nations forum as a success story. A key part of the region’s strategy is the launch of the "International Date Route," an effort to boost annual date exports and solidify the Kingdom’s position as a global date trading hub in line with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: Qassim Region

records.description: The Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development (KFED) is supporting the participation of 10 Emirati SMEs in Grains Africa 2025, a major event for agriculture and food security in Nairobi, Kenya. The SMEs, which specialize in agricultural technology, food security, and sustainable agriculture, are being backed as part of KFED's vision to enhance the global competitiveness of Emirati enterprises and expand the national entrepreneurial ecosystem. The initiative also aligns with the Fund’s "SME Export Enablement Programme," which aims to help small and medium-sized businesses enter international markets and contribute to the UAE's goals for industrial and agricultural innovation.
records.institution: Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development (KFED)

records.description: The inaugural Firnas Summit, organized by the Ibn Firnas Drone Center in Oman, was held to promote the use of drone technologies and position the country as a regional hub for the drone industry. The summit, which supports the goals of Oman Vision 2040, served as a platform for experts from various sectors, including representatives from the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, Nama Group, and Omantel. A key feature was the first Middle East launch of the DJI Matrice 400 (M400) drone, for which the Ibn Firnas Drone Center is the exclusive agent. The event included discussions on practical drone applications in urban planning, agriculture, and utilities, showcasing how the technology can improve service efficiency and support smart city infrastructure.
records.institution: Ibn Firnas Drone Center

records.description: A consortium led by Masdar, a UAE renewables company, has secured financial closure for the 2-gigawatt (GW) Al Sadawi solar project in Saudi Arabia. The $1.1 billion project, which includes partners GD Power Development Company and Korea Electric Power Corporation, has received funding from eight regional and international lenders, including Standard Chartered Bank, KEXIM, and HSBC. Located in the Eastern Province, the plant is a part of the National Renewable Energy Programme (NREP) and supports Saudi Arabia’s target of achieving 50% renewable energy by 2030.

records.description: Global South Utilities (GSU), a UAE-based company, has officially broken ground on a 50-megawatt (MW) solar plant in Sakaï, Central African Republic (CAR). The project, which includes a 10 MW-hour battery energy storage system (BESS), is expected to supply clean electricity to more than 300,000 households and offset over 50,000 tons of carbon emissions annually. This initiative, which also aims to create new employment opportunities, follows a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) signed between the UAE and CAR, reinforcing the UAE's commitment to clean energy investments in Africa.
records.institution: Global South Utilities (GSU)

records.title: Meranti Green Steel (MGS) is advancing its plans for a major green iron project in the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) in Oman.
records.description: Meranti Green Steel (MGS) is advancing its plans for a major green iron project in the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) in Oman. The first phase will feature a 2.5 million tonnes per annum (mtpa) Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant, with a Final Investment Decision (FID) targeted for mid-2026 and commissioning planned for mid-2029. The facility will initially use a mix of natural gas and green hydrogen, with the goal of progressively increasing the hydrogen share to 85% to reduce carbon emissions. This project is a key part of the company's strategy to supply sustainable materials to its proposed green steel mill in Rayong, Thailand, and to meet growing demand from European customers. Oman was selected as the project's location for its competitive energy resources and the robust infrastructure of SEZAD.
records.institution: Meranti Green Steel (MGS)

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) is making progress on its initiative to invest in insect farming as a sustainable source of protein for animal feed.
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) is making progress on its initiative to invest in insect farming as a sustainable source of protein for animal feed. The project, which is in the preliminary assessment stage with a feasibility study completed, involves producing insect meal from organic and poultry waste. The company is exploring the use of black soldier fly larvae (BSFL) as they contain a high crude protein content and can be reared efficiently on waste, aligning with a circular economy model. This initiative is one of several new ventures under consideration by OFM, which also include a health bar manufacturing facility and a baby food project in Uzbekistan. The company's animal feed division currently accounts for roughly half of its total revenue, and this project aims to further enhance its market position and address global trends toward sustainable protein.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills (OFM)

records.title: Qatar is advancing its renewable energy strategy, a key component of the Qatar National Vision (QNV) 2030 and the Third National Developm...
records.description: Qatar is advancing its renewable energy strategy, a key component of the Qatar National Vision (QNV) 2030 and the Third National Development Strategy 2024–2030. Three major solar power plants are now operational, including the flagship Al-Kharsaah Solar Power Plant (800 MW) and two others that add 875 MW of capacity. A larger, 2,000 MW project, the Al-Dhakhira Solar Power Plant, is also planned. These large-scale projects, alongside the "BeSolar Service" initiative by Qatar General Electricity & Water Corporation (Kahramaa), which enables residents to install rooftop solar panels and feed excess electricity back to the national grid, reflect the country's commitment to reducing carbon emissions, diversifying its economy, and transitioning to clean energy.
records.institution: Qatar General Electricity & Water Corporation (Kahramaa)

records.title: A model hydroponic farm in Madinah has produced over 2,015,000 kilograms of various crops, including lettuce and herbs, from an area of 1...
records.description: A model hydroponic farm in Madinah has produced over 2,015,000 kilograms of various crops, including lettuce and herbs, from an area of 183,000 square meters. The farm employs modern agricultural technologies that provide significant environmental and economic benefits, such as reducing fertilizer use by up to 60% and conserving approximately 90% of water compared to traditional methods. These efforts align with the country’s National Water Strategy 2030 and the National Agricultural Strategy, with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture supporting farmers to enhance production efficiency, quality, and market competitiveness.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi climate center launches project to digitize 73 years of weather records
records.description: The Regional Climate Change Center, in collaboration with the National Center for Meteorology, has launched a major project to digitize 73 years of historical climate records from 33 stations across Saudi Arabia. This initiative aims to enhance data accuracy and accessibility for scientific research and environmental planning by converting 36,000 paper archives into digital copies. The project follows a five-track process that includes data entry, auditing, and quality checks, with the ultimate goal of supporting the digital transformation of the meteorological sector and reinforcing the country's position as a leading regional hub for climate monitoring and forecasting.
records.institution: Regional Climate Change Center

records.title: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) are co-hosting a regional...
records.description: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) are co-hosting a regional hackathon called "Hack4safeFood" at the SFDA's headquarters in Riyadh. The event aims to foster innovation and develop technical and policy solutions for food safety challenges in the NENA region, with a focus on supply chain tracking, early warning systems, and reducing food waste. Winning participants will be offered a six-month incubation program and a chance to present their ideas at the FAO's Science and Innovation Forum in Rome. The hackathon highlights the ongoing collaboration between the two organizations to leverage data and artificial intelligence for better food practices.
records.institution: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.title: A workshop on expanding grain and legume production was held in Hodeida governorate, organized by the local authority in cooperation with...
records.description: A workshop on expanding grain and legume production was held in Hodeida governorate, organized by the local authority in cooperation with the General Corporation for Grain Development and Production. The event aimed to achieve national self-sufficiency and reduce import costs by strengthening the role of agricultural associations and promoting a contract farming project. Officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the local government affirmed the importance of the initiative, highlighting the governorate’s potential and the commitment to supporting farmers with modern inputs and stable marketing mechanisms to ensure food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Al-Baha Region of Saudi Arabia is a key agricultural area with a growing interest in grape cultivation, which currently spans 51 hect...
records.description: The Al-Baha Region of Saudi Arabia is a key agricultural area with a growing interest in grape cultivation, which currently spans 51 hectares with an annual production of 772 tons. To support this sector, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is launching the Grape City Project in Baljurashi Governorate, a large platform designed to provide advanced facilities for sorting, packaging, and marketing to enhance product quality and market competitiveness. The ministry also empowers farmers through government support programs, including the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (REEF) and the Organic Agriculture Program, which provides financial and technical assistance to increase production efficiency and help farms obtain organic certification.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Unaizah International Dates Season in Saudi Arabia is a leading environmental event that operates with zero carbon emissions.
records.description: The Unaizah International Dates Season in Saudi Arabia is a leading environmental event that operates with zero carbon emissions. The season features a market platform launched by the National Center for Palms and Dates to enhance transparency and efficiency in the buying and selling of dates. As the world's largest producer and exporter of dates, the Kingdom reinforces its global position through the event, which aligns with the agricultural sustainability and economic diversification goals of Saudi Vision 2030. The season receives support from relevant government entities and broad participation from farmers, marketers, and entrepreneurs.
records.institution: National Center for Palms and Dates

records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) and the Dibba Al Hisn Municipality are co-organizing the Al Maleh and Fishing Festiva...
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) and the Dibba Al Hisn Municipality are co-organizing the Al Maleh and Fishing Festival at Al Hisn Island. The festival's purpose is to preserve the UAE's maritime heritage by celebrating the traditional salted fish (Al Maleh) industry and other ancient sea-based crafts. It serves as a platform to stimulate economic and tourism activity in the Eastern Region by empowering entrepreneurs and productive families in marine industries. The event features educational workshops, seminars on sustainable fishing, and exhibition spaces, blending traditional practices with modern approaches to support the long-term viability of the maritime economy.
records.institution: Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: A meeting in Al-Hodeidah province, attended by officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the General...
records.description: A meeting in Al-Hodeidah province, attended by officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the General Authority for Fisheries, discussed strengthening cooperation with Hodeida University. The primary goal is to activate specialized research on fisheries to support sustainable practices, preserve marine resources, and improve livelihoods. The participants also discussed transforming the Faculty of Agriculture’s farm into a model training and research station to provide students with practical experience. The meeting underscored the importance of linking academic institutions with government entities to address community needs and enhance sustainable development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The General Authority for the Development of Tihama, represented by its Agricultural Extension Department, organized a training workshop...
records.description: The General Authority for the Development of Tihama, represented by its Agricultural Extension Department, organized a training workshop for Farmer Field School facilitators in Al-Hodeidah. Held under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and with support from the Agricultural and Fisheries Initiatives Financing Unit, the training targeted 16 facilitators. The workshop aimed to enhance participants’ skills in field-based education to improve the production of strategic crops like cotton, sesame, and maize. The program underscored the importance of hands-on training for adopting modern agricultural techniques and the vital role of facilitators in enhancing food security and achieving a qualitative shift in crop production.
records.institution: General Authority for the Development of Tihama

records.title: Agricultural markets in the Kingdom are experiencing an abundance of local pomegranate production, with a volume exceeding 37,100 tons, w...
records.description: Agricultural markets in the Kingdom are experiencing an abundance of local pomegranate production, with a volume exceeding 37,100 tons, which is boosting food security and self-sufficiency. According to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, cultivation is concentrated in the Aseer, Makkah, Tabuk, Qassim, and Al-Baha regions, with popular varieties including Taifi, Hijazi, Wonderful, and Eversweet. The ministry is committed to supporting farmers with technical and financial assistance and by promoting modern agricultural technologies to enhance production, in line with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: New agricultural and development projects with a total budget of 344,533,000 Yemeni riyals have been inaugurated in the southern district...
records.description: New agricultural and development projects with a total budget of 344,533,000 Yemeni riyals have been inaugurated in the southern district of the Al-Hodeidah governorate. Funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, the projects include the rehabilitation of irrigation facilities and canals in Wadi Zabid, the restoration of buildings for the General Authority for Tihama Development, the construction of six dual-purpose greenhouses, and the drilling of a solar-powered well. The initiatives are part of a government plan to strengthen the agricultural sector, improve production, and achieve food security and self-sufficiency, with the aim of creating jobs, supporting farmers, and restoring the region's role as a key "food basket."
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources
