records.title: The Date Palm Harvest Closing Festival was held in the Al-Tuhaita District of the Al-Hodeidah Governorate, highlighting the economic and...
records.description: The Date Palm Harvest Closing Festival was held in the Al-Tuhaita District of the Al-Hodeidah Governorate, highlighting the economic and social importance of dates to the Tihama region. Organized under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the local authority, in cooperation with institutions such as the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the Agricultural and Fisheries Project and Initiative Financing Unit, the General Authority for the Development of Tihama, and the Al-Balad Al-Tayyibah Multipurpose Association, the festival aims to support farmers and promote Tihami dates. The event showcased a variety of dates and related products and featured traditional cultural activities, underscoring a commitment to developing this strategic crop and improving production methods.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP) in Oman has announced four new usufruct land investment opportunities totaling 16 hecta...
records.description: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP) in Oman has announced four new usufruct land investment opportunities totaling 16 hectares in the Dhahirah governorate. The projects are dedicated to cultivating citrus, figs, and palms for date production, as well as livestock and fodder cultivation. These initiatives, developed in cooperation with the Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources, aim to strengthen the agricultural sector and attract investors to support the economic diversification goals of Oman Vision 2040. Preference will be given to proposals that utilize modern irrigation systems and sustainable practices to enhance food security and improve competitiveness in local and export markets.
records.institution: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP)

records.title: Saudi Arabia has lifted its ban on poultry imports from Brazil's southernmost state of Rio Grande do Sul following a bird flu outbreak.
records.description: Saudi Arabia has lifted its ban on poultry imports from Brazil's southernmost state of Rio Grande do Sul following a bird flu outbreak. The decision was welcomed by Brazilian food processor BRF, whose exports had been affected by the trade restrictions. Chile, which had also imposed restrictions, has agreed to resume buying Brazilian poultry products. Meanwhile, other large importers like China have not yet resumed buying.
records.institution: Saudi Arabia Government

records.title: Saudi Arabia is addressing soil pollution through a multi-pronged approach that includes mapping, regulation, monitoring, emergency respo...
records.description: Saudi Arabia is addressing soil pollution through a multi-pronged approach that includes mapping, regulation, monitoring, emergency response drills, and strict waste controls. The efforts are aimed at mitigating threats to human health, food security, and climate resilience caused by contaminants like heavy metals, hydrocarbons, and industrial and agricultural chemicals. This is in line with warnings from environmental agencies about the global consequences of soil degradation, which can lead to biodiversity loss, degraded farmland, and polluted groundwater.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The third annual Agricultural Products Festival is taking place in Tayma Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and...
records.description: The third annual Agricultural Products Festival is taking place in Tayma Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Tabuk Region. The four-day event, held at Tayma’s Historic Wall Park, involves over 30 farmers and exhibitors, as well as various government and non-profit entities. The festival aims to support local farmers by providing a marketing platform for their products and to promote sustainable agricultural practices, in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. The event features a variety of local crops, educational workshops on topics such as organic farming, and dedicated sections for producer families to sell their handicrafts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Organic Meat Company Limited (TOMCL), a Karachi-based processor and exporter, has become the first Pakistani meat company to gain app...
records.description: The Organic Meat Company Limited (TOMCL), a Karachi-based processor and exporter, has become the first Pakistani meat company to gain approval to supply products directly to Carrefour outlets in the United Arab Emirates. The approval, which came after TOMCL achieved a score of 94.89% in a comprehensive audit, allows the company to supply its chilled and frozen halal meat products without intermediaries. This move, supported by MAF Hypermarkets Pakistan (Private) Limited, is considered a key stage in TOMCL's expansion into Middle Eastern markets and is expected to increase its export volumes to the UAE. The company's new status as an authorized vendor for Carrefour UAE, which is operated by Majid Al-Futtaim Hypermarket LLC, provides access to a high-value retail channel in a market where demand for halal-certified meat is strong.
records.institution: The Organic Meat Company Limited (TOMCL)

records.title: A new international study led by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), and published in the journal Nature, offers...
records.description: A new international study led by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), and published in the journal Nature, offers a blueprint to reverse land degradation by the year 2050. The study, conducted in collaboration with the AEON Collective and the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD), proposes three key actions: increasing sustainable food production from the sea, reducing food waste by 75%, and restoring 50% of degraded land. Implementing these measures would save a total land area roughly the size of Africa and protect biodiversity and food security. The research highlights that these approaches are feasible and can be achieved by transforming food systems, supporting small-scale farms, and fostering international cooperation.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: The third edition of the Tayma Governorate’s Agricultural Products Festival has been launched, organized by the Ministry of Environment,...
records.description: The third edition of the Tayma Governorate’s Agricultural Products Festival has been launched, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Tabuk Region branch. The four-day event features over 30 farmers and exhibitors, alongside several governmental and non-profit organizations. The festival's primary goal is to showcase the rich variety of crops in the governorate, support the agricultural sector, empower small-scale farmers, and strengthen food security. It includes dedicated sections for children to learn about farming and other awareness activities for the public.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Tabuk Region branch

records.title: EWEC issues RFP for UAE’s largest single-site carbon-capture-ready CCGT power plant
records.description: Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC) has issued a Request for Proposals (RFP) for the Al Nouf Independent Power Producer (IPP) project, which is planned to be the UAE's largest single-site carbon-capture-ready Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant. The 3.3 gigawatt (GW) plant will be located at the new Al Nouf Complex in Abu Dhabi, a strategic hub for power and water production that can also accommodate desalination technologies. The project, expected to begin commercial operations in the third quarter of 2029, will provide transitional capacity to support large-scale renewable energy integration and meet peak demand. The requirements for the RFP include the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and digital twins to optimize the plant's performance and maintenance.
records.institution: EWEC (Emirates Water and Electricity Company)

records.title: New agricultural projects with a total budget of 272.5 million riyals have been launched in the Al-Hodeidah governorate, funded by the Pr...
records.description: New agricultural projects with a total budget of 272.5 million riyals have been launched in the Al-Hodeidah governorate, funded by the Project and Agricultural & Fisheries Initiatives Financing Unit. The projects, located in the Al-Duha District, include the drilling of five solar-powered wells and the restoration of the Agricultural Research Center “Tihama Station”. These initiatives are part of a plan by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources to enhance the agricultural sector, improve productivity, and contribute to food security and self-sufficiency. The projects are expected to provide sustainable water resources for the General Organization for Seed Multiplication and enhance the research capabilities of the center, thereby improving farmers' livelihoods.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman is now focusing on the development of white hydrogen, a naturally forming, low-emission energy source.
records.description: Oman is now focusing on the development of white hydrogen, a naturally forming, low-emission energy source. A key agreement between Sohar Port and Freezone and the Swiss company Hynat will facilitate the evaluation and development of this resource, in line with Oman Vision 2040 and the National Strategy for an Orderly Transition to Net Zero. While significant technical challenges exist in subsurface estimation and extraction, academic institutions like Sultan Qaboos University are set to play a crucial role in research and development. The goal is to leverage innovations in technology, including artificial intelligence, to overcome hurdles and position Oman as a frontrunner in this emerging sector, thereby enhancing energy security and economic resilience.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The third Agricultural Products Festival is being held in Tayma Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agricult...
records.description: The third Agricultural Products Festival is being held in Tayma Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Tabuk Region branch. The four-day event, featuring over 30 farmers and exhibitors, aims to showcase the diverse agricultural products of the Tabuk Region, including crops, palm produce, and vegetables. The festival also includes a dedicated area to introduce children to the fundamentals of agriculture and a guidance corner that promotes modern and sustainable farming techniques.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Tabuk Region branch

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and the EDF Group, has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Emirates Development Bank (ED...
records.description: Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and the EDF Group, has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Emirates Development Bank (EDB) to explore developing and financing distributed solar projects in the UAE. Under the agreement, Emerge will identify potential renewable energy projects for EDB to evaluate and offer tailored financing solutions. The partnership aims to support the UAE's energy transition and strengthen industrial growth by helping commercial and industrial businesses, including small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), to lower costs and achieve their clean energy goals.
records.institution: Emerge

records.title: Oman is revitalizing its olive sector, particularly in the Al Jabal Al Akhdhar and Western Hajar mountain ranges, as part of a national v...
records.description: Oman is revitalizing its olive sector, particularly in the Al Jabal Al Akhdhar and Western Hajar mountain ranges, as part of a national vision for food security. With government support, including the distribution of free saplings and the establishment of modern olive mills, the number of olive trees has increased to 20,000. The country's production reached over 83 tonnes of olives and 10,000 liters of olive oil in 2022, but this still falls short of the high demand. To further boost output, research from the College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences is identifying ideal cultivation areas and promoting best practices, while new efforts are being made to transform by-products like olive leaves into value-added products.
records.institution: College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The annual prickly pear season in the Aseer region, where the fruit is known as "Al-Barshumi," is a significant seasonal event that blend...
records.description: The annual prickly pear season in the Aseer region, where the fruit is known as "Al-Barshumi," is a significant seasonal event that blends nutritional value with tourism appeal. The season revitalizes local markets, with visitors and vacationers purchasing the fruit in its various colors, from green and yellow to red. According to a researcher from the National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa), the prickly pear is a nutrient-dense cactus fruit rich in fiber, vitamin C, and essential minerals like potassium and calcium. Its consumption is linked to several health benefits, including improved digestive health, boosted immunity, and the regulation of blood sugar and blood pressure.
records.institution: National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa)

records.title: The Madinah Regional Municipality is organizing the first-ever grape festival in the Al-Hanakiyah Governorate to promote local agricultur...
records.description: The Madinah Regional Municipality is organizing the first-ever grape festival in the Al-Hanakiyah Governorate to promote local agricultural products, support productive families, and enhance handicrafts. The five-day event, to be held at the Al-Nakheel Center, will feature an exhibition of grape varieties, traditional and artistic performances, and children's activities. The festival aims to revive Al-Nakheel’s agricultural heritage, market local products, and encourage investment in farming, in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: Madinah Regional Municipality

records.title: Dragon fruit from the Balangir district of Odisha has been exported to Dubai, UAE for the second consecutive year, reflecting the state’s...
records.description: Dragon fruit from the Balangir district of Odisha has been exported to Dubai, UAE for the second consecutive year, reflecting the state’s growing agri-horticulture export sector. The 330 kg shipment was sold at a 20% higher price compared to the previous year, highlighting increased demand and market access for farmers. This export was facilitated under the Promotion and Stabilization of Farmer-Producer Organizations (PSFPO) project, implemented by Palladium with support from the Gates Foundation, and received marketing support from the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA). The initiative is part of a broader effort by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment (DA&FE) to empower local farmers and integrate them into competitive global markets.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Fourth Fruit Festival has opened in Tabarjal Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in...
records.description: The Fourth Fruit Festival has opened in Tabarjal Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region. The event brings together 30 local farmers and 20 families from the cottage industry to showcase agricultural products, handcrafted goods, and fruit processing industries. In addition to commercial pavilions, the festival offers cultural activities, including visual arts, theatrical performances, and a children's art studio. The primary objective of the festival is to support local farmers, promote their products, and establish new marketing channels.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM Food Company Topian, has l...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM Food Company Topian, has launched the second edition of a greenhouse management training program to enhance the skills of national cadres. The program aims to equip participants with advanced expertise in modern technologies such as smart irrigation, crop monitoring systems, and energy-saving solutions. Trainees will receive hands-on experience under the guidance of experts to prepare them for managing climate-controlled greenhouses and addressing key agricultural challenges like water scarcity and soil health. This initiative is part of Estidamah's commitment to supporting agricultural innovation and aligns with the objectives of the National Agriculture Strategy to improve production efficiency and preserve natural resources.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), is a key driver in the...
records.description: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), is a key driver in the food and agriculture sector, with a strategic focus on food sustainability and diversifying supply sources. Since its establishment, SALIC has pursued a long-term investment strategy, resulting in a diversified international portfolio of 13 projects across seven countries. The company's managed assets have increased to over SAR27 billion, reflecting its successful approach of balancing economic returns with a commitment to food security. Through its global investments, SALIC has access to more than 20 million tons of strategic commodities, strengthening the Kingdom's ability to respond to emergencies and achieve its development goals.
records.institution: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC)

records.title: In Al-Bayda Province, a preliminary survey for a veterinary campaign targeting cattle and goats has been launched by 11 field teams from...
records.description: In Al-Bayda Province, a preliminary survey for a veterinary campaign targeting cattle and goats has been launched by 11 field teams from the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries. The ten-day survey aims to detect and treat livestock diseases by collecting samples for diagnostic tests, which will help identify the appropriate vaccines and preventive measures needed. The campaign is intended to protect this vital resource and contribute to its development, and local authorities have been urged to cooperate with the teams to ensure their success.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: Dhofar Foods & Investment (DFI), a key player in Oman's food security efforts, will participate in a Food Safety Exhibition in Salalah.
records.description: Dhofar Foods & Investment (DFI), a key player in Oman's food security efforts, will participate in a Food Safety Exhibition in Salalah. The company's presence at the event, which is part of its year-long "Rooted in Oman. Nurturing the Future" campaign, aims to highlight its role in advancing the nation's journey toward self-sufficiency and sustainable development in line with Oman Vision 2040. DFI will showcase its vertically integrated model across various sectors, including dairy, beverages, and agriculture, through an interactive exhibition space. The company's participation also serves to emphasize the Dhofar Governorate's growing importance as a strategic food production hub, with the goal of enhancing local value creation, supporting job opportunities, and reducing import dependence.
records.institution: Dhofar Foods & Investment (DFI)

records.title: Oman's agricultural sector is undergoing a transformation toward innovation and technology, in line with Oman Vision 2040, to enhance foo...
records.description: Oman's agricultural sector is undergoing a transformation toward innovation and technology, in line with Oman Vision 2040, to enhance food security and sustainability. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is leading this effort by providing financial and technical support to innovative projects and collaborating with research centers and international organizations like the Arab Organisation for Agricultural Development (AOAD) and the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO). The government has also enacted legislation to support agricultural startups, including tax exemptions and customs waivers on modern technologies. This focus on innovation is demonstrated by a research study from Sultan Qaboos University on the antifungal properties of the local Harmal plant and by new products from innovators, such as the organic pesticides from the company AZDARA and the smart soil analysis device from the University of Technology and Applied Sciences in Ibri. These collective efforts aim to promote sustainable practices, reduce chemical usage, and transform the food system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Farms in Saudi Arabia's Aseer Region have become a leading model for sustainable agricultural tourism, drawing visitors to its mountainou...
records.description: Farms in Saudi Arabia's Aseer Region have become a leading model for sustainable agricultural tourism, drawing visitors to its mountainous highlands. The region's farmers have transformed their agricultural holdings, known for a variety of crops, honey, and roses, into tourist destinations offering immersive experiences in nature and farming techniques. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Aseer highlights the region's prominent role, noting that it has over 159,000 agricultural holdings, is the top national honey producer, and contributes 14% of the Kingdom's fruit production. With 40 tourist farms, including the country's largest rose farm, Aseer is positioning itself as a major rural tourism destination that blends nature and heritage.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Aseer

records.title: An activation workshop was held in Yemen's Dhamar province for directors of agriculture branches, organized by the governorate’s Agricult...
records.description: An activation workshop was held in Yemen's Dhamar province for directors of agriculture branches, organized by the governorate’s Agriculture Sector and funded by the Executive Unit for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing. The workshop focused on preparing for the second phase of the Grain and Legumes Expansion Project and intensifying oversight of pesticide and fertilizer sales, with a specific emphasis on smuggled or banned products. The event highlighted the importance of enhancing agricultural production and achieving food security by leveraging available facilitations like contract farming and loans provided through agricultural cooperatives. Discussions also covered mechanisms for monitoring and licensing vendors and strengthening the role of cooperatives in supporting the resilient community economy.
records.institution: Executive Unit for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing

records.title: The General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Enterprises implemented numerous projects in the first half of a given year...
records.description: The General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Enterprises implemented numerous projects in the first half of a given year to create sustainable jobs, support local production, and empower communities. The initiatives, which are aligned with priorities set by the National Committee for Economic Empowerment, focused on six key value chains: dairy, sesame, palm, cotton, leather, and fish. Key achievements included providing interest-free loans and in-kind support for farmers and fishermen, often in partnership with the General Authority for Zakat and local associations. The Authority also established several revolving lending portfolios in various governorates, implemented training and capacity-building programs, and conducted research to design targeted interventions.
records.institution: General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Enterprises

records.title: Oman is adopting smart agriculture to address environmental challenges and ensure food security.
records.description: Oman is adopting smart agriculture to address environmental challenges and ensure food security. This strategy, also known as precision farming, uses technologies like IoT sensors, drones, and AI-powered analytics to improve efficiency and reduce waste. Pilot projects, led by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, are implementing methods such as hydroponics and aquaponics in greenhouses. The country is also focusing on developing human capital through initiatives like the Agriculture Innovation Centre to train a new generation of "agripreneurs" with the necessary digital skills. This move toward smart agriculture aligns with the national strategic plan.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Wadi Qafeefah dam is successfully supporting agriculture in the drought-hit Ibra region.
records.description: The Wadi Qafeefah dam is successfully supporting agriculture in the drought-hit Ibra region. The dam, which is 122 meters long and 24.3 meters high, has a storage capacity of up to 926,520 cubic meters of water. This water is helping to replenish groundwater, recharge traditional irrigation systems known as aflaj, and ultimately boost crop fertility. The region's agricultural output includes local produce like mangoes, dates, lemons, and bananas. The dam also contributes to the local ecosystem by providing habitats for wildlife and supporting indigenous flora.
records.institution: The Ministry of Information

records.title: Saudi Arabia's annual cantaloupe production exceeds 63,100 tons, with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture attributing this...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's annual cantaloupe production exceeds 63,100 tons, with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture attributing this high volume to the adoption of modern farming technologies. These advancements have not only increased production and improved the quality of various cantaloupe varieties but have also boosted farmers' incomes. This strategic focus on agricultural technology is part of the ministry's broader effort to enhance the Kingdom's food security and support the sustainability of the agricultural sector. The main cantaloupe-producing regions are identified as Riyadh, Qassim, Madinah, Hail, and Najran.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

The initiative has already recycled over 50,000 cubic meters of organic waste into high-quality fertilizer, which has been distributed to more than 1,300 farmers and used to rehabilitate over 3,000 hectares of degraded farmland. This project has also led to significant environmental and economic benefits, including a 30% reduction in chemical fertilizer use and the sequestration of carbon dioxide. As part of its community outreach, the RCU has provided training programs to more than 240 farmers and students, underscoring its commitment to long-term sustainability and food security in the region.

records.title: Kuwait is prioritizing environmental sustainability as a core pillar of its national plans, aiming to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060.
records.description: Kuwait is prioritizing environmental sustainability as a core pillar of its national plans, aiming to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060. The government has intensified efforts, guided by its Cabinet, to implement a long-term roadmap for low-carbon development. This roadmap emphasizes sustainable economic growth through a circular carbon economy, green investment, and innovative solutions. Kuwait is also working to diversify its energy mix, with an ambitious goal of generating 50% of its electrical power from renewable energy by 2025. Key projects include the Shagaya Renewable Energy Park and a policy requiring all facilities to produce a portion of their energy from renewable sources. Furthermore, the country is focusing on sustainable urban development through its 2040 Master Plan, promoting green buildings, and expanding green spaces to combat desertification.
records.institution: Federation of Arab News Agencies (FANA)

These opportunities, offered by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the North Al Sharqiyah Governor’s Office, are designed to attract private sector involvement. The agricultural projects focus on using modern farming techniques for crops such as figs, onions, garlic, potatoes, and dates, with the goal of ensuring sustainability and enhancing competitiveness. The commercial opportunities, which include a strategic investment project in Ibra and the establishment of industrial shops in Al Mudhaibi, are aligned with Oman Vision 2040 and aim to diversify national income, boost local economies, and create jobs for citizens.

records.title: Emerge signs 20-year solar energy deal with Misk City
records.description: Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and EDF power solutions, has signed a long-term agreement with Misk City to deliver sustainable electricity by developing a 621-kilowatt peak rooftop solar plant. The project, located in Riyadh, will be fully developed and managed by Emerge and is expected to significantly reduce the city’s carbon footprint. This initiative supports Misk City’s ambition to achieve a high level of environmental performance through LEED certification and its vision of becoming a leading green urban community. The partnership, which was attended by representatives from the French Embassy in Riyadh, leverages the combined expertise of the Masdar and EDF Group to accelerate the transition to clean power in the region.
records.institution: Emerge

records.title: The Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia is a vital hub for fish farming, with its strategic location on the Arabian Gulf facilitating exports...
records.description: The Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia is a vital hub for fish farming, with its strategic location on the Arabian Gulf facilitating exports to regional and international markets. According to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Eastern Region branch, the region has 88 licensed fish-farming projects, with 23 currently in production. In 2024, the combined production from these projects and the Arabian Gulf coasts exceeded 44,000 tons. These projects, which use a closed-system, semi-intensive farming method, have a target annual production capacity of 12,000 tons and an average investment value of SAR4 million to SAR6 million. This initiative is crucial for strengthening local markets, enhancing food security, and contributing to the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) in the UAE has released the results of its joint monitoring and inspection campaigns for the first half of 2025, which were conducted in collaboration with local authorities. The campaigns, which are part of MOCCAE’s Strategic Plan 2023–2026, involved 27 joint inspections of 91 facilities across various Emirates. The inspections focused on the livestock, agricultural, and fisheries sectors, as well as the environmental compliance of industrial facilities like crushers and cement factories. The initiative is a mechanism for enforcing environmental laws, identifying violations, and educating business owners about their role in achieving environmental sustainability. The ministry confirmed that legal actions, including penalties and closures, were taken against non-compliant entities, and that an emphasis was also placed on educational and awareness programs to prevent future violations.

The initiative is a collaborative effort with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones, designed to connect local agricultural output with the food processing industry and support the goals of Oman Vision 2040. SEFCO has committed to buying the entire sesame harvest from 35 farmers in the project’s first phase, which spans 600 acres. The partnership is a model of public-private cooperation aimed at reducing reliance on imports, enhancing self-sufficiency, and driving sustainable national growth.

The initiative, launched in 1438 AH, is supported by the Governor of Qassim Region and the Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture and is overseen by the ministry's branch in the region. It is implemented in two annual phases and is the result of collaboration between government agencies, the private sector, environmental associations, and volunteers. This effort is a prominent part of Saudi Arabia's wider environmental strategy, including the National Environment Strategy and the Saudi Green Initiative, which are aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.

records.description: The International Date Council has officially become an "Observer" in the Codex Alimentarius Commission, a move that signifies growing global recognition of the council's role. records.description: NRTC Food Holding LLC, a leading fruits and vegetables distribution company in the GCC, has acquired Al Hashemeya Farms, one of the largest privately managed farming estates in Egypt. The acquisition, a strategic move to secure a sustainable fresh produce supply and enhance regional food security, marks NRTC's direct entry into upstream agriculture. The 10,000-acre farm, located in Egypt’s Wadi El Natrun region, has a diverse portfolio of crops, including citrus, olives, and grapes, and is supported by modern irrigation systems. By controlling its supply chain from the source, NRTC aims to improve quality and reduce reliance on third-party suppliers.

records.description: The General Authority for Water Resources and Infrastructure held a workshop in Sana'a to launch a groundwater recharge program called "Blessings from the Sky and Earth." The event, which included officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the Water Resources Authority, focused on utilizing rainwater and floodwaters to replenish groundwater reserves and mitigate declining water levels. The program aims to optimize water resources for both drinking and agriculture, thereby enhancing water and food security. Officials emphasized the collective responsibility for water security and the importance of prioritizing drinking water and agriculture over other needs. The initiative is intended to be a national effort, involving local authorities in drafting proposals and educating the public on its importance.

records.title: Oman has adopted smart agriculture as a key part of its strategy to achieve food security and preserve natural resources, in line with Om...
records.description: Oman has adopted smart agriculture as a key part of its strategy to achieve food security and preserve natural resources, in line with Oman Vision 2040. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, through its Directorate General of Agricultural and Livestock Research, is promoting modern technologies such as soilless farming, smart irrigation, and drones. The strategy aims to enhance crop productivity and reduce costs while carefully balancing the integration of these innovations into traditional systems, such as upgrading aflaj irrigation channels. The ministry provides farmers with specialized training and, along with the Development Bank, offers financial support and soft loans to help them acquire these technologies. Despite challenges like infrastructure disparities and the need for greater technical awareness, Oman is steadily moving toward establishing smart agriculture as a cornerstone of its sustainable development.

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has been awarded the ISO 42001:2023 certification for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems, making it the first entity globally in the agriculture and food security sector, and the first government entity in the UAE, to receive this recognition. The certification acknowledges ADAFSA's responsible integration of AI, including intelligent analytics and machine learning, into its core functions. This achievement supports the UAE’s strategic focus on sustainability, digital innovation, and leadership in AI governance, and aligns with the goals of the UAE’s Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2031. The UAE has been proactively involved in shaping international AI standards through its Emirates AI Experts Group, and this milestone reinforces ADAFSA’s status as a leading body committed to pioneering innovation in food safety and long-term sustainability.

The initiative aims to improve urban greenery, enhance food security by utilizing public spaces for production, and serve as a model for other provinces. records.description: A scientific study conducted by the American University of Sharjah (AUS), in partnership with international research institutions, has highlighted the potential of soil microbiomes for sustainable agriculture in the UAE. The research, published in the journal Science, explores how microbial interactions in arid soils can enhance fertility and improve crop resilience under extreme weather conditions. To further this initiative, AUS has launched the Sharjah Sustainable Agriculture Research Group and is conducting field trials on local crops using microbial inoculants to improve resistance to heat, drought, and salinity. The study redefines soil as a living system that can be harnessed for sustainable and climate-resilient farming.
records.institution: American University of Sharjah (AUS)

records.title: The General Authority for Science, Research, Technology and Innovation in Yemen has announced the successful manufacturing and developmen...
records.description: The General Authority for Science, Research, Technology and Innovation in Yemen has announced the successful manufacturing and development of solar dryers as a sustainable solution to reduce post-harvest agricultural losses. A specialized technical team reverse-engineered a German solar dryer to produce a local version with comparable efficiency at only 30% of the import cost. The Authority has conducted research and trials on various Yemeni crops, such as grapes, coffee, and dates, and has also trained technicians from cooperative associations. The initiative, which has shown promising initial results with palm farmers in Al-Hodeidah, aims to increase crop quality, boost farmers' income, and promote local innovation.
records.institution: General Authority for Science, Research, Technology and Innovation

records.title: Bahrain's total livestock population has significantly increased over the past decade.
records.description: Bahrain's total livestock population has significantly increased over the past decade. The data indicates a substantial rise in the number of animals, with sheep remaining the most dominant livestock. Goat and cattle numbers have remained relatively stable, while horse and camel populations have also stayed consistent. The number of chicken farms has shown little change, reflecting a focus on local meat production.
records.institution: Bahrain Government

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman, through its sovereign wealth fund-majority-owned ME Solaris Commodities Holding (Solaris), has acquired a controll...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman, through its sovereign wealth fund-majority-owned ME Solaris Commodities Holding (Solaris), has acquired a controlling interest in Humberg Agribrasil Comércio e Exportação de Grãos SA (Agribrasil), a leading Brazilian grain exporter, and the Santa Catarina grain terminal (TESC). This strategic move strengthens Oman's global food security and expands its agricultural commodities footprint, aligning with Oman Vision 2040 by securing reliable food sources and diversifying its economy. Solaris gains entry into Brazilian corn and soybean markets and access to port logistics, while Agribrasil benefits from enhanced global reach and supply stability.
records.institution: ME Solaris Commodities Holding (Solaris)

records.title: King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (KACARE), in collaboration with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), has successfully deve...
records.description: King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (KACARE), in collaboration with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), has successfully developed and implemented an integrated water desalination system in Riyadh. This innovative system utilizes solar thermal energy and forward osmosis technology, a project carried out by a national team from KACARE and SWA's Water Technologies Innovation Institute and Research Advancement (WTIIRA). The initiative, part of a national effort to develop sustainable renewable energy solutions, has achieved significant environmental outcomes by creating a zero-carbon desalination system that reduces wastewater production by 20% compared to traditional methods. This project is crucial for bolstering Saudi Arabia's water security and supporting its transition to a low-carbon economy.
records.institution: King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (KACARE)

records.description: Saudi Arabia has made significant strides in environmental conservation, water sustainability, and food security under Saudi Vision 2030, as reported by its Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The National Environment Strategy has led to five specialized environmental centers and a large environmental fund, alongside new regulatory frameworks. Under the Saudi Green Initiative, substantial land rehabilitation and tree planting have occurred, with national parks increasing and protected areas expanding significantly. Enforcement efforts by the National Center for Environmental Compliance have surged, and air quality monitoring has expanded. Two pioneering centers, the Regional Center for Climate Change Studies and the Regional Center for Sand and Dust Storms, have been established.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Diriyah Gate Development Authority (DGDA) and the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) have signed a memorandum of understandi...
records.description: The Diriyah Gate Development Authority (DGDA) and the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) have signed a memorandum of understanding to enhance waste management and environmental sustainability within DGDA's supervisory area, aiming to transform Diriyah into a global cultural and tourist destination by 2030. This partnership, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030, involves MWAN providing qualified waste management service providers and clarifying regulations, while DGDA will pilot a sustainable neighborhood with waste source separation and recycling of construction and demolition waste. Both organizations will collaborate on improving waste management regulations and exchanging environmental data to support decision-making and achieve environmental sustainability across the Kingdom.
records.institution: Diriyah Gate Development Authority (DGDA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The State of Qatar is pursuing an ambitious strategy in renewable energy, primarily solar, to foster a green economy and reduce reliance...
records.description: The State of Qatar is pursuing an ambitious strategy in renewable energy, primarily solar, to foster a green economy and reduce reliance on biofuel, aligning with the environmental and energy objectives of the Qatar National Vision 2030. Targets include producing 20% of electricity from renewable sources by 2030 and slashing greenhouse gas emissions by 25%. Flagship projects like the 800-megawatt Al Kharsaah solar power plant, commissioned in 2022, and the recently operational Ras Laffan and Mesaieed solar power plants, with a combined capacity of 875 megawatts, have boosted Qatar's total solar output to 1,675 megawatts, covering nearly 15% of peak electricity demand. This strategic expansion by QatarEnergy, which aims to generate over 4,000 megawatts of renewable energy by 2030, demonstrates the nation's commitment to sustainability and economic diversification, with a growing reliance on national expertise for the construction, operation, and maintenance of these plants.
records.institution: QatarEnergy

records.description: Saudi Arabia has made significant progress in environmental conservation, water sustainability, and food security under Saudi Vision 2030, as reported by its Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The National Environment Strategy has led to five specialized environmental centers and a large environmental fund, alongside new regulatory frameworks. Under the Saudi Green Initiative, substantial land rehabilitation and tree planting have occurred, with national parks increasing and protected areas expanding significantly. Enforcement efforts by the National Center for Environmental Compliance have surged, and air quality monitoring has expanded. Two pioneering centers, the Regional Center for Climate Change Studies and the Regional Center for Sand and Dust Storms, have been established. In waste management, strategic plans are in place to divert waste from landfills.

records.title: The grape orchards in Saudi Arabia's Najran Region, covering approximately 67 hectares and yielding around 3,000 tons annually, are cruci...
records.description: The grape orchards in Saudi Arabia's Najran Region, covering approximately 67 hectares and yielding around 3,000 tons annually, are crucial for both the agricultural and tourism economies. The approaching conclusion of the summer grape harvest highlights the region's agricultural development and local production. This season is popular for residents and visitors, offering shopping and recreation opportunities in areas like Al-Hadhan Village, known for its landscapes and diverse crops. Najran's fertile soil, moderate climate, and abundant water contribute to its significant agricultural output and make it a rural tourism destination.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s regional branch in Tabuk Region has organized the third annual Honey and Agricultura...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s regional branch in Tabuk Region has organized the third annual Honey and Agricultural Products Festival, a five-day event at Prince Fahd bin Sultan Park. Over 45 farmers and beekeepers are participating, alongside various government, private, and non-profit entities. The festival serves as a platform for agricultural awareness and the promotion of local honey products, aiming to strengthen collaboration, provide marketing opportunities, elevate product quality, and encourage investment in agriculture and beekeeping. It aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals to support productive sectors and empower small-scale producers, featuring over 45 booths, including a "Young Beekeeper" section for children.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s regional branch

records.title: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center) has launched the "BugVape" Applicati...
records.description: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center) has launched the "BugVape" Application Project in Saudi Arabia, an innovative technology adopted by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) for the early detection of red palm weevil infestations. This project, part of a regional management program in the NENA region, aims to strengthen efforts against the destructive pest by enabling early detection that significantly outperforms traditional visual inspections. The Weqaa Center plans to expand the application of this technology through strategic local and international partnerships, following final evaluations.
records.institution: National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center)

records.title: The Liwa Ajman Dates and Honey Festival, in its 10th edition, was opened by the Crown Prince of Ajman and Chairman of Ajman Executive Cou...
records.description: The Liwa Ajman Dates and Honey Festival, in its 10th edition, was opened by the Crown Prince of Ajman and Chairman of Ajman Executive Council, reflecting the legacy of the late Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan in strengthening national identity and Emirati heritage. Organized by the Ajman Department of Tourism Development (ADTD) at the Emirates Hospitality Centre, the festival showcases dates, honey, and fruits from producers across the UAE, GCC, and Arab world, including Saudi Arabia, Oman, Jordan, and Egypt. The event aims to promote Ajman's cultural legacy, enhance its identity, and boost its reputation as a cultural and tourism destination, while also supporting sustainable development and innovation in local agriculture.
records.institution: Ajman Executive Council

records.title: The Municipal Council’s Technical Committee in Kuwait has approved Kuwait Flour Mills and Bakeries Company (KFMB) to expand its operation...
records.description: The Municipal Council’s Technical Committee in Kuwait has approved Kuwait Flour Mills and Bakeries Company (KFMB) to expand its operational scope across all bakery locations. This strategic move allows KFMB to offer a wider range of food and beverage services, including retail sales of all manufactured products, hot and cold beverages, pies, pastries, sweets, and the operation of various bakery styles. The approval also permits the use of designated areas for manufacturing and storing industrial products, though it is contingent upon clearances from the Ministry of Finance, the Public Authority for Industry, and other relevant regulatory bodies. The decision supports Kuwait's urban development goals and the company's commitment to consumer preferences.
records.institution: Kuwait Flour Mills and Bakeries Company (KFMB)

records.title: In Saudi Arabia's Najran Region, over 500,000 palm trees cultivate more than 40,000 tons of high-quality dates annually, including Najran...
records.description: In Saudi Arabia's Najran Region, over 500,000 palm trees cultivate more than 40,000 tons of high-quality dates annually, including Najran Rothana, Shishi, Barhi, Medjool, and local specialties like Al-Bayad and Al-Mawakil, significantly contributing to the local market and regional economic activity. The area's moderate climate and fertile soil enhance date quality. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture actively supports palm tree cultivation, ensuring product quality and effective marketing, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 to increase local agricultural output, ensure food security, and promote sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Three specialized laboratories from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region are providing quality s...
records.description: Three specialized laboratories from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region are providing quality services to farmers at the ongoing Khairat Al-Jouf Festival in Sakaka. These include a pesticide residue laboratory with a portable testing device for immediate, on-site results; a soil and water testing laboratory offering comprehensive analysis for optimal agricultural practices; and an olive oil quality testing laboratory conducting precise acidity assessments. These services aim to ensure product quality and adherence to approved standards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) in the UAE has launched the MUSTADEEM program as part of the 'Year of Community',...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) in the UAE has launched the MUSTADEEM program as part of the 'Year of Community', aiming to develop youth skills in environment and sustainability. This first edition, targeting Emirati youth aged 13-16, is organized in partnership with Silal, an agricultural food and technology company, and the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA). The program offers specialized workshops in areas like soil and water laboratory, post-harvest laboratory, and crop health, alongside professional safety awareness. It seeks to shape future sustainability leaders in agriculture and the environment, foster innovation in food security, and enhance participants' readiness for the job market by empowering them with research, analytical, and teamwork skills.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman, represented by its Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, is participating in the second United N...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman, represented by its Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, is participating in the second United Nations Food Systems Summit (UNFSS+4) in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Jointly organized by the governments of Ethiopia and Italy, the summit aims to review global progress in transforming food systems to align with the 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The gathering seeks to enhance joint action, assess national and international efforts, and mobilize resources to establish comprehensive, sustainable, and resilient food systems that ensure food security and nutrition for all.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) hosted a delegation from Shell to discuss Shell's "Energy Security Scenarios" report, which...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) hosted a delegation from Shell to discuss Shell's "Energy Security Scenarios" report, which explores AI's impact on global energy systems. DEWA showcased its pioneering clean energy projects, including the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, aiming for a significant capacity by 2030, and its new headquarters, the Al Shera'a building, designed to be the tallest and largest net-positive energy government building. DEWA also highlighted its remarkable achievements in adopting AI, aiming to become the world's first AI-native utility, and its global leadership in low electricity and water network losses and customer minutes lost.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

records.title: The Zabid Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association has launched a community-led initiative in Wadi Rama’, Al-Hodeidah, to rehabi...
records.description: The Zabid Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association has launched a community-led initiative in Wadi Rama’, Al-Hodeidah, to rehabilitate 14 main and secondary irrigation canals. This effort, supported by the Provincial Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, aims to revive the agricultural infrastructure in the area, which has suffered from years of neglect. The initiative is part of a broader effort to enhance food security and expand arable land, and has been praised by local authorities for demonstrating effective cooperation between communities and officials in serving the agricultural sector and improving livelihoods.
records.institution: Zabid Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Northern Borders Region is undertaking a national excellence project for ani...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Northern Borders Region is undertaking a national excellence project for animal research and disease control, spanning over 17,000 square meters and budgeted at SAR 29,636,570. This initiative aims to enhance veterinary security and the veterinary sector by improving diagnostic services and research capabilities through specialized facilities including laboratories, animal pens, and administrative buildings. The project's overarching goal is to foster an advanced scientific environment, improve transboundary animal disease control, strengthen food security and animal health, and contribute to the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 for sustainable agricultural and environmental development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture
