records.title: The 9th Al Dhaid Date Festival, held at Expo Al Dhaid, saw record participation from leading date producers and palm farmers across the UAE.
records.description: The 9th Al Dhaid Date Festival, held at Expo Al Dhaid, saw record participation from leading date producers and palm farmers across the UAE. Organized by the Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), the festival showcased innovative sustainable farming technologies, including modern agricultural mechanization and AI-driven processes, alongside the preservation of traditional practices. The event served as a commercial and marketing platform for technology transfer among farmers, emphasizing product excellence and innovation's role in food security and sustainable development. Notable participants like Al-Washah Dates Farm and Al-Fahd Dates Farm highlighted premium local date varieties and strategic investments in downstream industries, respectively. Young farmers also presented inspiring success stories, reflecting the UAE's efforts to empower youth in agriculture. Participating farmers praised the consistent support from the Sharjah Chamber.
records.institution: Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: Saudi Arabia's agricultural sector is experiencing a successful summer fruit harvest, with watermelon production exceeding 610,000 tons a...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's agricultural sector is experiencing a successful summer fruit harvest, with watermelon production exceeding 610,000 tons and demonstrating high demand in local markets. The diverse and high-quality watermelon varieties, such as Charleston Gray, Klondike R7, Congo, Royal Sweet, and Crimson Round, are integral to various food processing industries like juices, ice creams, and candies. This successful harvest aligns with Saudi Arabia's vision for food security and self-sufficiency, supporting the national economy. The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture actively empowers farmers through technical guidance, financial facilitation, and the promotion of modern agricultural technologies, while also supporting supply chains and marketing programs to ensure national products reach consumers efficiently and enhance their economic impact.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Qatif Governorate office of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia commemorated the International Day for...
records.description: The Qatif Governorate office of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia commemorated the International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem with a field visit to the Ras Tanura Mangrove Eco-Park. The event included participation from the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) and local beekeepers. This participation was part of a ministry initiative to promote the responsible economic use of mangrove resources and to showcase locally produced mangrove honey. The Ras Tanura Mangrove Eco-Park is significant as the Kingdom’s first nature reserve specifically dedicated to mangrove forests, classified as an organic nature reserve due to its rich biodiversity and balanced coastal ecosystem, making it a vital component of the national environmental protection system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: UN-Water has recognized the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia as a global model for best practices in accelerating progress towards Sustainable Dev...
records.description: UN-Water has recognized the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia as a global model for best practices in accelerating progress towards Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6), which focuses on water. This announcement was made during the High-Level Political Forum on Sustainable Development (HLPF) at the United Nations headquarters in New York. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture represented the Kingdom, sharing insights on enhancing water security and sustainability in a water-scarce region. Key lessons included the importance of strong political commitment, clear strategies with measurable targets, effective use of innovation and data for improved water governance, private sector engagement, and robust international partnerships.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Dubai Municipality is participating in the Dubai Dates Festival to showcase its advanced laboratory services, agricultural initiatives, a...
records.description: Dubai Municipality is participating in the Dubai Dates Festival to showcase its advanced laboratory services, agricultural initiatives, and food safety programs, while also promoting environmental sustainability. This involvement highlights the Municipality's dedication to supporting national products and fostering a sustainable food ecosystem. The Dubai Central Laboratory will conduct daily on-site testing of date samples using its Mobile Food Testing Lab, ensuring rapid analysis and adherence to international safety standards. The Municipality will also present its agricultural programs that support local farmers through education and sustainable practices, emphasizing productivity enhancement and environmental impact reduction. Furthermore, it will showcase scientific pest control efforts, particularly against the red palm weevil, offering live demonstrations, expert consultations, and information on tissue culture techniques and free home palm pest control services.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.title: The Government of Change and Development in Yemen has launched the Value Chain Management Program, a strategic initiative aimed at signif...
records.description: The Government of Change and Development in Yemen has launched the Value Chain Management Program, a strategic initiative aimed at significantly reducing import costs and achieving self-sufficiency. This program, considered vital for economic resilience and job creation, particularly in rural and urban areas, is built on a national vision leveraging Yemen's potential, with success dependent on genuine partnerships between the government, private sector, and community. The Ministry of Administration and Local and Rural Development plays a pivotal coordinating role, mobilizing community initiatives and encouraging local authority participation.
records.institution: The Ministries of Economy, Industry and Investment

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Qassim Fruits Exhibition has opened in Buraidah, organized by the Qassim Principality and the Qassim Chamber.
records.description: The Qassim Fruits Exhibition has opened in Buraidah, organized by the Qassim Principality and the Qassim Chamber. The three-day event showcases the diverse seasonal produce of the Qassim Region, including watermelons, cantaloupes, strawberries, grapes, pomegranates, peaches, figs, and over 150 varieties of pumpkins, some weighing more than 500 kilograms. The exhibition also features live cooking demonstrations, product tastings, and educational booths aimed at promoting agricultural knowledge and enriching food culture.
records.institution: Qassim Principality

records.title: A new agricultural products collection center is being developed in the Masroon area of Ibra, North Sharqiyah, Oman, with funding exceedi...
records.description: A new agricultural products collection center is being developed in the Masroon area of Ibra, North Sharqiyah, Oman, with funding exceeding RO300,000 from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund. This facility, spanning 42,000 square meters, will serve as a logistics hub for receiving, storing, and distributing seasonal produce, aiming to enhance local farming output, improve market access, and add value to products while ensuring quality standards for both local and export markets. The center will feature modern storage, sorting and packaging facilities, sales outlets, and display spaces for fresh produce.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has launched a project to rebuild and modernize the fish market in Al...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has launched a project to rebuild and modernize the fish market in Al Saffala, Ibra, North Sharqiyah. This initiative aims to boost seafood trade and improve market infrastructure for fish across the governorate. The existing market, one of the oldest in the governorate, currently handles approximately 1,250 tonnes of fish annually. The new, climate-controlled facility, spanning 2,081 square meters and fully funded by the Ministry at a cost of RO50,000, is slated for completion in the second quarter of 2026. It will include 12 fish display platforms, an ice-making unit, a waiting area, and other public utilities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Kuwait's Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN) has implemented new trade measures for poultry meat imports due to avian influenz...
records.description: Kuwait's Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN) has implemented new trade measures for poultry meat imports due to avian influenza concerns. Following a recommendation by the Supreme Committee for Food and Water Security, the existing ban on poultry imports from Brazil has been lifted for all categories of poultry meat, as Brazil has been declared free of bird flu. Conversely, PAFN has imposed a new ban on poultry imports from several regions in the United States due to fresh outbreaks of the virus. These adjustments, reported by the Kuwaiti News Agency (KUNA), reflect Kuwait's ongoing efforts to ensure domestic food safety while maintaining reliable sources for the 70% of its poultry demand met by imports. In 2023, Kuwait imported poultry meat worth US$364 million, with Brazil being the top supplier.
records.institution: Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN)

records.title: The Ministry of Investment in Saudi Arabia is launching the Syrian-Saudi Investment Forum to strengthen bilateral economic ties with Syri...
records.description: The Ministry of Investment in Saudi Arabia is launching the Syrian-Saudi Investment Forum to strengthen bilateral economic ties with Syria, aligning with Saudi Arabia’s vision for regional integration and mutual benefit. Acting on directives, the Ministry is working to activate the private sector in both countries by facilitating cross-border partnerships, including organizing this forum and related business workshops. As part of preparations, the Ministry, in cooperation with the Federation of Saudi Chambers, is coordinating a delegation visit to Damascus involving prominent Saudi companies across various sectors. The forum is expected to feature the signing of memoranda of understanding and joint venture agreements, opening new avenues for cooperation in infrastructure, manufacturing, agriculture, and technology.
records.institution: The Ministry of Investment

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Summer Fruits Season has commenced in AlUla as part of the “Khayrat AlUla” initiative by the Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU).
records.description: The Summer Fruits Season has commenced in AlUla as part of the “Khayrat AlUla” initiative by the Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU). Held at Al Manshiyah Farmers' Market, this event showcases the region's agricultural diversity, featuring fruits like mangoes, grapes, and figs from local farmers, alongside participation from productive families. This period is significant for AlUla, producing over 4,900 tons annually from approximately 216,000 fruit-bearing trees. The Summer Fruits Season is part of the larger Khayrat AlUla series, which also includes seasons for dates, citrus fruits, and honey. These efforts align with the RCU's goals to enhance food security and develop agricultural communities, contributing to Saudi Vision 2030. The initiative also aims to empower farmers, expand marketing channels, and develop sales outlets to foster the long-term sustainability of the agricultural sector.
records.institution: Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU)

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef), in collaboration with the National Research and Development Center f...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef), in collaboration with the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), has launched an innovative project utilizing tissue culture technology to boost coffee seedling production. This initiative aims to increase coffee tree productivity by 30% and plant 50,000 seedlings by the end of 2025. Significant progress includes re-evaluating genetic patterns to consolidate them into 12 genetic groups, initiating seedling production from cuttings, and developing disease-resistant and drought-tolerant varieties. The project has also produced fourteen knowledge products on advanced techniques and good agricultural practices, completed a technical review of the coffee cultivation guide, and prepared a comprehensive book on coffee resources.
records.institution: Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A new report by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) confirms that renewable energy sources maintained their cost leadership...
records.description: A new report by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) confirms that renewable energy sources maintained their cost leadership in global power markets, with solar PV and onshore wind being significantly cheaper than new fossil fuel alternatives in 2024. This cost advantage, driven by technological innovation and economies of scale, resulted in substantial avoided fossil fuel costs and reinforces renewables' role in improving energy security. While continued cost reductions are anticipated, challenges such as geopolitical shifts, trade tariffs, raw material bottlenecks, and infrastructure limitations, particularly in Europe and North America, could temporarily raise costs; however, regions like Asia, Africa, and South America are expected to see pronounced declines.
records.institution: International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA)

records.title: Abu Dhabi delivers ‘Climate Change Adaptation Plan for Environment Sector'
records.description: The Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD) has launched the Abu Dhabi Climate Change Adaptation Plan for the Environment Sector (2025–2050), a comprehensive, science-based roadmap to protect the emirate's natural resources from climate change impacts. This pioneering plan, the first of its kind for the emirate, is part of the broader Abu Dhabi Climate Change Strategy 2023–2027 and aligns with the UAE National Climate Change Plan 2017-2050 and the UAE Framework for Global Climate Resilience established at COP28. The plan focuses on three highly vulnerable environmental systems: groundwater, soil, and biodiversity, which are critical for human health, water security, and agricultural productivity. It outlines 142 adaptation actions to be implemented by 2050, with 86 high-priority projects set for the next five years, encompassing technical, institutional, and nature-based solutions. Developed collaboratively with over 40 government, semi-government, academic, civil society entities, and youth, the plan is designed to be dynamic, with mechanisms for periodic review and integration of new scientific findings, aiming to increase food self-sufficiency, promote sustainable land and water management, and enhance biodiversity conservation.
records.institution: Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD)

records.title: The Agriculture and Fisheries Development Fund is financing an initiative to support the Omani rose harvest sector in Jabal Akhdar.
records.description: The Agriculture and Fisheries Development Fund is financing an initiative to support the Omani rose harvest sector in Jabal Akhdar. This program aims to enhance the value-added potential of the region’s distinctive rose harvest, which spans over 6,300 rose trees across more than 10 acres. The enhancements will come through improved production quality, expanded marketing and manufacturing capabilities, and farmer training specifically focused on developing products derived from rose water.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: A field day for vegetable farmers in Hamdan District, Sana'a, was organized by the Small and Micro Enterprises Development Agency (SMEDA)...
records.description: A field day for vegetable farmers in Hamdan District, Sana'a, was organized by the Small and Micro Enterprises Development Agency (SMEDA) of the Social Fund for Development (SFD) to encourage and support agricultural productivity. The event was funded by the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and supervised by the Agricultural Sector in the province. This initiative aims to enhance food security, improve livelihoods, and introduce modern agricultural techniques, including modern irrigation systems and advanced methods, to 60 small-scale vegetable farmers. The project also includes rehabilitating agricultural infrastructure such as ponds, dams, irrigation channels, and terraces through a "Cash-for-Work" component. Officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Water Resources and the local authority stressed their commitment to developing agricultural infrastructure and supporting farmers to achieve self-sufficiency, praising the collaborative efforts of all partners.
records.institution: Small and Micro Enterprises Development Agency (SMEDA)

records.title: Saudi Arabia has achieved global leadership in water safety and drowning prevention standards, following the adoption of its National Dro...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has achieved global leadership in water safety and drowning prevention standards, following the adoption of its National Drowning Prevention Policy. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced a 17% decrease in drowning fatalities, attributing this progress to nationwide safety programs and their economic and social impact, which have helped avoid an estimated economic burden exceeding SR800 million. This achievement, highlighted during a workshop marking World Drowning Prevention Day, is the result of 12 integrated national initiatives. The ministry, in collaboration with the Public Health Authority (Weqaya) and other government bodies, has activated awareness campaigns through various platforms to promote safe behavior around water.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Eastern Region has completed preparations for the shrimp fishing season, whi...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Eastern Region has completed preparations for the shrimp fishing season, which will run for six months with 710 licensed vessels. Strategies for this season include issuing electronic permits to streamline licensing for fishermen, a process facilitated in coordination with the National Company for Agricultural Services (AgriServ). Furthermore, the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program “Reef Saudi” offers financial support to Saudi fishermen for qualifying trips. The Ministry enforced a six-month fishing ban to allow stock regeneration, and the Fish Resources Research Center, in collaboration with the General Directorate of Border Guard, will conduct monitoring campaigns to ensure compliance and protect the marine environment.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Makhlaf Munqitha Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Dhamar governorate has launched a wheat and legume seed distrib...
records.description: The Makhlaf Munqitha Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Dhamar governorate has launched a wheat and legume seed distribution campaign to farmers, in preparation for the autumn farming season. This initiative is a collaborative effort with the General Corporation for Grain Development and Production, Bonyan Development Foundation, the governorate’s Agriculture Sector, and the local authority. The campaign aims to encourage farmers to expand agricultural production, enhance food security, and move towards self-sufficiency, aligning with directives to reduce reliance on food imports. The General Corporation for Grain Development and Production reaffirmed its commitment to providing seeds and has already purchased a significant quantity of bean seeds from the association for cultivation. Additionally, the Agriculture Sector and its Executive Unit for Agricultural Project and Initiative Financing are committed to facilitating expanded cultivation, having previously provided loans to agricultural cooperatives for grain production.
records.institution: Makhlaf Munqitha Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: Tabuk's farms are a significant source of high-quality pears, producing over 750 tons annually from more than 15,000 trees, with peak pro...
records.description: Tabuk's farms are a significant source of high-quality pears, producing over 750 tons annually from more than 15,000 trees, with peak production in July and August. This success is attributed to the region's temperate climate, fertile soil, and the integrated efforts of farmers and relevant authorities, notably the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture Tabuk branch, which provides guidance on modern agricultural practices. Tabuk's favorable environment attracts investors and farmers, supporting over 14,000 farms across 270,000 hectares that yield diverse crops beyond pears, including peaches, apricots, grapes, and various vegetables, solidifying its role as a vital national agricultural hub.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has signed a cooperation agreement with Green E...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has signed a cooperation agreement with Green Environment Industrial Company to remove invasive mesquite trees from designated sites and sustainably repurpose the resulting waste. This initiative aims to protect native vegetation, support national environmental preservation efforts, and evaluate the effectiveness of mesquite elimination methods, as these invasive species threaten local ecosystems, plant diversity, and vegetation quality.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The 2025 Liwa Dates Festival, organized by the Abu Dhabi Heritage Authority, welcomed over 50,000 visitors in its first five days.
records.description: The 2025 Liwa Dates Festival, organized by the Abu Dhabi Heritage Authority, welcomed over 50,000 visitors in its first five days. This 21st edition, ongoing in Liwa City, Al Dhafra Region, is a significant platform celebrating the UAE's palm heritage and traditional agriculture. The festival provides vital support for the agricultural sector and food security, featuring 24 competitions with 308 prizes totaling AED8.735 million, along with stage competitions for visitors. The event reflects Abu Dhabi's dedication to preserving and transmitting heritage across generations, while also celebrating the date harvest and the palm tree's cultural significance. It attracts visitors and tourists from across the UAE and the Gulf Cooperation Council, offering a traditional and interactive atmosphere that supports farmers and engages families.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Heritage Authority

records.title: An awareness meeting for palm farmers in al-Nakhila area of al-Durayhimi district in Hodeida governorate focused on best practices for hi...
records.description: An awareness meeting for palm farmers in al-Nakhila area of al-Durayhimi district in Hodeida governorate focused on best practices for high-quality date collection, proper drying, and marketing through agricultural associations. Organized by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in coordination with al-Durayhimi Farmers' Association, the meeting aimed to enhance farmers' capabilities to improve date quality and market value. The initiative is part of a national strategy to localize date production, achieve self-sufficiency, and reduce import costs, with the state directing traders and date companies to purchase local produce through associations to improve packaging and marketing.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Oman accelerates the localization of green hydrogen technology.
records.description: Oman is accelerating its efforts to localize green hydrogen technology and manufacturing capacity, driven by Hydrom, the entity overseeing the country's green hydrogen sector. The nation aims to produce 1 million tonnes of low-carbon molecules annually by 2030, which will require a substantial number of solar panels and wind turbines. To achieve this, Hydrom is focusing on technology localization, including signing Memorandums of Understanding with electrolyser manufacturers like Siemens Energy and ThyssenKrupp Nucera.
records.institution: Hydrom

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has launched an electronic service for issuing...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has launched an electronic service for issuing grazing permits via its "Nabati" platform. This new service aims to simplify procedures, promote digital transformation, and support local communities while ensuring the sustainable use of natural rangelands. It offers easy, fully electronic application and rapid issuance of permits, automatically verifying environmental and regulatory requirements and integrating with geospatial and environmental data platforms. This initiative coincides with a NCVC effort, in cooperation with the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture and other entities, to allow controlled grazing in specific natural rangelands and forest areas across the Kingdom.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with global biotechnology provide...
records.description: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with global biotechnology provider PhageGuard and Saudi poultry producer Tanmiah Food Company. This partnership aims to promote sustainable livestock production and enhance the quality and safety of local products in Saudi Arabia. Under the MoU, PhageGuard, through its local agent Portalis Capital, will provide advanced bacteriophage technology to Tanmiah Food Company. This technology serves as a biological alternative to traditional antibiotics, specifically targeting Salmonella bacteria to reduce its spread, lower antibiotic dependence, and transition towards safer food production. The initiative is expected to boost the poultry sector's operational and production efficiency, build a knowledge- and innovation-driven livestock industry, and mitigate the risk of foodborne illness, thereby strengthening the competitiveness of Saudi animal products.
records.institution: National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program

records.title: The TAB Group has announced the 6th Global Vertical Farming Show (GVF 2025), scheduled to take place at the Festival Arena, Dubai Festiva...
records.description: The TAB Group has announced the 6th Global Vertical Farming Show (GVF 2025), scheduled to take place at the Festival Arena, Dubai Festival City. This event aims to be a transformative gathering for professionals in vertical farming and controlled-environment agriculture (CEA), addressing global food security challenges. It expects over 5,000 attendees, 100 exhibitors, and 50 speakers from more than 35 countries, serving as a strategic meeting point for agritech startups, CEA pioneers, investors, policymakers, and researchers. The show is supported by partners and sponsors like IEMA, Enjazonic, Wallfarm SRL, and Körber Technologies, showcasing next-gen solutions in various aspects of vertical farming. With support from government bodies such as the UAE’s Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, MOCCAE, ADAFSA, and Emirates Development Bank, GVF 2025 is set to foster public-private collaboration for food system resilience.
records.institution: TAB Group

records.title: The first phase of a project to plant ten thousand Sidr tree seedlings has commenced in the Jabal Ras district of Hodeidah Governorate.
records.description: The first phase of a project to plant ten thousand Sidr tree seedlings has commenced in the Jabal Ras district of Hodeidah Governorate. This initiative, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, is part of broader national efforts in Yemen to expand green areas and achieve sustainable environmental and agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: An agreement for a major agricultural investment project to cultivate moringa trees and produce byproducts has been signed, supporting fo...
records.description: An agreement for a major agricultural investment project to cultivate moringa trees and produce byproducts has been signed, supporting food security, environmental sustainability, and export diversification. The usufruct contract, covering 10.5 million sqm in the Hanfit area of Thumrait, was signed between the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. This project, led by Trufud, has an investment value exceeding RO5.3 million. It is a unique initiative linking agriculture, manufacturing, and supply chains, aiming to yield annual revenues of RO4 million to RO5 million through exports to North America, Europe, and Asia.
records.institution: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning

records.title: Grape cultivation in Tanuf village, Dakhliyah, is becoming a significant model for food security and agricultural innovation in Oman, wit...
records.description: Grape cultivation in Tanuf village, Dakhliyah, is becoming a significant model for food security and agricultural innovation in Oman, with increasing support from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR). A vineyard, initially spanning 1.5 acres with 1,000 grape seedlings, yielded three tonnes of fruit this season, with further increases expected as more vines mature. The farm receives technical supervision and regular agricultural consultations from the MAFWR. The initial phase of the vineyard involved an investment exceeding RO16,000, covering farm setup, modern irrigation, trellises, and seedling nurseries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman’s OQ Alternative Energy has signed an agreement with Kuwait’s Naqaa Sustainable Energy to invest in multiple wind energy projects in...
records.description: Oman’s OQ Alternative Energy has signed an agreement with Kuwait’s Naqaa Sustainable Energy to invest in multiple wind energy projects in the wilayats of Duqm, Mahout, and Sadah. These projects are anticipated to generate up to 1,100 megawatts (MW) of power using wind turbines that will be locally manufactured by Mawarid Turbine’s upcoming factory in Duqm. This collaboration reinforces OQ’s role in the clean energy transition and supports Oman's national objectives to diversify energy sources by harnessing its natural resources, aligning with the OQ Group's broader strategy to build an integrated clean energy value chain and promote national industries by localizing expertise.
records.institution: OQ Alternative Energy

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture branch in Najran reports that date palm farming is crucial to the region's economy, w...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture branch in Najran reports that date palm farming is crucial to the region's economy, with over 526,000 palms producing more than 40,000 tons of dates annually from 2,696 hectares. Najran's favorable climate and rich soil are key to the high quality and quantity of its dates, such as the popular Khalas and Majdool varieties. Farmers receive financial and logistical support from the Ministry, which helps maintain product quality and market effectiveness, aligning with the region’s strengths and Vision 2030. The early harvest dates are already stimulating the local market, with prices fluctuating based on type, supply, and demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Tadweer Group has acquired Masdar's stake in the Sharjah Waste-to-Energy plant, making Tadweer Group and BEEAH joint venture partners...
records.description: The Tadweer Group has acquired Masdar's stake in the Sharjah Waste-to-Energy plant, making Tadweer Group and BEEAH joint venture partners in the Emirates Waste-to-Energy company. This strategic move allows Masdar to focus on increasing its clean energy capacity, while Tadweer Group expands its UAE operations and international presence in waste value unlocking. The Sharjah Waste-to-Energy plant, inaugurated in 2022, is crucial for diverting waste from landfills and generating electricity, aligning with the UAE's sustainability goals. The joint venture plans to enhance the plant's power output from 30 MW to 60 MW, double its processing capacity for hard-to-recycle waste, and reduce emissions, further solidifying the UAE's ambition to be a global leader in sustainable waste management and energy conversion.
records.institution: Tadweer Group, Masdar

records.title: A workshop was held in Al-Bayda province to launch work on value chains for crops, agricultural products, and livestock, targeting three...
records.description: A workshop was held in Al-Bayda province to launch work on value chains for crops, agricultural products, and livestock, targeting three model districts. Organized by the local authority in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, in coordination with the Agricultural Cooperative Union and the Bunyan Development Foundation, and funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Financing Unit, the workshop aimed to introduce development partners to the action plan. This effort is part of an integrated vision to achieve food security and enhance local production, with discussions covering development principles, intervention mechanisms for agricultural and food products, and the roles of supporting entities. The Al-Bayda Governor emphasized the project's priority for the current year, stressing the importance of institutional work, alignment among government agencies, civil society, and donors, and activating the role of agricultural associations and cooperative unions. The project is expected to contribute to rural development, job creation, and improved resource efficiency, translating the National Vision's objectives of doubling local production and achieving self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Sana’a Governorate, particularly the Al-Hayma Al-Dakhiliya District, is experiencing a significant shift towards revitalizing its agr...
records.description: The Sana’a Governorate, particularly the Al-Hayma Al-Dakhiliya District, is experiencing a significant shift towards revitalizing its agricultural sector, with a notable trend of replacing qat cultivation with high-return cash crops like coffee and almonds. This movement is driven by increasing farmer awareness of the economic benefits and aligns with the Government of Change and Development’s plans for self-sufficiency and sustainable growth, as supported by local authorities and multi-purpose agricultural cooperative associations. A pilot initiative in Hijrat Al-Ain village has already seen farmers successfully replace qat with coffee, leading to a clear conclusion that coffee offers a more valuable return. Farmers are seeking support from relevant authorities in the form of coffee seedlings, promotion of intercropping, and reliable water sources through the construction of dams and reservoirs.
records.institution: Government of Change and Development

records.title: AlUla's public parks are undergoing several sustainable development projects focused on preserving local vegetation and enhancing aesthet...
records.description: AlUla's public parks are undergoing several sustainable development projects focused on preserving local vegetation and enhancing aesthetics in line with the area's environmental identity and heritage. These initiatives include intensive planting of local species, developing green infrastructure with modern and eco-friendly irrigation, and rehabilitating natural components for sustainability and efficiency, all while adhering to environmental standards. The projects also involve designing visitor-friendly paths and facilities that offer recreational and cultural experiences, support biodiversity, and mitigate environmental impacts, as part of an integrated plan balancing urban development and nature conservation.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.title: Saudi Arabia will host the fifth session of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) Conference of Ministers in Charge of Water in J...
records.description: Saudi Arabia will host the fifth session of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) Conference of Ministers in Charge of Water in Jeddah. The three-day conference will focus on addressing water-related challenges and exploring solutions for OIC member states' water needs. The Kingdom officially signed the hosting agreement with the OIC General Secretariat. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture noted that Saudi Arabia's hosting underscores its pivotal role in supporting water issues across the Islamic world and its commitment to strengthening cooperation in sustainable development, aligning with OIC initiatives and global water challenges. Preparations for the event are already underway, involving coordination, development of organizational and technical requirements, and review of international water resource developments.
records.institution: Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The fourth annual Otaiqah Dates Season is set to launch in early August at the Agricultural Seasons Hall in Otaiqah Central Market in Riy...
records.description: The fourth annual Otaiqah Dates Season is set to launch in early August at the Agricultural Seasons Hall in Otaiqah Central Market in Riyadh, running for four months to coincide with various date harvesting periods across Saudi Arabia. This event serves as a significant tourist destination and an integrated platform for showcasing the Kingdom's date varieties, attracting visitors, shoppers, investors, merchants, and farmers from Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states. The date sector is crucial to the national economy, contributing approximately 12% to agricultural GDP, with products reaching over 113 countries. The season, managed by the Riyadh Development Company, spans 10,000 square meters, including an air-conditioned indoor hall, and offers 65 retail stalls, the large Otaiqah Haraj traditional date auction with 16 lanes, and an an online store for broader reach.
records.institution: Riyadh Development Company

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) is preparing to launch the 9th edition of the Al Dhaid Date Festival at Expo Al Dhaid...
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) is preparing to launch the 9th edition of the Al Dhaid Date Festival at Expo Al Dhaid, featuring extensive participation from UAE palm farmers, date producers, government entities, private agricultural organizations, and home-based businesses. This annual event aims to promote palm cultivation by encouraging advanced agricultural practices to enhance date quality and support the UAE's food security and sustainable agricultural growth. The festival will host various competitions with prizes, including "Ratb (Date) Beauty" contests, "Best Lemons," "Fig Contest," and a homegrown date competition for women, alongside cultural activities and workshops on modern agricultural methods.
records.institution: Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: In Al-Ta’aziyah District, Taiz Province, 300 fodder choppers are being distributed to 1,200 families of livestock breeders in Al-Da’isa,...
records.description: In Al-Ta’aziyah District, Taiz Province, 300 fodder choppers are being distributed to 1,200 families of livestock breeders in Al-Da’isa, Al-Shahna, and Hazran villages, with support from the Social Fund for Development. This initiative aims to enhance food security and promote sustainable rural development. The project also plans to establish milk collection and localization centers in Taiz Governorate and activate contract farming for corn and legumes in the upcoming year. The Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, and Water Resources, along with Taiz’s Acting Governor, has secured an agreement with the Hail Group of Companies to receive dairy and legumes produced in Taiz and Ibb Governorates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, and Water Resources

records.title: Oman and Türkiye have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to deepen technical and investment cooperation across the energy spectru...
records.description: Oman and Türkiye have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to deepen technical and investment cooperation across the energy spectrum, encompassing oil and gas, green hydrogen, and carbon-capture technology. The agreement was signed in Muscat by Oman’s Ministry of Energy and Minerals and its Turkish counterpart, committing both sides to exchange expertise, align regulatory policies, explore joint projects, and study financing options to boost efficiency and accelerate the transition to cleaner fuels. Areas of collaboration include crude exploration, liquefied natural gas trade, renewable power, energy-storage solutions, and alternative fuels, with a dedicated focus on green hydrogen production, storage, and transport, aligning with Oman's 2050 net-zero drive. This pact supports Oman’s ambition to become a regional hub for sustainable energy and attract foreign direct investment, while Türkiye expressed interest in expanding LNG volumes and participating in upstream projects.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Oman's Environment Authority (EA), in coordination with the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, organized a three-day wor...
records.description: Oman's Environment Authority (EA), in coordination with the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, organized a three-day workshop in Muscat to advance the country's National Adaptation Plan (NAP) for climate change. This initiative aims to integrate climate risk into national planning and strengthen Oman's third Nationally Determined Contributions under the Paris Agreement. Participants, including representatives from various government agencies and international organizations, are discussing national policies, strategies, and financing mechanisms for implementing adaptation measures across key sectors like water, agriculture, health, coastal zones, and infrastructure.
records.institution: Oman's Environment Authority (EA)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has signed a contract for a project focused on utilizing ground and surface wat...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has signed a contract for a project focused on utilizing ground and surface water resources and mitigating flood risks. This initiative aims to improve water resource management and development, conserve non-renewable groundwater from depletion and pollution, and contribute to water security by fostering a safe and sustainable water sector. The project is part of MEWA's broader efforts to enhance the efficiency of non-renewable water resources through monitoring drilling and production, rationalizing usage, identifying safe water sources, and supporting their development, while maximizing the use of surface and renewable water with international best practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environm...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the principalities of Jazan, Al-Baha, Aseer, and Makkah regions, and other stakeholders, launched an initiative to allow continued grazing in natural rangelands and forest areas across several Saudi Arabian regions. This initiative will engage local communities, nonprofit and for-profit organizations, and volunteers in pruning dry juniper branches in Makkah, Aseer, and Al-Baha. The NCVC encourages livestock breeders in various specified areas to benefit from this effort, which is part of broader aims to preserve the environment, support rangeland development, enable sustainable use of forage plants, meet livestock nutritional needs, enhance rangeland sustainability, protect wildlife habitats, and foster biodiversity.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism, in coordination with the UAE Embassy in Tunisia, organized the UAE-Tunisia Agriculture and Food Foru...
records.description: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism, in coordination with the UAE Embassy in Tunisia, organized the UAE-Tunisia Agriculture and Food Forum on the sidelines of the International Food Show Africa (IFSA Africa) at Tunisia's KRAM Expo Center. The forum aimed to strengthen economic partnership between the UAE and Tunisia in food, supply chains, and food value chain technologies. Attended by officials from both public and private entities, including Al Islami Foods, Iveco, and Emirates Bio Farm, and representatives of international organizations and startups, the event emphasized enhancing bilateral cooperation in food manufacturing, modern agricultural technologies, and sustainable food production practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: In Al-Dhalea Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, alongside the Acting Governor of Al-Dhalea, inaugu...
records.description: In Al-Dhalea Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, alongside the Acting Governor of Al-Dhalea, inaugurated 23 agricultural and fisheries projects worth over 598 million Yemeni riyals. Funded by the local authority through the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit and coordinated with the agricultural sector, these projects cover institutional and social development, marketing and services, and the development of livestock and crops. The initiatives align with directives from the Supreme Political Council and the Transformation and Development Government's agenda to boost agricultural growth and food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Cleanliness and Improvement Fund in Amran governorate has launched a campaign to plant 2,000 fruit trees, including guava, lemon, and...
records.description: The Cleanliness and Improvement Fund in Amran governorate has launched a campaign to plant 2,000 fruit trees, including guava, lemon, and pomegranate, along median strips of several streets in Amran city. This initiative, supported by the Amran governorate leadership, emphasizes utilizing the rainy season for urban greening with fruit-bearing and ornamental trees, aligning with directives to promote agriculture. The campaign is part of a broader effort to increase vegetation cover, preserve the environment, and foster a culture of planting productive trees, thereby supporting national agricultural development programs and enhancing food security.
records.institution: Amran Governorate

records.title: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) has invested over OMR6 million in procuring locally grown wheat, a collaborative initiative with the Minis...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) has invested over OMR6 million in procuring locally grown wheat, a collaborative initiative with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources that has benefited more than 150 Omani farmers. This investment supports OFM's strategy to promote in-country value and strengthen national food security through domestic agricultural production. As part of these efforts, OFM launched 'Flour 1', the first flour made entirely from Omani wheat, showcasing its commitment to supporting local agriculture and developing value-added food industries.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Local date markets in several Riyadh Region governorates are experiencing significant commercial activity with the start of the early dat...
records.description: Local date markets in several Riyadh Region governorates are experiencing significant commercial activity with the start of the early date harvest season. The palm and date sector is a vital resource for the national economy, contributing to income diversification and enhancing food security, with the Kingdom's date exports reaching SAR1.695 billion last year, distributed across 133 countries. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has identified Riyadh Region as a key date-producing area, home to major central date markets and nearly 80 diverse varieties. The region's total date production exceeded 453,000 tons, positioning it as one of the highest-producing areas in the Kingdom, with over eight million palm trees, of which more than 6.8 million are productive.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: On Shark Awareness Day, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture renewed its call for responsible environmental behavior and pu...
records.description: On Shark Awareness Day, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture renewed its call for responsible environmental behavior and public awareness regarding the protection of marine species, especially endangered sharks. This emphasis highlights the vital ecological role sharks play as apex predators in maintaining marine balance by feeding on weak and sick fish, which helps prevent disease spread and ensures overall ecosystem health. By regulating prey populations, sharks indirectly support biodiversity and critical habitats like coral reefs and seagrass meadows, contributing to the resilience of marine environments against issues like overfishing and climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Saudi Principal Buyer has signed power purchase agreements, totaling SAR31 billion ($8.3 billion), with a consortium led by Acwa Power fo...
records.description: Saudi Principal Buyer has signed power purchase agreements, totaling SAR31 billion ($8.3 billion), with a consortium led by Acwa Power for seven new renewable energy projects, falling under the Saudi Ministry of Energy's National Renewable Energy Program. These projects, upon completion, will collectively have a total capacity of 15,000MW. The consortium includes Acwa Power as the main developer, along with Water and Electricity Holding Company (Badeel), owned by the Saudi sovereign fund PIF, and Aramco Power, owned by Saudi Aramco. The seven projects consist of five photovoltaic solar projects and two wind energy projects located across the Aseer, Madinah, Makkah, and Riyadh Regions, with competitive levelized costs of energy.
records.institution: Acwa Power

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched the second phase of its "Sustainability Innovation Challenge" program in...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched the second phase of its "Sustainability Innovation Challenge" program in Boston, US, to enhance innovation and sustainability in the environment, water, and agriculture sectors. A ministry delegation visited Boston to start an intensive training program for the challenge winners, in collaboration with Babson College. This initiative aims to equip participants with essential skills for their innovative projects, reflecting the Kingdom's commitment to fostering sustainable solutions and promoting international collaboration.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The strawberry farms located in Aseer Region's high peaks, over 3,000 meters above sea level, have become a prominent agricultural and to...
records.description: The strawberry farms located in Aseer Region's high peaks, over 3,000 meters above sea level, have become a prominent agricultural and tourist attraction, drawing visitors from across the Kingdom to experience freshly harvested strawberries. These ventures combine natural beauty with the local community's passion for farming, leveraging the region's cool climate and scenic landscapes to cultivate thousands of strawberry seedlings. The farms represent an advanced model of environmental and agricultural tourism, offering an immersive experience in nature. The success of strawberry cultivation in the summer is due to cool temperatures and seasonal rainfall at high elevations, resulting in superior crop quality and abundance. Key locations for strawberry farming, known for their crop size and quality and popular for visitors, include Al-Aziza village, the center of Abha, and Wadi Bin Hashbal.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is undertaking a comprehensive transition of its services and infrastructure...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is undertaking a comprehensive transition of its services and infrastructure to cloud computing. This strategic move aligns with the Abu Dhabi government's vision, led by the Department of Government Enablement (DGE), to establish a fully AI-native government by 2027. ADAFSA aims to leverage cloud platforms to streamline operations, optimize resource utilization, drive innovation in agriculture and food safety, and enhance operational efficiency, agility, and service accessibility for stakeholders. This initiative is a crucial part of Abu Dhabi's broader digital strategy to integrate over 40 government entities into a centralized, hybrid, multi-cloud environment.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Hodeida governor has launched the 2025 date harvest season and a pilot date and agricultural/fish product drying project in al-Suweiq...
records.description: The Hodeida governor has launched the 2025 date harvest season and a pilot date and agricultural/fish product drying project in al-Suweiq area of al-Tuhaita district, which includes solar drying rooms and drying beds. This initiative is supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, the local authority, and implemented by the Agricultural and Fisheries Production Promotion Fund in cooperation with partners, aiming to enhance value chains and improve local product quality. The project is seen as a key step towards food security and developing date production in Tihama, improving post-harvest processes, and boosting market quality for dates, with the Head of Agricultural Production Development noting the eco-friendly nature of the solar dryers. The Head of Tihama Development Authority highlighted its role in supporting farmers, and the Executive Director of the Production Promotion Fund emphasized that this is the first of several sustainable initiatives to modernize post-harvest practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The local authority in Hodeida governorate launched a workshop to initiate agricultural and livestock value chains across 13 model distri...
records.description: The local authority in Hodeida governorate launched a workshop to initiate agricultural and livestock value chains across 13 model districts, as part of the 1447 AH development plan. Supervised by the Ministries of Agriculture and Local Development and supported by the Agricultural and Fisheries Financing Unit, the project aims to enhance food security and local production. The Governor of Hodeida emphasized the need for coordinated efforts among government bodies, communities, and the private sector, highlighting the region's potential for self-sufficiency through improved production, packaging, and marketing. Presentations were given by key agencies, with partners like the Zakat Authority and the Yemeni Economic Corporation committing to support the project's implementation and sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministries of Agriculture and Local Development

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, along with the Ibb Governorate leadership and the General Authority for Wate...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, along with the Ibb Governorate leadership and the General Authority for Water Resources and Facilities, have inaugurated projects for constructing water lakes to harvest rainwater and floods. These projects, part of the first phase targeting the Habish and Al-Makhader districts, aim to replenish groundwater. The Minister of Agriculture emphasized that these initiatives are in line with the directives of the Leader of the Revolution, the Supreme Political Council, and the Government of Change and Construction's program, all aimed at enhancing water security and optimizing the utilization of rainwater and floods.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: In a valley beneath the Asir Mountains, local environmentalist Lahiq Al-Hadi is developing an educational environmental museum in the Rij...
records.description: In a valley beneath the Asir Mountains, local environmentalist Lahiq Al-Hadi is developing an educational environmental museum in the Rijal Almaa governorate. This initiative aims to raise awareness, attract tourists, and preserve the region’s natural and cultural heritage. The museum will document rare trees, insects, birds, and traditional agricultural tools, with a dedicated section on beekeeping, honey production, and the preservation of endangered seeds. Al-Hadi has already replanted over 68 species of rare or threatened local trees and plants on his farm, actively sourcing and distributing rare seeds to growers. His efforts have shown positive results, including the return of migratory bird species due to environmental improvement. The museum will also feature a pavilion on Asir’s traditional stone architecture, offering insights into the region’s cultural legacy.
records.institution: Rijal Almaa governorate

records.description: In Ibb Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, along with the Ibb Governorate leadership, has inaugurated 45 completed agricultural projects and launched 57 new ones for the year 1446 AH, representing a total investment of 1.852 billion Yemeni riyals. These projects span various sectors, including institutional and informational infrastructure, community development, human resource development, land resource management, water resource development (with significant community contributions), plant resource development, agricultural extension and media, livestock development, and marketing and agricultural services. Key officials from the General Authority for Water Resources and the Grain Development Foundation were present at the ceremony, underscoring the collaborative effort towards agricultural advancement in the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.description: The Oman’s Ministry of Energy and Minerals reported stable oil and gas production in 2024, alongside progress in renewable energy and green hydrogen initiatives. Crude oil and condensate reserves stood at 4.825 billion barrels, and natural gas reserves at 23.3 trillion cubic feet. The country operated 475 production fields, drilling 73 exploratory wells. Daily oil output averaged 992,600 barrels, with exports totaling 308.4 million barrels at an average price of $80.79.

records.description: Qassim Region is a prominent area for fruit production in Saudi Arabia, with seasonal fruits like grapes, pomegranates, figs, Japanese plums, watermelons, and mulberries being highly popular, especially in summer. The production of these fruits consistently increases due to the region's fertile soil, abundant freshwater, and skilled farmers. This agricultural growth is further bolstered by the government's support through soft loans, agricultural services, and expert guidance, which has encouraged investment from specialized agricultural companies.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.description: Qassim Region, known for its fertile soil, is experiencing significant agricultural development and crop diversification. Notably, fig cultivation is emerging as a new success story, complementing traditional date palms and other crops, and directly supporting national food security objectives. The region boasts 10 specialized fig production projects, including nurseries and over 10 different fig varieties, alongside related processing industries. This expansion in fig cultivation and enhancement of agricultural infrastructure aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals to generate additional economic value and boost food security.

records.title: As part of Oman’s efforts to boost agricultural sustainability and food security, the Agricultural Research Centre in Suhar, affiliated w...
records.description: As part of Oman’s efforts to boost agricultural sustainability and food security, the Agricultural Research Centre in Suhar, affiliated with the Directorate-General of Agricultural and Animal Research at the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, conducted two vital studies focused on mango cultivation. These initiatives aim to improve pest management and optimize nursery planting media for mango seedlings, a crucial fruit crop for Oman, which covers significant acreage and produces thousands of tonnes annually. The first study evaluated seven insecticides against thrips, finding that certain products like Plesiva Pro and Tracer effectively maintained high mortality rates.
records.institution: The Agricultural Research Centre

records.description: The General Organization for the Conservation of Coral Reefs and Turtles in the Red Sea (SHAMS) is launching its “Adopt a Coral” environmental initiative this Saturday. This program aims to engage the community in coral reef restoration and raise awareness about their importance, aligning with national efforts to protect Saudi Arabia's marine environment, the goals of Saudi Vision 2030, and the Saudi Green Initiative. SHAMS, which has extensive field experience in reef restoration and monitoring, will offer opportunities for public participation through coral planting, awareness workshops on threats like climate change and pollution, and engagement in reef monitoring.
records.institution: The General Organization for the Conservation of Coral Reefs and Turtles in the Red Sea (SHAMS)

records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, represented by the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture (MEWA), showcased seven advanced digital initiatives at the World Summit on the Information Society (WSIS+20) High-Level Event in Geneva. These initiatives significantly enhance livestock health, water sustainability, and food security. Highlights included MEWA's AI-powered Livestock Health AI Platform, which recently received a Certificate of Excellence, and the Smart Platform for Monitoring Water Resources aimed at groundwater conservation. The presentation also featured Smart Monitoring of Slaughterhouses and Public Benefit Markets, demonstrating an integrated approach to food security and public health.

records.description: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company, and Spanish utility Iberdrola have jointly secured approximately $4.8 billion in funding from 24 international banks for the East Anglia Three wind farm in the UK. This 1.4 gigawatt greenfield project, located off the Suffolk coast, is expected to begin operations in late 2026. Masdar and Iberdrola each hold a 50 percent stake, with the transaction anticipated to close shortly. This achievement follows the successful installation of 50 wind turbines at their Baltic Eagle offshore wind farm in Germany. Masdar, which is 43 percent owned by Abu Dhabi National Energy Company (Taqa), continues to expand its international presence in renewable energy, having recently secured significant green bond sales and non-recourse financing for various clean energy projects globally.
records.institution: Masdar

records.description: Morocco is in discussions with several UAE companies to initiate wind energy projects in its southern provinces, specifically in Western Sahara, as part of its ambitious goal to increase renewable energy's share to 52 percent by 2030. Reports indicate that Rabat is negotiating with Masdar, AMEA Power, and Taqa for these projects, which are expected to involve investments ranging from $8 billion to $10 billion and achieve a production capacity of 5,000 megawatts. Western Sahara currently hosts four operational wind stations, and additional projects are planned for Boujdour and Tiskrad.

This foundational step for green iron production in Duqm is complemented by ongoing discussions with potential green hydrogen and financing partners, including KfW IPEX-Bank. The project underscores Duqm's growing appeal for 'hard-to-abate' sectors, supported by anticipated green hydrogen availability.
records.institution: Integrated Gas Company (IGC)

records.title: The National University of Science and Technology has developed an innovative, environmentally friendly method to produce aluminum oxide...
records.description: The National University of Science and Technology has developed an innovative, environmentally friendly method to produce aluminum oxide nanoparticles from used aluminum foil. A research study, titled “Eco-Friendly Synthesis and Characterization of Aluminum Oxide Nanoparticles from Waste Aluminum Foil for Antibacterial, Anti-fungal and Anti-Corrosion Applications,” demonstrated these nanoparticles' effectiveness against bacteria and fungi, making them promising for various biological, environmental, and industrial applications. This approach addresses the issue of accumulating aluminum waste by transforming it into high-value functional materials, promoting sustainable practices. The research highlights potential uses in healthcare for antibacterial coatings, in environmental waste management for sustainable recycling, in industry for anti-corrosion coatings, in water purification for efficient filtration, in food packaging for extended shelf life, and in agriculture as natural antifungal agents.
records.institution: The National University of Science and Technology

records.title: A national team of 12 specialists from Saudi Arabia's environment, water, and agriculture ecosystem, including representatives from the M...
records.description: A national team of 12 specialists from Saudi Arabia's environment, water, and agriculture ecosystem, including representatives from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s water agency, the Saudi Irrigation Organization, and the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, participated in a training course in Lanzhou, China. Organized by the Gansu Academy of Agricultural Sciences in cooperation with the Chinese Ministry of Commerce, the course focused on rainwater harvesting technologies and their applications. This participation aligns with Saudi Arabia's efforts to implement international agreements and exchange expertise in water management, covering topics such as harvesting system designs, water quality management, purification technologies, supplementary irrigation, economic evaluation, sponge city concepts, water reuse, and the role of harvesting in combating desertification and promoting sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The date palms of Madinah Region have flourished for generations, providing fruit locally and internationally, with the temperate desert...
records.description: The date palms of Madinah Region have flourished for generations, providing fruit locally and internationally, with the temperate desert climate being vital for sustainable cultivation, preserving quality, and cementing Madinah's status as a top date producer. The region's unique environmental features, including stable temperatures, favorable rainfall, and low humidity, enhance crop quality and support year-round agricultural activities, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 goals to boost food security, promote sustainable practices, and improve the economic and cultural significance of Madinah dates in global markets.
records.institution: The Saudi Government

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) in Saudi Arabia has highlighted the continuous growth of the cooperative sector...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) in Saudi Arabia has highlighted the continuous growth of the cooperative sector, which reached 198 cooperatives by the end of Q1 2025, encompassing agriculture, livestock, fisheries, and environmental sectors. This growth underscores their crucial role in rural development and enhancing food security, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. To bolster knowledge and institutional capabilities, MEWA has developed 13 guidebooks for managing agricultural cooperatives and has enhanced their regional and international presence through participation in events like the regional conference of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), and collaboration with the International Cooperative Alliance (ICA).
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.description: The World Green Economy Summit (WGES) is positioned as a global catalyst for climate action, focusing on empowering societies vulnerable to climate change with practical solutions for climate security. Organized by the Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), and the World Green Economy Organization (WGEO), the summit's theme is 'Innovating for Impact: Accelerating the Future of the Green Economy'. It will explore the role of modern technologies, including AI and IoT, in optimizing renewable energy integration, enhancing predictive analytics, and improving carbon emissions monitoring, while also addressing energy storage solutions and promoting public-private collaboration for green technology deployment.

records.title: Oman's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) at constant prices grew by 2.5% in the first quarter of 2025, reaching OMR 9.43 billion.
records.description: Oman's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) at constant prices grew by 2.5% in the first quarter of 2025, reaching OMR 9.43 billion. This increase from OMR 9.20 billion in the same period of 2024 is primarily due to a 4.4% rise in non-oil activities, which contributed OMR 6.92 billion. Specifically, agricultural and fishing activities saw a 7.6% growth (OMR 273.6 million), industrial activities increased by 7% (OMR 2.03 billion), and services grew by 3.2% (OMR 4.62 billion). Conversely, oil-related activities experienced a slight decline of 0.4%, totaling OMR 2.92 billion, driven by a 2.2% decrease in crude oil production. However, natural gas activities showed strong growth, increasing by 9.5% and contributing OMR 475.3 million to the GDP.
records.institution: The National Centre for Statistics and Information

records.title: Al-Ra’i National Livestock Company, a subsidiary of the National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec), has launched a SAR 2 billion p...
records.description: Al-Ra’i National Livestock Company, a subsidiary of the National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec), has launched a SAR 2 billion project in Saudi Arabia's Hail region for intensive livestock farming and meat production, with significant financing from the Agricultural Development Fund (ADF). This initiative aims to boost local meat production, reduce reliance on imports, and support small-scale farmers, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 by targeting an annual production capacity of one million heads of sheep by 2030. Furthermore, Al-Ra’i has signed memorandums of understanding with the University of Hail, the Sulaiman Al-Rajhi Foundation for Development Finance, and the Entag Association for Productive Families in Hail to foster student training, research, local industry development, and social responsibility, enhancing the project's broader economic and social impact.
records.institution: Al-Ra’i National Livestock Company, a subsidiary of the National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec)

records.description: AlUla is a prominent agricultural destination, particularly for mangoes, with farms covering approximately 125 hectares and containing over 50,000 mango trees. These trees produce around 1,125 tons of various mango varieties annually, including the popular Zebda, Sanarah, and Keitt, known for their high quality and unique flavors. The mango season in AlUla runs from July to September. The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) is dedicated to supporting farmers, promoting modern agricultural practices, and developing infrastructure to enhance environmental sustainability, food security, and diversity, while preserving the region's natural and cultural heritage. The information is provided by the Saudi Press Agency (SPA).

records.description: The King Khalid Foundation has opened registration for the fourth edition of its green grants, available to nonprofit organizations across the Kingdom until August 9. This initiative supports Saudi Arabia’s economic diversification, green investment promotion, and nonprofit sector empowerment, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. The grants aim to raise awareness of the green economy and foster sustainable development within the nonprofit sector by providing financial support for projects that equip lower-income individuals with vocational and professional skills. records.description: Tadweer Group, the waste management authority for Abu Dhabi and a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company (ADQ), has officially joined the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC). This move reinforces Tadweer Group's commitment to sustainable waste transformation through circular economy solutions, aligning with the UAE’s Net-Zero 2050 Strategic Initiative and the national Green Agenda 2030. By joining, Tadweer Group pledges to implement the UNGC’s Ten Principles, particularly those on environmental stewardship, and to report annually on its progress. This membership supports Tadweer Group's international engagement as it expands its role in waste-to-energy and waste-to-resource innovation, including projects like a major Waste-to-Energy facility and the largest Material Recovery Facility in Abu Dhabi, as well as advancing methane-to-graphene conversion and sustainable aviation fuel development.

records.description: In Jabal Al-Sharq Directorate, Dhamar Province, the Agriculture Sector Branch and the Jabal Al-Sharq Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association launched an initiative to distribute and plant 4,500 fruit seedlings from the Hran Model Nurseries. The Agriculture Sector Branch, the association, and development stakeholders are tasked with monitoring the cultivation's success, targeting government facilities and promoting intercropping, aligning with directives from the Supreme Agricultural and Fisheries Committee to encourage economically beneficial fruit tree expansion and create productive green spaces.

A key part of this initiative is the implementation of the Smart Flock Saudi system, which uses Internet of Things (IoT) and facial recognition technology for advanced digital farm management, a global first for small ruminants. This system monitors productivity, provides health updates, and manages animal registries. Saudi Reef's overall aim is to increase breeders' incomes, modernize traditional practices, and strengthen food security.

The organization reaffirmed its commitment to advancing the camel sector through international cooperation, knowledge exchange, and partnerships to support camel-based economies and communities.

This refresh reinforces KAPSARC’s core action: producing evidence-based, applied research and policy advice to support energy transition, sustainability, and regional economic development, while actively contributing to global climate and environmental platforms.
