records.description: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is launching a series of virtual awareness workshops this July to strengthen farmers' and breeders' skills in modern, sustainable agricultural practices. Covering topics like poultry farm efficiency, sheep pen standards in hot climates, and integrated pest management, the workshops aim to improve productivity, reduce costs, enhance food safety, and promote eco-friendly farming. ADAFSA emphasized the importance of these sessions in supporting agricultural sustainability, food security, and resource conservation for future generations.

records.description: Bahrain’s national standards committee has approved comprehensive updates to its product regulations, introducing a new eco-label called the “Green Product Card” and aligning water-saving rules with Gulf Cooperation Council standards to improve efficiency in plumbing and fixtures. The revisions also update technical specifications to enhance consumer safety and conformity with international measurement, safety, and quality benchmarks, with further proposals under review to support domestic initiatives. The move demonstrates a strategic commitment to embedding sustainability into Bahrain’s industrial and trade frameworks, with the next phase focused on enforcing the updated standards and promoting public awareness of the green labeling system.

records.description: Project cargo has commenced arriving at the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) for Oman's inaugural green hydrogen and ammonia venture, marking a significant step for the Sultanate's burgeoning green energy industry. Green Hydrogen and Chemicals Company SAOC (GHC), a subsidiary of India-based ACME Group, is developing the $750 million green ammonia plant, which will have an initial capacity of 100,000 tonnes per annum (tpa) with plans for phased expansion to 1.1 million tpa. The initial shipment of oversized equipment has been successfully delivered, with further heavy cargo, including solar PV modules, trackers, and electrolyzers, expected as the plant prepares for its scheduled commissioning in the first quarter of 2027.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia announced the start of the Rutab (semi-ripe date) harvest season in A...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia announced the start of the Rutab (semi-ripe date) harvest season in Al-Ahsa Governorate, home to the world’s largest palm oasis and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With over two million palm trees producing more than 120,000 tons of dates annually, markets across the Kingdom are receiving early Rutab varieties, while the full date (tamar) harvest will follow from mid-August to early October.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched a national awareness and guidance program to protect poultry farms a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched a national awareness and guidance program to protect poultry farms and hatcheries from diseases and epidemics. Led by the General Directorate of Animal Health and Veterinary Quarantine and the General Directorate for Livestock Development, the initiative targets broiler producers, hatcheries, and parent farms, focusing on biosecurity, veterinary care, nutrition, and hatchery management. It aims to reduce production losses, improve food security, and advance toward self-sufficiency in poultry products, with periodic monitoring to ensure adherence to health and safety standards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Oman's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 4.7 percent in the first quarter, reaching 10.53 billion Omani rials, largely driven by a str...
records.description: Oman's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 4.7 percent in the first quarter, reaching 10.53 billion Omani rials, largely driven by a strong 4.1 percent increase in non-oil activities. The agriculture and fisheries sector saw the highest growth at 11.1 percent. This expansion reflects Oman's strategic focus on diversifying its economy, with non-oil exports also rising significantly. The nation is also implementing fiscal reforms, including a future personal income tax, and its residential property market has shown renewed strength.
records.institution: National Centre for Statistics and Information

records.title: The traditional process of date peeling, known as Tabsil, has commenced in several regions of Oman for the creation of Al Faghour, a loca...
records.description: The traditional process of date peeling, known as Tabsil, has commenced in several regions of Oman for the creation of Al Faghour, a local delicacy. Al Faghour is made from unripe dates and its production is a significant cultural and heritage activity, often carried out by hand by families and communities, particularly in the Wilayat of Manah. This seasonal practice focuses exclusively on Al Mabsaly date palm trees, which are widely cultivated across Oman. After careful peeling, the unripe dates are dried and processed into Al Faghour, a product experiencing growing demand both domestically and internationally, with a substantial portion exported. Besides being enjoyed as a food, Al Faghour is also converted into a powder for use in sweets, cakes, and cookies as a natural sweetener. There are also plans to further integrate Al Faghour into food industries to maximize its economic potential.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy and the United Nations Environment Program (UNEP) have formalized their collaboration on climate action...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy and the United Nations Environment Program (UNEP) have formalized their collaboration on climate action, signing a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to advance the Regional Cooperation for Emissions Reduction Initiative. This agreement, stemming from recent high-level discussions, aims to bolster MENA countries in achieving their climate goals by fostering clean energy technologies and developing supportive policy frameworks. The partnership will focus on shared objectives of enhancing resource efficiency and reducing carbon emissions through a balanced and sustainable approach. Key areas of cooperation include policy research, international partnerships, knowledge exchange, and the creation of comprehensive climate policy frameworks, all designed to support the overarching aims of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change and the Paris Agreement, while also promoting Saudi initiatives like the Saudi Green Initiative and the Middle East Green Initiative, and the Circular Carbon Economy (CCE) framework.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy

records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed a development loan agreement exceeding $38 million with the Ministry of Economy and Plann...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed a development loan agreement exceeding $38 million with the Ministry of Economy and Planning of the Republic of Tunisia to fund an Oasis Hub Project in southern Tunisia. This project aims to support sustainable rural development by reclaiming over 1,000 hectares of agricultural land, drilling wells, expanding rural villages with housing units and infrastructure, and developing educational, agricultural, cultural, social, and commercial centers. This initiative aligns with the SFD's commitment to financing infrastructure projects that improve living standards, create jobs, and contribute to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Tunisia, continuing a long-standing development partnership.
records.institution: Saudi Fund for Development (SFD)

records.title: Kuwait's KOC eyes green economy with net-zero goal by 2050
records.description: Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) is conducting a comprehensive study on the green economy to facilitate its transition to clean energy and achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2050. This effort includes exploring green hydrogen production, expanding carbon capture, and underground carbon dioxide storage. The Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT) recently approved KOC's request to cancel tenders for electrical power supply to industrial pumps, aligning with cost-cutting and emission reduction goals. Despite these cancellations, KOC continues to modernize operations, improve efficiency, and aggressively rehabilitate idle oil wells. The company has a history of integrating renewable energy, notably with its Sidra 500 solar project, and is actively pursuing solar and wind initiatives to balance oil production with sustainability.
records.institution: Kuwait Oil Company (KOC)

records.description: Oman's inaugural green ammonia project, developed by Green Hydrogen and Chemicals Company SAOC (GHC), a subsidiary of India-based ACME Group, has started receiving essential cargo at the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD). This significant project, with an initial capacity of 100,000 tonnes per annum (tpa) and future expansion plans to 1.1 million tpa, has an estimated cost of around $750 million. Key shipments for the project include oversized equipment, solar PV modules, trackers from GameChange Solar for a 450 MWp solar installation, and alkaline electrolysis systems from Sungrow Hydrogen and Shuangliang Hydrogen. The plant is slated for commissioning in the first quarter of 2027 and is pivotal for launching Oman's large-scale green energy industry.
records.institution: Green Hydrogen and Chemicals Company SAOC (GHC)

records.title: Saudi Arabia signs port deals to boost logistics
records.description: Under the patronage of the Minister of Transport and Logistic Services, the Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) and the National Center for Privatization (NCP) have finalized 20-year Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) contracts to privatize multipurpose cargo terminals across eight key Saudi ports. These agreements, signed with Saudi Global Ports and Red Sea Gateway Terminal Company, represent a significant private sector investment exceeding SAR 2.2 billion (US$586 million) aimed at boosting port capacity, operational efficiency, and global competitiveness. The Minister highlighted these partnerships as crucial for Saudi Arabia's emergence as a logistics hub, aligning with the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and Vision 2030. The CEO of NCP emphasized this as a comprehensive privatization effort in the maritime sector, expected to yield long-term economic benefits.
records.institution: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani)

records.title: ADQ, an Abu Dhabi-based sovereign investor, plans to acquire a 35% stake in Limagrain Vegetable Seeds (LVS), the vegetable seed division...
records.description: ADQ, an Abu Dhabi-based sovereign investor, plans to acquire a 35% stake in Limagrain Vegetable Seeds (LVS), the vegetable seed division of Limagrain. This strategic move aims to deepen ADQ's involvement in the food value chain. As part of this collaboration, LVS and Silal, an ADQ agri-food technology company, will form a joint venture to develop desert-adapted vegetable genetics. This partnership will focus on creating crop varieties resilient to extreme heat, drought, and salinity, with research conducted at Silal's Innovation Oasis in Al Ain. The initiative is expected to significantly enhance the UAE's national food security agenda by boosting local innovation in climate-resilient seeds and increasing domestic food production.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi's ADQ

records.title: Armenia has approved an economic partnership agreement with the UAE under the EAEU framework, a move that follows negotiations initiated...
records.description: Armenia has approved an economic partnership agreement with the UAE under the EAEU framework, a move that follows negotiations initiated in 2022. This agreement aims to boost and streamline trade by reducing barriers and fostering economic cooperation. Notably, approximately 95% of Armenia's exports to the UAE will receive preferential treatment. Once effective, 217 out of 270 export goods will gain preferential access, potentially saving Armenian exporters around $500,000 by reducing average customs duties from 6% to 2.6%. Armenia is particularly focused on increasing agricultural exports such as fresh fruits, tomatoes, and honey, eyeing a potential export value of at least $10 million in the UAE market.
records.institution: The UAE Government

records.title: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), in partnership with King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST), h...
records.description: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), in partnership with King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST), has developed an innovative new composite material that significantly enhances solar cell efficiency and lifespan through passive cooling. This breakthrough material absorbs moisture at night and releases it during the day, effectively cooling solar panels without consuming electricity, leading to an 18 percent reduction in electricity generation costs. Tested successfully across diverse climates, this technology also shows potential for applications in lighting and laser technologies, contributing to national goals in renewable energy and food security.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: Witthal to set up UAE’s first lithium battery recycling plant at Kezad
records.description: Witthal Gulf Industries, a part of Singapore-based Witthal Group, has secured a 50-year land lease agreement with the Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (Kezad Group) to establish the UAE's first lithium battery recycling plant in the Taweelah region. The company, a major player in the global commodities market, will invest AED 40 million ($11 million) in this project. The new plant will utilize cutting-edge technology to recycle end-of-life batteries from electric vehicles, solar farms, and other renewable energy systems, recovering valuable materials like black mass, copper, and aluminum to produce sustainable alternatives. This collaboration is set to create robust infrastructure for responsible lithium battery recycling, aligning with both entities' vision for sustainable industrial development and the UAE's net-zero goals.
records.institution: Witthal Gulf Industries, Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (Kezad Group)

records.title: The Model Farms Programme in Al Dhahirah Governorate, launched in 2020, is a significant initiative aimed at increasing farmers' income b...
records.description: The Model Farms Programme in Al Dhahirah Governorate, launched in 2020, is a significant initiative aimed at increasing farmers' income by providing high-yielding seeds and modern irrigation systems. This project supports over 250 farms, distributing more than 15,000 date palm offshoots and various fruit seedlings, including mango, Adalia lemon, Omani lemon, guava, figs, and grapes. These efforts have led to the cultivation of date palm and fruit trees across 140 fedans, contributing to the agricultural development of the governorate. The program is an integral part of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources' broader plan to enhance food security and achieve sustainable agricultural development in Oman. The Ministry, in close cooperation with farmers, supports this program, which also extends to other governorates. The core idea is to achieve a qualitative shift in the agricultural sector by improving quality and productivity, with the distribution of seedlings governed by strict conditions to ensure the installation of modern irrigation systems for water conservation and increased production efficiency, thereby making these farms agriculturally sustainable.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Wilayat of Taqah in Dhofar Governorate recently hosted the second Agricultural Forum, a two-day event organized by the Office of the...
records.description: The Wilayat of Taqah in Dhofar Governorate recently hosted the second Agricultural Forum, a two-day event organized by the Office of the Wali of Taqah in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. This gathering brought together farmers, agricultural experts, government officials, and private sector partners to advance sustainable agriculture and support national food security. The forum aimed to strengthen local farming practices, boost productivity, and expand rural economic opportunities, with discussions highlighting Dhofar’s unique advantage of the annual monsoon season, known as Khareef, for reviving traditional farming cycles and expanding crop production. Technical sessions covered topics such as pest control, livestock genetic improvements, and enhancing the value of local agricultural products. An agricultural exhibition showcased local produce, agri-tech solutions, and services.
records.institution: TAQAH

records.title: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change in Qatar organized a workshop on the updated National Biodiversity Strategy as part of the...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change in Qatar organized a workshop on the updated National Biodiversity Strategy as part of the Early Action Support Project for the Global Biodiversity Framework, in collaboration with the Global Environment Facility and the United Nations Environment Programme. The event reviewed new national objectives and initiatives aimed at conserving biodiversity, supporting food and water security, and promoting sustainable environmental resources in line with Qatar National Vision 2030. It also focused on aligning national priorities with global biodiversity targets and fostering inclusive participation from government, academia, civil society, and the private sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

records.title: Tabuk Agricultural Development Company (TADCO) has sought approval from the Capital Market Authority (CMA) to reduce its capital by 52.94%.
records.description: Tabuk Agricultural Development Company (TADCO) has sought approval from the Capital Market Authority (CMA) to reduce its capital by 52.94%. This move, recommended by the board, aims to restructure the company's capital and extinguish accumulated losses. If approved, TADCO's capital will decrease from SAR 391.76 million to SAR 184.35 million, with a corresponding reduction in the number of shares. The capital reduction is contingent on both CMA approval and the endorsement of the company's extraordinary general assembly. This financial restructuring follows TADCO's recent agreement to establish a power transmission station for its farm in the Tabuk region.
records.institution: Tabuk Agricultural Development Company (TADCO)

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in collaboration with Aramco, successfully sowed appr...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in collaboration with Aramco, successfully sowed approximately 50 million seeds of native plant species across three sites in the Rub' al Khali Desert and two additional sites in eastern Saudi Arabia. This initiative aligns with the Saudi Green Initiative and the Middle East Green Initiative, demonstrating Saudi Arabia’s commitment to global climate goals and efforts to combat climate change. This action further expands the country's ongoing greening efforts towards a sustainable future. Since the launch of Vision 2030, Saudi Arabia has made significant strides in environmental protection, accelerating energy transition, and implementing sustainability programs, including offsetting carbon emissions, expanding afforestation, restoring land, and protecting natural areas.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.description: An open community gathering, co-organized by the Emirates Council for Balanced Development and Emirates Nature-WWF, recently brought together residents in Al Rams, Ras Al Khaimah, to brainstorm ideas for a sustainable future, aiming to align future initiatives with local needs and preserve the area's unique identity. This "majlis" is part of a broader sustainable development roadmap for Al Rams, which includes infrastructure enhancements and eco-tourism plans. This collaborative effort, led by the Emirates Council for Balanced Development, seeks to improve quality of life and foster economic growth in Emirati villages, leveraging nature-based projects to conserve heritage, create unique tourism experiences, and generate opportunities for local people, particularly youth, farmers, and entrepreneurs, while establishing Al Rams as a national model for sustainable rural living.
records.institution: The Emirates Council for Balanced Development and Emirates Nature-WWF

records.title: Officials in the Capital recently participated in a fruit tree planting campaign across two districts, an initiative led by the Capital S...
records.description: Officials in the Capital recently participated in a fruit tree planting campaign across two districts, an initiative led by the Capital Secretariat's Agriculture Sector and Knights of Development. Trees and coffee seedlings were planted, with emphasis placed on the economic and environmental benefits and the importance of community participation and local nurseries. Over 13,500 fruit trees have been planted in recent months as part of ongoing efforts to green the capital and foster agricultural development.
records.institution: Capital Secretariat's Agriculture Sector

records.title: The Second Agricultural Forum has officially opened in the Wilayat of Taqah, Dhofar Governorate.
records.description: The Second Agricultural Forum has officially opened in the Wilayat of Taqah, Dhofar Governorate. This two-day event brings together agricultural experts, farmers, government officials, and rural entrepreneurs to discuss modernizing agriculture, supporting local communities, and strengthening food security in line with Oman Vision 2040. Organized by the Office of the Wali of Taqah in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the forum features technical presentations, case studies, and an exhibition of innovative agricultural products and technologies. Key topics include improving date palm cultivation, modern breeding practices, veterinary health standards in livestock farming, and enhancing the value of local agricultural goods. The event also promotes home-based farming and sustainable animal husbandry, with competitions and the distribution of free seedlings and farming starter kits. The forum emphasizes applied agricultural research, pest management, hydroponic farming, sustainable irrigation, and home nurseries, underscoring Dhofar's importance to Oman's food production and the country's commitment to economic diversification and climate-resilient agricultural practices.
records.institution: Office of the Wali of Taqah

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Veolia has launched its GreenUp 2027 strategic program in Oman, highlighting three significant projects in waste, water, and energy manag...
records.description: Veolia has launched its GreenUp 2027 strategic program in Oman, highlighting three significant projects in waste, water, and energy management that align with Oman's Vision 2040 and its shift towards a low-carbon, resource-efficient economy. In waste management, Veolia is transforming the Barka and Al Multaqa landfills into pioneering biogas-to-energy systems, converting landfill gas into 1.08 MW of renewable energy and maximizing landfill capacity while reducing greenhouse gas emissions. For water, in partnership with Petroleum Development Oman (PDO), Veolia operates the Rima Wetlands, a nature-based solution for oilfield wastewater treatment that processes 66,000 cubic meters daily, significantly reducing CO2 emissions and fostering wildlife habitats. In energy, the Sur Desalination Plant is a vital water infrastructure asset that integrates one of Oman's largest solar farms dedicated to water production, providing potable water to over 600,000 residents and increasingly powered by renewable sources with advanced reverse osmosis technology.
records.institution: Oman Environmental Services Holding (be’ah)

records.title: Date markets across Saudi Arabia are now receiving the early harvest of dates from Madinah, signaling the start of the annual date season.
records.description: Date markets across Saudi Arabia are now receiving the early harvest of dates from Madinah, signaling the start of the annual date season. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture stated that Madinah alone produces 58 distinct date varieties, contributing to the Kingdom's extensive total of over 404 varieties grown nationwide. Saudi Arabia boasts approximately 37.1 million date palm trees, with total date production surpassing 1.9 million tons. Regionally, Qassim led in production, followed by Riyadh, Madinah, and the Eastern Region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: In the Capital Secretariat, Yemen, several agricultural and fisheries projects, funded by the local authority through the Agricultural Pr...
records.description: In the Capital Secretariat, Yemen, several agricultural and fisheries projects, funded by the local authority through the Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, have been inaugurated. These initiatives, totaling over 659 million Yemeni riyals, aim to boost food security and self-sufficiency by establishing fish sales points, launching a digital platform for support, and enhancing the Agricultural and Veterinary Institute through hospital upgrades and educational resource improvements for its colleges. Officials emphasize that these projects strengthen value chains, promote local product marketing, and contribute to a resilient economy, with plans for further integration and expansion of similar initiatives nationwide.
records.institution: Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Omani researchers from the German University of Technology in Oman (GUtech) and Oman LNG, in collaboration with EJAAD (the research and d...
records.description: Omani researchers from the German University of Technology in Oman (GUtech) and Oman LNG, in collaboration with EJAAD (the research and development platform of the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation), have completed a study on repurposing the Sultanate's natural gas pipeline network for green hydrogen transport. This is crucial for Oman's future green hydrogen economy, which aims to produce up to 8.5 million tonnes annually by 2050 for both export and domestic decarbonization. The study assessed the technical and economic feasibility of retrofitting existing pipelines, noting that this approach offers significant cost and complexity advantages over building new infrastructure, leveraging the existing, well-established network. The research included rigorous analysis of operating conditions, gas mixtures, and physical properties, developing a model to calculate the levelized cost of hydrogen transport across various natural gas-hydrogen blends. EJAAD facilitated this public-private partnership, demonstrating the value of such collaborations in supporting Oman's energy transition and economic diversification efforts.
records.institution: German University of Technology in Oman (GUtech), Oman LNG

records.title: Vineyards in Saudi Arabia's Najran Region have begun supplying local markets with high-quality grape harvests, following a five-month cul...
records.description: Vineyards in Saudi Arabia's Najran Region have begun supplying local markets with high-quality grape harvests, following a five-month cultivation period. This agricultural process, from planting to irrigation and care, is a seasonal tradition for the region's farmers, with grapes now distributed across Najran and throughout Saudi Arabia. The region's farms annually yield nearly 3,000 tons of grapes from 67 hectares, including both white and black varieties. The fertile soil, moderate climate, and ample water supply in Najran contribute to the exceptional quality of these grapes, making agriculture a significant contributor to the local economy and a vital income source for farmers. Known for their nutritional value, rich flavor, and sweetness, Najran's grapes are in high demand. Recent observations noted scenic rows of grape clusters and farmers actively harvesting and packing the fruit.
records.institution: The Saudi Government

records.title: Emirates Biotech has collaborated with the United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) in Al Ain to conduct joint research on new applications...
records.description: Emirates Biotech has collaborated with the United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) in Al Ain to conduct joint research on new applications and end-of-life solutions for Polylactic Acid (PLA). This partnership aims to enhance PLA's sustainability and performance as a bio-based, biodegradable polymer, leveraging UAEU's resources and engaging its academic community. The goal is to facilitate the commercialization of bioplastics tailored for the UAE and wider Middle East, positioning PLA as a viable alternative to fossil-based plastics and supporting a circular economy. Both organizations express enthusiasm for this collaboration, viewing it as a significant step towards advancing the biopolymers sector in the region, fostering innovation in materials science, and providing students with practical research experience. Emirates Biotech plans to market and manufacture PLA for various uses, including packaging and 3D printing, with end-of-life options like composting to reduce landfill waste.
records.institution: Emirates Biotech, United Arab Emirates University (UAEU)

records.title: The Mayor of the Capital recently reviewed a community initiative in the al-Thawra district focused on planting fruit trees in front of h...
records.description: The Mayor of the Capital recently reviewed a community initiative in the al-Thawra district focused on planting fruit trees in front of homes. This effort, praised by the Mayor, is a partnership between a local development group and the Capital's Agriculture Sector, which supplied the seedlings, with citizens responsible for their upkeep. The initiative is part of broader efforts to expand tree planting through the collaboration of local authorities, community members, development groups, and neighborhood leaders. The Mayor also inspected a campaign aimed at clearing unsightly structures and reducing congestion in the same district, reviewing the organization of street vendors and hearing updates on the field teams' progress in stabilizing the area.

records.title: AlUla Governorate, known for its unique natural landscape and agricultural abundance, is a key producer of dates in Saudi Arabia.
records.description: AlUla Governorate, known for its unique natural landscape and agricultural abundance, is a key producer of dates in Saudi Arabia. Its palm farms span approximately 16,579.40 hectares, hosting over 3.1 million palm trees. The region's annual date production is about 116,055.81 tons, significantly contributing to the national supply. The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) actively supports the agricultural sector through technical assistance and advisory programs, promoting sustainable farming practices to enhance production efficiency and strengthen food security, aligning with national development goals.
records.institution: AlUla Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Al-Baha branch recently undertook a rapid initiative, re-plowing over 858,000 square...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Al-Baha branch recently undertook a rapid initiative, re-plowing over 858,000 square meters across 393 farms in just ten days. This project, focused on revitalizing agricultural terraces in the villages of Daws and Barahrah, north of Al-Mandaq Governorate, aims to significantly enhance food security in the region. The branch's director noted that the effort exceeded its goals thanks to strong cooperation from local residents and various governmental and private organizations. This initiative also seeks to boost environmental protection by clearing dry weeds to reduce fire risks, encourage renewed farming activity, and improve soil quality for future seasons. Al-Mandaq Governorate, known for its rich natural resources and diverse crops like pomegranates, grapes, and coffee, stands to benefit greatly from these efforts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is actively progressing afforestation efforts i...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is actively progressing afforestation efforts in Makkah Region, aligning with Saudi Arabia's broader environmental sustainability initiatives. Millions of trees have been planted as part of a national green initiative, with these efforts forming part of numerous planned projects covering key zones in Makkah. This campaign directly supports the national objective to plant a massive number of trees and rehabilitate extensive areas of degraded land throughout the Kingdom, underscoring Saudi Arabia’s ongoing commitment to enhancing vegetation cover, combating desertification, and promoting long-term environmental sustainability.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has announced new regulations for the sale of live livestock by weight, set to...
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has announced new regulations for the sale of live livestock by weight, set to take effect soon. These regulations aim to enhance fairness and transparency in livestock markets across the Kingdom, benefiting both producers and consumers while contributing to environmental and economic sustainability, in line with Saudi Vision 2030. The new rules will apply to livestock sold both within and outside pens. For sales within pens, vendors must use approved, regularly maintained scales and provide a safe weighing environment, meticulously recording all operations. Transparency in the weighing process is mandated, allowing buyers to request reweighing and strictly prohibiting any tampering. For sales outside pens, market investors are required to provide a sufficient number of approved scales and dedicated staff for weighing.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, "Saudi Reef," continuously highlights and supports the achievements of its benefi...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, "Saudi Reef," continuously highlights and supports the achievements of its beneficiaries, including small-scale farmers, producers, and productive families. The program aims to motivate participants and empower them with effective production and marketing techniques to enhance their farming outputs and traditional handicrafts. It provides direct assistance that helps intensify cultivation, expand planted areas, and encourages the adoption of sustainable practices, leading to recognized successes in producing premium local produce. The fruit sector is one of several key areas targeted by Saudi Reef, which implements strategic projects to improve quality of life, achieve food security, and enhance the economic status of various agricultural sectors.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The grape harvest season has commenced in AlUla Governorate, marking a significant period for the region's summer agriculture as high-qua...
records.description: The grape harvest season has commenced in AlUla Governorate, marking a significant period for the region's summer agriculture as high-quality grapes, alongside figs and pomegranates, become highly sought after in local and domestic markets. Grapes are the most abundant and economically vital of these summer crops, collectively cultivated across approximately 348.96 hectares and yielding over 3,140.66 tons annually. Their production not only supports regional trade and creates seasonal employment but also plays a crucial role in local food security. The Royal Commission for AlUla actively supports the agricultural sector through various development initiatives, advisory programs, and the integration of modern farming technologies, aiming to enhance the quality, sustainability, and productivity of AlUla’s agricultural output, in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: Royal Commission for AlUla

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, known as "Saudi Reef," continues to highlight the success of its beneficiaries, i...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, known as "Saudi Reef," continues to highlight the success of its beneficiaries, including small-scale farmers and producers. Through its "From Our Countryside" series, the program showcased farmer Salman Al-Tuwairqi from Taif Governorate, who successfully enhanced the quality of his local grapes, even surpassing imported varieties, using traditional propagation methods. He also cultivates Taif roses and other seasonal fruits. An Assistant Secretary-General at Saudi Reef explained that direct support from the program enabled Al-Tuwairqi to intensify grape cultivation, expand his planted areas, and adopt sustainable farming practices, leading to the recognition of his premium local grapes.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program Saudi Reef

records.title: In Ibb governorate, a veterinary vaccination campaign has been launched, targeting over one million small ruminants and livestock across...
records.description: In Ibb governorate, a veterinary vaccination campaign has been launched, targeting over one million small ruminants and livestock across 17 districts to combat diseases like sheep pox and address internal and external parasites. The Governor of Ibb emphasized the national leadership's commitment to developing the livestock sector, crucial for food security and economic growth. He lauded the campaign's organization and urged full cooperation from citizens and breeders with the field teams, stressing the importance of reaching all animals, including those in remote areas. The head of the Agricultural Sector in the province detailed the 20-day campaign's scope, including specific vaccination targets and the various diseases it aims to address, noting its extension of prior efforts.
records.institution: General Administration of Animal Health and Veterinary Quarantine

records.title: A Riyadh-based private equity firm has partnered with a Canadian asset manager to launch two substantial funds for agricultural investmen...
records.description: A Riyadh-based private equity firm has partnered with a Canadian asset manager to launch two substantial funds for agricultural investments across the GCC, with an ambitious long-term goal of investing significantly and becoming a leading global fresh food business. The new joint entity will serve as the Canadian firm's regional headquarters, focusing on investments in permanent crops and temperature-controlled supply chain infrastructure within the region and globally to enhance food security. This collaboration seeks to reconfigure food trade routes and bolster the region's resilience against disruptions, directly addressing the high dependency on food imports, which governments are striving to reduce through national economic programs. The funds will target a range of agricultural companies, technology, and new projects.
records.institution: Aram Palms Company

records.title: Italy and the UAE are strengthening their agricultural collaboration, particularly in GreenTech, to boost the UAE's agricultural developm...
records.description: Italy and the UAE are strengthening their agricultural collaboration, particularly in GreenTech, to boost the UAE's agricultural development. The UAE's agricultural machinery market is seeing significant growth, with Italian exports to the region more than doubling in recent years. Italian manufacturers primarily supply systems for milk processing, seeding, fertilizing, and livestock. Officials emphasize that innovative Italian technology is crucial for addressing the UAE's challenging environmental conditions, such as limited arable land and water scarcity. The upcoming Agrilevante exhibition in Bari will be a key platform to showcase specialized solutions, fostering partnerships and introducing new features like robotic technologies and a dedicated gardening sector.
records.institution: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG)

records.title: Dhofar Municipality has initiated a large-scale environmental campaign in the Dhofar mountains during the current khareef season, aiming...
records.description: Dhofar Municipality has initiated a large-scale environmental campaign in the Dhofar mountains during the current khareef season, aiming to restore natural vegetation and control invasive species. This involves dispersing approximately 10 million seed balls and over 3 billion pastoral grass seeds. Building on previous years' efforts, this initiative, overseen by a steering committee, is part of a broader plan to enhance biodiversity and curb the spread of problematic plants like parthenium weed and mesquite trees, which contribute to desertification alongside overgrazing, climate change, and human activities. The project employs nature-based solutions through drought-resistant seed balls containing native plant species adapted to local conditions. In addition to seed dispersal, various methods such as manual removal, mechanical cutting, flame treatment, and targeted pesticide use are being applied to control parthenium weed and mitigate its harmful effects.
records.institution: Dhofar Municipality

records.title: Saudi Aramco has launched the Regional Center for Sustainable Development of Fisheries (RCSDF) on Abu Ali Island in Jubail, a collaborati...
records.description: Saudi Aramco has launched the Regional Center for Sustainable Development of Fisheries (RCSDF) on Abu Ali Island in Jubail, a collaborative effort with the Ministry of Energy and the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture. This center aims to support local fishermen, bolster expertise, and enhance fish production to protect marine life in the Arabian Gulf. It features a fish hatchery designed to produce and release local fish species that have seen population declines, managing their entire life cycle using advanced aquaculture and water recycling technologies. This initiative complements Aramco's ongoing mangrove plantation project, as these forests provide crucial nursery habitats for the released fish, ultimately contributing to the sustainability of marine ecosystems and aligning with national aquaculture goals.
records.institution: Saudi Aramco

records.title: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG), the UAE’s largest national provider of protein and beverages, has forged a strategic partnership with Finnish...
records.description: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG), the UAE’s largest national provider of protein and beverages, has forged a strategic partnership with Finnish food-tech innovator FoodIQ. This collaboration marks a significant milestone, as AAFG will be the first company globally, outside of Finland, to implement FoodIQ’s patented Multi-Layer Cooker (MLC) technology on an industrial scale. This innovative system enables the local production of a new generation of clean-label, natural, and high-protein foods, allowing for flexible-batch production of various high-viscosity recipes while preserving nutritional value and significantly reducing energy use, water consumption, and waste. This agreement directly supports the UAE’s Food Security Strategy, its National Strategy for Industry and Advanced Technology, and Net Zero goals, reinforcing AAFG’s role as a regional leader in functional, natural foods and contributing to the UAE’s emergence as a global hub for sustainable food-tech innovation.
records.institution: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG)

records.title: The Multi-Purpose Hays Agricultural Cooperative Association has been officially launched in Al-Jarahi District, Hodeida province, followi...
records.description: The Multi-Purpose Hays Agricultural Cooperative Association has been officially launched in Al-Jarahi District, Hodeida province, following a meeting organized by the local council. During the meeting, administrative and supervisory bodies for the association were elected. Officials present described the association's establishment as a significant step for agricultural development in the district, embodying the state's commitment to empowering local communities in managing their projects and improving livelihoods. They noted that Hodeida province is experiencing growing developmental momentum, particularly in agriculture, and emphasized the importance of community involvement in leveraging agricultural potential.
records.institution: The Multi-Purpose Hays Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: Oman is strategically positioning itself as a global leader in green hydrogen, leveraging its abundant solar and wind resources, progress...
records.description: Oman is strategically positioning itself as a global leader in green hydrogen, leveraging its abundant solar and wind resources, progressive government policies, and world-class port infrastructure. Driven by its Vision 2040 and National Energy Strategy to achieve 30% renewable electricity by 2030, the Sultanate established Hydrogen Oman (Hydrom) in 2022 to oversee the development of its green hydrogen economy, which aims to produce up to 8.5 million tonnes per annum by 2050. Hydrom has already secured landmark agreements worth nearly $20 billion with major global firms for projects around the ports of Duqm and Salalah, representing approximately 15 GW of planned renewable capacity. Notable projects include Hyport Duqm, a collaboration to produce 60,000 tonnes of green hydrogen annually, and ACME's Duqm facility aiming for 900,000 tonnes of green ammonia.
records.institution: OQ Group, Petroleum Development Oman (PDO)

records.title: On the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought, the Ministry of Municipality in Qatar reiterated its strong commitment to environ...
records.description: On the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought, the Ministry of Municipality in Qatar reiterated its strong commitment to environmental sustainability by significantly expanding the nation's green infrastructure. This strategic focus involves growing public parks and increasing vegetation cover as a crucial part of Qatar's efforts to combat desertification, mitigate drought impacts, and promote long-term sustainable development. The initiative, themed "Restore the land. Unlock the opportunities," highlights how land restoration can generate jobs, enhance food and water security, support climate action, and build economic resilience. Qatar currently boasts 127 public parks and 153 green areas, with plans to increase this to 160 soon, having already developed over three million square meters of green space. Projects prioritize native and drought-tolerant plants, along with smart water-saving technologies and the use of treated wastewater for irrigation. The Ministry's landmark "Plant Ten Million Trees Initiative" complements a broader strategy for green belts, ornamental agriculture, and aesthetic landscaping. Beyond planting, the Ministry fosters a culture of environmental responsibility through public awareness campaigns, encouraging community participation in conservation and urban farming, reinforcing Qatar's dedication to environmental stewardship for future generations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.title: VCM, Enowa to deliver over 30mln tonnes of carbon credits
records.description: The Voluntary Carbon Market Company (VCM), a carbon credit firm established by the Public Investment Fund (PIF) and Saudi Tadawul Group, has announced a significant long-term agreement with Enowa, NEOM's energy and water subsidiary. This deal aims to facilitate the delivery of approximately 30 million tonnes of high-integrity carbon credits by the end of this decade. The agreement marks a major step in VCM's goal to foster a robust voluntary carbon market in the region, with credits sourced primarily from global climate action projects, especially in the Global South, and transacted on VCM's platform. This collaboration helps Enowa offset current emissions while building sustainable infrastructure for NEOM's renewable energy system, and it provides crucial funding certainty for climate projects worldwide.
records.institution: Voluntary Carbon Market Company (VCM)

records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), in collaboration with the Municipal Council of Khor Fakkan and Khor Fakkan City Muni...
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), in collaboration with the Municipal Council of Khor Fakkan and Khor Fakkan City Municipality, is launching the fourth edition of the Mango Festival at Expo Khor Fakkan. The festival, themed "Mango: Our Fruit, Our Wealth," aims to promote the Eastern Region as an agri-tourism destination, bolster the local economy by supporting farmers and families, and enhance the quality and sustainability of domestic agricultural products. It also seeks to preserve cultural heritage and advance national food security goals. The event will showcase over 150 local mango varieties and feature competitions for the "Mango Mazayna" (beauty contest), "Best Mango Basket," "Best Agriculture-themed Video" for children, and "Best Farmer's Booth." Educational workshops with agricultural experts will also be offered, covering mango tree care and modern farming techniques. The organizing committee has set a submission deadline for video entries via WhatsApp.
records.institution: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: The UAE Ministry of Defense has partnered with National Central Cooling Company (Tabreed) and Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar (UAE...
records.description: The UAE Ministry of Defense has partnered with National Central Cooling Company (Tabreed) and Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar (UAE) and EDF Group (France), to integrate solar energy into two district cooling plants serving the ministry in Abu Dhabi. This project, established through a partnership agreement signed in March 2024 for 25 years of operation, involved installing approximately 4,000 solar panels. These panels will provide 2.4 megawatts (MW) of clean electricity to power the plants' thermal energy storage infrastructure and chilled water pumps, significantly reducing reliance on the electricity grid during peak periods and preventing over 2,600 tons of CO2 emissions annually. This initiative aligns with the UAE's broader sustainability goals and the UAE Armed Forces Climate Change Strategy, emphasizing the growing importance of renewable energy solutions across vital sectors.
records.institution: The UAE Ministry of Defense, National Central Cooling Company (Tabreed)

records.title: Saudi Arabia is a leading participant in global efforts to combat desertification and drought, driven by its diverse geography and a comm...
records.description: Saudi Arabia is a leading participant in global efforts to combat desertification and drought, driven by its diverse geography and a commitment to environmental sustainability. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture highlights the ambitious Saudi Green Initiative, which aims for massive tree planting, carbon emission reduction, and the protection of both land and marine ecosystems, all in alignment with the national vision for a sustainable economy and improved quality of life. Significant progress has been made, including the rehabilitation of vast areas of degraded land, extensive tree planting, and the designation of substantial protected zones, alongside reintroducing endangered species. Through public environmental education and its pivotal role in hosting major international conferences, the Kingdom reaffirms its leadership in addressing land degradation and strengthening resilience to drought globally.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy

records.title: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has reaffirmed its deep and long-standing commitment to supporting Saudi Arabia's transfor...
records.description: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has reaffirmed its deep and long-standing commitment to supporting Saudi Arabia's transformative efforts in rehabilitating degraded lands, combating sand encroachment, and enhancing climate resilience, aligning with global calls for land restoration. As a strategic partner in this endeavor, the FAO has collaborated on initiatives ranging from irrigation projects to rangeland rehabilitation and institutional capacity building, praising the Kingdom's global leadership in combating land degradation and reducing carbon emissions through ambitious policies like the Saudi Green Initiative and the Middle East Green Initiative. This partnership has led to significant achievements in sustainable land management and climate adaptation, exemplified by the Kingdom's hosting of a major international conference on desertification, which launched a global drought resilience partnership.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Voluntary Carbon Market Company (VCM), a carbon credit firm established by a sovereign wealth fund and a major stock exchange group,...
records.description: The Voluntary Carbon Market Company (VCM), a carbon credit firm established by a sovereign wealth fund and a major stock exchange group, has sealed a long-term agreement with an energy and water subsidiary of a prominent new city project. This landmark deal aims to provide tens of millions of high-integrity carbon credits to help offset emissions as renewable energy infrastructure is developed, supporting national net-zero ambitions. The credits will mainly originate from climate action projects globally, particularly in developing regions, and be transacted on VCM's recently launched exchange platform. This platform, designed with institutional-grade infrastructure, aims to create a transparent, scalable, and liquid marketplace for carbon credits, offering features for secure transactions and price discovery, and supporting Islamic finance principles. This collaboration is a significant step in fostering a thriving voluntary carbon market and positions the nation as a key player in global climate finance.
records.institution: The Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM)

records.title: Over 31 million trees have been planted in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province as part of a national afforestation project.
records.description: Over 31 million trees have been planted in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province as part of a national afforestation project. This initiative, led by a national center in partnership with numerous other entities, aims to plant 1.5 billion trees in the province by 2100 and restore over 7.9 million hectares of land. This provincial effort is a key part of a larger national green initiative that seeks to plant a total of 10 billion trees across the country and rehabilitate over 40 million hectares. Beyond planting, the center also focuses on environmental monitoring, combating illegal logging, public awareness, preventing sand encroachment in farming areas, and using native plant species to maintain ecological balance. They also collaborate with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture to organize a national afforestation season.
records.institution: National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is spearheading ambitious plans to boost vegeta...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is spearheading ambitious plans to boost vegetation cover in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Region, aiming for comprehensive sustainable development by 2100. To date, the NCVC has planted over 31.2 million trees in collaboration with numerous government, private, and non-profit partners. Four major projects are currently adding over 1 million more trees, contributing to a larger goal of planting 1.5 billion trees and rehabilitating over 7.9 million hectares of land. These ongoing efforts have already led to significant improvements in the region's environmental indicators and vegetation cover, demonstrating the effectiveness of the NCVC's scientific and integrated approach to afforestation. The center's projects actively support global climate change mitigation and carbon emission reduction, aligning with the Saudi Green Initiative and enhancing the quality of life for current and future generations.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), the Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, and the World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO) ar...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), the Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, and the World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO) are collaboratively hosting a major summit focused on accelerating the future of the green economy through innovation. This event will gather international experts to discuss effective approaches to combat climate change, with a strong emphasis on empowering developing regions, fostering global cooperation, and strengthening public-private partnerships. The summit's agenda is structured around seven key themes, including cutting-edge technology and innovation in climate resilience, clean and renewable energy solutions, shifts in policy and regulation, financial mechanisms for the green transition, addressing climate equity, strategies for climate adaptation and resilience, and the vital role of youth in climate action through entrepreneurship and activism.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), Dubai Supreme Council of Energy and the World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO)

records.title: The United Arab Emirates has made significant strides in combating desertification through proactive measures and innovative initiatives,...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates has made significant strides in combating desertification through proactive measures and innovative initiatives, despite challenging climatic conditions. Guided by its National Strategy to Combat Desertification 2022–2030, the UAE aims to preserve ecosystems, improve arid lands, adapt to climate change impacts, raise awareness, integrate modern technologies and scientific research, and strengthen partnerships. Recent achievements include the rehabilitation of thousands of hectares of degraded land, a smart soil monitoring system using AI, numerous scientific studies on rain enhancement, and projects in saline and desert agriculture. Various initiatives, such as sustainable grazing, a land degradation neutrality program, gene banks for native plants, and early warning systems for sand and dust storms, have been launched. The UAE's comprehensive approach also involves reclaiming desert land, establishing artificial forests and green belts, reducing unsustainable practices, promoting treated water use, and engaging the public through awareness campaigns. As a signatory to international environmental conventions, the UAE's Ministry of Climate Change and Environment has developed and updated national desertification strategies, successfully transforming vast desert areas into green landscapes and establishing numerous nature reserves.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Defense

records.title: The Vegetation Cover Development Foundation (Morooj), a Saudi entity, showcased its leading projects under the Saudi Green Initiative at...
records.description: The Vegetation Cover Development Foundation (Morooj), a Saudi entity, showcased its leading projects under the Saudi Green Initiative at GreenTech Amsterdam, a global exhibition for environmental innovations. Morooj highlighted its significant efforts, including planting millions of mangrove trees, afforesting mosque courtyards, engaging communities in environmental sanitation, and rehabilitating nature reserves across the Kingdom. The foundation's participation aimed to demonstrate its technical expertise and innovative environmental solutions, emphasizing alignment with international best practices and fostering strategic partnerships. This initiative directly supports Morooj's goals of enhancing international collaboration, sharing expertise, and promoting effective environmental practices, reinforcing Saudi Arabia's commitment to combating climate change and advancing environmental sustainability in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Vegetation Cover Development Foundation (Morooj)

records.title: The Saudi AgriFood Tech Alliance (SAFTA) recently expanded its network by signing agreements with prominent Dutch companies and research...
records.description: The Saudi AgriFood Tech Alliance (SAFTA) recently expanded its network by signing agreements with prominent Dutch companies and research institutions during a major exhibition in Amsterdam. This initiative aims to strengthen international cooperation and broaden opportunities in agricultural innovation, fostering bilateral ties and strategic partnerships for knowledge exchange between Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands, directly aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. A separate agreement also brought Dutch water entities into the Saudi Water Innovation Alliance, further advancing collaboration in food security and sustainable agricultural technologies. Ultimately, SAFTA serves as a national platform dedicated to accelerating the adoption of advanced technological solutions and enabling the Kingdom's agricultural sector to implement global best practices in smart farming, environmental sustainability, and high-quality food production.
records.institution: The Saudi AgriFood Tech Alliance (SAFTA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has announced the indefinite closure of the squid fishing season in the Red Se...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has announced the indefinite closure of the squid fishing season in the Red Sea, effective immediately. A decision from the ministry prohibits all squid fishing during this period. The General Authority for Fisheries in the Red Sea has been directed to inventory all stored squid quantities in preparation labs, refrigerators, and fishery facilities within a week. The Ministry warns that any violations will result in penalties as outlined by the Law Regulating Fishing, Exploitation and Protection of Aquatic Life.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands have forged a significant partnership, formalizing over SR428 million in investments through numerous ag...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands have forged a significant partnership, formalizing over SR428 million in investments through numerous agreements and Memoranda of Understanding. These collaborations aim to develop and localize cutting-edge technologies across the environmental, water, and agricultural sectors. Key initiatives include localizing livestock disease control research, advancing agricultural technology and innovation, and implementing greenhouse farming solutions. Specific projects focus on biotechnology transfer, boosting potato production—including a new French fries factory—and investing in various localized agricultural innovations.

records.title: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah), a Saudi institution, has partnered with the Dutch c...
records.description: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah), a Saudi institution, has partnered with the Dutch company Hudson River Biotechnology (HRB) through a memorandum of understanding, aiming to significantly enhance international cooperation in sustainable agricultural research and technology. This collaboration focuses on transferring and localizing advanced genomics technologies and improving plant tissue culture techniques. It also includes implementing specialized training programs to develop national talent in biotechnology and genetic modification, alongside launching applied projects. These efforts are designed to boost the performance and productivity of Saudi Arabia's strategic crops, increasing their resilience to environmental and biological stresses, ultimately leading to greater agricultural production efficiency and long-term sustainability for the Kingdom.

records.title: ADNOC Distribution has released its 2024 Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Report, showcasing significant advancements in susta...
records.description: ADNOC Distribution has released its 2024 Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Report, showcasing significant advancements in sustainability and national value creation. The report, prepared in line with GRI Standards and verified by KPMG, aligns with the UAE Net Zero by 2050 agenda and ADNOC Group's Net Zero by 2045 ambition. The company is actively pursuing a decarbonization roadmap, aiming to reduce carbon intensity in its operations by 25% by 2030 through energy-saving initiatives, building retrofits, and integrating renewable energy. Key achievements highlighted include expanding its electric vehicle (EV) charging network to 220 points, advancing over 20 AI-driven projects for sustainability and efficiency, achieving an Emiratisation rate of over 62%, and investing AED 3.9 million in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).

records.title: Significant progress in combating water scarcity has been made by Khalifa University and Green Waste Solutions Trading DMCC through the d...
records.description: Significant progress in combating water scarcity has been made by Khalifa University and Green Waste Solutions Trading DMCC through the development of innovative technologies. Khalifa University has created a solar-powered thermal distillation device that efficiently produces freshwater from seawater without generating brine, achieving a notable daily output and attracting interest from major national companies. Concurrently, Green Waste Solutions Trading DMCC has developed a mobile, solar-powered integrated system that transforms organic waste and wastewater into potable water, renewable energy, and bio-fertilizers. This system has been successfully deployed in various countries, providing substantial quantities of clean water to remote communities. Both organizations were recently recognized for their contributions at a prestigious water award ceremony, with Khalifa University winning in the "Innovative Research and Development – National Institutions" category and Green Waste Solutions in the "Innovative Projects – Large Projects" category.
records.institution: Khalifa University

records.title: A representative from Bahrain's Animal Health Directorate, part of the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture, recently joine...
records.description: A representative from Bahrain's Animal Health Directorate, part of the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture, recently joined a global gathering of the World Organisation for Animal Health in France. This important session brought together delegates from many countries and international groups to tackle key animal health issues. They focused on updating international standards for animal health and trade, reviewing current disease situations like foot-and-mouth and avian influenza, and boosting cooperation under the One Health approach. A special forum on vaccines and immunization also took place, aiming to create a plan for improving global immunization efforts. The meeting wrapped up with several recommendations, including adopting new technical standards, launching joint efforts to enhance reporting on epidemics, developing strategies for new and zoonotic diseases, and supporting national programs for immunisation and veterinary labs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: Khor Al Sawadi in Oman is recognized for its vital mangrove forests, which create a rich habitat for marine life and serve as a crucial s...
records.description: Khor Al Sawadi in Oman is recognized for its vital mangrove forests, which create a rich habitat for marine life and serve as a crucial stopover for migratory birds. Faced with global threats like climate change, the Environment Authority is diligently working to protect and rehabilitate these ecosystems. This includes a national program focused on mangrove restoration across Oman, with significant efforts in Khor Al Sawadi resulting in the substantial natural expansion and growth of the trees. A major rehabilitation campaign, conducted over several years, involved extensive planting of saplings, greatly contributing to the preservation of this critical coastal environment.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The grape harvesting season has commenced in the Wilayat of Yanqul, A’Dhahirah Governorate, with locally grown grapes highly valued for t...
records.description: The grape harvesting season has commenced in the Wilayat of Yanqul, A’Dhahirah Governorate, with locally grown grapes highly valued for their quality and taste in local markets, and the season is expected to continue until early August. Grapevines in the wilayat span approximately 13 acres, featuring about 2,600 grape trees, including both local and imported varieties, which significantly contribute to meeting the governorate's summer grape demand. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources actively supports grape farmers by providing technical supervision, advisory services on planting, trellis design, modern irrigation, pest control, and supplying seedlings, as well as scheduling preventive spraying and fertilization. These services also foster knowledge sharing among farmers, aiming to create sustainable income sources and optimize resource utilization, particularly through rationalized water consumption via modern irrigation techniques.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Oman has lifted its ban on poultry imports from select regions in Europe following updated veterinary assessments, according to Ministeri...
records.description: Oman has lifted its ban on poultry imports from select regions in Europe following updated veterinary assessments, according to Ministerial Decision No. 126/2025 issued by Agriculture Minister Saud bin Hamoud al Habsi. The ban removal applies to Northern Ireland, Zealand Island (Denmark), Veneto (Italy), Lubuskie (Poland), and Flanders (Belgium), and aligns with international biosecurity standards. The decision takes effect upon publication in the Official Gazette.
records.institution: Oman Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: OQ Alternative Energy, the clean energy arm of a major Omani group, is set to begin operating key projects next year, aiming to contribut...
records.description: OQ Alternative Energy, the clean energy arm of a major Omani group, is set to begin operating key projects next year, aiming to contribute significantly to Oman's renewable energy capacity with a target of upwards of 7 GW by the end of the decade. This initiative is centered on two pillars: developing renewable energy and green hydrogen projects, and fostering holistic development across the entire value chain to attract foreign investment and advanced technology. A joint venture between OQ Alternative Energy and an international energy group will develop three initial projects, supplying renewable electricity to a prominent oil and gas producer under long-term agreements. Construction is underway with contributions from a Chinese contracting giant for engineering, procurement, and construction, as well as leading Chinese manufacturers for wind turbines and solar panels.
records.institution: OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE)

records.title: Dubai Municipality recently hosted its third Food Safety Forum, aligned with World Food Safety Day's theme "Food Safety: Prepare for the...
records.description: Dubai Municipality recently hosted its third Food Safety Forum, aligned with World Food Safety Day's theme "Food Safety: Prepare for the Unexpected." The event convened representatives from the UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), and various public, private, and academic entities. Discussions centered on the scientific underpinnings of food safety policy and risk management, aiming to enhance food supply chain resilience and empower consumer choices. Officials from Dubai Municipality underscored their commitment to a knowledge-driven, sustainable food ecosystem built on innovation and partnerships. The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment highlighted the UAE's dedication to food safety as a national priority, citing a robust legislative framework, digital transformation initiatives like the 'ZAD' portal and Biosecurity Early Notification System, and collaboration with FAO on a new strategic index for food control systems.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.title: A meeting recently convened in Hajjah governorate, chaired by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, focused on the...
records.description: A meeting recently convened in Hajjah governorate, chaired by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, focused on the implementation of programs for expanding grain and legume production through contract farming. Attendees, including ministry undersecretaries, reviewed collective efforts to boost these strategic crops, aiming to enhance food security, build resilience, decrease import costs, and achieve national self-sufficiency, aligning with directives from the leadership and the government's agenda. The Minister underscored the necessity of robust inter-agency coordination for effective execution and the importance of collecting farmer data to facilitate agricultural guidance through field schools. An Undersecretary from the Ministry of Local Administration and Rural Development emphasized these programs as a top priority and a key metric for assessing the performance of district directors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the Hodeida Governor recently inaugurated a project to sow and plant 250,...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the Hodeida Governor recently inaugurated a project to sow and plant 250,000 Sidr tree seedlings at a district nursery. This initiative, a collaborative effort with local beekeepers and agricultural cooperative societies, aims to expand afforestation and increase agricultural land. During their visit, the officials were briefed on the nursery's operations, including seedling production and distribution plans, recognizing its role in community afforestation and boosting rural incomes. The Minister underscored the project's significance for plant production, beekeeping, and achieving self-sufficiency in fruit and environmental trees, highlighting Sidr's multifaceted value. He also emphasized the ministry's focus on establishing community nurseries to enhance farmer incomes, create employment, and foster agricultural partnerships within communities, envisioning this nursery as a model for other regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Bahrain recently participated in a major international ocean conference in France, where government representatives discussed the nation'...
records.description: Bahrain recently participated in a major international ocean conference in France, where government representatives discussed the nation's ongoing commitment to environmental security and sustainability, guided by its national leadership. The conference, co-chaired by two republics, focused on accelerating efforts to conserve and sustainably use oceans, addressing challenges like pollution and overfishing, and aiming to adopt a declaration and action plan for ocean preservation. The delegation affirmed Bahrain's support for global initiatives to protect marine resources and advance sustainable development in cooperation with international organizations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia will enforce new regulations on June 27 mandating livestock sales by weight rather than size to curb price manipulation and...
records.description: Saudi Arabia will enforce new regulations on June 27 mandating livestock sales by weight rather than size to curb price manipulation and ensure fair value for buyers and sellers. The move targets inflated pricing, particularly during Eid Al-Adha, when livestock demand spikes. In 2024, over 4 million animals were imported, with prices reportedly rising by more than SAR2,000 during the holiday. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture aims to eliminate unregulated roadside trading and improve market transparency across the supply chain.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture
