records.title: The UAE and the US are reinforcing their strategic energy partnership for a sustainable future through substantial joint investments in c...
records.description: The UAE and the US are reinforcing their strategic energy partnership for a sustainable future through substantial joint investments in clean and renewable energy to bolster global energy security and support emerging economies. A key initiative, PACE, aims to mobilize US$100 billion to deploy 100GW of clean energy by 2035, including a $20 billion allocation to develop 15GW of US clean energy projects led by Masdar. ADNOC has also invested in a blue hydrogen project in Texas. To support innovation, the Abu Dhabi Department of Energy has agreements with the University of Arizona and IRENA for advanced clean energy technologies.
records.institution: Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company)

records.title: The Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI) received a delegation from the Republic of Maldives, with several Kuwaiti business own...
records.description: The Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI) received a delegation from the Republic of Maldives, with several Kuwaiti business owners present. KCCI expressed appreciation for the delegation’s visit, noting the growing ties between Kuwait and the Maldives based on friendship and shared aspirations for economic and cultural cooperation. Trade relations between the two countries have significantly strengthened over the past decade, with a notable increase in Kuwaiti exports to the Maldives. The partnership is further strengthened by Maldivian excellence in tourism and maritime industries, attracting Kuwaiti investors, while Kuwaiti companies excel in finance, logistics, healthcare, and energy, providing a solid foundation for productive cooperation and investment. The Maldives Foreign Minister outlined prominent investment opportunities available in his country, mainly in sectors such as tourism, investment, alternative energy, logistics, ports, housing cities, agriculture, and fisheries.
records.institution: Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI)

records.title: Oman's wheat production is projected to exceed 7,700 tonnes for the 2024-2025 season as harvesting commences across key agricultural regi...
records.description: Oman's wheat production is projected to exceed 7,700 tonnes for the 2024-2025 season as harvesting commences across key agricultural regions. While the cultivated area has decreased in some areas due to crop diversification, government support and improved farming practices are helping maintain strong yields. Dhofar's Najd region is expected to be the top producer, despite a slight reduction in acreage as farmers shift to more water-efficient crops. Wheat remains strategically important for national food security, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund, which distributed 30 tonnes of wheat seeds at a 50% subsidy and provided free harvesting machinery, with collection managed by Oman Flour Mills Company. Dhahirah and Dakhliyah also anticipate significant wheat production with government support, including subsidized seeds and modern irrigation. Buraimi expects over 250 tonnes of wheat due to high-quality seeds provided to farmers. Despite a modest decrease in total wheat acreage, ongoing government support and infrastructure continue to position wheat as a key element of Oman’s food security strategy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The UAE National Codex Committee (NCC), under the Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology, in collaboration with ADAFSA and GFoRSS,...
records.description: The UAE National Codex Committee (NCC), under the Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology, in collaboration with ADAFSA and GFoRSS, has inaugurated a two-day workshop in Abu Dhabi to evaluate and strengthen the UAE’s alignment with Codex Alimentarius standards. The workshop gathers members of the UAE NCC, international and local experts, and ADAFSA representatives. Opening remarks emphasized national collaboration and the FAO/WHO self-assessment tool for evaluating the UAE’s Codex initiatives and ensuring alignment with scientific and legislative developments. The workshop features presentations on the self-assessment tool's methodology and procedures, covering institutional mechanisms, consultation processes, understanding Codex work, policy frameworks, and activity utilization. Interactive working groups discuss assessment criteria, scoring, consistency, and documentation to ensure participant understanding. Organizers highlight the workshop's importance in bolstering the UAE’s food security and agricultural sustainability strategies by aligning national Codex activities with international standards to enhance national food safety regulations.
records.institution: The UAE National Codex Committee (NCC)

records.title: Oman’s Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries Wealth, and Water Resources is expected to award a tender for consultancy services for the Wadi...
records.description: Oman’s Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries Wealth, and Water Resources is expected to award a tender for consultancy services for the Wadi Ahin Flood Protection Dam in North Al Batinah Governorate in the third quarter. The design and supervision consultancy tender was issued with bid submissions due in the second quarter. The contract is anticipated to be awarded in the third quarter, with project completion scheduled for the third quarter of 2027. The consultant will review the existing dam design, propose modifications, and supervise construction, evaluating various conditions, topography, safety, and land allocation. The scope also includes construction oversight to ensure compliance with updated specifications and standards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Environment Authority and Japan Ministry of Environment signed a memorandum of cooperation (MoC) on environmental matters.
records.description: The Environment Authority and Japan Ministry of Environment signed a memorandum of cooperation (MoC) on environmental matters. The MoC seeks to enhance cooperation towards sustainable development and the implementation of environmental multilateral agreements, like the Paris Agreement, establishing a framework for cooperation based on equality, reciprocity, and mutual benefits. The agreement provides for cooperation in mitigating climate change effects, adapting to related impacts, waste management, and biodiversity conservation as nature-based solutions. The two sides will conduct training courses, expert visits, research, interactive discussions, and information exchange in areas of cooperation and joint projects.
records.institution: The Environment Authority

records.title: The FoodTech Challenge (FTC) has shortlisted 42 early-stage startups with tech solutions to transform global food systems.
records.description: The FoodTech Challenge (FTC) has shortlisted 42 early-stage startups with tech solutions to transform global food systems. Organized by UAE entities and partners, the third FTC offers a $2 million prize. The competition, announced in 2024, will award four winners cash grants, support, and network access for deployment in the UAE and the Global South, leveraging the UAE's climate as a launchpad. Judges reviewed over 1,200 entries from 113 countries, showcasing innovations from lab-grown dairy to AI crop monitoring. UAE startups comprise 16 percent of the semifinalists, with significant female and youth co-founder representation. The cohort includes startups from numerous countries offering solutions in smart packaging, urban farming, and AI analytics, with a focus on reducing food loss and waste. Selected startups will undergo interviews and pitches for a top 10 shortlist, judged by representatives from organizing entities and international organizations. Launched under the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy 2051, FTC aims to support solutions related to the food-water-energy nexus, reduce food loss, and accelerate globally replicable innovations.
records.institution: International Affairs Office at the UAE Presidential Court, Tamkeen

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Wilo, a multinational technology group, and Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company – Masdar, the UAE’s clean energy leader, have formed a cooper...
records.description: Wilo, a multinational technology group, and Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company – Masdar, the UAE’s clean energy leader, have formed a cooperation agreement emphasizing efficiency technology and renewable energy. This strategic partnership aims to significantly expand their collaboration in the Middle East and beyond, highlighting the necessity of both renewable energy expansion and energy efficiency initiatives to address the global energy shortage. The agreement combines Masdar’s green energy expertise with Wilo’s technologies and manufacturing capabilities to deliver integrated solutions for a cleaner, more efficient world, also strengthening ties with Germany as a key market. The signing occurred at Wilo Group’s expanded production plant in Dubai. Wilo’s evolution into a provider of sustainable water and energy-efficient technology demonstrates the potential for climate-friendly innovations to offer global solutions, considered vital for regions aiming to become climate-neutral industrial leaders.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company – Masdar

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: France's energy regulator advised governments against sudden changes to renewable energy support, as even reform announcements can underm...
records.description: France's energy regulator advised governments against sudden changes to renewable energy support, as even reform announcements can undermine investor trust and create power sector uncertainty. The regulator stated that altering support contracts without system-level consideration risks market destabilization and erodes trust in long-term public support. While acknowledging past subsidy issues, the focus should shift to incentivizing renewables to meet real-time grid demands through balancing markets, exposing them to system constraints. However, prolonged negative electricity prices, common with high renewable penetration, can impede new project financing. Increasing system instability due to limited storage and balancing needs is also a concern. Instead of new frameworks, modifying distorting older contracts could maintain investor confidence. The regulator stressed that policy must be tailored to each country's energy system and renewable mix, advocating for practical dialogue and context-specific solutions rather than simply adopting others' policies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources celebrated the opening of Wadi Adawnib Dam in the Wilayat of Salalah, Governor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources celebrated the opening of Wadi Adawnib Dam in the Wilayat of Salalah, Governorate of Dhofar. The dam, with an 83 million cubic metre storage capacity and costing about OMR24 million, is the second largest of its kind in Oman and aims to enhance flood protection. It features an integrated monitoring system, including wells, sensors, and cameras, with data directly transmitted to a control room for immediate decisions during emergencies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman participated in the annual International Day of Plant Health, themed “The Importance of Plant Health for a One Heal...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman participated in the annual International Day of Plant Health, themed “The Importance of Plant Health for a One Health Approach.” This day emphasizes the vital role of plant health in food security, human and animal well-being, and environmental sustainability, as healthy plants are fundamental to nutritious food systems and ecological balance. The international observance aims to raise global awareness about safeguarding plants and crops from pests and diseases, conserving natural resources, and improving plant health, thereby contributing to global food security, environmental protection, biodiversity, pollution reduction, safe trade, and socio-economic progress. Global and regional organizations are marking the occasion with scientific events to promote the importance of plant health in global economic development. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources continues to monitor laboratory reports and pest risk analyses from exporting countries and is improving workforce training to enhance plant health efficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia and China have signed two export protocols allowing Saudi dairy and aquaculture products into the Chinese market.
records.description: Saudi Arabia and China have signed two export protocols allowing Saudi dairy and aquaculture products into the Chinese market. The agreements, finalized during an official visit, aim to expand trade in high-quality food and strengthen customs cooperation. Discussions focused on enhancing trade in these sectors, streamlining export procedures, and encouraging Saudi companies' expansion in China, aligning with national export goals. This cooperation reflects growing trust and will facilitate the entry of leading Saudi companies into the Chinese market. The Kingdom reaffirmed its commitment to robust regulations and private sector empowerment through international best practices, expressing optimism about increasing exports to China, deepening economic and food security partnerships, and future trade agreements.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia, through the National Center for Wildlife (NCW), has joined the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands to conserve environmental reso...
records.description: Saudi Arabia, through the National Center for Wildlife (NCW), has joined the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands to conserve environmental resources, habitats, and biodiversity while supporting sustainability and the economy. This reflects the NCW's leadership in wetland protection plans, including research, monitoring, and conservation, coordinating national implementation of the Convention. Saudi Arabia aims to manage sites for the Ramsar List of Wetlands of International Importance according to global standards. Wetlands are vital ecosystems for biodiversity, carbon storage, water, food, energy, climate, agriculture, and ecotourism, also serving as migratory stopovers. This accession is a strategic step enhancing environmental and economic benefits, with a commitment to global best practices in wetland conservation aligning with national visions. The Ramsar Convention, established in 1971, provides a global framework for wetland conservation and sustainable use, covering various wetland types.
records.institution: The National Center for Wildlife (NCW)

records.title: In observance of the International Day of Plant Health, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) reaffirms its commit...
records.description: In observance of the International Day of Plant Health, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) reaffirms its commitment to initiatives safeguarding plant health and agricultural sustainability across the emirate through crop inspections, integrated pest management, and farmer education. ADAFSA employs a comprehensive biosecurity strategy, including the Integrated Palm Pest Management Programme targeting key pests with environmentally safe methods like pheromone traps, resulting in the capture of millions of weevils. A palm survey programme identifies and treats infestations with high success rates. ADAFSA also removes and repurposes severely infested palm trees. Embracing integrated pest management, the Authority combines economic and environmental practices for sustainable pest elimination and has an emergency response plan for agricultural pests, positioning the region as prepared for such challenges. ADAFSA is dedicated to best practices, innovative technologies, regular pest monitoring, farmer education, a comprehensive pest database, biological pest control, agricultural quarantine, advanced laboratories, and expert teams with research stations to inform pest control and the selection of pest-resistant plant varieties.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources celebrated the opening of Wadi Anaar Dam in Salalah, Governorate of Dhofar.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources celebrated the opening of Wadi Anaar Dam in Salalah, Governorate of Dhofar. The project, costing about OMR23 million, aims to enhance protection against flood risks and promote water security by capturing large volumes of rainwater from nearby mountains that flow towards Salalah Port, Raysut Industrial City, and Salalah Free Zone. The dam is equipped with advanced technologies for safety during emergencies, including smart monitoring systems for water levels, seismic sensors to track geological activity, and surveillance cameras for comprehensive coverage. Automatic control gates regulate water flow and can be operated remotely through a secure central system that receives and analyzes data in real-time.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: Qatar's abundant marine biodiversity and increasing emphasis on environmental conservation are establishing it as a leader in sustainable...
records.description: Qatar's abundant marine biodiversity and increasing emphasis on environmental conservation are establishing it as a leader in sustainable tourism within the region. By consistently working to protect its marine environment and promote ecotourism, the country is not only safeguarding its natural heritage but also supporting broader global environmental objectives. Qatar's marine environment is recognized as the most diverse in the region due to its unique peninsular geography. The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MECC) highlights Qatar's extensive coastline, stretching around 563 kilometers along the Arabian Gulf, which supports a wide variety of coastal and marine ecosystems. The depth of Qatar’s territorial waters ranges from sea level to approximately 60 meters.
records.institution: Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MECC)

records.title: The 21st Mango and Tropical Fruits Festival, organized in Sabya Governorate by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Jazan...
records.description: The 21st Mango and Tropical Fruits Festival, organized in Sabya Governorate by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Jazan branch, continues to attract large crowds of all ages. The week-long festival offers children an engaging experience to explore tropical fruits, learn about their environmental importance, and enjoy mango flavors. Interactive competitions encourage participation in a fun, family atmosphere. Educational workshops introduce children to agriculture and the role of healthy fruits in a balanced diet. A theater features magic shows and animated presentations, adding to the lively atmosphere and visitor enthusiasm.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: In Dubai, the Global Olive Corporation (GOC) unveiled a project to tokenize 100 million olive trees globally, starting with a million alr...
records.description: In Dubai, the Global Olive Corporation (GOC) unveiled a project to tokenize 100 million olive trees globally, starting with a million already planted in Georgia. This initiative aims to link investors with real olive trees through blockchain tokens representing ownership in a productive asset. Token holders are promised a share of profits from olive oil and fruit sales, as well as carbon credits, while supporting afforestation across four continents. The GOC's olive-backed token, tentatively named Olive Cash, will be formally introduced in Singapore in October. Future expansion includes countries across multiple continents. Each tree will have a unique digital token trackable via blockchain, with real-time data on its condition. Tokenization aims to boost agricultural productivity and resource management. The model includes a replacement system for dead or diseased trees. GOC aims to tap into the demand for verified carbon offsets linked to each token. The initiative seeks to offer a sustainable investment with environmental benefits.
records.institution: Global Olive Corporation (GOC)

records.title: Saudi Arabia has signed an agreement with a global packaging solutions provider to explore establishing local manufacturing operations wi...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has signed an agreement with a global packaging solutions provider to explore establishing local manufacturing operations within the Kingdom. This move underscores Saudi Arabia's commitment to attracting international partners for advanced manufacturing and technology transfer in key industrial sectors, aligning with its Vision 2030 goals for economic diversification and private sector growth. Representatives from the Saudi National Industrial Development Center and the packaging company formalized the agreement, highlighting the packaging provider's expertise and the collaboration's aim to build competitive industrial capabilities and attract long-term investment. The partnership will jointly assess the feasibility of local services and training programs for the Kingdom’s food and beverage packaging sector, following a market assessment for high-value contributions to Saudi manufacturers. This development occurs as the packaging company expands its sustainable packaging innovations, recently introducing a high-speed solution for still beverages using 100% recycled materials, featuring patented technology for improved efficiency and reduced environmental impact, compatible with existing lines and various bottle formats.
records.institution: Saudi National Industrial Development Center

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Buraimi Governorate has begun its wheat harvest across the governorate's...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Buraimi Governorate has begun its wheat harvest across the governorate's districts, expecting a total production exceeding 250 tons due to a significant expansion in cultivation of this key food security crop. The Director General of Agriculture and Water Resources noted that over 200 acres were planted, with a substantial quantity of high-quality seeds distributed to farmers, emphasizing the Directorate's ongoing support with necessary resources for a successful harvest and their commitment to expanding wheat cultivation for the governorate's food security. Plans are in place to further increase wheat cultivation next season, utilizing the governorate's advantages in wheat production, with new investments planned and local seed sourcing to encourage sustainable domestic production.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced the Kingdom's joining of the UN Food and Agriculture Organization...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced the Kingdom's joining of the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Agreement on Port State Measures (PSMA) to combat illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) fishing, supporting marine biodiversity protection and global environmental sustainability. The ministry stressed this reflects a commitment to international environmental agreements and safeguarding marine resources, aligning with national laws and enhancing local authorities' monitoring of ports and vessels. PSMA aims to improve coordination among national entities, enforce penalties on illegal fishing, and raise awareness in coastal communities. The agreement will boost international cooperation on IUU fishing data, improve global fisheries management through standardized monitoring, promote compliant investment, prevent offending vessels' port access, and offer technical support to developing nations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment

records.title: Oman's fisheries sector significantly contributes to food security and economic growth, with a substantial total fish production in the p...
records.description: Oman's fisheries sector significantly contributes to food security and economic growth, with a substantial total fish production in the past year, primarily driven by sustainable artisanal fishing. The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund has supported numerous projects across various specialized areas, including advisory services, aquaculture, resource development, quality control, and marketing. Key advancements include the introduction of electronic marketing in fish markets, ongoing efforts for a central fish drying unit, and the deployment of artificial coral reefs to enhance fish stocks. The fund has also backed initiatives in statistical and knowledge development, such as a Fishermen’s Village to support artisanal fishing and a program to preserve maritime heritage. The fund's overall focus has been on increasing productivity through modernizing techniques, diversifying income through aquaculture and industrial growth, and promoting environmental conservation via sustainable practices and marine protection, ultimately advancing Oman's fisheries sector.
records.institution: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund

records.title: The National Food Loss and Waste Initiative, ne’ma, has launched the country’s first National Baseline Study with 3,000 participants to m...
records.description: The National Food Loss and Waste Initiative, ne’ma, has launched the country’s first National Baseline Study with 3,000 participants to measure actual food loss and waste, aiming to halve it by 2030 in line with UN SDG 12.3. This 18-month study will assess the entire food value chain across all Emirates, with findings expected in the first half of 2026 to establish national indices and inform intervention strategies for food security and sustainability. The effort involves partners like the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment and various municipal and statistical authorities. Data collection includes a field survey in September 2025 to identify where and why food is lost or wasted. The study's results will be shared nationally and internationally to advance sustainable food systems and the UN's 2030 Agenda.
records.institution: Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: A meeting led by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources addressed the implementation of programs to increase grain a...
records.description: A meeting led by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources addressed the implementation of programs to increase grain and legume production through contract farming. Officials from the General Corporation for Grain Development and Production and the Agricultural Cooperative Union discussed the implementation processes and the collaborative roles of various involved entities. The Minister emphasized the need for inter-agency coordination to efficiently execute agricultural and fisheries programs aimed at boosting production, reducing import dependence, and achieving self-sufficiency, also highlighting the importance of expanding grain and legume cultivation for food security. A call was made for a training program to improve the capabilities of local branches and agricultural cooperatives in managing contract farming data and product tracking.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.description: A meeting was held under the chairmanship of the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources with members of the Fertilizers and Pesticides Committee at the ministry. The meeting, attended by the Director General of the Quality Control Department for Production Inputs, focused on the committee’s workflow and performance as the first of its kind established by the ministry to reform fertilizer and pesticide management policies and operations. The committee approved the formation of a team of experts and academics to review the foundations, standards, and regulations for correcting the fertilizer and pesticide management policy prepared by the ministry's specialists. This is considered crucial for improving work procedures, removing obstacles, and protecting land resources, especially given the current challenges the country is facing. The Minister praised the committee’s performance in aligning with the current phase’s requirements and contributing to increased production and enhanced food security.

records.description: In coordination with local authorities in Dhamar Governorate and several agricultural nurseries, an afforestation and vegetation cover project has been launched across the governorate's districts. This initiative involves the planting of 400,000 sidr and eucalyptus seedlings. During the project launch in Al-Manar District, the Director of the Agriculture Sector in the Governorate explained that a significant number of sidr seedlings will be distributed throughout the district's villages and sub-districts, following a pre-determined plan that identifies suitable planting locations for these seedlings.

records.title: Modern and innovative farming techniques are significantly benefiting the Najran Region, with methods like greenhouse and vertical agricu...
records.description: Modern and innovative farming techniques are significantly benefiting the Najran Region, with methods like greenhouse and vertical agriculture boosting production, saving land, and conserving water. Utilizing agricultural waste as fertilizer has further supported the region's agricultural growth, establishing it as a key economic sector and contributor to food security. The adoption of advanced technologies and sustainable practices, alongside favorable environmental conditions, has made Najran ideal for year-round diverse crop cultivation, including grains, dates, citrus fruits, vegetables, and new additions like coffee and strawberries, replacing traditional farming methods. A representative from the Najran Coffee Agricultural Cooperative Society highlighted the region's advantages for cultivating diverse crops without pesticides or chemical fertilizers, emphasizing the cooperative's role in promoting modern agricultural practices.
records.institution: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Al-Baha branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture presented the contract for an agricultural city project to the A...
records.description: The Al-Baha branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture presented the contract for an agricultural city project to the Agricultural Production and Marketing Cooperative in Bani Kabir on Monday. This project, covering a significant area, is dedicated to cultivating almond and fruit trees. The handover is part of the ministry’s broader efforts to promote sustainable agricultural development and support agricultural cooperatives across the Kingdom, aiming to enhance food security and boost the local agricultural sector. A representative from the ministry highlighted the project as a promising way to utilize the Al-Baha Region’s natural resources, noting the economic value of almond and fruit tree cultivation in the area. The branch emphasized its commitment to empowering agricultural cooperatives and fostering a supportive environment for their success, hoping this project will serve as a model for sustainable agricultural investment, with expectations of creating jobs, improving local produce quality, and generating economic benefits for the region.
records.institution: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: Oman's green hydrogen industry orchestrator, has launched a Single Permit System to significantly ease the permitting process for green h...
records.description: Oman's green hydrogen industry orchestrator, has launched a Single Permit System to significantly ease the permitting process for green hydrogen developers, announced during the introduction of Oman’s third green hydrogen auction round for a substantial land block near the Duqm Special Economic Zone. Previously, developers had to engage with over a dozen government bodies to secure land access. This new one-stop system, a key outcome of a collaborative national laboratory, aims to provide developers with immediate land access upon award, eliminating the need for multiple individual approvals from entities such as the Ministry of Energy and Minerals, Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, Environment Authority, Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ), and others. While developers still have obligations to fulfill, the Single Permit System is expected to greatly reduce administrative complexity and save time, enabling earlier project commencement.
records.institution: Hydrom

records.title: Fresh Chinese vegetables are reaching supermarket shelves in Dubai, UAE, within 48 hours of harvest, meeting the significant demand in th...
records.description: Fresh Chinese vegetables are reaching supermarket shelves in Dubai, UAE, within 48 hours of harvest, meeting the significant demand in this vegetable-import-reliant region due to the UAE's challenging desert climate for leafy green production. This rapid delivery is facilitated by efficient cold-chain logistics, ensuring freshness from harvest in China to display in Dubai within two days. A major produce procurement group reports that Chinese vegetables account for a substantial portion of their total vegetable sales in the UAE throughout the year. These imports are also enriching the local culinary scene, with chefs and consumers embracing the unique flavors of Chinese vegetables like bok choy, which has become a popular ingredient in various dishes, garnering praise from a diverse customer base.
records.institution: Wenchao Group

records.title: A meeting in Sana'a, chaired by the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Administration and Local and Rural Development, focused on affo...
records.description: A meeting in Sana'a, chaired by the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Administration and Local and Rural Development, focused on afforestation efforts and plans to improve vegetation cover nationwide. The Deputy Prime Minister stressed governmental work to find sustainable alternatives for those dependent on logging, emphasizing shared responsibility for environmental protection and the need for central support to local authorities for afforestation, urging the use of the autumn season for expanding green areas and increasing seedling production for future sustainability. The importance of media and community leaders in environmental awareness was noted, highlighting Yemeni society's potential for agricultural-ecological transformation through community mobilization. The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced a national million-seedling planting project. The Minister of Health and Environment discussed establishing new nurseries and integrating agricultural awareness into education, emphasizing the impact of vegetation loss on public health and the need to prevent excessive logging.
records.institution: The Yemeni Government

records.title: The marketing of locally produced chicken has been launched in Bajil district, Hodeida province, aiming to substitute imported chicken.
records.description: The marketing of locally produced chicken has been launched in Bajil district, Hodeida province, aiming to substitute imported chicken. This initiative is led by the Bajil District Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Society in collaboration with local poultry farmers, intending to boost local production and regulate the poultry sector through cooperative efforts that support food security and small producers. A local official emphasized this as a practical step towards empowering local producers and improving poultry farmers' capabilities via a regulatory framework that stabilizes prices and ensures quality. A poultry sector representative explained that the current output resulted from organized collaboration between cooperatives, farmers' associations, and the private sector, enabling the marketing of high-quality local frozen chicken to meet market needs, as part of a national program to decrease imports and foster investment in the poultry sector. Representatives from the Bajil Cooperative Society affirmed their readiness to provide the necessary quantities of local frozen chicken, highlighting the project as a practical model of farmer and supporter integration, and praised the role of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in sponsoring such initiatives to develop local production and expand its marketing.

records.description: The Najd agricultural region in Dhofar Governorate has cultivated approximately 6,400 acres of wheat across 52 farms, expecting a 6,000-ton production for the 2024/2025 season, with harvesting commencing in early April under the supervision of the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Dhofar, in collaboration with the Agriculture and Fisheries Development Fund. While wheat cultivation area saw a decrease due to some farmers shifting to other crops for environmental and economic reasons, and more seeking government subsidies exploring alternatives like onions and tomatoes, the ministry provided subsidized wheat seeds and free harvesters, also facilitating delivery to Oman Flour Mills Company, emphasizing wheat's importance in food security.

records.description: A delegation from the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) attended the Earthna Summit in Doha, Qatar, alongside representatives from international organizations. The summit focused on advancing sustainability in hot and arid regions through innovation and knowledge, addressing environmental, economic, and social dimensions, and sharing best practices in sustainable agriculture and climate change adaptation. During the summit, the NCVC delegation highlighted Saudi Arabia’s pioneering efforts in mangrove forest development and preservation, community support through volunteer work, and the promotion of mangrove honey production, which received significant praise. The NCVC continues its extensive work to foster a thriving and sustainable vegetation cover across Saudi Arabia by protecting and enhancing vegetation, rehabilitating degraded lands.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

This year, the ministry has increased its efforts to ensure the continued success of this annual celebration, which serves as a platform for farmers and entrepreneurs to market their produce and expand their customer base in a region boasting over 3,360,000 tropical fruit trees with an annual production of 123,311 tons.

records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) is making notable advancements in mango and tropical fruit cultivation in the Jazan Region as part of its efforts to promote sustainable agriculture. The center's research fields feature over 70 varieties of mangoes and tropical fruits, where they are evaluated to improve production quality and increase farmers’ economic returns. Estidamah also focuses on transferring successful agricultural practices to farmers and investors, contributing to regional economic growth and enhanced food security. The center's initiatives aim to support farmers and promote the use of modern agricultural techniques, thereby fostering sustainable development in the sector, raising productivity, improving farmers' incomes, and strengthening Jazan's position as a key agricultural hub in the Kingdom.

records.title: Abu Dhabi is launching Nutri-Mark, a mandatory Front-of-Pack Nutrition Labelling (FOPNL) system, set to begin in July.
records.description: Abu Dhabi is launching Nutri-Mark, a mandatory Front-of-Pack Nutrition Labelling (FOPNL) system, set to begin in July. Developed by the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council and the Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre, this system will feature an A–E color-coded rating to quickly inform consumers about a food product's nutritional profile. While drawing inspiration from Europe's Nutri-Score, Nutri-Mark is specifically adapted to the UAE's dietary patterns and Halal requirements. Initially, the system will apply to five key food categories, with a phased expansion planned to eventually cover all food products, including unpackaged items and restaurant meals. This initiative is a strategic public health effort to combat high rates of overweight and obesity by empowering consumers to make healthier choices.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council

records.title: Saudi Arabia is aggressively pursuing a leading role in the hydrogen economy by investing significantly in both green and blue hydrogen p...
records.description: Saudi Arabia is aggressively pursuing a leading role in the hydrogen economy by investing significantly in both green and blue hydrogen production, aiming to power half of its electricity with renewables by 2030 and achieve net-zero emissions by 2060 through strategic alliances and initiatives like NEOM. Major Saudi energy companies are at the forefront of these efforts, undertaking substantial projects in line with national sustainability objectives. The Kingdom intends to invest heavily in green hydrogen manufacturing and become a major global producer of blue hydrogen, with ambitious production targets for blue ammonia by 2030. Saudi Arabia is actively exploring diverse applications of hydrogen across industrial, power generation, and transportation sectors, a strategy driven by its Vision 2030, strong international partnerships, technological advancements, and government support. Integrating hydrogen into the national blue economy is considered vital for sustainable growth, with green hydrogen expected to revolutionize transportation and heavy industry.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy

records.title: Taiz officials launched agricultural activities in summer schools, in coordination with the Agriculture Sector, emphasizing the leadershi...
records.description: Taiz officials launched agricultural activities in summer schools, in coordination with the Agriculture Sector, emphasizing the leadership's interest in agriculture as a national development priority. They highlighted the importance of equipping students with agricultural and development skills for the country's future, improving living standards, and enhancing food security. It was stressed that agricultural knowledge is a key focus of national development alongside other educational activities, requiring trained scientific personnel. An official from the Province's Agriculture Sector expressed hope that students would benefit from the agricultural program, learning about methods, fertilization, and pruning, and acknowledged teachers' role in providing this knowledge.
records.institution: The Yemeni Government

records.title: Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC – Masdar, the UAE’s clean energy leader, announced that its subsidiary TERNA ENERGY has 1 completed...
records.description: Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC – Masdar, the UAE’s clean energy leader, announced that its subsidiary TERNA ENERGY has 1 completed its delisting from the Athens Stock Exchange following Masdar’s full acquisition of the company. A delegation from Masdar visited TERNA ENERGY’s Athens headquarters to discuss Masdar’s strategy for expanding the business and accelerating renewable energy growth in Southeastern and Central Europe. The acquisition aims to strengthen Masdar's position in Greece and the wider region, expedite renewable energy solutions, and unlock necessary investment for clean energy targets, demonstrating the commitment of both the UAE and Masdar to affordable, secure, and sustainable energy. This move will support Greece’s National Energy and Climate Plan, the EU’s net-zero emissions ambition, and Masdar’s global target of 100 GW clean energy capacity by 2030, with TERNA ENERGY aiming for 6GW by 2030 with Masdar’s backing. The integration of the two companies is expected to maximize their combined expertise to accelerate clean energy projects in Greece and the region, establishing TERNA ENERGY as Masdar’s flagship platform there.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC – Masdar

records.title: The Mleiha Wheat Farm in Sharjah, UAE, has cultivated a new wheat variety, Saba Sanabel, with a record-high native protein content, signa...
records.description: The Mleiha Wheat Farm in Sharjah, UAE, has cultivated a new wheat variety, Saba Sanabel, with a record-high native protein content, signaling a major step in the UAE's efforts to reduce food import dependence and become a wheat exporter. The farm, covering over 1,400 hectares, aims to boost local food production through sustainable, chemical-free agriculture in a country with limited arable land and high import reliance. This desert-grown, nutrient-dense wheat variety has the potential to significantly alter the national food landscape, with the farm eventually aiming to meet Sharjah's entire wheat demand. The project demonstrates the transformation of harsh conditions into fertile opportunities through innovation and climate-resilient practices. The farm's flagship variety was selected for its drought and salinity tolerance, with advanced technology and AI-driven irrigation optimizing growth. Organically cultivated and quality-certified, this high-protein wheat has been used to launch a product line, indicating plans for commercial expansion and positioning Sharjah as a potential premium wheat supplier in international markets.
records.institution: The Mleiha Wheat Farm

records.title: The United Arab Emirates continued its global engagement for the 2026 United Nations Water Conference, which it is co-hosting with Senega...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates continued its global engagement for the 2026 United Nations Water Conference, which it is co-hosting with Senegal, by participating in the 41st UN-Water Meeting in Rome and the 12th Roundtable on Financing Water in Jeddah, co-organized by the OECD and the Islamic Development Bank. These forums gathered stakeholders to discuss leveraging finance, including Islamic finance, for sustainable water investments, aiming to inform the agendas of upcoming water conferences, given the significant investment needed to achieve Sustainable Development Goal 6. High-level officials from various nations underscored the global commitment to water finance. Representing the UAE, a senior official emphasized the importance of the 2026 conference in accelerating progress and unlocking new capital, particularly from the private sector, alongside aligning policy and innovation. The UAE also highlighted its water innovation initiatives. Its participation in the UN-Water Meeting strengthened coordination with partners, including Senegal and UN DESA, discussing preparations for the 2026 conference and encouraging input on dialogue themes that will inform a background note for a preparatory meeting. records.title: The Municipal Council approved amendments to building regulations for agricultural and livestock areas, defining these areas as state pro...
records.description: The Municipal Council approved amendments to building regulations for agricultural and livestock areas, defining these areas as state property for production by the Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR), the Public Authority for Sports (PAS), and the Public Authority for Manpower (PAM). These areas will be used for diverse agricultural and livestock activities, including cultivation, raising animals, beekeeping, and the breeding/training of racehorses and camels by relevant clubs, specifically including plots in Abdali and Wafra. The amendments allow a building ratio of up to 10 percent of the plot area, with a 10,000 square meter maximum, in agricultural zones within Wafra, Abdali, and Sulaibiya. Furthermore, the council approved allocating a reservoir and pathway, adding a transformer, canceling previous reservoirs in South Sabahiya, and allocating overhead lines for the main transformer station in Wafra.

records.title: Acting in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and...
records.description: Acting in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has conducted field trials to assess the effectiveness of drones in combating desert locusts. This initiative is part of the Ministry's efforts to advance modern aerial spraying techniques for controlling locusts and other agricultural pests. The trials aim to evaluate aerial spraying methods, including the use of drones, for potential standardization in member states of Desert Locust Control Commissions. The event involved the participation of FAO experts and representatives from local and international companies specializing in the development of drone-based aerial spraying technologies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Jazan Region is a significant agricultural hub in the Kingdom due to its fertile land and consistent water supply, enabling sustainable f...
records.description: Jazan Region is a significant agricultural hub in the Kingdom due to its fertile land and consistent water supply, enabling sustainable farming that enhances food security and the local economy. The region's high productivity in tropical fruit cultivation, yielding approximately 53,211 tons annually, offers further development opportunities, boosted by Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture initiatives modernizing farming and introducing new varieties. This has solidified Jazan's leading role in tropical fruit production, supported by state aid to farmers. With increasing agricultural awareness, over 19,110 farmers cultivate various fruits, including mangoes, figs, guavas, papayas, bananas, and custard apples. Jazan annually celebrates its tropical fruit harvest with a festival that promotes its agricultural products nationally and internationally, reinforcing its status as a key agricultural producer contributing to national food security and economic strength, aligning with the Kingdom's agricultural vision.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has reaffirmed its ban on frozen chicken imports to protect local production and support poultry farmers, aligning with national self-sufficiency goals and import cost reduction strategies. This ban aims to safeguard local production, stabilize the market, and offer healthy alternatives for consumers, with the ministry commending efforts to purchase and stock local chicken as direct support for small farmers and market stability. Highlighting the poultry sector's importance to the national economy and food security, the ministry noted the private sector's positive response to local produce and affirmed its commitment to facilitating local production and investment in the poultry sector to meet domestic demand and enhance national product quality.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Municipal Council of Al Buraimi Governorate discussed developmental and service topics, emphasizing investing in natural resources fo...
records.description: The Municipal Council of Al Buraimi Governorate discussed developmental and service topics, emphasizing investing in natural resources for ecotourism and updates on key infrastructure projects. records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has partnered strategically with British consultancy Kew REACH to implement the initial phase of a previously announced agreement. This collaboration aims to accelerate the National Greening Program through impactful partnerships that facilitate knowledge transfer and reinforce the Kingdom’s environmental sustainability agenda, initially announced at COP 16. Kew REACH will assist the NCVC in establishing baseline data, conducting assessments, and framing planning for the National Greening Program and the Saudi Green Initiative, providing expertise in ecosystem restoration, seed conservation, sustainable land management, and offering advisory services and training. The partnership also includes a knowledge exchange program at the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, in London. The NCVC Chief Executive highlighted that the collaboration will leverage Kew’s botanical expertise for land restoration and environmental sustainability, aligning with national green initiatives. Kew REACH, a joint-venture consultancy, delivers scientific and advisory services for ecosystem restoration based on rigorous data.

AgriNext bridges traditional farming with modern tech, empowering stakeholders and offering opportunities for investors and startups.

records.title: UNS Farms is revolutionizing UAE food production through innovation and sustainability as a leading Dubai urban vertical farm producing p...
records.description: UNS Farms is revolutionizing UAE food production through innovation and sustainability as a leading Dubai urban vertical farm producing pesticide-free vegetables daily with significantly less water and higher yields than traditional methods. Beyond its operations, UNS Farms consults on modernizing food systems, offering design and development services to make sustainable farming more accessible. Addressing global population growth and climate challenges, UNS Farms provides year-round local produce, reducing import dependence and aligning with Dubai’s Food Security Strategy.
records.institution: UNS Farms

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is celebrating World Veterinary Day, highlighting the theme of teamwork in a...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is celebrating World Veterinary Day, highlighting the theme of teamwork in animal health, which involves collaboration across various disciplines to deliver high-quality veterinary services. ADAFSA's observance reflects its support for its veterinary staff and its continuous annual Animal Disease Awareness and Vaccination Campaign, which aims to vaccinate a large number of livestock against major diseases through field teams working closely with livestock breeders. Alongside this, ADAFSA has launched intensive awareness campaigns to promote biosecurity and disease prevention among livestock owners, emphasizing key practices such as isolation of animals, reporting illnesses, maintaining hygiene, and sourcing from reliable suppliers, while also providing guidance on preventing zoonotic diseases. ADAFSA underscores that its biosecurity protocols, vaccination efforts, and awareness initiatives are vital for controlling animal diseases. A representative from ADAFSA emphasized that their approach relies on strong cooperation between veterinary teams, livestock breeders, and the wider community to ensure animal health, food safety, and public wellbeing.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Discussions were held in Sana'a concerning the imminent launch of a Specialized Court and Prosecution Office dedicated to Agricultural Ca...
records.description: Discussions were held in Sana'a concerning the imminent launch of a Specialized Court and Prosecution Office dedicated to Agricultural Cases. The meeting, involving the Minister of Justice and Human Rights and the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, focused on finalizing the necessary logistical and personnel arrangements, including the training of specialized staff to ensure the court's effective operation. This initiative aims to strengthen legal protections for the agricultural sector and address offenses that impact food and water security. The court is anticipated to handle cases involving environmental violations, illegal well drilling, water encroachment, banned pesticides, and seed smuggling, reflecting the government's dedication to protecting natural resources and supporting sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Justice and Human Rights

records.title: The Undersecretary of Agriculture and Animal Wealth Affairs at the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture highlighted the cri...
records.description: The Undersecretary of Agriculture and Animal Wealth Affairs at the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture highlighted the critical role of veterinary medicine in protecting public health as the first line of defense against zoonotic diseases. Marking World Veterinary Day, observed annually on the last Saturday of April, the Undersecretary emphasized the importance of disease surveillance, vaccination programs, and ensuring the safety of animal products to strengthen national health security. The Undersecretary commended the contributions of veterinary professionals both domestically and internationally to animal health, food safety, and the prevention of diseases shared between humans and animals. The Ministry's continuous efforts to enhance the national veterinary system by developing local skills, providing a supportive work environment, and maintaining high international standards to promote biosecurity, food security, and environmental balance were underscored.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Aseer branch is continuing its Environment Week 2025 activities with a community ini...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Aseer branch is continuing its Environment Week 2025 activities with a community initiative that involved 35 volunteers planting approximately 250 seedlings of various flowers and aromatic trees. This initiative aimed to empower community members in environmental preservation, especially regarding water and food consumption, and to encourage collaborative efforts and knowledge sharing for the region's sustainable growth and prosperity, ultimately ensuring societal well-being and a better future. Through numerous programs and activities, the ministry's Aseer branch is working to raise environmental awareness across all societal groups and sectors, share knowledge about key environmental issues in the Kingdom, encourage environmental commitment, and foster a sense of responsibility to address harmful environmental behaviors and promote positive ones.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: A meeting in Sana'a, led by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, addressed methods for enhancing the performance...
records.description: A meeting in Sana'a, led by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, addressed methods for enhancing the performance of the General Authority for Water Resources and Facilities. The Minister emphasized the urgent need for a specialized working group to establish guidelines for water resource development and management to improve efficiency and achieve sustainability goals. The completion of the Authority's automation project as part of the Ministry's digital transformation, including network connectivity and modern electronic systems, was also highlighted. The Minister urged the Authority to support community initiatives for rainwater harvesting and develop digital solutions for groundwater recharge and depletion reduction. Activating the Water Resources Unit for agricultural associations and appointing coordinators to improve performance were also emphasized. The Chairman of the General Authority for Water Resources and Facilities reviewed efforts to develop scientific foundations for water resource development and update public policies, noting a planned memorandum of understanding with the Geological Survey and Mineral Resources Authority and the Oil Exploration and Production Authority for integrated efforts in protecting groundwater and developing water basins.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The sole operator of Oman’s national gas transportation network anticipates developing 300–400 km of hydrogen pipelines by 2030 to suppor...
records.description: The sole operator of Oman’s national gas transportation network anticipates developing 300–400 km of hydrogen pipelines by 2030 to support the country’s green hydrogen industry, with funding approval expected. As the National Infrastructure Provider, the company will use a phased approach, starting with regional pipelines expandable to a national network, forming part of a common use infrastructure for various utilities intended for the consortiums developing green hydrogen projects in specific governorates. The operator will leverage its experience from the extensive national gas network and is collaborating with the entity overseeing Oman’s green hydrogen strategy on the technical aspects of the proposed hydrogen pipeline system. Last year, a MoU was signed with a green hydrogen project consortium in Salalah, and a strategy study on hydrogen infrastructure development was conducted. In parallel, the operator is planning a carbon dioxide (CO₂) transportation network to link emission sources with storage and utilization, including CCS and feedstock use in various industries.
records.institution: OQ Gas Networks (OQGN)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: In Doha, Qatar, local vegetable markets and Mahaseel achieved significant success in 2024, selling over 37,000 tonnes of domestically gro...
records.description: In Doha, Qatar, local vegetable markets and Mahaseel achieved significant success in 2024, selling over 37,000 tonnes of domestically grown vegetables, a testament to the Ministry of Municipality's effective marketing strategies aimed at increasing farmers' output. The vegetable markets, involving 150 local farms, sold over 13,000 tonnes in the recent agricultural season, a substantial rise since their inception. Mahaseel for Marketing and Agriculture Services Company also played a key role, receiving 24,000 tonnes of vegetables from 199 local farms, supporting them through various contracting programs under the Ministry's guidance. The Ministry's Agricultural Affairs Department offers multiple marketing avenues for local produce, including vegetable markets and partnerships with major commercial outlets and Mahaseel. Furthermore, the 'Dates Supply Programme' saw a considerable amount of dates supplied, indicating the Ministry's ongoing support for local date production to enhance food security and agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.title: Qatar's Minister of Environment and Climate Change emphasized that biodiversity and wildlife conservation are key priorities within the n...
records.description: Qatar's Minister of Environment and Climate Change emphasized that biodiversity and wildlife conservation are key priorities within the nation's environmental policy, integral to its sustainable development goals under the National Vision 2030. Speaking at the opening of the International Council for Game and Wildlife Conservation's General Assembly in Doha, the Minister underscored Qatar's dedication to global efforts in protecting wildlife and preserving ecosystems, noting the urgent need for increased international cooperation to address biodiversity loss and ensure the planet's future. The Minister highlighted the Ministry's initiatives to enhance wildlife protection, expand nature reserves, and enact strong legislation for endangered species as part of the National Environment and Climate Change Strategy. Hosting the Assembly in Doha provides a valuable platform for sharing knowledge and best practices in environmental conservation, with global recognition of biodiversity's central role in climate action. Qatar is also actively collaborating with international partners on wildlife conservation projects, urging participants to develop practical recommendations for advancing these efforts and integrating environmental and developmental policies, reaffirming its commitment to environmental protection and the importance of investing in biodiversity for the future.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A recently released Sustainability Report from DP World highlights a significant achievement, with the company sourcing 65% of its electr...
records.description: A recently released Sustainability Report from DP World highlights a significant achievement, with the company sourcing 65% of its electricity from renewables, marking considerable progress in its sustainability journey. The report outlines a substantial investment of $1.17 billion in green and low-carbon infrastructure projects, alongside innovative efforts in sustainable finance, environmental management, and inclusive growth. The company's inaugural Green Sukuk Impact and Allocation Report detailed the allocation of $1.17 billion from a prior bond towards green initiatives such as low-carbon infrastructure and renewable energy systems. DP World also issued a $100 million Blue Bond, a first for a corporate in its region, to fund sustainable projects in marine transportation, port infrastructure, and environmental conservation, establishing a new benchmark for sustainable finance in emerging markets.
records.institution: DP World

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman will host the fourth Green Hydrogen Summit (GHSO) under the Ministry of Energy and Minerals, in strategic partnership with Hydrogen...
records.description: Oman will host the fourth Green Hydrogen Summit (GHSO) under the Ministry of Energy and Minerals, in strategic partnership with Hydrogen Oman (Hydrom) and hosted by Birba Energy Services. The summit aims to attract thousands of international delegates, including officials, investors, and experts, and is considered a milestone in Oman's journey towards a green hydrogen economy and carbon neutrality goals, leveraging its strategic advantages. The Ministry views the conference as crucial for establishing a green hydrogen culture and measuring market readiness. The summit will facilitate investment, innovation, and partnerships to support Oman's hydrogen masterplan for energy security, economic diversification, emission reduction, and local capacity development, building on awarded projects in Duqm and Dhofar. Hydrom Oman highlighted the summit's significance as a key event for global stakeholders to exchange knowledge and promote innovation across the green hydrogen value chain, emphasizing Oman's commitment to annually host the summit to engage with international partners and showcase opportunities in its green hydrogen sector, featuring technology exhibitions, policy discussions, and business forums to collectively shape the future of green hydrogen.
records.institution: Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.title: Qatar's Cabinet convened its regular meeting, commending the Amir's visit to Russia for enhanced economic ties and partnership, and ackno...
records.description: Qatar's Cabinet convened its regular meeting, commending the Amir's visit to Russia for enhanced economic ties and partnership, and acknowledging his discussions with Lebanon's President, underscoring strong bilateral relations and regional stability. Subsequently, the Cabinet reviewed its agenda, noting the Shura Council's approval of a meteorological services law and endorsing decrees for the Ras Abu Fontas power and water project by the Qatar General Electricity and Water Corporation, in line with national development goals. A draft decision by the Minister of Commerce and Industry on a national technical regulation to improve trade and food quality was also approved. Furthermore, cooperation agreements in agriculture with Algeria, maritime affairs with Cyprus, and sports and youth with Hungary were endorsed. The meeting concluded with a review of the annual report on the Anti-Concealment Committee's activities, resulting in appropriate resolutions.
records.institution: The Cabinet, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry

records.title: The Ministry has reaffirmed its commitment to supporting Oman’s agricultural sector and ensuring the stability of its food supply system,...
records.description: The Ministry has reaffirmed its commitment to supporting Oman’s agricultural sector and ensuring the stability of its food supply system, acknowledging the current oversupply of locally grown onions and the concerns of farmers seeking fair market opportunities and sustainable returns. The Ministry assured that it is coordinating with relevant partners to develop practical and long-term solutions to address the marketing gap, emphasizing its understanding of Omani farmers' dedication to product quality and national food security. Measures under consideration include better organization of production cycles, more effective marketing mechanisms, and support strategies to stabilize the local market during supply fluctuations. The Ministry also encouraged farmers and agricultural investors to register with the Omani Farmers Association for guidance and support programs that align with national agricultural policies and frameworks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre (OCEC) in Muscat, in collaboration with TotalEnergies Renewables Distributed Generation Middle...
records.description: The Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre (OCEC) in Muscat, in collaboration with TotalEnergies Renewables Distributed Generation Middle East & Africa and with the support of OMRAN Group, has commissioned its solar rooftop project, now fully operational. The installation includes 8,300 solar PV modules across 16,600 square metres, designed to reduce the venue’s carbon footprint by approximately 3,300 tonnes of CO2 annually and generate around 25% of OCEC’s total energy needs. The PV modules also offer benefits like lowering indoor temperatures and protecting the roof. This initiative aligns with Oman’s national Net Zero 2050 ambitions and complements OCEC’s other sustainability efforts. The CEO of OCEC emphasized the project as a major step towards becoming a more sustainable venue, meeting the demand for green destinations through strong partnerships. The Managing Director of TotalEnergies Renewables highlighted their contribution to a sustainable future in Oman. The system is already providing green power to events hosted at the Centre.
records.institution: Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre (OCEC)

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar, in collaboration with the Agricultural Affairs Department, has launched 17 new agricultural servic...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar, in collaboration with the Agricultural Affairs Department, has launched 17 new agricultural services on its ‘Oun’ app as part of its digital transformation project. This initiative aims to enhance service efficiency and simplify procedures for permits related to importing fertilizers, soil enhancers, honeybees, trees, wood, produce, fodder, seeds, pesticides, and flowers, as well as requests for various certificates and approvals. This expansion of digital services, now totaling hundreds on the Ministry’s platform, seeks to provide smart and automated services to the public and streamline processes through technological upgrades and data sharing with other government bodies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 588 food baskets in Yemen’s Aden Governorate, benefiting 4,116...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 588 food baskets in Yemen’s Aden Governorate, benefiting 4,116 people. This distribution is part of the 2025 Food Aid Distribution Project in the Republic of Yemen. This assistance is part of the relief and humanitarian efforts provided by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through KSrelief to ease the difficulties faced by the Yemeni people due to the continuing humanitarian crisis.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)
