records.title: Cleantech company Sparklo has partnered with UAE bottled water company Mai Dubai to encourage recycling by installing 30 AI-powered Rever...
records.description: Cleantech company Sparklo has partnered with UAE bottled water company Mai Dubai to encourage recycling by installing 30 AI-powered Reverse Vending Machines (Sparklomats) in high-traffic areas across the UAE. Users will earn points for recycling containers, redeemable for rewards like discounts on Mai Dubai deliveries. This initiative aims to make recycling more rewarding and create a closed-loop system for Mai Dubai products. Both companies' CEOs highlighted their commitment to sustainability and empowering consumers to participate in a circular economy for a more sustainable future in the UAE.
records.institution: Sparklo

records.title: Hodeida officials from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit conducted a field visit to assess the progr...
records.description: Hodeida officials from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit conducted a field visit to assess the progress and impact of several funded agricultural and fisheries projects. Inspections included the rehabilitation of the central slaughterhouse in Hodeida city, ongoing work at a shrimp factory aimed at increasing the value of marine resources and supporting employment, and infrastructure development at the fishing port to improve traditional fishing activities and fish preservation. The Unit Director emphasized the importance of continuous field monitoring to ensure quality implementation and achieve the desired development impact in crucial sectors like agriculture, fisheries, and livestock, noting that these visits help improve performance and facilitate support decisions for the Project Financing Unit's development goals within the governorate.
records.institution: Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit

records.title: The Amran Water Basin Committee reviewed applications for drilling new wells and deepening existing ones in Amran and Jabal Ayal Yazid di...
records.description: The Amran Water Basin Committee reviewed applications for drilling new wells and deepening existing ones in Amran and Jabal Ayal Yazid districts. The meeting, attended by committee members including directors from the Water Resources and Facilities Authority, Rural Water Projects, the Agriculture Sector, and the Local Water and Sanitation Corporation, examined the technical and legal aspects of the submitted applications for well-drilling permits, covering objections, legal compliance, and key technical observations. Attendees, including the directors of Amran and Khamr districts, approved one application and rejected the rest due to non-compliance with legal and technical requirements. The Governor emphasized the importance of protecting the basin's water sources and implementing measures to preserve groundwater, preventing depletion caused by unregulated drilling, stressing the need to continue prohibiting random drilling in the basin area, coordinating with relevant authorities to safeguard the basin, prioritizing drinking water and agricultural needs, and restricting new well permits.
records.institution: Water Resources and Facilities Authority

records.title: A pioneering sustainable hydroponics project implemented by Al-Bir Charity Association in Al-Laith Governorate has achieved self-sufficie...
records.description: A pioneering sustainable hydroponics project implemented by Al-Bir Charity Association in Al-Laith Governorate has achieved self-sufficiency in rural areas. Located on a large area, it utilizes modern agricultural technology systems. The project has a notable ecological impact by producing high-quality organic products, conserving water, and enhancing national food security through pesticide-free manufacturing. It also generates a significant investment return and creates jobs for young people in the governorate. The project serves as an inspiring model for innovation in agricultural investments and social entrepreneurship for non-profits and charitable organizations.
records.institution: Al-Bir Charity Association

records.title: BRF, a Brazilian food company, will invest up to US$160 million in a new meat processing plant in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, through a joint v...
records.description: BRF, a Brazilian food company, will invest up to US$160 million in a new meat processing plant in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, through a joint venture with Saudi Arabia’s Halal Products Development Company (HPDC), owned by the Saudi Public Investment Fund (PIF). The plant is expected to start operations by mid-2026, producing around 40,000 tonnes of halal beef and poultry annually, mainly for the Saudi market with potential regional expansion. Designed for future growth, the facility could double its capacity and will create over 500 jobs. This will be BRF’s third plant in Saudi Arabia and seventh in the Middle East, initially using Brazilian raw materials. The investment will occur over two years. This initiative supports BRF’s international growth and Saudi Arabia’s aim to build a local halal manufacturing base, reduce import dependence, and meet rising demand for locally produced, high-quality processed meat, strengthening its position in the global halal market.
records.institution: Halal Products Development Company (HPDC)

records.title: KROHNE Middle East participated in Saudi Food Manufacturing 2025, highlighting the vital role of precision measurement in transforming th...
records.description: KROHNE Middle East participated in Saudi Food Manufacturing 2025, highlighting the vital role of precision measurement in transforming the food and beverage sector and supporting Saudi Vision 2030. A futurist predicted Saudi Arabia will become a central food hub along the Silk Road due to its significant investment and growth in the sector. KROHNE's General Manager emphasized that their technology provides crucial data for safer, more sustainable, and efficient food systems, showcasing applications like energy reduction in sugar production and fewer batch failures in fermentation. KROHNE's Global Food Industry Expert noted that successful digital transformation requires both technology and user trust in data. The summit emphasized aligning people, process, and purpose for regional food security. KROHNE is supporting this transformation with measurement solutions for food producers across the GCC and the Silk Road.
records.institution: KROHNE Middle East

records.title: Saudi Arabia and South Korea have jointly initiated a smart agriculture complex project in Riyadh.
records.description: Saudi Arabia and South Korea have jointly initiated a smart agriculture complex project in Riyadh. The initiative aims to enhance agricultural production, improve resource efficiency, and strengthen cooperation in smart farming. Representatives from both nations stated that the project represents a new turning point in modern agriculture, a result of integrated and collaborative efforts to foster innovation in the agricultural sector, contributing to food security and sustainable development in the Middle East. The joint project reflects technological advancements in agriculture, combining AI, IoT, and vertical farming to address contemporary agricultural challenges, increase productivity, and improve crop quality. Located at the National Agricultural and Animal Resources Research Center, the 4,000 square meter project includes a vertical farm for leafy greens, strawberries, and mushrooms using advanced container farming, and a greenhouse equipped with modern agricultural technologies to reduce water and fertilizer use while increasing production. The project utilizes AI systems to regulate water, collect and analyze data for crop recommendations in vertical farming, and features a mobile farming system that significantly increases production compared to traditional greenhouses.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture:

records.title: The Saudi Investment Recycling Company (SIRC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), participated in Environment Week 2025, o...
records.description: The Saudi Investment Recycling Company (SIRC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), participated in Environment Week 2025, organized under the patronage of the Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The event saw broad engagement from private, government, and non-profit sectors. SIRC's participation underscored its ongoing commitment to advancing a green economy and the transition to a circular economy, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 objectives. SIRC and its subsidiaries emphasized their dedication to the Saudi Green Initiative's goals, including diverting waste from landfills and achieving net-zero emissions through advanced recycling technologies for a sustainable environmental future. The SIRC group manages a comprehensive network of leading companies in recycling and treating various types of waste and producing soil improvers, making it a key supporter of the Kingdom's sustainable development goals.
records.institution: The Saudi Investment Recycling Company (SIRC)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) inaugurated a 6.3-megawatt solar power plant in the Comoros, funded at AED25.7 million (US$7 mi...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) inaugurated a 6.3-megawatt solar power plant in the Comoros, funded at AED25.7 million (US$7 million). The project aims to improve the Comoros' energy infrastructure, support economic growth, and promote environmental sustainability, aligning with global development goals. The solar plant will provide a reliable, renewable energy source for Moroni and surrounding areas, reducing reliance on fossil fuels and carbon emissions, thus enhancing the quality of life. Leaders from both the Comoros and the UAE attended the inauguration, praising the partnership and its impact on clean energy transition and economic stability. The project, integrating with the national grid, highlights ADFD’s long-term support for the Comoros’ development in critical sectors.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD)

records.title: The Minister of Municipalities and Agriculture Affairs inspected the progress of the development project for two parks in the Sitra housi...
records.description: The Minister of Municipalities and Agriculture Affairs inspected the progress of the development project for two parks in the Sitra housing project, where the completion rate has reached 40%. The inspection was attended by the Chairman of the Capital Municipal Council, the Capital Municipality Director-General, and the Assistant Undersecretary for Housing Services Affairs. The Minister emphasized the commitment to advancing service projects that support the country’s development and highlighted the Ministry’s efforts to enhance parks and public facilities, expand green spaces, and improve park infrastructure to meet community needs. The first park in Sitra’s housing city, spanning 2,104 square metres, will feature two padel courts, over 50 trees, and 680 square metres of ground cover. The second regional park, covering 2,176 square metres, will include a multi-activity playground, approximately 50 trees, 680 square metres of ground cover, 26 parking spaces, and four seating areas. The Minister underscored the importance of collaboration with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning to ensure integrated services within housing projects, optimize spaces, bring municipal services closer to residents, and enhance the urban landscape and environmental quality of these areas.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities and Agriculture Affairs

records.title: The 7th Oman International Food Safety and Quality Conference, held at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Center, gathered 500 specialist...
records.description: The 7th Oman International Food Safety and Quality Conference, held at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Center, gathered 500 specialists from 32 countries presenting 26 papers. Under the patronage of a Secretary-General from the Council of Ministers, the event featured opening remarks from the Director General of the Food Safety and Quality Center at the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, who emphasized the ministry's collaboration with government and private sectors to build a sustainable food safety system and the conference's role as a strategic platform for regional food safety solutions. The President of IUFoST and CEO of the Global Food Legislation Organisation highlighted the conference as a global forum to address agricultural and livestock challenges and explore technological solutions. Key themes include modernizing food safety, quality control, food fraud verification, analytical methods, risk assessment, and green food supply chains. Organized by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources with government and private sector collaboration, the three-day event was attended by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and other officials.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah) branch in Jazan Region is a key agricultural center...
records.description: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah) branch in Jazan Region is a key agricultural center in the Kingdom, providing significant services through agricultural research. It aims to advance regional agricultural development scientifically, especially in tropical fruits and field crops, leading to improved crop composition and farmer income. Utilizing the region's climate and water resources, Estidamah has successfully cultivated tropical and subtropical fruits, aligning with national agricultural goals. The Jazan branch manages a large agricultural field with over 65 crop varieties and studies others. It also focuses on plant disease control to produce healthy seedlings and develop biological resistance.
records.institution: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah)

records.title: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program participated in the fourth edition of the Middle East Poultry Expo at the Riyadh...
records.description: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program participated in the fourth edition of the Middle East Poultry Expo at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center. The participation aimed to showcase key initiatives, achievements, and projects designed to advance Saudi Arabia's poultry sector. It also sought to promote local product marketing in global markets and highlight promising investment opportunities and incentives for investors in the poultry industry. Saudi Arabia's poultry sector is a major and rapidly growing sector in the region, driven by increasing government support led by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, which provides loans and facilities to poultry projects. There is also a coordinated effort to boost investment in this sector, in collaboration with the private sector, to achieve the food security goals of the Kingdom's Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Bids were opened for the supply, installation, and operation of a solar energy system at the Information Systems Center of the Ministry o...
records.description: Bids were opened for the supply, installation, and operation of a solar energy system at the Information Systems Center of the Ministry of Agriculture. The Tender Committee of the Agricultural and Fisheries Production Promotion Fund oversaw the bid opening, with representatives from bidding companies in attendance. The committee decided to refer the submitted bids to the technical evaluation committee for review and assessment based on the tender documents' conditions and standards. The committee emphasized adherence to the specified conditions and technical specifications and agreed to forward the results to the awarding committee to proceed with the procurement process in accordance with the law. This project is part of the fund's efforts to support sustainability and clean energy initiatives in the agricultural sector, aiming to promote the transition to renewable energy and enhance institutional performance efficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched the second phase of producing and marketing 2,500 tons of locall...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched the second phase of producing and marketing 2,500 tons of locally frozen broiler chicken as an alternative to imported frozen chicken. During the launch, a representative from the Agricultural Marketing and Trade sector stated that this initiative aligns with the ministry’s strategy to reduce import costs, encourage local production, and support small poultry farmers in returning to production. This will be achieved by regulating sales based on weight and fostering competition to supply chicken with high standards and reasonable prices that satisfy both producers and consumers. A representative from the Poultry Unit emphasized the importance of contract farming in producing and marketing frozen broiler chicken to replace imports. He explained that the initiative operates under an organized mechanism involving multi-purpose cooperative associations comprising poultry breeders, producers, importers, production companies, and slaughterhouses. He highlighted that the initiative will be implemented in phases to eventually replace imported chicken with local products.
records.institution: The The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Agricultural and Marine Sciences Group at the College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences at Sultan Qaboos University (SQU) hosted th...
records.description: The Agricultural and Marine Sciences Group at the College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences at Sultan Qaboos University (SQU) hosted the 13th Agricultural Science Festival in the university's Grand Hall. The festival, themed "Reach: From Roots to Horizons," emphasized sustainability, innovation, and community engagement, serving as a key platform for students to raise awareness about the agricultural and marine sectors' importance in achieving national goals. Activities included scientific exhibitions, workshops, and interactive stations presenting agricultural and environmental information engagingly. The festival focused on food security, agricultural sustainability, modern technologies, and biodiversity, addressing environmental and economic challenges with innovative solutions aligned with national sustainable development. Over 120 students and researchers showcased their work and competed in a research competition promoting student talent in areas like food security and smart agriculture. Open to the public, the festival aimed to simplify scientific concepts and present agriculture as a vital science for a sustainable future. An entrepreneur in agricultural tourism highlighted the festival's value for showcasing ideas and fostering collaborations, noting its educational importance for students to engage with agriculture, environment, and sustainability.
records.institution: Agricultural and Marine Sciences Group

records.title: Strawberry cultivation is thriving in Najran, demonstrating the region's capacity to utilize local resources and advanced technologies fo...
records.description: Strawberry cultivation is thriving in Najran, demonstrating the region's capacity to utilize local resources and advanced technologies for sustainable agriculture, reinforcing its position as a key agricultural region in Saudi Arabia. The Executive Director of the Cooperative Agricultural Association West of Najran stated that Najran is a highly promising region for diversifying agricultural activities, with strawberry cultivation achieving significant success due to the region's favorable climate and fertile soil, ideal for producing high-quality strawberries. Through the adoption of greenhouses and suspended farming techniques, local farmers have successfully met local market demands and contributed to food security, with daily production reaching nearly 500 packages in the last season. The Executive Director also highlighted that Najran-grown strawberries are known for their large size and distinctive flavor, making them a preferred choice for consumers regionally and beyond.
records.institution: The Cooperative Agricultural Association West of Najran

records.title: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the "Green Leader Initiative" in Riyadh.
records.description: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the "Green Leader Initiative" in Riyadh. The launching ceremony was attended by the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Cabinet Member, and UN Climate Envoy. The initiative, under the slogan "Their path is green," is organized by the Environment Fund as part of the "Environment Week" activities. Through this initiative, the Environment Fund seeks to strengthen community partnerships with various sectors to protect the environment and direct efforts toward achieving the goals of the Kingdom's Vision 2030 in the field of environmental sustainability. The initiative aims to spread the culture of environmental sustainability among students of all ages through interactive and innovative educational programs that span schools across the Kingdom. These programs focus on enhancing environmental awareness, encouraging action to address environmental challenges, promoting innovation for climate change, and stimulating a green transformation in society. The launch of this initiative comes within the framework of "Environment Week," an annual national environmental event aimed at spreading environmental awareness in the community, achieving environmental sustainability, preserving natural resources, and reducing all forms of pollution.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture stressed that the National Environmental Performance Index (EPI) is a strategic tool t...
records.description: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture stressed that the National Environmental Performance Index (EPI) is a strategic tool to monitor environmental conditions and inform decisions that ensure long-term sustainability in Saudi Arabia. His statement followed the launch of the EPI, designed to measure and track progress across various environmental areas. The launch coincided with the commencement of Environment Week. He emphasized that the index reflects the environment sector's commitment to providing practical tools for measuring progress, assessing environmental challenges, and enhancing environmental policies, aligning with the Kingdom's Vision 2030. The ministry stated that this national tool, a collaboration with the UN Environment Programme and national environmental bodies, assesses the Kingdom's environmental status and influencing factors, providing an early warning system for both positive and negative developments.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Muscat Governorate met with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to review a flood risk mapping consultancy project.
records.description: Muscat Governorate met with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to review a flood risk mapping consultancy project. The project aims to map flood risks, develop management and emergency plans, and create a flood risk evaluation guide. The process involves analyzing rainfall data, designing flood maps, and developing risk management plans to protect vulnerable regions. Strategies include protective measures, evacuation points, and recommendations for relevant authorities, compiled in a guidebook. Initiated earlier, the project is underway in Muscat, Dhofar, and Musandam Governorates.
records.institution: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The farms of Tabuk Region saw the blooming of over 90,000 citrus trees spread across more than 8,000 dunums, encompassing a variety of or...
records.description: The farms of Tabuk Region saw the blooming of over 90,000 citrus trees spread across more than 8,000 dunums, encompassing a variety of oranges, lemons, tangerines, kumquats, and other renowned regional citrus fruits. Tabuk Region stands out as one of the Kingdom's leading agricultural areas, thanks to its advanced infrastructure and comprehensive government support. It is home to over 14,500 farms covering more than 270,000 hectares, promoting crop diversity and the development of innovative agricultural practices. These efforts play an essential role in achieving both environmental and economic sustainability while meeting the needs of the local market. A representative of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Tabuk highlighted the region's substantial agricultural assets that have contributed to the sector's growth and development, noting that citrus cultivation has emerged as one of the leading agricultural initiatives in Tabuk. The representative emphasized that the ministry supports farmers through agricultural financing programs, providing modern equipment and training on best agricultural practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Established as a division of Speedex Group, UNS Farms is a leading urban vertical farm in Dubai, producing significant amounts of pestici...
records.description: Established as a division of Speedex Group, UNS Farms is a leading urban vertical farm in Dubai, producing significant amounts of pesticide-free vegetables daily using an advanced multi-level system for year-round supply. The farm utilizes hydroponics, drastically reducing water use and increasing yield while eliminating pesticides and lowering emissions, establishing it as a leader in sustainable food production. Beyond its own operations, UNS Farms consults on modernizing food systems, making sustainable farming more accessible. Addressing global challenges, it offers a diverse range of high-quality, locally grown produce, reducing the UAE’s import dependence and aligning with Dubai’s Food Security Strategy. The Executive Director emphasizes their goal to revolutionize food production by making sustainable, local produce the norm through technology and agricultural expertise, shaping the future of farming in the UAE and beyond.
records.institution: UNS Farms

records.title: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar province organized a workshop focused on correcting, updating, and entering agricultural expansion data...
records.description: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar province organized a workshop focused on correcting, updating, and entering agricultural expansion data according to modern models. The workshop was attended by directors of agriculture branches, agricultural associations, and development workers in the directorates. At the opening of the workshop, a representative of the governorate emphasized its importance in correcting farmers' data and the volume of expansion in plant production. The head of the governorate's agriculture sector pointed out that the workshop aims to review farmer manuals and forms, update and correct their data according to the updated forms, and provide participants with skills and expertise on how to enter farmers' data into the electronic system prepared for this purpose. He emphasized the role of agriculture branches, associations, development workers, and coordinators from a development foundation in providing participants with the skills and expertise needed to successfully expand the cultivation of staple crops, improve natural resource management, and promote the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Province

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) announced the first Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition at ADNEC Centr...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) announced the first Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition at ADNEC Centre Al Ain. This event supports the UAE’s agricultural sector and food security goals under the ‘Plant the Emirates’ National Programme. It will gather officials and global agricultural leaders to discuss sustainable agriculture. The Minister highlighted the UAE's focus on agricultural development for national food security using climate-smart solutions and the event's role in empowering local farmers and promoting dialogue. The conference and exhibition aim to address challenges like water scarcity with smart technologies, foster innovation, and engage the community in building a resilient agricultural sector. It will showcase local produce and facilitate partnerships among various stakeholders, including farmers, universities, and tech companies. Key features include a National Agricultural Extension Forum and sessions on sustainability, food security, and modern agriculture. The event will display agricultural innovations and promote sustainable practices. Specialized zones will feature farmers, youth, technology, schools, corporations, startups, government entities, and food and beverage.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI) highlighted the importance of improving cargo transport with Kazakhstan, especially in...
records.description: The Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI) highlighted the importance of improving cargo transport with Kazakhstan, especially in livestock, to enhance food security, following a meeting with Kazakhstan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister and the Kazakh Ambassador. The KCCI lauded Kazakhstan's economic growth and natural resources, expressing a desire to strengthen cooperation through renewed agreements and business meetings. The Kazakh Minister emphasized his country's commercial potential due to its strategic location linking the GCC, Russia, and China, its investor-friendly environment with incentives, and its efforts to improve the business climate through digitalization, inviting Kuwaiti businesses to invest in various sectors, particularly given the visa exemption for Kuwaiti citizens.
records.institution: The Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI)

records.title: During an award ceremony, the “International Consortium for Red Palm Weevil Control” was launched.
records.description: During an award ceremony, the “International Consortium for Red Palm Weevil Control” was launched. This initiative is a partnership between the International Affairs Office (IAO) at the Presidential Court, the Gates Foundation, the International Centre for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA), the Award’s General Secretariat, and various national, regional, and international organizations. The Consortium aims to address the growing global challenge of the Red Palm Weevil, building on a commitment to agricultural innovation. Founding institutions, including the IAO, ICARDA, and the Khalifa International Award, were represented at the launch. The Consortium is funded and overseen by the IAO and the Gates Foundation, in collaboration with the Khalifa International Award, ICARDA, United Arab Emirates University, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority, and the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA). The initiative will test and refine technologies in the UAE for controlling the pest and then scale and deploy them in affected low and middle-income countries, focusing on bio-based innovations (led by ICIPE), biotechnological innovations (led by IITA), digital innovations & AI (led by ICRISAT), Good Agricultural Practices (led by ICBA), and policy and global access (led by ICARDA). The UAE, through this Consortium, aims to be a science-driven partner supporting vulnerable agricultural communities globally.
records.institution: Khalifa International Award for Date Palm and Agricultural Innovation

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Tadweer Group has signed an agreement with China’s SFECO Group to explore developing a manufacturing facility in Abu Dhabi that will conv...
records.description: Tadweer Group has signed an agreement with China’s SFECO Group to explore developing a manufacturing facility in Abu Dhabi that will convert industrial solid waste into green building materials. This collaboration supports Tadweer Group’s commitment to unlocking the value of waste and fostering circular economy practices in line with Abu Dhabi’s wider sustainability objectives, with the potential facility utilizing SFECO’s mineralisation and low-carbon cement technologies to transform industrial waste into sustainable construction materials for the local market. The Managing Director and CEO of Tadweer Group commented that this agreement reflects their ongoing strategy to forge international partnerships that bring innovative, scalable waste-to-value solutions to the UAE, supporting their ambition to lead in sustainable industrial waste management and contribute to the nation’s green growth. A joint working committee will be formed to assess the project’s viability and shape future collaboration, with the intention of progressing towards a definitive agreement subject to feasibility outcomes, as this partnership forms part of Tadweer Group’s broader mission to advance integrated waste management through strategic investments and technology transfer, supporting the UAE’s journey towards net zero and a more circular economy.
records.institution: Tadweer Group

records.title: A workshop on the Agricultural Expansion Program was held in Marib province, organized by the local agriculture sector.
records.description: A workshop on the Agricultural Expansion Program was held in Marib province, organized by the local agriculture sector. The workshop aimed to provide agricultural sector officials in the directorates, members of the Executive Unit for Financing Agricultural Projects, Initiatives, and program supporters in the province with skills and expertise to implement the project to expand the cultivation of staple crops. A representative of the Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit in the province highlighted the need to benefit from the outcomes of the workshop and apply them on the ground to achieve the desired goals. The workshop saw interaction from the participants and included technical explanations by the Ministry's agricultural expansion project engineer about the mechanisms for entering data through the electronic application and building a comprehensive database for the province in the agricultural field.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector in Marib Province

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Omani government, through its state-owned energy group OQ, has announced an agreement to construct the world's first commercial-scale...
records.description: The Omani government, through its state-owned energy group OQ, has announced an agreement to construct the world's first commercial-scale liquid hydrogen corridor connecting Oman to the Netherlands and Germany. The government's green hydrogen entity, Hydrom, will manage the upstream production in line with national targets and integrate the project into Oman's hydrogen infrastructure. OQ will be responsible for developing the hydrogen plant and associated storage and export facilities at the Port of Duqm. The corridor will facilitate the export of compliant liquid hydrogen from Duqm to the Port of Amsterdam and key logistics hubs in Germany. ECOLOG, based in the UAE, will handle the shipping using specialized vessels. On the European end, import terminals will be established in the Port of Amsterdam for re-gasification and distribution to industrial users in the Netherlands and Germany via various transportation methods.
records.institution: OQ Company

records.title: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia actively safeguards its environment through national initiatives and policies to preserve natural resources,...
records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia actively safeguards its environment through national initiatives and policies to preserve natural resources, foster sustainability, and increase environmental awareness. This commitment is highlighted by Environment Week, a Kingdom-wide event, which underscores the nation's dedication to conservation and public awareness, aligning with its comprehensive vision for sustainable development. Environment Week is an annual national event through which the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture aims to cultivate community environmental awareness and stimulate broad participation from all segments of society—governmental, private, and non-profit entities—to protect the environment and achieve sustainable development. This year's program includes tree-planting and clean-up campaigns, environmental exhibitions, educational workshops, and volunteer initiatives held across the Kingdom. These events reflect a shared commitment to environmental protection and an enhanced quality of life.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The "International Consortium for Red Palm Weevil Control" has been launched through a partnership between the International Affairs Offi...
records.description: The "International Consortium for Red Palm Weevil Control" has been launched through a partnership between the International Affairs Office (IAO) at the Presidential Court and the Gates Foundation, with collaboration from ICARDA, the Khalifa International Award, and other organizations. This initiative, following a UAE-Gates Foundation commitment to agricultural innovation, aims to unite global efforts against a significant agricultural challenge. Funded and overseen by the IAO and the Gates Foundation, partners include the Khalifa International Award, ICARDA, UAE University, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority, and ICBA. Officials emphasized the Consortium's potential for global impact through science and collaboration. The initiative aims to protect the date palm and develop sustainable solutions for communities.
records.institution: International Affairs Office (IAO)

records.title: A meeting in Sana'a province, chaired by the governor, focused on establishing the implementation mechanism for a project aimed at signif...
records.description: A meeting in Sana'a province, chaired by the governor, focused on establishing the implementation mechanism for a project aimed at significantly expanding tree planting of Sidr seedlings to enhance vegetation cover, increase green spaces, provide a natural food source for bees and honey production, support biodiversity, protect agricultural soil from erosion, combat desertification, and contribute to environmental preservation. The discussed mechanism included seedling distribution, planting, monitoring, evaluation, and target areas, involving the governor's undersecretaries, directors of various provincial units and funds, district directors, and heads of cooperative development sector associations, with a key outcome being further meetings with local officials and association heads for effective implementation and the formation of committees for field visits to engage communities and establish local teams, as the governor emphasized the crucial role of district and sector associations and the resilience of Sidr trees, urging community cooperation for the project's multiple benefits.
records.institution: Sana'a province

records.title: The Bahrain Smart Cities Summit 2025, themed "Building the Future: Smart Cities, Sustainable Growth," was inaugurated by the Deputy Prime...
records.description: The Bahrain Smart Cities Summit 2025, themed "Building the Future: Smart Cities, Sustainable Growth," was inaugurated by the Deputy Prime Minister, focusing on Bahrain's dedication to developing cities with advanced infrastructure and sustainable urban environments. Organized by the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture, the summit brought together public and private sector representatives and experts to discuss future-oriented city development, emphasizing sustainability, innovation, and community participation. The Deputy Prime Minister highlighted the importance of public-private collaboration in achieving these goals. The Minister of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture underscored Bahrain's commitment to integrating technological innovation with human and social dimensions in urban planning, noting the Kingdom's improved ranking on the IMD Smart City Index 2024. The event also included the Bahrain Smart Cities Awards 2025, recognizing outstanding projects in sustainable smart city development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: ANDRITZ, A global technology firm has secured a major contract to build a high-capacity animal feed plant in Riyadh Province, aimed at bo...
records.description: ANDRITZ, A global technology firm has secured a major contract to build a high-capacity animal feed plant in Riyadh Province, aimed at boosting Saudi Arabia’s self-sufficiency in livestock feed production. The facility will produce 90 tons per hour—divided between poultry and ruminant feed—and is part of a broader strategy to improve feed quality and enhance integrated operations. The company will deliver a complete production line, including core machinery and services such as installation, commissioning, and after-sales support, with key components manufactured in Europe. This partnership follows a thorough evaluation process and aligns with national goals under Vision 2030 to strengthen food security. The project highlights the firm’s growing presence in the region and its commitment to sustainable, high-performance feed solutions.
records.institution: Alwadi Poultry Farms Company

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) is prominently featured at the Rose and Aromatic Plants Global Forum,...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) is prominently featured at the Rose and Aromatic Plants Global Forum, showcasing its advancements in the rose and aromatic plant sector, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030's objectives of enhancing food security and rural development. The program's participation underscores its role in empowering farmers and promoting initiatives that have led to a significant increase in rose production, with ambitions to further elevate the Kingdom's standing in the global rose market.
records.institution: Saudi Reef

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is actively supporting the UAE’s sustainable waste management strategy through various i...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is actively supporting the UAE’s sustainable waste management strategy through various initiatives aligned with the Dubai Integrated Waste Management Strategy 2021–2041 and the UAE Circular Economy Policy 2021–2031. DEWA's efforts, guided by its Circular Economy Strategy's five core principles, include implementing advanced waste management systems, investing in waste-to-energy projects like the Dubai Waste Management Centre (DWMC) in Warsan (the world's largest and most efficient), and collaborating with Dubai Municipality on biogas electricity generation from landfill sites. Furthermore, DEWA promotes recycling among its employees through smart collection machines and has digitized all its services, achieving 100% paperless operations. The authority is also developing the Middle East’s first data centre powered by waste-to-energy technology.
records.institution: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries has inaugurated its new organic soil fertiliser production facility in Ras Al Khaimah, marking the reg...
records.description: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries has inaugurated its new organic soil fertiliser production facility in Ras Al Khaimah, marking the region's first dedicated facility for sustainable agricultural products with a US$20 million investment. The opening event, attended by Uterra's founder and RAKEZ Group CEO, showcased the facility's advanced organic production processes, including vertical farming, and its focus on chemical-free, non-GMO fertilisers and innovative cultivation methods. The 33,000 m2 facility aims to produce high-efficiency micro-biological organic fertilisers and enhance the year-round production of fresh produce. Uterra's technology focuses on restoring degraded soil and increasing crop yields while improving the nutritional content and resilience of plants. RAKEZ Group CEO emphasized the facility's role in advancing the UAE’s agricultural ecosystem and sustainability agenda, positioning Ras Al Khaimah as a hub for sustainable innovation. A collaboration between Uterra, RAKEZ, and the Government of Ras Al Khaimah supports the company's growth and success in the region.
records.institution: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries has opened its state-of-the-art organic soil fertiliser production facility in Ras Al Khaimah, the reg...
records.description: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries has opened its state-of-the-art organic soil fertiliser production facility in Ras Al Khaimah, the region's first dedicated to sustainable agricultural products, following a US$20 million investment. The facility uses advanced organic production and indoor/outdoor farming technologies, including vertical farming, to produce chemical-free and GMO-free fertilisers and develop unique cultivation methods. This aims to maximize yield and sustainability, restoring degraded soil and promoting eco-friendly agriculture. The facility is expected to significantly contribute to the UAE’s agricultural ecosystem and sustainability goals, strengthening Ras Al Khaimah’s position as a hub for sustainable innovation.
records.institution: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries

records.title: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources Ministry has launched various agricultural and veterinary production services through its...
records.description: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources Ministry has launched various agricultural and veterinary production services through its new e-services portal, "Tabasit" (tabsit.ye). This initiative aims to modernize work processes, simplify procedures, and enhance the quality and accessibility of services, including those related to seed production, seedlings, fodder, fertilizers, pesticides, and veterinary medicines. The ministry stated that this step is intended to regulate agricultural production activities, ensure compliance with technical and health standards, improve consumer protection, and increase control over provided products and services. All individuals and entities working in or entering these fields are urged to visit the "Tabasit" portal to register, regularize their status, and obtain the necessary licenses by following the platform's instructions for each service.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A specialized wind turbine manufacturing factory is being established in Oman's Special Economic Zone at Duqm (Sezad) by Mawarid Turbine...
records.description: A specialized wind turbine manufacturing factory is being established in Oman's Special Economic Zone at Duqm (Sezad) by Mawarid Turbine Company, aiming to bolster the country's renewable energy sector. The facility, with a $200 million first-phase investment, will have a 1,000 MW annual production capacity, producing 6.25 MW and 9.6 MW turbines, and is expected to commence commercial operations in 2026, creating 1,080 jobs. The project, supported by the Ministry of Energy and Minerals, will supply turbines for Omani wind farms and localize renewable energy technology. Mawarid Turbine signed agreements with Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group for technology licensing and turbine supply, and with CID (Gulf) for factory design. A memorandum of understanding was also signed with OQ Group for plant establishment. Additionally, the Ministry of Labour, APSR, and Mawarid Turbine will collaborate to train 350 Omani job seekers for roles in the renewable energy sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water (MAFWR) is expanding a grape farming initiative in North Sharqiyah, Oman, to boost agric...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water (MAFWR) is expanding a grape farming initiative in North Sharqiyah, Oman, to boost agricultural self-sufficiency and food security. The Model Grape Farms Project in Ibra aims to increase grape cultivation, improve yields, and create new market opportunities, while also encouraging youth participation in agriculture. Launched following the 2023 Grape Festival, the project seeks to cultivate 72 acres of grapes, targeting an annual production of 250 tonnes and an economic return exceeding RO250,000. Farmers will receive support, including trellising systems, irrigation, fencing, and high-quality seedlings. The initiative also focuses on private sector involvement and contract farming through agricultural associations to generate rural employment.
records.institution: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water (MAFWR)

records.title: An official from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the official logo of the World Water Forum 2027 in Riyadh, m...
records.description: An official from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the official logo of the World Water Forum 2027 in Riyadh, marking the start of preparatory events for the forum, which will be held in the Middle East for the first time. The event gathered experts to address global water issues and plan for the 2027 forum. The official emphasized Saudi Arabia's commitment to international cooperation in tackling water challenges and achieving Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6). They highlighted Saudi Arabia's national water strategy, Integrated Water Resources Management, and long-term supply and demand plans, all aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. They also mentioned the establishment of the Global Water Organization and an International Water Research Center. A representative from the World Water Council discussed the framework for the 11th forum and the need to prioritize water globally. A Deputy Minister for Water stressed the urgency of action and the importance of coherence, integration, and unified efforts to achieve SDG 6, emphasizing financing, innovation, diplomacy, and environmental considerations. The World Water Forum 2027 will serve as a platform for international water management discussions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Al-Baha Region in Saudi Arabia is presented as a model for sustainable agricultural development, featuring 19 agricultural cities tha...
records.description: The Al-Baha Region in Saudi Arabia is presented as a model for sustainable agricultural development, featuring 19 agricultural cities that bolster food security, support the local economy, and align with Saudi Vision 2030. The region benefits from significant rainfall, allowing for water storage in numerous dams. These agricultural cities cultivate a variety of crops, including pomegranates, grapes, almonds, coffee, mangoes, olives, bananas, and citrus fruits, alongside beekeeping initiatives. These projects create job opportunities, enhance the region's tourism appeal, and contribute to its economic identity. Al-Baha aims to become a key food provider for the Kingdom while promoting sustainable practices and reducing reliance on food imports.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) and the World Food Programme (WFP) have initiated a Model Farm Project in t...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) and the World Food Programme (WFP) have initiated a Model Farm Project in the Socotra Archipelago Governorate, Yemen. The project involves constructing a protective fence, a water tank, rehabilitating farmland, and installing drip irrigation and solar-powered water systems. Approximately 5.5 acres of land will be cultivated, benefiting local families. The Yemeni Minister of Agriculture, Irrigation and Fisheries expressed gratitude to Saudi Arabia and KSrelief for their support. This project is part of Saudi Arabia's broader efforts to enhance Yemen's agricultural and fisheries sectors, improve food security, and foster sustainable development.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The National Water Company (NWC) has completed a SAR400 million project to supply desalinated water to Dhruma, Al Muzahimiyah, Al-Quwaiya...
records.description: The National Water Company (NWC) has completed a SAR400 million project to supply desalinated water to Dhruma, Al Muzahimiyah, Al-Quwaiyah, and the Al Qiddiya project in the Riyadh region. The project, supported by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, involved laying 172 km of transmission lines and constructing six operational reservoirs with a 100,000 cubic meter daily capacity. This initiative aims to improve water services for over 270,000 beneficiaries, strengthen infrastructure, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure water security in line with the Kingdom's urban development goals. NWC is focused on rapidly implementing infrastructure projects to provide sustainable, high-quality water services and achieve Vision 2030 objectives.
records.institution: The National Water Company (NWC)

records.title: Chile advances toward a trade agreement with UAE
records.description: Chile is progressing with a trade agreement with the UAE, focused on increasing bilateral trade by reducing or eliminating tariffs on Chilean products. The proposed Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) aims to remove tariffs on a large percentage of Chilean exports, including key products like fruit, copper, wine, and food, with immediate benefits for various agricultural sectors. Within a few years, almost all Chilean exports are expected to be tariff-free in the UAE. The agreement, currently under legislative review, seeks to enhance the competitiveness of Chilean goods, attract investments, and broaden export markets, potentially establishing Chile as a strategic partner in the Middle East.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has launched the Al Miyah Challenge, starting with a competition focused on developing water-effic...
records.description: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has launched the Al Miyah Challenge, starting with a competition focused on developing water-efficient agricultural technologies. This AED8 million challenge aims to find solutions that reduce water consumption while maintaining crop yields, with successful technologies to be tested in the UAE by December 2026. The initiative, in collaboration with ADAFSA, ASPIRE, and Silal, seeks to identify and support practical water solutions for the UAE and other water-scarce regions. The challenge emphasizes the importance of scalability and deployment, with a significant prize awarded to the winning team. Participating teams will pilot their solutions in the UAE and undergo evaluation to demonstrate real-world impact.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: A meeting in Taiz, Yemen, brought together agriculture branch directors and agricultural association heads to discuss strategies for expa...
records.description: A meeting in Taiz, Yemen, brought together agriculture branch directors and agricultural association heads to discuss strategies for expanding grain production. The meeting, attended by 44 participants, focused on activating collaborative efforts to boost the agricultural sector and reduce reliance on imports. Participants discussed data collection on agricultural areas, irrigation sources, farmers interested in contract farming, livestock, crop types, and production volumes. The goal is to expand contract farming and involve agricultural associations in achieving self-sufficiency.
records.institution: Agriculture Branches (within Taiz province)

records.title: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, signed 11 u...
records.description: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, signed 11 usufruct contracts to implement agricultural and livestock projects in Oman, with investments exceeding OMR1.8 million. These projects, covering 800 acres across various governorates, aim to enhance food security and self-sufficiency by enabling investors to establish quality projects that improve local production and utilize modern technologies. The projects will be located in North Al Batinah, South Al Batinah, North A’Sharqiyah, A’Dakhiliyah, and Musandam governorates.

records.description: The Customs Authority in Taiz province donated 666 kilos of fresh fruits to the 3rd Brigade. records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla launched the first AlUla Honey event at AlManshiyah Farmers Market to highlight local honey quality and support regional beekeepers. Attendees sampled AlUla's unique honey varieties and participated in demonstrations and activities. records.title: Qatar is making significant strides in circular economy and sustainable waste management through initiatives like the Domestic Solid Wast...
records.description: Qatar is making significant strides in circular economy and sustainable waste management through initiatives like the Domestic Solid Waste Management Center (DSWMC) in Mesaieed, which processes substantial amounts of household waste and generates electricity and fertilizer. The country's 2024-2030 strategy, led by the Ministry of Municipality, focuses on implementing the National Integrated Solid Waste Program, which includes constructing new landfills, rehabilitating old sites, promoting waste segregation, and increasing recycling rates. To boost private sector involvement, the Ministry has established the Al Afjah Recycling Industries site, facilitating the recycling of various materials. Qatar is also implementing a phased waste segregation program and conducting public awareness campaigns to foster a culture of sustainability. Through these efforts, Qatar aims to reduce landfill dependency, recover resources, and advance its environmental stewardship.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality

records.title: An agricultural experiment to cultivate sandalwood and aloeswood is being conducted in Najran, with approximately 200 seedlings planted o...
records.description: An agricultural experiment to cultivate sandalwood and aloeswood is being conducted in Najran, with approximately 200 seedlings planted on three farms, as part of a national development project. A representative from the Najran Chamber's Agricultural Committee stated that Najran's inclusion in sandalwood cultivation aligns with national vision goals, aiming to boost the local economy and diversify income. He highlighted Najran's suitable agricultural conditions, including its climate, soil, and water resources. A local farmer emphasized the value of sandalwood and aloeswood for their fragrance and natural oils, particularly in the perfume and cosmetics industries, despite requiring special care. The cultivation effort aims to create new investment opportunities, strengthen the national economy, support sustainable development, and preserve environmental heritage.
records.institution: Jazan Mountainous Development Authority

records.title: The Undersecretary of Al-Bayda province and the Engineering Supervision Officer of the Central Intervention Unit inaugurated the distribu...
records.description: The Undersecretary of Al-Bayda province and the Engineering Supervision Officer of the Central Intervention Unit inaugurated the distribution of 3,500 bags of cement to support road and agricultural initiative projects in the province. The initiative aims to motivate community involvement in implementing service and development projects. The Undersecretary praised community efforts and emphasized the need for project supervision. The Supervision Officer highlighted the unit's commitment to accelerating project implementation and supporting new initiatives to improve infrastructure.
records.institution: Central Intervention Unit

records.title: The Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan launched a Country Partnership Strategy (CPS) to su...
records.description: The Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan launched a Country Partnership Strategy (CPS) to support Jordan's economic resilience and inclusive growth, marked by the signing of a KWD21 million loan agreement. The CPS includes a potential financing package of KWD211 million to support Jordan, focusing on improving social services like water infrastructure, renewable energy production, and TVET education, as well as unlocking private sector potential through investments in high-value industries, SMEs, and startups. The initial loan will finance a gasification unit to enhance Jordan's energy security. The CPS aims to contribute to several Sustainable Development Goals. The Arab Fund has been a long-term supporter of Jordan, providing significant financing across various key sectors since its establishment.
records.institution: The Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development

records.title: The renewable energy company Masdar from the United Arab Emirates has completed its acquisition of Greece's Terna Energy, having previous...
records.description: The renewable energy company Masdar from the United Arab Emirates has completed its acquisition of Greece's Terna Energy, having previously secured a majority stake in November of the preceding year. This full acquisition, achieved through a mandatory tender offer for the remaining shares at the same price of 20 euros per share, signifies a further step in Masdar's international expansion strategy, particularly within European markets. The CEO of Masdar emphasized the acquisition as a demonstration of the company's dedication to the energy transition in both Greece and Europe. With ambitions for growth in Asia and the United States, Masdar aims to increase its renewable energy capacity significantly by 2030. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi and controlled by TAQA, ADNOC, and Mubadala Investment Company, Masdar's recent activities include consideration of an initial public offering.
records.institution: Masdar

records.title: Under the patronage of a high-ranking official and in line with a national program, an Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition wil...
records.description: Under the patronage of a high-ranking official and in line with a national program, an Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition will be held at a specific venue from May 28 to 31, 2025. Organized by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), the event aims to support local farmers and advance the nation's agricultural, food, and developmental goals by promoting sustainable agricultural practices through modern technologies. The conference and exhibition will serve as a platform for dialogue, knowledge exchange, and collaboration, showcasing local produce, fostering partnerships between various stakeholders, and featuring international expertise. It will also host the launch of a National Agricultural Extension Forum and include specialized sessions and workshops on topics such as sustainability, food security, and innovative agricultural technologies, with a focus on engaging the community and youth to build a resilient and sustainable agricultural sector and achieve national food security objectives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Bahrain reaffirmed its commitment to cutting methane emissions as part of its climate strategy, aiming for net-zero emissions and a 30% m...
records.description: Bahrain reaffirmed its commitment to cutting methane emissions as part of its climate strategy, aiming for net-zero emissions and a 30% methane reduction. The national plan includes energy efficiency, renewable energy, better waste management, and a circular carbon economy. Emphasis was placed on international cooperation and balanced policies that address climate goals while supporting sectors like agriculture through innovation and waste reuse.
records.institution: Kingdom of Bahrain’s Parliament

records.title: The Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy has established a committee to raise public awareness about the rational consump...
records.description: The Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy has established a committee to raise public awareness about the rational consumption of electricity and water, focusing on sustainability, particularly during the summer. The committee, composed of specialists from various ministries and institutions, will develop comprehensive awareness programs delivered through media platforms to emphasize the importance of rational consumption for preserving public funds and the environment. The committee will engage with civil society and economic sectors, especially during peak summer hours, and educate the community on energy-efficient systems and water conservation technologies across different sectors, organizing workshops and lectures. Collaboration with the private sector and research institutions will be pursued for joint projects involving renewable energy and water-saving technologies, aiming to encourage responsible consumption and the sustainable management of national resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy

records.title: Oman's state water utility, Nama Water Services (NWS), is implementing initiatives to significantly reduce its high potable water losses...
records.description: Oman's state water utility, Nama Water Services (NWS), is implementing initiatives to significantly reduce its high potable water losses (around 40% of production). Plans include replacing old networks, deploying leak detection technologies, and rolling out smart meters. This effort aims to cut Non-Revenue Water (NRW), which costs the utility millions annually. The Authority for Public Services Regulation (APSR) has a long-term goal to reduce losses to 10%. NWS has achieved some reduction and is investing in infrastructure replacement and advanced leak detection technologies, including satellite imaging, drones, and AI, along with smart meters for commercial users. The high cost of desalinated water drives these reduction efforts, which are acknowledged as a sustained challenge. Oman Water Week is held under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources.
records.institution: Nama Water Services (NWS)

records.title: Al Baha, situated in the Sarawat Mountains at a high altitude, is a renowned natural destination for nature lovers and hikers due to its...
records.description: Al Baha, situated in the Sarawat Mountains at a high altitude, is a renowned natural destination for nature lovers and hikers due to its diverse terrain of deep valleys, towering mountains, and dense forests. The Director General of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Al-Baha highlighted a project focused on agricultural terraces in the region, which has benefited a total of 355 farms across preliminary and three subsequent phases. Al Baha's valleys, characterized by natural beauty, green mountains, and waterfalls, offer ideal environments for walking and hiking. Notable valleys include Al-Ahsabah Valley, Dhark Valley, Bida Valley with its water and pomegranate orchards, and Al Hamdah Valley known for its streams and waterfalls. Beyond natural landscapes, visitors can also explore traditional villages and archaeological sites, making Al Baha a prominent tourist destination in Saudi Arabia that blends adventure with cultural discovery.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed its first development loan agreement with the Solomon Islands, pledging $10 million for a...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed its first development loan agreement with the Solomon Islands, pledging $10 million for a renewable energy project. This project will fund the construction of 35.5 megawatt solar power plants with hourly energy storage systems. The initiative aims to decrease the Solomon Islands' dependence on traditional energy sources, align with global sustainability goals, and support economic growth and environmental resilience. This agreement marks the start of development cooperation between the SFD and the Solomon Islands, underscoring the Fund’s increasing support for small island developing states facing developmental, economic, and environmental challenges. Since its establishment, the SFD has financed over 800 development projects in more than 100 countries, totaling over $21 billion, across sectors like health, education, transport, water, and energy, with the goal of improving living conditions, enhancing skills, and creating jobs worldwide.
records.institution: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is launching Saudi Environment Week with wide participation from various sectors and i...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is launching Saudi Environment Week with wide participation from various sectors and individuals, emphasizing the Kingdom's dedication to environmental preservation and sustainable development, aligning with the "Saudi Green Initiative" to improve quality of life and protect natural resources for future generations, aiming to raise environmental awareness, promote responsible practices, encourage community engagement, and foster a culture of sustainability by educating the public and mobilizing collective efforts for environmental stewardship and the protection of natural ecosystems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has initiated a technology and agricultural practice...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has initiated a technology and agricultural practices transfer program in Al-Kharj Governorate to promote Azolla cultivation as a supplementary protein source for poultry and livestock feed. The program provides farmers with hands-on training in modern agricultural techniques, including pond construction, fertilization, and harvesting, along with educational materials on crop care and effective usage. This initiative demonstrates Estidamah's role in transferring knowledge and research outcomes to support farmers and enhance their technical skills, aligning with agricultural sector goals and improving local production efficiency through sustainable technologies and practices.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) has finished installing solar energy systems on 22 of its buildings and facilities to increas...
records.description: Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) has finished installing solar energy systems on 22 of its buildings and facilities to increase renewable energy use and lessen environmental impact. This project reflects RTA’s dedication to environmental sustainability and clean energy, aligning with its Zero-Emissions Strategy 2050, the Dubai Clean Energy Strategy 2050, and the Dubai Integrated Energy Strategy 2030. A Director at RTA stated that the project supports Dubai’s vision for sustainable development and is expected to generate about 32 million kilowatt-hours annually, reducing carbon dioxide emissions by around 10,000 tonnes each year. Solar panels were installed at 16 RTA facilities, including bus depots, bus stations, maintenance workshops, and metro depots. RTA is committed to following the standards of Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) for solar panel distribution and installation, ensuring they suit each facility’s specific conditions. Energy production is monitored using DEWA’s Shams Dubai Calculator for real-time efficiency tracking.
records.institution: Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority (RTA)

records.title: The SaudiFood Manufacturing show is a key event for the Kingdom's growing F&B manufacturing industry, bringing together numerous global b...
records.description: The SaudiFood Manufacturing show is a key event for the Kingdom's growing F&B manufacturing industry, bringing together numerous global brands and country pavilions to showcase the latest in processing, packaging, ingredients, supply chain solutions, and automation, with the Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones (MODON) as a strategic partner; occurring amidst a significant valuation and growth in Saudi Arabia's food sector and government plans for localization, the event also features the Food Forward Summit with international experts discussing crucial industry topics like AI and food security, offering a vital platform for business solutions and strategic insights.
records.institution: The Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones (MODON)

records.title: SEE Holding is unveiling The Sustainable City 2.0 (TSC 2.0) at the Annual Investment Meeting (AIM) Congress 2025 in Abu Dhabi.
records.description: SEE Holding is unveiling The Sustainable City 2.0 (TSC 2.0) at the Annual Investment Meeting (AIM) Congress 2025 in Abu Dhabi. Building on the success of The Sustainable City, TSC 2.0 is an AI-driven, net-zero, and human-centric next-generation city. Smart systems will optimize environmental sustainability through vertical farms, precision agriculture, clean energy from various sources, intelligent grids, and comprehensive water conservation technologies. Waste will be repurposed, recycled, or converted to energy, and a cooler microclimate will be maintained through design and technology. Mobility will be fully electric and autonomous. The city prioritizes people with pedestrian-friendly neighborhoods, wellness infrastructure, immersive learning environments, and proactive healthcare supported by digital monitoring. The Chairman and CEO of SEE Holding emphasized that TSC 2.0 is a model being built today, designed for future generations by integrating AI and focusing on human well-being. The original Sustainable City in Dubai has already achieved significant environmental and economic outcomes, and its model is expanding across the UAE and Oman. AIM Congress 2025 attendees can experience TSC 2.0 through an interactive showcase.
records.institution: SEE Holding

records.title: The agriculture sector in Qatar is experiencing significant growth, projected to reach $180.30m in 2025 and $235.31m by the end of the de...
records.description: The agriculture sector in Qatar is experiencing significant growth, projected to reach $180.30m in 2025 and $235.31m by the end of the decade, driven by increasing food demand and government initiatives focused on food security through measures like PPP laws and financial incentives. Despite its arid climate, Qatar is adopting sustainable agricultural practices and technologies such as automated irrigation, aquaponics, and hydroponics to enhance yield and quality. While making strides in local food production, the country remains a major importer of cereals, fruits, and vegetables, with key suppliers including Brazil, the United States, India, and Australia. Qatar is actively working to diversify its economy by increasing local food production, supported by events like AgriteQ showcasing agri-tech advancements, and by investing in both domestic and international agribusiness ventures, with the agriculture sector expected to see a compound annual growth rate of 5.47 percent by the end of 2030.
records.institution: Mordor Intelligence

records.title: Oman Water Week will take place at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre, attracting significant international participation for disc...
records.description: Oman Water Week will take place at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre, attracting significant international participation for discussions on water sustainability, innovation, and technology. The event, hosted by Nama Water Services with support from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Authority for Public Services Regulation, will feature field visits to key water infrastructure projects, a conference with global experts and officials, and specialized workshops to promote knowledge exchange and collaboration in addressing water resource management challenges and ensuring water security in line with national development goals.
records.institution: Nama Water Services
