records.title: The Sultanate of Oman is strategically positioning itself as a global leader in the emerging green hydrogen sector by leveraging its abun...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman is strategically positioning itself as a global leader in the emerging green hydrogen sector by leveraging its abundant renewable energy resources to foster economic growth and facilitate energy transition. The managing director of Hydrom emphasized that Oman's ambition is supported by strategic planning, regulatory frameworks, and substantial investments in hydrogen infrastructure. While currently producing hydrogen from natural gas, Oman is actively pursuing blue and green hydrogen production, with green hydrogen produced via electrolysis using renewable energy being the ultimate goal, capitalizing on the nation's abundant solar and wind resources. Oman has allocated significant land for hydrogen projects, aiming for a total capacity of 35 gigawatts and creating opportunities for localizing manufacturing of related technologies. The government is focused on creating a favorable regulatory environment to attract private sector investment, both local and international. Despite challenges in technological development and cost reduction, Oman's commitment to hydrogen is driven by the need for energy security and sustainability under Oman Vision 2040, aiming to become a key hydrogen-exporting hub in the global market.
records.institution: Hydrom (Hydrogen Oman LLC)

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Saudi Water Partnership Company (SWPC) has announced the commencement of commercial operations for the Madinah 3 Wastewater plant, a...
records.description: The Saudi Water Partnership Company (SWPC) has announced the commencement of commercial operations for the Madinah 3 Wastewater plant, a SAR964 million ($257 million) project. Developed by a consortium led by Acciona, with Tawzea and Tamasuk as partners, the plant has a capacity of 200,000 cu m/day, expandable to 375,000 cu m/day in emergencies. Operated under a BOOT model, Acciona will manage the facility for 25 years, treating wastewater for industrial and agricultural use. The plant successfully treated over 5 million cu m of wastewater during Ramadan. The project also achieved a safety milestone of two million man-hours without LTI.
records.institution: Saudi Water Partnership Company (SWPC)

records.title: UAE-based Hotpack Global has partnered with the Saudi Ministry of Industry to establish a SR1 billion ($266 million) food packaging proje...
records.description: UAE-based Hotpack Global has partnered with the Saudi Ministry of Industry to establish a SR1 billion ($266 million) food packaging project in Saudi Arabia, aiming to produce environmentally friendly, recyclable, and biodegradable products over seven years. This initiative seeks to reduce packaging waste and explore the use of agricultural waste as raw material. The agreement aligns with the Saudi Ministry of Investment’s objective to enhance the Kingdom's investment appeal and foster sustainable economic growth. This venture follows Hotpack's previous plans to invest in biodegradable packaging plants in Malaysia.
records.institution: The Ministry of Investment

records.description: In celebration of 2025's "Year of the Community," Abu Dhabi City Municipality, Miral, and ALEC launched the "Planting the Roots of a Sustainable Future" initiative, planting 300 trees in Al Masar Park, Khalifa City. The project, aligning with Miral's environmental CSR strategy, engaged over 200 participants, including students, in planting Ghaf, Flame, and Neem trees, fostering environmental awareness and sustainability.

records.description: TAQA and EWEC are partnering to develop new energy infrastructure in the UAE, including a 1GW gas turbine plant and advanced grid infrastructure, to support the nation's AI and Net Zero 2050 goals; this collaboration will also bolster EWEC and Masdar's project for 24/7 renewable energy dispatch, driving approximately AED36 billion in investment and establishing a global benchmark for sustainable energy systems that balance technological advancement with environmental responsibility.

records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) has significantly improved its electricity and water production efficiency by 43.61% since 2...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) has significantly improved its electricity and water production efficiency by 43.61% since 2006, resulting in a cumulative reduction of 104 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.This achievement, equivalent to planting 527 million trees, has also yielded substantial financial savings. DEWA attributes this success to continuous innovation, technology deployment, and operational enhancements, including co-generation and hybrid desalination systems that optimize energy use and minimize costs.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

records.title: The Trilokeswar Farmer Producer Company (FPC), in partnership with the Department of Horticulture and Palladium marketing agency, success...
records.description: The Trilokeswar Farmer Producer Company (FPC), in partnership with the Department of Horticulture and Palladium marketing agency, successfully exported 12 tons of G9 bananas from Kalampur, Kalahandi, to Dubai. The bananas were sourced from local farmer shareholders. The initiative, supported by Trilokeswar FPC, Mahashakti Foundation, NABARD, and the Government of India, introduced new agricultural techniques and provided farmers with quality planting materials, organic fertilizers, training, and marketing support. A 150-acre banana cluster was established to improve market access and boost Kalahandi's fruit export capabilities.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: The In-Country Value Added (ICV) system is presented as a crucial strategy for sustainable development in agriculture, fisheries, and aqu...
records.description: The In-Country Value Added (ICV) system is presented as a crucial strategy for sustainable development in agriculture, fisheries, and aquaculture, aiming to maximize the economic benefits retained within a country. ICV focuses on boosting local production, establishing domestic supply chains, strengthening the workforce, and sustainably managing natural resources. In agriculture, ICV initiatives include increasing local productivity, improving supply chain efficiency, promoting job creation through training, and encouraging research and development. In fisheries, ICV emphasizes supporting local fishermen, developing value-added processing enterprises, conserving marine resources, creating jobs in aquaculture and related activities, and expanding market access. In the water sector, ICV aims to localize water projects, promote research and innovation in water management, develop a skilled local workforce, and encourage water efficiency.
records.institution: The Omani Government

records.title: Ghitha Holding PJSC reported strong financial results, with increased revenue and gross profit.
records.description: Ghitha Holding PJSC reported strong financial results, with increased revenue and gross profit. The Group's total assets also grew significantly. The company plans to use AI and technology to streamline operations and improve decision-making. The Group's focus on operational consolidation aims to enhance agility and drive innovation. Ghitha Holding, a subsidiary of International Holding Company (IHC), has a diversified portfolio, including Al Ain Farms, Marmum Dairy Farm, and other subsidiaries, specializing in various food sectors. IHC, its parent company, is a major holding company in the Middle East.
records.institution: Ghitha Holding PJSC

records.title: Oman has imported over 428,000 live animals to meet red meat demand, with veterinary measures in place to prevent disease spread.
records.description: Oman has imported over 428,000 live animals to meet red meat demand, with veterinary measures in place to prevent disease spread. The imported livestock includes cattle, sheep, and goats, coordinated through specialized companies. In 2023, Oman saw a 45% increase in livestock exports but a slight decrease in poultry production. Oman's livestock production index, which includes various agricultural outputs, has shown growth, with current production figures indicating significant annual outputs of red meat, poultry, eggs, and milk. Agricultural land constitutes a small percentage of Oman's total land area. Additionally, A'Saffa Foods SAOG is expanding its broiler chicken production capacity to meet growing demand and support Oman's economic development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.description: Saudi Arabia is actively pursuing a sustainable future through its Circular Carbon Economy framework and national initiatives, while also engaging in regional diplomacy by facilitating talks to resolve the conflict in Sudan. The Kingdom's economy sees a boost during Ramadan with increased sales of traditional goods, and humanitarian aid is being distributed to those in need in Pakistan and Yemen. A healthcare innovation conference is set to take place in Riyadh, aiming to advance medical technologies and practices.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has announced two investment opportunities, totaling 200 acres...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has announced two investment opportunities, totaling 200 acres in Buraimi, to boost the country's food security. These sites, located in Al Sunaynah, are designated for cattle and goat/sheep farming, meat production, and fodder cultivation, aiming to support farmers, increase national income, and create jobs. Additionally, MAFWR held its first meeting for the electronic census (Ta'dad) of agriculture, fisheries, and water resources, focusing on improving data collection for better planning and accurate information. The census will utilize modern technologies and a streamlined questionnaire for farmers, livestock breeders, fishermen, and private sector stakeholders. The Minister emphasized the importance of updated statistics for informed policy-making and to assess the contribution of these sectors to Oman's food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has imported over 428,000 live animals to satisfy consumer demand for red meat.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has imported over 428,000 live animals to satisfy consumer demand for red meat. This shipment included approximately 29,000 cattle and 399,000 sheep and goats. The imports were coordinated with specialized companies, and the Veterinary Quarantine Centre is ensuring the animals are free of contagious diseases. Veterinary staff are diligently implementing health measures to prevent the spread of animal diseases into Oman.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: Larsen & Toubro (L&T), through its L&T Energy Hydrocarbon (LTEH) unit, has secured a major contract from QatarEnergy LNG for the North Fi...
records.description: Larsen & Toubro (L&T), through its L&T Energy Hydrocarbon (LTEH) unit, has secured a major contract from QatarEnergy LNG for the North Field Production Sustainability Offshore Compression Project (NFPS COMP 4), valued at over Rs150 billion ($1.7 billion). This is the largest single order in L&T's history. The project involves the engineering, procurement, fabrication, installation, and commissioning of two offshore compression complexes, including platforms, power generation, living quarters, and other related structures, located 80 km off the coast of Qatar. L&T's Chairman and Managing Director expressed gratitude to QatarEnergy LNG for their trust and highlighted the project's significance in strengthening L&T's global energy portfolio and supporting Qatar's energy security goals.
records.institution: QatarEnergy

records.title: Saudi Arabia celebrated its annual Saudi Green Initiative (SGI) Day, highlighting the country's commitment to environmental sustainabilit...
records.description: Saudi Arabia celebrated its annual Saudi Green Initiative (SGI) Day, highlighting the country's commitment to environmental sustainability and the crucial role of community involvement. Under the patronage of HRH, the SGI aims to protect the planet through clean energy initiatives and environmental protection. Experts emphasized the impact of local action, showcasing community-led projects that drive environmental change. Initiatives like the National Cheetah Conservation Program and the National Center for Vegetation cover's mangrove planting project demonstrate the success of engaging local communities as conservation allies. The Royal Reserves' leadership, including its female ranger training program, also highlights the kingdom's whole-of-society approach to sustainability. Experts noted that by leveraging local knowledge and enthusiasm, communities are proving that a greener Saudi Arabia starts at the grassroots level.
records.institution: National Center for Vegetation cover

records.title: The UAE Food Bank and the National Initiative to Reduce Food Loss and Waste, "Ne’ma," have announced a strategic partnership to enhance f...
records.description: The UAE Food Bank and the National Initiative to Reduce Food Loss and Waste, "Ne’ma," have announced a strategic partnership to enhance food support and environmental sustainability, particularly during Ramadan 2025. Key initiatives include providing one million meals from surplus food and deploying "Ne'ma Community Fridges" across Dubai. The "One Million Meals" initiative, in collaboration with over 75 hotels and the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism, will collect and distribute untouched surplus food, while inedible food will be converted into oil and compost. This effort has shown significant reductions in food waste and increased compost production. The "Ne'ma Community Fridges" will provide accessible food to individuals in need, with the UAE Food Bank and Ne'ma ensuring food safety.
records.institution: UAE Food Bank

records.title: An economic empowerment project to support people with disabilities was launched in Zabid district, Al-Hodeida province, implemented by t...
records.description: An economic empowerment project to support people with disabilities was launched in Zabid district, Al-Hodeida province, implemented by the Central Economic Empowerment Unit in cooperation with Al-Jarahi and Al-Tahita associations. Under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, and funded by the Fund for the Care and Rehabilitation of the Disabled, the project provides white loans and distributes 240 cattle heads to 120 beneficiaries in Tahita and Jarahi districts. The initiative aims to promote economic empowerment for people with disabilities, with a focus on agricultural and rural sector participation. The project is part of broader efforts to support needy groups, achieve economic and social development, and improve the lives of marginalized communities. The project represents a practical model for economically empowering people with disabilities and enhancing their productive role in agriculture, contributing to self-sufficiency and improved living standards.
records.institution: Central Economic Empowerment Unit

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: EMSTEEL Group and Yellow Door Energy have partnered to develop a 31.5 MWp solar PV rooftop project in the UAE, the largest of its kind in...
records.description: EMSTEEL Group and Yellow Door Energy have partnered to develop a 31.5 MWp solar PV rooftop project in the UAE, the largest of its kind in the region. This project will power EMSTEEL's facilities with renewable energy, supporting their decarbonization strategy and aligning with the UAE's Net Zero by 2050 commitment. Yellow Door Energy will finance, build, own, operate, and maintain the solar installations across 40 EMSTEEL roofs in ICAD 1, Abu Dhabi, generating approximately 50 million kWh of clean electricity annually and offsetting 16,000 metric tonnes of CO₂ emissions. Construction is scheduled to begin in 2025, with commissioning in 2026. This partnership will enable EMSTEEL to reduce energy costs and its carbon footprint, while Yellow Door Energy will manage the project's development without requiring upfront investment from EMSTEEL.
records.institution: EMSTEEL Group

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Masdar has agreed to acquire a 49.99 percent stake in four Spanish solar plants from Endesa, totaling 446 MW in capacity, for Dhs702m (EU...
records.description: Masdar has agreed to acquire a 49.99 percent stake in four Spanish solar plants from Endesa, totaling 446 MW in capacity, for Dhs702m (EUR184m). This deal, subject to regulatory approvals, expands Masdar's presence in the Iberian Peninsula and Europe. Building on a previous 2 GW solar asset partnership with Endesa, this acquisition strengthens their collaboration and supports Spain's National Energy and Climate Plan (NECP) targets. Masdar's CEO emphasized the company's commitment to Europe's decarbonization and global energy transformation, while Endesa's CEO highlighted the partnership's role in accelerating the energy transition. With this acquisition, Masdar's operational capacity in the Iberian Peninsula reaches 3.2GW, reinforcing its contribution to the EU's 2050 net-zero targets. Masdar also has an MOU with Enel Group to explore further renewable energy opportunities in Europe.
records.institution: Masdar

records.title: The National Initiative for Agriculture Development (NIAD), in partnership with Ghosn Al Bahrain, Sanwan Nursery, and Abu Subaie Nursery,...
records.description: The National Initiative for Agriculture Development (NIAD), in partnership with Ghosn Al Bahrain, Sanwan Nursery, and Abu Subaie Nursery, has completed the planting of 200 acacia trees at Al Fateh Mosque in Bahrain. This initiative demonstrates community collaboration in promoting sustainable development and increasing green spaces. The Undersecretary for Agriculture and Animal Wealth highlighted the Ministry's support for such initiatives, which align with Bahrain's national afforestation plan to double the number of trees and enhance environmental sustainability.
records.institution: National Initiative for Agriculture Development (NIAD)

records.title: Nama Water Services has partnered with Al Tayer Engineering Services Company to build a water purification plant at Wadi Dayqah Dam in Om...
records.description: Nama Water Services has partnered with Al Tayer Engineering Services Company to build a water purification plant at Wadi Dayqah Dam in Oman, a project valued at over OMR55 million. This 20-year public-private partnership (PPP) will utilize a Build, Own, Operate (BOO) model, constructing a plant with a 65,000 cubic meter daily capacity. Of this, 35,000 cubic meters will supply potable water through Nama Water Services' network, and 30,000 cubic meters will support agricultural irrigation in the Wilayat of Quriyat, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources. The project aims to enhance water and food security, diversify water sources, and reduce desalination costs. It includes constructing the plant, a seven-kilometer water transmission line, a pumping station, and a 20,000-cubic-meter collection tank. The plant is expected to be completed within 22 months and will employ advanced purification technologies, benefiting from the dam's lower salt content compared to seawater, thereby reducing energy consumption.
records.institution: Nama Water Services

It will feature a conference and exhibition showcasing Oman's green hydrogen projects, investments, and policies. The summit will foster collaboration and investment, focusing on local content development, green financing, industrialization, job creation, and research. Oman has secured substantial green hydrogen production commitments through Hydrom's land block auctions, with a future auction round planned to further expand its role in the global hydrogen market.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals and Hydrom

The partnership aligns with Tanmiah's sustainability goals and Saudi Arabia's clean energy objectives. Emerge, established in 2021, focuses on developing renewable energy solutions for commercial and industrial clients. records.description: Empower, a Dubai-based district cooling services provider, has reiterated its dedication to environmental protection by using treated water in its operations, aligning with World Water Day. In 2024, 8.3% of Empower's water usage came from recycled sources, primarily treated sewage effluent (TSE), reducing the strain on freshwater reserves. Empower has achieved significant water savings through advanced environmental practices, in accordance with Dubai Executive Council Resolution No. (27) of 2008. The company advocates for public efforts to conserve natural resources and promotes efficient water use to protect the environment and combat climate change.

records.description: The Director-General of the National Centre of Meteorology and President of the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) emphasized the importance of this year's World Meteorological Day theme, "Closing the Early Warning Gap Together," highlighting the global commitment to strengthening early warning capabilities against increasing extreme weather events. He noted the UN's "Early Warnings for All" initiative, aiming to protect everyone on Earth within five years, and while progress has been made, gaps remain, requiring enhanced global cooperation, especially to support vulnerable countries. He stressed the economic benefits of investing in early warning systems, stating a US$1 investment yields US$9 in economic benefits, and reaffirmed WMO's commitment to achieving the "Early Warnings for All" vision, placing a shared responsibility on the global community for a secure and resilient future.

records.title: Saudi Arabia has introduced stringent fines for water misuse, with penalties reaching SR200,000.
records.description: Saudi Arabia has introduced stringent fines for water misuse, with penalties reaching SR200,000. The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has outlined these penalties in its executive regulations, covering violations across urban, agricultural, industrial, service, and general sectors. Urban violations include using inefficient plumbing fixtures, wasting water from tanks, and failing to operate grey water stations. Agricultural and industrial violations involve non-compliance with water licensing and allocated water footprints. General violations include obstructing inspectors and failing to provide required information. Service providers face fines for non-compliance with review processes, reporting, and operating without a license. The National Center for Water Efficiency and Conservation is central to these regulations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia, recognized as a global leader in water sector innovation, utilizes artificial intelligence in desalination and develops pal...
records.description: Saudi Arabia, recognized as a global leader in water sector innovation, utilizes artificial intelligence in desalination and develops palm tree-based technologies for erosion control and water infrastructure. The Kingdom's integrated institutional structure, led by the Saudi Water Authority under the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, ensures sustainable water management. The authority oversees the production and distribution of approximately 15 million cubic meters of water daily through an extensive network, demonstrating its commitment to sustainability and climate change adaptation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.description: Saudi Arabia's poultry sector has achieved complete self-sufficiency in table egg production, exceeding 8 billion eggs in 2024. They are also focused on enhancing food quality, safety, and availability.

Key projects include distributing recycled water to farms, promoting hydroponics and smart irrigation, and developing an "Electronic Irrigation Calculator" for crop water requirements. ADAFSA also provides irrigation water through collective stations and encourages the use of non-traditional water sources.

Aramco is also developing a Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) hub in Jubail with Linde and SLB, aiming to capture and store up to nine million metric tons of CO2 annually by 2027. records.title: Saudia Cargo plays a crucial role in exporting Saudi Arabian dates, a symbol of Ramadan, to global markets.
records.description: Saudia Cargo plays a crucial role in exporting Saudi Arabian dates, a symbol of Ramadan, to global markets. Saudia Cargo supports national sustainability initiatives, aligning with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the National Center for Palms and Dates. records.description: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) is implementing sustainable development projects in Yemen, focusing on infrastructure and essential services. Notably, they are enhancing the water sector through 58 projects, including two renewable energy-powered water security projects in Aden and Hadhramaut. These projects aim to diversify water sources, improve distribution efficiency, and reduce operational costs by using solar energy. In Aden, 10 wells are being upgraded, benefiting 800,000 people. In Hadhramaut, the project targets nine districts, benefiting 1.7 million people. SDRPY supports various sectors across Yemen with 264 projects.

Despite the failed acquisition, Almarai remains interested in future expansion opportunities.

records.title: KAUST researchers are collaborating with local farmers and the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture to address water sca...
records.description: KAUST researchers are collaborating with local farmers and the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture to address water scarcity in agriculture. They are developing innovative strategies, including controlled environment agriculture (CEA) integrated with tailored desalination and wastewater treatment, to provide "clean enough" water for hydroponic farming. The project aims to reduce costs and energy use by selectively removing unwanted ions from brackish water and reclaiming municipal wastewater. They are evaluating technologies like nanofiltration and forward osmosis, with the goal of developing prototypes. This initiative supports Saudi Arabia's goals for sustainable agriculture, wastewater reuse, and food security.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.description: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) is significantly improving livelihoods and rural resilience in Yemen through various development projects. These initiatives build local community capacities through training and rehabilitation, supporting food security and economic empowerment. SDRPY has implemented 264 projects across Yemen, contributing to vital sectors and enhancing the Yemeni government's capabilities.
records.institution: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY)

records.title: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund in Oman is crucial for achieving Oman Vision 2040's goals, focusing on environmental sust...
records.description: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund in Oman is crucial for achieving Oman Vision 2040's goals, focusing on environmental sustainability, economic diversification, innovation, human capital development, and food security. The Fund supports projects using modern technologies, promotes biodiversity, and aims to increase the agricultural and fisheries sector's GDP contribution. It fosters innovation through e-marketing and advanced production technologies, empowers women and youth, and strengthens public-private partnerships. The Fund also focuses on transitioning to a green economy and combating pests and diseases, aligning with the vision's principles of supporting advanced technologies, financing innovative projects, strengthening partnerships, developing infrastructure, and ensuring product quality and safety.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's potato production reached 621,751 tons in 2023, achieving an 87% self-sufficiency rate.
records.description: Saudi Arabia's potato production reached 621,751 tons in 2023, achieving an 87% self-sufficiency rate. records.title: Saudi Greenhouse Management and Agri Marketing Co.
records.description: Saudi Greenhouse Management and Agri Marketing Co. (SGH) and Topian are partnering to establish the Horticulture Innovation Center (HIC) at the University of Tabuk, aiming to advance controlled-environment agriculture in Saudi Arabia. Designed with expertise from the World Horti Center, the HIC will be a hub for horticultural education and innovation, showcasing diverse technologies and growing methods. SGH will lead construction and joint operation, while Topian will manage daily operations. The center will foster collaboration and develop skilled greenhouse operators, contributing to sustainable agricultural practices in the Kingdom. Construction is set to begin in Q2 2025.

records.title: GS Enima Barka 5 Desalination Company in Oman has signed a power purchase agreement (PPA) to integrate solar energy into its desalination...
records.description: GS Enima Barka 5 Desalination Company in Oman has signed a power purchase agreement (PPA) to integrate solar energy into its desalination plant in Barka. A 6.5-megawatt peak photovoltaic (PV) solar plant will supply up to 11% of the desalination plant's energy needs by 2044, reducing its carbon footprint. Construction is set to begin, with operation expected in the first quarter of 2026. This project aligns with GS Enima's goal to incorporate renewable energy into the water sector. Once operational, it will be the second solar-powered desalination facility in Oman, following Veolia's Sharqiya Desalination Company's 17 MW peak plant.
records.institution: GS Enima Barka 5 Desalination Company

records.title: Hilton Foods, NADEC form joint venture to expand meat production in Saudi Arabia
records.description: Hilton Foods is entering the Saudi Arabian market through a 10-year joint venture with The National Agricultural Development Company (NADEC). Hilton Foods will hold a 49% stake and invest US$8.3 million. The partnership aims to establish modern meat processing facilities in Saudi Arabia, with NADEC supplying red meat and integrating products into its distribution network. This aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030, enhancing food security and local production. The venture will begin operations in the second half of 2026, pending regulatory approval. Saudi Arabia is a major meat consumer, with beef being the most popular red meat.
records.institution: The National Agricultural Development Company (NADEC)

records.title: The United Nations Water Committee (UN-Water) has recognized Saudi Arabia as a leading model for integrated water resources management.
records.description: The United Nations Water Committee (UN-Water) has recognized Saudi Arabia as a leading model for integrated water resources management. A workshop, hosted by the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Riyadh, examined the Kingdom's progress. UN-Water is conducting a case study of Saudi Arabia's approach, which aligns with Vision 2030 and the National Water Strategy 2030, to serve as a model for other nations. The workshop reviewed findings on how Saudi Arabia's practices can accelerate progress toward Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6).
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: ADQ has become the majority shareholder of Aramex PJSC, achieving 58% ownership.
records.description: ADQ has become the majority shareholder of Aramex PJSC, achieving 58% ownership. This includes shares from a tender offer and those already owned by AD Ports Group. Aramex will join ADQ’s Transport & Logistics cluster, alongside other companies. ADQ intends to develop Aramex into a globally competitive business. ADQ is a sovereign investor focused on infrastructure and supply chains, with a large portfolio across various sectors.
records.institution: ADQ

records.title: Oman Investment Authority (OIA) has invested in Tidal Vision, a US-based biopolymer technology company, during its Series B funding round.
records.description: Oman Investment Authority (OIA) has invested in Tidal Vision, a US-based biopolymer technology company, during its Series B funding round. Tidal Vision specializes in converting crustacean shells into chitosan-based biopolymer solutions for various industries, including water treatment, agriculture, and oil and gas. OIA's investment, through its Future Generations Fund (FGF), aims to localize innovative solutions for the Omani market and support sustainable returns. Tidal Vision's technology focuses on a zero-waste extraction process and repurposes byproducts from the fishing industry, contributing to a circular economy.
records.institution: Oman Investment Authority (OIA)

records.title: Oman is becoming a leader in the Middle East's green hydrogen sector, with five major projects expected to be operational by 2030.
records.description: Oman is becoming a leader in the Middle East's green hydrogen sector, with five major projects expected to be operational by 2030. These projects, including the ACME Duqm Hydrogen Project and others by POSCO Consortium, Amnah Consortium, Fortescue Future Industries, and EDF, leverage Oman's abundant solar and wind resources. Oman's strategic location, particularly the Duqm Special Economic Zone, and government support through Hydrom and OPAZ, are attracting international investors. While facing regional competition from Saudi Arabia and the UAE, Oman's focus on green hydrogen provides a competitive advantage in the global transition to net-zero emissions.
records.institution: Hydrom, Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ)

records.title: Preliminary data from Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI) shows a minor decline in the nation's tomato output fo...
records.description: Preliminary data from Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI) shows a minor decline in the nation's tomato output for 2024, with total production reaching 219,775 tons. This figure represents a 2.5% decrease compared to the production levels recorded in 2023. Despite this slight dip, the agricultural sector remains a vital part of Oman's economy. Notably, the North Batinah Governorate has maintained its position as the country's primary tomato-producing region, contributing a substantial 155,241 tons to the overall yield. This region's consistent productivity is attributed to its advantageous climate and strong farming infrastructure, reinforcing its status as a key agricultural center within Oman.
records.institution: The National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI)

records.title: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar is highlighting the success of local produce sale yards, particularly during Ramadan, where they se...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar is highlighting the success of local produce sale yards, particularly during Ramadan, where they see increased consumer demand and trust. These markets, established in 2012, have developed significantly, offering fresh, local products at competitive prices, reducing intermediaries, and boosting farmers' profits. Open during specific hours throughout Ramadan, these markets are regulated to ensure fair pricing and product quality, balancing producer and consumer interests. The Ministry supports farmers by providing free sales outlets, technical assistance, and packaging, while also collaborating on initiatives to distribute produce to low-income families and support home-based businesses.
records.institution: The Agricultural Affairs Department at the Ministry of Municipality

records.title: Researchers at King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST) have developed a vertical farming system that drastically reduces s...
records.description: Researchers at King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST) have developed a vertical farming system that drastically reduces saffron cultivation time to 10 days, compared to the traditional four to six weeks. Utilizing artificial lighting with specific wavelengths and climate control, they've created an optimal growing environment, addressing Saudi Arabia's challenging climate. This innovation aims to capitalize on the growing global saffron market and reduce the Kingdom's substantial saffron imports. The technology not only enhances agricultural productivity and crop quality but also contributes to environmental and economic sustainability by reducing carbon emissions, conserving resources, and promoting self-sufficiency in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: Saudi researchers at King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST)

records.description: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) has significantly improved Yemen's energy sector through various projects. These initiatives enhance essential services like education and healthcare by improving energy efficiency and promoting renewable energy use. SDRPY projects have ensured 100% reliability of electricity in its healthcare facilities via independent power systems. They've also expanded the Al-Ghaydah power plant, improved distribution networks, and implemented solar-powered lighting in public spaces. These energy sector projects are part of a broader effort supporting eight key sectors across Yemen.

records.title: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reported that nearly 290,000 livestock animals were made available to co...
records.description: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reported that nearly 290,000 livestock animals were made available to consumers in the first two months of 2025, with a significant majority being sheep and goats. To meet increased demand during Ramadan and Eid Al Fitr, the Ministry has issued numerous import permits, allowing for a larger total potential import. Veterinary quarantine measures are being strictly enforced to prevent the spread of animal diseases.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is developing an AI-powered robotic system to automate date palm harvesting, a...
records.description: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is developing an AI-powered robotic system to automate date palm harvesting, aiming to revolutionize Saudi Arabia's agriculture sector. The system, featuring robotic arms with high-precision visual sensors, will automate tasks like harvesting, pollination, and tree maintenance, promising increased yields and improved date quality. Field trials are planned for 2025, with full operation expected within three years. KAUST envisions a Robots-as-a-Service model to make the technology accessible to smaller farmers. The project is expected to enhance Saudi Arabia's agricultural technology and expertise, attracting talent and providing training opportunities for local laborers.
records.institution: The King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: Emirati seeds, studied at the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), have been deposited in the Svalbard Global Seed Vaul...
records.description: Emirati seeds, studied at the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), have been deposited in the Svalbard Global Seed Vault, the "Doomsday Vault," in the Arctic. This first-of-its-kind deposit from the Gulf region safeguards climate-resilient crops, including those from the UAE's Ghaf tree. ICBA's seeds, chosen for their tolerance to extreme conditions, represent decades of research and ensure future access to vital genetic resources. This initiative, with over 1.3 million seed samples stored, reinforces the UAE's commitment to global food security and sustainability.
records.institution: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA)

records.title: A meeting in Sana'a province, Yemen, addressed the development of contract farming and the empowerment of agricultural associations to bo...
records.description: A meeting in Sana'a province, Yemen, addressed the development of contract farming and the empowerment of agricultural associations to boost agricultural output. Discussions centered on improving farmer coordination, achieving self-sufficiency, and establishing collection centers. Participants highlighted the potential of local associations and the need for institutional development, including training for contract farming coordinators. Challenges such as input shortages were discussed, along with the importance of product quality and water initiatives. Officials emphasized the need for trained coordinators, diversified crop production, and collaboration between associations and traders. The local authority reiterated its commitment to supporting agricultural associations and enhancing food production. Efforts to provide improved seeds, implement agricultural projects, and offer training in various agricultural practices were also outlined, aiming to achieve food security.
records.institution: The Cooperative Associations

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM), a government-owned food company, is introducing millet cultivation in Oman to reduce grain import reliance.
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM), a government-owned food company, is introducing millet cultivation in Oman to reduce grain import reliance. Millet, a nutrient-rich cereal, is adaptable to Oman's climate and supports food security. OFM is importing millet seeds and leveraging its existing grain storage and milling infrastructure. This initiative aligns with global trends and UN efforts to promote millet. It also builds on Oman's recent increase in domestic wheat procurement, demonstrating OFM's commitment to a more self-sufficient and sustainable agricultural sector.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills (OFM)

records.title: Emirati seeds, studied at the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), have been deposited in the Svalbard Global Seed Vaul...
records.description: Emirati seeds, studied at the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), have been deposited in the Svalbard Global Seed Vault in the Arctic. This marks the first deposit from the Gulf region, safeguarding climate-resilient crops. The seeds, including those from the UAE's national Ghaf tree, are selected for their tolerance to drought, heat, and salinity. The "Doomsday Vault" protects seeds from global crises, and ICBA's contribution, representing decades of research, ensures future access to vital genetic resources. ICBA, with its extensive gene bank, focuses on crops for arid environments, reinforcing the UAE's commitment to food security and sustainability.
records.institution: The International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA)

records.title: Balady Poultry Company reported a net profit of SAR 118.11 million in 2024, marking a 17.04% year-on-year increase from SAR 100.91 millio...
records.description: Balady Poultry Company reported a net profit of SAR 118.11 million in 2024, marking a 17.04% year-on-year increase from SAR 100.91 million in 2023. The company's revenue also saw substantial growth, soaring by 16.58% to SAR 887.11 million, up from SAR 760.97 million in the previous year. The earnings per share (EPS) improved to SAR 17.98, compared to SAR 15.36 in 2023. These positive results reflect strong performance throughout the year, with notable increases in both net profit and revenue observed during the first nine months and the first half of 2024.
records.institution: Balady Poultry Company

records.title: Abu Dhabi's TAQA and Saudi Arabia's ACWA Power, along with other international and local firms, have been awarded green hydrogen projects...
records.description: Abu Dhabi's TAQA and Saudi Arabia's ACWA Power, along with other international and local firms, have been awarded green hydrogen projects in Morocco, totaling nearly $32 billion. The Moroccan government selected these companies, including Chinese, German, and Spanish firms, for six projects in South Morocco. The projects will focus on producing ammonia, industrial fuel, and green steel. Consortia include ORNX (American, Spanish, German), TAQA/Cepsa (Emirati, Spanish), Nareva (Moroccan), ACWA Power (Saudi), and a Chinese consortium of UEG and China Three Gorges.

records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (Dewa) is seeking international developers for the 1,600MW (expandable to 2,000MW) seventh phase of...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (Dewa) is seeking international developers for the 1,600MW (expandable to 2,000MW) seventh phase of the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park. This phase will feature photovoltaic solar panels and a 1,000MW battery energy storage system with a 6,000MWh capacity, making it one of the world's largest solar-plus-storage projects. Implemented under an independent power producer (IPP) model, it's expected to produce 4.5 terawatt-hours annually, reducing natural gas consumption and carbon emissions. The project will increase the solar park's capacity to 7,260MW, raising Dubai's clean energy share to 34% by 2030. The project is scheduled for phased operation between 2027 and 2029, with a March 21 deadline for expressions of interest.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (Dewa)

records.title: The agricultural sector in Marib province has begun distributing pesticides to combat wheat rust and fall armyworm in maize crops.
records.description: The agricultural sector in Marib province has begun distributing pesticides to combat wheat rust and fall armyworm in maize crops. The distribution, overseen by the director of the agricultural sector, will be done through local agriculture sector branches to ensure the pesticides reach affected farmers. This initiative is part of an agricultural expansion project and aims to protect crops and maintain agricultural production.
records.institution: The Yemeni Government

records.title: Date production in Oman is a vital part of the nation's economy, with significant yields reported.
records.description: Date production in Oman is a vital part of the nation's economy, with significant yields reported. Several regions contribute, and a variety of date types are cultivated. The average consumption of dates per person is high, reflecting their cultural and nutritional importance. The date sector supports numerous livelihoods and related industries. Efforts are underway to further develop the industry through initiatives aimed at increasing production and research focused on preserving unique date varieties. Priorities include improving supply chains, marketing strategies, and ensuring sustainable agricultural practices to enhance the country's position in the global date market.
records.institution: The National Centre for Statistics and Information

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture reports a significant increase in red meat production, exceeding 270,000 tons.
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture reports a significant increase in red meat production, exceeding 270,000 tons. This growth has led to a 61% self-sufficiency rate, supporting food security and aligning with Vision 2030 goals. The increase is attributed to livestock sector development, support for local breeders, and the adoption of advanced technologies. The Kingdom's livestock inventory includes millions of sheep, goats, cows, and camels.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Etihad Water and Electricity (EtihadWE) is supporting the UAE's food and water security efforts by providing sustainable solutions for th...
records.description: Etihad Water and Electricity (EtihadWE) is supporting the UAE's food and water security efforts by providing sustainable solutions for the agricultural sector. They are promoting the use of desalinated water for irrigation, which reduces reliance on groundwater and offers cost savings for farmers through a revised tariff structure. Over 1,300 farmers have benefited from these reduced tariffs. EtihadWE, in collaboration with the Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure and the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, is committed to the UAE Water Security Strategy 2036, the National Food Security Strategy 2051, and other national initiatives. The focus is on enhancing water consumption efficiency and promoting responsible resource management for sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: Etihad Water and Electricity (EtihadWE)

records.title: Oman Water Week (OWW) 2025, hosted by Nama Water Services under the patronage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries Wealth & Water Re...
records.description: Oman Water Week (OWW) 2025, hosted by Nama Water Services under the patronage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries Wealth & Water Resources, will serve as a crucial platform for advancing water sector dialogue, innovation, and collaboration in the region. The event, held in Muscat, will feature over 2,500 participants, expert speakers, and exhibitors, focusing on solutions for water resilience, efficiency, and sustainability. Through strategic, municipal, and industrial conference tracks, alongside an exhibition showcasing the latest technologies, OWW 2025 aims to facilitate knowledge sharing, strategic discussions, and new partnerships to address pressing water challenges. The event will also include site visits to key water infrastructure projects, and is organized by Raya Services. It is designed to bring together industry leaders, policymakers, and innovators to drive progress towards sustainable water solutions.
records.institution: Nama Water Services, The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries Wealth & Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman, in partnership with Zubair Enterprises Development Centre and the FAO...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman, in partnership with Zubair Enterprises Development Centre and the FAO, has launched an 'Agricultural Ecotourism in Aflaj Systems' project in Balad Sayt. The project aims to revitalize rural areas, promote sustainable agriculture, and preserve cultural heritage by showcasing the village's unique aflaj systems. Balad Sayt, with its rich agricultural heritage and terraced fields, was chosen for the pilot program, which could expand to other areas. The project will support the local economy by promoting local products and creating opportunities for farmers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, has announc...

These opportunities, covering 659.4 acres, include agricultural projects, animal production units, and water bottling units, aimed at boosting food security and agricultural investment. records.title: The Qassim Region witnessed the signing of an SAR 8.5 billion contract for the Jubail-Buraydah Independent Water Transmission Pipeline Pr...
records.description: The Qassim Region witnessed the signing of an SAR 8.5 billion contract for the Jubail-Buraydah Independent Water Transmission Pipeline Project, aimed at enhancing water security in Saudi Arabia. The project, linking the Eastern and Qassim regions, will transport up to 650,000 cubic meters of desalinated water daily over 587 kilometers. It features a reverse pumping capability and includes the construction of strategic reservoirs in Al-Shimasiyah Governorate and Jubail City. The initiative reflects the government's commitment to developing water infrastructure and aligns with Saudi Vision 2030, emphasizing private sector partnerships for improved service quality and efficiency.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has signed two significant contracts. records.title: Taif Governorate in Saudi Arabia is historically significant for its advanced ancient water systems, including springs, dams, and wells,...
records.description: Taif Governorate in Saudi Arabia is historically significant for its advanced ancient water systems, including springs, dams, and wells, reflecting its strategic water management. Over 120 years, Taif has developed a unique irrigation and water supply system, contributing to water security. Today, with over 97% water network coverage, it serves as a key water source and strategic reservoir. Taif is home to ancient dams dating back to the Umayyad era, and historian Issa Al-Qasir highlighted the presence of around 70 dams, some with historical inscriptions, demonstrating Taif's rich water management heritage.
records.institution: Saudi Arabia's government

records.description: Saudi Arabia's date production is a cornerstone of its food security, with 2024 yields surpassing 1.9 million tons, ensuring domestic abundance. This surplus production allows Saudi Arabia to meet domestic demand and export to numerous countries worldwide.

records.description: The UAE's Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the FAO have initiated a Food Control System Assessment. FAO experts led the workshop, training participants on the FAO/WHO Food Control System Assessment Tool. This tool assesses about 160 criteria, covering food safety policy, laws, inspections, risk management, and traceability, ultimately aiming to align the UAE's system with international standards and boost food safety and trade.

records.description: An experiment analyzing and fermenting organic fertilizer from animal and plant waste has been launched at a model farm in Al-Jundiya Al-Awliya, Al-Taiziya district, Taiz province. A local agricultural extension director highlighted the benefits of fermented organic fertilizer over conventional methods, including complete decomposition, full plant utilization, absence of harmful side effects, and activation of beneficial soil organisms. The fermented fertilizer also helps loosen and aerate the soil and counteract the harmful effects of excessive chemical fertilizer use.

records.description: Jazan region in Saudi Arabia is renowned for its flourishing honey industry, driven by its diverse flora and favorable climate. The ministry aims to significantly increase honey production and achieve higher self-sufficiency in both honey and beehives by 2030. records.description: The Bahi Ajman Palace Hotel has launched the region's first 100% water-from-air sustainable water bottling plant, marking a significant step towards environmental responsibility. This innovative technology extracts moisture from the air to produce pure drinking water, eliminating the need for plastic bottles and reducing the hotel's carbon footprint. By producing 365,000 liters of water per year, the hotel is setting a new standard for sustainable hospitality in the Northern Emirates.
records.institution: The Bahi Ajman Palace Hotel

records.title: UNS Vertical Farms, a pioneer in UAE vertical farming since 2018, offers a diverse selection of sustainably grown microgreens.
records.description: UNS Vertical Farms, a pioneer in UAE vertical farming since 2018, offers a diverse selection of sustainably grown microgreens. These nutrient-packed greens, rich in antioxidants, vitamins, and micronutrients, are linked to various health benefits, including inflammation reduction and improved heart health. UNS cultivates over 45 varieties, harvesting and delivering within 48 hours to ensure freshness and quality. Examples include Red Veined Sorrel (vitamin C and antioxidants), Shiso Purple (calcium and antioxidants), Red Amaranth (vitamins A, C, and K), and Broccoli microgreens (sulforaphane). UNS emphasizes sustainable practices, minimizing environmental impact and reducing food miles.
records.institution: UNS Vertical Farms

records.title: A meeting of the Water Basin Committee in Dhamar province, chaired by the governor, discussed preserving water resources.
records.description: A meeting of the Water Basin Committee in Dhamar province, chaired by the governor, discussed preserving water resources. The governor stressed responsible water management, including limiting well drilling to essential needs, replenishing groundwater, and addressing excessive water use in qat cultivation. The committee reviewed the Water Resources Authority's achievements, such as monitoring water levels and rainfall, reducing illegal wells, resolving water conflicts, and implementing water harvesting projects. They emphasized continued collaboration between authorities and security services to enforce conservation measures and ensure sustainable water use.
records.institution: The General Authority for Water Resources

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has significantly increased its collaboration with Oman, with project v...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has significantly increased its collaboration with Oman, with project value rising 83% in 2024. Key initiatives focus on enhancing food security, climate resilience, and sustainable agricultural practices. FAO partners with the Omani government, private sector, and academia, aligning with the country's National Environmental Strategy. This includes restoring degraded lands, promoting water conservation, and integrating advanced technologies. Beyond Oman, FAO promotes global initiatives like the International Year of Camelids, highlighting their importance for food security in arid regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR), the Environment Authority (EA), and Sultan Qaboos University (SQU)

records.title: Qatar is increasing its investments in sustainable development, including green bonds for renewable energy and infrastructure.
records.description: Qatar is increasing its investments in sustainable development, including green bonds for renewable energy and infrastructure. Experts emphasize the importance of private firms prioritizing sustainability and digitalization to keep pace with evolving market dynamics. Qatar's economic diversification, driven by its National Vision 2030, focuses on smart city development, using technologies like AI and cloud-based solutions for energy-efficient buildings and intelligent waste disposal. Projects like Lusail City and Msheireb Downtown showcase Qatar's commitment to smart city innovation, integrating technology with national heritage.

records.description: The Qatar International Agricultural Exhibition (AgriteQ) will be held at Katara Cultural Village. Featuring numerous participating countries and exhibitors, the event will showcase innovative agricultural solutions and methods. Specialized markets for various agricultural products will also be present. Organizers emphasized the exhibition's role in enhancing innovation, exchanging expertise, and attracting investment, aligning with the country's food security strategic plan.

records.title: The farmers' market in Qatif Governorate is thriving, attracting shoppers, farmers, traders, and agricultural companies.
records.description: The farmers' market in Qatif Governorate is thriving, attracting shoppers, farmers, traders, and agricultural companies. The market showcases and supports local crops, empowers farmers, and highlights the region's agricultural wealth, blending local products with heritage events. Sixty booths offer a variety of fresh produce, honey, dates, dairy, and other local delicacies, including organic options. Artisan spaces also feature local crafts, such as calligraphy combined with beads and crystals. A local official emphasized the market's importance in supporting the agricultural sector and national production, aligning with national goals for sustainable development and food security.

records.title: Borouge, a leading petrochemicals company, has signed new supply agreements and collaborations valued at over $100 million, reinforcing i...
records.description: Borouge, a leading petrochemicals company, has signed new supply agreements and collaborations valued at over $100 million, reinforcing its commitment to sustainability. These partnerships with companies like Bericap, Taghleef Industries, INDEVCO Group, and ALPLA will provide advanced polyethylene and polypropylene for use in high-performance closures, durable packaging films, and sustainable packaging solutions. Borouge is focusing on creating innovative materials that improve product safety, reduce wastage, and enhance recyclability. The company is also collaborating with Tahzeem Packaging and Rebound to produce heavy-duty shipping sacks utilizing 30 percent post-consumer recycled (PCR) polyethylene, demonstrating its commitment to a zero-waste strategy.
records.institution: Borouge Plc

records.title: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) has launched "Omani White Flour No.
records.description: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) has launched "Omani White Flour No. 1," a premium flour made entirely from 100% Omani wheat. This versatile flour, enriched with essential nutrients, is suitable for various baking applications. Following its recognition as Oman's Most Powerful Manufacturing Brand, OFM is expanding its operations, including increasing silo capacity, developing food security projects, and supporting local wheat farmers. The company is also pursuing an ambitious growth strategy, exploring acquisitions in the animal feed and sweets and confectionery sectors, aligning with its vision to diversify its operations and contribute to the development of the Omani food industry.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM)

records.title: Dubai Municipality significantly increased its greening efforts in 2024, planting over 216,500 trees and expanding green spaces by 391.5...
records.description: Dubai Municipality significantly increased its greening efforts in 2024, planting over 216,500 trees and expanding green spaces by 391.5 hectares. This aligns with the Dubai Quality of Life Strategy 2033, focusing on urban environment enhancement. Key initiatives included planting a diverse range of trees, including indigenous and ornamental species, and implementing 165 beautification projects across the city. Sustainable practices were emphasized, utilizing recycled water for irrigation. These efforts contribute to enhancing air and soil quality, mitigating climate change impacts.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: UAE plant nurseries importing seeds or saplings need authorization from the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE).
records.description: UAE plant nurseries importing seeds or saplings need authorization from the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE). This involves obtaining an import permit before shipping, which requires specific documentation depending on the type of import (seeds/tubers, plants, etc.). All shipments are inspected upon arrival. Key documents include certificates of origin, phytosanitary certificates, and company authorizations. Specific packaging and labeling requirements apply to seeds. Certain plants from countries with specific diseases or pests are prohibited. The application process is online, involves fees, and permits are valid for six months. A valid agricultural activity license is also required.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) hosted "Renewables Talk" and "Women in Diplomacy" events to celebrate the International Day...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) hosted "Renewables Talk" and "Women in Diplomacy" events to celebrate the International Day of Clean Energy. Held at DEWA’s Sustainability and Innovation Centre, the events were organized by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment and the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA). The events, launched by the UAE through its Permanent Mission to IRENA, aim to facilitate knowledge exchange and enhance communication within the renewable energy sector to drive a sustainable energy transition and achieve net-zero goals. "Renewables Talk" connects IRENA, its representatives, and the diplomatic community, while "Women in Diplomacy" highlights the role of women in the sector and fosters partnerships.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment and the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The 7th International Rain Enhancement Forum (IREF) is set to begin on January 28th.
records.description: The 7th International Rain Enhancement Forum (IREF) is set to begin on January 28th. Held under the patronage of Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan and attended by Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the forum highlights the UAE's dedication to addressing global water challenges through innovation. Organized by the National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) and the UAE Research Program for Rain Enhancement Science (UAEREP), the three-day event also marks UAEREP's 10th anniversary, honoring key contributors and launching the sixth award cycle. Global experts, policymakers, and researchers will discuss water security, weather modification, and advanced technologies, focusing on collaboration, innovation, capacity building, AI, and applied research.
records.institution: The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM)

records.title: A preparatory committee met in Sana'a to plan celebrations for the National Day of Yemeni Coffee.
records.description: A preparatory committee met in Sana'a to plan celebrations for the National Day of Yemeni Coffee. They approved programs including the Sana'a International Coffee Exhibition to promote Yemeni coffee globally. The Minister of Agriculture emphasized supporting coffee farmers with quality seedlings and modern technologies, highlighting coffee's importance as an economic resource and part of Yemen's heritage. The meeting stressed collaboration among stakeholders to ensure the success of these promotional initiatives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.domain: Fisheries and aquaculture measures and regulations
records.title: Oman and Yemen discussed enhancing cooperation in agriculture, fisheries, and water resources.
records.description: Oman and Yemen discussed enhancing cooperation in agriculture, fisheries, and water resources. Oman's Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources met with Yemen's Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates to explore investment and partnership opportunities in food security projects. They also discussed fisheries and livestock issues and emphasized the importance of exchanging expertise and best practices to improve food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Oman has successfully grown blueberry bushes for the first time in a mountainous region.
records.description: Oman has successfully grown blueberry bushes for the first time in a mountainous region. This initiative by the Ministry of Agriculture aims to diversify agriculture and promote sustainable farming by cultivating economically valuable crops suited to colder climates. The project involves growing specific blueberry varieties that require a certain number of cold hours to thrive. Sustainable practices like modern irrigation and organic fertilizer are used. The Ministry is also providing support and guidance to investors and farmers in this new agricultural endeavor.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources
