records.title: Siemens Energy has secured a $1.5 billion contract to build and maintain two gas-fired power plants in Saudi Arabia, named Taiba 2 and Qa...
records.description: Siemens Energy has secured a $1.5 billion contract to build and maintain two gas-fired power plants in Saudi Arabia, named Taiba 2 and Qassim 2. Scheduled to commence operation in 2026, these plants will deliver nearly 4GW of electricity to the kingdom, enhancing its energy infrastructure and replacing older oil-dependent facilities. The project, spanning 25 years, will initially operate in simple cycle mode before transitioning to combined cycle operation in subsequent years. Siemens Energy's advanced gas turbine technology is expected to significantly reduce CO₂ emissions by up to 60% compared to traditional oil-based power plants, supporting Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 goals for economic diversification and sustainable development.
records.institution: Siemens

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia has entered into a partnership with the Brazilian government aimed at enhancing environmental sustainability. This collaboration, initiated during the G20 Young Entrepreneurs Alliance Summit in Goiania, Brazil, involves implementing Saudi digital technology to plant trees in Jataí, Brazil. Dr. Ali Al-Sabhan, Director General of the General Department of Entrepreneurship at the Research and Innovation Agency in the Saudi Ministry of Environment, emphasized the significance of international cooperation in supporting entrepreneurs and advancing sustainable development goals. The partnership will leverage Saudi digital technology to manage carbon emissions and enhance environmental sustainability, marking a pivotal moment in global environmental cooperation.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: Abu Dhabi launches First-of-its-kind Family Business Index
records.description: Abu Dhabi has launched the groundbreaking Family Business Index in partnership with UAE University and the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (ADDED). This initiative aims to rank and analyze family-owned businesses based on key metrics such as revenue, industry impact, governance structures, leadership diversity, and socio-economic contributions. It seeks to deepen understanding of these businesses' role in Abu Dhabi's economy, providing crucial insights for investors, policymakers, and academics. Aligned with Abu Dhabi's family business governance law, the index promotes sustainable economic models and supports smooth generational transitions, reinforcing the emirate's commitment to economic diversification and growth through robust research and strategic planning.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (ADDED) & United Arab Emirates University (UAEU)

records.description: ADNOC expands into Europe with strategic deals across chemicals, renewables, and oil and gas sectors, enhancing its global footprint and diversifying operations. Key moves include advanced talks for Covestro's acquisition, stake acquisitions in OMV and Fertiglobe, and LNG supply agreements with SEFE and EnBW, marking significant steps in securing Europe's energy market amidst geopolitical shifts.

records.title: Dubai-based Alcazar Energy plans to invest $500 million (€466 million) in North Macedonia's largest wind energy project.
records.description: Dubai-based Alcazar Energy plans to invest $500 million (€466 million) in North Macedonia's largest wind energy project. The 400MW Shtip project, located 75km south of Skopje, will increase the country's wind energy capacity more than fivefold. Expected to create over 630 construction jobs, the project will provide clean energy for over 100,000 households annually and reduce CO2 emissions by over 670,000 tonnes per year. This investment aligns with North Macedonia's goal to phase out coal by 2030, as announced at the COP28 climate summit. Alcazar Energy's total planned investments in the western Balkans will reach around $1 billion (€932 million) with this project, alongside the 118MW Bijela wind farm in Montenegro.
records.institution: Alcazar Energy

records.title: Mitsui, in partnership with TA'ZIZ (owned by Adnoc), Fertiglobe, and South Korea's GS Energy Corporation, will construct an ammonia produ...
records.description: Mitsui, in partnership with TA'ZIZ (owned by Adnoc), Fertiglobe, and South Korea's GS Energy Corporation, will construct an ammonia production facility in Al Ruwais, UAE. Starting in 2027, the plant will produce 1 million tons of low-CO2 ammonia annually. To reduce emissions, CO2 capture and storage facilities will be installed, with clean ammonia production planned by 2030. Mitsui will offtake a portion of the clean ammonia for supply to Japan and other Asian markets, supporting decarbonization in fuel, chemical, and fertilizer industries. This project aligns with Mitsui's Global Energy Transition initiative, focusing on next-generation fuels to achieve a decarbonized society.
records.institution: Mitsui

records.title: Non-oil trade between the UAE and Colombia rose to $553 million in 2023, a 43% increase from 2022 and more than double the 2021 levels.
records.description: Non-oil trade between the UAE and Colombia rose to $553 million in 2023, a 43% increase from 2022 and more than double the 2021 levels. This growth comes as the UAE and Colombia signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (Cepa) and launched a new Emirates flight to Bogota. The Cepa, expected to be implemented by the end of 2024, aims to eliminate tariffs on over 95% of product lines, enhance customs cooperation, and improve market access. Sectors of interest include renewable energy, agriculture, tourism, AI, and free zones. The UAE sees potential in collaborating on green hydrogen and technology with Colombia, the third-largest IT services provider in Latin America. Colombia's exports to the UAE include coffee, flowers, fruits, beef, and agro-industrial products, with total exports reaching $289.4 million in 2023. Emirates' new daily flight to Bogota via Miami will facilitate business and leisure travel, enhancing supply chains and economic ties between the two countries. The UAE’s non-oil trade with Latin America hit a record $13.1 billion in 2023, reflecting the growing importance of these markets to the UAE's diversified economic partnerships.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) continues its humanitarian efforts in Lebanon and Sudan.
records.description: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) continues its humanitarian efforts in Lebanon and Sudan. In northern Lebanon's Miniyeh region, KSrelief-funded Souboul Al-Salam Social Association ambulance service completed 56 emergency missions, transporting patients to hospitals and providing first responder services. In Sudan, KSrelief distributed 620 food packages to displaced families at the Shelter Center in Blue Nile State, benefiting approximately 6,131 individuals as part of the third phase of the Food Security Support Project.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: Spinneys 1961 Holding has opened its first store in Riyadh's An Nuzha district, with plans to expand to 12 more locations in Saudi Arabia...
records.description: Spinneys 1961 Holding has opened its first store in Riyadh's An Nuzha district, with plans to expand to 12 more locations in Saudi Arabia by 2028. The new store, part of La Strada Yard development, offers premium products and in-house production capabilities. This expansion aligns with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, aiming to boost the retail sector. Spinneys' recent $375 million IPO attracted significant investor interest, reflecting the company's growth and profitability, with a 12.8% year-on-year increase in quarterly net profit to Dhs75 million and a 10.9% rise in revenue to Dhs815 million.
records.institution: Spinneys

records.title: Dubai's ruler, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al-Maktoum, announced an ambitious $8 billion plan for a comprehensive stormwater runoff system...
records.description: Dubai's ruler, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al-Maktoum, announced an ambitious $8 billion plan for a comprehensive stormwater runoff system aimed at addressing the aftermath of unprecedented floods that paralyzed the city two months earlier. Set to be completed by 2033, the new rainwater drainage network will cover all areas of Dubai, capable of absorbing over 20 million cubic meters of water daily. Sheikh Mohammed highlighted that this initiative will increase the emirate's rainwater drainage capacity by 700 percent, significantly boosting its resilience against future climate challenges. The plan marks Dubai's largest infrastructure project of its kind, addressing the fallout from record-breaking rains that severely impacted the UAE in April, resulting in casualties and extensive damage across the region.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid, Vice President and Ruler of Dubai, has approved the Dh30 billion ($8.16 billion) Tasreef project to improve w...
records.description: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid, Vice President and Ruler of Dubai, has approved the Dh30 billion ($8.16 billion) Tasreef project to improve water drainage in Dubai. Scheduled for completion by 2033, this initiative will enhance the city's ability to manage climate-related challenges by increasing the drainage network's capacity by 700%, capable of handling over 20 million cubic meters of water daily. The project, the largest rainwater collection system in the region, aims to serve Dubai for the next 100 years. Utilizing advanced tunnel boring machines (TBM) with automated control systems, the project ensures continuous monitoring and safety for workers and equipment. This strategic effort follows previous drainage projects launched in 2019 covering areas like Expo Dubai, Al Maktoum International Airport City, and Jebel Ali, and addresses the heavy rainfall challenges experienced in April, the heaviest in 75 years.
records.institution: Dubai Government

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is advancing agricultural sustainability through innovative programs and smart practices, enhancing the sector to support national food security. Operating three applied agricultural research stations, ADAFSA focuses on optimizing resource use and addressing environmental challenges. A key project is the KOREA-UAE Smart Farm Research Project, developing advanced greenhouse models and hydroponic systems. ADAFSA collaborates with Khalifa University to implement modern agricultural technologies, including ICT, AI, post-harvest management, and climate-smart practices, aiming to boost productivity and sustainability in the UAE's agriculture.

records.title: The UAE and Hungary are exploring ways to strengthen their economic partnership.
records.description: The UAE and Hungary are exploring ways to strengthen their economic partnership. In a recent meeting, officials discussed various strategies to enhance bilateral trade and investment opportunities. This fourth session of the joint economic committee focused on sectors such as renewable energy, technology, and tourism, aiming to foster collaboration and mutual growth.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Economy

records.title: Abu Dhabi’s Silal has launched a new 41,000-square-meter food distribution facility in Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD).
records.description: Abu Dhabi’s Silal has launched a new 41,000-square-meter food distribution facility in Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD). Equipped with 36,800 storage platforms, advanced cold rooms, and the latest logistical technologies, this facility is set to become a major food distribution hub in the UAE. It features 38 loading docks and 36 loading points, enhancing transportation logistics and trading opportunities. The facility also includes re-export and repackaging capabilities, helping manage supply chain disruptions. It aims to foster sustainable partnerships with local and global distributors, ensuring a continuous supply of essential food products. This launch is part of Abu Dhabi’s strategy to become a global supply chain hub, supporting the UAE’s food security agenda. Earlier this year, Silal opened a high-tech packhouse in Al Ain, capable of processing 216 tons of fresh produce daily. The packhouse uses advanced technology for efficient post-harvest operations, reinforcing Silal’s commitment to sustainability and local agriculture.
records.institution: Silal

records.title: Masdar, the UAE's renewable energy company, has agreed to acquire an initial 67% stake in Greece's Terna Energy from GEK Terna and other...
records.description: Masdar, the UAE's renewable energy company, has agreed to acquire an initial 67% stake in Greece's Terna Energy from GEK Terna and other shareholders for EUR 20 ($21.45) per share, valuing the company at EUR 2.4 billion with an enterprise value of EUR 3.2 billion. Following regulatory approvals, Masdar plans a mandatory tender offer to acquire the remaining shares, aiming for full ownership. This move is part of Masdar's strategy to expand in Europe, Asia, and the US, with a goal of reaching 100 gigawatts of renewable energy capacity by 2030. Owned by TAQA, Mubadala, and ADNOC, Masdar's investment underscores the UAE’s commitment to clean energy in Greece and Europe.
records.institution: Masdar

records.title: UAE Ministry of Finance Unveils Key New Projects to Boost Competitiveness
records.description: The UAE Ministry of Finance has unveiled strategic projects aimed at boosting the country's financial sector and enhancing global competitiveness. These initiatives align with the UAE's broader strategy to future-proof its economy and reinforce its status as a leading global financial hub over the next decade, in line with the ‘We the UAE 2031’ vision. Minister Mohamed Hadi Al Hussaini emphasized the focus on digital transformation, improving government operations, and attracting foreign investments. Key projects include developing the local debt capital market in collaboration with the Central Bank of the UAE and enhancing the presence of specialized Emirati leaders in international financial forums through partnerships with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. These efforts aim to position the UAE as a prominent player in international cooperation and strengthen its economic partnerships worldwide.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Finance

records.title: Masdar, a UAE-based renewable energy firm owned by ADNOC, has struck a landmark deal to acquire a majority stake in Greece's Terna Energy.
records.description: Masdar, a UAE-based renewable energy firm owned by ADNOC, has struck a landmark deal to acquire a majority stake in Greece's Terna Energy. The acquisition, valued at €2.4 billion in equity and €3.2 billion in enterprise value, marks the largest energy transaction on the Athens Stock Exchange. Masdar plans to initially purchase 67% of Terna's outstanding shares, with intentions to eventually acquire the remaining shares through a mandatory tender offer, aiming for full ownership. This move aligns with Masdar's goal to achieve 100 gigawatts of global renewable energy capacity by 2030, emphasizing their strategic expansion in the European Union's renewables sector.
records.institution: UAE Masdar

records.title: Chinese PV cell manufacturer Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.
records.description: Chinese PV cell manufacturer Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. has announced plans to establish Oman's inaugural solar PV cell factory, aimed at producing up to 10 GW of TOPcon solar photovoltaic cells annually. The project, backed by a preliminary agreement with the Oman Investment Authority (OIA), entails an estimated investment of USD 700 million (EUR 653.3m). Hainan Drinda intends to deploy the production capacity in two phases of 5 GW each, marking a significant milestone in Oman's strategy to bolster its solar energy infrastructure and advance green hydrogen initiatives. This initiative aligns with Oman's broader ambitions to integrate substantial solar power capacity to support its burgeoning green hydrogen production targets, aiming to produce over 1 million tonnes of green hydrogen annually by the decade's end.
records.institution: Hainan Drinda New Energy Technology Co., Ltd.

records.title: Qatar Charity has made a significant impact through its 'Qurbani Program' in Bangladesh, benefiting over 20,000 underprivileged individua...
records.description: Qatar Charity has made a significant impact through its 'Qurbani Program' in Bangladesh, benefiting over 20,000 underprivileged individuals, including orphans and widows. The initiative involved distributing sacrificial animal meat across 18 locations, including orphan care centers, throughout the country. Led by Dr. Mohammad Amin Hafiz Omar, Qatar Charity ensured the efficient and heartfelt delivery of meat, fostering solidarity and compassion during Eid ul-Azha. Government officials also supported the program, underscoring its importance in alleviating food insecurity and bringing joy to vulnerable communities. Recipients, such as widow Salma Akhter and farmer Sultan Ahmed, expressed deep gratitude for Qatar Charity's generosity, highlighting the program's profound impact on their Eid celebrations.
records.institution: Qatar Charity

records.title: Seafood Souq, based in Dubai, has forged an exclusive partnership with Argentine seafood supplier Newsan Food, marking a pivotal developm...
records.description: Seafood Souq, based in Dubai, has forged an exclusive partnership with Argentine seafood supplier Newsan Food, marking a pivotal development in direct seafood exports from Argentina to the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region and beyond. This strategic alliance, highlighted in a recent press release, grants Seafood Souq exclusive distribution rights for Newsan Food products in the GCC. Seafood Souq, known for its innovative digital platform facilitating seafood trading, will leverage this partnership to expand its market reach and enhance trade transparency. Newsan Food, a significant player with annual revenues exceeding US$1 billion, operates a fleet of 40 fishing vessels, 16 processing plants, and three large cold storage facilities, ensuring a robust supply chain for its premium seafood offerings worldwide.
records.institution: Seafood Souq

records.title: Under the Sheikh Zayed Falcon Release Programme, established in 1995 by the late founding father of the UAE, over 2,000 falcons have been...
records.description: Under the Sheikh Zayed Falcon Release Programme, established in 1995 by the late founding father of the UAE, over 2,000 falcons have been successfully reintroduced into their natural habitats after undergoing extensive veterinary examinations, training, and implantation of electronic chips. This milestone marks the programme's 30th edition, with 63 falcons recently released across migratory areas spanning Kazakhstan, Russia, China, Mongolia, and neighboring regions. Supervised by Kazakhstan's Ministry of Agriculture, the initiative underscores Abu Dhabi and the UAE's commitment to wildlife conservation, particularly for falcons and other ecologically significant species. The programme aligns with Sheikh Zayed's legacy of preserving falconry traditions and safeguarding species from extinction through scientific research and habitat restoration efforts.
records.institution: The Forestry and Wildlife Committee in the Kazakh Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The UAE has significantly bolstered its support for humanitarian efforts in Sudan with a pledge of $70 million in aid to UN agencies, as...
records.description: The UAE has significantly bolstered its support for humanitarian efforts in Sudan with a pledge of $70 million in aid to UN agencies, as announced by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. This funding will be directed towards various UN bodies including the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, the World Food Programme, and others, focusing on critical needs such as food, health services, protection for vulnerable groups, and emergency shelter. This initiative underscores the UAE's commitment to addressing the multifaceted humanitarian crisis in Sudan, reflecting its ongoing efforts to provide substantial aid and relief amidst ongoing conflict and displacement.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs

records.title: ACWA Power Co, in partnership with UzKimyoSanoat, has applied for USD 21.2 million in debt funding from the European Bank for Reconstruct...
records.description: ACWA Power Co, in partnership with UzKimyoSanoat, has applied for USD 21.2 million in debt funding from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) to finance a 20-MW hydrogen plant in Uzbekistan's Tashkent region. The project aims to establish an electrolyser in Chirchiq capable of producing 3,000 tonnes of green hydrogen annually. This initiative will leverage electricity from a 52-MW wind farm within the EBRD-backed 500-MW Bash wind complex in Bukhara, southwestern Uzbekistan. The funding request, part of a broader loan package totaling USD 55.4 million, is set for approval by June 26, supporting Uzbekistan's renewable energy ambitions and hydrogen production capabilities.
records.institution: Saudi ACWA Power

records.title: Thailand has received authorization from Saudi Arabia to export live cattle, sheep, and goats, marking a significant development in bilat...
records.description: Thailand has received authorization from Saudi Arabia to export live cattle, sheep, and goats, marking a significant development in bilateral trade relations. Under the agreement, which includes hygiene certificates for livestock, Thai animals can now be imported into Saudi Arabia for rearing and slaughter. This approval, conveyed through Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture to Thailand's embassy in Riyadh, follows earlier approvals for the export of Thai chicken products. The move aims to boost trade between the two countries, with Thailand directing relevant agencies to inform and assist exporters in meeting the necessary regulatory requirements for this new market opportunity.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Emirates Red Crescent (ERC) has initiated a project to distribute sacrificial meat from animals slaughtered during Eid Al Adha in Yem...
records.description: The Emirates Red Crescent (ERC) has initiated a project to distribute sacrificial meat from animals slaughtered during Eid Al Adha in Yemen's Hadhramaut province. On the first day of Eid, 279 portions of meat were distributed to 1,116 families, including vulnerable groups such as people with disabilities and hospital patients. By the end of the holiday, the ERC aims to distribute a total of 904 portions of meat, benefiting approximately 6,328 individuals. This effort is part of the UAE's ongoing humanitarian and relief initiatives, aimed at improving living conditions and supporting underprivileged communities across the Middle East.
records.institution: Emirates Red Crescent

records.title: The UAE is projected to see a substantial increase in the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs), with these vehicles potentially constituti...
records.description: The UAE is projected to see a substantial increase in the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs), with these vehicles potentially constituting up to 25% of all new passenger cars and light commercial vehicle sales by 2035, driven by the country's decarbonisation goals. Currently, EVs account for only 3% of vehicle sales in the UAE, but this figure is expected to rise to over 15% by 2030. Factors influencing this growth include expanding EV model options, investments in charging infrastructure, and declining total ownership costs. The UAE aims to enhance its EV ecosystem swiftly, leveraging lessons from earlier adopter countries to accelerate its transition towards a low-carbon economy under its Energy Strategy 2050.
records.institution: PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwC)

records.title: Bahrain's livestock industry faces a critical challenge following Bahrain Flour Mills' abrupt decision to double the price of wheat bran,...
records.description: Bahrain's livestock industry faces a critical challenge following Bahrain Flour Mills' abrupt decision to double the price of wheat bran, a vital feed for livestock and poultry, effective June 16, 2024. This unexpected hike has stirred deep concerns among farmers and officials alike, with MP Mohammed Yousif Al Maarafi labeling it as a significant threat to food security and a potential detriment to the entire agricultural sector. The move, implemented without prior consultation or explanation, has prompted fears of higher food prices and a shift towards imported livestock, exacerbating the already precarious situation for local breeders and traders.
records.institution: Bahrain Flour Mills

records.title: Under the auspices of Oman's Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, the...
records.description: Under the auspices of Oman's Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, the Saham Agricultural City (SAC) project is poised to revolutionize agricultural and urban development in Oman. Spanning 65 square kilometers, with 70% dedicated to agriculture, SAC aims to ensure food security for 25,000 people annually through innovative practices like hydroponics and aquaculture. Located strategically in Saham for its fertile soil and existing infrastructure, SAC integrates sustainable urban planning with modern agricultural techniques, aligning closely with Oman Vision 2040's goals for economic diversification and environmental sustainability.
records.institution: Omani Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning & Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.description: Broaden Energy has partnered with the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (ADDED) to establish Abu Dhabi’s inaugural hydrogen equipment manufacturing facility, a venture valued at over Dhs1 billion. This initiative, aligned with Abu Dhabi's Industrial Strategy, aims to bolster sustainability efforts, strengthen value chains, and enhance the emirate's industrial competitiveness. Supported by the UAE National Hydrogen Strategy and Net Zero 2050 Strategy, the project seeks to propel the UAE into the top 10 global producers of green hydrogen by 2031, targeting an annual production of 1.4 million tonnes. By fostering hydrogen hubs and infrastructure, the collaboration intends to drive widespread industry adoption and attract international energy leaders, contributing significantly to a sustainable future aligned with the UAE's strategic vision.
records.institution: Broaden Energy

records.title: Kidzink, a Dubai-based educational and architectural firm, in collaboration with UK's Waste to Wonder Worldwide, is set to establish a co...
records.description: Kidzink, a Dubai-based educational and architectural firm, in collaboration with UK's Waste to Wonder Worldwide, is set to establish a community culinary school and sustainable farm in West Africa, specifically in The Gambia. This initiative aims to empower young people with skills in sustainable cooking, agriculture, hospitality, and tourism, fostering environmental consciousness and community development. The project will also engage local community members in employment opportunities and support local businesses. Chef Conor Spacey, renowned for his 'Zero-waste' culinary approach, will contribute expertise in sustainable practices, ensuring the project aligns with circular economy principles. Waste to Wonder Worldwide's involvement will further enhance educational facilities through ethical furniture redistribution, promoting sustainable outcomes and socio-economic empowerment in The Gambia and beyond.
records.institution: Kidzink

records.title: In Doha, Qatar, the Ministry of Municipality, represented by the Agricultural Affairs Department, has launched 13 new electronic services...
records.description: In Doha, Qatar, the Ministry of Municipality, represented by the Agricultural Affairs Department, has launched 13 new electronic services aimed at enhancing digital transformation within the agricultural sector. These services, accessible through the ministry's website, streamline processes such as importing permits for fruits, vegetables, plants, seedlings, palm trees, offshoots, natural wood, and plant parts. Additionally, permits for green and dry grain fodder, fertilizers, agricultural soil enhancers, cut flowers, honeybees, pesticides, and restricted-use fertilizers are now available online. This initiative aligns with Qatar's National Development Strategy 2024-2030 and Qatar National Vision 2030, emphasizing efficiency gains, paperless transactions, and enhanced service accessibility across sectors including agriculture, urban planning, and public services. The project integrates advanced technologies like blockchain, big data analytics, machine learning, and AI to ensure secure, efficient, and user-friendly service delivery round the clock.
records.institution: Qatari Ministry of Municipality

records.description: Minister of Climate Change and Environment Amna bint Abdullah Al Dahak visited the Inter-American Institute for Cooperation on Agriculture (IICA) in Costa Rica, where Director-General Manuel Otero extended an invitation for the UAE to join the organization as an observer country. This invitation aligns with the UAE's proactive role in advancing sustainable agriculture and climate action globally, as evidenced by its initiatives such as hosting COP28 and promoting the Declaration on Sustainable Agriculture, Resilient Food Systems, and Climate Action. The UAE's participation aims to foster collaboration on transforming agrifood systems and enhancing resilience to climate change across the Americas and beyond.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.title: The UAE has expressed keen interest in investing across various sectors in Türkiye, highlighting energy, agriculture, transportation, tou...
records.description: The UAE has expressed keen interest in investing across various sectors in Türkiye, highlighting energy, agriculture, transportation, tourism, and others as potential areas for collaboration. This sentiment was underscored by UAE Energy Minister Suhail al-Mazrouei, who emphasized Türkiye's robust economy and strategic importance as a partner. Al-Mazrouei noted Türkiye's openness to renewable energy, an area where the UAE has significant expertise, suggesting opportunities for expanding renewable energy projects and partnering with Turkish companies. The UAE aims to strengthen bilateral relations through increased investments and strategic partnerships, leveraging Türkiye's role as a crucial hub for energy infrastructure and regional connectivity.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: Yemen Signs Its First Country Programme Framework (CPF) for 2024–2029
records.description: Yemen recently signed its inaugural Country Programme Framework (CPF) for 2024–2029 with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). The agreement, signed by HE Mr. Haytham Adbulmomen Hassan Shoja’aadin and Mr. Hua Liu, outlines strategic areas for technical cooperation to support Yemen's national development goals. These priorities include enhancing nuclear and radiation safety, advancing food and agriculture capabilities, improving health and nutrition services, managing water resources sustainably, and fostering nuclear science and technology. This CPF signifies Yemen's commitment to leveraging nuclear technology for socio-economic progress and environmental sustainability under the guidance and support of the IAEA.
records.institution: International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)

records.title: Oman and Mauritania have engaged in discussions aimed at enhancing their cooperation across various sectors, including fishing, mining, e...
records.description: Oman and Mauritania have engaged in discussions aimed at enhancing their cooperation across various sectors, including fishing, mining, energy, agriculture, logistics, and tourism. During political talks in Nouakchott, Foreign Ministers Sayyid Badr Hamad Al Busaidi of Oman and Mohamed Salem Ould Merzoug of Mauritania explored ways to deepen business partnerships between their private sectors. They also exchanged views on regional and international issues of mutual concern, emphasizing their commitment to promoting security, stability, and peace globally. Additionally, they voiced support for efforts to address the conflict in Gaza through ceasefire agreements and humanitarian aid initiatives, advocating for international law and humanitarian principles to guide these efforts.
records.institution: Omani Ministry of Foreign Affairs

records.title: Oman and Sri Lanka have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in the field of Agriculture, underscoring mutual cooperation and devel...
records.description: Oman and Sri Lanka have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in the field of Agriculture, underscoring mutual cooperation and development in agricultural practices. The agreement, signed by Oman's Ambassador to Sri Lanka, Ahmed Ali al Rashdi, and Sri Lanka's Minister of Agriculture and Plantation Industries, Mahinda Amaraweera, aims to enhance bilateral collaboration in agricultural technologies, research, and sustainable farming methods.
records.institution: Omani Government

records.title: KSrelief is maintaining its commitment to food security in Sudan, as reported by SPA.
records.description: KSrelief is maintaining its commitment to food security in Sudan, as reported by SPA. In the Beheira locality of River Nile State, the agency distributed 581 food packages to support displaced and needy families, reaching a total of 3,340 individuals. Additionally, in Sennar, 500 food packages were delivered to displaced families, benefiting approximately 2,830 individuals in efforts to alleviate food insecurity in the region.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: Silal, a leading agricultural company in the UAE, is pioneering the use of nanotechnology to revolutionize agriculture in the region.
records.description: Silal, a leading agricultural company in the UAE, is pioneering the use of nanotechnology to revolutionize agriculture in the region. This initiative aims to bolster food security, enhance crop productivity, and promote sustainability. Collaborating with Bayer, Silal focuses on integrated pest management, crop protection, and advanced irrigation techniques to optimize farming in the UAE's challenging climate. Additionally, Silal's solar-powered desalination project and partnerships with Khalifa University underscore its commitment to eco-friendly practices and agricultural innovation, positioning it as a key player in shaping the future of UAE agriculture.
records.institution: Silal

records.title: Bahrain Logistics Zone (BLZ) has finalized a lease agreement with Al Daaysi Holding for over 8,400 square meters of land, aimed at develo...
records.description: Bahrain Logistics Zone (BLZ) has finalized a lease agreement with Al Daaysi Holding for over 8,400 square meters of land, aimed at developing a specialized logistics hub for Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), including refrigerated and frozen products. This initiative, announced recently, seeks to enhance Bahrain’s re-exports to Africa and the Middle East while bolstering local food security and consumption. Managed by Ports and Maritime Affairs under Bahrain’s Ministry of Transportation and Telecommunications, BLZ offers customs-bonded zones and a logistics park, providing a range of services to local, regional, and multinational companies since its establishment in 2008 adjacent to Khalifa Bin Salman Port (KBSP) in northern Bahrain.
records.institution: Bahrain Logistics Zone (BLZ) & Al Daaysi Holding

records.title: Saudi Arabia’s King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) and the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) have collabor...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) and the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) have collaborated to rehabilitate a fish landing center in Yemen’s Hodeidah, as reported by the Saudi Press Agency. This initiative is part of an emergency support program aimed at safeguarding the livelihoods of vulnerable populations in Yemen reliant on agriculture, livestock, and fisheries. The project focuses on revitalizing key fish landing centers along Yemen’s coastline and includes provisions such as 1,000 ice boxes and 3,000 life jackets for fishermen in Al-Mahrah governorate. Additionally, it supports local farmers and herders to sustain food production for home consumption and local markets. Hodeidah Governor Al-Hassan Taher expressed gratitude for KSrelief’s support, highlighting the center's role in boosting the marine fishing sector and improving livelihoods by providing essential facilities like solar-powered cold storage to preserve and protect the catch from pollution and damage.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) & Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) continues its humanitarian efforts in Yemen and Syria, focusing on providin...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) continues its humanitarian efforts in Yemen and Syria, focusing on providing essential food supplies to vulnerable individuals and families. In Yemen, KSrelief distributed 2,251 food parcels to 2,251 families across several districts in Abyan and Al-Dhale Governorates, benefiting a total of 15,757 individuals. Meanwhile, in Syria, KSrelief assisted 470 families affected by an earthquake in Harem, Idlib Governorate, by distributing 470 food baskets and hygiene kits. These efforts highlight ongoing support aimed at alleviating hardships and enhancing the well-being of communities facing humanitarian crises in both countries.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: In Abu Dhabi, the launch of AgriFood Growth & Water Abundance (AGWA) represents a transformative initiative aimed at addressing global fo...
records.description: In Abu Dhabi, the launch of AgriFood Growth & Water Abundance (AGWA) represents a transformative initiative aimed at addressing global food shortages and water scarcity. Led by the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (ADDED) and Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO), AGWA has garnered support from major infrastructure partners including Abu Dhabi Ports, Abu Dhabi Airports, Abu Dhabi Distribution Company (ADDC), and Masdar City. These partnerships are crucial in establishing AGWA as a global hub for innovative food production, water technologies, and sustainable practices. The cluster aims to leverage Abu Dhabi's strengths in logistics, energy, and sustainability to support local suppliers, enhance food security, and drive economic growth through technological innovation and strategic infrastructure development. AGWA is set to play a pivotal role in advancing the UAE's National Food Security Strategy 2051 and contributing significantly to the economy with projections of substantial GDP growth, job creation, and investments in the coming years.
records.institution: AgriFood Growth & Water Abundance (AGWA)

records.title: India has authorized an additional export of 10,000 tons of onions to the UAE to stabilize prices ahead of Eid al-Fitr, a period of heigh...
records.description: India has authorized an additional export of 10,000 tons of onions to the UAE to stabilize prices ahead of Eid al-Fitr, a period of heightened demand for consumables like vegetables and spices. This decision aims to impact onion prices in the UAE, which recently surged to over Dh7 per kilogram, contrasting with the usual retail range of Dh2 to Dh3, and promotional prices as low as Dh1. Facilitated through the National Cooperative Exports Ltd (NCEL) under the Ministry of Commerce and Trade's guidance, this export supplements the 14,400 tons shipped last month. The move follows a temporary export ban amidst domestic price increases and aligns with the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (Cepa) between India and the UAE, designed to bolster bilateral trade.
records.institution: Indian National Cooperative Exports Ltd (NCEL)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Razan Al Mubarak, UN Climate Change High-Level Champion for Cop28, highlighted the critical role of ocean conservation at the Mena Oceans...
records.description: Razan Al Mubarak, UN Climate Change High-Level Champion for Cop28, highlighted the critical role of ocean conservation at the Mena Oceans Summit in Dubai, stressing its integration into global climate strategies post-Cop28. She emphasized commitments to preserve coastal ecosystems and scale up ocean-based mitigation efforts, underscoring the UAE Consensus's pivotal role in advancing these goals regionally. Discussions at the summit focused on regional initiatives to protect oceans, including research on resilient corals and sustainable fisheries practices, alongside efforts to engage communities and explore innovative financing mechanisms like "blue bonds" for conservation. The event aimed to catalyze partnerships and actionable steps to safeguard ocean health amidst escalating global challenges.
records.institution: UN Climate Change High-Level Champion for Cop28

records.title: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid, Prime Minister and Ruler of Dubai, highlighted significant advancements in the Emirati Genome Programme durin...
records.description: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid, Prime Minister and Ruler of Dubai, highlighted significant advancements in the Emirati Genome Programme during a UAE Cabinet meeting in Abu Dhabi. With over 600,000 samples collected toward a goal of one million, the initiative aims to map genetic and hereditary diseases in the UAE population. Emphasizing the program's role in developing tailored medical treatments, Sheikh Mohammed also announced the launch of a premarital screening pilot program. The meeting also saw approvals for a federal traffic law accommodating self-driving vehicles and modern transportation technologies, alongside developments in the Federation of Chambers of Commerce and Industry to bolster economic growth and international partnerships.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: IsDB Group and State of Qatar Ink Strategic Cooperation Agreement
records.description: At the Qatar Economic Forum 2024, the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) and Qatar finalized a memorandum of understanding (MoU) for strategic cooperation, aiming to establish a comprehensive Member Country Partnership Strategy (MCPS) for 2024-2028. Signed by H.E. Dr. Muhammad Al Jasser, IsDB Chairman, and H.E. Ali bin Ahmed Al Kuwari, Qatar’s Finance Minister and IsDB Governor, the agreement aligns with Qatar's National Vision 2030 and IsDB's 2023-2025 strategy. This partnership emphasizes Qatar’s role in promoting sustainable economic development and South-South cooperation, focusing on pillars such as economic transformation and cross-cutting areas including women and youth empowerment, climate action, and institutional capacity building.
records.institution: Qatari Ministry of Finance & Islamic Development Bank (IsDB)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Agreements signed at Oman's Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources this week mark a significant step towards establishin...
records.description: Agreements signed at Oman's Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources this week mark a significant step towards establishing commercial-scale microalgae farms for biofuel production in the Sultanate of Oman. This initiative, supported by three companies—Net Zero Solutions (NTZ), Al Tharmad Business and Services Company, and Green Gulf Industries—aims to contribute to sustainable low-carbon fuel production. With an estimated investment of RO 9 million, the project will utilize photobioreactor technology to cultivate microalgae, leveraging residual CO2, heat, and water for efficient production. At full capacity, the project is expected to yield 3,700 tonnes of biofuel annually, supporting Oman's goals in renewable energy and carbon capture efforts.
records.institution: Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation in Yemen has reiterated its ban on importing frozen chicken, emphasizing the need for importer...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation in Yemen has reiterated its ban on importing frozen chicken, emphasizing the need for importers to obtain prior permits before bringing any shipments into the country. This measure aims to protect and promote local chicken production without adversely affecting small poultry producers and breeders. The ban, enforced under Ministerial Resolution No. (20) of 2024, reflects the government's commitment to achieving self-sufficiency in poultry production. The Ministry has warned of strict penalties for violators, including fines and measures to ensure compliance with health and quarantine regulations to safeguard public and animal health. It also plans to publish a blacklist of non-compliant importers and urges adherence to import laws and procedures to maintain food safety standards across the country.
records.institution: Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: FAO recently convened a Regional Training of Trainers workshop in Muscat, Oman, focused on enhancing technical capacities for monitoring...
records.description: FAO recently convened a Regional Training of Trainers workshop in Muscat, Oman, focused on enhancing technical capacities for monitoring and surveillance of the Red Palm Weevil (RPW) using the "SusaHamra" App. Attended by specialists and officials from seven Gulf countries, including Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Yemen, and Oman, the workshop was part of the FAO's efforts under the RPW eradication program. Participants engaged in discussions on RPW management strategies, sharing national plans, and addressing gaps in monitoring systems. The workshop aimed to improve skills in visual inspection, trapping techniques, data collection, validation, and analysis through the SusaHamra platform, essential for decision-making and resource planning in pest control programs. This initiative underscores FAO's commitment to regional cooperation and sustainable management to safeguard palm tree health and agricultural productivity against RPW threats.
records.institution: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Ethiopia have solidified their economic cooperation with the establishment of a joint Saudi-Ethiopian Business Council.
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Ethiopia have solidified their economic cooperation with the establishment of a joint Saudi-Ethiopian Business Council. Signed at the Ethio-Saudi Investment and Trade Forum in Addis Ababa, this agreement marks a significant milestone aimed at enhancing bilateral economic relations. The council will serve as a pivotal platform for Saudi and Ethiopian entrepreneurs to promote their activities, explore investment opportunities, and foster commercial partnerships. Discussions at the forum highlighted potential investments in industrial zones, agriculture, energy, and other key sectors of mutual interest, underscoring the commitment of both nations to deepen their economic ties.
records.institution: The Federation of Saudi Chambers

records.title: Saudi Arabia has joined the multi-country central bank digital currency (CBDC) initiative known as Project mBridge, alongside China and t...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has joined the multi-country central bank digital currency (CBDC) initiative known as Project mBridge, alongside China and the UAE, as part of its strategy to modernize payment systems and reduce reliance on physical cash. The Bank for International Settlements (BIS) confirmed Saudi Arabia's participation as a full member, highlighting the kingdom's interest in leveraging wholesale CBDC to enhance cross-border payment efficiency and settlement between commercial banks. Project mBridge, launched in 2021, aims to facilitate faster and more cost-effective cross-border transactions, particularly in regions with limited financial access. It addresses concerns of financial inclusion by integrating Ethereum Virtual Machine compatibility, allowing for expanded technological solutions and interoperability. The initiative is a key component of the UAE's Financial Infrastructure Transformation program, supported by its Digital Dirham, aiming to bolster global payment infrastructure while ensuring robust security standards.
records.institution: The Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

records.title: Saudi Arabia has announced significant environmental initiatives on World Environment Day 2024, including the establishment of a national...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has announced significant environmental initiatives on World Environment Day 2024, including the establishment of a national academy for the environment and a new program offering incentives and grants tailored to the environmental sector. Celebrated under the theme "Our land. Our future.", the day highlighted the importance of land as a fundamental aspect of global sustainability. Minister of Environment, Water, and Agriculture, Eng. Abdulrahman AlFadley, outlined the academy's role in enhancing human capacity and promoting innovation in collaboration with national and international institutions. The incentives program aims to support eco-friendly practices, research, and investment opportunities across small and medium enterprises, universities, and non-profits. Saudi Arabia's efforts align with global strategies to combat land degradation and climate change, underscored by upcoming initiatives like hosting COP16 of the UNCCD to drive international cooperation on desertification and drought resilience.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: Huhtamaki has announced plans to consolidate its three Flexible Packaging manufacturing sites in the United Arab Emirates, focusing on re...
records.description: Huhtamaki has announced plans to consolidate its three Flexible Packaging manufacturing sites in the United Arab Emirates, focusing on retaining its Jebel Ali factory while expanding operations at the Ras Al Khaimah facility. This strategic move, scheduled to unfold gradually in the latter half of 2024, aims to streamline manufacturing processes, enhance competitiveness, and lay a robust foundation for future growth in the region. The consolidation aligns with Huhtamaki's global strategy to drive efficiency improvements, expected to yield approximately €100 million (US$108.73 million) in savings over the next three years. Despite incurring consolidation-related costs of about €4 million (US$4.35 million) in Q2 2024, this restructuring underscores Huhtamaki's commitment to optimizing its operational footprint while supporting its workforce through transitions to new opportunities.
records.institution: Huhtamaki

records.title: President Sheikh Mohamed of the UAE and President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan held a phone conversation discussing bilateral cooperation a...
records.description: President Sheikh Mohamed of the UAE and President Ilham Aliyev of Azerbaijan held a phone conversation discussing bilateral cooperation and opportunities for further development between their countries. The leaders emphasized collaboration in economic sectors, development initiatives, renewable energy projects, and climate action efforts. A key topic was Azerbaijan's preparations to host Cop29, the upcoming global climate conference scheduled for November in Baku. This follows the UAE's hosting of Cop28 in Dubai, where the UAE Consensus was established to advance global climate action and sustainable development goals.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: The Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE), in collaboration with the Bank for International Settlements Innovation Hub Hong Kong Centre, the Ho...
records.description: The Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE), in collaboration with the Bank for International Settlements Innovation Hub Hong Kong Centre, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the Bank of Thailand, and the Digital Currency Institute of the People’s Bank of China, has launched the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) platform of the mBridge project. This initiative aims to establish a multi-central bank digital currency (CBDC) common platform for wholesale cross-border payments and settlement, utilizing distributed ledger technology. The platform facilitates efficient, low-cost, and instant cross-border payments settled in central bank money. The mBridge project, a key initiative under the CBUAE’s Financial Infrastructure Transformation (FIT) programme, supports the UAE’s CBDC strategy, including Phase 1 implementation with the Digital Dirham. It marks a significant milestone in enhancing international trade and cooperation through improved cross-border payment systems.
records.institution: The Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE)

records.title: In Unaiza, Saudi Arabia, the annual date market showcases the region's pivotal role in the date industry, trading 280 tons of dates daily.
records.description: In Unaiza, Saudi Arabia, the annual date market showcases the region's pivotal role in the date industry, trading 280 tons of dates daily. Located in the Qassim region, the event highlights various date varieties, including the esteemed Sukkari. Prices vary widely, from 5 riyals for 3 kg to 700 riyals, reflecting quality differences. Auctioneers facilitate sales, crucial for global exports, reaching approximately 50 countries last year despite pandemic-related visitor restrictions. This year, exports aim to expand to 60 countries, targeting 20,000 tons of dates from Saudi Arabia's annual production of 1.4 million tons, supported by the National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD).
records.institution: Saudi National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD)

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources, Bandar bin Ibrahim Al-Khorayef, met with Moroccan counterparts to strengthen e...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources, Bandar bin Ibrahim Al-Khorayef, met with Moroccan counterparts to strengthen economic ties between the two nations. Discussions focused on enhancing cooperation in mining, developing economic sectors, and bolstering financial institutions. Key areas included advancing the phosphate industry, optimizing phosphate fertilizer competitiveness, and facilitating regional mineral trade. The talks also addressed collaborative efforts in export promotion and supporting Saudi exports in Morocco, underscoring mutual strategic interests in industrial and mining sectors.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources

records.description: Uzbekistan and Saudi Arabian ACWA Power are advancing joint investment projects following discussions between President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and Muhammad Abunayyan, co-chairman of the Uzbek-Saudi Business Council and chairman of ACWA Power. The talks, held on June 4, focused on ongoing investment initiatives and expanding cooperation with Saudi firms. President Mirziyoyev praised the success of ACWA Power's contributions to Uzbekistan's energy sector, highlighting a combined project portfolio exceeding $17 billion. Emphasis was placed on accelerating joint projects in construction, airport management, digital and energy infrastructure modernization, heat supply networks expansion, waste processing, pharmaceuticals, oncology clinics, tourism, textile clusters, and agricultural development.
records.institution: Saudi ACWA Power

records.title: Ambassador Abdulaziz Akkulov of Uzbekistan met with Raya Almazrouei, Director General of UAE's Etihad Credit Insurance, to discuss insuri...
records.description: Ambassador Abdulaziz Akkulov of Uzbekistan met with Raya Almazrouei, Director General of UAE's Etihad Credit Insurance, to discuss insuring export-import contracts for agricultural products between the two countries. They emphasized the growing interest of UAE companies in importing Uzbek agricultural goods and the need for reliable partnerships and connections. During the meeting, a memorandum of understanding was signed between Etihad Credit Insurance and Uzbekinvest, aiming to facilitate and secure trade transactions, reflecting mutual efforts to strengthen bilateral economic ties.
records.institution: Etihad Credit

records.title: President Sheikh Mohamed of the UAE met with Afghanistan's Interior Minister, Sirajuddin Haqqani, at Al Shati Palace in Abu Dhabi to disc...
records.description: President Sheikh Mohamed of the UAE met with Afghanistan's Interior Minister, Sirajuddin Haqqani, at Al Shati Palace in Abu Dhabi to discuss bilateral relations and regional stability. The meeting focused on economic cooperation and supporting Afghanistan's reconstruction efforts following years of conflict. Haqqani expressed a desire to strengthen ties with Sheikh Mohamed, emphasizing mutual cooperation in various developmental sectors. Notably, no country has formally recognized the Taliban government in Afghanistan since its takeover in 2021, although several nations, including those in the Gulf region, have engaged with Kabul on diplomatic levels.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: In Wenchang City, Hainan Province, the "China-UAE Friendship Forest of Date Palm" showcases accelerated fruiting of date palm trees, a re...
records.description: In Wenchang City, Hainan Province, the "China-UAE Friendship Forest of Date Palm" showcases accelerated fruiting of date palm trees, a result of successful cooperation between China and the UAE in the date palm industry. Led by Hu Wei of the Coconut Research Institute, advancements include the rapid fruiting of date palms within two years, compared to the typical three to five years in Arab countries. This collaboration, initiated with a UAE donation of 100,000 date palm seedlings in 2019, emphasizes technology transfer and cultivation techniques, enhancing ecological restoration efforts in hot regions like Hainan and Yunnan.
records.institution: Coconut Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Tropical Agricultural Sciences

records.description: Saudi Arabia and the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) will host World Environment Day on June 5 in Riyadh under the theme "Our Land, Our Future." The event, at the King Abdulaziz International Conference Center, aims to highlight Saudi Arabia's commitment to environmental protection and sustainable development in alignment with Vision 2030 goals. Focus areas include land restoration, combating desertification, and enhancing drought resilience, reinforcing global initiatives like the G20 Global Land Initiative and upcoming UNCCD COP16 session in Riyadh.

records.description: Italian Ambassador to the UAE, Lorenzo Fanara, emphasizes the strong bilateral ties between Italy and the UAE, aiming to build enduring bridges through cultural diplomacy amid global challenges. He highlights the revitalization of relations, citing increased trade and significant cultural exchanges, including Italian cultural events in the UAE. Fanara also discusses Italy's humanitarian efforts in Gaza and its stance on immigration, stressing the need for legal and humane migration policies in Europe.

records.title: Fisheries Development Oman (FDO) has proudly commissioned the state-of-the-art fishing vessel "ADAMAS" under its subsidiary Oman Pelagic,...
records.description: Fisheries Development Oman (FDO) has proudly commissioned the state-of-the-art fishing vessel "ADAMAS" under its subsidiary Oman Pelagic, marking a significant advancement in Oman's fisheries sector. Built to the highest international standards at Zamakona Shipyard in Spain, ADAMAS epitomizes FDO's commitment to sustainable fishing practices and economic growth. With a length of 84 meters and a capacity of 1200 tonnes, ADAMAS is equipped with advanced environmental instruments and biodegradable fish aggregation devices, ensuring operational efficiency and ecosystem conservation. This milestone underscores Oman's dedication to enhancing food security and bolstering its maritime legacy in line with Oman Vision 2040.

The initiative, conducted in collaboration with the Ministry of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries and Water Resources, aims to meet growing regional demand for high-quality Omani agricultural products while expanding market presence and farmer participation.

This initiative is part of their efforts to enhance food security and promote local wheat cultivation. CEO Haitham bin Mohammed al-Fannah highlighted the company's ongoing support for farmers, collaborating with the Ministry of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries, and Water Resources to expand wheat production.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills Company

records.title: The Central Bank of Yemen, based in Sana’a, has issued a ban on 13 financial institutions, both local and international, prohibiting deal...
records.description: The Central Bank of Yemen, based in Sana’a, has issued a ban on 13 financial institutions, both local and international, prohibiting dealings with them due to violations of Yemeni laws and the Central Bank's regulations. These violations include conducting banking activities without proper licensing, breaching Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing laws, and collaborating with internationally convicted entities involved in corruption, money laundering, and terrorist financing. Furthermore, these institutions have been accused of leaking financial data to hostile entities, posing a threat to Yemen's national security.
records.institution: Central Bank of Yemen

The session emphasized collaboration across sectors and saw the signing of agreements and MoUs. Abdul Aleem Khan highlighted the importance of private sector engagement and urged Kuwait to ease visa procedures. Dr. Kazim Niaz emphasized the potential of the JMC in fostering cooperation. Discussions covered various sectors, and both sides agreed to establish Joint Working Groups.
records.institution: Kuwait Fund

records.title: CESCO EPC and United Feed Co.
records.description: CESCO EPC and United Feed Co. (UFC) have partnered on a significant storage and conveying project in Saudi Arabia, focusing on enhancing UFC's capacity with 15 corrugated steel flat-bottom storage silos totaling 205,152 tonnes. Designed for storing grains, cereals, and oilseeds, the facility includes advanced features like high-capacity receiving lines, state-of-the-art cleaning processes, and a versatile reclaiming system for efficient material distribution. CESCO's comprehensive conveyor system ensures operational efficiency and supports future expansion plans, reinforcing UFC's role in Saudi Arabia's food industry and enhancing regional food security through stable feedstock supply capabilities.
records.institution: CESCO EPC & United Feed Co. (UFC)

records.title: Iyris, a startup operating in Riyadh, Abu Dhabi, and Delaware, has secured $16 million in Series A funding to address the challenges of c...
records.description: Iyris, a startup operating in Riyadh, Abu Dhabi, and Delaware, has secured $16 million in Series A funding to address the challenges of climate change in agriculture. Led by the San Francisco-based climate and sustainability fund Ecosystem Integrity Fund (EIF), the investment will support Iyris' innovative agricultural solutions, particularly its flagship technology, SecondSky. Developed from innovations at the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), SecondSky utilizes an additive in polyethylene manufacturing to block heat while allowing essential light for photosynthesis, enabling farmers to reduce cooling costs and water usage. This technology has gained traction globally, especially in regions facing harsh growing conditions due to climate change. By extending growing seasons and increasing yields, Iyris aims to enhance food security while maintaining profitability for farmers.

This achievement was highlighted during the second edition of the Government Digital Transformation Forum, held alongside the COMEX Show. The forum served as a platform to showcase government institutions' achievements in adopting digital technologies, discussing best practices, future trends, and innovative solutions to enhance public services and skill development within the sultanate. H E Shidhani outlined Oman's progress, emphasizing the commitment to digital transformation and the significant increase in electronic transactions and services digitization. Notably, efforts have simplified numerous services and digitized a substantial portion of basic government services, marking significant progress towards the goal of digitizing all essential services by 2025.

HE Mr Ali bin Ahmed Al Kuwari, Qatar's Minister of Finance, and HE Mohamed Hadi Al Hussaini, UAE Minister of State for Financial Affairs, signed the agreement. The signing ceremony, attended by H.E. Mr. Khalifa bin Jassim Al-Kuwari, President of the General Tax Authority, symbolizes Qatar's commitment to bolstering economic relations and trade cooperation with sisterly countries. records.title: Saudi Arabia has initiated a new share sale for state oil giant Aramco, with plans to raise up to $13.1 billion.
records.description: Saudi Arabia has initiated a new share sale for state oil giant Aramco, with plans to raise up to $13.1 billion. The sale, aimed at funding Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's economic diversification agenda, involves offering approximately 1.545 billion Aramco shares, equivalent to about 0.64% of the company's stake, at a pricing range of 26.7 to 29 riyals per share. An additional greenshoe option could potentially increase the value to $13.1 billion, allowing the sale of nearly 1.7 billion shares. About 10% of the offering will be reserved for retail investors. Aramco's CEO, Amin Nasser, highlighted the opportunity to expand the shareholder base and increase liquidity through this offering. The move follows Aramco's record-setting IPO in 2019, which raised $29.4 billion. The proceeds from the latest sale will contribute to financing domestic projects aimed at diversifying Saudi Arabia's economy away from oil dependency. This initiative aligns with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's vision to invest in various sectors, including renewable energy, technology, tourism, logistics, and manufacturing, to stimulate long-term economic growth. Joint global coordinators for the deal include Morgan Stanley, Citi, Goldman Sachs, HSBC, Saudi National Bank, Bank of America, and JPMorgan, with several local banks serving as joint bookrunners.
records.institution: Aramco

records.description: Saudi Arabia is prioritizing solar power as part of its energy transition efforts, despite its significant oil reserves. The Sudair solar project near Riyadh exemplifies this commitment, with vast arrays of solar panels capable of powering thousands of homes. While renewables currently contribute minimally to the country's electricity generation, Saudi Arabia aims to increase its renewable energy output to around 50 percent by 2030. However, analysts anticipate challenges in achieving this ambitious target, emphasizing the need for continued investment and innovation in the renewable energy sector.

records.description: Saudi Arabia reaffirmed its commitment to tackling challenges in agricultural development and food security, both domestically and internationally, during an extraordinary virtual meeting of the GCC Agriculture and Food Security Agents Committee. The meeting focused on assessing the current food security situation in the GCC, exploring opportunities for regional cooperation, and developing strategies to enhance food security. records.description: The UAE and South Korea have entered into a comprehensive economic partnership agreement (CEPA), signaling a significant move towards free trade and enhanced investment between the two nations. Dr. Thani bin Ahmed Al Zeyoudi, Minister of State for Foreign Trade, and Ahn Duk-geun, Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy of South Korea, inked the agreement in Seoul. As part of the UAE's CEPA foreign trade program, aimed at boosting non-oil foreign trade, the agreement will gradually eliminate tariffs on over 90 percent of imports from both countries over the next decade, fostering cooperation in key sectors like energy, healthcare, advanced industries, and more. The visit of President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan to Seoul saw the signing of 19 business agreements, spanning investment, energy, defense, and technology. Noteworthy deals include the UAE's commitment to invest $30 billion in South Korea and cooperation frameworks on climate change and energy infrastructure development.

records.description: A delegation of Saudi companies, coordinated by the National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD), recently visited Alibaba Group's headquarters in Hangzhou to explore opportunities in the Chinese market and amplify the promotion of Saudi dates globally. Mohammed Al Nuwairan, CEO of NCPD, emphasized that featuring Saudi dates on Alibaba's expansive platform would facilitate their access to global markets, building upon the partnership established during the World of Dates Expo in Riyadh last December. The visit underscores NCPD's commitment to supporting Saudi date exports and positioning them as a preferred choice worldwide. records.title: The Kuwaiti market is set to receive 800 Naimi sheep from Jordan ahead of Eid Al-Adha, part of a larger shipment of 10,000 sheep expected...
records.description: The Kuwaiti market is set to receive 800 Naimi sheep from Jordan ahead of Eid Al-Adha, part of a larger shipment of 10,000 sheep expected to enter the country. These sheep will enter through the Abdally border, marking the first time since 1990. Due to previous sheep shortages during Eid Al-Adha, alternative arrangements were made, with sheep being imported through Iraq instead of Saudi Arabia, which currently has blocked roads. The Kuwait General Administration of Customs and Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources have provided assistance in facilitating this process. Additionally, sheep from Turkiye and Syria will also be imported to ensure a sufficient supply in the local market, which is expected to reduce prices by approximately 15 percent.

records.title: A national campaign in the UAE has successfully eliminated 409 mosquito breeding sites, reducing the risk of dengue fever infections.
records.description: A national campaign in the UAE has successfully eliminated 409 mosquito breeding sites, reducing the risk of dengue fever infections. Specialist teams deployed by the Emirates Health Services Corporation conducted surveys and monitored virus-carrying mosquitoes using GPS trackers. The campaign included analyzing 309 blood samples for mosquito DNA to determine effective pesticides. Health facilities were equipped to handle dengue fever cases, as incidents increased due to population control measures and wet weather creating more breeding sites.

Sebastian Carlton, CEO of Pure Food Technology, underscores the significance of advanced technology in meeting growing food demands, emphasizing the farm's potential to contribute to the UAE's self-reliance in food production and support sustainability goals. The aim is to boost poultry production, elevating the company's market share in an industry currently totaling over 250 million birds annually, with plans to reach 450 million birds by 2027. The announcement, made during the expo's third edition inaugurated by the Minister of Environment, Water, and Agriculture, Eng. records.title: Since November, the UAE has delivered nearly 50,000 tonnes of urgent supplies to Gaza as part of its aid mission to assist those affected...
records.description: Since November, the UAE has delivered nearly 50,000 tonnes of urgent supplies to Gaza as part of its aid mission to assist those affected by the conflict in the enclave. According to figures from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, this aid was transported via 260 flights and 1,243 lorries up until May 13. Additionally, three aid ships carrying 13,190 tonnes of aid departed for Egypt’s Al Arish Port as part of Operation Gallant Knight 3, with the intention of distributing the aid to Gaza. As part of its assistance program, the UAE has established two hospitals in Gaza, one of which includes a center for amputees providing prosthetic limbs to Palestinians injured during the conflict. The field hospital in the southern Gaza Strip, staffed with over 100 medical professionals, has treated 20,503 cases since December 2, offering services such as general surgery, orthopedics, intensive care, internal medicine, dentistry, family medicine, and psychiatric treatment. Additionally, the UAE provided a 100-bed floating hospital in Al Arish Port, equipped with operating rooms, intensive care facilities, a laboratory, a pharmacy, and medical warehouses. Six desalination plants provided by the UAE are capable of producing 1.2 million gallons of clean drinking water per day for 600,000 people. Furthermore, the UAE supplied five automated bakeries in Gaza, producing bread for up to 72,000 people and enough flour for eight existing bakeries, feeding 17,140 people daily. Additionally, the UAE facilitated the transfer of 671 individuals from Gaza to the UAE for medical treatment, accompanied by 735 family members.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs

records.title: Tadweer Group is set to build Abu Dhabi’s first-ever dedicated Material Recovery Facility (MRF), a key milestone in diverting waste from...
records.description: Tadweer Group is set to build Abu Dhabi’s first-ever dedicated Material Recovery Facility (MRF), a key milestone in diverting waste from landfills and promoting recycling. This state-of-the-art facility will process 1.3 million metric tonnes of waste annually, recovering valuable recyclable materials like metals and plastics. The initiative aligns with Tadweer Group’s goal of diverting 80% of Abu Dhabi’s waste by 2030 and supports the circular economy principles. Expected to commence operations by the end of 2026, the MRF will not only contribute to waste management but also create job opportunities and promote private sector investment in the UAE.
records.institution: Tadweer Group

records.description: Construction is set to begin on the $3bn UAE-Oman Hafeet Rail, spanning 303 km from Abu Dhabi to Sohar with a stop in Al Ain. Trains will travel at speeds exceeding 200km/hour, reducing travel time between Abu Dhabi and Sohar to just 100 minutes. A shareholder agreement has been signed among Etihad Rail, Oman Rail, and Mubadala Investment Company to kick off the project, with civil works awarded to an Omani-Emirati alliance. Siemens and HAC will equip the railway fleet with advanced technologies, enhancing reliability through GPS-based train control and tracking.

records.title: Oman's livestock exports surged by 45% in 2023, reaching US$8.3 million, according to data from the National Centre for Statistics and In...
records.description: Oman's livestock exports surged by 45% in 2023, reaching US$8.3 million, according to data from the National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI). Camels led the list of exported livestock, with the United Arab Emirates emerging as the top importer, followed by Yemen and Saudi Arabia. Additionally, livestock re-exports saw a significant 97% growth, reaching US$239.89 million. Oman's meat market is also on the rise, with revenue reaching US$913.30 million in 2024, and projections suggest continued growth in both consumption and production in the coming years.

records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, "Reef Saudi," has allocated a significant investment of SAR 140 million (US$37 million) to enhance Saudi Arabia's honey sector, benefiting over 10,584 individuals in rural regions. Through initiatives like establishing queen bee breeding stations and providing essential services to beekeepers, Reef Saudi seeks to strengthen the local bee population and promote self-sufficiency in honey production while addressing disease and pest concerns. Additionally, the program has deployed mobile laboratories and clinics to support bee health and productivity in the field.

records.title: Oman’s Ministry of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries, and Water Resources is ramping up efforts to ensure water security by maintaining and...
records.description: Oman’s Ministry of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries, and Water Resources is ramping up efforts to ensure water security by maintaining and enhancing the efficiency of dams and aflaj systems across the country. Through rigorous monitoring and targeted maintenance programs, the Ministry is safeguarding the operational integrity of dams while preserving Oman’s rich water heritage embodied in its aflaj networks. One notable project is the groundwater recharge dam in Wadi Imti, established in 2014, which plays a pivotal role in bolstering Izki’s groundwater reserve. With a storage capacity of approximately 0.7 million cubic meters, this dam significantly contributes to water levels in nearby wells and aflaj systems, benefiting various villages. Engineer Youssef bin Masoud bin Ali Al-Mandhari, Director of the Dams Department, highlighted the broader objective of enhancing water resources, particularly in agriculturally significant areas, while Mohammed bin Abdullah Al Riyami underscored the dam's critical role in sustaining agricultural productivity by increasing water levels in the Falaj system.

records.description: Saudi Arabia's Almunajem Foods Company is set to embark on a new venture with a $41.88 million investment in a food factory project in Jeddah. With construction scheduled to begin in the third quarter of 2024 and operations targeted for the first quarter of 2026, the factory will have an annual production capacity of 35,000 tonnes, covering poultry, red meat, seafood, and dairy products. Spanning 56,000 square meters in Jeddah's Third Industrial City, the project is expected to be self-financed with additional external funding. Despite recent financial challenges, Almunajem Foods remains optimistic about its future, anticipating modest growth in earnings per share and eyeing long-term expansion opportunities.

Eng Ahmed Khalid Othman from ADAFSA highlights the government's commitment to supporting small farmers and enhancing food security.
