records.title: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, in his role as the Ruler of Dubai, issued Law No.
records.description: Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, in his role as the Ruler of Dubai, issued Law No. (1) of 2024 concerning the taxation of foreign banks in Dubai. This law mandates a 20% tax on the annual taxable income of all foreign banks operating outside the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), including those in special development and free zones. The tax paid can be offset by any corporate tax already paid under Federal Law No. (47) of 2022. The law outlines the procedures for tax calculation, filing, audits, and voluntary disclosures. Additionally, banks have the right to object to tax assessments and fines—which can reach up to AED1 million for repeat offenses—with the Department of Finance. This law, effective from the tax year following its enactment, replaces Regulation No. (2) of 1996 and will be implemented by decisions published in the Official Gazette.
records.institution: Central Bank of the UAE

With non-oil trade between the two countries reaching US$764.5 million in 2023, the proposed CEPA aims to remove or reduce tariffs and trade barriers, improve market access, and establish investment pathways in sectors such as agriculture, renewable energy, logistics, education, professional services, and healthcare..

The 5-gigawatt Aral wind power project was formalized at the Tashkent International Investment Forum, attended by key figures such as Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev, Prime Minister Abdulla Aripov, and Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud. records.description: Bahrain Flour Mills Co., a Bahraini public shareholding company, is gearing up for expansion and modernization as its profits surge by 76%. With a strategic focus on ensuring long-term food security and delivering value-added products in the Gulf region, the company plans to construct a new, cutting-edge flour mill and prioritize digital transformation to meet Bahrain's flour demands. Basim Al Saie, the company's chairman, highlighted the significance of this project, emphasizing its role in enhancing food security and diversifying product offerings. The new mill, a national food security initiative, will feature advanced technology and cater to Bahrain's flour needs for the next few decades. Alongside physical expansion, the company is embracing digital solutions, transitioning to a new ERP system and establishing an e-commerce platform to enhance customer experiences. This strategic move comes on the heels of previous successful expansion plans and a significant surge in net profit for the year ended December 31, 2023. The company attributes this growth to record sales of subsidized products and increased market value of equity investments.
records.institution: Bahrain Flour Mills Co.

These initiatives aim to utilize 4.5 gigawatts of renewable energy to produce approximately 178,000 tons of green hydrogen annually by 2030, primarily for a new ammonia plant in the Salalah Free Zone. Highlighting Oman's strategic advantage between Europe and Asia, Salim Nasser Al Aufi, Oman’s Minister of Energy and Minerals, emphasized the country's strong infrastructure and early entry into the global hydrogen market. With additional agreements, including a recent $10 billion investment for projects in the Al Wusta governorate, Oman’s total hydrogen production capacity is expected to reach 1.38 million tons per year by the decade's end, positioning it as a key player in the international green hydrogen and ammonia production landscape.

records.description: DP World leads the way as the first company globally to unveil a Sustainable Development Impact Disclosure (SDID), in collaboration with the Impact Disclosure Taskforce. During a four-month public consultation period, DP World invites industry feedback to refine the guidance, ensuring it effectively addresses stakeholders' needs.

records.description: Saudi Arabia is actively working to boost its seafood production to meet rising domestic demand, aiming for an output of 230,000 metric tons in 2024. This represents a significant increase from the 214,600 metric tons produced in 2023. The country's fish consumption has historically surpassed production, necessitating heavy reliance on imports. To address this, the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture is accelerating the development of 16 fishing ports along its extensive coastline, which spans 2,500 kilometers across the Persian Gulf and the Red Sea. These ports are expected to enhance marine fish production, which is a major component of the national seafood output. Additionally, the government is encouraging private investment in the sector by offering financial incentives, including covering 75% of capital expenditures for fisheries projects, providing interest-free loans, and offering discounts on fishing equipment.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

As part of the project, solar power stations will be established in nine areas to improve water availability, accompanied by training for local technicians.

records.title: India has relaxed its export restrictions on onions, aiming to alleviate high onion prices and meet demand from Sri Lanka and the UAE.
records.description: India has relaxed its export restrictions on onions, aiming to alleviate high onion prices and meet demand from Sri Lanka and the UAE. This adjustment is part of India's broader strategy to manage regional trade dynamics, especially in light of China's growing influence. The move follows similar easing of restrictions for the Maldives due to tense bilateral relations. Previously, India, a major onion exporter, had imposed limits that contributed to price surges in dependent countries. The new "special quota" system now allows onion exports to several nations including Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Mauritius, Bahrain, and Bhutan, with resumed shipments to the Maldives under an exemption from future export bans valid through the 2024-25 fiscal year.
records.institution: Indian Government

records.description: The Mleiha dairy farm in the UAE is set to become the largest clean milk production project within three years, boasting 1,250 cows initially with plans to expand to 5,000 cows. Daily milk production is expected to surge from 75 to 310 tons, backed by a budget of approximately Dh600 million. Operational insights reveal a meticulous approach, with cows not subjected to medical interventions or growth enhancers, and a focus on A2A2 protein-rich milk known for its health benefits. Cutting-edge technology, including smart collars monitoring various aspects of cow health, enhances efficiency and animal welfare. The farm integrates innovative systems like water sprinklers and autonomous robots for streamlined operations. Packaging innovation ensures milk quality preservation, aligning with the farm's commitment to sustainable, high-quality production.

records.title: At the inaugural World Economic Forum Special Meeting held in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia has pledged a substantial $500 million...
records.description: At the inaugural World Economic Forum Special Meeting held in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia has pledged a substantial $500 million over the next five years to support the Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI). This significant increase in funding aims to vaccinate over 370 million children annually against polio, bolstering efforts to end the disease globally. The pledge, made in collaboration with key partners including the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, Gavi, Rotary International, and others, underscores Saudi Arabia's commitment to improving global health outcomes. In addition to addressing polio, the funding will strengthen health systems and provide essential interventions to underserved communities, aligning with broader efforts to enhance healthcare resilience worldwide.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.title: SABIC, in collaboration with Napco National and FONTE, has introduced the first circular packaging project in Saudi Arabia, a significant...
records.description: SABIC, in collaboration with Napco National and FONTE, has introduced the first circular packaging project in Saudi Arabia, a significant step towards a circular plastic economy. FONTE's bread bags, manufactured by Napco National, utilize SABIC's certified circular polyethylene (PE), derived from pyrolysis oil generated from recycled post-consumer plastics. This innovative approach marks a milestone in Saudi Arabia's sustainable packaging journey, aligning with SABIC's TRUCIRCLE program to promote circularity in plastic usage and address environmental concerns.
records.institution: SABIC, Napco, & FONTE

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM), a subsidiary of Oman Food Investment Holding Company (Nitaj), is embarking on an ambitious expansion strategy acr...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM), a subsidiary of Oman Food Investment Holding Company (Nitaj), is embarking on an ambitious expansion strategy across the Gulf region, eyeing acquisitions in various food-related sectors. With a diverse portfolio spanning grain imports, milling, bakery operations, and more, OFM aims to capitalize on growth opportunities within the food industry. Plans include venturing into the animal feed sector and confectionery business, with Atyab Investments spearheading acquisition processes. Additionally, Atyab Food Industries (AFI) is nearing the acquisition of a prominent bakery in Oman.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills (OFM)

records.title: Qatar Charity has launched an automated bread production line in northern Syria as part of its ongoing efforts to enhance food security i...
records.description: Qatar Charity has launched an automated bread production line in northern Syria as part of its ongoing efforts to enhance food security in the region. This initiative, situated in the Afrin district, is a component of Qatar Charity's broader project, 'Support the Wheat Value Chain,' which has been ongoing for five years. The newly established bread production line has the capacity to produce 15,000 loaves of bread daily, catering to the needs of over 50,000 people, including those residing in displacement camps. The ultimate objective of Qatar Charity is to foster self-sufficiency among the crisis-affected population in northern Syria. Aref Mohammed Ali, Director of Services and member of the Local Council in Maabatli, expressed gratitude for Qatar Charity's contribution, emphasizing the importance of the automated bread production line in alleviating financial burdens and enhancing food security in the region.
records.institution: Qatar Charity

records.title: Qatar Museums' Cultural Heritage Protection department has introduced the Al Zubarah Trashboom Project, an environmental initiative aimed...
records.description: Qatar Museums' Cultural Heritage Protection department has introduced the Al Zubarah Trashboom Project, an environmental initiative aimed at combatting ocean pollution and safeguarding Qatar's Unesco World Heritage Site. This project, launched on International Earth Day, utilizes Trash Booms strategically deployed along rivers, sea streams, and beaches to deflect, contain, and collect various pollutants, including marine waste and plastics. Supported by the Ras Laffan Industrial City Community Outreach Programme, the project repurposes collected waste material for fittings within the site and uses Trash Boom anchors as artificial reefs, enriching marine biodiversity in Al Zubarah Bay. This multifaceted approach aligns with Qatar's commitment to long-term sustainability and the preservation of its cultural treasures, enhancing the site's ecological footprint while addressing environmental concerns.
records.institution: Qatar Museum

records.title: ACWA Power, a prominent Saudi energy company renowned for its focus on renewable energy, has entered into a new agreement aimed at expedi...
records.description: ACWA Power, a prominent Saudi energy company renowned for its focus on renewable energy, has entered into a new agreement aimed at expediting the development of renewable energy projects in Azerbaijan. The agreement, finalized with SOCAR, the State Oil Company of the Azerbaijan Republic, builds upon an initial cooperation understanding signed in February 2023. This new deal primarily centers on the joint assessment of the "Low-Carbon/Green Fertilizer" project, wherein both entities will collaborate to evaluate the production of green hydrogen to support the decarbonization of SOCAR downstream assets. Marco Arcelli, CEO of ACWA Power, expressed pride in the collaboration with SOCAR, emphasizing the shared commitment to sustainability and the potential for driving innovation in renewable energy development in Azerbaijan. The agreement's main focus is to enhance SOCAR's carbamide fertilizer facility, aiming for the production of more value-added low-carbon products. As part of the project, feasibility studies will be conducted to assess the potential production and sale of green fertilizers, aligning with Azerbaijan's vision for a clean environment. ACWA Power will play a crucial role in advancing the renewable energy and green hydrogen production aspects of the project, leveraging its expertise in these areas. Anar Mammadov, vice president of SOCAR, highlighted Azerbaijan's commitment to building a sustainable future and underscored the significance of the partnership with ACWA Power in driving renewable energy development in the region. This collaboration marks a significant step in Azerbaijan's transition toward a low-carbon economy and demonstrates the commitment of both organizations to sustainable development practices.
records.institution: ACWA Power

records.title: Abu Dhabi's clean energy company Masdar is considering entering the Chinese market to bolster its renewable energy capacity, aiming to re...
records.description: Abu Dhabi's clean energy company Masdar is considering entering the Chinese market to bolster its renewable energy capacity, aiming to reach 100 gigawatts by 2030. Evaluating potential partnerships and market strategies, Masdar recognizes China's significance in the renewable energy landscape, with the country installing 298 gigawatts of renewable energy capacity in 2023, according to the International Renewable Energy Agency.

records.title: The UAE and Colombia have completed the first phase of their Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), marking a significant m...
records.description: The UAE and Colombia have completed the first phase of their Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), marking a significant milestone in strengthening their trade and investment ties. The Ministry of Economy highlighted that both countries are actively working together to finalize the agreement's draft, with negotiations expected to conclude within three months. H.E. Dr. Thani bin Ahmed Al Zeyoudi, Minister of State for Foreign Trade, emphasized the strategic importance of the CEPA, noting Colombia's position as a key economy in South America and a potential gateway for UAE businesses. This agreement, the first of its kind between the GCC and Latin America, aims to expedite economic benefits for both nations and contribute to sustainable global growth. Under the CEPA, customs tariffs on various goods will be reduced or eliminated, market access will be enhanced, and cooperation in sectors such as hospitality, tourism, and agriculture will be expanded.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Economy

records.title: The UAE is investing in space technologies to enhance its capability to forecast heavy rains and floods, aiming to improve early warning...
records.description: The UAE is investing in space technologies to enhance its capability to forecast heavy rains and floods, aiming to improve early warning systems and support search and rescue missions during storms. By 2026, the country plans to deploy advanced space imaging and radar capabilities for continuous monitoring of Earth's surface. The SAR program, known as 'Sirb', will involve the development of a swarm of SAR satellites, making the UAE the first Arab country to do so. This initiative follows the urgency highlighted by the devastating floods in Fujairah in 2022, prompting the need for real-time monitoring and early warnings.
records.institution: UAE Space Agency

records.title: Iran and Qatar are poised to bolster their bilateral energy cooperation through the signing of new agreements, with a focus on integratin...
records.description: Iran and Qatar are poised to bolster their bilateral energy cooperation through the signing of new agreements, with a focus on integrating their electricity grids and expanding collaboration in areas such as wastewater and solar energy systems. Mojtaba Akbari, an official with Iran's Ministry of Energy, highlighted the efforts undertaken under the leadership of Leader Ebrahim Raisi to advance these initiatives. Iranian energy officials are set to visit Doha later in April to finalize these agreements, with skilled Iranian firms expected to play a role in the development of solar farms in Qatar. The Qatari Electricity and Water Company has already engaged in discussions with Iranian knowledge-based firms, signaling a promising avenue for collaboration between the two nations.
records.institution: Qatari Electricity and Water Company

records.title: Tabuk Agricultural Development Co.
records.description: Tabuk Agricultural Development Co. (TADCO) has entered into a non-binding memorandum of understanding (MoU) with NEOM Food Company (Topian) to collaborate on the development, construction, and operation of a hydroponic greenhouse for fruit and vegetable production in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. As per the agreement, TADCO will allocate 100 hectares of agricultural land for the construction of a mid-tech hydroponic vegetable facility equipped with necessary water and electricity infrastructure in a suitable location in Tabuk. The company will also facilitate the sale of produce to Topian for distribution to supermarket, retail, and wholesale buyers in Saudi Arabia. Additionally, TADCO will provide warehousing, cold storage, labor, and other necessary equipment for the project, as well as oversee the construction process. On the other hand, Topian will be responsible for designing and installing the greenhouse, as well as offering technical expertise for its operation and maintenance.
records.institution: Tabuk Agricultural Development Co. (TADCO) & NEOM Food Company (Topian)

records.title: The United Arab Emirates and Costa Rica have solidified their trade and investment relations by signing a Comprehensive Economic Partners...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates and Costa Rica have solidified their trade and investment relations by signing a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), according to UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. This agreement, announced on social media, is expected to enhance bilateral trade ties between the Middle Eastern and Central American nations. CEPAs signed by the UAE are comprehensive free trade agreements encompassing investment and services clauses. Reports from the UAE's state news agency indicate that bilateral non-oil trade between the two countries reached $65 million in 2023, marking a 7% increase from the previous year.
records.institution: UAE Government

records.title: In response to the recent rainfall and subsequent flooding in Bahrain, HRH Crown Prince Salman has taken decisive action to address the s...
records.description: In response to the recent rainfall and subsequent flooding in Bahrain, HRH Crown Prince Salman has taken decisive action to address the situation. He has directed the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture and the Ministry of Works to evaluate the damages caused by the floods and provide compensation to those affected. Additionally, he has instructed for the identification of areas most impacted by the rainfall and the implementation of sustainable infrastructure and drainage solutions to mitigate future risks. The Crown Prince expressed appreciation for the efforts of the ministries and other relevant authorities in their response to the flooding, emphasizing the importance of their continued collaboration in addressing this issue effectively.
records.institution: Bahraini HRH Crown Prince Salman

records.title: Pakistan has presented over 25 projects with an estimated potential investment of more than $32 billion to a high-powered delegation from...
records.description: Pakistan has presented over 25 projects with an estimated potential investment of more than $32 billion to a high-powered delegation from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), aiming to bolster bilateral cooperation and economic ties. These projects span various sectors, including rail infrastructure, dams, luxury hotels, smart device manufacturing, semiconductor development, mining, power transmission, tourism, and refineries. The Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC), jointly run by military and civilian authorities, highlighted the evolving economic landscape of Pakistan and emphasized initiatives to stimulate investment and achieve macroeconomic stability. Key sectors identified for investment include defense, agriculture, mines and minerals, IT, telecom, and energy. Additionally, the discussions addressed the resolution of pending agreements and financial settlements, indicating progress in addressing concerns raised by Saudi investors.
records.institution: The Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC)

records.title: Saudi Arabian developer Red Sea Global has partnered with Warner Bros.
records.description: Saudi Arabian developer Red Sea Global has partnered with Warner Bros. Discovery to produce a documentary titled "Beneath the Surface: The Fight for Corals," which explores the critical importance of combating climate change's impact on coral reefs. Scheduled to launch on Earth Day, April 22, 2024, on the Discovery Channel across various regions, the film showcases Red Sea Global's commitment to environmental care and regeneration in its development projects. Through the journey of Saudi free diver Salma Shaker, viewers will witness innovative coral research conducted by scientists at Red Sea Global and King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), highlighting the global dangers facing coral reefs. The documentary also delves into the uncharted reefs along Saudi Arabia's Red Sea coastline, emphasizing their biodiversity and ecological significance while exploring the potential benefits of Red Sea coral research for global ecosystems.
records.institution: Red Sea Global & Warner Bros.

records.title: In Muscat on April 16, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources reported a total of 4,881 fishing violations in 2023,...
records.description: In Muscat on April 16, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources reported a total of 4,881 fishing violations in 2023, representing a decrease of approximately 4.96% from the previous year's total of 5,136 violations. These violations encompassed various infractions, including issues related to licenses, lack of identification marks on boats and ships, use or possession of prohibited fishing tools, and unauthorized use of tracking devices. Additionally, violations were recorded for fishing in prohibited areas, unauthorized fishing of rock lobster and ear shell, and various other infractions. The ministry also seized 24,398.3 kilograms of various types of fish in 2024, along with the arrest of 420 foreign workers, representing a decrease of 19.39% from the previous year's total of 521 workers. Furthermore, there was a 51.51% increase in the confiscation of boats and fishing equipment by the ministry in 2023 compared to the previous year, with a significant rise in the total number of confiscated items. Fishing in Oman is regulated by the Law of Marine Fishing and Protection of Living Aquatic Resources, which mandates the acquisition of licenses and permits for fishing activities. Violations of these regulations can result in fines, equipment confiscation, or license revocation.
records.institution: Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: A high-level Saudi delegation, led by Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan, convened in Islamabad for the joint Special I...
records.description: A high-level Saudi delegation, led by Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan, convened in Islamabad for the joint Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC) meeting with Pakistani counterparts, chaired by Pakistan’s Minister of Foreign Affairs Ishaq Dar. The discussions centered on leveraging economic cooperation opportunities across various sectors and enhancing bilateral trade. Prince Faisal emphasized the longstanding Saudi-Pakistani relations, highlighting the significance of the visit in alignment with previous high-level engagements between leaders of both nations. The meeting aimed to bolster investment prospects and provide support to investors from both countries.
records.institution: Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC)

records.title: Tolga Soytekin, founder of Bare Foods Global, has introduced the Meatless Monday campaign to the Middle East, aiming to promote sustainab...
records.description: Tolga Soytekin, founder of Bare Foods Global, has introduced the Meatless Monday campaign to the Middle East, aiming to promote sustainable and healthy eating habits. By partnering with third-party catering companies, schools, universities, and hospitals across the UAE are encouraged to offer plant-based dishes every Monday. Drawing on his culinary expertise, Soytekin emphasizes the importance of familiar comfort foods to ease the transition for students and diners. Through social media advocacy and recipe inspiration, Bare Foods Global seeks to raise awareness about the environmental and health benefits of reducing meat consumption. With plans to expand outreach through seminars and educational initiatives, the ultimate goal is to instill a culture of plant-based eating across households in the UAE, driven by the influence of children on family dining choices.
records.institution: Bare Foods Global

records.title: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar is actively engaged in stabilizing prices for local agricultural produce, especially during peak se...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar is actively engaged in stabilizing prices for local agricultural produce, especially during peak seasons when both Qatari farms and international sources contribute to the market. Through its Agricultural Affairs Department, the Ministry has initiated programs to reduce production costs for local farms, enhancing their competitiveness against imported goods. One crucial strategy involves promoting high-quality agricultural produce during peak seasons to manage market saturation effectively. Ahmed Salem Al Yafei, Head of the Agricultural Guidance and Services Section at the Ministry, highlighted collaborative efforts with relevant ministries to address challenges faced by local farmers due to large imports of agricultural produce. Measures include regulating imports to meet local quality standards and providing agricultural inputs like fertilizers, pesticides, seeds, irrigation systems, and greenhouses at no cost to farmers. Additionally, marketing platforms are being developed to ensure profitable returns for local producers.
records.institution: Qatari Ministry of Municipality

records.title: Land Bank Insurance's pioneering training program for Black assessors in South Africa's agricultural sector marks a significant step towa...
records.description: Land Bank Insurance's pioneering training program for Black assessors in South Africa's agricultural sector marks a significant step toward inclusivity and empowerment within the industry. Unveiled at the esteemed Mzansi Young Farmers Indaba, this groundbreaking initiative promises to revolutionize agricultural assessment and insurance practices, thereby ensuring that all farmers, regardless of background, have access to tailored insurance solutions that meet their unique needs. Spearheaded by Land Bank's Insurance Company managing director, Pascal Siphugu, the program's comprehensive curriculum encompasses a wide array of topics crucial to agricultural assessment and insurance, including crop valuation, risk management, and the utilization of cutting-edge technology.
records.institution: Land Bank's Insurance Company

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) has pledged $10 million to the United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) to...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) has pledged $10 million to the United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) to provide daily hot meals to 140,000 vulnerable Ukrainians across 1,200 institutions, including hospitals, shelters, and orphanages. This initiative, aimed at alleviating the hardships faced by those affected by the ongoing conflict, underscores KSrelief's commitment to humanitarian assistance. By procuring and delivering essential food commodities locally in Ukraine, WFP's institutional feeding program not only addresses immediate food needs but also supports the country's economy and food systems. Through this collaboration, KSrelief and WFP demonstrate their dedication to mitigating the impact of the conflict and providing vital support to communities in need.
records.institution: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief)

records.title: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev of Uzbekistan recently hosted a delegation led by Suhail Al-Mazrui, the Minister of Energy and Infrastructur...
records.description: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev of Uzbekistan recently hosted a delegation led by Suhail Al-Mazrui, the Minister of Energy and Infrastructure of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), on April 15, coinciding with the second meeting of the "Central Asia-Gulf Arab States Cooperation Council" ministerial dialogue. During the discussions, Minister Al-Mazrui conveyed warm regards from prominent UAE leaders and both sides expressed satisfaction with the expanding economic ties, noting a consistent increase in bilateral trade volume. Particularly noteworthy was the significant presence of UAE investments in Uzbekistan, with over 300 UAE enterprises operating and a joint project portfolio exceeding $4 billion, highlighting the depth of economic engagement between the two countries. The discussions also centered around exploring potential projects in sectors such as green energy, metallurgy, agriculture, transport, and communication, indicating fertile ground for mutually beneficial collaboration and economic growth. A key highlight was the deliberation on the Trans-Afghan railway project, showcasing strategic importance in bolstering regional connectivity and facilitating trade.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued guidelines for farmers and livestock breeders to navigate unpredi...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued guidelines for farmers and livestock breeders to navigate unpredictable weather conditions, urging precautionary measures to safeguard crops and animals. Highlighted measures include clearing water drainage channels, securing tools and equipment, and inspecting structures for damage to mitigate risks during heavy rain and strong winds. Livestock should be housed in barns with access to food and water, while feed stocks must be stored safely to prevent moisture damage. Greenhouses require attention to reduce humidity and block dust, with a focus on ventilation, fencing integrity, and electrical system functionality. Monitoring drainage near greenhouses is crucial to prevent waterlogging, while suspending agricultural work during storms is advised for worker safety. Additionally, crops may require preventative fungicides post-rain to combat diseases, with ADAFSA recommending seeking assistance from their guidance centers or veterinary clinics if necessary.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Amidst ongoing military confrontations initiated by Israeli aggressors in southern Lebanon since October 2023, the Kuwait Red Crescent So...
records.description: Amidst ongoing military confrontations initiated by Israeli aggressors in southern Lebanon since October 2023, the Kuwait Red Crescent Society (KRCS) has emerged as a crucial lifeline, providing essential relief aid to affected residents. Despite the persisting challenges of the conflict, the KRCS has demonstrated unwavering commitment by delivering critical supplies, including foodstuff and necessities, benefiting approximately 2,500 families in the region.
records.institution: Kuwait Red Crescent Society (KRCS)

records.title: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar has intensified efforts to ensure fair prices for local agricultural produce, particularly during p...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar has intensified efforts to ensure fair prices for local agricultural produce, particularly during peak seasons when the market is flooded with vegetables from both Qatari farms and abroad. Through initiatives led by the Agricultural Affairs Department, the Ministry aims to reduce production costs for local farms by providing agricultural inputs and marketing platforms. One key initiative involves allowing only high-quality agricultural produce during peak seasons, thereby preventing the market from being overwhelmed with vegetables. Additionally, the Ministry offers support to local farmers by providing agricultural inputs and facilitating marketing platforms to enable them to achieve better returns for their efforts. These efforts, including direct selling yards and marketing programs like "Premium Qatari Vegetables" and "Qatar Farms," reflect Qatar's commitment to bolstering its agricultural sector and achieving greater self-sufficiency in fresh food production, with the self-sufficiency rate rising from 27 percent in 2011 to about 45 percent in 2024.
records.institution: Qatari Ministry of Municipality

records.title: Green Corp has completed the acquisition of Emad Bakeries, a Jeddah-based producer of Arabic bread and pastries, as part of its strategy...
records.description: Green Corp has completed the acquisition of Emad Bakeries, a Jeddah-based producer of Arabic bread and pastries, as part of its strategy to bolster investments and expand its portfolio in the Saudi food processing sector. Established in Bahrain in 2023 by Gulf Islamic Investments (GII), Green Corp serves as a platform for sustainable agricultural, aquaculture, food processing, and production projects across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states. The acquisition, supported by a US$150 million fund managed by GII, underscores Green Corp's commitment to creating an integrated food platform across the food value chain to reduce food import dependency and ensure sustainable benefits for consumers. Emad Bakeries, operating the largest industrial fresh flatbread bakery in western Saudi Arabia, brings fast-growing food production capabilities to Green Corp's investment platform. Mohammed Alhassan, co-founder and co-CEO of GII, highlighted Emad Bakeries' heritage and quality commitment, emphasizing its resonance with Saudi customers. Pankaj Gupta, fellow co-founder and co-CEO of GII, stressed the strategic alignment of the acquisition with Green Corp's vision of establishing a comprehensive GCC food investment platform. RidgePoint Advisors served as the sole financial advisor to Emad Bakeries, with legal advisory provided by King & Spalding and AlAmmar Law Firm. Looking ahead, Green Corp aims to make further acquisitions in the Kingdom as it continues to build its asset portfolio and enhance Gulf food security.
records.institution: Green Corp

records.title: Saudi Arabia's First Milling Company, a prominent milling firm, has unveiled its latest venture, the establishment of "First Food Supplie...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's First Milling Company, a prominent milling firm, has unveiled its latest venture, the establishment of "First Food Supplies Company," a wholly-owned subsidiary aimed at supporting future business expansion and strategic goals. With a capital of SAR 100,000 (approximately US$27,000) and headquartered in Jeddah, the new entity will specialize in various areas including bakery product manufacturing, grain mills products, starches, pasta, and more. Additionally, it will engage in storage, transportation, wholesale and retail of agricultural raw materials and food products. The financial impact of this venture is expected to positively contribute to First Milling Company's results starting in 2025. This move follows the company's recent announcement regarding its intention to conduct an initial public offering (IPO) of 16.65 million shares representing 30% of its share capital on the Saudi Exchange. With a wheat milling capacity of 4,200 tons daily and a feed mixing capacity of 900 tons per day,
records.institution: Saudi First Milling Company

records.description: Khazaen Economic City is on the verge of unveiling the Khazaen Central Market for Fruits and Vegetables, scheduled for completion by the end of the first half of 2024, with construction already surpassing 98%. CEO Salim bin Sulaiman Al Zahli emphasized the market's pivotal role within Khazaen Economic City, serving as a hub for marketing, distribution, storage, export, and re-export of agricultural produce both domestically and internationally. With over OMR50 million in private sector investments, the project aims to become a national platform for Oman's agricultural products, spanning an expansive 500 sq. meters, five times larger than its predecessor. Al Zahli highlighted the market's potential to foster SME growth and revolutionize the agricultural marketing landscape, aiming to reduce current produce waste levels significantly.

records.title: Qatari food company Baldana is on the verge of finalizing an agreement with the Algerian government to establish a vast farm dedicated to...
records.description: Qatari food company Baldana is on the verge of finalizing an agreement with the Algerian government to establish a vast farm dedicated to milk production, as part of Algeria's efforts to achieve self-sufficiency in this sector. Baldana, well-known in Qatar for its milk and dairy products, plans to inaugurate a sprawling farm covering 100,000 hectares. Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune confirmed the upcoming agreement, specifying that the farm will be located in Adrar, southwestern Algeria.
records.institution: Baldana Partners

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) in Saudi Arabia has embarked on a significant initiative aimed at agricultural...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) in Saudi Arabia has embarked on a significant initiative aimed at agricultural innovation and sustainability by localizing the production of banana seedlings, with a particular focus on the Jazan region. Leveraging advanced tissue culture and propagation techniques, MEWA's center for plant tissue culture and biotechnology has successfully cultivated various banana varieties tailored to the Kingdom's climate. These high-quality, disease-free seedlings, cultivated both in greenhouses and open fields, represent a notable advancement in the agricultural sector, enhancing sustainability and productivity. The localization of seedling production is anticipated to attract investment in tissue culture technology, with a focus on intensifying the production of nutritionally rich varieties to yield higher economic returns. Importantly, local production of seedlings is projected to significantly reduce economic losses, estimated at around 25% incurred from importing seedlings. MEWA's initiatives, aligned with the Saudi Green Initiative, include plans to plant 45 million fruit trees on agricultural terraces and four million lemon trees using renewable water by 2030..
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: Ridat, a thermoforming equipment manufacturer based in the UK, has secured its first project in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) by partner...
records.description: Ridat, a thermoforming equipment manufacturer based in the UK, has secured its first project in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) by partnering with major dates and confectionery specialist, Al Wathba Dates & Sweets, to support a new packaging facility. Located in Abu Dhabi, Al Wathba Dates & Sweets specializes in fresh dates, date syrup, and confectionery products. Ridat will supply technology and expertise for the new plant, which includes a Model 2420AFCS-P Automatic Thermoforming, Cut & Stack machine designed for high-speed production and precise forming. This machine utilizes air pressure for improved forming definition and features water-cooled molds to prevent overheating, offering a comprehensive packaging solution for Al Wathba Dates & Sweets.
records.institution: Ridat

records.title: Yemen Launches a Pandemic Fund Project to Protect the Most Vulnerable Communities From Epidemic Disease Threats
records.description: Yemen has initiated the Pandemic Preparedness and Response Project (PPRP) to safeguard its vulnerable population from epidemic disease threats. Launched in Aden, Yemen, the project aims to enhance the country's ability to prevent, detect, and respond to endemic and pandemic threats over a three-year period. Through a collaboration of stakeholders including the World Health Organization (WHO), UNICEF, FAO, and the World Bank, the project targets four key objectives: strengthening disease prevention, enhancing laboratory capacities, building multisectoral workforce capabilities, and improving coordination among One Health stakeholders. With a US$26 million grant from the Pandemic Fund and complementary actions from other World Bank grants, PPRP builds upon previous successful investments in outbreak preparedness and response.
records.institution: Yemeni Ministry of Public Health and Population, Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation and Fisheries, & Pandemic Fund Secretariat

records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MoCCAE) has issued a decree banning the fishing of Golden trevally and Painted sweetlips during their breeding season from April 1 to April 30, a measure set to last until 2026. This ruling, outlined in decree no. 24, aims to safeguard fish stocks' sustainability in UAE waters and bolster the nation's food security. Additionally, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Endangered Safety Authority has launched a two-day awareness campaign targeting various stakeholders involved in the regulation of fish hunting and marketing, emphasizing the importance of responsible fishing practices.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MoCCAE)

records.description: The National Food Loss and Waste Initiative, ne'ma, has launched the Food Rescue Programme as part of its Count Your ne’ma campaign during Ramadan, aiming to reduce food waste and redistribute surplus meals. This initiative aligns with the UAE’s goal of halving food waste by 2030. With the participation of 300 volunteers, including prominent figures like Mariam Almheiri, ne’ma has successfully rescued and distributed over 156,000kg of surplus local produce, benefiting thousands of families. The initiative emphasizes the UAE’s commitment to sustainability and encourages collaborative efforts across the private and public sectors to achieve significant reductions in food waste, reflecting the nation's values and traditions.
records.institution: UAE National Food Loss and Waste Initiative

records.title: The Oman Investment Authority’s newly launched Future Fund Oman has earmarked $4.7 billion for investment in large-scale projects within...
records.description: The Oman Investment Authority’s newly launched Future Fund Oman has earmarked $4.7 billion for investment in large-scale projects within the country over the next five years. The fund, with a total capital of $5.2 billion, will primarily focus on investing directly in economically viable projects, allocating 90% of its capital for this purpose. Additionally, 7% of the fund will be allocated to support small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), while 3% will be invested in startups. These investments, amounting to approximately $1 billion annually, will target eight key sectors, including tourism, manufacturing, green energy, fisheries, agriculture, ports and logistics, mining, and information and communication technologies.

records.description: The Imperial College London Diabetes Centre (ICLDC), part of the M42 group, is launching a specialized facility in Madinat Zayed to provide comprehensive care for diabetes and endocrine patients, reducing travel time by over 75% for the Abu Dhabi population, catering to over 6,000 diabetes sufferers in the Al Dhafra region. This expansion aims to extend accessibility to diabetes care across Al Dhafra, including residents in Liwa, Mirfa, Gayathi, Ruwais, and Tarif. Alongside clinical care, ICLDC emphasizes preventive solutions through community outreach programs, promoting active lifestyles and healthy eating habits. Hasan Jasem Al Nowais, Managing Director of M42, highlights the commitment to delivering world-class health solutions, while Dr. Mai Al Jaber, CEO of ICLDC, stresses the urgent need for accessible and comprehensive diabetes care. Over the past two decades, ICLDC's efforts have led to a significant decrease in HbA1c levels among patients, demonstrating expertise and commitment across facilities. The new Al Dhafra center will offer the latest diagnostic and management facilities, supported by a multi-specialty team, providing specialized care for diabetes and endocrine-related complications, and complementing existing clinics within the UAE.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's wheat production is set to increase by 25% in the upcoming 2024-25 season, reaching 1.5 million tonnes, in line with its e...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's wheat production is set to increase by 25% in the upcoming 2024-25 season, reaching 1.5 million tonnes, in line with its efforts to boost agricultural self-sufficiency amid rising domestic demand. The Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) of the US Department of Agriculture notes that this surge aligns with the maximum allowed production quota, which may be adjusted by the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture (MEWA) based on various factors. Competitive wheat prices have incentivized farmers to cultivate wheat over alfalfa hay, with domestic consumption projected to rise by 5% to reach 4.75 million tonnes, driven by factors such as tourism growth and infrastructure development projects. Despite advancements in domestic agriculture, Saudi Arabia remains dependent on rice imports to meet consumption demands, with imports expected to increase by 4% in 2024-25, fueled by expansions in the food service sector and rising demand for rice and poultry.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture (MEWA)

Daman's customers with international coverage plans gain access to AXA's Select network of 1.9 million healthcare providers worldwide through the new Global Healthcare Plan, administered by Daman and supported by AXA. This partnership reflects Daman's commitment to meeting evolving client needs, especially given extensive overseas travel from the UAE's global business hub status. Karim Idilby, Managing Director for AXA – Global Healthcare, emphasizes the strategic alignment between Daman's distribution reach, domestic network, and digital platform with AXA's vision for IPMI growth in the UAE. This collaboration not only enhances international medical insurance options but also underscores both entities' dedication to meeting client needs with top-notch healthcare services worldwide.

records.description: Saudi-based amplifAI Health and Canadian Healthspan Digital Inc. have forged a strategic partnership to revolutionize vascular health management, combining amplifAI Health’s AI-powered thermal hyperspectral technology with Healthspan Digital’s longevity clinical protocols. This collaboration aims to enhance healthspan and quality of life, particularly as global life expectancy rises. By addressing vascular aging, the partnership seeks to mitigate chronic conditions and develop therapeutic interventions. Dr. Meshari F. Alwashmi, CEO of amplifAI Health, and Dr. Fady Hannah-Shmouni, CEO and Founder of Healthspan Digital Inc., expressed enthusiasm for the collaboration, highlighting its potential to advance thermography and AI in vascular aging assessment. Leveraging AI algorithms, the partnership aims to improve diagnostic accuracy and reliability, ultimately enhancing personalized healthcare. With a vision for global expansion, the partnership strives to prolong health and well-being worldwide.

records.description: Bahrain Real Estate Investment Company (Edamah), in collaboration with Badia Farms, a leading controlled environment food producer, has unveiled plans for a new sustainable farm in Bahrain. This strategic partnership aims to revolutionize Bahrain's agricultural industry by introducing innovative farming practices. Badia Farms, renowned for its mission-driven sustainability efforts, will invest millions of dollars in the project, leasing a 50,000 sq.m. area from Edamah to implement cutting-edge hydroponic farming techniques. The initiative focuses on year-round crop production, bolstering food security and addressing challenges like limited arable land and water scarcity. The signing ceremony, attended by dignitaries including Bahraini Minister for Sustainable Development and CEO of the Bahrain Economic Development Board (EDB), underscores the commitment to environmental stewardship and economic growth through sustainable agriculture.

Chaired by Basim Al Saie, the BFHC board of directors comprises experienced individuals such as Sami Zainal, Khaled Al Amin, and others, who will contribute to enhancing BFHC's capabilities and driving future growth. Mumtalakat will consolidate its existing food sector assets under BFHC, facilitating collaboration and integration while fostering Bahraini expertise in the field. BFHC will prioritize investments in ventures and technologies to improve food production, processing, and distribution. Shaikh Abdulla bin Khalifa Al Khalifa, Mumtalakat's CEO, emphasized the company's commitment to promoting sustainability in the national food industry and addressing food security priorities through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. BFHC aims to invest in agri-food technology, sustainable agriculture, and food services to achieve long-term sustainable growth and reduce reliance on imports while providing nutritious food for the kingdom's population.

This collaboration aims to benefit health and education ministries, military entities, first responders, and NGOs by optimizing Niflink’s solutions to operate seamlessly across Thuraya’s extensive satellite network, covering 80% of the globe. records.title: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia reaffirmed their commitment to further deepening bilateral ties during a meeting between President Asif Ali Zar...
records.description: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia reaffirmed their commitment to further deepening bilateral ties during a meeting between President Asif Ali Zardari and Saudi Arabia's Defence Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman Al Saud at the Aiwan-e-Sadr. President Zardari emphasized the utmost importance of Pakistan's relations with the Kingdom, citing their fraternal bond and shared faith. He expressed gratitude for Saudi Arabia's support during challenging times and praised the leadership of King Salman bin Abdul Aziz Al Saud and Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman Al Saud. Prince Khalid highlighted the strong historical, strategic, and defense cooperation between the two countries and emphasized the need for further collaboration to deepen bilateral relations. In recognition of Prince Khalid's contributions, President Zardari conferred the Nishan-i-Pakistan award on him. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif also met with Prince Khalid, discussing bilateral matters, regional peace, and security. The Prime Minister expressed Pakistan's appreciation for Saudi Arabia's support and highlighted the close brotherly ties between the two nations. He emphasized the need for increased cooperation in defense and economy and reiterated Pakistan's eagerness for the visit of the Saudi Crown Prince. Prince Khalid thanked Pakistan for the warm welcome and expressed his appreciation for attending the Pakistan Day parade as a special guest, noting the importance of promoting defense relations between the two countries.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.description: The governments of Kazakhstan and Qatar have initiated an ambitious $17.6 billion investment drive, signaling a significant milestone in their bilateral economic relations. Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov's recent visit to Qatar further solidified the burgeoning partnership, emphasizing the commitment to elevate cooperation across various sectors. Discussions between Bektenov and Qatari officials, including Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, centered on the expedited implementation of key investment projects spanning energy, agriculture, and more. These projects, ranging from gas processing plants to agricultural facilities, signify the depth of collaboration between the two nations. records.title: UAE Reveals Details of National Policy on Biofuels
records.description: The UAE has unveiled its National Policy on Biofuels, endorsed by the UAE Cabinet, signaling a pivotal move towards clean and sustainable energy sources. Developed by the Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure (MoEI) in collaboration with public and private sector partners, the policy aims to diversify the energy mix and provide sustainable fuel alternatives. Minister of Energy and Infrastructure, Suhail bin Mohammed Al Mazrouei, emphasized the policy's role in decarbonization, aiming to increase biodiesel consumption by 20% and reduce the carbon footprint of diesel cars by 75% by 2050. Al Mazrouei highlighted the policy's alignment with the UAE Energy Strategy 2050 and its contribution to economic growth through waste utilization and circular economy principles. The policy encompasses regulations for biofuel distribution, production standards, and investment criteria, supporting the UAE's sustainability goals and the Net Zero by 2050 Strategic Initiative. Industry leaders, including Ali Khalifa Alshamsi of Emirates General Petroleum Corporation (Emarat), Saif Humaid Al Falasi of ENOC Group, and others, expressed support for the policy, underscoring its significance in advancing the country's energy transition and sustainability agenda.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure (MoEI)

records.title: Almarai Announces US$4.8B Investment in Saudi Dairy Farms to Boost Food Security
records.description: Almarai Co., Saudi Arabia’s leading dairy business, has announced a US$4.8 billion investment program over the next five years to enhance food security within the kingdom. The Riyadh-based company plans to diversify production, focusing on core dairy, juice, and baked goods products, alongside technological advancements and supply chain logistics improvements. This initiative aligns with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 plan to diversify the economy away from oil by investing in other industries. Investments will also bolster poultry sales and introduce new products, aiming to reduce the kingdom’s reliance on food imports. Almarai’s board revealed a detailed strategic plan, allocating funds for poultry expansion, fortifying core product categories, exploring new food segments, and technology development. The initiative will be financed through operational cash flows, with the aim of enhancing food security while adding value to shareholders amidst transformations in the region’s food industry.
records.institution: Almarai Co.

records.description: Oman has initiated the process of inviting developers for five wind projects across the Sultanate, collectively valued at USD 1.2 billion, aimed at bolstering its renewable energy portfolio. The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (PWP), responsible for procuring electricity from independent power plants in Oman, issued a request for qualifications (RFQ) for these projects, slated to be operational by 2027 as independent power projects (IPP). The largest among these ventures is the Mahoot I project, with a planned capacity ranging from 342 MW to 400 MW, requiring an estimated investment of OMR 187 million. Scheduled for the fourth quarter of 2027, Mahoot I is expected to generate 1,226 GWh of power annually. Other projects include Jaalan Bani Bu Ali, Dhofar II, Duqm Wind IPP, and Sadah Wind IPP, each contributing significantly to Oman's renewable energy objectives with their respective capacities, locations, and estimated investments.

Leveraging Pakistan's fertile soil and agricultural potential, this collaboration signifies a strategic move towards bolstering the country's agricultural sector and fostering mutual benefit for both nations.

records.description: Dubai Can, an ambitious sustainability initiative led by Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, has achieved a significant milestone by reducing the consumption of nearly 18 million 500ml single-use plastic water bottles within just two years of its launch. With the installation of 50 public water stations across key locations in the city and the dispensing of close to nine million liters of water, Dubai Can has provided residents and visitors with an eco-friendly alternative to plastic bottles. This initiative, aligned with Dubai's 2040 Urban Masterplan and the UAE's commitment to UN Sustainable Development Goals and Net Zero 2050 targets, represents a major step forward in environmental conservation. As part of the broader sustainability efforts, Dubai recently implemented a ban on plastic bags and other single-use disposable products, signaling the government's dedication to promoting sustainable practices and reducing environmental impact. Through awareness campaigns and collaboration with relevant entities, Dubai aims to encourage citizens to embrace eco-friendly alternatives and contribute to a greener future.

records.description: The 'GigaFarm' project, nestled within the visionary Food Tech Valley in the UAE, promises to revolutionize sustainable food production with its expansive 12-meter-high, 83,612-square-meter facility set to yield an impressive 3 million kilograms of food annually. Spearheaded by UAE-founded enterprise ReFarm, the initiative embodies a commitment to innovation and sustainability, aiming to mitigate environmental concerns while meeting the escalating demand for sustainable food sources. By integrating advanced technologies to repurpose waste streams into valuable resources like compost, animal feed, clean water, and energy, the GigaFarm endeavors to significantly reduce the carbon footprint of food production and foster a more sustainable ecosystem. Leveraging vertical farming techniques and efficient production methods, the project aims to enhance food security in the region while addressing critical environmental challenges, marking a significant stride towards a more sustainable future for food production in the UAE.

records.title: India has resumed onion exports to the UAE, offering relief to consumers grappling with inflated prices after a three-month hiatus.
records.description: India has resumed onion exports to the UAE, offering relief to consumers grappling with inflated prices after a three-month hiatus. The decision, prompted by India's ban on exports in December 2023 due to domestic price surges, allows for the export of 14,400 tonnes of onions through the National Cooperative Exports Ltd (NCEL). This move is expected to have a significant impact on the UAE market, where onion prices soared during the ban, prompting consumers to seek alternatives from countries like Turkey, Iran, and China. Abdullah Sultan Al Fan Al Shamsi, Assistant Undersecretary for the Monitoring and Follow-up Sector at the Ministry of Economy, highlighted ongoing dialogues with India to address supply challenges. Dr. Dhananjay Datar, Chairman and Managing Director of Adil Group, and Kamal Vachani, Group Director and Partner of Al Maya Group, expressed optimism about the forthcoming imports, predicting a potential 20% reduction in local onion prices and improved affordability and quality. Abubakker TP, Director for the Abu Dhabi and Al Dhafra region at Lulu Group, acknowledged interim reliance on imports from Turkey and Sudan, anticipating a price correction as India resumes exports. This development not only addresses immediate pricing concerns but also showcases the resilience of global supply chains amidst complex market dynamics.
records.institution: National Cooperative Exports Ltd (NCEL)

records.title: The UAE Food Bank is launching five initiatives aimed at distributing five million meals during Ramadan, under the leadership of H.H.
records.description: The UAE Food Bank is launching five initiatives aimed at distributing five million meals during Ramadan, under the leadership of H.H. Sheikha Hind bint Maktoum bin Juma Al Maktoum, Chairperson of the UAE Food Bank. These initiatives include providing daily meals to over half a million families and three million workers. Various sub-initiatives and campaigns are part of this effort, such as 'Your Iftar is on Us,' 'No for Wasting Food,' 'Cook of Thousand Meals,' 'Food Parcel,' and 'Iftar with the Workers,' along with educational programs focusing on environmental sustainability and social responsibility. Over 5,000 volunteers will support these initiatives, and strategic partnerships with more than 350 organizations are expected to enhance the bank's efforts. The UAE Food Bank aims to divert 975 tons of food waste from landfills during Ramadan and has distributed meals to over 35 million beneficiaries globally since its establishment in 2017.
records.institution: UAE Food Bank

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia is urging the adoption of responsible consumption practices to addres...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia is urging the adoption of responsible consumption practices to address the significant challenge of meat waste in the Kingdom, aligning with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030 for sustainability and food security. Annually, the country grapples with substantial meat waste, including poultry, sheep, camel, fish, and other meats. To tackle this issue, the ministry emphasizes the importance of raising awareness about reducing meat loss and promoting responsible consumption habits among the population. It sees these measures as vital for curbing food waste, achieving sustainable development objectives, and preserving natural resources. The ministry advises individuals to plan food purchases according to their family's needs, minimize meal variety to reduce waste, and utilize leftovers effectively. Additionally, it warns against falling prey to marketing strategies that encourage unnecessary purchases and encourages repackaging surplus food for future use or donation. The ministry has also initiated educational initiatives to inform the public about reducing food waste, improving storage and cooling techniques, and enhancing meat quality and preservation methods.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Ocean Network Express (ONE) has established its West Asia Regional Headquarters in Dubai as part of its strategic expansion plan in the I...
records.description: Ocean Network Express (ONE) has established its West Asia Regional Headquarters in Dubai as part of its strategic expansion plan in the Indian Subcontinent, Middle East, and East Africa markets. The new headquarters will serve as a central hub for commercial activities, customer service, and digitization, aiming to enhance ONE's presence and accelerate growth in these rapidly developing regions. Sundeep Sibal has been appointed as the Regional Director, bringing with him extensive experience in the shipping industry, particularly in the Middle East, Indian Subcontinent, and Southeast Asia. Jeremy Nixon, CEO of ONE, highlighted the significance of the move, emphasizing the region's importance as a key growth market for the company. Sibal expressed his honor in leading ONE's efforts in the region and outlined plans for deploying new services to cater to customer needs effectively.
records.institution: Ocean Network Express

records.title: Ericsson and stc Group’s iot squared have forged a strategic partnership by signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) at Mobile World C...
records.description: Ericsson and stc Group’s iot squared have forged a strategic partnership by signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) at Mobile World Congress Barcelona 2024, Spain, with the aim of revolutionizing waste management practices in Saudi Arabia. Through this collaboration, the Ericsson Connected Recycling (ECR) platform will be introduced as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution in the Kingdom, marking a significant leap towards sustainable waste management. The ECR platform, designed to digitalize reverse supply chains, offers a holistic approach to addressing the environmental impact of waste by optimizing processes, enhancing traceability, and promoting the monetization of waste materials. By focusing initially on Municipal Solid Waste (MSW) streams, the partnership aims to contribute to the Saudi Green Initiative's sustainability goals. Othman Aldahash, CEO of iot squared, and Håkan Cervell, Vice President of Ericsson Middle East and Africa, expressed their commitment to leveraging technology to drive sustainability and foster a circular economy, underscoring Ericsson's dedication to innovation and environmental responsibility. This collaboration represents a significant milestone in Saudi Arabia's technological landscape, paving the way for a more sustainable future by promoting transparency and environmental stewardship in waste management practices.
records.institution: Ericsson & stc Group’s iot squared

records.title: Abu Dhabi-based Novel Foods Group, a subsidiary of Gewan Holding, has recently sealed a significant agreement to establish a US$500 milli...
records.description: Abu Dhabi-based Novel Foods Group, a subsidiary of Gewan Holding, has recently sealed a significant agreement to establish a US$500 million biotech production hub in the UAE, with a focus on precision fermentation. This ambitious endeavor, involving partnerships with industry leaders such as Glatt Group, BioEngineering AG, and CB Consultancy AG, aims to capitalize on the commercial potential of Brazzein, a natural sweet protein known for its remarkable sugar-like taste. With applications spanning various sectors including beverages, confectionery, and dairy, Brazzein offers a healthier alternative to traditional sucrose. Amidst a growing global demand for alternative sugar solutions, the Novel Foods Group is poised to leverage precision fermentation technology to overcome challenges associated with traditional harvesting methods, ensuring a sustainable and economically viable supply of Brazzein to the market. This initiative underscores the company's commitment to innovation and health, exemplified by its collaborative efforts with universities and research institutions to develop brazzein-infused recipes and gather valuable consumer feedback, ultimately aiming to provide consumers with a sweet experience without compromising on taste or health.
records.institution: Novel Foods Group

records.title: The Unifrutti Group has finalized the acquisition of Bomarea and AvoAmerica Peru, securing 100% ownership of both entities in collaborati...
records.description: The Unifrutti Group has finalized the acquisition of Bomarea and AvoAmerica Peru, securing 100% ownership of both entities in collaboration with Solum Partners and Alpine Fresh. With a combined area of nearly 2,000 hectares, these companies are renowned for producing premium blueberries and avocados in Peru, aligning perfectly with Unifrutti's goal to expand its presence in Peru and diversify its multi-fruit portfolio. This strategic move positions Unifrutti to meet the growing global demand for these superfruits, particularly in key markets like the US and China. Mohamed Elsarky, CEO of Unifrutti Group, emphasized the significance of this acquisition in enhancing their product range and customer service excellence, highlighting the increasing popularity and rapid expansion of blueberries and avocados as desired superfruits. This acquisition follows Unifrutti's earlier acquisition of Verfrut in January 2024, signaling the beginning of its ambitious journey to become a leading sustainable multi-fruit company globally. Currently pending customary closing conditions, the transaction underscores Unifrutti's commitment to growth and quality in the global fresh fruit market. Established in 1948, Unifrutti Group maintains vertical integration in production, marketing, and distribution, spanning over 14,000 hectares across various countries and serving customers in more than 50 countries year-round. With over 11,000 employees, Unifrutti is now part of ADQ, an Abu Dhabi-based investment and holding company.
records.institution: Unifrutti Group

records.title: PureHealth has partnered with the Emirates Foundation to launch the Active Abu Dhabi initiative, aiming to promote active and healthy lif...
records.description: PureHealth has partnered with the Emirates Foundation to launch the Active Abu Dhabi initiative, aiming to promote active and healthy lifestyles in Abu Dhabi. Scheduled to commence on March 18, 2024, for 14 days, the initiative will feature a year-long schedule of fitness activities. Notably, H.H. Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Chairman of the Presidential Court for Development and Fallen Heroes’ Affairs, attended the launch, underscoring its significance. With 37.3 percent of the population already meeting the WHO's physical activity criteria, Active Abu Dhabi seeks to enhance sports participation, foster positive societal interaction, and encourage a broader community segment to embrace an active lifestyle. Powered by Pura, PureHealth’s AI-enabled longevity app, the initiative will provide challenges and incentives to participants, thereby promoting greater involvement and progress toward healthier living. This collaboration reflects PureHealth’s mission to improve lifespan and prioritize holistic health and well-being. The partnership between PureHealth and Active Abu Dhabi is hailed as a milestone by Ahmed Al Shamsi, CEO of the Emirates Foundation, who emphasizes the potential to effect positive change and redefine health, wellness, and community engagement standards. Shaista Asif, Group CEO of PureHealth, highlights the initiative's role in advancing a health-conscious community and realizing the vision of a thriving, wellness-oriented society. Mansour Al Dhaheri, Founder of Active Abu Dhabi, emphasizes the initiative's aim to unite the community and promote health and well-being as essential components of a fulfilling life. The first event, "First Steps," is a 14-day walking challenge set to commence on March 18, 2024, at Umm Al Emarat Park, open to individuals of all fitness levels and accessible both in-person and virtually through the Pura app. This initiative underscores a concerted effort to foster healthier lifestyles and community engagement in Abu Dhabi.
records.institution: Emirates Foundation & PureHealth

records.title: Saudi Arabia has announced a relief package for the rain-affected city of Gwadar, where torrential rains caused significant damage, resul...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has announced a relief package for the rain-affected city of Gwadar, where torrential rains caused significant damage, resulting in five fatalities and hundreds of houses being damaged. Saudi Arabia's Ambassador to Pakistan, Nawaf Bin Saeed Ahmad Al Maliky, visited Balochistan and met with Chief Minister Sarfraz Bugti, where he pledged humanitarian assistance for the residents of Gwadar. The ambassador announced the provision of 9,000 shelter camps and ration packs for those affected by the calamity, emphasizing Saudi Arabia's commitment to supporting its Pakistani brothers during this challenging time. Chief Minister Bugti appreciated Saudi Arabia's gesture and highlighted the impact of climate change, particularly noting the unprecedented rainfall in Gwadar this year. Efforts are underway to rehabilitate the victims, with governmental support and assistance from the Pakistan Army and Navy establishing hospital camps to provide healthcare to those affected by the disaster.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.title: M42, a prominent Abu Dhabi-based health company, marked International Women’s Day by inaugurating the "Laha Wellness Hub," a women’s well...
records.description: M42, a prominent Abu Dhabi-based health company, marked International Women’s Day by inaugurating the "Laha Wellness Hub," a women’s wellness clinic at HealthPlus Family Clinic in Al Bandar, Abu Dhabi. Tailored for women aged 35 and above, the clinic emphasizes preventive care, personalized plans, and educational support, addressing issues such as menopause and fertility. Notably, M42 extends access to the clinic to its staff as part of a new corporate policy supporting female staff through menopause and promoting gender equity. With a mission to advocate for women’s health locally and internationally, the clinic offers comprehensive services facilitated by a team of dedicated female healthcare professionals, aiming to create a transformative space fostering community and support networks for women. The initiative aligns with M42's commitment to prioritizing employees’ health and well-being, highlighted by the implementation of a half-day wellness leave policy for all workers. Through its extensive network and state-of-the-art facilities, including Danat Al Emarat Women & Children’s Hospital and the HealthPlus Fertility Center, the Laha Wellness Hub ensures accessibility to high-quality medical treatment for women across Dubai and the northern Emirates, underscoring M42's proactive approach to promoting wellness and health equality for women.

records.title: During a bilateral meeting held at his royal palace in Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan expres...
records.description: During a bilateral meeting held at his royal palace in Al Ain, Abu Dhabi, UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan expressed a keen interest in elevating the country's relationship with Bangladesh to a strategic partnership. He proposed the signing of a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement and activating the Joint Business Council to enhance economic collaboration between the two nations. Bangladesh Foreign Minister Hasan Mahmud presented an invitation letter from Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to the UAE president, inviting him to commemorate the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries. Both ministers emphasized the importance of exploring new areas of cooperation, such as energy security, food security, environmental issues, climate change, renewable energy, and people-to-people communication, to bolster bilateral trade. Mahmud highlighted investment opportunities for the UAE government and businessmen in developing the Matarbari Exclusive Economic Zone and infrastructure projects in Rangunia. Regional issues, including Rohingya repatriation and efforts to resolve the Gaza conflict, were also discussed, with Sheikh Abdullah expressing willingness to simplify the visa process for various professionals from Bangladesh and facilitate the transfer of work permits between employers. The meeting was attended by the Bangladesh Ambassador to the UAE Md Abu Zafar and Director General of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Md Shafiqur Rahman.

records.description: Dan Company is making significant investments in Saudi Arabia's Al-Ahsa region, renowned for its rich agriculture and natural diversity, by unveiling plans for the development of an agri-resort, an eco-resort, and an adventure resort. His Highness Prince Saud bin Talal, Governor of Al-Ahsa, and Abdulrahman Abaalkhail, CEO of Dan Company, convened recently to discuss the company's ambitious agenda to establish a premium farm-based tourism destination in the heart of the Al-Ahsa Governate, an area celebrated for its agricultural significance and UNESCO World Heritage status. Following the recent partnership agreement with Hilton to manage Dan Company's initial three projects, the company aims to attract tourists seeking immersive experiences amidst lush green landscapes and breathtaking natural vistas. Dan Company envisions creating a world-class tourism ecosystem that promotes sustainable, social, and economic growth while showcasing Saudi Arabia's diverse agricultural and natural heritage through agritourism, ecotourism, and adventure tourism initiatives. This strategic endeavor aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 objectives of economic diversification and community empowerment, with Dan Company projected to contribute approximately $1.6 billion (SR6 billion) to the kingdom's non-oil GDP by 2030, underscoring its commitment to expanding its footprint and fostering inclusive prosperity.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's ACWA Power Company has embarked on the ambitious task of constructing two wind-power plants in Uzbekistan, with a combined...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's ACWA Power Company has embarked on the ambitious task of constructing two wind-power plants in Uzbekistan, with a combined capacity of 800 MW, estimating investments totaling $1.085 billion. Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev has greenlit the investment agreements inked between the Uzbek government and ACWA Power for wind farm projects in Karakalpakstan, set at 500 MW, and in the Bukhara Region, slated for 300 MW. The investment agreements outline the design, financing, construction, and operation of the wind farms and overhead power lines by the investors and project companies. The resolution also sanctions agreements between JSC National Electric Grids of Uzbekistan and the project companies for the purchase of electrical energy over a 25-year period. These projects mark a significant step in Uzbekistan's energy landscape, which has traditionally relied heavily on oil and gas, with more than 90% of its fuel and energy resources sourced from these sectors.
