records.title: Bahrain's food industry is set to showcase its offerings at Gulfood, the world's largest food exhibition, taking place at the Dubai World...
records.description: Bahrain's food industry is set to showcase its offerings at Gulfood, the world's largest food exhibition, taking place at the Dubai World Trade Centre from February 19 to 23. With the Bahraini Pavilion nearly fully booked, the event aims to support Bahraini institutions involved in the food and beverage sector, providing them with a platform to launch their exports globally and gain insights into international advancements in various areas of the industry. This initiative aligns with Bahrain's efforts to enhance food security, elevate local food production, seek sustainable solutions, and attract investments in the food sector. The significant turnout underscores the valuable prospects recognized by Bahraini companies, offering opportunities to showcase products, services, and innovations alongside global counterparts. The Bahraini Pavilion will feature prominent companies and brands such as Awal Dairy Company, Deeko Bahrain, and Kazerooni Brothers, alongside a diverse representation from notable international food and beverage companies. Participation in the exhibition presents a unique opportunity for Bahraini companies to forge agreements, expand distribution networks, establish a stronger international presence, and contribute to the kingdom's position as a prominent global hub in the food and beverage industry.
records.institution: Gulfood

records.title: Alstom has secured a significant $540-million contract to construct the world's longest battery-powered tramway in Saudi Arabia, aligning...
records.description: Alstom has secured a significant $540-million contract to construct the world's longest battery-powered tramway in Saudi Arabia, aligning with the country's Vision 2030 plan. The project, spanning 22.4 kilometers and featuring 20 Citadis B battery trams, aims to provide access to several UNESCO World Heritage sites in Saudi Arabia's northwest region. As part of the contract awarded by the Royal Commission for Al-Ula, Alstom will handle the comprehensive design, integration, installation, testing, and commissioning of the battery-powered system, along with providing maintenance services for a minimum of 10 years. Leveraging its predictive maintenance tool, HealthHub, Alstom plans to monitor the health of trains and infrastructure using advanced data analytics. With a history of infrastructure projects spanning 70 years in Saudi Arabia, Alstom aims to deliver innovative, climate-adapted trams for both residents and tourists, emphasizing environmental stewardship in alignment with Saudi Arabia's focus. This project marks another step forward in Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 plan, which prioritizes the development of tramways and other rail systems to enhance accessibility to key cultural, tourism, agricultural, and residential destinations across the country.
records.institution: Alstom

records.title: Bank ABC has closed a $27.1 million sustainability-linked credit facility for Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company (SPMC), with support from...
records.description: Bank ABC has closed a $27.1 million sustainability-linked credit facility for Saudi Paper Manufacturing Company (SPMC), with support from the Italian Export Credit Agency SACE, spread across a term of five years. The loan aims to facilitate SPMC's expansion plan by financing the procurement of advanced machinery from Toscotec, enhancing efficiencies in scale and scope for future business operations. The signing ceremony, held at Bank ABC's Head Office in Bahrain, marked a significant milestone, attended by key officials from both entities. This transaction highlights Bank ABC's commitment to supporting the manufacturing sector in the region, with SPMC expressing gratitude for the bank's support and professionalism throughout the financing process. The collaboration between Bank ABC, SACE, and Toscotec underscores strategic efforts to promote industrial growth and sustainable practices, reflecting a shared commitment to driving economic development and environmental stewardship.
records.institution: Bank ABC

records.title: Serco, an international public services company, has acquired Climatize, a renowned sustainability and engineering consultancy, to streng...
records.description: Serco, an international public services company, has acquired Climatize, a renowned sustainability and engineering consultancy, to strengthen its capabilities in empowering governments and businesses to achieve their Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) goals. This acquisition marks Serco's commitment to delivering top-tier sustainability services, blending its international capabilities with Climatize's expertise. Climatize, known for its green building engineering and sustainability strategies, will offer consultancy services including net-zero strategies, resource efficiency management, and green technology integration. The move aligns with Serco's purpose-driven approach and aims to accelerate clients' journey towards net-zero while reducing operational costs and creating employment opportunities. The acquisition, coming timely after COP28, signifies a shared passion for sustainability between Serco and Climatize, promising innovative solutions and growth in new markets.

records.title: The Bahrain-Hungary Joint Economic Commission recently held a meeting in Budapest, co-chaired by Dr.
records.description: The Bahrain-Hungary Joint Economic Commission recently held a meeting in Budapest, co-chaired by Dr. Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani, Bahrain's Minister of Foreign Affairs, and Péter Szijjártó, Hungary's Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade. During the meeting, both parties explored opportunities for cooperation in various sectors, including economics, the environment, education, culture, energy, and agriculture, with the aim of boosting trade, attracting investments, enhancing food security, and adopting modern technology. The significance of strengthening joint political and diplomatic efforts between the two countries was also emphasized, encompassing areas such as political consultation, diplomatic training, support in international forums, and the implementation of bilateral cooperation decisions.

records.title: In Muscat, the Environmental Authority has commenced the initial phase of planting frankincense trees in the Madam area of Salalah.
records.description: In Muscat, the Environmental Authority has commenced the initial phase of planting frankincense trees in the Madam area of Salalah. This initiative is part of a broader plan to develop a series of environmental parks in Dhofar province, aimed at showcasing prominent native trees. Madam is set to be part of this environmental park network and will accommodate over 11,000 trees across 181,000 square meters. In this first phase, 500 frankincense trees were planted in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the yet-to-be-established Nature Protection Association, and the local community.
records.institution: Omani Environment Authority

records.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence for All Initiative
records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, through the Minister of Communications and Information Technology, Engineer Abdullah bin Amer Al-Sawaha, unveiled the Generative Artificial Intelligence for All initiative during the third General Assembly meeting of the Digital Cooperation Organization. This initiative, tailored for members of the Digital Cooperation Organization under the auspices of the International Center for Artificial Intelligence Research and Ethics (ICAIRE), aims to promote generative artificial intelligence research, enhance awareness of AI ethics, and govern policies related to generative AI. The initiative aligns with Saudi Arabia's commitment to advancing digital transformation and supporting inclusiveness and digital prosperity globally, particularly in developing countries. The announcement follows the launch of principles of artificial intelligence ethics by the Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA) during the World Summit on Artificial Intelligence, emphasizing the Kingdom's dedication to ethical AI practices and governance.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Morocco have strengthened their economic ties with a new agreement signed between chambers of commerce from both countries.
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Morocco have strengthened their economic ties with a new agreement signed between chambers of commerce from both countries. The agreement encourages cooperation among businesses and companies and includes provisions for financial collaboration, the exchange of economic and legislative information, and the organization of conferences, seminars, workshops, expos, and markets. It also focuses on facilitating the exchange of trade delegations, removing investment barriers, and resolving disputes amicably. This agreement reflects the commitment of both countries to promote bilateral cooperation and create a conducive environment for business growth.
records.institution: Federation of Saudi Chambers

records.title: Saudi Arabia and the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) have signed an agreement to host the 16th session of the...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) have signed an agreement to host the 16th session of the Convention’s Conference of the Parties (COP16) in Riyadh from 2-13 December 2024. This event will be the largest-ever meeting of UNCCD’s 197 Parties and the first held in the Middle East, marking the 30th anniversary of the UNCCD. Eng. Abdulrahman Abdulmohsen Alfadley, Saudi Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture, emphasized Saudi Arabia's commitment to environmental protection through initiatives like the Saudi Green Initiative and the Middle East Green Initiative. UNCCD Executive Secretary Ibrahim Thiaw stressed the urgency of addressing global land degradation and drought, which currently affect up to 40% of the world's land and threaten food, water, and energy security. The Riyadh COP16 aims to mobilize global efforts towards land restoration and drought resilience, showcasing sustainable land stewardship initiatives in Saudi Arabia and the broader Middle East region.
records.institution: United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD)

records.title: Significant progress has been achieved in various areas of cooperation between Uzbekistan and the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
records.description: Significant progress has been achieved in various areas of cooperation between Uzbekistan and the United Arab Emirates (UAE). In 2022, the volume of mutual trade increased by 2.1 times, reaching $518.6 million, and in 2023, it further increased by nearly 21 percent to $625.9 million. The number of enterprises with UAE capital involvement has also grown to 300. These developments were highlighted during a meeting between Tanzila Narbayeva, Chairperson of the Senate of the Oliy Majlis, and Abdulla Nasser Lootah, Director General of the UAE Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Authority, and Deputy Minister of Cabinet Affairs for Competitiveness and Knowledge Exchange. The discussion emphasized the need to enhance trade indicators by strengthening the activities of the joint Intergovernmental Commission. The meeting also covered various aspects of the multifaceted relations between the two countries, including trade, economics, social, cultural, and humanitarian aspects, as well as cooperation in digital technologies, youth support, and business development, in line with Uzbekistan's designation of the Year of Support for Youth and Business in 2024.
records.institution: UAE Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Authority

records.title: The ongoing Red Sea crisis could lead to a rise in stock prices for UAE-based shipping companies as global counterparts struggle to navig...
records.description: The ongoing Red Sea crisis could lead to a rise in stock prices for UAE-based shipping companies as global counterparts struggle to navigate the situation. Dubai-listed Gulf Navigation (GULF NAV) and Abu Dhabi-listed Al Seer Marine saw share price growth in 2023. GULF NAV's stock price increased by 424% over the year. While the crisis has caused concern for global liners, local experts believe that UAE-based shipping companies could benefit if the situation escalates further. However, this is speculative, and the impact on the shipping industry remains uncertain.
records.institution: Dubai-listed Gulf Navigation (GULF NAV) & Abu Dhabi–listed Al Seer Marine

records.title: Yemeni Ambassador to Jordan, Jalal Ibrahim, expressed appreciation for His Majesty King Abdullah's strong support for the Palestinian peo...
records.description: Yemeni Ambassador to Jordan, Jalal Ibrahim, expressed appreciation for His Majesty King Abdullah's strong support for the Palestinian people and his efforts to end the war on Gaza, as well as providing humanitarian aid to the region. He also commended the Jordanian Armed Forces–Arab Army for their air-drop relief aid operations. Ambassador Ibrahim highlighted Jordan's hospitality in hosting Yemeni people and providing them with support in education, healthcare, and training. He praised Jordan's role in promoting peace in Yemen by hosting various Yemeni political parties for meetings in Amman. Additionally, he discussed the strategic importance of Jordan as a gateway for Yemen in aviation, healthcare, education, and various other sectors. Yemen intends to expand its investments in Jordan and is planning a forum for Yemeni businesspeople to explore investment opportunities in the country. On the Palestinian issue, Ambassador Ibrahim emphasized the centrality of this matter in Yemeni foreign policy and the importance of establishing a sovereign Palestinian state based on the pre-1967 borders and relevant UN Security Council resolutions to enhance regional and international security.
records.institution: Yemeni Government

records.title: Saudi Arabia's decision to halt strawberry imports from Egypt and other countries is a regulatory measure aimed at balancing the supply a...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's decision to halt strawberry imports from Egypt and other countries is a regulatory measure aimed at balancing the supply and demand in the Kingdom's internal market, according to the Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation. The decision is not a ban or a rejection of shipments for health or quarantine reasons. It applies to various crops imported by Saudi Arabia from around the world, and Egypt is not the only affected country. Strawberry exporters need to obtain an export permit valid for 15 days from January 24, 2024, and the Saudi Ministry will resume issuing import permits for strawberries in the future.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: A new partnership between Bayer and agri-tech company Silal, part of Abu Dhabi-headquartered ADQ, aims to enhance sustainable agriculture...
records.description: A new partnership between Bayer and agri-tech company Silal, part of Abu Dhabi-headquartered ADQ, aims to enhance sustainable agriculture in the UAE. The collaboration will conduct trials on over 30 varieties of vegetable seeds, including tomato, cucumber, and melon, to assess their performance under the challenging desert conditions in the country. The data from these trials will not only benefit UAE agriculture but will also inform agricultural practices in other countries facing the challenges of climate change. Bayer and Silal will also focus on capacity-building programs for farmers and addressing climate change challenges in the region. In addition, they will explore innovative solutions and advanced technologies to improve agricultural practices in arid desert conditions, such as no-till farming, crop protection, and breeding technology, while also leveraging precision seed application and irrigation to conserve resources.
records.institution: Bayer & Silal

records.title: A meeting was held between the Agricultural and Fishery Development Fund, affiliated with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Wat...
records.description: A meeting was held between the Agricultural and Fishery Development Fund, affiliated with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Oman, and the Agricultural Development Fund in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Both sides emphasized the financing mechanisms for the two funds to enhance agricultural development programs and projects in both countries. The meeting was attended by His Excellency Dr. Saud bin Hamoud Al-Habsi, Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and Chairman of the Agricultural and Fishery Development Fund in Oman, along with Munir Fahd Al-Sahli, the General Manager of the Agricultural Development Fund in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
records.institution: Omani Agricultural Fisheries Development Fund of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Rebound, a recycled plastic trading platform based in the UAE, has partnered with the Circular Packaging Association (CPA) to advance sta...
records.description: Rebound, a recycled plastic trading platform based in the UAE, has partnered with the Circular Packaging Association (CPA) to advance standardization efforts for plastic recyclates. This collaboration, announced at the 28th Conference of Parties, aims to work toward material standards convergence in the UAE and globally. The partnership will focus on developing data analytics and insights, specifically related to material volume estimates in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region and the UAE. Rebound, as a Knowledge Partner to the Circular Packaging Association, will provide insights on global recycled plastics quality and infrastructure. The collaboration aims to promote high-quality recycled plastics in both food-grade and non-food-grade materials and accelerate sustainable packaging solutions.
records.institution: Rebound & the Circular Packaging Association

records.title: Saudi aid agency KSrelief has launched 24 humanitarian aid projects in Somalia, with a total value of over SR 171.8 million (approximatel...
records.description: Saudi aid agency KSrelief has launched 24 humanitarian aid projects in Somalia, with a total value of over SR 171.8 million (approximately $45.8 million). These projects span various sectors, including healthcare, food security, water sanitation, education, shelter security, volunteer programs, and education. The initiatives aim to benefit nearly 5.8 million people across Somalia, focusing on improving healthcare, reducing child mortality, providing education support, ensuring food security, and enhancing access to clean water. These projects demonstrate Saudi Arabia's commitment to humanitarian assistance and its desire to strengthen bilateral relations with Somalia, as the country highly values Saudi Arabia's contributions to its development and welfare.
records.institution: KSRelief

records.title: Ali Saeed bu Sherbak al-Mansouri, the acting general manager of Qatar Chamber, met with a delegation from Nepal led by Chandra Prasad Dha...
records.description: Ali Saeed bu Sherbak al-Mansouri, the acting general manager of Qatar Chamber, met with a delegation from Nepal led by Chandra Prasad Dhakal, the president of the Federation of Nepalese Chambers of Commerce and Industry. During the meeting, they discussed enhancing commercial and economic bilateral relations between Qatar and Nepal, explored investment opportunities, and identified key sectors for cooperation between the Qatari private sector and its Nepalese counterpart. Two memoranda of understanding (MoUs) were also mentioned, which aim to boost cooperation and partnership between the private sectors of both countries. Both sides emphasized the importance of trade and business visits to foster collaboration and learn about investment opportunities in various sectors. Nepal invited Qatari investors to participate in an Investment Summit scheduled for April.
records.institution: Qatar Chamber

records.title: In a historic development, Saudi Arabia has seen the opening of its first liquor store in over seven decades, signifying a notable shift...
records.description: In a historic development, Saudi Arabia has seen the opening of its first liquor store in over seven decades, signifying a notable shift towards liberalization in the once-conservative kingdom. Located in Riyadh, the store is exclusively accessible to non-Muslim diplomats and is in alignment with Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman's efforts to transform Saudi Arabia into a prominent tourism and business hub as part of broader economic diversification initiatives. The newly established store, situated in Riyadh's Diplomatic Quarter, offers a selection of liquor, wine, and two types of beer, with customers required to present their diplomatic identification for entry. The opening coincides with recent reports of new regulations governing alcohol sales to diplomats in the kingdom, indicating a change in the country's historically strict stance on alcohol, which has been in place since the early 1950s when King Abdulaziz imposed a ban following a significant incident involving alcohol.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.title: During a visit to Saudi Arabia by a delegation led by First Deputy Minister of Economy Elnur Aliyev, discussions were held to expand econ...
records.description: During a visit to Saudi Arabia by a delegation led by First Deputy Minister of Economy Elnur Aliyev, discussions were held to expand economic cooperation between Azerbaijan and Saudi Arabia. Meetings were held with Saudi officials, including the First Deputy Minister of Economy and Planning and the Deputy Minister for International Economic Affairs. The talks emphasized the growing economic relations between the two countries, with a focus on increasing trade turnover and exchanging expertise in priority economic sectors. The parties also explored areas for private sector cooperation and discussed mutual investments, as well as opportunities for collaboration in trade, investments, energy, infrastructure, tourism, and other sectors.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Economy and Planning

records.title: Saudi Arabia is set to begin importing South African beef and lamb products, marking the end of a 20-year ban that was lifted by the king...
records.description: Saudi Arabia is set to begin importing South African beef and lamb products, marking the end of a 20-year ban that was lifted by the kingdom's Food and Drug Administration in August. Final approvals for shipping halal cuts to Saudi Arabia are in place, with exports expected to commence in the coming weeks. The move aims to tap into Saudi Arabia's $2 billion meat market as part of its efforts to diversify its economy away from oil. South Africa and Saudi Arabia are also exploring potential cooperation in pharmaceuticals, technology, and sports investments, including falconry and equestrian disciplines.
records.institution: Saudi Food and Drug Administration

records.title: Saudi Arabia Launches National Biotechnology Strategy Set to Transform the Kingdom
records.description: Saudi Arabia has launched the National Biotechnology Strategy, with the goal of positioning the country as a biotechnology leader in the Middle East and North Africa region by 2030 and an international biotechnology hub by 2040. The strategy will focus on four strategic areas: vaccines, bio-manufacturing and localization, genomics, and plant optimization. It aims to enhance the domestic biotechnology industry, strengthen food security, and promote economic growth, job creation, and sustainability. The strategy is part of Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 initiative to diversify its economy and reduce dependence on oil revenue.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.title: South Africa and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia have committed to enhancing trade relations to promote economic growth in both countries.
records.description: South Africa and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia have committed to enhancing trade relations to promote economic growth in both countries. President Cyril Ramaphosa and Minister of Trade, Industry and Competition Ebrahim Patel have been leading discussions to facilitate local businesses' entry into the Saudi Arabian market. Stavros Nicolaou, Co-Chair of the South African–Saudi Arabia Business Council, emphasized the significant growth opportunities in Saudi Arabia for South African companies. Dr. Hisham Al Amoudi, Vice-Chairman of the Saudi–South Africa Business Council, reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's commitment to investing in South Africa, with Saudi investments contributing to South Africa's Gross Domestic Product. In 2023, South Africa's exports to Saudi Arabia increased to R7.3 billion, while imports from Saudi Arabia decreased to R54.6 billion. Saudi Arabia is the largest investor in South Africa's local renewable energy sector, with overall Saudi investment estimated at $1.62 billion.
records.institution: Saudi–South Africa Business Council

records.title: Al Jouf Agricultural Development Company of Saudi Arabia has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Korean company E Green G...
records.description: Al Jouf Agricultural Development Company of Saudi Arabia has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Korean company E Green Global (EGG) to transfer technology for potato seed production, enabling local production in Saudi Arabia for 180 days. The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture will conduct necessary studies to establish a partnership between the two companies for seed production in the Kingdom. This agreement is expected to enhance Al Jouf Agricultural's position in both domestic and international markets. In August 2023, Al Jouf Agricultural and the French energy company Engie signed a solar energy purchase deal.
records.institution: Al Jouf Agricultural Development Company of Saudi Arabia

records.title: Unifrutti Group, based in Abu Dhabi, has acquired Chile-based fruit supplier and exporter Sociedad Exportadora Verfrut.
records.description: Unifrutti Group, based in Abu Dhabi, has acquired Chile-based fruit supplier and exporter Sociedad Exportadora Verfrut. Verfrut is a well-known fresh produce company with operations in Chile and Peru, covering over 7,500 hectares of farming and processing facilities. They produce a variety of fruits, including grapes, cherries, apples, and blueberries, and have a distribution network spanning from South America to the US and China. Unifrutti, majority-owned by the Abu Dhabi government investment fund ADQ, plans to retain Verfrut's management team and production operations following the acquisition, which was made for an undisclosed sum. This strategic move aligns with Unifrutti's ambition to become a leading global multi-fruit company with a strong commitment to sustainability.
records.institution: Unifrutti Group

records.title: The UAE has dispatched an aid plane carrying 50 tonnes of food assistance to Burkina Faso, as part of its ongoing humanitarian efforts to...
records.description: The UAE has dispatched an aid plane carrying 50 tonnes of food assistance to Burkina Faso, as part of its ongoing humanitarian efforts to support nations facing adversity. This gesture underscores the UAE's commitment to extending aid to vulnerable populations, particularly children, the elderly, and women, who are most affected by food security challenges. Sultan Al Shamsi, Assistant Minister of Foreign Affairs for Development Affairs and International Organisations, highlighted that this aid shipment aligns with efforts to address Burkina Faso's pressing food security issues, aiming to alleviate the suffering of its residents severely impacted by ongoing challenges. The UAE's assistance not only reinforces bilateral relations but also contributes to broader national and international initiatives aimed at achieving food security and supporting vulnerable populations.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs for Development Affairs and International Organisations

records.title: Three Abu Dhabi-based logistics companies, including Etihad Airways' cargo division Etihad Cargo, Abu Dhabi Airports, and Abu Dhabi Food...
records.description: Three Abu Dhabi-based logistics companies, including Etihad Airways' cargo division Etihad Cargo, Abu Dhabi Airports, and Abu Dhabi Food Hub, have entered into an initial agreement to establish an air corridor aimed at enhancing food trade and investment diversification. This collaborative effort, known as Fresh Corridor 2.0, seeks to position the UAE as a significant player in the global food supply chain by facilitating two-way food trade between the UAE and other nations. The initiative aims to expand food sources, establish new trade routes, and enhance product options for regional consumers. Elena Sorlini, Managing Director and Interim CEO of Abu Dhabi Airports, emphasized that this corridor would foster diversification and growth in imports and exports, benefiting both UAE consumers and global markets. The partnership aims to develop a comprehensive food trading corridor with advanced infrastructure, regional market access, and reliable logistics, addressing evolving demands in the food trade sector. The collaboration also intends to engage with government stakeholders, facilitators, and key industry players to ensure seamless trade operations. By leveraging Abu Dhabi's strategic location and infrastructure, Etihad Cargo customers are expected to benefit from enhanced connectivity to global markets, as noted by Antonoaldo Neves, CEO of Etihad Airways. This initiative aligns with the UAE's broader objectives to bolster its food security strategy and stimulate economic growth in the food and agriculture sector.
records.institution: Etihad Cargo, Abu Dhabi Airports & Abu Dhabi Food Hub

records.title: Saudi Arabia Unveils Priority Specializations Eligible to Obtain Special Talent Residency
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Premium Residency Center has unveiled the priority specializations eligible for obtaining Special Talent Residency. This type of residency is designed for individuals with expertise in scientific, administrative, and research fields who possess exceptional capabilities and experiences that can contribute to strengthening local capabilities and knowledge exchange. Saudi Arabia aims to attract top talents from around the world to reside and work in the country, fostering development, creativity, and investment in human resources while supporting the stability of expatriates benefiting from this residency type. The eligible specializations include healthcare and life sciences, digital technologies, financial services, advanced manufacturing, space and defense, energy and circular economy, metals and mining, logistics and transport, tourism infrastructure, and technologies in food and agriculture. Additionally, there are various categories in research and innovation, such as space and aviation, environment, water and agriculture, energy, materials and production, health, urban transformation, logistics, and digital technologies.
records.institution: Saudi Premium Residency Center

records.title: The Telecommunications Regulatory Authority (TRA) has issued a third-class license to Oman Lens Company, marking a significant milestone...
records.description: The Telecommunications Regulatory Authority (TRA) has issued a third-class license to Oman Lens Company, marking a significant milestone as the first of its kind in Oman. This license permits the establishment of a ground station connected to a satellite network, specifically for monitoring, tracking, and controlling satellites within the Star Vision Aerospace Limited network. The license will enable the provision of imaging services from space, facilitating the collection and analysis of satellite image data for various applications, including mapping, environmental monitoring, resource management, agriculture, and disaster management. This initiative aligns with the TRA's strategic objectives to enhance local value, promote investment in innovative technologies and services, and foster technology localization.
records.institution: The Telecommunications Regulatory Authority (TRA)

records.title: Saudi Tadawul Group Holding Company (STG), a prominent capital markets group in the MENA region, has inked a binding agreement with exist...
records.description: Saudi Tadawul Group Holding Company (STG), a prominent capital markets group in the MENA region, has inked a binding agreement with existing shareholders of DME Holdings Limited, securing a 32.6% stake in the Dubai Mercantile Exchange (DME), a leading international commodities exchange. This agreement positions STG as the joint largest shareholder in DME Holdings alongside CME Group, and other shareholders include the Oman Investment Authority (OIA), Dubai Holding, and global financial and commercial industry leaders. The deal also allows STG to potentially increase its shareholding in the future, with the proceeds from new shares supporting DME's growth efforts. The partnership aims to leverage the Middle East's strategic location between commodity production hubs and end-markets, capturing demand for energy, metals, and agricultural commodities while promoting the transition to a sustainable economy through next-generation derivatives contracts.
records.institution: Saudi Tadawul

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Fourth Milling, known for its flour, feed, bran, and wheat products, has selected Riyad Capital to manage its upcoming ini...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Fourth Milling, known for its flour, feed, bran, and wheat products, has selected Riyad Capital to manage its upcoming initial public offering (IPO) on Tadawul, marking a significant milestone for the company, which has experienced remarkable growth since its establishment in 2017. With a daily production output of 3,150 tonnes and a strong presence in Madinah, Fourth Milling is planning to go public, and the IPO could potentially raise over $200 million. This development aligns with Saudi Arabia's "Vision 2030" framework, which aims to diversify the economy away from oil by privatizing certain industries and attracting investments. The IPO launch, expected in the first half of the year, signifies a noteworthy event for the Saudi food processing sector and offers investors an opportunity to be part of this flourishing enterprise.
records.institution: Saudi Fourth Milling

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has signed a strategic partnership agreement with the King Abdullah University...
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has signed a strategic partnership agreement with the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) to accelerate innovation and sustainability in environmental and agricultural science within Saudi Arabia. This partnership aims to align KAUST's research efforts with the ministry's strategic plan, enhance environmental protection, and contribute to sustainable food and agriculture security in the country. Minister of Environment, Water, and Agriculture Abdulrahman Al-Fadli visited KAUST to tour the KAUST-MEWA Algal Biotechnology Development and Aquaculture Facility, which plays a crucial role in transforming food production to meet the Kingdom's animal-feed demand while creating local job opportunities.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture & the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

records.title: The first-ever forum connecting various components of the animal wealth sector was held in Saham, Oman, with the aim of highlighting the...
records.description: The first-ever forum connecting various components of the animal wealth sector was held in Saham, Oman, with the aim of highlighting the sector's role in achieving food security, employment generation, and economic growth. The event celebrated Livestock Breeders' Day and was organized under the patronage of Eng Yaqoub bin Khalfan al Busaidy, Under-Secretary of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources for Fisheries. The forum included an exhibition featuring local goat breeds, rare animals, and distinctive birds. Animal wealth is a vital economic resource in Oman, contributing to self-sufficiency in animal products and food security. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources works on improving local breeds and enhancing the sector's growth rate.
records.institution: The Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Saham

records.title: The Ministry of Municipality (MoM) in Qatar has initiated a project to develop "protected farms" and climate-smart agriculture in collabo...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality (MoM) in Qatar has initiated a project to develop "protected farms" and climate-smart agriculture in collaboration with South Korea. This project aims to convert open farm areas into closed farms to reduce evaporation, water loss, and address soil issues. It will assess climate changes that may impact food production in Qatar and propose measures to mitigate these effects, including the development of drought-resistant crops and modern agricultural practices. Workshops and capacity-building activities will be conducted to share knowledge and technology, fostering sustainable and resilient agriculture in Qatar.
records.institution: Qatari Ministry of Municipality

records.title: Saudi Arabia and the World Economic Forum's (WEF) innovation platform UpLink signed two agreements at the WEF Annual Meeting 2024 in Davo...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and the World Economic Forum's (WEF) innovation platform UpLink signed two agreements at the WEF Annual Meeting 2024 in Davos, Switzerland, to foster innovative global solutions for environmental and sustainability challenges. The agreements, titled 'Catalysing Innovation for an Ocean Positive Economy' and 'Catalysing Innovation for a Positive Circular Carbon Economy (CCE),' aim to support early-stage impact entrepreneurs and stimulate investments in solutions addressing issues such as ocean degradation, biodiversity loss, and circular carbon economy. The initiative, led by the Ministry of Economy and Planning (MEP) and involving multiple Saudi ministries and initiatives, emphasizes the importance of innovation and collaboration in addressing climate and sustainable development challenges. John Dutton, Head of UpLink, highlighted the significance of early-stage entrepreneurs in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the role of UpLink in creating a supportive ecosystem for them.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Economy and Planning

records.title: LyondellBasell (LYB) has announced its acquisition of a 35% stake in Saudi Arabia's National Petrochemical Industrial Company (NATPET) fr...
records.description: LyondellBasell (LYB) has announced its acquisition of a 35% stake in Saudi Arabia's National Petrochemical Industrial Company (NATPET) from Alujain Corporation for approximately $500 million. This joint venture, empowered by LYB's Spheripol polypropylene (PP) technology, provides LYB with opportunities to expand and enhance its core PP business by gaining access to beneficial feedstocks and increased product marketing capacity in a strategically important region. The completion of the transaction is subject to regulatory and customary closing conditions, and both Alujain and LYB are exploring the possibility of constructing a new propylene facility and a PP facility at the NATPET site in line with Saudi Arabia's 2060 carbon reduction strategy. This investment aligns with LYB's strategy of growing and upgrading its core assets and businesses.
records.institution: LyondellBasell (LYB)

records.title: In 2023, the Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) reported a 12.07% increase in container handling across its managed ports.
records.description: In 2023, the Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) reported a 12.07% increase in container handling across its managed ports. May 2023 saw the highest monthly container handling statistics, with an 18.8% increase in handled containers. A total of 8,443,746 TEUs were handled, up from 7,534,307 TEUs the previous year. The annual container handling at Saudi Arabia's ports increased by 9.01%, reaching 11,380,302 TEUs compared to 10,439,620 TEUs. Exports and imports of containers increased by 15.56% and 12.68%, respectively, while transshipment containers rose by 8.96%. The number of vehicles imported increased by 40.54%, and passenger traffic grew by 41.3%. Maritime traffic also increased by 7.16%, with 12,130 vessels in 2023 compared to 11,320 vessels in 2022. Mawani signed contracts worth over SAR 1 billion in December 2023 to support Saudi Arabia's national transport and logistics strategy, including the introduction of new tugboats and maritime units.
records.institution: Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani)

records.title: Saudi Coffee Company, in collaboration with The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), hosted...
records.description: Saudi Coffee Company, in collaboration with The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), hosted a sustainability workshop titled "Fertilization Programs to Improve Coffee Production in the Kingdom" in Jazan, Saudi Arabia. The workshop aimed to advance coffee farming and production methods in the Kingdom, engaging local and international experts in soil management and fertilizers. Key stakeholders including Saudi Coffee Company, Estidamah, and Sabic participated to benefit from international expertise and develop specialized fertilizers for local coffee plantations. This initiative aligns with Saudi Coffee Company's commitment to drive sustainable practices and elevate the coffee industry's quality standards in Saudi Arabia, supporting the Kingdom's Vision 2030 goals. The workshop featured sessions on enhancing coffee quality, sustainable production, and strategies for resilient coffee planting in the face of climate change.
records.institution: Saudi Coffee Company & The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: KSrelief, the Saudi aid agency, has been actively involved in various health and aid projects in Yemen, particularly focusing on helping...
records.description: KSrelief, the Saudi aid agency, has been actively involved in various health and aid projects in Yemen, particularly focusing on helping people who have lost limbs due to the conflict. Through a prosthetics center in Aden governorate, KSrelief has provided physical therapy, prosthetic limb manufacturing, fitting, delivery, and maintenance services to 314 beneficiaries, including 73 patients who received prosthetic limbs. Additionally, the agency has distributed tents and shelter bags in Aden governorate, supported school bags initiatives, and worked on water supply and environmental sanitation projects. Yemen is among the top beneficiaries of KSrelief assistance, with numerous projects addressing food security, health, sanitation, shelter, nutrition, education, telecommunications, and logistics.
records.institution: KSRelief

records.title: Iran's ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Alireza Enayati, and the Chairman of the Federation of Saudi Chambers of Commerce and Industry met to...
records.description: Iran's ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Alireza Enayati, and the Chairman of the Federation of Saudi Chambers of Commerce and Industry met to discuss expanding bilateral relations, particularly in the area of trade. They emphasized the potential for cooperation in various fields such as industry, agriculture, technical and engineering services, energy, and tourism. Both parties expressed their willingness to enhance economic ties between the two countries, aligning with Saudi Arabia's "Vision 2030" and emphasizing the importance of cooperation between the private sectors of Iran and Saudi Arabia.
records.institution: The Federation of Saudi Chambers of Commerce and Industry

records.title: Saudi Arabia Unveils Plan to Recycle up to 95% of Waste in 2024
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has unveiled an ambitious plan to recycle up to 95% of the country's waste by 2024. This initiative is expected to contribute SR120 billion ($31.99 billion) to the gross domestic product and create over 100,000 jobs for Saudi nationals, with a goal of recycling up to 100 million tons of waste annually to promote sustainability. The plan is aligned with the Kingdom's sustainable development goals and includes more than 65 initiatives with an investment exceeding SR55 billion. In addition to waste recycling, the ministry's efforts have preserved over 90,000 hectares of land, planted 50 million trees across the country, and increased community awareness and environmental commitment, improving the quality of life. To further support waste management solutions, King Abdullah Financial District Development and Management Co. signed a memorandum of understanding with Saudi Investment Recycling Co. to promote recycling initiatives and environmentally friendly practices.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Aster Pharmacy in the UAE has made a significant shift towards sustainability by replacing plastic bags with recyclable paper bags as par...
records.description: Aster Pharmacy in the UAE has made a significant shift towards sustainability by replacing plastic bags with recyclable paper bags as part of its Green Choices initiative. Over the past three years, the company has successfully implemented this change, using 7.4 million paper bags annually to serve customers. This transition aligns with the UAE's Green Agenda 2023 and global efforts to combat plastic pollution. Aster Pharmacy, part of the Aster DM Healthcare Group, has been committed to eco-friendly practices, including using sustainable and recyclable materials for store interiors. The organization's waste recycling initiatives have contributed to a more sustainable environment.
records.institution: Aster Pharmacy

records.title: A UAE-based company is set to invest $30 million in a berry farming project in Uzbekistan's Andijan region, as reported by the Ministry o...
records.description: A UAE-based company is set to invest $30 million in a berry farming project in Uzbekistan's Andijan region, as reported by the Ministry of Agriculture. The project, a collaboration between the Agency for Agricultural Services under the Ministry of Agriculture and the Emirati company, will establish a 470-hectare berry farm in the Pakhtaabad district. Initially, the focus will be on cultivating blueberries using drip irrigation systems on 20 hectares. The project's long-term plan includes the cultivation of blueberries, raspberries, and vegetable products. With an estimated yield of 400-500 tons per hectare when planting 4,000 bushes, special nets will be used to protect the berries from heat. The investment is part of the UAE company's broader initiative to create an agricultural cluster in the Andijan region, encompassing berry plantations and fisheries.
records.institution: The Agency for Agricultural Services

records.title: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia are expected to advance discussions on a potential investment deal regarding the Reko Diq copper and gold proje...
records.description: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia are expected to advance discussions on a potential investment deal regarding the Reko Diq copper and gold project during the three-day mineral forum in Riyadh. Led by Energy Minister Muhammad Ali, a high-level Pakistani delegation is attending the Future Minerals Forum (FMF) to promote mineral value chains. Officials from various Pakistani organizations, including SIFC, PMDC, OGDCL, PPL, and GSP, are part of the delegation. Besides the Reko Diq project, the delegation is likely to discuss Saudi Arabia's interest in constructing a refinery in Pakistan. Saudi Arabia aims to attract significant investments in its mining industry, estimated to exceed $1.3 trillion, and the visit may lead to a deal between the two countries for the Reko Diq project and a state-of-the-art deep conversion refinery. Saudi Arabia's interest in various sectors, including mining, agriculture, and energy, reflects its commitment to enhancing its investment footprint in Pakistan.
records.institution: Saudi Government

records.title: ADAFSA Launches Ambitious Plan to Expand Recycled Water Use in Abu Dhabi Farms
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has unveiled an ambitious plan to expand the use of recycled water in agriculture in Abu Dhabi. ADAFSA, in collaboration with strategic partners including the Department of Energy - Abu Dhabi (DoE), the Environment Agency - Abu Dhabi (EAD), and TAQA, aims to deliver recycled water to over 1,600 farms in Al Khatam, Al Khaznah, and Al Nahda areas. This initiative aligns with sustainability goals and aims to reduce pressure on groundwater resources, ultimately conserving non-renewable water resources and promoting the sustainable development of the agricultural sector. By utilizing recycled water, ADAFSA intends to reduce groundwater depletion and reliance on desalinated seawater, fostering more sustainable agricultural practices and systems. The project corresponds with the UAE Water Security Strategy 2036 objectives and Abu Dhabi's recycled water policy to maximize recycled water usage. Additionally, it offers environmental and economic benefits by cleaning and disinfecting discharged water and contributing to the rational use of groundwater in agriculture.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Dubai has implemented a ban on single-use plastic bags starting from January 1, 2024, through Executive Council Resolution No.
records.description: Dubai has implemented a ban on single-use plastic bags starting from January 1, 2024, through Executive Council Resolution No. (124) of 2023 concerning single-use products. The resolution, championed by Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, aims to promote sustainable recycling practices and reduce the environmental impact of plastic waste. The ban covers various single-use disposable products, including plastic bags, food delivery packaging, and containers. While there are exceptions for specific items like waste bags and packaging for food items, non-compliance can result in fines ranging from Dh200 (US$54.46) to Dh2,000 (US$544.60) for repeat violations within a year. Dubai's government is also launching awareness campaigns to encourage citizens to minimize plastic use and opt for eco-friendly alternatives, alongside initiatives to enhance recycling efforts and reduce plastic waste's environmental impact. This move aligns with Dubai's commitment to environmental sustainability and waste management goals, contributing to the UAE's broader vision of achieving net-zero emissions by 2050.
records.institution: Dubai Municipality

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Tunisia have signed seven memoranda of understanding (MoUs) during the 11th session of the Saudi-Tunisian Joint Committe...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Tunisia have signed seven memoranda of understanding (MoUs) during the 11th session of the Saudi-Tunisian Joint Committee in Tunis, aiming to strengthen cooperation in various fields. Two of the MoUs focus on agricultural scientific research and environmental protection, involving the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture and the Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries, as well as the Ministry of Environment. Additionally, an MoU on industrial cooperation was signed between the Saudi Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources and the Tunisian Ministry of Industry and Energy, while another MoU pertained to tourism between the two countries. Further agreements covered labor, climate, and meteorology cooperation. During Q3 2023, Saudi non-oil exports to Tunisia amounted to SR513.42 million ($140 million), primarily consisting of chemicals, polymers, packaging, and building materials, while imports from Tunisia reached SR206.59 million, primarily in food products, textiles, heavy machinery, and electronics. The Saudi Industrial Development Fund contributed SR3.8 million to finance one project in Tunisia.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources

records.title: An agreement between the Associations Support Fund (ASF) and the Sekaya Charitable Foundation in Saudi Arabia aims to strengthen collabor...
records.description: An agreement between the Associations Support Fund (ASF) and the Sekaya Charitable Foundation in Saudi Arabia aims to strengthen collaboration in water irrigation projects. The agreement intends to establish a sub-fund known as the Water Associations Support Fund, which will focus on developing and empowering entities involved in the water irrigation sector in the Kingdom. This initiative aligns with the goals outlined in Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030. The Sekaya Charitable Foundation specializes in organizing and providing charitable water resources and plays a vital role in executing charitable watering projects in underserved villages and areas across the country. The foundation's efforts aim to enhance the sustainability and efficiency of charitable organizations involved in managing and operating such projects in line with national objectives.
records.institution: The Associations Support Fund & The Sekaya Charitable Foundation

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the National Co.
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the National Co. for Agricultural Services (AgriServ) to enhance support for the agricultural sector. AgriServ, a government-owned entity founded in 2018, is dedicated to achieving the goals of the agricultural sector outlined in Vision 2030. Under the agreement, the Environment Ministry will offer data, monitoring, compliance, and coordination support to AgriServ's operations, while AgriServ will carry out all operational tasks for the services it is responsible for, following an agreed-upon timeline. This collaboration aims to improve the quality of services provided to the beneficiaries of the farming sector, promoting agricultural growth and food security in Saudi Arabia.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Permanent Executive Committee for Fuel Stations and Service Centers has announced updated terms and conditions for fuel st...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Permanent Executive Committee for Fuel Stations and Service Centers has announced updated terms and conditions for fuel stations and service centers to regulate and develop the sector in line with global energy industry standards and Vision 2030 goals. The updated requirements aim to improve the establishment, management, operation, and maintenance of these facilities and enhance the services they offer. Key requirements include the operation of fuel stations by qualified facilities, specific distances between gas stations within and outside urban areas, and criteria related to pumps, tanks, cleanliness, maintenance, product quality, and service provision. Existing stations have a 12-month corrective period from the date of publication to comply with the updated terms.
records.institution: Saudi Permanent Executive Committee for Fuel Stations and Service Centers

records.title: During the sixth meeting of the Kazakh-Saudi Intergovernmental Joint Committee on Trade, Economic, Scientific, Technical, and Cultural Co...
records.description: During the sixth meeting of the Kazakh-Saudi Intergovernmental Joint Committee on Trade, Economic, Scientific, Technical, and Cultural Cooperation in Riyadh, Kazakh Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Murat Nurtleu emphasized the strategic importance of enhancing cooperation between Kazakhstan and Saudi Arabia. He highlighted the significant potential of the Saudi market for strengthening trade and economic relations, particularly in sectors such as green energy, food security, transport and logistics, mining, petrochemicals, agriculture, finance, and tourism. Nurtleu regarded Saudi Arabia as a crucial partner for Kazakhstan in the Middle East and the international arena. The meeting also included a Kazakh-Saudi investment round table, bringing together business representatives from both countries, and discussions on deepening collaboration and establishing joint ventures in various sectors. Saudi Minister of Investment Khalid Al-Falih expressed his country's keen interest in strengthening ties with Kazakhstan, and the event featured speeches from heads of large Saudi companies, including Saudi Aramco and ACWA Power. Additionally, Kazakhstan and Saudi Arabia signed agreements related to visa exemptions for diplomatic and service passport holders and the establishment of a joint innovation hub.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Investment

records.title: The Omani-Austrian Business Forum recently convened to explore avenues for enhancing cooperation across multiple sectors, encompassing to...
records.description: The Omani-Austrian Business Forum recently convened to explore avenues for enhancing cooperation across multiple sectors, encompassing tourism, industry, construction, infrastructure, information technology, and medical education. Organized by the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) in partnership with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry, and Investment Promotion in Muscat, the forum also delved into incentives and investment prospects within the Sultanate of Oman. Faisal Abdullah al Rawas, Chairman of the OCCI Board of Directors, emphasized the potential for joint projects between Oman and Austria to bolster investment and trade exchanges. Dr. Martin Kocher, Austrian Minister of Labour and Economy, highlighted the opportunity for economic collaboration, particularly in industry, green hydrogen, and tourism, aligning with Oman's Vision 2040 goals. The forum served as a platform for Omani and Austrian businesses to foster trade relations and explore collaboration opportunities.
records.institution: The Omani-Austrian Business Forum

records.title: Construction has commenced on Saudi Arabia's largest indoor vertical farming project in Riyadh.
records.description: Construction has commenced on Saudi Arabia's largest indoor vertical farming project in Riyadh. The project, spearheaded by YesHealth Group, a Taiwanese controlled-environment agriculture (CEA) construction company, will encompass 20,000 square meters with 19 layers and a height of 15 meters. This facility is expected to yield up to 2,200 kilograms of leafy greens daily, including various types of lettuce, cruciferous vegetables, baby leaves, and specialty crops like edible flowers. The vertical farm will also include an experiential center with exhibition and dining areas for visitors to enjoy meals while observing the farm's operations. The project involves close coordination between teams in Saudi Arabia and Taiwan, with YesHealth Group supplying the equipment and technology needed for efficient indoor farming.
records.institution: YesHealth Group

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: In the Asir region of Saudi Arabia, traditional farming practices have been a reliable source of food for the population.
records.description: In the Asir region of Saudi Arabia, traditional farming practices have been a reliable source of food for the population. However, an increasing number of farmers in the region are transitioning to organic farming with the support of the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture. Saad Al-Damik, a farmer with over 20 years of experience, has praised the benefits of organic farming, citing the negative effects of chemical fertilizers on soil quality and crop yields. The government's organic scheme offers educational and awareness programs to support farmers in this transition. Organic farming in the region aims to promote ecological sustainability, healthy food production, and the preservation of natural resources. The Ministry's Asir branch has been actively encouraging and assisting farmers in adopting organic farming practices, with several farms already making the transition and many more in the process of doing so. The Saudi government has been working to expand organic production and related services since 2005 to meet the growing demand for organic products.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The largest grain growing operation in Western Australia, known as Merredin Farms, is up for sale and expected to fetch close to $200 mil...
records.description: The largest grain growing operation in Western Australia, known as Merredin Farms, is up for sale and expected to fetch close to $200 million. The portfolio, spanning nearly 80,000 hectares, produces wheat, barley, and canola. The Saudi Arabian government and the Perth-based agricultural investment fund PenAgri, which jointly own Merredin Farms, have decided to sell. The buyer will become the state's largest broadacre farmer. This sale marks another significant deal in Western Australia's agriculture sector, following other notable transactions in the region throughout the year. Merredin Farms was part of a 200,000-hectare portfolio acquired by the Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC) from John Nicoletti in 2019, while PenAgri owns the remainder. SALIC Australia is owned by the Saudi Arabian government and focuses on investments to ensure food security. PenAgri, run by agriculture investor Greg Harvey, owns two other large-scale mixed-cropping and livestock aggregations in the state. The sale is part of SALIC Australia's plans to reshape its strategic focus on various agricultural value chains in the region.
records.institution: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company

records.title: BlackRock Commits US$400M to Dubai’s Positive Zero for Decarbonization Initiatives
records.description: BlackRock has pledged to invest up to $400 million in Dubai's decarbonization company, Positive Zero, through a diversified infrastructure fund. This substantial investment is aimed at supporting Positive Zero's efforts in advancing energy transition initiatives across Gulf countries. Positive Zero was formed last year through the merger of solar enterprise SirajPower, energy efficiency services provider Taka Solutions, and on-demand battery operation HYPR Energy. The investment aligns with the objectives of the UAE-hosted COP28 summit, which seeks to triple renewable energy capacity by 2030 and double global energy efficiency improvements. BlackRock is among the institutional investors supporting the UAE's $30 billion climate fund called Alterra.
records.institution: BlackRock

records.title: IFFCO Group, a fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) company, has entered into a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Tetra Pak, a leading...
records.description: IFFCO Group, a fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) company, has entered into a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Tetra Pak, a leading provider of food processing and packaging solutions. Their collaboration aims to enhance sustainability initiatives across IFFCO's manufacturing facilities, focusing on reducing the environmental impact. They plan to implement global standards and leverage advanced technologies to achieve this goal. IFFCO's objective is to produce sustainable, high-quality products while contributing to the Saudi Arabian economy and championing waste reduction, emission mitigation, and compliance with green industry protocols. They also aim to support long-term sustainable production and packaging of culinary creams in Saudi Arabia. This partnership underscores IFFCO's commitment to sustainability and economic growth in the region.
records.institution: IFFCO & Tetra Pak

records.title: Tanmiah Food Company to Plant 100,000 Trees in Bahrain
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company has launched a tree planting campaign in Manama, Bahrain, with the goal of planting 100,000 trees. This initiative aligns with the Saudi Green Initiative and the Middle East Green Initiative, emphasizing collaborative environmental efforts between Saudi Arabia and Bahrain to combat the impacts of climate change through afforestation. Afforestation is vital for improving air quality, preventing soil erosion, supporting wildlife, absorbing carbon dioxide, and mitigating the effects of climate change. The campaign, symbolized by the slogan "Planted in Saudi Arabia, to be grown in Bahrain," demonstrates Tanmiah's commitment to global sustainability goals and a cleaner, healthier, and more sustainable future for the region and beyond. The initiative was inaugurated by Dr. Khaled bin Abdullah Al-Abd Al-Qader, Executive Director of the National Center for Vegetation Development and Desertification Control, representing the Minister of Environment, Water, and Agriculture. This tree planting effort reflects the united commitment of both countries to create a greener and more sustainable future for the Middle East region.
records.institution: Tanmiah Food Company

records.title: The Saudi General Authority for Food Security has disclosed that Saudi Arabia has successfully procured approximately 1.3 million tons of...
records.description: The Saudi General Authority for Food Security has disclosed that Saudi Arabia has successfully procured approximately 1.3 million tons of wheat in a recent tender. These shipments of wheat are anticipated to reach the kingdom between February and May 2024. The tender specifically sought hard wheat with a 12.5% protein content and was concluded on Friday. Various source options were presented in the tender, enabling sellers to choose their preferred source from regions such as the European Union, the Black Sea region, North America, South America, and Australia. The wheat shipments will be distributed to different ports in Saudi Arabia, including Jeddah Islamic Port, Yanbu Commercial Port, King Abdulaziz Port in Dammam, and Jazan Port.
records.institution: Saudi General Authority for Food Security

records.title: Oman Flour Mills Co.
records.description: Oman Flour Mills Co. (OFMC) celebrated the official inauguration of its new feed mill in Muttrah, marking a significant advancement in Oman's efforts to bolster local animal feed production and reduce dependence on imports. The state-of-the-art facility has a production capacity of 20 tonnes per hour and was constructed to cater to the distinct nutritional needs of various livestock. OFMC's CEO, Haitham Mohamed al Fannah, highlighted the facility's commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility, with cutting-edge technology like robotics for packaging and advanced control systems for real-time adjustments. This initiative aims to enhance efficiency, reduce production costs, and support Oman's agricultural and livestock sectors while fostering self-sufficiency in animal feed production.
records.institution: Oman Flour Mills Co. (OFMC)

records.title: India and Oman have unveiled a roadmap to strengthen their cooperation across various sectors, including green energy, maritime affairs,...
records.description: India and Oman have unveiled a roadmap to strengthen their cooperation across various sectors, including green energy, maritime affairs, digital payments, agriculture, and food security. These agreements were reached during a meeting between India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Oman's Sultan Haitham in New Delhi. Both countries are also fast-tracking negotiations on a comprehensive economic partnership agreement to boost bilateral trade. The expansion of this partnership aligns with Oman's Vision 2040 and India's development goals, reflecting their shared commitment to enhancing economic ties and trade relations. The two nations have witnessed significant growth in their bilateral trade and investment relationship, with India ranking among Oman's top trading partners.
records.institution: Omani Government

records.title: Saudi Arabia's state wheat buying agency, GFSA, has issued an international tender to purchase approximately 715,000 metric tons of milli...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's state wheat buying agency, GFSA, has issued an international tender to purchase approximately 715,000 metric tons of milling wheat between February and May 2024. The tender seeks hard wheat with 12.5% protein content, sourced from optional origins in 12 consignments, mostly of 60,000 tons each. The consignments are intended for arrival in different Saudi ports, including Jeddah, Yanbu, Dammam, and Jizan, within specific timeframes. The GFSA reserves the right to buy 10% more or less than the standard 60,000-ton consignment size. This tender is part of Saudi Arabia's efforts to secure its wheat supply. In the last reported international wheat tender in June, Saudi Arabia purchased 624,000 tons of wheat.
records.institution: Saudi GFSA

records.title: Investments in the aquaculture sector are set to flourish as Saudi Arabia and China explore opportunities for growth and collaboration at...
records.description: Investments in the aquaculture sector are set to flourish as Saudi Arabia and China explore opportunities for growth and collaboration at the Global Investment Promotion Conference in Shenzhen, China. Representatives from Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture engaged with over 60 specialized Chinese firms to expand the aquaculture sector's prospects. This initiative aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 plan to diversify the economy and generate employment opportunities through the production of 600,000 tons of fish annually. By fostering expertise exchange and private sector involvement, this partnership aims to bolster economic cooperation and job creation while enhancing the sustainability of the aquaculture industry.
records.institution: Saudi Arabian Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia is continuing its efforts to become a tourism powerhouse with the launch of the "Dan Company," an organization under the sov...
records.description: Saudi Arabia is continuing its efforts to become a tourism powerhouse with the launch of the "Dan Company," an organization under the sovereign wealth fund aimed at promoting and developing agritourism and eco-tourism. The first project by Dan will be situated in the Al Ahsa region, covering 1.8 million square meters and featuring an eco-resort, agri-resort, and adventure resort. The initiative is expected to contribute approximately $1.6 billion (SAR 6 billion) to Saudi Arabia's non-oil GDP by 2030, with a focus on offering travelers "traditional farming experiences" in the Gulf state. The Public Investment Fund (PIF) sees Dan as a means to stimulate economic development, integrate sustainability, and involve the private sector and local farmers in agritourism and ecotourism. PIF, chaired by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman, has substantial assets, making it a key player in financing various tourism projects in the country, such as ski resorts, mega-yacht hubs, archipelagos, and entertainment-focused cities.
records.institution: Saudi Public Investment Fund (PIF)

records.title: Stella Okotete, the Executive Director of Business Development at the Nigeria Export – Import Bank, visited Qatar to explore opportunitie...
records.description: Stella Okotete, the Executive Director of Business Development at the Nigeria Export – Import Bank, visited Qatar to explore opportunities for boosting bilateral trade between Qatar and Nigeria. She highlighted the potential for job creation and food security in both countries through strong partnerships. The trade volume between the two nations has steadily grown, reaching QAR 298 million in 2023, with cashew nuts being a significant export. Okotete emphasized Nigeria's commitment to economic reforms, including diversifying the non-oil sector, under President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's leadership. She sees these reforms as an investment in global peace and prosperity, with the potential to create over 40 million jobs for Nigerians. Okotete has a background in humanitarian work and women's empowerment, aiming to improve livelihoods and quality of life in her community and beyond.
records.institution: Nigeria Export – Import Bank
